author: Joshua Fields
review_text: An excellent operation with a chill vibe and a creative menu, taking amazing meals up a notch in unique ways. The Tartare Crostini is well formed and very flavorful, the salad’s cream and seasonings took some mixing up to get used to but that was good. Brown butter Crab with bread was great, and my two favorite starters the Grilled Octopus and the Seafood Rice. The octopus had perfect char and a sweet delicious taste paired great with the egg. The Seafood Rice was a great blend of fish stocked rice and cold fish as a topping. Then the Pork Collar, I loved this it’s a perfect preparation. Great portion with a beautiful seasoned top layer and a wonderful fatty center. We didn’t care much for the side, which for a dish this pricey you’d like solid side as a base but this gets a pass. Lastly to finish off the Panna Cotta was straight up great, safest dessert option.

author: Justin Godbout
review_text: Bravo. I’ve determined that this would officially be my last meal. Everything was perfect. The restaurant itself is super cosy. The service was excellent, relaxed. The food was interesting and flavourful. We tried a number of fun wines that paired well our food. My only complaint is how hard it was to get a reservation 😆

author: Nomadicus
review_text: Four Horsemen feels like stumbling into a very well kept secret that somehow never tries to impress you… and still does. I decided to try getting in without a reservation and luckily they thoughtfully keep bar and window seats available for walk-ins. The best approach is to line up right when the kitchen opens, or wait until the initial 5pm dinner rush tapers off and secure a seat at the bar. The dining room is quietly romantic but a bit snug nonetheless creating a relaxed, understated atmosphere. Service is genuinely warm and technically precise without a hint of theatrics, striking an ideal balance of professionalism and ease. The menu consists of tapas-style plates that are intentionally restrained. With minimal ingredients and thoughtful execution, each dish allows the quality of the product to shine rather than relying on excess or embellishment. The result is food that feels confident, focused, and deeply satisfying. Four Horsemen is refined without feeling formal, and thoughtful without being precious, making it a place worth the effort, even on short notice.

author: Meredith Oliver
review_text: I enjoyed Four Horsemen, but it didn't blow my mind for the price. If I went again, I'd stick to the small plates so I could try more things. The chicken was good, but not great and it was huge. Their menu changes on a regular basis, so you can't be sure what you're going to get. Nothing I had was bad. Wagyu crostini and harimasa (not pictured) were my favorites. I arrived at 10:45am, and waited for them to open at 11. A line formed quickly, and it's a slow process for them to seat everyone in their tiny space. If you can't get a reservation, show up as early as you can.

author: brandi brady
review_text: I really enjoyed every bite and the service was great! the server had lots of great suggestions on food & pairings. we were a party of 4, walk in. for me, it makes it extra special when you stand in line for a seat & secure it in the first seatings. the hiramasa & green tomatoes are my fav, the glazed beetroot & mushroom toast were great. the mackerel was good, it didn’t knock my socks off the way everything else did. looking forward to when I can get over there for lunch!

author: Mohamed Izlanshah
review_text: exceptional. dare i say one of the best meals ive had in my life. from start to finish every bite and every sip is so well thought out, so stunning and so so delicious. complicated flavours served in a non pretentious setting, laid back sunday lunch in the best restaurant in brooklyn. life changing stuff.

author: Patrick K
review_text: Michelin star wine bar? Yes pls! But people come here for the food. Impossible to snag a resy but worth waiting for a walk in spot at lunch or before dinner service. Vibe cozy and cute. Food was amazing! Small menu but basically every dish was a hit. Also the wine selection was well curated. Verdict: recommend and will return!!

author: Lili McFarlane
review_text: Not a single miss. Everything was standout, flavors are thought provoking. For 2 people we shared the mushroom toast, fennel salad, bread, hiramasa, pork collar, and halibut. Toffee pudding for dessert. Portions are smaller but with this order we left full. Service was excellent especially for recommending wine.

author: Sally Nguyen
review_text: This restaurant is overrated, and I honestly don’t understand how it has held a Michelin star for several years. It’s definitely not worth the price. The portions are tiny, the flavors were either far too salty or overly acidic. Despite spending over $200 for just five dishes for 3 people , none of us left feeling satisfied. On top of that, getting a reservation here is unnecessarily difficult. For the same price, we had a much better experience at Theodora, which doesn’t even have a Michelin star but served food that was both delicious and filling. Save your time and money—skip this place and go somewhere else.

author: Delphica Sibyl
review_text: The Four Horsemen - finally 😊 My husband and I have been devoted LCD Soundsystem fans for years, so the fact that James Murphy co-founded this place has always made it feel like a small dream waiting to happen. We’d been postponing it for weeks, as life has a way of reshuffling plans, but this time my husband said, 'This is your birthday and that’s it. We’re going.' I agreed ;) The restaurant itself is small, understated, and effortlessly elegant. The interior has that kind of simple chic that feels authentic: warm wood, soft light, no pretense. We didn’t have a reservation but decided to take a chance, and after waiting about thirty minutes, we got a table right after 5:20 pm The menu is tiny, almost minimalist, but every dish feels deeply considered. We weren’t too hungry, so we ordered a few small plates and a bottle of wine, saving room for dessert and hoping for a candle later. And the food… oh, the food. I’m not sure words can do it justice. Every bite was a perfect balance of acid, sweetness, and texture. I’m from wine and vinegar country, so I truly appreciate the taste of acidity and here, I finally found a place in New York that speaks to my palate. Their flavors don’t fade the moment you swallow; they linger, evolve, and make you think. I couldn’t help but notice almost everyone around us was ordering their famous warm bread, it looked absolutely divine. But since I bake my own bread at home and had already had a fresh loaf that morning, we decided to skip it this time. Still, it clearly seemed to be the must of the evening, and I’ll definitely try it on our next visit. The wine list is impressive. We chose a French white that was absolutely balanced, bright, and beautifully alive (and no headache after!). And the desserts… I’m still dreaming about the passionfruit cake, so light, tangy, and joyful. I was especially happy that nobody from the staff sang 'Happy Birthday.' ❤️ As for the staff, 'perfect' doesn’t even begin to describe their service. They have that rare ability to make you feel both taken care of and completely at ease. The atmosphere, the music, the people, the vibe: 10 out of 10, or maybe 100 out of 100. To Be Continued :))

author: Marvin Fuentes
review_text: The four horsemen has to be one of the best dining experiences I’ve been to this year. Everything was exquisite from the presentation to the music. But all the credit has to go to our Bartender Will; his knowledge of wine and bitters and amaro is renowned with some of the best in the game. Sit at the bar and thank me later

author: AC Slater
review_text: Can't wait to return. Everything was incredible, especially the oeuf mayonnaise- which is forever engrained in my memory as one of my favorite bites anywhere. Queued up 30 minutes before opening and the line filled up FAST

author: Noe Amighini
review_text: The experience was bad from the start, when they seated us at a bar facing the street next to the entrance door, which opened every two minutes and froze us. There were four empty seats at the other bar, and we asked to change, but they said no, that they were busy, even though no one was sitting there. On the other hand, the food is scarce and not very tasty for what they charge, especially for a restaurant that is supposedly recommended by Michelin. We ordered rice with seafood, and it was almost impossible to find. For starters, we had mayonnaise eggs that were cold!!! They didn't warn us, they were tiny, not incredible and the price was extremely high. In conclusion, if you want to eat ordinary food, meager portions, nothing particularly sophisticated in terms of flavor, and pay a fortune... this is the place! Oh, the bread was very good!

author: Jack Bekos
review_text: One of my favorite meals in NYC this year. Every dish was a dream. We ordered the oeuf, green tomatoes, fennel salad, tartare, mushroom toast and rainbow trout. Latter two were our favorites. The passion fruit tart dessert was magical. The best part? The wildly inventive wine list that paired perfectly with every bite. Service was great and homey, intimate setting was wonderful. Expensive but worth it for a special occasion.

author: Maria
review_text: Tiny spot known for his extensive wine list and ever-changing (short) menu. We started with the bread and clams which pairs perfectly together - thanks to the suggestion of our waitress. Next we had the green tomatoes dish which was our favorite by far as it was packed with so much flavor and seasoned to perfection. We finished with the Golden Rice topped with Uni which was delicious as well. Highly recommend this Michelin star spot for a date night! *Resys are a must unless you get there right at 5pm and get a bar or window seat

author: Khoi Pham
review_text: Interestingly enough, my personal favorites were the smaller dishes rather than the larger ones. Notably, the oeuf mayonnaise and the warm house bread (the butter especially) were great. Otherwise, everything else was fine although nothing too particularly memorable. The staff is very attentive and helpful. The vibes are lively but also serene, which I like.

author: Audreanna
review_text: Some dishes were fantastic while others weren’t. The summer squash was drowning in Beurre Blanc and rather gross. The fried crab was soggy. The pork shoulder was delicious. The service was overall good but slow. Their wine selection is one of my favorite things about the experiences. Overall I found the four horsemen to be mid for this type of restaurant and expectation.

author: Yulia Shekeladze
review_text: everything was delicious (although deep fried mackerel wasn’t out favourite, it had a very fishy taste) and this place absolutely deserves the hype. also we went without reservation, i got in line at 4:45 (saturday night) to put my name down for a group of 3 and we were seated at 7:30, so it is definitely possible.

author: Jennifer Lee
review_text: Finally getting around to writing this, but The Four Horsemen really lived up to the hype. The place is super cozy and welcoming. Our server was awesome and gave us great wine recs that perfectly complemented the food. Everything we ate was seriously delicious—you can tell they put a lot of thought into every dish.

author: Julie Geng
review_text: This was my third visit to The Four Horsemen since June 2024, and sadly, it was a sharp departure from the consistently excellent experiences I’ve had in the past. The quality of the food has noticeably declined. They no longer serve the signature seared yellowfin tuna. The skewer was aggressively spicy, overwhelming rather than enhancing the flavor. The Gen clam dish came across as bland. The swordfish was dry and overcooked. Even the egg appetizer that people rave about felt uninspired. Equally disappointing was the service behind the bar. The bartenders were visibly drinking while serving us, and one even spat into the sink right in front of us while we were eating. That kind of disregard for basic professionalism and hygiene. It’s disheartening to see such a reputable place slip so far in both culinary quality and hospitality. I hope this was an off night, but given the steep drop in standards, I’m hesitant to return anytime

author: KrisKat Meow
review_text: Came here because I know Coach House to be opened late. After a little change, the renovations are lovely. Martin was our server and he was attentive. The trio appetizer and burgers were delicious. Will be back to try the rest of the menu!

author: sarah bender
review_text: came here on a whim, the first time since the remodel.. and WOW! Martin was our server, he was super accommodating and kind. We ordered the tomahawk steak and 2 salads and everything was prepared perfectly. We will definitely be back.

author: Jillian Perez
review_text: I genuinely liked Coach House. In the beginning they were good and consistent. Lately food quality and quantity has been disappointing. Also I have had a few issues with take out orders. Today I placed an order for delivery. I ordered a cheeseburger deluxe (photo attached). $14 for this and look at the amount of fries given. That’s ridiculous. There were barely any fries. Also, you receive different fries every time. Sometimes it’s crinkle fries, then sometimes it’s regular fries. I used to order breakfast, and as part of breakfast you would get toast, 2 slices. Now you receive 1 slice of toast that is barely even toasted. Why only 1 slice of toast? That’s so odd. Another time I called to place a takeout order and was told that I wasn’t “allowed” to order a kids chicken fingers for takeout for my daughter. I then asked to speak to a manager because what kind of ridiculous policy is that. The manager I spoke with ended up accommodating but she also asked if it was for a child. I guess you’re not allowed to order kids chicken fingers because they think an adult is getting it for themselves. Regardless, if I want to get chicken fingers and I’m paying for it, what does it matter? The next situation I had was just last week, where I ordered grilled chicken and a side of home fries. When I went to pick it up, I was asked if I have ordered that before, which I have. Then I was told that I wasn’t “allowed” to order grilled chicken. At this point I’m annoyed because I’ve already had previous issues with Coach House. I then wait to speak with the manager and I was told that I needed to order a grilled chicken dinner and not a side of grilled chicken. Well put it on the menu then. My husband has stomach issues and can only eat a handful of things and he likes the grilled chicken. But yet I wasn’t allowed to order that? That’s absurd. My guess is because it was charged as a side and not a whole $20 meal. It’s disappointing because I genuinely liked Coach House. Lately though, all of these issues make me not want to order from them anymore or even go there. Coach House please do better. I have been a customer for years, this is not the level of service that one should be given.

author: Aury Ortiz- Rivera
review_text: Hosted my best friends proposal in the Red Room & everything came out perfect !! Diana and Elena accommodated all our needs & our server Julius was super attentive. We had a delicious dinner & a great time celebrating our friend. The restaurant itself was beautifully decorated for Christmas !! Would recommend 100% and will definitely be coming back for dinner.

author: Sarah Bolano
review_text: I guess I’m just disappointed. I grew up in Jersey City Heights and often went to coach house with my family. They definitely improved the atmosphere, but I would say overall, the food was just…decent. For me, I say, if it ain’t broke, don’t fix it. This was a community staple for years and when I was there I heard other patrons complaining about the fact that the place and food were so different. The starting bread was stale, the pizza was 5/10, the lobster bisque was 5/10, the lobster ravioli I had was pretty good though! 7.5/10. I think the price was fair considering that both my husband and I got lobster. I brought my two kids and it didn’t feel family friendly at all. It was extremely quiet, and they gave us a coloring page for my son but had no crayons. Not sure if it’s the nostalgia, but I just feel the old coach house was better /: either way, best of luck to these new owners.

author: A. S. T.
review_text: Excellent menu, great prices, live music on Friday nights. The Cabernet Sauvignon that was served was exquisite. The only things that bothered me was that the wild mushrooms croquettes (pictured) were actually just mashed potatoes, and the tacky violinist playing tacky music for an hour between the live jazz sets. Luckily the friends I invited for the jazz act had a good attitude.

author: Kim Tannu
review_text: I needed a restaurant for a repast, I had less than 3 days to book a place and the amount of people went from 30-50 to 75-80. Diana was amazing, she worked with me on the menu to accommodate the few vegetarians we had and was able to work out final details and get me all the paperwork via email and texts so I didn't have to drive there. She was professional, responsive and easy to work with. I had dined at the old Coach House Diner many times but never at CH Steakhouse and was nervous about the quality but the food was delicious! Everything was well seasoned and all th entrees came with mashed potatoes and vegetables. It was such a large crowd yet the filet mignon was cooked perfectly. Those that ordered the Dill Salmon and Chicken Marsala also enjoyed their meals. The onion soup I had to begin the meal and cheesecake that ended the meal were also wonderful. Even the cabernet that was included in our package was so much better than I expected. Our section's server, Albert was amazing and did everything in his power to make sure everyone was taken care of. I could not ask for a better experience especially on such short notice. It was well worth the price. Next time I'm in that area, I will definitely book a table!

author: Modern Spin 7410 Broadway
review_text: Came here for my God father’s repass dinner. Over 50 ppl and i must say they were amazing. Both service and food was impeccable. Very impressive menu and dessert was scrumptious! Highly recommend. Although ill miss my chicken fingers and fries at 3am , the transition to fine dining was a great change. Well done. Coming from another restaurant owner..

author: William Roldan (xoll75)
review_text: The food was amazing. Everything came out fresh and delicious. Very friendly customer service. The servers and staff were excellent!

author: A Eng
review_text: Our party of 16 arrived for a 10:30 dinner. We were seated quickly with tables prepared for our big party. The interior of the place was nice and renovated. It's probably the nicest diner I've been to. The staff was great and the food came out hot. I was impressed with the food and service. Parking was available too which helped with family who drove in from out of town. This diner wasn't my top choice for a late celebration, but I'm glad we gave this place a chance because we will be back for breakfast and future celebrations.

author: Norma Medina
review_text: First time returning after renovations, whole experience made us feel very welcome Julius our server was really kind and generous! Chef George rocks at the food! Will definitely come again 1 million times over

author: Stephany Rivas
review_text: Great food, loved my salad, lobster bisque and my drink. 10 out of 10, Coachhouse has gotten an upgrade and I’m here for it

author: Lizbeth suarez
review_text: The venue is beautiful both inside and out. The food is exceptional; I devoured my plate—it was delicious! The server was very friendly and attentive, checking on us multiple times during our visit. The bathroom is impressive as well, featuring a baby diaper changing room and easy access. Additionally, they have a bar and a VIP room, and the space is quite large.

author: Jocelyn Herrera
review_text: First time passing by after it being remodeled and honestly loved it. Place looked very cute! Music was definitely a vibe && Martin our server was amazing !!

author: Joseline Sosa
review_text: I would like to start by saying my rating has nothing to do with the people that work there they were professional and nice people, my rating is because of the menu, im so disappointed in the change the made the menu options are terrible and to the point where the table next to me walked away. Do not recommend this place. Looks nice though.

author: Anthony Gangaram
review_text: Martin was amazing! Couch house has constantly adapted to the times and looks amazing these days! New menu is great and I recommend their angel envy's old fashion

author: Carlos Cuello
review_text: I’ve been going to Coach House for decades now. My first time there was in 1987 or 1988. God I loved this place. It was my daughter’s favorite spot to go eat. Throughout the years the food quality and service declined. As I was parking the car to go in there, I called my daughter to let her know that I was there. She told me her last time there was not a good experience and that she would never go back. I got upset but we had parked the car sans we were hungry. From the very beginning, the upgrades were extremely noticeable, the service exceeded any expectation that I may have had. Isaac, our server went above and beyond. Nothing was forced, it came naturally to him. If you could clone Isaac that place will never fail any patron. Without writing anything down, he remembered every detail of our appetizers, main course and the many different desserts with specific requests that all 3 of us had. This place is back on my to go back and eat again list. He didn’t even mention anything to us about writing him a review but his service was 5 stars. The cappuccino and the simple but classy strawberry cheesecake drizzled with chocolate syrup was to die for. The pistachio cheesecake with pistachio ice cream was delicious and presentation on point. Extremely elegant! The raspberry white chocolate cheesecake was extremely delicious. What a great experience. Again, kudos to Isaac for making our experience there a great one. Can’t wait to go back!!!

author: John Acosta
review_text: The food was delicious and the service was super fast. Our waiter Julius was very nice and super helpful. He was very attentive and made us feel welcome. The new look and atmosphere of this diner is so beautiful and chic. I’ll definitely be back!

author: Emtalvarado@gmail.com Alvarado
review_text: Great place for family and friends to hang out. The food was amazing and the staff one of a kind. Highly recommend.

author: Carmen Guerra
review_text: My godmother and I had a delicious fish with mash potatoes and vegetables. Then we tried a tasty dessert (mango sorbet), which was amazing. The service was spectacular!

author: Esg
review_text: Today we came to Fusta restaurant for a family birthday. Such a great time. The service was great, Nazar was very attentive,friendly and kind,he gave such a great service. The food was super good. This place is a must come if you are in the area. The atmosphere was nice,calm. It's not so big inside but is worth it. Great for any type of event. We all order different dish and everything was super good..I order skirt steak,spinach and mashed potatoes. Super delicious. The calamari also very good..usually I order this on other places and the calamari is always extremely fried like rubber not here. Totally recomend this place and I would definitely visit again. You can get an idea of some of the dish below..ahh let's not mention for the coffee lovers like me,my expresso shot is a must, super good. Note: the calamari is serve with lettuce but we ask no lettuce just the calamari.

author: Neftali Marrero
review_text: LA FUSTA was a bustaa. Sorry to say, but this was my first time going to this establishment, which I saw many good reviews, so I believe that because of the special day being sunday(MOTHER'S DAY).they were not well prepared for so much confusion,so I'm rating my bad experience on one day,but I will be back to try and give a better review on a slower day.For one was a small place and parking was challenging on tonelle Avenue, in new jersey.for this particular day.It started off with 2 waiters coming for our orders ,we told the second waiter that we put our order of drinks and appetizers with the first waiter. Never served the bread,butter, or the famous chimi churi sauce.i believe you have to pay for bottle water because they never brought regular water out,so we continued to ask for more bottled water 💧 cause it goes fast in our party.lol..the appetizers were not bad but as you look at the picture of the fried calamari plate it was more lettuce than calamari ( a rabbit would've enjoyed that dish) they must've been running short on calamari. Another suggestion if when ordering grilled Argentinian meat plate and you don't eat intestines, ask for no intestines cause it brings the most,and one of other meats which have to say were very good. Plus, the chimi churi sauce was delicious. As well as the salad was plenty with all you can imagine and very healthy and delicious. Oh yes,and the shrimp soup was not bad. My Personal recommendation is this place to book on holidays or special occasions not recommended maybe on a regular day they might be better 🤔.we paid over $200, not worth it .Sorry to say very expensive, but it was a special day, and they also had another limited menu, not their regular menu.

author: Pa Papi
review_text: If you want the best freshest Authentic Argentine food you MUST stop by here and ask for Pablo. He greeted me with a big warm smile took me to the best table with a view of their TV’s and the service was best Cloth with table cloth and they serve Alcohol for those that might want to try some of De best Wine

author: corenzo wilkerson
review_text: Beautiful spot It's looked in maybe not so beautiful place on route 1 &9. But there is parking lot. The service is very good the staff is attentive. The food is amazing the steaks melt in your mouth. The sausages are exploding 🤯 with flavor so delicious 🤤. The ribs are delicious. We had several side all were great. If your in the mood for steak 🥩.

author: Cindy W
review_text: We ended up at this restaurant after our flight was canceled. It was a delightful surprise! We arrived about 30 minutes before the restaurant was due to close, but the servers and live music welcomed us warmly. Kevin was very friendly and recommended some dishes for us. The two of us shared some empanadas and a smaller portion of the mixed grill. The mixed grill was enormous, with a portion large enough for at least four people! The steaks were perfectly cooked to medium rare, and the sweet bread was delicious (even though I am usually not a fan). It was the perfect dish to share and taste a bit of everything! If you love steak, this is the place to be!

author: Dalesca castro
review_text: Amazing personal, Lucas our server the manager and the other caleño guy 🫂🫂🫂 excellent 🙏🏼🙏🏼great fresh food you feel the quality really tasty😋, perfect place if you like feel at home and at the same time being cared for by the staff it’s wow. It’s classic 🙌🏽🙏🏼👍

author: Dina Gamez
review_text: Lovely place. Nazar was a great waiter! Cute too 😋 Overall great food. Just a little bit warm inside.

author: O' Neill Morales
review_text: Amazing food! Amazing people! Amazing service! Amazing atmosphere! This place so far has been the best restaurant I've ever been to, compared to other high-end restaurants I've been to. Prices are reasonable, I expected it to be more expensive due to the great quality and service. The food was amazing, so good that I forgot to take pictures of it. But at least I captured the dessert. And on the weekends they have live music, very beautiful classic music as you'll see on the video. So take your wife, girlfriend, mother or significant other here and you'll both leave happy. You won't regret it!

author: Rene Munoz
review_text: This review is written after speaking with a person who frequents Argentina as his father is born and raised in Argentina. The main focus was the meat, as that's what Argentina is known for. I was excited about it since my family has been butchers for generations. I asked the mixed grilled meats, medium well. A week later, I still tasted the charred exterior, the lack of flavors, and the meat was over-cooked. The decor is full of Argentina soccer glories and televisions displaying the baseball world classic. The fried Calamari was not memorable and bland. The only thing worth the price was the mashed potato. Overall, it was overpriced and not worth a second visit. Over $200!! The service took too long to take our orders, and rarely did they ask us if we needed anything.

author: John John
review_text: First, I will say this is not a WHITE TABLE CLOTH Resteraunt, but the tablecloths are white, The Resteraunt name really says a lot because they WHIP your food up. I've been to many. This food was terrible. I will never go to this restaurant again or anything close to it. The chicken empanada was terrible poor qualiy. I couldn't even pick it up because it was soggy. So I needed a fork to eat my empanadas????? Never had an Empanada like that, and I've eaten all over the world. Beef empanada was fried more appropriate, but the beef used was poor quality. The spinach empanada was clearly the one that you see coming out the shell it wasn't good either. Next , the shrimps in garlic sauce a total of 6 for 22.50, which was also horrible, and a side order of spinach was not edible. I couldn't eat it. I literally couldn't swallow the food. And a bottle of pellegrino cost 8.25? That cost 4 times the amount as one bottle in a 12 pack. Then they rush you to leave. The waiter didn't have an understanding of the menu. For example, if you dont have something available on the menu what is the most popular dish or anything you suggest is the job of the waiter. The waiters and staff did not speak english enough to suggest anything in the menu. White Table Cloth Restaurants don't have 5 to 8 men waiters and busboys standing by the bar talking. Nobody greets you at the door. They greet you at Applebee's. For those who have eaten at AUTHENTIC WHITE TABLE CLOTH RESTAURANTS knows this is a 2.5 star restaurant at best. There's an OUTBACK STEAKHOUSE not too far from this place that's probably better. Oh yeah, I forgot the bread was good.

author: Ed Steell
review_text: Wow very nice place.. I've lived in the area for years and it wasn't until last week that I realized this restaurant is the best, great atmosphere, good prices, excellent food, I highly recommend it.

author: Carlos Mennea
review_text: My wife and I recently visited La Fusta for the Copa America final, and it was our first time dining there. Despite the hectic night, the staff was incredibly friendly and attentive. We ordered a mix of empanadas (carne/beef, spinach, and jamon y queso/ham and cheese), a mixed salad, and milanesa completas. The prices were more than fair and actually cheaper than some other Argentine steakhouses in NJ. The quality and taste of the food were superb—everything tasted fresh and was seasoned to perfection. Although we didn’t get a chance to try their parillada, which they are known for, we will definitely be returning soon!

author: Erika Armstead
review_text: Great food excellent service! Nasa was an amazing server! Answered all my questions thoroughly!

author: Javier Otero
review_text: Great food and atmosphere and awesome service. Definitely I will come back soon. 100% Recommended.

author: leslie paredes
review_text: really nice place to go to. Service here was good and especially the food ! Walking out I loved that I was able to see them feed stray cats it shows that the restaurant cares about their customers and the less fortunate ❤️.

author: hector coyoy
review_text: Service was top notch 👌 the waitress were so nice and the food was cook as we asked.

author: Jade Reviews
review_text: My family and I had an excellent time here. My oldest even found some vegetarian options to our surprise.

author: Christian G
review_text: Wow!! What a great find!!! Food was amazing, servers were even better. This is a hidden GEM in NJ. Highly recommend you visit and enjoy the high quality food. I ordered the skirt steak and parrilla. Bought some wine and the waiters were very attentive. Absolutely loved this place.

author: Mark Coletta
review_text: This is a hidden gem the food is always good and our family enjoys the different steaks great Argentina Restaurant and the staff is always very attentive.

author: Mercedes Landeta
review_text: Service is kind and food is exquisite! The cow feet soup remind me of the one my Mom does it was delicious👌🏼😋 we will always get back when we crave for “parrillada Argentina 🇦🇷!!! Sangria was also the perfect match 🥳

author: Emily Litman
review_text: A friend took me here to celebrate my birthday. The ambience is understated elegance with a touch of whimsy with the presentation of the cocktails and food. I really enjoyed the shrimp arepa bowl and steak with onions. We had 2 cocktails, one appetizer and the two entrees for about $90. Everything tasted great and the service was friendly and professional. I hope to return soon!

author: Victor Hernandez
review_text: I’ve visited this restaurant several times and always enjoyed it, but on this occasion I noticed the quality has gone down a bit. Food quality: The Caesar salad had no dressing and the garlic shrimp lacked seasoning also. The sides of tostones were old, they just heated up a little. I truly hope they bring back the great flavor and freshness that used to set them apart because I’ve always liked this place, but they definitely need to fix something with the kitchen staff. On the other side… They have a very good customer service, what always makes us return there. The beautiful host Camila was very kind and find us a comfortable table. And our server Richard was attentive and kind. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Prices 💰: For such a fancy place, the prices are very suitable to your pocket, we had 2 main course, 2 no alcoholic drinks, one appetizer and a salad for $53 excluding the tip. Which is not bad at all.

author: Catalina Leuro-Rey
review_text: I had high expectations for this restaurant — the social media posts made it look very appealing. To start, I tried to make a reservation, but there were no openings, so I was advised to arrive and wait, which I did with my family. Parking was quite difficult even though there’s valet service, since the space fills up quickly, so we ended up parking on the street after driving around for a while. The decoration and presentation of the dishes were very creative and visually appealing. We ordered the Venezuelan Sampler, which allowed us to try five different items. For our main courses, we had the Arepa La Venezolana, Arepa Manjar Llanero, and the Classic Pabellón. Unfortunately, the meat for all of the entrees were very tough, which we mentioned to our waiter. He was very polite and offered to replace the dish, but by that point we weren’t in the mood for anything else. We hope to have a better experience with the food next time, as the concept and atmosphere truly stand out.

author: Nolan Rizzo
review_text: This restaurant is exceptional! This is hands down our best meal my wife and I had on our vacation. The atmosphere, Service and Food were all wonderful! Our waiter Luis was so nice and helpful walking us through the menu and giving us recommendations which were perfect! My wife ordered the Maracaibo sampler which gives you a little bit of everything and it was delicious! Luis walked us through everything that came with the sampler. I ordered the Patacon Apollo Mechado and it was incredible! To finish off this awesome meal we ordered the flan and it was the best I have ever had. We enjoyed our experience so much we made reservations to eat here again before we leave. Thank you Luis for our wonderful experience. We will be back for the service and food!

author: danny velez
review_text: Of all the things to say about this place, I'll start by saying that the food is great, the atmosphere is great, and the portion sizes are great. This place is all about getting that perfect picture for Instagram but without compromising on taste. All their drinks come in special glass. The food is delicious. The wait times aren't too bad, though sometimes it appears like they're completely packed (cause that parking situation is bad). Speaking of parking, they have valet as well. Pass by and enjoy great food with a great staff at great prices, especially if you've never had typical Venezuelan food.

author: Jo Gu
review_text: The experience was great, it was really a piece of Venezuela in New Jersey. We had the example as an appetizer, then we had soup, pabellon and patacon everything tasty and delicious; for dessert cabello de Angel tres leches cake wow definitely recommended.

author: Natasha Reyes
review_text: This restaurant and it’s staff has been the best by far I’ve ever been to and that’s including Disney! Our waiter Jose Gonzalez was absolutely attentive and did it all with warmth and welcoming hospitality. The food is all delicious! Can’t wait to come back

author: Mike V
review_text: I had the best experience celebrating my mom’s birthday at Maracaibo Restaurant in Union City! From the moment we walked in, the service was warm, welcoming, and attentive — they truly made us feel like family. The food was absolutely delicious, full of flavor, and came out fresh and perfectly prepared. On top of that, the prices were very reasonable, which made the evening even better. The staff went above and beyond to make my mom’s special day memorable, and we couldn’t have asked for a more perfect celebration. If you’re looking for a place with amazing service, great prices, and outstanding food, I highly recommend Maracaibo. We’ll definitely be back! 🎉👏

author: Interstellar Productions
review_text: Food was low quality and bland with no flavor, whoever the chef is has got no creativity on his food, it was dishes one expects at a fast food truck. Plato Navideño ; Waiter was rude instead of helpful and made a rude comment telling me he didn’t care. This is when I told him the salad was too small of a portion for the price of almost $30. It was the chicken salad. The hallaca had no flavor on it’s stew and corn flour. I would give it 1 out of 10. And the Ham bread it was the smallest two slices i ever received in any restaurant. Listen you are not Gourmet , it’s street food value food and by putting it in a fancy carousel Does not make it fancy . Small portions don’t help either unless you’re running out of business and are portioning your budget. Maracaibo Parrilla , it was small boring and nothing fancy but it’s decor. The Sopa de Lenteja; was bit watery and miss the flavor it was meant to have. It did have pork for smokiness. Nothing good or fancy about it. Almost bland. Try some flavor meat stock instead of water to get that intended flavor. Or let it cook little longer to get the lentils to become thicker and flavors to come throughout. Desserts were the typical boring what you expect from a food truck , I didn’t bother to waste my time with another flan or tres leches. Be original and invent this old recipes and turn them into fusion beauties. Overall food was bland and missed the mark, and the poor portions in pretending to be a fancy Michelin restaurant its failed missionary. They spend more money on the look which attract young audiences of a tick tock and Instagram flair. And finally just another Venezuelan restaurant playing with the nostalgia of those who seek an authentic flavor.

author: Cynthia Salamanca
review_text: 5-Star Review for Maracaibo I had an absolutely spectacular experience at Maracaibo and can’t stop thinking about how perfect the evening was from start to finish. Everything from the moment we arrived to the final farewell felt thoughtfully curated and genuinely guest-centric. Service Alex Valencia** was beyond amazing. From the moment we sat down, he exuded warmth, attentiveness, and a remarkable amount of knowledge about the menu and pairings. He anticipated our needs before we even realized them—refilling drinks without being asked, recommending dishes tailored to our preferences, and sharing little stories about the ingredients and origins behind each plate. His troubleshooting for a dietary preference without compromising flavor was flawless: he suggested alternative preparations that maintained the integrity and style of the dishes we loved. He checked in at just the right intervals, offering gracious pauses between courses so we could fully savor the experience. Alex’s genuine enthusiasm for the cuisine and for ensuring we had a memorable night shone through in every interaction. He treated us like VIP guests and left us feeling warmly cared for long after the check was settled. Food The menu showcased a masterful balance of bold flavors and thoughtful technique. Every course felt intentional and cohesive with the overall dining narrative. Star dishes included [insert standout dishes if you know them], each delivered with precise execution: vibrant textures, harmonious seasonings, and impressive presentation. The pacing was perfect. Courses arrived in a rhythm that allowed us to appreciate the artistry without feeling rushed, and the kitchen’s timing was consistently on point. Venue The venue is truly stunning—an atmosphere that feels both inviting and refined. The interior design, lighting, and acoustics contributed to a warm, celebratory mood without being stuffy. The dining room offers a sense of intimacy while still feeling expansive, and the ambient music complemented our conversation rather than competing with it. The bar area deserves special mention for its chic vibe and the bartender’s flair—great craft cocktails and carefully chosen wine pairings that elevated each course. Overall Experience From the welcome to the farewell, the entire Maracaibo experience was elevated, professional, and joy-filled. The staff’s attentiveness, the cuisine’s sophistication, and the venue’s beauty combine to create a rare, memorable evening. If you’re looking for a dining experience that excels in hospitality, flavor, and atmosphere, Maracaibo is a standout choice and definitely a 5-star destination. We left inspired by the care and passion evident at every touchpoint, and we’re already planning our next visit to relive this special night. Recommendation Highly recommend asking for Alex Valencia by name when you book for an extra layer of personalized service. Consider the tasting menu or chef’s specials to truly savor the kitchen’s breadth and depth. If you have dietary needs or celebrations, share them in advance; the team is incredibly accommodating and will tailor the experience to you. In short: Maracaibo delivered a flawless, memorable evening. Five stars all the way!!!!! Los Amo!!!

author: Mariana Raquel
review_text: This is a must try! I’m from Maracaibo, Venezuela🥹 This place is the best Venezuelan restaurant that I have tried in my 4 years living in New York. Went with my family to celebrate my brother’s birthday, drinks were amazing, had a Polar negra, had the Cara-Caracas and a cepillao (This one came with music, made me feel at home). We shared the Mcbo-sampler to start, my favs were the mini Cachapas and the tequeños. Then we had main course, I shared an arroz chinozuela (20/20), I tried the asado negro, patacón de pernil and we also shared the Parrillada Maracaibo. Everything was delicious, atmosphere and playlist were amazing, staff were super kind and attentive with me and my family, they even sang happy birthday with us, I truly appreciated it. If you are thinking about going here or somewhere else, just don’t think it twice and go to Maracaibo, you will not regret it. Thank you guys for making my brother’s birthday dinner very special. ❤️‍🩹

author: Fatima & Juan Carlos Benitez
review_text: What a gem of a find!! We had our eye on it for a while and today was the day to check it out and it sure did not disappoint! From the atmosphere, the delicious food, and the friendly staff, our experience was the best we’ve had in a while. We had never tried Venezuelan food and it’s so nice to find out we have one so close to home! Posted a few of the things we ordered. Give it shot, you won’t be disappointed! Shout out to Harold Guevara and his amazing team for taking care of us as if we were in their home ❤️ thank you, we’ll be back again!

author: bianca macedo
review_text: This was my first time at Maracaibo Restaurant and I will definitely go back. I really loved everything. The food was amazing , the service was incredible. Our waiter Harold was so lovely and friendly. We highly recommend this place. Thank you !

author: Ray Mendez
review_text: I fell in love with this place. The food? Absolutely exquisite! every bite tastes like Venezuela itself, rich, soulful, and made with love. The papelón? To die for, sweet like a memory you never want to let go of. And for my birthday, they surprised me with a golfeado.. soft, warm, and sweeter than the gesture itself. The people here aren’t just kind, they’re tender, genuine souls who make you feel at home the second you walk in. This week alone, I’ve already been twice that’s how good it is. It’s not just a restaurant; it’s a little piece of home, a hug disguised as a meal.

author: Carla Acosta
review_text: I am Venezuelan and I enjoyed this place very much. They have a large selection of food and drinks. Price is very reasonable giving the area. The portions are good as well. We tried the arepas, steaks and appetizers. The music was a little too loud for my taste and I think they could pick better restaurant music to provide a more relaxing experience to their customers. Otherwise, everything was on point, clean and good customer service! I want to come back soon

author: Marcela Lindo
review_text: Came to the restaurant for a private event so we were upstairs. They have valet parking which is great because it’s in a busy area. They work off tips. We were greeted upon entering. The event space is really nice with a bar area. Loved how they set it up. Servers were very attentive. The appetizers were delicious. My faves were the calamari and chicharron. The food was buffet style which included sweet plantains, white rice, chicken and beef. They also had salmon. They served churros and tres leches as the dessert. The churros were so good and fresh!

author: Katherine Melo
review_text: Amazing experience at Maracaibo! The food was absolutely delicious, full of flavor and beautifully prepared. The service was outstanding, especially Frandery )Frank), who was incredibly attentive and kind. Even though we arrived close to closing time, we were made to feel truly welcome. Exceptional food and service. Highly recommended!

author: Carlos Aguilar
review_text: Truly a phenomenal restaurant with excellent service. Our server, Daniel Castillo, was outstanding and guided us through the menu. I was really impressed with the details.

author: Mayra Ortiz
review_text: At first when I saw the menu i didn’t know what it was and I was unhappy, than came our waiter to help us explain the what the dish were I was still a little off until the appetizers came they were delicious than came the main course I was blow away with the taste and the presentation I do say you need to try this restaurant if your not sure exactly the menu is ask for help and they would be gladly to help I do t like to give 5* but they deserve it. You might think it’s expensive but it’s not we had drinks appetizer main dish and dessert all for under 150. Yes we order many drinks

author: Just Me
review_text: Between the taste of the food, the hospitable service, the atmosphere. I was thrilled to have learn about this place for the first time! My husband being Venezuelan now I know he’s not alone. It’s not easy finding great Venezuelan places like these. The pork chops from the parrillada extravaganza were INCREDIBLE soooo tender. The tequenos were unbelievable with their dipping sauces! Please if you’re in town, or want to have a birthday party or you just want to go for drinks and appetizers come try this place! It’s incredible 🙌🏼❤️‍🔥❤️‍🔥

author: Preeti Sharma
review_text: Rainy day + Namaste Momo Cottage = perfect combo 🥟 Veg noodles were comforting and veg steamed & fried momo were fresh, amazing, clearly made with love. And the ghar wali chai (off-menu!) just hit different when it’s raining. Such a good stop, coming back for sure!

author: Vivek Vijay
review_text: Really nice cozy food. There is lot of love and story in the store and the team than just the food.

author: Go Local New Jersey
review_text: Had some of the most comforting food of my life here at this hidden gem. The momos were so filling and satisfying and paired great with the paneer. Jhol Momos are great if you want to eat something warm on a cold day. If you love Indian or Chinese food you need to try this restaurant out! I only wish the restaurant was a little bigger so I could invite more people.

author: Prabina Bhattrai
review_text: Momo Nepali Authentic Food delivers an unforgettable taste of Nepal with its expertly crafted momos and traditional dishes. The flavors are rich, with a perfect balance of spices that bring comfort and authenticity in every bite. The cozy atmosphere and attentive service make it feel like a home away from home. A must-visit for anyone craving genuine Nepali cuisine.

author: Ashish Upreti
review_text: Had the Chill momo and steam Momo. The Best Nepali Momo in all of new Jersey. Authentic Nepali taste !! One of few places in US, where I really enjoyed the momo.

author: allison thornton
review_text: Got the chili momo. So good! Clean flavors, perfectly fried momo; the tomato chili based sauce balanced with diced sweet onions and red and green peppers, not over sauced, not oily. Packaged tight so nothing spilled into the paper takeout bag. Included in my bag was a cup of a lighter tomato-based sauce and another of a chili paste at the spice level of fresh wasabi. I’m new to this food/dish, and this restaurant, and now after one dish I’m a fan. I thought it may of been pricy, but there’s maybe 8-10 momo in the serving. One of the women told me about the 3-5pm ‘happy hour’ with lower prices. The menu on the wall is a lil different from the website, is different from Google. Meh. It was a lil frustrating til I arrived then I got it. It’s a neighborhood spot; you instantly feel the warmth when u enter. It feels like a family dining room inside an abandoned bodega, and I would totally invite some friends and eat there. There’s a great Mom Energy coming from the ladies in there, and that energy is also in the food. I’m going back. At whatever time of day. I ate it all. Maybe next time I’ll share.

author: John Hu
review_text: A no-frills place with very friendly staff serving a specialized menu. I opted for the combo of steamed veg momos with veg chow mien. The freshly steamed momos went great with the accompanying sauces. I found the chow mien very delicious (sweet and savory) as a straightforward dish. I'll need to come back and try the other momos.

author: Shareen Fatima
review_text: Chanced upon this place coincidentally while out and about. It’s a deli that also sells Nepalese food. Confirmed with the cashier that the chicken is halal. Tried their combo 4 box which included 5 pieces of chicken momos and a side of vege chow mein. The momos were fresh with the right amount of spicy. They give a side of sauce and spicy chutney to go with it for extra kick. Price is good for the amount of food you get. Do visit if you enjoy momos, I know I’m definitely going back for more :)

author: Shouvik Maazumder
review_text: I opted for a catering from this place for a small gathering at my place yesterday and I couldn't be happier with the experience! The lady who assisted me was incredibly sweet and accommodating, making the entire process seamless. The food, both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options, was absolutely delicious and a huge hit with all of my guests. Everyone loved the authentic Nepali cuisine, with the flavors being truly outstanding. I highly recommend Namaste Momo Cottage for anyone looking to enjoy great food with excellent service. Lastly, chicken chilli momos is highly recommended.

author: Shivani sharma
review_text: I ordered three items from this restaurant, but I was very disappointed. The food was really disgusting. The chutney was made without salt, and the vegetables used in the chow mein and fried veggie momos were all raw. Never order potato chili; you will get mashed potato with sweet and sour sauce. I feel like I wasted my money, and I definitely won't be going back. I wouldn't recommend this restaurant for momos.

author: Sanchit Kamath
review_text: Have been seeing this place since 2021 and today finally made a move inside. The ambience over here gives you a typical Nepali vibe and a little space for the seating area. I was craving Momos for a long time and today I'm glad to have it. I had ordered chicken Momos. The dish came along 2 sauces( 1 spicy, 1 regular) and a rice kheer. The spicy sauce was enough to make my nose runny, the other sauce was fine whereas the kheer too was okay. Coming to the chicken Momos, the staff said that they make it fresh in the morning and deep freeze it.. honestly, I didn't get the logic behind it as it's officially frozen but once they steamed it.. it did feel a bit fresh compared to what a fully freshly made momo would feel like. Honestly, I was expecting a fresh product here in a Nepali restaurant and I would admit that I felt a bit down after seeing the frozen momo. Overall the taste was above average as of now since this is the first time I've had Momos in this country! Btw the staff is friendly over here. Looking to try out a few more dishes next time!

author: Tania Zaman
review_text: Amazing food!!! This an absolute must if you are looking for reasonably priced momos in NJ. Sooo good. Recommend the Chilli momos! My younger daughter also loves the Schezuan Chicken Noodles. Have returned 3 times and will continue.

author: Anjan Pariyar
review_text: Food was great. It has a authenticity. I highly recommend anyone to try and feel the taste of Nepali food here.

author: Geocentricity
review_text: The momos reminds me of how my mom makes dumplings. An order of steamed came with 10, plump momos with noticable hints of spice and sweetness. The two sauces are very contrasting: yellow is a slight curry/turmeric flavor and not salty while the red was spicy and strong flavor of dried chilis and maybe paprika. Eventually I ate them plain and it felt right. The seating area is small and cramped, plus most of the store is like a deli. Although $12 for 10 pieces seems kinda steep currently, the quality of the momos will bring me back again.

author: Dhanush Sirohi
review_text: Love this place! It’s a hidden gem Chowmein and momos are so tasty. True Nepalese taste. It’s must visit if you are around. The owner is also very friendly and lovely. Would definitely visit again.

author: V M
review_text: Hole in the wall place close to JSQ . No frills , but amazing momos . Had the steamed chicken and veg jhol momos , both made freshly by the woman who runs the place . Very authentic feel - almost like eating in your own home kitchen! They also recently started chaat . They gave us samples to taste - pani puri and dahi puri . Also pretty good!

author: Gregory Varshavskiy
review_text: HIDDEN GEM! My wife and I came in for lunch on Sunday and Deepa welcomed us and made us feel like family. Every dish we ordered was exquisite and made fresh for us. You can really tell that Deepa and her family are artists and the kitchen is their studio 😋

author: Harsh Kothari
review_text: Their chili momo’s are really good, you got to try it and i also liked their chawmen. Fried rice and chili panner was average.

author: Tarun Goud Golyalla
review_text: Looking for quick grab in the evening for a snack? You are at the right place. Must not miss the Chilli momos, and specially the crispy ones.

author: YouToobr
review_text: We had Chow Mein and chilly momo. Chow mein and chilly momos were good. Unlike Chinese lo mein the chow Mein isn't sweet and that's fine because they have the flavor of garlic, onions, and peppers to compliment. Would visit again when In the area.

author: Ingrid Schultze
review_text: Argentine Bakery has been my favorite since they opened abt 35 yrs. ago. I had the honor to order my son°s engagement cake yesterday, and they did a SUPERB JOB…Love them all….as if family. Gracias Natalia for making Justin and Kelly°s day so special…the whole cake was fully consumed by attendees and are today still raving about it. Los quiero!

author: Genesis Leon
review_text: I was so pleased with my daughter’s birthday cake, as I have been with other cakes I ordered in the past. Everyone complimented the cake for its flavor. The sweetness was just right, including the frosting which was airy and velvety. I also loved the design and felt they did an amazing job delivering what I asked for. I will continue buying my cakes from Argentina Bakery.

author: niki kaur
review_text: We ordered our baby shower 2 tier cake from Argentina bakery, this has been our go-to bakery for all big and small occasions given their exceptionally delicious cakes! I showed them a reference picture of what I wanted, something simple with a few cake toppers (ordered by me and dropped off for them to decorate). To say that the cake was LOVED would be an understatement, the cake was devoured within minutes. The flavors were fantastic especially their famous Dulce De Leche. Our Tier 1 was Dulce De Leche, Chocolate with fresh strawberries and Tier 2 base was Dulce de Leche with chocolate, both were phenomenal! Everyone at the bakery is so warm and friendly and they listen to you to deliver exactly what you need.

author: Rob
review_text: I haven’t given this place the credit it deserves since I usually order here off Uber Eats. I been buying from here occasionally for the past 6-7 years or so. Their cakes has to be one of the best cakes I’ve ever had. I’ve tried their empanadas and they’re great too but their cakes is something to die for. It’s so tasty and fulfilling. The perfect mix of sweet and flavor where some bakeries can’t get that perfect combination. I live local but never been here in person lol. I will make sure I stop by here one day to see the wonderful people who have sending me delicious treats all the years in person.

author: Tatianna Benitez
review_text: She gave me a cake saying happy birthday from your wife when it was supposed to be happy birthday from your husband and then she had the audacity to be snotty over the phone never getting a cake there not only other pricey she was rude and nasty on the phone

author: Lucy Ruiz
review_text: Delicious cake Was of dulce de leche, peaches and vanilla custard

author: Manjusha Ray
review_text: Love the sandwiches and the baked goods. As well as the cakes. Can't go wrong. Plus they are very nice and helpful with any questions

author: Agustina Rastelli Gatti
review_text: I got my wedding cake from here, and it was the best one I’ve ever tried ❤️ I will get my facturas today!

author: Barney Simon
review_text: The house special cake and the pastries are amazing. Owner is friendly and super helpful

author: Joe
review_text: Unfortunately I can’t recommend this place for its pastries. I’ve tried multiple times hoping maybe something will be different. Not sure what it is but the quality of the pastries is just not really up to par and the flavor of most of them is just dull. No butter flavor—just sort of salty/yeasty. Dulce de Leche on Jersey City is a much better option in my opinion. Maybe the cakes are better though—-I haven’t tried them.

author: Amber Tidwell
review_text: Stopped in here during my stay and the gentleman working the counter was so welcoming and helpful. We couldn’t decide on one thing and ended up getting quite a few things. From the empanadas to the fall, the pastries. Everything was absolutely delicious. My favorite were the cookies/cakes Dulce de leche. We wanted to get by before we left town but didn’t make it. I was sad.

author: A. Ace.
review_text: Great variety of different cakes, sandwiches, and pastries made well and tasty. The place is always clean. The workers are helpful provide a friendly service, and are ready to serve you. Highly recommend this place.

author: Rox BO
review_text: Update! Stopped by my favorite Argentinean bakery, got parking in front of the store and bought delicious "facturas" pastries and " sandwiches de miga" always the best food and service!!! I have purchased many delicious food items from this place over the 30 years, since Don Carlos was there!!!! This time I bought "Torta Balcarse" omg its decadent!!! Also the signature sandwiches de miga and facturas everything was fresh and delicious!!! Parking is difficult in that area, but after a few turn around you find it, I wouldn't take star off for that. A little far for me but totally worth the trip!!! Service was great!!!

author: Rick C
review_text: I lived by Argentina Bakery in the mid 90s and now l live in CT. I still travel to NJ for their awesome and delicious empanadas!!!! Great job!!!! See you soon!!!!

author: Cristian Diaz
review_text: This place has been here for years and it is always amazing. I love all the sweets and cakes and empanadas. Gotta try it out you won't be disappointed

author: claudia p
review_text: Best Argentian Bakery around, all the staff is Amazing and very friendly. I have been coming to them for 25 yrs +. Highly recomend them.

author: Jackee Santiago
review_text: This is a small but wonderful bakery I have to stop here every time I come to the state of New Jersey thank you

author: Traci Bidwell
review_text: I got a cream puff and tres Leche pie. So yummy. Everything was homemade and fresh.

author: Sinrrys Flores
review_text: We love their cakes we drive from upstate NY almost every we need a cake

author: Nubia Zazzini
review_text: I been for years with my dad so i was due .i am from argentina closet your going from Argentina its fab .i brought everything that why i went

author: Brian
review_text: I’ve been here on several occasions but I will mention my most recent experience. We went on Thanksgiving day. Surprisingly, the place was not crowded so the staff weren’t crazy busy. As usual I he food was well seasoned and the portions were more than generous. I give it a 10 out of 10.

author: Jenny Ramos
review_text: The food was well made. But it was not anything spectacular. The Tomahawk was pricy for the size. I have had bigger ones for the same price. The gin and tonic was mid at best. Service was good. I feel like this place is overpriced for Newark and especially the area in Newark. Hidden in the back. I think Newark has better offerings.

author: Yatin Pradhan
review_text: Great spot with old school vibes. We had the Rodizio and they do not skimp on portions. From chicken to lamb to steaks, everything was 💯. In case you do not like well done steaks, ask them for medium temps and they bring it right away. As someone on a carnivore diet, this was a perfect meal. For almost $70 pp, this is definitely a great deal.

author: Lizett Canari
review_text: Service and most importantly food was right on point! Though a steak house, their seafood selection was also just as great. I can't wait to go back!

author: A T
review_text: Rodizio was amazing. The ribs were delicious! And to top it off, the cappuccino was excellent. The place was beautiful. I would have given all 5 stars for atmosphere but the music playing was very distracting and ruined the ambiance. It was playing the radio with ads. But I would definitely come back again. Staff, can you please change the music to fine dining music or nice cafe jazz background music? 🙏🏻 I asked the waiter but he said they couldn't change it.

author: Zach Brindisi
review_text: Terrible quality food and service, do not waste your money here! I had been a loyal customer for over ten years, spending thousands of dollars and have brought many friends/family members. The past several times I’ve dined there the service has been poor and food quality is horrible. The meat is either extremely undercooked or overcooked. They simply do not come out with good quality food anymore.

author: Daniel Clyburn
review_text: This is a fine dining restaurant. Service is upscale. food choices fits all categories. Large portions. I had the duck breast which could've cooked for about 5 more minutes it was somewhat chewy but acceptable. The restaurant is large but i suggest having a reservation. Very comfortable atmosphere. I learned of this place from a conversation with an Uber driver. He raved about it and i became curious. Easter Sunday after church a few of us was trying to figure a place to go. I remembered me wanting to try this place and it was in the area. It was a good decision. Whew ... I would not have survived the backlash from my friends had it not been. We all agreed it was a good place.

author: Anel M Abreu
review_text: Best place to get great steak and seafood. The Rodisio is my favorite. Deserts are delicious and the staff is very friendly and attentive.

author: sam si
review_text: “Rodizio Experience That Delivers!” Went for the rodizio experience, and it did not disappoint! I got to try at least 10 different meats (I lost count because they were bringing them out so fast). While not every cut was to my taste, they were all served hot, fresh, and flavorful, which made the experience truly enjoyable. The sides—rice, plantains, beans, and fries—were solid, with the fries being the standout. I do wish the pineapple had been grilled a bit more for that extra caramelized flavor. We also tried the lava cake which were absolutely delicious and a great way to end the meal. A big thank you to the servers who took such great care of us. Their attentiveness made the evening even better. If you’re looking for a fun and satisfying rodizio experience, this place is definitely worth a visit!

author: Andrew Mcmahon
review_text: Staff were extremely attentive and polite. Had the filet mignon and shrimp. The sauce was delicious and surprisingly not sweet given it had slices of banana. My friend had the hamburger which was huge. Shrimp and octopus in garlic sauce appetizer, almond tart and tiramisu for dessert. I have been to all Fernandes' restaurants and all outstanding.

author: Anna Hudack
review_text: European Sea-bass is die for! Ribeye and lobster special was excellent! Shrimp & garlic and chorizo is always done perfect! By the way we just here for Sangria! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

author: T. Sanichara
review_text: Our experience has always been amazing! From the owner to Valentino to Raphael, the bartender, Gonzalo and the rest of the crew have always been great! Great service and great food!

author: Miguel Silva
review_text: Food here was ok but it is a little pricey. Not saying it was bad because it wasn't just nothing special. I feel I could have gotten the same meal somewhere for a better price. Went on a Saturday night at 8pm and it was packed. Couldn't even get into valet parking so we had to look in the street. Doesn't seem like the best area to be walking around late at night. Make sure to make reservations. The service was good, the issue I had personally was I felt I was being rushed. We were having apps and he came and took my plate away before I got more calamari. I felt they could have come a few times more to check on us. I was looking for a waiter because I ran out of drinks. The place itself is nice and big. We were seated upstairs and it was pretty crowded. No music in the background but it's really loud. I could barely hear a friend 2 seats away. We also had this unnecessarily loud group behind us. It's a 25min drive for me to get here so I probably won't be coming back. I feel I can do same or better closer to me. If I was from the area I would like to give it another shot.

author: Sam
review_text: Went for the rodizio experience, and it did not disappoint. Tried at least 10 different meats (I lost count cause they were bringing them out so fast). Not all cuts were my taste, but they were hot and fresh. The sides of rice, plantains, beans and fries were good (especially the fries). I wish they grilled the pineapple more though. We also had the dulce de leches cheesecake and paella. Both very good 👍 Thank you to the servers who took care of us! We had a great time!

author: Kk Stix
review_text: Wow! One of the best Delmonicos I've ever had! Cooked perfectly and not overly seasoned like many places do. The sauce and the potatoes that came with it were delicious too! Staff was all very friendly and honestly I don't have a single complaint. Highly recommend!

author: Tanya
review_text: Had an amazing time for my mother's 70th birthday. We had a party of 12. Staff was amazing, everyone's food was excellent!!! We will definitely be back.

author: Double R Detailing NYC
review_text: I’m never disappointed!! Great food and even better service. I just wish I had more space for the food it’s so good !

author: Nathan Folk
review_text: Worst lobster Ive had ever. It was frozen and rubbery. The butter they served with it was fake and the veal i got was even worse. The veal had no seasoning at all. The tbone was very burnt and the only half decent thing was the bread. It is way overpriced and they lie about their portion sizes. My order said it would come with 3 lobster tails and it only came with one. The veal was no more than 8 ounces when it should be about 12. It was small and pathetic. The service was pretty good though. The meals are overpriced to hell.

author: joe jacob
review_text: Great location as well as good food selection, only remarks some waiter seems comes out high-school, no clue whatsoever what they representating, management should not put them to take order like burger king, other than great food

author: Carlos Curramba
review_text: Classy set up in the dining room. The host was courteous. The staff wasn't as attentive or friendly. Had to be on top to request service. Multiple servers serviced with different styles philosophies of serving. As appetizers ordered a manchego cheese platter which was creamy, and portuguese chorizo (sausage) which had a grilled taste to it rather than sautéed in garlic, delicious accompanied with bread which i removed the dough from the middle and ate the crust. Had a Napa bottle of wine soft to the palate, and no after taste. As the main course i tried the seafood paella which was a bit dried, and T-bone steak accompanied with boiled potatoes, rice, and vegetables. The steak was tender easy to cut into with a succulent taste to it. I'll order the steak again. I am not sure that I'd come back soon based on the staff customer service. Rating of 3.9.

author: Melissa Benbow Flowers
review_text: We ordered the vegan chicken and waffles, the banana pancakes, the skillet side (potatoes and eggs) the matcha, chamomile mint tea, and. Chai tea to go. The food is good, and the chai and matcha are fantastic. Like the ingredients they use for the matcha and chai and the tea are quality. I would definitely come back and try more menu items. I should also say the staff are nice too!

author: BK DUCHEZZ
review_text: My girlfriends and I came across this place by accident. We just wanted to grab a bite to eat before hitting the road after attending the Burna Boy concert in Newark the night before. We googled a few spots close to our Airbnb and decided on this one. I’m so glad we did. Food was good. A variety of vegan options and the server even made some suggestions. The service was courteous, friendly and warm. The atmosphere was adorable . They even had a Dj that started playing some tunes we could groove to. I loved everything about this place. I will make sure I visit again if I’m in the Newark area.

author: Cris Buck
review_text: Work brought me to the area and I stopped by for an afternoon refuel. The location was fairly unassuming but maybe that’s just me being used to the Northwest. I found it to be a wonderful establishment juxtaposed by the dense (but neat) industrial area. Better parking and interior space than I’ve grown accustomed to around here, wonderful separation and options for seating, service was quick and they’re very considerate. Last of all but most importantly, they’ve officially taken first place for best dirty chai this side of the Mississippi. Creamy but balanced, slight anise flavor that’s just perfect if you like that. Check it out. Food menu looks great just didn’t have time.

author: Pokeo Ninja
review_text: A true gem hidden in a rather industrial neighborhood! This is why I love using GoogleMaps to find places to eat when we travel: a wide selection of original salads, burgers, sandwiches, smoothies and crafted coffees and teas in a very hip setting, minutes from 95. I am writing the review so we can find this place again next time we travel this way.

author: W
review_text: Great food, we have the freshly baked chocolate cupcake, golden waffle, and pepper bacon sausage sandwich. Everything is tasty!

author: Hislight Studios
review_text: Great place with a mad chill atmospheric vibe. As a vegan, I make an effort to find places that accommodate the plant based lifestyle with more than salads, lol. Their vegan menu was very extensive. I felt a little cheat in me, so I ordered the vegan blueprint Phillychesse steak wrap. Which was phenomenal. My only issue was the portion size. I do feel that the wrap could've been bigger, but the taste of the ingredients made me overlook that. Well seasoned mock meat, with fresh veg inside. The fries were coo, no issues there. Lightly seasoned for an overall tasty vibe. I treated myself to the maple and also the blueberry vegan donuts. The blueberry was one point!! The maple could've been better. They should've been heated up a little more to truly let the donut melt in your mouth. They didn't hold well and became less enjoyable as time went on. But the blueberry was definitely more of the hit for me. I would definitely recommend this place, and I do plan to visit again.

author: Aija ivy
review_text: This place is beyond great! The customer service, the food, the environment is all 10/10. I have nothing bad to say about this place ever. The Blueprint Vegan Burger is my favorite…I love how they give you vegan cheese options or vegan sauce options too. Every time I go there I always see Ivan at the register or serving customers. He is a great part of BluePrint Cafe & I hope the owner knows that. Everything in the bakery is just as amazing as the food. I recommend this place to everyone!

author: Samantha Fitzgerald
review_text: I wish I caught our server’s name—he was excellent! From the time I called to check if seating was available to even after dropping the check, our server was prompt, attentive, and had our entire group laughing. The food was great with many vegan options. We enjoyed the atmosphere, and it was very clean. It has its own parking lot which made everything easy. Perfect place to go if you need to be close to Newark Penn Station.

author: Melissa Sheehan
review_text: Vegan-friendly! The menu had multiple vegan options available. Portions are massive. I had the tofu scramble which was just OK - wish it had more developed flavor. I could taste the spices, but something was missing. My partner had the sausage omelet and enjoyed it. The interior is very cute and well-decorated. There is seating outdoors as well. The parking lot is right before the building and can be easily missed.

author: Atia Allen
review_text: I went here to celebrate my daughter’s 24th bday back in January. Me and my family had such a great time!!! It was a chill atmosphere and we were able to simply relax and enjoy ourselves. The food was phenomenal!!!!!!!! My boyfriend and I went back last weekend but we arrived right before closing and were unable to dine in. I wanted to introduce him to the establishment since he had never been. We arrived too late, but we will definitely try again another time.

author: Jacquelyn Boyett
review_text: Stumbled upon this amazing Gem. Amazing!! My partner and I really enjoy the whole experience. Victory was our server. She was absolutely adorable and helpful. She also made our tea really well. Her spirit was very warm and welcoming. She always came back to us with a smile everytime. The food was soooooooooo good. I'm a vegan, my partner is not. It was nice to accommodate both of our food needs/wants. Food was a 10/10. The place is a vibe. The decor is industrial/ rustic with high ceilings. They had an amazing DJ the day we went. He kept some good beats going!! I really enjoyed my time there. We will be back

author: mike professionaal
review_text: This was my first time at this spot and it was great! Definitely going back, the food was amazing with something for everyone! Carnivore? Vegan? Pescatarian? They got you! Rustic decore is brilliant! It's the Blueprint to good eating! Forgive the pics we was so hungry and the food was so good I almost forgot to take pics.

author: Aliee Delvalle
review_text: I got the chicken wings, they were good saucy but tasted dry. I forgot the name of the burger but it looked as amazing as it tasted! First food place we tried in Newark NJ! The service was spectacular and that’s what would bring us back.

author: Onika Burrowes
review_text: IVAN is amazing!! My sister and I have been coming to this cafe for 3years or more and it is much better when IVAN is working because his patience is amazing. We both are picky eaters and picky coffee drinkers. Out of all the employees who work at this cafe Ivan is the best not just I say so but people who were recommended to come here. What a humble young man! The food is pretty good!!!!!!!!!! My favorite is the Blueprint vegan burger and my sister's is the vegan sausage sandwich. The prices for the food as raised which was surprising. Which Slows me down from coming as often. But overall the environment and food Deserve more than a 5 start. So check it out if you are ever in the area you're not going to regret it.

author: Magna Gopal
review_text: Super cute café, off the beaten path in Newark. Great ambience and music in a huge open and eclectic space. Food was pretty good - had the stuffed French toast & chicken and waffles.

author: Nathalie
review_text: Food is pretty good! As a vegan, i like that they have a good amount of options for me ! So far I’ve had the tofu scramble & vegan cheesesteak wrap, & both were good. I also tried their vegan maple walnut donut which was amazing . Sunday’s they have a DJ, which is pretty cool ! The server’s are nice & friendly. Overall, great experience. I’ve been here twice & will def be coming back again to try their other menu items.

author: Yager
review_text: I recently visited Blueprint Café, and although I arrived close to closing time, Ivan still provided excellent service with a welcoming and positive attitude. His professionalism and warm demeanor made such a strong impression on me that I’ve decided this will be my go-to spot for work on a daily basis, if possible.
