I’m so happy to have discovered this hidden gem in Newark. Having lived here all my life, I never knew this place existed, but you can be sure I’ll be telling all my friends about both Blueprint and Ivan’s incredible service!

author: Sharayna Christmas
review_text: I visited Blueprint Café for the first time today for brunch and unfortunately had a very disappointing experience. I ordered the chicken and waffles, but the chicken was undercooked and the waffle looked nothing like what was shown on their website—it was thick, tough, and difficult to chew. When I shared these concerns with the staff, they didn’t offer to remake the dish or even ask how I wanted to proceed. Instead, they simply took the same plate and put it in the oven to re-cook it, despite it being a fried chicken dish that should be prepared fresh. I was honestly shocked by this approach. There was no apology, no offer of a replacement, and not even a gesture like offering a drink while I waited. In the end, we left the food as it was, paid for the meal, and walked out. Given the undercooked chicken and the lack of basic customer service, I would not return to this establishment.

author: Jeffrey Osborne
review_text: Such a great low key place to get work done on a busy weekday, most people won’t travel that far from the downtown area so the foot traffic isn’t terrible, no distractions, great environment and even better food options ( vegan )

author: Darlene Laplante
review_text: I’ve been driving past this place for a while as it’s on a “trucker’s road”. TikTok led me here and I’m glad it did cause the food , the live DJ on weekends and the calm atmosphere was. 10/10!

author: Renato Miranda
review_text: I visited Casanova during a special event and had a great time. They served many Brazilian pastries such as coxinha, pastel, chicken pie and churrasco steak and they were all delicious. The staff members I interacted with were friendly and helpful. Parking around this area is challenging since it's near the Ferry st area but if you check Spot Hero, Park Whiz or any other parking apps you'll find many parking lots on Raymond Ave (10 minute walk) for $10.

author: Khaled Bejdough
review_text: Hi , this afternoon was my 1st at this venue. The employees are kind, helpful, hospitality Is top notch. The restaurant Is clean, the entree’s are very delicious too. Will be coming back again

author: Christopher R.
review_text: Great food, well seasoned, adequately priced, and bigger than expected portions. Good beer selection, too. There was a live band that was a bit too close to the tables and a bit too loud, but it didn't take away from the experience too much. We'll be sitting inside next time.

author: Jony Santos
review_text: This is the best Brazilian restaurant ever, the food is fresh and delicious, the staff are totally kind, there’s bands playing music whole day, and the owner is the the icing on the cake, this guy knows how to make it the best experience. If you’re not brazilian, you i’ll feel like you’re, try the “caipirinha”, trust in me, you never tried anything like that before.

author: Fillipe Candido-Fraga
review_text: I love this place. It was one of my go-to spots when I visited North Jersey. It's a Brazilian place and they mainly speak Portuguese. They have nightly live music, both Brazilian and American songs. Great atmosphere. It's becoming a regular spot for me when visiting Northern NJ.

author: Jonathan Speights
review_text: All food great. Service not to bad just gotta grab attention when drinks are needed

author: B.
review_text: Food was great but the service was horrible. The waitress was nice but after bringing us our drinks and food, she disappeared. We finally ordered drinks with her and another server and didn’t receive those drinks until over a half hour later. The workers/servers were taking shots with the locals at the bar. There was only one guy for the entire restaurant going around serving all the different meat for the ridizio. That is UNACCEPTABLE, especially on a busy day like Father’s Day. There were also a bunch of solicitors coming in trying to sell stuff to everyone. Not sure what type of management they have, but they definitely need to make some adjustments to their service.

author: binho Motorcycle Club
review_text: The place is very bad, terrible service. They forced us to give a tip, which was already included in the bill. I will never go back to this place again. Everything is very bad. I do not recommend it. Food: 1/5 | Service: 1/5 | Atmosphere: 1/5

author: Joshua Rivera
review_text: Food was good but portion sizes too big and overpriced. Won't be going back there again

author: Luciana Nascimento
review_text: Ordered some food and asked for well done the meat was burnt that’s not well done and the meat seemed like it’s been cut and sat for hours. The only good thing about the food was the fries. The sausage was raw inside. 38 dollars on food that I barely ate…never ordering again.

author: J G
review_text: Run away from this place. First of all it is not an attractive place, raw and dry. Some of the waiters are well trained to deal with clients. There is no ambience and the inside resembles those shady places in Brazil. The food is horrendous pricey for no reason. The portions are small and tasteless. The old crowd that hangs in the bar seems to be local farmers employees. Go to any other places but avoid this one. trust me you will be glad that you did.

author: N Q
review_text: Food was good service was OK not great the bartender never said your welcome after repeated thank you. She was nice but seemed like she was rushing us and the place was empty. She was cleaning the dust off the bottles which 90 percent of places don't...very clean place but the nail in the coffin was gratuity added for 2 people. I'm a good tipper I say you know I would have left you a bigger tip then 10.95 she says sorry but it's our rules you can leave more if you like. I said sorry to late you already told me how much I have to tip. She did apologize and was nice but I hate places that do that I get it if it's a big party but 2 people for lunch at a bar when the bill was 65.00 lol ....I asked how the soup was her response was its good soup is soup you know...probably won't go back. Brazilian bar tenders I'm Brazilian I spoke English only I felt that it bothered them. I speak Portuguese but wanted the American experience..

author: Hoover E Londono
review_text: I lived in Brazil 7 years eating here is like being in Brazil . The beer the food the beef

author: Edward Phipps
review_text: I ordered a churrasco for 1 person, with medium rare steak, collard greens & black beans. The waitress took my order made me pay before I got my order, and never got back to me until she brought my order more than 30mins later. Never acknowledged or apologized they had me waiting forever for a take out order. When I got home & looked my food, my steak was well done & I got red beans. The food was great but…. Common courtesy & good customer service.

author: Wrthg Hvn
review_text: Went there for some food and drinks. My friend had the rodizio, which I sampled as well. The meat was super tender and not salty. We also had a passion fruit sangria and beers. The sangria was excellent. The crowd was really nice. There was music playing inside and outside. There were a lot of nice people around. It was a good crowd. I look forward to returning soon .

author: pedro pedrao
review_text: Always have a great time at this place. Specially saturdays with live music. And Leandro is a very nice guy.

author: Noah Bustos
review_text: I ordered mixed steak. The chicken and beef was tough and burnt, looked like it was from the day before and they just heated it up. We paid and the lady never returned with the change, we had to go look for her. Needless to say, the place was not packed enough to say that she was busy. Lousy place.

author: Shalese Fuller
review_text: Unfortunately I only speak English that was a big problem!! Our waitress never understood anything we asked for (straw, ketchup, steak sauce & ingredients in our mixed drinks) I had the rodizeo & the meat tasted bland.. I work close & popped in with a coworker for a early Friday meal, guess this place wasn't for us.

author: Chad Vazquez
review_text: Excellent food and decent service - we come here often when we’re in the area. Consistently great food!

author: James Stewart Jr
review_text: Stopped in during the annual Portuguese Feast, it's a little in off Ferry Street, indoor/outdoor seating, food was excellent, service was perfect, quick, attentive and on point.

author: Jenny Ramos
review_text: Tuesdays are the day to go. They have 31.95 Rodizio. Great price. All the meat you can eat and they will come back again. What they didn’t have was the grilled pineapple. They said it usually goes to waste to so they didn’t set it up. They all have a Rodizio special for lunch. The sea bass was not great according to my companion. It was a frozen fillet. Didn’t taste fresh. The Rodizio on Tuesday is their best offer. It wasn’t packed so you could hold a conversation.

author: Cristina Major
review_text: I had a little trip to Newark and it was a bit chaotic but choosing Casa Nova Grill was the best choice for the whole trip. Evando waited on us and he was the nicest. He showed us our options, detailed about the all you can eat options. Just for his service I would rate the 5 stars and the food was amazing as well. I will definitely come back when traveling up north again. I absolutely love my experience today. Going back to Louisiana and hope to be able to go back to Casa Nova Grill again.

author: Gu Sar
review_text: Everything was terrible. I don’t recommend this place at all. Better go somewhere else. By the way, I do not usually behave in the manner you are suggesting. I believe it would be more appropriate for you to focus on improving your customer service, as the attention we received was truly disappointing. The overall experience left much to be desired, and honestly, I would not return to your establishment. The people who were with me that day also left with a negative impression and share the same opinion about your restaurant. I genuinely hope you take steps to improve, for the sake of both yourself and your staff, as no business can succeed without its customers.

author: Luis Diaz
review_text: Good dining experience in Newark. Sangria was flavorful, the salad bar was fresh and the meats were all delicious. The service was good as well. Parking was not easy and I had to find a spot on the street.

author: Johan Jaramillo
review_text: Wanted rodizio for my birthday and after checking out a few places, we decided to come back here — I had been once a while ago and remembered it being good. The service was beyond great! The rodizio was amazing, with tons of different cuts of steak, all super tasty. I definitely got full fast but still tried to sample as many as I could — the picanha was especially delicious! The sangria was also a hit. Overall, a great experience and I’ll definitely be back!

author: Celena L
review_text: Didn’t like the meat or buffet selection. The hush puppies were good, fries and fried banana were good also. Drinks were strong, didn’t have a big cocktail menu. Disappointed they didn’t have the cheese ball. Never been to a Rodizio like this. Barely received any steak options, meats were either over cooked or too seasoned. Oh they gave fresh chips, those were good also. Service was slow, no one came back to us for a while to see if we wanted anything besides the Rodizio.

author: H G
review_text: We were in the vicinity and opted to dine at a Brazilian rodízio, which turned out to be a significant error as the meats were not fresh. Additionally, we ordered some beverages that were excessively diluted. We expressed our concerns to the waiter, who informed us that this was the standard. At that point, we asked to speak with a manager. The manager, named Victor, was exceptional. He made every effort to accommodate us, and I genuinely felt sorry for him. As we informed him of our decision not to return, it became clear that this establishment is utterly disappointing, especially considering the Ironbound area, which boasts numerous excellent restaurants.

author: Cindy M
review_text: Went for early dinner on weeknight for Rodizio. WOULD NOT RECOMMEND this. Apparently we got lucky with beef rib that was cooked to medium (just as we would have requested if we were asked), Pichanna was next also lucky those 2 meats were awesome HOWEVER that's where it ends. Only offered sausage and chicken, filet wrapped in bacon (well done) and garlic steak also well done. When we requested to server "can we have meat medium" his reply "that is how it is already cooked" he followed with "not good during week, you should have called and requested medium meats" He did absolutely nothing to rectify the situation. So when I asked "do you have pineapple " he said "no we do not have pineapple during t week only on the weekends". We have been there for dinner on weekend and that is why when we were in area we chose to stop there again. We will not make that mistake again.

author: Miriam Noyola
review_text: Casa Nova Grill (Brazilian Rodizio) is a wonderful place to go with family. We were well taken care of and the staff was friendly and professional. Our food was delicious. I had the paella and it was full of seafood 😋 It’s a bit far from the train station if you’re walking but definitely a place to experience delicious Brazilian cuisine!

author: Gabriel Arnaudville
review_text: The restaurant is beautiful. The food was not very tasty, and the server Evando was really slow and bad at his job, on purpose.. It wasnt busy and he had a smug attitude and face. He of course included gratuity for his bad job which we paid. But definitely ask for a different server. We unfortunately will not try it again.

author: Lu H
review_text: Tried Brazilian Rodizio for the first time and had a mixed experience. The salad bar offered a variety of options but was disappointed by the dried and hard mini pizza and the less-than-fresh vegetables. During happy hour, the $3.99 beer price was a highlight. The rodizio's meat-serving performance was interesting and enjoyable. However, most of the rodizio meats were salty and tasted similar, which made their mouth tired of the same flavors. Despite this, overall experience was cool and memorable.

author: Kimberly
review_text: The service overall was amazing. Evando made sure we were good the whole time we were a party of 12 and he was patient, efficient and very professional. Made sure we were taken care of immediately we highly recommend him. The food was 100/10 enjoyed everything overall!!

author: Robin
review_text: We've visited this establishment many times. This trip included a party of 8. The food was good -- nice and filling. The service was thorough, pleasant and professional. There was live music and television screens around the restaurant.

author: Armi Castro
review_text: Great food! If you go there as for Joao Neto. He is excellent and will help you have a great time eating authentic Brazilian food. The Pichana is great and the music was on point! I will definitely come back again with my family

author: joshwin clervoix
review_text: Great food! Very comfortable and cozy intimate setting. Food comes out very fast and fresh for Rodizio and the salad bar was very good it’s like you can get an entire entree in the salad bar alone. Me and my wife had a great time only negative is the parking but I soon figured out you can park at the bank across the street.

author: J J
review_text: Loved it ! Thank you ! Very much recommended and will continue to come appreciate the hospitality !!

author: Giovanna Alfaro
review_text: Such a great restaurant! The open space is beautiful and the food was absolutely delicious — so worth it. Definitely going back! Our server Evando was super helpful and had such a great personality.

author: Nataly Romero
review_text: Came for the first time and the experience was absolutely amazing. Joao Neto was our sever and he was very polite, friendly and made excellent recommendations. Casa Nova Grill went above and beyond my expectations, definitely coming back.

author: grace ebourefi
review_text: I like the restaurant the food yummy service people just amazing specially Evando nice person so humble happy to serve each table ,all of them they who’s nicer.

author: Davi Galvao
review_text: The food was okay. All the meats tasted really dry, and the buffet food seemed kind of old and not very warm, likely because it was sitting out in the open without a cover. I was expecting a better buffet and churrasco rodizio for the price. Overall, the food was okay, and Evando provided excellent service, attending to our needs promptly and answering our questions.

author: Lakeisha G.
review_text: The tables in the middle are a little too close together. You cant even squeeze through to get out of your seat. The food was good, we had about a 20 minute wait, but it was packed and Sunday.

author: Phanit Duong
review_text: Went on a Monday for dinner and everything was fresh. My raw clams and mussels were on deck and I ate 6 platters all for $20 with tip, you can’t go wrong here! Full review on YouTube@hellachluy

author: Lex K
review_text: The buffet has a great ambiance and the staff were friendly and said thank you. The food was ok but some items are better than others such as fried chicken but the salmon was cold so choose wisely also I did notice some unsanitary conditions like sneezing and stuff so I stayed away from the hibachi would I go back ? They would have to make some changes before that.

author: Mikeyy Lunarezz
review_text: I found this place by accident on Google maps while looking at jersey mills mall. I decided to check this place out after shopping at the mall which is a few miles away. Restaurants is located in a trip mall which has free parking which is always a plus. From the outside place doesn't seem very big but that is deceiving because it's pretty big inside. There's plenty of seating very large selection of food, including fruits, vegetables and more. Staff is welcoming and your really get you money's worth. Food was great, they keep place clean and food always stocked. They even have a party room for special events. They also have a restrooms which is also clean and well maintained. I enjoyed my experience overall. If you're looking for a cool buffet and you're out with friends or family and you happen to be in the area this place will not disappoint.

author: Zac
review_text: Food was above average for this type of restaurant, and service was good. The main downside was we were seated under a leak in the roof so water was dripping on us, and it was very busy so we didn't bother requesting to change seats. Overall I would go again, but at $46 for two, I don't know if the value is really there.

author: 9TF M
review_text: We had the best experience in this restaurant. The manager was so sweet and smart. She gave us a feeling like dining at home. My son observed her dealing with some difficult customers in a very nice and smart way. Every staff was so dedicated in making you feel comfortable. Will come back again for sure!!

author: Quayah Seabrooks
review_text: The food is old and nasty .. I paid almost 70 dollars for my children and I to eat and everything tasted the same .. they don’t have enough utensils to serve the food so you have to the same utensil for different dishes (cross contamination) so don’t come if you have a seafood allergy .. the workers hover over you and tell you when your done eating so don’t think your not being timed .. it’s honestly not worth the money (at least not the dinner ) 70 dollars for food that’s been sitting out all day . The sushi bar is ok and the hibachi had great uncooked meat out but it’s small .

author: Ceo wa Mairura
review_text: First paying before you eat is a good sign to start with , food was cold, just few options unlike other buffet . I don’t even finish my first plate

author: Jenuwine Blu
review_text: Great time. Clean store & friendly staff. Waited no more than 15 minutes for my table. The food was so fresh. Lots of variety.

author: Crystal Morris
review_text: I've been going there for a while and I have no complaints about anything the service is excellent the staff is very respectful and very nice and the food is fresh and they welcome anyone to come eat and enjoy yourself and I give them 10 or more star's 💯❤️

author: Justin Marrero
review_text: This was hands down the worst Chinese buffet I’ve ever been to — and I’m not exaggerating. Every single thing I tried tasted bland, stale, or just plain wrong. The chicken? Rubbery. The noodles? Oily and flavorless. The sushi? I wouldn’t trust it to feed a stray cat. Even the fried rice somehow managed to be dry and soggy at the same time. How is that even possible? Nothing — and I mean nothing — was enjoyable. Not one bite. I actually left hungrier and more frustrated than when I walked in. If this is what they consider “fresh” or “authentic,” they need to seriously reevaluate everything. The only thing worse than the food was the regret that hit me halfway through chewing the first bite. Save your money, your time, and your stomach — go literally anywhere else.

author: Marina Tichonyuk
review_text: We came for the first time and I am sure for the last. Food was good with a lot of options. But the service is terrible. They require paying up-front! Never saw anything like this. Coming in and have to pay right away. AND put tip there!!! Tip before the service! So disrespectful! And then nobody came over a single time. So tip for what??? Terrible service.

author: Paris
review_text: I truly love this buffet, they have it all sea food, sushi, hibachi and everything in between. If your in the mood for buffet style asain cuzine this is the place, especially if your local!

author: Afiesha
review_text: I DONT KNOW WHAT HAPPEN TO THIS PLACE FOOD USE TO BE SOO GOOD flavorful I went there yesterday TRASH THREW UP IMMEDIATELY AND THE ROACH OUTSIDE THE RESTAURANT TOLD ME EVERYTHING I REGRETTED EATING THERE WILL NEVER GO AGAIN N STOP SELL OLD FOOD HEATING IT UP WONT MAKE IT TASTE BETTER THE NEXT DAY NOODLES WAS SO SOFT TAKE LIKE MASH POTATOES RICE SMELL SPOILED I JUST ATE PLATE OF FRUITS AND LEFT WORST EXPERI EVER I WISH TO NEVER GO BACK IMMA THROW UP AGAIN AFTER THIS REVIEW DIGUSTING

author: Ayodele Abiodun
review_text: The service here is 110/100. Girls are versatile in their doing🥰🥰🥰

author: Melissa Deleen
review_text: Not worth the price. Quality of food is poor and the environment was a bit dirty.

author: Michelli Ikawa
review_text: The food is good, but pay attention when paying the bill. We were 4 adults and 2 children and they charged us $160. Since it was the 4th of July, each adult should have paid $19.90 and each child $9.90. The total is almost $100, each person drank a soda, it doesn't make sense that they charged $10 per soda... I didn't like that

author: Derek
review_text: The food here was surprising good compared to what I paid. The service was great as well. They have a large election of food. I would be back.

author: Kseniya Karpova
review_text: The food was amazing! It's a cosy place with a relaxing atmosphere.

author: Wendy Foster
review_text: My sister n i...went to celebrate our hubby's b.day...they both where happy...we come from brooklyn n this its one gem we keeping..lol..food good waiter was on point n again the food was goooodddddd.

author: Amy W
review_text: We were so thoroughly impressed by our meal here on Saturday night that we ended up coming back two other times during a quick weekend trip to NYC. We even rode the PATH train into Newark FROM Manhattan on Sunday evening because we had enjoyed our first experience so much and knew we wouldn’t find a better meal. My boyfriend is Portuguese and has extremely high standards for the cuisine. We have been to Portugal multiple times and we agreed that the meals we had at Coimbra equaled the best meals we had across the Atlantic. Just like a true Portuguese place, olives and delicious rustic breads were served right away. (But unlike Portugal, there was no charge!) My boyfriend got squid for one meal (pictured) and octopus for another. Both were so tender and flavorful, and the potatoes and vegetable sides fresh and perfectly cooked. I ordered the barbecue chicken special (pictured) for two meals, it was so delicious. The stuffed rock crab appetizer is also pictured, another A+. The caldo verde was better than some versions I had in Portugal. The flaming chourico and aletria and bolo de bolacha desserts were perfection as well. The prices are extremely reasonable for the portions and quality delivered. The service is incredible. Pedro was so pleasant and welcoming and helped us out with his thoughtful recommendations. He remembered us when we came back and treated us so well each time. Nelson was also very kind and friendly and we really appreciated his attentiveness. We felt like we had made new friends. We will definitely be back. This place is worth the drive from Maryland. I can’t wait to visit Coimbra again!

author: Ahri A
review_text: Amazing crispy skin. Garlic shrimp is delicious. Service is excellent and the attention paid to us was top notch. Pedro took great care of us. Coimbra is a flavor-packed experience you don’t want to miss. The citrus notes in the dishes cut through the richness of the fatty pork perfectly—it’s a match made in culinary heaven. Pair it all with a glass of their red sangria, and you’re in for a treat. Definitely try a bit of everything on the table! Pro tip: use the crispy pork skin to scoop up some rice and dip it into the salty, savory sauce. Don’t be afraid to get your hands messy—it’s all part of the fun and flavor.

author: Ricardo A.
review_text: Great authentic portuguese food. Amazing squid (grilled) and calamari, the food is always spectacular. Especially the cod fish items. Always pleasing to chat it up with the locals and the hostess. Parking can be a hassle if the lot is packed but never have a problem finding one nearby.

author: Wayne Eichler
review_text: Food was average at best. The two entrees were not seasoned and tasteless. I asked what the waiter recommends and read all the entrees. What was one or two that were really good. My mistake on my part to ask. Plenty of other options to try in the area.

author: Erick Carrillo
review_text: We where here for my wife's birthday 🎉 excellent food and ambience. I like the steak and seafood. I would love to comeback another great spot in Ironbound

author: Ana Butler
review_text: Breaking from my routine introduced me to this gem. Employees understand the menu while staying approachable. You get genuine service and delicious meals. The servings here are generous and taste exceptional. Another trip here is guaranteed.

author: Maribel Hernandez
review_text: What is there not to love but the closest taste of fine Portuguese dining while not having to catch a flight to Coimbra, Portugal. My favorite was their pork cube clams, well marinated that the pork cubes and clams taste like they were one. The octopus salad was also well seasoned, maybe a little too heavy with the onions but the octopus wasn't chewy or overcooked, it was seasoned and settled well with all the flavors when served. I did not like the soup, I can get fresher soup from Seabra's on 83 Wilson Ave. The not-so-pleasant-going-towards-the-fermented soup I couldn't palate the soup after the second try. Other than that everything else was well made, locally bought and I did love their mixed salads, the salads tasted fresh which is difficult during a time of climate justice. Maybe the waiter should of asked was there something wrong with the soup. I would have shared my opinion. The pastel de nata sweet and not too heavy but just heavenly crisp and a thick pudding like cream of heaven. There's a parking lot available on Fillmore, the atmosphere was laid-back, patrons sitting down either at the bar or on the serving tables. There's a larger dining area on the left side of the restaurant and a private room downstairs for a more private party. Waiters were attentive and courteous, they wanted to know how they can be of service as they checked in on the customers. There bartenders can be a little snarky but I understand it's challenging to be behind the counter. Next time Coimbra, overall well done.

author: Antonio Grelicha
review_text: Undercooked suckling pig, mixed up order, wrong food on Christmas Day. Very disappointed. Having Hoped for better turnout. Alex did not offer any remedy. Frequented place.

author: Juan Garcia
review_text: Another fantastic lunch in Coimbra restaurant, one of the best .

author: Gerri
review_text: My first time at this restaurant and it was great. The service was on point and the food delicious. Definitely going back again.

author: Laurinda Esteves
review_text: I had a nice celebratory dinner there with 15 people last Saturday. The food was great as always but they packed us very tight, and you couldn't even get out. The other negative was the singer. I made a couple of requests for Portuguese songs that are very popular and perfect for dancing and he never played them. I asked him 3 times, I said when are you going to play the songs I requested and he replied "when you leave". He kept played stupid slow Brazilian songs and the Portuguese popular fast songs were not his priority. He needs to go or I will not be going there while that rude man is there. Usually the singers play songs requested for any event but I did not even bothered to ask him for anything more after I experienced is foul demeanor. This restaurant needs to find a DJ, who will do a much better job.

author: Alexa Fontes
review_text: Coimbra Bar and Restaurant is a standout spot in Newark! The food is absolutely delicious, with authentic Portuguese flavors and generous portions. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, perfect for all occasionds. What truly makes this place shine is the awesome service—the staff are attentive, friendly, and make you feel right in Portugal. Highly recommend for an unforgettable dining experience! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

author: Monica Fernandes
review_text: The best place to enjoy real Portuguese food!!! It was my second time going. I took my friends, and they instantly fell in love. The prices are really good, considering you get big portions. The chouriço was perfect. The service was really friendly and welcoming. They explained all the plates on the menu and gave suggestions. I would completely recommend this place, and for sure, I will be back

author: Orang Gina
review_text: Our first visit here. Truly a gem in the "beautiful" ironbound section of Newark. We had goat and cod dishes. Clams and sausage appetizers were great, in fact it was the best sausage I've ever had. The food was beyond excellent. The bar and restaurant are in the same room so you can eat and watch soccer or Portuguese CNN from anywhere. There also appears to be an event dining room in a separate section.

author: Estela Cordeiro
review_text: Took a ride from Boston (Massachusetts) to Newark (New Jersey) to drop off some boxes at a transport company to ship to Portugal and stumbled upon this Coimbra Bar & Restaurant and what a treat it was. Our server Pedro was amazing!!! The piglet was the best I’ve ever had, with its crispy skin, and the service was 5 stars even with the Saturday lunch rush. This is definitely a site we will be visiting again. See you soon!

author: Jorge T
review_text: Great food matched by great atmosphere. The place was packed. They could space out the tables a little better. They really cram everyone in there. Nice professional staff. Will definitely be back

author: Leo Amador
review_text: The food was just ok. We ordered a soup, carapaus assados, Chicken picadinho, buffalo chicken wings, ate 2 lava cakes. The price for a Macallan12 @ $25 per doze is outrageous considering the surrounding establishments charge between $12 and $16. The service was slow! Spent over $60 (with a bottle of wine) per person with a baby and 2 childen. We will not be coming back!

author: Alex Andino
review_text: Food was terrible. A surprise for a Portuguese restaurant in Ironbound. They served me days old chicken that was reheated. it smelled like a chicken out of the fridge that was put back in the oven. Fries were cold. Not coming back.

author: Arestides Andre
review_text: Everything was just right, plenty of food, staff was great, the place is very clean, yes I will be returning and I will recommend the restaurant to friends and family.

author: Isabella Nobriga
review_text: They should let you know when they have a special menu for certain holidays. Dishes were much more expensive on mothers day and my favorite dish was excluded from the menu. Service was subpar even though I've seen it busier. Overall I resent having to pay more for food I really didn't want.

author: charnetta holley
review_text: The restaurant itself is beautiful with a great atmosphere, good vibes, and very reasonable prices. The food was delicious, and our waitress, manager, and the rest of the staff (other than security) were welcoming and professional. Unfortunately, the security experience really brought the mood down. We were only in the area briefly while waiting for my daughter’s concert to finish and decided to try the restaurant after checking the website and reviews. The website states that the dress code only applies after 7pm on Friday and Saturday. We went on a Sunday, but my son and I were almost denied entry because we had on Crocs. Security made a big deal about the shoes and we stood out there for 5-10 min just waiting because of the shoes (there was no line) After I pointed out the policy, security checked with the manager and then let us in. My sister also had her Stanley cup with water because it was hot outside, and the security guard was extremely rude and snotty about it, saying “you can’t bring that in here, y’all must not go out much.” He then made her leave it at the front door. That comment felt unnecessary and unprofessional, and it took away from the excitement we had walking in. We mentioned the situation casually to our waitress, and without us even asking, the manager came to our table to personally apologize. That gesture meant a lot, and it showed that management truly cares about their customers. Overall, the food and vibes were excellent, but the security staff needs more professionalism and consistency with following the restaurant’s actual policies. Parking is also tough, so be prepared to use valet (around $30). If the security experience matched the quality of the food and staff, this would have been an easy 5-star review.

author: Cindy Juarez
review_text: This was honestly one of the worst places I’ve eaten at. The food was terrible, nothing tasted fresh and most of it seemed stale. We went during the week and the menu was super limited, barely any options. From the fajitas to the birria tacos, everything tasted off and not authentic at all. It felt super Americanized. I would’ve rather eaten at Chipotle or even Taco Bell. I also ordered a piña colada and it was disgusting. It tasted super fake, like they used some kind of powder mix instead of making it fresh. I couldn’t even finish it. I ordered a Coke too and got a tiny glass full of ice with barely any soda. They didn’t even give me the can, which was annoying because it felt like they kept the rest of my drink. On top of that, they automatically added an 18% gratuity for a party of four, which is crazy considering that’s not even a big table especially with how bad the food and service were. The prices were high, and I don’t mind spending money on good food, but this definitely wasn’t it. The place looks nice from the outside, but the food is not good at all. Huge disappointment.

author: Nikiea Hawkins
review_text: Food was delicious (albeit not hot) so I'll give 4 stars. And the atmosphere was amazing. The staff was very unfriendly I guess bc my sister and I are Muslim. We sat there in am empty restaurants at the smallest table they had until I just got fed up and moved myself. I'll attach some photos so you can see that is actually beautiful. But they only want Spanish people in their spot 🙄 of the owner or manager disagrees then by all means invite us back. We spent $140 for cold food. And weak drinks! This is my honest respectful review!

author: Gayathri Gopal
review_text: Had a wonderful time at this Mexican place! The cocktails were great, and the chicken tacos were absolutely amazing. The service was friendly and attentive, and the place had a lovely Mexican vibe. Overall, a fantastic experience — would definitely visit again! 🌮🍹

author: beldim2010
review_text: Beautifully decorated spot with good food but impersonal service. My wife and I visited Little Tijuana for an early dinner in May 2025. The moment we walked in, we were struck by the restaurant’s beautiful, artistic decor, which instantly set the tone for a pleasant dining experience. The overall experience was mixed though. Most of the food ordered was excellent with a couple of exceptions. The drinks were flavorful, but noticeably diluted. Service was efficient but impersonal. Everything arrived correctly and politely, yet we never felt truly cared for - no one stopped by to ask if we liked the food or drinks, no smile, no friendly chat. We can recommend Little Tijuana for its ambiance, décor, and solid food — just don’t expect much beyond what's served at your table. Food ordered Guacamole Trio - three types of guacamole to try and all three were absolutely tasteless :( Mexican Fajita - excellent. Flavorful and sizzling. Lamb Barbacoa (lamb shank) - excellent. Melting in the mouth.

author: Anchal Sikka
review_text: Must try🍽️ Tijuana Burrito ( Veg) (limited Veg options, but the burrito tasted so so good. It was a lot of veggies with fresh sour cream was m and the habanero sauce) The presentation and ambiance was lit. The music was so so loud!! But the vibe was great. Perfect was a bigger party if you want to have fun and have amazing food. The DJ seemed chill and the mixes were really good. Gratuity is included and the prices are kinda high. Overall worth it!!

author: Fatima Mendez
review_text: So awesome place to chill and vibe, the best part is getting to chose your vibe settings here. They have three different levels. The lounge , you dance and have drinks, the dinning room where the music is at its mid and the rooftop, super elegant and that’s where I was loved it! Had a great time🫶 the owner did such a great job and he made us feel so welcomed that’s really what made me want to stay cause I don’t like being in Newark. The only thing I did not like was the valet parking. I get the $25 to park but what threw me off is that the guy didn’t let me enter the restaurant from the parking lot and made me walk around to the front. But when I came back for my car I saw he let someone else go through the back. So idk if maybe she’s also the owner prob. Idk. But I’d hope if they could change that because I had heals on and it was super dark and a bit of walk to go to the front.

author: Tanesha Peralta
review_text: AMAZING, we held an office party here and it was fabulous. The food tasted delicious and the space is beautiful. The manager, Larry, answered all our questions and offered great menu options (Including options for vegetarians).

author: Erin Orth
review_text: My friend and I stumbled across this place while on vacation on The Union Presents “Blackout” open mic night, and didn’t realize how lucky we got! The entertainment was amazing, the atmosphere was incredible, the food was on point, the drinks were strong and the service was the best I’ve ever experienced. To our waitress, I wish we’d gotten your name, you made our night and thank you for the recommendation for other places after you closed. We will definitely be coming back!!

author: Anudeep Jain
review_text: Food was decent but I gave 3 star because of poor billing. They charge gratuity on the bill irrespective of the group size. Wonder whether that is even legal.

author: Adilene Llanes
review_text: The food was decent, but overall the experience was disappointing because of all the extra fees added to the bill. In addition to the menu prices, there was a non-cash adjustment fee of $6.72, an automatic 18% gratuity, and a $25 parking fee. None of this was made very clear upfront, and it significantly increased the total cost. The food itself was just okay—not bad, but not good enough to justify all the added charges. I would recommend paying cash when eating here.

author: Debra Tencio
review_text: We dined here on Saturday, September 27. The food was cold, the dance floor in the separate area and the rooftop was closed. The DJ played a couple of bachata songs and 1-2 merengues but it was mostly rachet music. I didn't expect to listen to Pop Smoke at a restaurant called Little Tijuana. Our server Fernando looked bothered the entire night and was eager to give us our check so we could leave. The vibe was NOT it.

author: DIEGO MORALES
review_text: Ordered the Al pastor torta. I was surprised it was really good. Small portion, fries were cold. Appetizers we ordered queso fundido and guacamole. That was really good. The drinks were okay, but the service was terrible. I had a torta de al pastor and it was really good, but it’s hard to appreciate a solid menu when the poor service drags everything down—especially with gratuity already included. I ordered one drink I really liked, but the server never came back to see if I wanted another; I probably would have ordered three more rounds. I was with a group, and even though the menu states that gratuity is included, our server acted like they didn’t need to earn it. Our bill was $200, and paying an added $36 for almost no service felt steep. Overall, the dine-in service is bad, and I won’t be coming back.

author: Kinda Jessop
review_text: Love the look, vibe and service here! We had the Four Lokos drink flight and a Watermelon Martini. Delish! However, food was okay. We had the elote and loaded fries. Not bad but definitely not on my foodie bucket list and I love Mexican food. Loved the selfie corners and decor. Music was pumping. Loved the staff birthday rollout!

author: Kenoa Askerneese
review_text: Visited shortly after brunch so food options were limited but good nonetheless. Chicken quesadilla came with a side of rice and beans. Had a Sunset in Tijuana. Everything was so so good. You can tell isa vibe at night too. Staff was friendly and helpful when explaining menu options. Lots of photo ops too! 😊 I'll definitely visit again.

author: Erica Liguori
review_text: Came here for dinner before seeing the NJ Symphony at NJPAC. We had Karina. She was fantastic!! Being first timers, we needed help navigating the menu. She recommended some items and we ordered all of her recommendations! Sooo dang good. We had the birria nachos, the crispy shrimp tacos, and the California burrito. We were STUFFED but everything was incredible. Our drinks were yum too!! Such a cool spot. Looks like it turns into a club at night! And they have so many events to attend; brunch, special DJs, drag shows, birthdays, hookah, bachelorette, etc etc. Only downside was that we had to pay $25 for valet.. thought that was pretty steep for just dinner. If we were staying into the night and attending the club scene, totally understand, but just for dinner? Idk I feel like $10 would have been more reasonable.

author: Leona Palevac
review_text: I went by myself sunday 10pm to have their roasted chicken tijuana chicken entree, which was advertised $18 on the site. When I arrived the entrance was interesting and the place wasn't the "barra" on google maps but Little Tijuana and had same pictures of this barra place. When you enter there is a big empty ballroom and a staircase to your right, as well as a staircase down before that to the kitchen I think. You have to go towards the brightly colored stairs and take a right to enter the bar area. I don't know what else is in the building but the bar, bathroom are beautiful and interesting, albeit terribly noisy. My bartender gave me an ipad with the menu, and I was informed by it there's an automatic gratuity of 18%. I did NOT like that. Then I learned the dish I wanted was $24, not $18, and the bartender didn't know but returned a few minutes later to inform me they didn't have roasted chicken. I then asked for tacos and they said they didn't have the steak, but they did have pulled pork so I got tacos al pastor for $19, chips and salsa for $5, and two modelo's $6 a piece. The food was good, but I did feel sick from eating the tacos and worried as to whether the meat was really food safe. I would go again in a heartbeat, especially if they changed the audio surroundings in the bar to not be deafening... especially if they fixed the televisions. You can put closed captions on the television if there's no sound for them. Overall it was ok, but really, REALLY not worth the price I paid whatsoever. I would not recommend you eat here until Little Tijuana gets an actual manager in their kitchen. I will update this review and do a whole new one if the business offers me, as I don't like leaving businesses with poor reviews but this place needs improvements. I will say there was some decent flavor in the tacos, so they definitely have some staff in the kitchen performing. IT's certainly their management that is lacking with inventory control. My tacos had I believe canned pineapples too, dull in color but with good flavor.

author: Art Dopplis
review_text: The decor and atmosphere were both amazing. The staff were friendly and attentive. The food was great. There wasn't a party going on this night but it still has a nice upbeat vibe. I would definitely recommend and we intend on returning next time in the area.

author: China Smith
review_text: The place is beautiful to look at. We had an awesome time. The food was okay for me. The atmosphere I loved. The music and staff were good. The music was great but not to loud that you couldn't talk over dinner. I would go again.

author: Marisol Colon
review_text: The restaurant is not in the greatest area, just to start. The service was awful our waiter forgot our appetizer order, forgot our drinks - he said he’s a little busy and didn’t even apologize. When we ordered dinner they didn’t have the steak fajitas, how is this possible when you’re a Mexican restaurant. The sangria tasted like kool aid - yes KOOL AID!! The only reason I came was because of the Christmas decoration and the ambiance that was supposed to feel magical. Don’t waste your time coming to this establishment. The gratuity was also added without our consent - apparently it’s done this way. I guess that’s why he sucked as a waiter.

author: Nancy Sears
review_text: Anytime I’m near the airport. I make a point to stop at this place. Their paella is not to be missed. The bartender Benjamin is so nice, informative and attentive.

author: David K
review_text: We walked in on a Tue eve and enjoyed a very good tapas dinner. It’s a good menu with traditional choices and well presented. My daughter has brought small business groups to the restaurant and it’s great for small parties as well and regular diners.

author: Sushmita Jadhav
review_text: Went here on a Friday night. It was nice and peaceful, not too loud. Food was really really good. Imo it’s a must visit place in NJ

author: Carlos G
review_text: Mompu nails the vibe with a sleek, modern dining room, chill back patio, and genuinely friendly staff. The sangria was spot-on, but the papas bravas stole the show—crispy, perfectly seasoned, and utterly delicious. The chicken skewers and house bread with spicy tomato sauce were solid picks. The mussels were just OK, and the tres leches dessert, while clever with its pound-cake base, could’ve used more moisture.

author: Nancy Cintron
review_text: It had been a while since I made it to Mompou. I was starving after our flight back home and decided to stop for some tapas. As always, Mompou did not disappoint! Our bartender was amazing and every tapas dish was excellent! We splurged and ordered the chocolate trio dessert! AMAZING!!!

author: Joshua Cooke
review_text: Came here with some friends and tried many different dishes from the tapas menu. Most of them were very good and we enjoyed the experience. I liked trying things that I normally wouldn't have ordered by myself. The staff was very attentive. Pictured below is the baked potatoes, hangar steak, fried calamari, empanadas, and avocado crab salad.

author: Angel Hsu
review_text: Cute place in ironbound for tapas and drinks. Love the bar seating area and bartenders are friendly. They have a solid selection of draft beers as well. Just wish they’d update their tapas menu every now and then. Also pricier compared to other places in the area. The tres leches cake though, best I’ve ever had.

author: F'burg Foodie
review_text: While working in the area a co-worker suggested we try this tapas joint. Went in on a weeknight and they were pretty busy, so be sure to make reservations. Service was really good during our entire stay. The menu is loaded with some really nice, appetizing Spanish dishes. But what impressed me most was that the food was very nicely prepared! After going to another local “Spanish” joint nearby I was very unimpressed with the way they prepared their food and felt that most all places with that outdated exterior and interior were going to be this way… It was refreshing to find this place that has a very updated and beautifully decorated interior and food to match. Bottom line – Definitely worth visiting, but make reservations! Oh, and get the paella!

author: Danielle Claros
review_text: cozy atmosphere, friendly staff, tasty tapas with beautiful presentation, fun variety of drinks, and everything came out super quickly! my friends and i had a blast pregaming here before our concert at prudential - totally looking forward to coming back soon🤠✨

author: P Gill
review_text: Had a fun Sunday afternoon lunch. We did the Tappas items from the menu. Octopus was very good. The highlight was the flamenco trio plus drummer. They were spectacular.

author: Benjamin L
review_text: Overall great experience. Food was delicious. The highlights would be the traditional paella which flowed with tons of flavor. My only thing is I wish there was more rice with the paella, but tons of seafood and meats was nice. The meat platter was also tasty, just sad there was only one lamb chop. The negra paella was also worth a try. Definitely go with a group of 3 or more people to try more tapas and enjoy all they have to offer. My only concerns was we went on a weekend night and were seated by the open window, where cars kept zooming past loudly. Ask to be seated further back in the restaurant and away from the street.

author: Jonathan Dorf
review_text: We had a great early dinner before a show at the Prudential Center. Easy to walk from to the venue. Awesome staff. Super attentive to my wife who has celiac disease - so many GF options even very good GF bread - seriously!

author: T Henderson
review_text: The food and customer service were amazing. Tabitha, thanks for making my first time memorable.

author: Denise D.
review_text: We had a blast celebrating my friend’s 40th birthday in a private room here. The servers were friendly and attentive. The room has a modern rustic vibe. That with our birthday decor for the place was so pretty. The food was delicious our group of 20 people enjoyed Tapas: dates stuffed with blue cheese and wrapped in bacon, empanadas, chorizo al vino, tostones, and grilled Pulpo 🐙 Mains: steak, paella pasta, vegetarian paella, and grilled pulpo with potatoes and spinach. The place has a beautiful design overall and the food was great.

author: J. Manes
review_text: The complimentary bread with garlic sauce was a winner. The drinks were nice. The lamb chops were over but tasty. The grilled octopus, shrimp and sea bass were okay. The biggest glaring issue was the traditional paella. When the waiter says it doesn’t look right can I send it back for you it’s not good. Even after waiting for another one it was not great. Not one spec of Socarrat which is what makes the dish.

author: Pratik Paddle
review_text: Everything we ordered was delicious and the service was great. I also like the vibe and the music here. It would also be a good spot to come and have a drink at the bar. We had the pinchos de pollo, the octopus, the squid tapas paella, the batatas bravas, and the mushrooms. The complimentary bread and dip they give you is sooooo good too. Our favorite was the mushrooms but everything we had was delicious. We had the tres leches for dessert and it was AMAZING. Very rich though, definitely share it.

author: Jo Atfo
review_text: Can't believe I never came here. The food was so good, except for the vegetarian paella...a hard pass never again. Had the mushrooms and salad, delish. And oh man, that dipping sauce they give with the bread was amazing! Sangria was ok.

author: Kan WD
review_text: Food was great but it was a bit salty. The sangria is nice and strong. Not sweet. $3.99 fee for credit card and the suggested tip on the receipt is based on the total with the fee. If you're a big group, be careful.

author: Dena Scoullos
review_text: Delicious tapas. Many gluten free options. The tapas are great to share and taste all different flavors. For two people we ordered 6 small tapas and it was perfect. Great drinks too!

author: Peter Yong (PedroJoven)
review_text: Nice little eatery and good service. Food's mostly ok. Jamon Iberico was excellent. Hanger steaks were done properly, medium rare. Alcachofas were not fresh and tasted like from canned. Mussels were tender. Paella was ok, can't say authentic Spanish, especially the peas but conceptually good lacking the socarrat. Spicy friend chicken wings is definitely not Spanish but ok taste. Pan con tomate was good. Empanadas tasted good but not Spanish. Ensalada was fresh. Lamb chops were done properly and well seasoned. Flan was good. Price wise is expensive for the quality and quantity, New York City high end price. 4% charge for using credit card which is also higher than normal.

author: Joseph Marino
review_text: The food here is incredible, especially the patatas — my absolute favorite! The drinks are fantastic, and I really appreciate that they have great choices for those who prefer plant-based options. Eating in made the whole experience even better than takeout. I’d definitely recommend this spot to anyone nearby!

author: yuchen wang
review_text: Food is good, for Arroz con pollo, although it taste good, and we do like dark meat, but it has too much bone, we expect whole piece of meat like chicken legs or chicken thighs that easier to eat.

author: Robin Stephens
review_text: We had the best experience here last Friday. We celebrated the holidays from work with our families and were treated like royalty. The food was delicious, the kids were comfortable and the service was very laid back and friendly! My pork chop dinner was sooo good! The minestrone soup that comes with the bread is fantastic!! Our drinks were also really good! Can’t say enough good things, yummy and friendly and parking across the street!!

author: tracey napoleon
review_text: Made reservations for 4 on Saturday at 4:45. When we got there it wasn’t crowded, so we were seated right away. The staff was professional and attentive. The restaurant has an old rustic vibe which was ok for me. We ordered some apps the..scallops stuffed with crab meat and scallops with calamari in a spicy sauce. It was just ok. I wasn’t able to eat the calamari, because they were rubbery. The lentil soup they served was good. My dinner was Salmon with crab meat on top. It wasn’t good. The salmon was flavorless and was on top of a red sauce that wasn’t good at all. My husband enjoyed his meal which was the steak ham and egg special. I should have just gotten the Paella Valenciana which my friend said was good. Over all the experience was good. If i do come back I will get the Paella Valenciana.

author: Peter Lo
review_text: We ordered the calamari, octopus and clams casino for apps. All were very good. Calamari crispy and that marinara sauce had a little kick which made it better. octopus was tender and not rubbery. The clams were satisfactory. My daughter ordered chicken and rice and me and my wife order paella Valencia for 2. Entrees were good. My only disappointment was they pushed the "still" water on me which cost $10. All patrons beware as it's a up sell tactic. I hated it cause I was targeted and no other table got screwed.

author: Antonio Gil
review_text: Great service. Food was ok I had the octopus Galician style very nice done and soft pulpo. it had a good taste but pieces were cut to thin and for my taste the pulpo could use a little more and heavier grade Spanish Olive oil. The caldo gallego soup had a great savor, taste, but it could use a few more white beans lol...

author: Jo Atfo
review_text: First off, the staff is amazing!!! Every time I go..amazing! I've been going here for years but this is the first time I dined in because I was with a friend. I love the food especially the patatas, my go to. Drinks amazing, and I love that there are options for the plant based community. Dining in is way better than taking out, which is what I'm used to doing. I highly recommend if you're in this area.

author: Eric Beckley
review_text: Excellent food and prices fair for the quality. The seafood pilaf was AMAZING!

author: Kerry
review_text: We came on my birthday for an early dinner. The designated parking lot is perfect, I actually watched the parking antics out the window as we ate 🤣 when you walk in you are in the bar. It seems a gallery of sorts with modern art on the walls small but cozy bar area, enough space for someone to enjoy a meal there. We were seated immediately in the dining room, very pretty atmosphere classic old world art reminiscent of my European grandparents’ dining room art ❤️. I chose this restaurant based on the reviews of the paella, we ordered the paella for two and enjoyed the escarole soup while we waited. The paella was amazing the seafood really does come out perfectly cooked. The meat; chicken and sausage were really good but the amount of meats compared to the seafood seemed less (maybe because it had been said I like seafood more, which there was plenty for both of us). There was plenty to eat and still enough fit each of us to have a full meal the next night. The fresh made potato chips are amazing we wound up taking them home too. The only reason I gave less stars for service was because I had to ask for lemon for my water so many times, there were plenty of servers to attend to all your needs, the service was fine after that was resolved. We both enjoyed the whole experience and plan to return. Thank you for the great birthday dinner.

author: Gary Liebchen
review_text: I'm starting this off with what I didn't like. They put a $6 fee on our bill for credit card. I get it. They get this ridiculous fee from them, they pass it on to you. The establishment has to wait to get their money. But to charge for debit card is wrong. They had the money in their account before I got home. On top of that they put the fee and tax in suggested tip amount. Now onto Spanish Tavern. The place is beautiful. Old school charm. The staff is terrific, also with a bit of old school charm. Our waiter Jose was great. They start you off with soup served up at the table. We started with garlic shrimp and paprika. Just fabulous. (Bread was stale and other tables had same issue) I got a seafood paella with shrimp, mussels, clams, scallops and lobster in a fantastic tasty rice. Lydia got the lobster dinner and was not disappointed, though she would have like a bigger lobster as they only have 1.25 lb size. We finished with flan which was very good. I also need to mention the pitcher of white sangria which was delicious, well made and among the tastiest we can remember.

author: Robert Czarneski
review_text: Excellent establishment... If you want a great meal before a event on Newark, you must check this place out !!!

author: Steven Pardalis
review_text: Been going to the Ironbound for 15 years and tonight’s meal was just pathetic. The service was a complete joke. Saw our waiter maybe 3 times, couldn’t get plates cleared, got given two separate bottles of empty ketchup, and didn’t even get to consider dessert because we never got a menu after waiting for 15 minutes. Two of us got lobsters that were barely a pound, overcooked, and had almost no meat. Really just disappointing overall. Go somewhere else.

author: Anonymous
review_text: This restaurant is PHENOMENAL! After reading other reviews, I decided to go here for Thanksgiving! I live in Queens, NY and went to Newark to see the movie "Sara's Oil" wanted a spot for dinner and they did not disappoint! I highly recommend and will stop by again when I'm in the neighborhood!

author: Renee Lam-Whiteman
review_text: Omgggg if you are looking for delicious seafood and paella. This is the place. When you walk in, it’s like you went back in time, almost like you’re on a movie set. The staff is polite and willing to serve. I highly recommend the garlic giant prawns, the paella and the sangria. It’s in Newark but luckily they have a parking lot. Great food!!

author: Alicia Laing
review_text: This restaurant is amazing. I was searching for a place to hold a surprise birthday dinner for my boyfriend. I looked at a few places but decided to try out this restaurant because of the reviews, and when I say they did not disappoint; they absolutely did not disappoint. The food was amazing, the service was amazing, everything was just amazing. When I initially reserved it, it was supposed to be for 10 people, and I was told I couldn't get a private room because the group was too small. To my surprise, they gave us a private room anyway. The room was so beautiful. I've been to many restaurants, and I don't think I've ever gotten this great service. The food was soooo delicious. Their appetizers oh my goodness they have this mushroom in garlic sauce that I don't know who's foot they put in it, but I could have eaten that one dish the whole night and I would have been satisfied. The vegetables I believe they were steamed, but they must have been steamed in love because they were amazing also. Everyone in my group, including the birthday boy, loved the restaurant, food, and service. I can't wait to go back again. When I got to work the next day, I told everyone they needed to go here. Oh, and not to mention it was not expensive at all. I absolutely love this restaurant.

author: Todd Reed
review_text: Holiday party at Spanish Tavern was outstanding. Food excellent portions and everything was delicious from the appetizers to the main dishes and dessert. Sangria was big hit as well.

author: Danny Mcguiness
review_text: Newark is really cool, never been here, coming to see a hockey game and came for lunch and whatba great surprise, white table cloth and servers all over, great service, the bread was great, complimentary soup, very tasty, we had the roast pork quesdilla very nice and flavorful and I had bone in chicken in a sherry sauce, super good, desserts were tasty as well! Super old school classy feel, will fo again.

author: Raymond Lim
review_text: Delicious food, good service, in what looks like a housing area. Seafood paella is chock full of shrimps, clams, scallops, mussels, and half a lobster. Very good. We have a nice dessert, not unlike a crème caramel, which is quite nice. Well priced, recommended if you're in the Newark area.

author: Lou Uffer
review_text: Excellent dinner. Great food and service. Best place we have been to in the Ironbound section of Newark. Convenient parking lot across the street.

author: Jenny Ramos
review_text: We have been coming here for years. The food does not disappoint. They make the best grilled prawns - langostinos around. The dish comes with the potato slices. The steak was cooked as requested and had good flavor. There is always complimentary collard green soup when you have dinner. We drank the mango sangria. For dessert we had the bread pudding and crema catalana. The crema looks like crem brûlée but it’s a little more lemon flavored. The waiters were very attentive and moved our items out of the way quickly to make room for the next course. The place is an inviting intimate setting.

author: Regi Taylor
review_text: The hotel shuttle driver recommended that we try The Cornbread Soul Food restaurant. He was absolutely correct in his suggestion. Dropped in about 7p on Friday night, the place was fairly busy. The staff was amazing, willing to walk 1st timers through their menu choices. You better bring your best appetite cause you can't eat it all, especially if you select the large meals. The collards are perfect and you'll drink the "pot liquor " (juice), the cabbage was slightly crunchy exactly as I like them and the juice was consumed as well. The yams were sweeten just enough to make your mouth water as they enter your mouth. Of course the Cornbread was the perfect compliment to the meal. The turkey leg meal was overwhelming, much more than I could eat without taking a nap in the restaurant after eating. Had to get the doggie bag to finish later. The catfish was cooked with a highly seasoned batter that took away from enjoying the full flavor of the fish. There were many other items I wanted to try but knew I was allowing my eyes to be larger than my stomach. I appreciate this shuttle drivers recommendation and I too want to suggest this restaurant as a must try!

author: André Thierry
review_text: Scored à free night from Marriott Bonvoy, staying at the Courtyard Newark Downtown (I broke up with a woman after we saw Wu Tang & Nas at Prudential, but y’all don’t need to know about that.) Annnyywaayz doe …. My main motivation from taking the train from Manhattan to NJ was to return to Cornbread Farm to Soul, and it did not disappoint! Had honey chicken & black eyed peas and macaroni and cheese and sweet teas! (Just one sweet tea, but I had to keep the rhyme scheme). Absolutely delicious!! Ten-course menus in Manhattan are nice to flex with, but nothing will satisfy me like soul food done right. I cleaned my plate and filled my heart. Glad to be back. And the service by Bernice Kim was as professional, warm and faith-restoring as the food and drink. Thank you Cornbread and Bernice, for making my Friday night and return to Newark memorable And also making me forget what’s-her-name. Much love to y’all. P.S. yes, I know there is a Cornbread in Brooklyn, but THIS location is where it’s at. Felt like I was back in the ATL ❤️

author: Dr. Reynaldo. Evangelista
review_text: Straight up foodies and flavor enthusiasts! Prepare your taste buds for a soulful journey through the heart of New Jersey, where hospitality meets mouthwatering cuisine. My recent visit to Newark's gem of a restaurant left me utterly speechless and completely satisfied. As I placed my order with the courteous cashier, I could sense the passion and dedication that went into every dish. And oh, the food! Each bite was a symphony of flavors, a tribute to the rich traditions of soulful cooking. From the tender fried chicken to the decadent macaroni and, every morsel was a delightful revelation. But the true star of the show was the impeccable service. The gentleman who served my meal did so with an air of grace and genuine care, ensuring that my dining experience was nothing short of exceptional. I urge you, dear reader, to embark on your own culinary adventure and discover the magic that awaits you in Newark's best-kept secret. You won't be disappointed. So, why wait? Treat yourself to an unforgettable dining experience and indulge in the phenomenal offerings of this soul food haven. Trust me, it's a journey worth taking. Enjoy!

author: Stephanie Cartagena
review_text: Review update/ As you can see by my originally review I was hyped. I got home and saw that zi didn’t get the BBQ sauce I requested many times. I paid $40 and was absolutely SHOCKED at the small portion size. As for flavor I like the Mac and cheese bur everything else had too much salt. The ladies there are amazing but I wouldn’t buy again. I posted pics of the food at the restaurant and then what $40 got me when I finally opened up my bag at home. —————————————- Ok hold up ✋✋✋✋ First time calling and first time coming here and LET 👏 ME 👏 SAY 👏 THIS👏 The service from Nana, Bernice, Shakira was top notch…… I mean I couldn’t stop talking about. They made it clear you arrive at 9:59 and they close at 10pm and they will take care of you. I almost don’t want to rate them so high so it don’t be getting packed in here Lol But highly recommend. Quality service and even at night food looks fresh and the smell will have you ordering way more than you were planning to. 5 ✨✨✨✨✨

author: Dionne Warren-Palmer
review_text: We stopped in here to eat for dinner after seeing the excellent reviews and food pictures. This restaurant did not disappoint! We were greeted when we walked in by NaNa and Shakerea. They are friendly, funny and very outgoing. The dining areas are clean with modern decor. We didn't have to wait long for our food to be brought to the table. My husband and 2 children ordered different entrees and they were all delicious!! It was a lot of food. We couldn't finish it all. Unfortunately, for us, we couldn't take it with us because we were staying at a nearby hotel before a cruise. We are looking forward to our next visit, and Cornbread Farm to Soul will be on our first stops to visit!!

author: Kevin Craven
review_text: This was a STELLAR experience! My friends said that we should all try this place out before the Brandy & Monica concert, and I couldn’t be happier that they did! This place felt like HOME! First off, the service is TOP TIER! There are many places that need to take note because the service I experienced was unmatched! It’s a lovely set up with the full menu on display. I ended up ordering the whiting fish with a side of mac n cheese, and it was absolutely divine! Soul food at its FINEST! Don’t call it soul food if there’s no soul! The fact that they call it farm to soul is spot on because I tasted the love! The fish was so nicely seasoned and crispy! The Mac n cheese got me ready for Thanksgiving! Perfectly cooked, cheesy and flavorful! I also tasted my friends yams, and collard greens, and they were NEXT LEVEL! Those were the best greens I’ve had in my life! The cornbread was also amazing! The woman who took our order was thee absolute kindest! I believe her name was Na, or something like it. She understood hospitality, and my friends and I all greatly appreciated her! All of the staff were just so helpful and friendly, and I couldn’t have asked for a better experience! I can’t wait to get back!

author: Kim Quick
review_text: This is my first time here and the food is absolutely delicious. Had an issue with, and it was resolved immediately. Thank you, Bernice, Za’Myah, and Hassan for providing top-notch service. Very surprisingly it was quite affordable. We have five fish, mac & cheese, collard greens, black-eyed peas, and chicken for under $35. And then we got the Southern Twang beverage that topped it off perfect!

author: Elizabeth Amadiz
review_text: If you’re looking for soul food that feels like it came straight out of grandma’s kitchen, this is it. I ordered the turkey wings with mac & cheese and cabbage, and let me tell you—those turkey wings hitttttt. The portion sizes are generous (so much that I couldn’t even finish mine), which means I get to look forward to leftovers tomorrow. Definitely worth every penny. What made the experience even better was the staff. Kim, Bernice, and Nana treated us like family. We weren’t just customers, we were sitting, talking, and laughing as if we were at home in a southern-style kitchen. That kind of warmth and hospitality is rare, and it really made the meal special. Between the incredible food and the welcoming atmosphere, this spot is a gem. I’ll definitely be back!

author: Robert Williams
review_text: Popped in randomly and ordered the catfish, yams Mac and apple cobbler. All of it was great. Nice creamy Mac and cheese fresh fried fish. Customer service was on point. And the dining area is nice, cozy and clean. Would definitely come back

author: Princess Lizzy
review_text: This food smelled and tasted so good I forgot to take a picture before we started eating! Mike and Nana (I hope I’m spelling her name right) were so enthusiastic and inviting, from the moment we stepped through the door. The catfish was HOT, fresh out the fryer, the mac & cheese was amazing and the cornbread was too! Coming from Atlanta, this was a great first stop for some food and we already agreed to order more tomorrow. Thank you Cornbread!! 🤎

author: Robert Hill
review_text: Overall the food was very good and flavorful! I had the turkey wings that were very tasty and tender. It was a big portion(3 wings). I had the cornbread that tasted almost like a cake. I personally prefer it not that sweet, but it was good. The cabbage and mac and cheese were good as well. My wife had the fried fish which she felt was a disappointment with it being dry and salty. My cousins had the fried chicken and collard greens which they felt were a hit! Overall, I would say it was a good experience!

author: Bentrice Jusu
review_text: The cornbread is actually amazing! The fish, fried to perfection, you hear me?! Hassan and Mike were incredibly hospitable and treated my complicated order with ease and care. Every time I come in, There’s a diverse crowd (Asian, Black, Hispanic, white men and women, and the food ALWAYS looks so delicious. Definitely a staple on broad street, and with it being right across from city hall, well I think they are here to stay! Would recommend 10/10!!!

author: C T
review_text: Nana the waitress was so nice and attentive. Bernice the cook, kudos to her the food was immaculate my first time here and I ate all my food!! It was amazing and fresh. Kim the manager was also so nice and made sure we were taken care of. Definitely would recommend this place and definitely coming back.

author: Neiko Alexander
review_text: The food was amazing! Catfish was so hot, fresh, and crunchy! I don’t play about mac and cheese and it certainly met my expectations. Cornbread was moist and not crumbling apart! Nice comfortable aesthetic too!

author: Krystal Simmons
review_text: Couldn’t even snap a picture before digging in. Food smells amazing, and tastes even better! Worth the price, about $20 for a meal with two sides. If I’m being honest, I normally don’t like cornbread but it complemented the meal perfectly, not too sweet but not bland either. Everything tastes very authentic and made with love and care. The restaurant was clean and I enjoyed the R&B/Afrobeats music. I will be returning!

author: nicole Idriceanu
review_text: Jasmine is the best at teamwork, hospitality and efficiency. The food was amazing (Collard Greens, awesome) and Catfish Poh Boy takes me to new Oreelans: crunchy, robust fish, light and smoother tasting. Thanks Cornbread Soul Food! Thanks Jasmine! Will be back soon

author: Joey Barrett
review_text: This is the best catfish I have had in a long time and some of the best I have ever had. The baked macaroni and cheese is made almost identical to how my family in South Carolina made it growing up same with the potato salad. On top of all that the cornbread is amazing, sweet and moist. I will definitely return! In addition to the wonderful, authentic food every one is very friendly. Wonderful service, clean restaurant, no issues at all!!!

author: Bunny
review_text: Berniece, Zamiyah and especially Mike are awesome and they are courteous! I came in feeling very sad and they lifted my spirits. Thank you die the good souls food and also making my soul feel better too with their kindness ❤️ I dined in and Mike bright me my food and was very professional and courteous and he is handsome too. Gos bless this establishment!

author: Richard Harrison
review_text: I stopped in town while visiting a friend and searched for nearby restaurants when Cornbread popped up. I’ll admit—I’m very particular about my soul food. But let me tell you, this place more than held up to my standards. Every dish was packed with flavor and you could tell it was made with love. The highlight wasn’t just the food, though. The customer service from Janelle and Mike made me feel like I was right at home. They were welcoming, attentive, and truly made the experience memorable. And listen—do not sleep on that baked chicken. It is nothing to be played with! Cornbread fed my soul in every way, and I’ll definitely be back whenever I’m in town again.

author: Krystal Quiles
review_text: Mike and Bernice were amazing, the cornbread was excellent and very fluffy and sweet. I’m eager to dive into this meal because it smells delightful. The whiting always fresh- It’s my favorite.

author: Ashley Hackett
review_text: Very disappointing experience. We ordered calamari, chicken Cesar salad and cheeseburger. The chicken was very stale and rubbery. It appears to have been rewarmed several times before serving. Order burger medium - came overcooked. The calamari was also very rubbery. I cannot understand how this restaurant has any more 2 stars honestly.

author: Tezeta “Tez” Roro
review_text: By far one of the worst restaurant experiences I have had. As a business owner myself, I am not quick to give a negative review yet this place lost every opportunity to make things right. We called ahead after an event an NJPAC for an early dinner. We were quickly sat which was a good start. We ordered calamari as an appetizer. I can tell from the first bite that it wasn’t quality food or preparation. The crispy coating came off flaking and I had a hard time grabbing the rubbery calamari underneath with a fork. I ordered a ceasar chicken salad as it felt like a fairly safe option-I was wrong. Before the plate even hit my table I can see how hard the chicken pieces were. Clearly NOT freshly made and looks like it has been warmed up several times. We couldn’t get a waiter to even look our way for a long time much less ask us how the food was. We had to flag someone down and tell them. She told who I believe was the supervisor. No acknowledgement again for a good amount of time. One of our party ordered medium burger and it came overcooked and saturated in whatever sauce was in it. We felt hostage to the place as we wanted nothing more than to leave yet couldn’t get acknowledgement, resolution, a bill or ownership of this experience. The waitress ultimately came with our check. And guess what? It had “suggested gratuity” INCLUDED on our bill and credit card charge which we had to cancel out. It is unfortunate as this is a venue that is well positioned being close to NJPAC yet that days experience has puzzled all of us about the ratings and reviews thus far which is what we based our decision to go there on. I understand that an establishment has an off day or maybe a different chef. Total and complete disregard for the quality of food that comes out or the experience tells me a lot about management.
