It is often when things don’t go well that businesses have an opportunity to win over customers and create loyalty. There was ZERO ownership, effort or acknowledgment here hence my 1 star review.

author: Rolland Colis
review_text: The paella was as super tasty as it was generous - I felt like I had kept eating it as it went on forever (which is important to me).. unfortunately no frond, but still an awesome dish.. my partner got a shrimp salad which was also quite generous . And I topped it all with a flan.. so decadent and good ! ! I plan on coming back here, especially if staying at RT again !

author: Yuri Choi
review_text: The restaurant is beautifully decorated and has a nice atmosphere, which is why we chose it for dinner before a concert at the Prudential Center. We had a group of six and came in on Friday night around 5 PM with a reservation. Unfortunately, the experience was very disappointing. They advertise lamb right at the entrance, but when we asked for it, the server told us they didn’t have any. On top of that, a few other menu items we tried to order were also unavailable, which was frustrating. The menu looks extensive, but most of what we tried fell flat. The Caesar salad was probably the worst I’ve ever had.. the chicken was dry and flavorless. We ordered our steaks medium, but they came out almost well-done. Pasta and risotto were the only decent dishes, thankfully. For a place calling itself a steakhouse, the quality didn’t come close to expectations. Even the restroom felt like an afterthought as their toilet paper was not stocked inside the dispenser, just hanging outside, which was sloppy. Overall, despite the nice décor and convenient location, the food and service really missed the mark. Sadly, I wouldn’t come back.

author: Tonja Howard Jenkins
review_text: Food was good. Well seasoned and fresh. Our server was kind and accommodating. There was a slight language barrier for us (no one in my party spoke Portuguese), but it all worked out. The music was the only thing off about the ambiance. The decor was steakhouse, but the music was diner/cafeteria. All in all, a great time.

author: Anna Burgess
review_text: What a fantastic night at Medallion Steak House & Seafood. The food was beyond incredible — honestly, out of this world. But the standout for us was our waiter, Carlos. He was thoughtful, kind, and so considerate, and he truly went above and beyond to make sure we had a great experience. Carlos is the reason this felt like more than just dinner. Highly recommend.

author: Jessica
review_text: Absolutely awful. Ordered the chicken cordon bleu, and it came out half raw. RAW CHICKEN. One side of it looked like they hadn't even tried to cook it (and the cheese was still solid), and it was drowning in sauce. Told a waiter that it was raw, and he gave us a weird look, looked confused, and said they'd make a "new one in 5-6 minutes". First of all, a brand new one of that thickness would take far longer than 5 minutes to cook, and second of all, they just reheated amd replated the same food (with the slice I cut off placed back on top). Even cooked properly, it wasn't good. The frozen chicken cordon bleu from Barber Foods is better. Whatever, we just wanted to hurry up and leave. They also served what looked like house-made potato chips as an appetizer, which might've been a unique feature if the chips hadn't been soggy. But things got worse when we got the bill. After being charged, we noticed that an extra $4 had been added, as well as a "suggested tip" of 20%, with another line for "additional tip". The total charged amount included the "suggested tip", making it a mandatory tip instead of a recommendation. This is for two people by the way, not a party of six. Called the manager over, he explained that the $4 was their credit card fee - this wasn't stated anywhere beforehand. Then, he tried to claim the suggested tip amount hadn't *really* been charged to the card yet: a flat out lie, considering we could see in the bank app that it HAD been charged. Next, he tried to claim that they charged the suggested tip but would refund the total afterward to be whatever we wrote on tip line... we pointed out that the receipt line said ADDITIONAL tip, not total tip. He stared blankly at the additional tip line and said "I've never seen that before". Brother, you're a manager and have no idea what your receipts look like?? Huh?? No, if we wrote something on the additional tip line, I am 100% certain that it would've been added on top of what we'd already paid. Then, he got frustrated with us and said "You know what, I'll just refund this and do it myself, I pay my employees". Uh, if you *actually* paid your employees, you would give them a liveable wage instead of relying on tips to do it for you. To be clear, we weren't arguing that the staff didn't deserve tips, but arguing that it's scammy and dishonest to charge a "suggested" tip and then ask for more on top of that, when the customer is going to assume that the bill didn't automatically include a tip (y'know, like how every other restaurant operates). Dishonest business practices abound. Wonder how many people they've scammed into double-tipping using this method.

author: Roger Beaujard
review_text: Very sad excuse for a steakhouse. I had the T-Bone which as you can see was more of a bone in strip steak with almost no fillet. No stand out flavor at all, very thin. Absolutely not worth it. Massive disappointment. I've literally had a better steak at Denny's and that's really sad.

author: Marc
review_text: So, they don't have any draft beer (they said they were broken... lots of lost sales there). They were also out of the chicken appetizers. Cod rolls are basically fish sticks, according to server. "Free" chips were super stale, gross. The only thing good about the main dish, was the mushrooms. Walls were pealing paint ans floor tiles were cracking. Presentation was poor. Not impressed.

author: Lauren Tinha
review_text: Our team had reservations earlier today, Joseph our server was amazing, he saved the day! The food was okay , but I was disappointed to learn that house items such as the calamari, the chicken parmigiana, and the surf and turf were unavailable during our visit. For that reason, I’m leaving a four-star review. However, Joseph’s excellent service and thoughtful plate recommendations truly elevated the experience to what felt like five-star hospitality. I will return, and I hope the restaurant will be better stocked on my next visit.

author: Jill C
review_text: Really good food! Went during happy hour and got 2 margaritas each at $15. T-bone steak was really good and juicy.

author: Latrone Huggins
review_text: Was an upscale feel with a down to earth staff that attend to our every need. The atmosphere was very comfortable and music was beautiful. A very nice outing for sure.

author: A R
review_text: Great food, great place and exceptional service. The steak was tender and cooked perfectly. The flan was amazing. I spilled a part of my drink on the table, and the waiter cleaned it up and brought me a whole new drink.

author: Max Sulla
review_text: Understaffed. Definitely not Brazilian. Nice hard working staff but so short staffed that they have no chance to be attentive even if they try. Two waiters and a bartender sharing all roles include a host post. Didn’t ask once if we need anything else once mains were served. Medium rare steak was medium well. Didn’t ask if we would like coffee or dessert after dinner. We had to ask for bread service. Brought main courses And left dirty appetizer plates on the table. We had to ask to clean the table. Don’t know how to make a decent dirty martini either. And then they added 20% gratuity for a party of 2 ! Convenient location for pre show dinner. Next table over burger looked good though. Hope to find a different pre show place to dine at near NJPAC.

author: Del Stokes
review_text: Facilities are nice and welcoming. That is only thing good I can say about the dining experience. Chose the location for my wife’s birthday dinner because it seemed upscale and had okay reviews. Wife is GF(celiac) and tried to order accordingly. Had two different wait staff confirm her order but neither seemed to know what was up with the food choices. They said the kitchen staff would handle the order of grilled chicken and mashed potatoes carefully. Food came out smothered in gravy. She had to send it back while server looked befuddled. Wife didn’t dare to trust anything else from the kitchen or staff. I hurriedly ate my meal and we left. Feel totally flustered and angry that a special dinner was ruined. Would definitely NEVER return or recommend location for another person.

author: Thomas Gross
review_text: I wasn't aware the restaurant was in a hotel and it was a little hard to locate. But, my wife and I are glad we found it. The atmosphere was quaint and quiet. Our server, Joseph did his job well. We didn't have to wait all evening for our food. It was brought to us promptly and the presentation was excellent. My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. And again, kudos to Joseph for his service. I had the t-bone, mashed potatoes, asparagus and rice w/bean sauce. My wife ordered steak w/onions and french fries. We both had salads. All foods were cooked to perfection. Very tasty. If there's a negative to our visit, it's the portions are large. I'm a big eater and I had to carry home leftovers. To much food. I highly recommend a visit.

author: Imigrou
review_text: We had a wonderful experience at this restaurant! The food was delicious and generously served, with every dish full of flavor and beautifully presented. The service was outstanding — very personalized, with a staff that was clearly well-trained and attentive. The atmosphere is warm and family-friendly, making it the perfect spot for our Sunday lunch. A special mention goes to the maître d’, Fabiano, who was especially kind and attentive throughout our entire meal. His attention to detail truly made the experience even better. Highly recommended!

author: Unknown Unknown
review_text: We had such a great experience thanks to our two waiters! Chantel and Renan. They were both friendly, attentive, and made sure everything came out perfectly. You could tell they really cared about their guests, we never had to ask for anything twice. Excellent service from start to finish!

author: Fred Becker
review_text: Just went in for a quick lunch and super impressed. The steak sandwich was wonderful: tender meat and wonderful blend of flavors. I ordered it medium and it came out perfectly - not easy to do on thin pieces of steak! Well done!!!

author: nessa i
review_text: From the atmosphere to the service to the food, it was overall pleasant The price is very reasonable and the food is well seasoned. Renan our Brazilian slwaiyer was very nice.

author: Barrett Zeto
review_text: Highly recommend this place 100%. The staff here was on top of their service, especially right after a show at the NJPAC theater. Small dining room, but made up for the very nice servers and attentive care they put on their customers. Food was fantastic, sauces are DELISH! Burgers are amazing. Cauliflower tots just as amazing. Very transparent on what they have to offer. Black owned business as well, love being able to support 🙌🏼 Much love to yall!

author: Karen K.
review_text: Amazing first experience at the yard. Came here with some coworkers for lunch and was pleasantly surprised by this hidden gem. Staff were super friendly and helpful when placing our orders. Also, they would always come check on us and made sure our drinks were always filled. Superb service! I ordered the seoul sista fried rice. Beautifully plated with a flower in the bowl. The fried rice was made with kimchi that wasn't overly spicy and a large fried egg on top. The Yaya sauce was creamy and paired well with everything. Overall, loved the dish! My coworkers ordered the oxtail sandwich, the walla chicken and the chopped thigh wrap. Everyone loved their dishes and want to come back to try the other dishes. Lastly, we ordered the grilled coconut cake. This is definately a MUST try! First time having a grilled cake and I can say I've been missing out!

author: Adam
review_text: Had the Fish Fillayyyy with cut-fries, very very tasty. The fish filet sandwich was great and also, that Walla Sauce I was dunking the cut-fries into was SUPER tasty. The staff service was excellent. Very attentive and friendly. Ended up ordering "The Breast" to go and had every intention of having it for dinner but... it's just too damn tasty. Eating it now. 5/5 stars. nom nom nom Keep up the good work, thank you for existing and also for being open on xmas eve. :)

author: Gina DeGesero
review_text: the warm welcome from the ultra friendly staff set the atmosphere for a meal filled with layers of flavor, spice and the right touch of heat. get the walla sauce and put it on EVERYTHING you will not regret it. save room for the coconut cake, slightly grilled , warm with a moist crumb *chef’s kiss* this is a meal I will say dream about for a long while. can’t wait to come back to Newark, thanks to the yard <3

author: Michael Robinson
review_text: If you’re seeing a show at the NJ Performing Arts Center and are looking for a bite, this is the place. Even if you aren’t seeing a show and are nearby, this is the place. I grabbed their chicken sausage roll before a show. It was so good I had to come back again after—to my memory I don’t think I’ve ever done the same restaurant twice in a day. Their fried chicken sandwich was one of the best I’ve had in recent memory (photo included), and they’ve got *sweet potato tots*—nuff said. Many thanks to Owner Kai and The Yard staff will definitely be back again🔥🔥🔥

author: Jessica W
review_text: Had the ox tail burger with a side salad. My fiance had wings. It was fye!🔥 Great service. Good music. Cool spot. BYOB. Will definitely come again. 💖

author: Candace Lennon
review_text: Wow! Wow! Wow! Out of all the places we googled, I picked the yard. The staff, the food, the grilled pound cook!! My friends and we're so happy I did. We were not disappointed by a long shot! The staff greeted us as soon as we stepped in. They were very attentive to our needs the whole time. Even though our flight was cancelled this past Saturday 11/8/25, this excellent experience at The Yard made up for it. Thank you to all the staff at The Yard. C Lennon Jacksonville FL

author: My3ti534
review_text: Talk about service with a smile. As soon as we entered we were greeted with a warm welcome. Oseeta, our waitress, sorry for botching your name, was a ray of sunshine, warm, pleasant and courteous. The food was to die for. I ordered the rasta pasta with beyond which comes hot or cold. I opted for it hot. While my husband had the shrimp burger with sweet potato tots. We fell in love with every bite. We also ordered fried cauliflower with sticky icky sauce for the table. There were other sauces but this one stood out for me. And let's not talk about the fried Georgia banana pound cake which we initially ordered for our son, but after the first bite we changed our minds. They deserve twenty stars and more

author: Maryn C
review_text: The food is incredibly flavorful, the staff are really kind and attentive, and the atmosphere of the restaurant in the park was very enjoyable. The dipping sauces were the highlight! Spicy ketchup and sweet tots were an excellent combo 👌

author: Maria Sweeney
review_text: This place is an amazing find. We were in the area to see a show at NJPAC and we happened upon this incredible gem of a restaurant! As other reviewers have said, the service is fantastic, so attentive. The food was delicious and beautifully presented. We are definitely coming back here with family and friends!

author: Corey W.
review_text: Well my wife and I visit the Yard a few times a year and they have some great burgers and sauces that are pleasurable to the palette. I had thr oxtail burger and my wife had the Seoul sister fried rice! It's always a vibe with the music in Military Park in the city of Newark!

author: Bryan McAllister
review_text: Excellent experience. The team here is welcoming and customer service-focused. The food is excellent! For me, I love the sweet potato tots and the marsalla dipping sauce - I'm probably spelling that wrong. The Yard is on my rotation when I visit Newark for work.

author: Matt Mitchell
review_text: Very friendly staff and amazing food. The Seoul Sista Kimchi Fried Rice was amazing! Got it with the jerk chicken added and do NOT regret it! New fave place in Newark. I wish I had a bigger stomach or more reasons to be in Newark because I want to try so many of the menu items.

author: Catherine Santos
review_text: We found this amazing spot before attending a concert at NJPAC. I wish there were enough words to describe the quality of our experience. The staff were so kind and friendly. Our food was delicious! This Philly girl will happily admit that I had one of the most delicious cheesesteaks of my life! I hope we attend another show in Newark just to eat at The Yard.

author: Scorpio Lyte
review_text: I've sent a few people to this restaurant after I was ranting and raving about the food during my initial visit on Nov. 9th 2024 Some of the people I've mentioned it to, have been more than me. I had the oxtail burger with hand cut fries that were so good I kept eating before picking up my oxtail burger. The burger was everything too. I also took a lamb burger home that night which was ok but I'll chalk that up to me warming it up in the microwave. Fast forward to yesterday July 12th 2025. There was an Afrobeat festival going on in the park surrounding The Yard. Hold on to that information. Now before I go with what I didn't like about my experience, I would like to give a shout-out to the guy who gave me a different burger after I realized I made an error on my burger and offered to pay for both as it was my mistake. He took back the original I ordered and gave me the kind I wanted without charging me extra. Upon walking into The Yard, there were 2 signs that read "ALL Orders at the WINDOW. NO Bathroom". In my mind I figured that meant all to go orders are to be placed at the window & the no bathroom was to keep the people who were attending the festival, out of the establishment. Crowd control. My mother and I walked inside to a restaurant that had 2 tables out of about 6 tables with customers. In other words there were about 4 tables available. I proceeded to tell the employee we will like a table for 2. From there we were told to order outside at the window. Confused but we complied. Once we were outside by the window, we sat there for about 7 mins while the worker appeared to be getting orders together. At this point I'm ready to leave but I know my mother wants to try the food since I spoke highly about it. The employee came outside to give out a few orders. While walking past us twice not saying a thing then I asked "why are we ordering at the window if there are a few tables available?" She mentioned that they were trying something different because of the festival in the park.😡 We ordered from the window, paid for our food at the window and then were let in to sit down at a table. 😕 One paying for food in advance when I'm going to be sitting in your restaurant is so strange. Two I never got an answer how ordering from the window then immediately being seated was beneficial for a customer whose intention was to sit down at a table and order. In addition to that whole process, the food was t served on plates but takeout containers. We weren't handed a jar/bottle for condiments but one small cup of ketchup for each of us. Mind you we both had burgers and fries. And plastic forks, not that they were needed. I will post pictures I hope whomever goes doesn't ever experience what I did. I didn't feel like a customer. And to think I traveled from another state to try this again and allow my mother to try it as I loved the food. I made up my mind that I will never go back to that restaurant. I think the only thing that could change this is a conversation with the owner.

author: Luna Reed
review_text: Went here recently with my father who lives out of state, this restaurant was a great introduction to the city of Newark. The atmosphere was very warm and inclusive and you could tell that people are regulars here, it was nice to see our server call their regulars by name. The presentation of the food is absolutely beautiful (See pictures), and the taste was amazing, our server brought us several sauces all of which were great. The only thing that could be improved is the seats were a little bit uncomfortable. P.S. the cream soda is S++++++ tier

author: Ronnie
review_text: I saw a viral foodie review that featured the oxtail burger and the shrimp burger and knew I had to try them both. It was an hour drive each way but I wasnt going to let that deter me. Although the place looked completely full and there was a very large party of about 10 people seated, we were greeted immediately by the host when we arrived and seated. I noticed the owner going around to all of the tables and actually talking with every different party. That really stood out to me. When he made his way over to my table, my husband and I really got the sense that not only does he take great pride and accountability in the quality and taste of the food but he is also a very warm individual who goes out of his way to welcome everyone. I didn't feel like I was talking to an "owner", I felt like I was talking with family. My pictures don't do the food justice but everything was phenomenal and well worth the drive! We got the oxtail burger, shrimp burger and a chicken sandwich. I actually have made plans to visit again very soon and I absolutely can not wait. This is food that is worth an hours drive each way.

author: Robert Morales
review_text: I walked in curious and hungry, craving something hearty like a classic cheeseburger and fries. That’s when I discovered the Oxtail Burger—my first one ever—and wow, it did not disappoint! Absolutely delicious and totally worth the stop. Anaya was awesome, super friendly, attentive, and full of great energy. She even checked in right after my first bite to make sure everything was perfect. Top-notch service and an all-around great experience!

author: L.A. T
review_text: 💎 Gem in the heart of Military Park! It gave me an at-home feel with comfortable seating, friendly service and the best playlist adding an extra razzle dazzle to the experience. The menu (which is digital) has eye catching names for the selections and everything we ate was made to order. From the Fried Salmon Cakes to the Chopped Chicken with grits we thoroughly enjoyed each bite. There is an outside seating area, concerts in the summer and live music regularly. It’s a beautiful spot and would highly recommend.

author: Charles Binau
review_text: Our waitress was Aniyah and she was amazing. She convinced me to go with the Oxtail Burger. I am glad I did! Seasoned well, lots of flavor and cooked perfect. My colleague ordered the lamb burger and he really enjoyed it too. We both got the sweet potato tater tots. I got mine dusted with brown sugar. I’m definitely going back.

author: Cindy Khan
review_text: Just wanna acknowledge the manger tonight , I didn’t get her name ! Shes a beautiful dark skinned woman , about 5’6, she went out her way to assist me and she was extremely sincere. The new guy also , HE IS A BEAST !! He is trying so hard and it shows! I love when these 2 are on shift!!! Thank you for being you.. the entire staff tonight was extremely great and trying there best!!!! Keep it up guys !!!

author: O K
review_text: Terrible customer service from the cashier taking the order on the headset last night, November 22. I could hardly order since the cashier was so in my mouth, cutting me off and not letting me finish my order. I had to repeat the order 5 times !! And he still got my order wrong !! He obviously doesn’t enjoy his job and should find a new one. I’ve never had an experience like that here. Very disappointing when people let their bad mood run their shifts. Please find a new night time cashier because he is not the one! That young man needs to be put on the food line or something because customer service is not for him !!

author: justin wormley
review_text: They have me standing here for two large fries and the manager is walking pass me saying nothing at all as if I am.not here no type of customer service and didn't even offer to say I was waiting . It took someone who didn't take order to actually ask if I got my order yet real customer service will get small orders put and then have one work on big orders . Totally unprofessional wish I could take the photo.. took me 21 mins to get this simple order

author: A
review_text: i would actually give it a 3.5/5 because the nuggets are always fresh but the past few times the fries haven’t been. My cat wouldn’t even eat them refried fries just horrible fries and the staff tends to get aggressive in drive-thru , but overall a pretty decent experience and if i had to suggest a meal it would be the Asiago Ranch Club meal ❤️

author: Gloria Norvell
review_text: If I go to a store and they telling me you have biggie bags for a 5,6 or 7 that's what I expect to pay for it not 6:40 5:40 or 7:40 even the extra amounts they put on after that and then I don't expect to be asked if I want medium or large I wanted the five or six or seven biggie bag the way it comes.

author: Tracey Coleman
review_text: Lines are always long at every Wendy’s .. But This one is always the worst .. always messes up orders , always excess wait time even for just a burger .. Customer Service can definitely be better !

author: Wendy Nunez
review_text: these females at the window are disrespectful and lazy they don’t wanna do they job! all they do is wanna yell and get mad ! I’m a UBER EATS DRIVER i didn’t wanna wait on the drive thru when i’m just picking up a order and they got mad because someone was ordering and i went in front of them i had to cancel the order ! DONT WASTE YOUR MONEY HERE

author: geo “ragingbutcher”
review_text: I went there food for my family they want to rush you out gave me the wrong ordering had the girl read it back and still didn't give me everything on my order they want to keep saying (is that it) if I spend my money here I should get what I order

author: Breanna Blackwell
review_text: The girl when I went to finally get my food was in a rush for me to get out her drive through , after only receiving my food 2 seconds ago . I received the order , she said thank you . After I went to check to make sure , she repeated the “thank you” again as if she was trying to basically say “move it along” . As I’m about to pull off I said “I heard you the first time” she says then after “calm down . Relax” I then backed up and had to ask her who she talking to and what was the problem?! As I don’t understand what’s the rush for me wanting to check MY food that I paid for . It wasn’t a line at the time while I was checking my food for her to be in a rush for me to move .. I then had to put her in her place to let her know that you’re not gonna get my money & then rush for me to go . After tonight I best believe she clocked out or ended her shift after the embarrassment & respect I needed to show her . Wendy’s teach your employee etiquette .

author: A
review_text: Very good Wendy's. It gets really busy, especially during lunch time. The staff is on point. The food is fresh and very speedy. They have a separate area for delivery folks so it doesn't get too crowded. When I went there, the girl at the cash register was very nice and welcoming. There was a guy, I believe was the manager, was expediting the orders and made sure everything ran smoothly. I ordered a double and some nuggets. It was fresh and I enjoyed it. The atmosphere was great and the dining area was clean. Good location in Newark.

author: Michael Anderson
review_text: Staff were very rude and I felt like I was a burden just ordering food. The wrap we ordered had some hard and chewable parts in it. The spicy chicken sandwich was put together very sloppy, I had to fix it to be able to eat it.

author: Randy Johnson
review_text: Their chilly is the best and the rest of thier for is alway fresh and delicious.

author: James Bischof
review_text: Wendy's always provides fresh and flavorful food, ensuring satisfaction every time. Whether you choose to dine in or order delivery, the quality is consistently top-notch. Make sure to try their invigorating lemonade drinks. Additionally, the Biggie Bag offers a substantial and satisfying meal. With a variety of options including burgers, nuggets, and fries, there's something to delight everyone's taste buds.

author: Shaquana Williams
review_text: When asking to use the restroom the manager Terrence would not let me use the restroom until I order something even though I advised him it was an emergency... I was making a purchase but my order had coupons that needs to be used.

author: Laurie Gibbons
review_text: If the thing in the wheelchair on the corner doesn't catch me every time I come here!👊 This spot is plagued with beggars and audacity! I probably won't ever come here again I barely do as is anyway lol EVERYTHING (and I mean everything cooked) is dried out and lukewarm 🥺. But if u must go... I'd recommend the frosty and baconactor ONLY lol

author: Jay Terry
review_text: My first Caramel Crunch Frosty definitely not my last. Warning: It's really sweet.

author: Luandri Castillo
review_text: They missed so much of my order and replaced it with a bunch of chicken nuggets and gave me cheese on everything after I asked for no cheese ( bc I am allergic ( awful night staff and will definitely never go here again

author: Todd Steven Burroughs
review_text: This is to make up for my "4" review on GrubHub last night. I made a mistake: my order *was* right and I'd like to thank everyone involved; Friday night shift, THANK YOU!!!

author: Gerardo Buenaventura
review_text: Service was a little fast. The food here is good would recommend. And the atmosphere is pretty good too.

author: Danny Hill
review_text: It stinks in here literally!!😭 the food is not what it used to be and im only talking about from a year ago! The guy at the register was weird acting and the food itself was kinda nasty. The people around this way don't care what they eat so they'll probably tell you it's good but to me nah you're better off heading to the one downtown on broad.

author: Zaahirah Richardson
review_text: Got a platter from here for my work lunch & i had a hair in my food. Had to work a 12 hr shift they wanted me to bring the plate the next day. Employees are unaware of refund policy wasted my time after telling me it’s okay to come back for a refund . The little of food I had yams were bland Mac and cheese was bland. Short ribs were good but for the price they are should been falling off the bone .

author: Jaevion Heyward
review_text: Good food. Service is terrrrrrrrible. I understand hard long days… i understand not being in the best of moods.. but this SERVICE here baaaaaaby NO! Literally been coming here for 5 years… ordering or dine in. Just terrible! Food is almost like your home cooked so no complaints. But Damn the attitude, I’m sorry to say they lost a customer, because I liked the food

author: Phyllis Lowe
review_text: Hailing from the south, I make it a point to find African American Soul Food restaurants when visiting other states. This one was impressive. The fried chicken was outstanding. Newark, you have my appreciation.

author: Annette Robinson-NeSmith
review_text: I’m so shocked that the potato salad was not the best. It was so sweet and loaded down with an over amount of mayo. The potatoes were not all cooked through. I couldn’t even eat it. The Salmon was good and the collards were ok. Hopefully they will review their potato salad.

author: Jameelah Wright
review_text: An absolute delight and fantastic time. Passed through on recommendation from a family friend and we all went together. They have many halal options for other muslims passing through for a bite. A few things we got were the chicken salad fish meals and mine a deluxe cheeseburger. And an Uptop (what I usually called an Arnold Palmer) the portion sizes for us all were great and hearty and filling and the fries that came with my meal were the perfect fresh and crunchy. Our server Vivian was an absolute delight and helpful. We happen to be there at a time it wasn't extremely packed but still busy. I liked sitting down but by my own habits I definitely would take my meal on the go, there were many beautiful areas around to rest and eat. All in all would love to visit here again when I'm in town.

author: Shawnette Fields
review_text: My Sister referred Kings Family & my daughter brought me. I was impressed. All of the staff that I interacted with were genuinely friendly, the atmosphere was pleasant, the restaurant was clean & everything I ordered was good.

author: Aminul Rouf
review_text: Overall 8/10 Food is a 7/10 As a halal joint of course i give this a 10/10. But to just give it a 10/10 because it’s halal and not be completely honest is so biased and not fair. I had the diva egg wrap (egg white, grilled chicken, lettuce and tomato), chicken tender wrap with fries, home fries with grilled onions and peppers, and i forgot the name of the last one (drenched?) gravy turkey chops which was the recommendation of the waitress. With a side of coleslaw corn bread (corn muffin lol) and mac and cheese. Diva wrap was 8.5/10 Fries 7/10 (a little too salty) Tender wrap 8/10 Turkey 5/10 Corn bread (corn muffin) 5/10 Mac and cheese 7/10 Cole slaw 5.5/10 (too many large onion pieces) Service and our waitress was absolutely wonderful. So pleasant, friendly and caring. Would definitely say to come by and try their food. I would totally come by again

author: Dkei Espinoza
review_text: Food is good but honestly customer service needs to improve drastically , its literally the same thing everytimeg at least let there satisfaction training , its not every staff because some are great but overall needs to looked into

author: elsie johnson
review_text: Sunday, we came had a good meal , server was not the friendliest, i said maybe because she's fairly new, I had to ask her name, got food ate food, wanrto order soup to go, but no server, if you're not they're table, they aint helping you, she finally came back, we ask for box and bill, I paid with card, and gave a 15% tip, then I see them in the corner discussing, and pointing, and looking at me, was I suppose to tip more?, for really very subpar service?, to the most all the ladies are very nice, and attentive, please help new workers present that same energy, you wont have to question your TIP.

author: Kim Armstrong
review_text: The owner is nice and the staff. The fried chicken wasn't good and expensive. The potato salad most people love. The banquet hall is being renovated, so I had to give it a low rating. Overall, this is a good place that doesn't serve pork.

author: Eddie Coltrane
review_text: Was in NJ from Boston and wanted to find a Black restaurant in the area. Long story short I found Kings. Halal Soulfood!!!! I got Fried Fish, Turkey Chops, Mac and Cheese, Stuffing, and a Beanpie. The Pie was Basic, but the food was a 10. Everything was good! I shared with my wife whom also felt the same way. The staff was also very helpful and friendly which made me feel at home. Everything was fresh and delicious, well seasoned, and tasty. Definitely worth every penny, and price was fair. Thank you! Easy 10 kings on Clinton Ave Nork

author: Desiree McNabb
review_text: It is an affordable halal restaurant, the staff was friendly and attentive. Food was good I had the fried chicken with potato salad and vegetables.

author: BiG Yu
review_text: I ordered food to go. I wanted to try the food out and it was BAD. I had a chicken gyro and fries. The fries were solid but the chicken gyro didn't have traditional tzyki sauce. Whatever sauce is on there was BAD. I wouldn't even call this a gyro, it's really a pita sandwich and it's Wack. The chicken was chewy and I tasted a hint of vinegar. I also ordered Salmon, Collards and Cabbage. This is all basic in its flavor profiles. All boring and lackluster but edible. However the cabbage was horrible. In closing I will never eat there again.

author: IamRetamichele
review_text: Pros : The food was absolutely delicious! And the atmosphere was clean and very nice . The service was awesome ! Everyone was soo kind I can’t wait to go again ! Cons : none Price: affordable 2 meals $35

author: Desiree Chisolm
review_text: More than $50 worth of food and there's nothing for us to eat. Oxtail are mealy. Gravy is watery. Vegetables are bland and unseasoned. Meatloaf was just not good. SAD EXPERIENCE.

author: Barbara West
review_text: I love their delicious food, friendly service and atmosphere. I'm located in Central jersey and it's always a treat when I travel North to have lunch or dinner there.

author: Happywifehappylife
review_text: I went here yesterday it was my first time,but it won’t be my last.Everything was so good and I mean everything from the service to the food.Thanks so much guys.I’ll be back real soon.

author: Willie York
review_text: The food is the best thing I ever had and I will be back for some more amen on God

author: Brittni Dillon
review_text: The food was delicious and the waitress was very friendly and very professional.

author: Monica Edmonds-Wilson
review_text: I do not recommend for a delivery order. I am a long time customer and enjoy the food. There needs to be a quality control process to double check orders before going out. There is no excuse for wrong items and missing items for a delivery. Eat In and pickup only are fine. In 2024 almost 2025 restaurants need to ensure quality is experienced in all service options. Please do better.

author: Moses
review_text: Terrible food quality, terrible food presentation, everything looked dried and not taste. The native rice was just terrible. Hard. Not fresh. And red stew was flavor less.

author: Samuel Oghogho
review_text: Food is really great.Well made African and Nigerian dishes.I tried Ofada rice and the sauce and it was fantastic.Also got a takeout the jollof rice which is always amazing.Food can be pricey but its worth every penny.

author: Sonia
review_text: The lady serving the food was very rude and lack customer service and for what ever reason, in a rush to take the customers orders. I went into this restaurant to purchase food for myself and a friend that was visiting from out of state and was embarrassed by the service that was provided. The character of the lady was extremely poor and tasteless. To the owner please train your staff and employees on how to deal with the public no matter where your customers are from. The treatment was unacceptable and becuase of this I will never patronize this restaurant again.

author: Ify Akpone
review_text: I love coming to this place every time I visit Newark, New Jersey. The food reminds me of the motherland Nigeria. I love the fact they have special soups for everyday of the week…Mon-Fri and they all taste amazing. I do recommend their Efo-Riro you can never go wrong with that meal. And their Jollof Rice is practically the best Jollof in Newark. Don’t argue with me argue with your mother oooo. But sincerely if you want a good naija meal and you are in the Newark, NJ area stop by you won’t regret. 😁😍

author: Oyin Ayo
review_text: My review is about catering. We do not know the owner or anyone working from this establishment. Although, I gave a 5 star for the atmosphere, I can not actually rate the dining space since we have never eaten there. We are a family that simply loves good food. I have used 9jabuka to cater very important milestones in my family order the past year. It is the only jollof vendor my partner will accept. Depending on the number of guests, they have only provided the best of the best! We have ordered pans of jollof, ayamase w/ white rice, nigerian salad, pepper soup, and most recently a cooler of jollof rice. I believe they are reasonably priced for catering. They are always on time for the pick-up and the food is always fresh, tasty, and hot (if applicable). There is a $50 deposit if you need to borrow a cooler like we did. We will continue to be a customer.

author: Arthurlyn Cee
review_text: Service here is terrible! Unfortunately, the server who assisted us had a very negative attitude, which made the service unpleasant.

author: Update
review_text: When I see good things I don't hesitate to support and give commemts. I went for a party 2 blocks away from this restaurant, saw cars parked outside tge restaurant, so we decided to check the place out. The environment was classic, the food is well cooked and delicious. i have been back there with friends and family from Trenton, which is over 56miles to enjoy the food again and again. I feel much as if am in Lagos each time am there. Pure Nigerian food, you need to try it.

author: Ebenezer A. Awolesi
review_text: This restaurant evokes memories of my youth in Nigeria. The food is excellent, service is professional.l, there are a wider variety of choices. Having a catering service is also a plus. I ordered ahead and it was ready upon arrival. This is our go to Nigerian restaurant. And strongly recommend this to anyone looking to enjoy Nigerian cuisine.

author: Tunde Ojo
review_text: A friend recommended and i decided to try it out. Best tasting Naija food I’ve had in north east area in a while. I ordered half pan of Ayamase and Ogbono and the meal was very well packaged and more importantly so delicious. I shall be back again

author: kimberly deschamps
review_text: I started visiting this restaurant about a year ago after trying every Nigerian restaurant in Newark and surrounding towns. My husband has an eclectic palate and so far most restaurants have been a miss. I bought the banga soup with the catfish head and it was soo good, it broke my heart to share it with my husband. After that I tried the edikidikang soup and it was a hit with my husband. I love the different soups every day..bitterleaf, egusi, vegetable is a hit with him too. We ordered jollof and fried rice for my baby shower. It is my go to for food now. I absolutely love the moi moi and akara. The staff recognize me and are very helpful and efficient. There is a sit down area but I do strictly takeout because I am always running errands. They close at 7pm and not open on weekends and I respect that because the food is always fresh.

author: adrien nicholas
review_text: First time visitor, the service was welcoming. As I came towards the end of the day there wasn't any pounded yams or fried plantains. But the jollof rice was tasty, but turkey was a bit on the oily side.

author: Tosin E.
review_text: I was in the area to make my hair and was really hungry. Saw high reviews on google and decided to try. I got the ofada & ayamase... the taste was average. The ofada was just a lot of oil and ponmo, and the quantity was small...quite unsatisfying.

author: Journey4Peace
review_text: Joloff is not good to me, they give u sooo much rice w very little meat, then what I thought was a trky wing I purchased on the side an it was just the tip, which was hard...very hard an chewy, tiny piece of cow foot just the bone, happened twice, i decided to gv another chance but im good now, we need zoodoo African spot back, the customer service is rushed but the tip jar is rte there , oh also over priced

author: FR. WENCESLAUS E. Y. Yoh
review_text: Among many in New Jersey, I found this restaurant the best. Real naija taste is here that will wow you. Original delicious Nigerian food with a clean environment and kind, welcoming and understanding staff.

author: Adeshola Andre
review_text: Delicious yummy food, clean environment and deliver food on time,no disappointment

author: humphrey phery
review_text: I always love coming here. Had moi moi, veg soup, banga soup, some fried turkey 🍗 and fried kidneys ..... with poundo yam and amala.... that's like 2 days food gotten one time... I really enjoy the moi moi here... so tasty, succulent and nice color 😋

author: Adekemi Alabi
review_text: Delicious and tasty food.Very classy and d owner’s customer service is outta dis world.All d way from Indianapolis she made me feel at home.

author: Oghenetejiri Okpodu
review_text: the food tastes great , i miss nigeria so much that it made me feel at home again, i will definitely come here again

author: T.
review_text: Authentic Nigeria food absolutely delicious. Lagos is right here.

author: Samuel Wale-Oladimeji
review_text: Considerable prices, food is 100% Nigerian delicacy. An Afican Restaurant to visit in Newark Nj area. Njoi ur meal

author: J
review_text: Chicken tikkah Mac and cheese was amazing. It consists of 2 well marinated tenders on top of Mac and loaded with the minty sauce. The spicy smash burger was good, but next time I would request no mayo sauce (or only on the side). Definitely trying the Nashville sandwich and the chicken & waffles combo next. Definitely a top pick for Nashville style halal on Bedford Av.

author: Ahmed Farid
review_text: When I entered the restaurant, there was no one at the counter. Three workers were outside talking, and I had to call them in for assistance. They came in with a bit of reluctance, which didn’t feel very welcoming. I ordered the Pataka Fries with chicken ($12), which turned out to be delicious, topped with a sweet sauce and served in a generous portion, perfect for one person. I also tried the Beef Smash Burger ($9); although it was quite small in size, it had a good flavor. The ambiance was pleasant and comfortable for dining. Overall, it was a good experience, and I would recommend visiting.

author: Hatice Büşra Kürk
review_text: We ordered nashville and tikkaville burgers. They were delicious, I did want my food to finish actually. The personnel was very kind and helpful as well. We ordered smash burger for the kids without spice, pickles etc. and they ate all of it, even though it was just cheese and meat and we ordered another. Pataka fries has a special sauce with garlic and spices, it was addictive🥹 I will tell my friends about this place and certainly come here again.

author: Vincent Li
review_text: Chicken sandwich and fries both came out cold. Also they charged us for an extra grilled cheese sandwich and when we brought it up they said it would get fixed before they charged it but it didn't. Food looked good, but 100% not worth

author: Mucho Garcia
review_text: Really enjoyed this place!! The food was really yummy! The fries was warm but on the colder side when it was served to us and so when I told them about it they gladly made me a new fresh one and it was soo tasty with a nice crunch. The playlist was really good too lots of Charli xcx and Ariana Grande so good vibes. Really happy with everything we ordered and would be back the next time we are in the area.

author: Mahedi Bhuiyan
review_text: I’ve been coming to this Namkeen for years now and the food, service, and quality has been consistently outstanding to this day. Most recently I went with a big party and the crew there handled all the orders with confidence and professionalism. Major props to the guys in the back pushing out all this amazing food. Definitely try the Nashville sandwich if you’re there, the clucking waffle sandwich is also a great option, but do not miss out on the loaded pataka fries (my personal favorite). Thank you Namkeen, and keep up the great work!

author: Fateema Akter
review_text: Namkeen is such a pretty restaurant and the staff are so sweet, especially Angie in the front :) We got the chicken and waffles, “hot” is not for the weak.. and the waffles were so tasty!! Everything comes out fresh. Definitely a great place to go with friends.

author: Penguinrating
review_text: Excellent place, excellent atmosphere, good service. The sandwich was excellent. The waffle was very fresh. The chicken was fresh. All the ingredients were fresh, a little spicy for my taste, but everything was good. The bathroom was a little dirty. The entire place on the outside was very clean. I liked hearing the chefs singing in the kitchen. A little expensive. The chicken had a lot of flour. Speedy 6/10.

author: Shamiha S.
review_text: Amazing spot! Affordable and delicious. Everything we tried was flavorful and well-spiced. We ordered the clucking waffle sandwich, the tikka melt, and their spicy smash burger. All of them were great!

author: Dania Zaidi
review_text: Amazing Experience at Namkeen! Food at this place was on point! We tried the Nashville and Tikkaville burgers, and both were absolutely amazing. I loved their Dhamaka fries – perfectly seasoned and paired wonderfully with all the sauces. Everything was made fresh, so it all came out hot and delicious. The staff were incredibly helpful and attentive, ensuring a great dining experience. Highly recommend this spot for anyone craving flavorful burgers with a unique twist!

author: Arsalan Atta
review_text: Incredible! I used to put chutney on my burgers as a kid, never expected a restaurant to do this. I should’ve taken a photo of the meat after taking a bite, it was great!

author: Yujing Wang
review_text: Got scammed by the Good Google reviews 😅 The chicken tenders were way below my expectations. Anyone who’ve tasted Dave’s Hot Chicken would understand my disappointment.

author: sümeyye kabasakal
review_text: The place was super cozy I loved every little detail. It was simple, but the small touches were so aesthetic. My friends ordered the Chicken dhamaka fries, the Waffle Sandwich, and the Tikkaville Sandwich. I was full, so I didn’t get anything at first, but I ended up taking a bite from their food and it was delicious! They loved everything and said they’ll definitely be coming back. When it was prayer time, I asked if they had a bag or anything I could use to pray on. One of the employees went to the back and brought me a prayer mat. They were so kind and thoughtful. We loved the place, the food, and the people. Definitely going back again!

author: Abhinav Sridharan
review_text: Truly one of a kind fast casual Indian dining. The Nashville sandwich was the right amount of seasoning and crisp with some desi flavors. The mac and cheese and tikka bites hit the spot also.

author: Ashley
review_text: Best fried chicken in Williamsburg, possibly all of Brooklyn. Addicting sauce, fluffy buns, and a ton of chicken. The maple wings, the classic sandwich, the Mac and cheese are all stars. We usually order pick up but dining in is low key with good seating.

author: Will M
review_text: The staff was very nice and the place vibey but the chicken sandwich was just okay. I got the medium and it didn’t feel spicy at all, I got the hot and it was just overly seasoned, not really hot.

author: Kiran Aravapalli (akakiran)
review_text: Went here a while ago and then came back, I think it has really dropped off - the tenders I ordered were cold, and the mac and cheese was also cold and given to me before my full Oder, And possibly the worst cole slaw I’ve had in recent memory and look how small it is! Biggest issue was they no longer offer tap Water! - Aparently people broke the cups (in Williamsburg really?) - it is a disappointing cash grab and I won’t be back because of it.

author: Craving Calories Foodie
review_text: Pricey but Halal. The atmosphere is pretty clean and calm. Service is good. Chicken is pretty-made and heated before serving. The Nashville sandwich is average. The waffles and chicken do not go as a sanwich/burger style. It’s practically too big to be eating as a sandwich/burger. It looks really good aesthetically in pictures/display.

author: Rupkatha Mukherjee
review_text: I just wanted to mention that their food is good but extremely spicy. Me and my friend ordered mild chicken tenders and chicken waffle and we almost passed out because of the spice level. My friend and I are both Indians from India, and this space offers extremely spicy food which can make you dizzy. The taste is great, no doubt but you will surely get sick the next day. I usually do not write reviews but for others safety it is required. I was extremely hungry so I took a few bite and then felt super dizzy and was sweating. They did offer us extra ice cream since we couldn't eat the food. The ambience is nice. My recommendation will be to add a warning when you are adding that level of spice. My friend is from Delhi who likes spicy momos and paanipuri and this was extreme. Stay safe out there!

author: Farhan Eram
review_text: We came with a party of nearly 32 people and even despite the immense traffic - service and quality of food was nothing short of terrific. We all left the establishment on the cold winter night feeling full, warm and most importantly, SATISFIED. Thats the Namkeen way!

author: Weston Corbin
review_text: The steak is phenomenal in every sense. The dry age is perfect and the seasoning is just right. It truly is a quality steak. The portions on the salads, appetizers, and sides are large enough to share. The German hash browns were particularly delightful. The atmosphere is somewhat stale and the service is good, not great. Overall, one of my favorite New York steakhouses.

author: Ilyxoxo
review_text: Honestly, I wouldn’t come here again. The atmosphere is great and the place looks fancy. The food and the service on the other hand, not so great. Our server was friendly, but very pushy. My table noticed he kept insisting that we add additional items to our meal, if you know, this place is very expensive. So that was off. After getting the bill, we tried to tip $15 because I thought tipping was the customers choice based on the service provided, but apparently not. We had to tip $50 which is insane. I don’t know how this is acceptable to these people, you’re already making tons of money from your overpriced items , but that isn’t enough for them. Now the food, it was ok. I enjoyed the steak and the sundae, but it wasn’t worth the price. I’ve eaten at steakhouses with better food and service, where they actually don’t force a $50 tip. I’ll be seeing myself there.

author: Caroline Tomon (Carrie)
review_text: What a great experience!! I recently had the pleasure of dining at Peter Luger while visiting my son in NYC. We did jit gave reservations the evening we dined however we did arrive earlier in the evening. We shared a house salad and tried the bacon to start. The salad was perfect as a start to our meal, simple yet fresh and delicious. The main course was absolutely amazing. The steak was cooked to perfection and just melted on your tongue. We enjoyed our server Mr Lou immensely who added some fun to our meal. Nothing beats spending time with those you love especially when the time you get is limited and spending a bit of that time with a bottle of champagne and a delicious steak and great service is appreciated. This experience was a treat I won’t forget and I hope to repeat on another visit to the city.

author: Doug Ainsworth
review_text: Excellent experience. One of the best steaks I've ever had. We did feel a little rushed but service was still great. We got the steak for 2 and was amazing. Really need to order it rare or medium rare its still going to cook in the butter once it's on your table. I know it seems over the top but spooning the butter over the meat takes it to another level. Can't go wrong with the German potatoes and finished it off with some cheesecake. Had several cocktails and a beer all were very good as well. For how well known and rated the place is prices weren't super crazy but you will spend 200 to 300 for 2 people. I would definitely come back again or at least try the one in Vegas.

author: Bill
review_text: Peter Luger delivered an old-school steakhouse experience that felt cozy and down to earth at the same time. We shared the steak for two with creamed spinach and sautéed mushrooms. The steak (medium rare) was incredibly tender with plenty of rare, juicy center cuts, and the signature sauce added a refreshing contrast. The creamed spinach was silky and perfect; the mushrooms were fragrant but a bit salty. Portions were huge, easily more than we could finish. We ended with the cheesecake and its iconic mound of whipped cream. Our server Eric was charming and funny throughout. Also worth noting: they only take debit or cash. A hearty, high-quality, and quintessential NYC steakhouse experience!

author: Vanessa Yiu
review_text: One of the best steak experiences I’ve had! The steak was insanely good—juicy, flavorful, and cooked to perfection. The crispy fries were the perfect side, and the desserts were just as impressive. The vibe is classic NYC—bustling and full of energy. Staff were super friendly and made us feel right at home. Be ready for a bit of a wait even with a reservation, but trust me, it’s totally worth it. If you’re looking for an unforgettable steakhouse in NYC, Peter Luger is a must-try!

author: Vivian N
review_text: We shared one steak and also got their sundae which was huge! We got our steak medium and it was pretty good. We made sure to drizzle the meat juices on the meat as well. The server served us each a slice of the steak in the beginning which I thought was pretty cool. It also explained why most of the google review photos didn’t have a fully intact steak lol. The sundae was a must-try for us- they’re known for their whipped cream. However, the ice cream itself didn’t taste like anything special. There was just a LOT of hot fudge and whipped cream. It was good but also got sweet/heavy fast. It could definitely feed four. The server showed us how to eat it which is to stick the entire long spoon into the sundae and pull up lol but it was so big. Surprisingly the milk chocolate coins were really good imo. Oh and I don’t think they take credit card (it’s written on the menu) so make sure you bring a debit card or cash. If you are celebrating a birthday or something, we did see them sing happy birthday to a couple tables.

author: Del Mar Dave
review_text: Love it or hate it - it's incredibly popular and not always easy to get reservations. New York mainstay, tradition, with a cult following who fiercely defend its reputation as one of the top steakhouses in the country. I'm probably one of those. Your waiter will likely be a stodgy older gentleman with years of tenor. I don't know of any other restaurant that only takes CASH - no credit cards wow. Unless you have a Luger's house account charge card. I'm one of those; had it for over 30 years. Be careful don't forget about this - bring CASH. I'd love to tell you everything is excellent, but I've always ended up ordering the same things, never did a deep dive on the menu. STEAKS. Important advice, if you go solo, don't get the single steak, order the steak for two it will cook to your temperature better, the single is too thin. You're going to love the dry-aged (they age in their own butcher shop in the basement - some creepy stories down there over the years for sure), it's a Porterhouse cut with both Filet Mignon and New York Strip, in an extra thick-cut steak. So, take the rest home for sandwiches and skip the steak for one. SIDES. Recommend several: Shrimp Cocktail they are giant - add side of extra-hot horseradish. Sliced tomato and onion (goes great with the Peter Luger Steak Sauce). Thick cut bacon, also great with the sauce. My last trip, for the first time ever I went with a Caesar Salad which was excellent. If you're looking for a rich, creamy, cheesy Creamed Spinach, you'll probably want to pass on their version - it's more "spinachy". DESSERT. I've only had one. The giant Ice Cream Sunday - assuming you have room in your stomach after dinner. Outstanding love the globs of chocolate sauce. This is not a new and shiny place, for those looking for an upscale dining experience. 100% OLD SCHOOL. I love the place, its cozy to me despite all the high energy and touristy crowds. Arrive, check in, have a Martini at the bar and take it all in. Love it or hate it - you'll have an experience you won’t regret.

author: Gavin Ransom
review_text: Brilliant! Love the crazy busy vibe, the old school charm and the fantastic food. Started with the awesome bacon and a cedar salad, both perfect. We hit steak for 3 between the 3 of us and it tasted wonderful but was easily enough for 5! The PL fried potato was nice and tasty. Cheesecake and Holy Cow fudge sundae were both fantastic and massive and the side of cream was enough for days and days!!!!

author: Omer Anis
review_text: Lunch at Peter Luger in Brooklyn was nothing short of phenomenal. I ordered the steak for one, accompanied by the creamed spinach and the legendary apple pie, and every bite was perfection. The steak was beautifully charred on the outside, tender and flavorful inside, truly the kind of cut that reminds you why this place has been an institution for over a century. The creamed spinach was rich and perfectly balanced, and the apple pie… simply unforgettable! comforting, crisp, and decadent all at once. A special mention must go to Denise, who made the experience exceptional. His warmth, attentiveness, and effortless professionalism elevated the entire meal. He struck that perfect balance between friendly and polished, making me feel genuinely welcomed and cared for.

author: Cathy Brelly
review_text: It was our first time going there but definitely not the last. The steak was delicious, overall the foods we've ordered were perfect. The service was commerdable as well.

author: Cindy Francis
review_text: My husband and I celebrated our anniversary at Peter Luger Steak House in Williamsburg, and it was incredible! The rustic old-time charm adds such a warm touch. Eric, our server, was amazing, attentive, kind, and even surprised us with an anniversary treat. We had the Steak for Two with baked potato and fries, perfect portions and absolutely delicious. Finished with the chocolate mousse cake and homemade whipped cream, which was the perfect ending. A true New York classic worth every bite! 10/10 recommend and can’t wait to return!

author: San
review_text: Even with a reservation, we waited about 30 minutes standing in a crowded corridor before being seated — and our table ended up being right next to the restroom. The hygiene standards were disappointing: staff handled cash and then served food without washing hands, and several aprons looked noticeably dirty. The food itself was good, but the overall experience did not match the expectations.

author: Goran Vadina
review_text: Everything was absolutely perfect at Peter Luger. The steaks were flawlessly seasoned and cooked to perfection. The meat was beautifully seared on the outside while perfectly juicy and tender on the inside. The house beer was top quality and complemented the meal wonderfully. Overall, it was an excellent dining experience that I would highly recommend. Ps.. cash only is a little bit down side as I dont like to travel with to much cash in my pocket.

author: Randall Hicks
review_text: This was a bucket item place for me. I didn’t know if I would ever have a chance to eat here. Reservations were easy through their website but plan ahead the time slots are taken up and it can be difficult to get in here. The staff are very welcoming and knowledgeable about their food. We did arrive about 30 minutes early for our reservation and the staff were gracious enough to fit us in with under a 10 minute wait. We ordered the Sizzling Bacon and tomato and onion appetizer. Both were phenomenal. Side note, the bacon slices are very big. We ordered 1 a piece and that was 1 too many. We started with a Cesar salad that was great. Then for our entree we had steak for two. We have different preferences for our doneness and the restaurant was able to accommodate that without difficulty. For dessert she had the chocolate mousse cake and she was impressed. Peter Leugers is a world class steakhouse and is on many people’s list to try. It’s worth it if you’re given the chance. Very important-they only accept cash or a Peter Leugers card.

author: Hanna Lin
review_text: Rsvp is highly recommended! We love the service and the atmosphere of the rustic steakhouse. The steakhouse for 2 was perfect for me and my daughter. My husband and son opted for a couple of burgers instead, but they unfortunately wasn't impressed.

author: Jenny Shin
review_text: We visited as a group of three — two women (Two women who usually have small appetites) and one man — and ordered the steak for two, baked potato, tomato and onion, and spinach. The portions were generous, and we left feeling very full and satisfied. Our reservation was for 5:45 PM on a Tuesday evening. Although getting to the restaurant during rush hour from Manhattan was a bit challenging and the location was somewhat unusual, it was absolutely worth it. It was the best steak I’ve ever had, and the high price felt completely justified. Everything we ordered was delicious, and the place was quite busy. I would definitely visit again.

author: Elizabeth Wang
review_text: Peter Luger in Brooklyn is definitely worth visiting — the steak was delicious, cooked perfectly, and you can really feel the sense of tradition and history in the place. The old-school vibe adds to the charm and makes the experience memorable. That said, it’s pretty inconvenient that they only accept cash or debit cards. In 2025, that feels a bit outdated. Still, the food and atmosphere make it an iconic spot that’s worth trying at least once

author: Aleksandra Dacko
review_text: Dining at Peter Luger Steak House in Brooklyn was truly exceptional. The steak was a masterclass in preparation, perfectly seared on the outside and tender within, showcasing the deep, rich flavor that only comes from expertly aged beef. The accompanying salad, though simple in concept, was executed with remarkable precision and freshness, proving that even the most straightforward dishes can be elevated to excellence. The atmosphere carried the weight of tradition, with a timeless New York charm that made the experience feel both iconic and intimate. Service was attentive yet understated, allowing the quality of the food to remain the centerpiece. This was not just a meal but a reminder of why Peter Luger continues to set the standard for steakhouses.

author: Joshua Dyer
review_text: Peter Luger delivered a great experience. The portions were generous, the service was attentive, and the steak was cooked to perfection. The apple strudel was a nice finish and tasted really good.

author: Peter Vu
review_text: L’Industrie absolutely lives up to the hype. The crust is light, airy, and perfectly blistered with just the right chew, while the sauce is bright and balanced—not overly sweet. Every slice feels thoughtfully made, from the classic Margherita with fresh basil to the richer toppings like burrata and pepperoni that add real depth without overwhelming the pizza. Even when it’s busy, the quality stays consistent, and the slices come out hot and fresh. Easily one of the best spots for authentic, no-nonsense pizza that still feels special, and well worth the wait.

author: Alexey Subach
review_text: Overall the pizza is nice and probably one of the best spots to try New York style pizza. To me the flavours were not as prominent and the price/quality ratio was a bit low. This place often has a large queue and the staff is not able to cope with the demand even they all work hard. Sausage pesto pizza didn’t have as much sausage but it surely had the spots of cream cheese that they put on most of their pizzas. I wish the baked cheese had a more prominent flavour. The dough structure and crunch was really great though. The New Yorker pizza was nice but the flavour was very straightforward of course. Overall if you want to try the New York style pizza then I do recommend this place. Not sure I want to be back and try it second time though

author: valeri bolkvadze
review_text: Just had the best pizza experience in Brooklyn, and it's no wonder L'Industrie is topping everyone's lists—it's the best for a reason! Tucked away in the heart of Williamsburg, this spot nails that perfect balance of no-fuss vibe and top-tier quality. I grabbed a classic cheese slice and the mushroom one, and holy cow, the crust is insanely crisp and thin without being floppy, with that ideal char that screams "made with love." The sauce has this rich, tangy kick that pairs perfectly with the gooey, high-quality cheese—none of that rubbery nonsense you get elsewhere. What sets it apart? It's not just the pizza; the whole setup feels effortless. Minimalist counter, friendly crew slinging slices like pros, and that fresh basil on top? Chef's kiss. I scarfed down two slices and was already plotting my next visit with friends—maybe the pepperoni or sausage next time. If you're in Williamsburg craving pizza that actually lives up to the hype, skip the lines at the tourist traps and head here. Hands down, one of my new favorites alongside spots like Martha's for that reliable quality hit. 10/10, would recommend to anyone who takes their slices seriously! 🍕

author: Mike
review_text: In my NYC Summer 2025 Pizza Top 5 list, there's a shared second place. One goes to L'Industrie Pizzeria in Williamsburg. This is what I imagine a NYC pizza to be. The crust is a bit crispy, but not too crispy, not too little—just right. The dough is perfectly thin. The tomato sauce is fantastic. The cheese is subtle and not overpowering, and most importantly, there's no dripping grease on the pizza (unfortunately, like with many other NYC pizzas). Be prepared for standing outside for about 20 minutes (in NYC, the waiting line duration is always 20 minutes, no matter where or what you're on line for). The staff is treating you with the typical NYC roughness but everyone is still friendly. Don’t forget: Ya‘ll always get a smile back when you smile first! Around the shop, with a few standing tables—you usually get the pizza to go—you can still find the original, not-yet-quite-gentrified Williamsburg. But don't worry, everything is still harmless here. Highly recommended.

author: Dessa R
review_text: On a Saturday evening, worth the wait. The line goes fast because the staff are super efficient. Got a slice of the cheese pie and for fun, a slice of the bacon & fig jam. The cheese slice was delicious, great char, cheese/sauce ratio and flavor….now the bacon and fig jam was soooo delicious (salty & sweet—>perfect balance). It’s gets crowded as it’s a super popular spot, if you find a spot inside along the windows, snag it). Next time would love to try the burrata slice.

author: JungJim 1776
review_text: L’Industrie Pizza — Burrata Slice Review Busy for a Thursday, but for good reason. I ordered the burrata slice and the presentation was excellent. Overall, it was a very good slice — 7.9/10. The crust had a nice crisp, though it could’ve used a bit more time in the oven. Slightly greasy, but not enough to detract from the experience. Still well-balanced and enjoyable. The atmosphere was my main downside: standing-room only and very crowded. Elbow-to-elbow dining made it feel a bit chaotic and had me feeling antsy. That said, I appreciated the small details — like the canned water branded with L’Industrie, which was a nice touch. If I return, I’d skip the single slice and go straight for one of their artisan pies with more toppings. While it wasn’t the best slice I had that day, it absolutely held its own on a full Brooklyn pizza walking tour. I’d definitely recommend it. Scorecard 🍕 Slice: 7.9/10 🔥 Crust: Crisp, could be more done 🧀 Toppings: High quality, well-presented 🏙 Atmosphere: Crowded, standing only 💧 Details: Branded canned water = nice touch

author: Jason Fong
review_text: This is it! The hype is real! This is the most delicious pizza I’ve ever had. Lots of flavor from the grana padano, the sauce was deep and tangy, basil was fresh and beautiful. Crust was perfectly crisp, with just the right amount of chew. It’s worth the wait. On my trip I also tried best pizza, John’s of bleecker, Angelo’s, and I liked this the best by far. Service is impeccable as well.

author: Ryan Naman
review_text: Is the hype real…? Short answer… Yeah! Guess we got lucky going in on a cold ass night cause there was no line and plenty of room to grab a spot to stand and eat a slice! This pizzeria has been on the bucket list for a minute and I’m glad I was able to make the trip out to grab a slice! I don’t remember the names of the slices… but they were fantastic! I love pesto and on pizza that’s this killer it was an amazing experience! But I’m here to rate the cheese slice baby! 8.9 Amazing, would definitely be back and would eat it drunk in bed every time!

author: Mendel Davis
review_text: Absolutely worth the trip from Baltimore! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I came all the way from Baltimore specifically to try this spot, and it did not disappoint. The burrata pizza was phenomenal—creamy, fresh, and perfectly balanced—and the Margherita pizza was classic, simple, and executed flawlessly. Every bite reminded me why great pizza doesn’t need to be complicated. On top of the amazing food, the service truly stood out. Wendy, one of their incredible team members, went above and beyond and even let us try the Neapolitan dessert—which was the perfect ending to an already fantastic meal. She was warm, knowledgeable, and genuinely made the experience memorable. Wendy absolutely deserves a raise and a promotion. Between the quality of the food and the outstanding service, this place is a must-visit. I’d gladly make the drive again without hesitation. @Wendy hmu on Ig @godsworkinprogress234

author: James
review_text: This is possibly the most hyped pizza spot in a city that's known for pizza, so I had to make my way over here to this Brooklyn spot. The line was present, but not too long - about 15-20 minutes or so I got the Burrata slice, which is just a basic cheese pizza, with some burrata on top If I had one word to describe this slice - it would be light. It was so thin, and so easy to eat. There wasn't an excess of anything - cheese, sauce, or thickness. The dough was probably my favorite part. The air bubbles near the top showed how well-fermented the dough was. It was very airy and fluffy overall. The only downside was I thought the bottom could've been cooked a bit more - it was missing that cracker-like crunch associated with other NY pizzas. While still cooked well - there was a good char on the bottom, better than most places, it wasn't quite at that absolute top level The mix of cheese & sauce over the top was very high quality. Like mentioned before, there wasn't a lot of it. I think I prefer a pizza with more cheese as it's a little bit plain for me, but the fundamental aspects of each ingredient are fantastic. I thought the cornicone on the outside was also very good The burrata topping was very nice, and probably the highlight for me. It's not something you see at most classic pizza places, and it added a super creamy nature to the sections where it was present This pizza cost me around $7, so it's on the slightly more expensive side when compared to a typical slice. I would say it's enough for a light meal, but don't expect it to keep you full for long. Overall, I think this pizza is excellent, and one of the best individual slices I've had. The artisan style is impressive, but if given the choice, I think I'd stick to the more classic NY-style variety. 9/10

author: Michael Wedd
review_text: One of the great NY slices. Get in line with 20+ minutes to spare at peak times. Get the burrata, NY slice, sausage and pesto, or anything else. Order to eat in (standing) for the real experience. The crust is crispy, the mid crust gooey, and the toppings like burrata being deluxe without over the top add ons. The service is friendly and smiley despite the chaos. Legit!

author: M M
review_text: One of the best pizza in NYC!!!! Dough are freshly made. Doughnuts are also made in house. You can see they mix the dough and the dough that are proving to rise. Pizza itself was really aromatic. Crust was perfect. Highly recommended

author: Rachel Deterding
review_text: Worth the hype, although expect to wait in line for a bit (we waited about 20 minutes on a Saturday around 2:30pm. If you want to dine-in inside, expect standing dining only and to be elbow-to-elbow with others with a fair ampunt of noise. The line moved pretty efficiently, and the pizza was really good, and decent value. The staff were efficient and friendly.

author: Herman Ng
review_text: In my opinion it is the best pizza in NYC that I’ve had. What I like about the pizza is it isn’t too heavy, more on the light side. The bottom is crisp with hardly any flop. I went to the Brooklyn location on a Monday, early afternoon. There was a banal line but it moved quickly. There are spots inside or outside to eat your slice.

author: Ryan Tammaro
review_text: Super light slice with a nice blend of cheese and sauce but a crisp slice. It’s excellent! Loved the chocolate chip cookie but probably not worth $4 You’ll have to contend with a line and likely limited to no seating but worth it for this slice!

author: Mohammad Naimur Rahman
review_text: Went to this place for try the pizza as I heard is very popular. Sometime you have to wait in line to order. I tried two of their popular pizzas. The food was ready with in 20 mins. The pizza taste was really good. Also after finishing the pizza tired the ice cream too. The food was really good. Highly recommended 👍.

author: Erin Johnston
review_text: Probably my favorite slice in NYC so far. Had the burrata slice and a Pesto sausage special. Crust is very good. Crispy on the bottom and thin but with a nice chew. Flavorful. Ingredients and toppings were all high quality. Pricey for a slice of pizza but in this case, it’s worth it! Visited on a Thursday around 4:30pm and no line/no wait.

author: Callin Mullaney
review_text: One of the best pizza places I've been too and a top contender in NYC. The staff was ridiculously friendly, the slices were huge and amazing, and the wait time (despite the long line) was not a big deal. This is a must stop for any traveler visiting Brooklyn or a local looking for the best place. Can't say enough great things about this place.

author: Tom Bouwhuis
review_text: L’Industrie is an absolute bucket list spot and more than worth the hype. We arrived just as it opened and it was already starting to get busy right away. By far, these were the best slices we had during our time in NYC. We tried three different slices— the burrata, the L’Industrie slice, and the spicy salami — and each one was absolutely awesome. Perfectly crisp, flavorful, and unforgettable. A must-visit for any pizza lover. We shared 3 slices with the two of us and were super full after.

author: 조현진 (jhonny)
review_text: I took a bite and it was so good that I got back in the long line to buy another one. But soon you came over and said, “Are you guys buying again? You don’t need to wait in line twice,” and helped us out. And that’s when I met the best fig jam ever. (I won’t say too much in case it causes any trouble for your shop—but I’m sure you know what I mean 😉) We felt like we received such a big gift that day.
