It’s one of the few places my dad genuinely enjoys, which says a lot. The restaurant is located right across the street from South Coast Plaza, in an area with many dining options. Whether you’re dining in or grabbing takeout, service is quick and reliable. It’s a small space, but there are plenty of tables. A hidden gem for real Sichuan flavor.

author: Sweta Baniya
review_text: I had delicious vegan food here and both dishes were made with care! The owner also asked about Oyster sauce which I don’t eat! He was very attentive to my request and was very kind and careful. The tofu was DELICIOUS! Cauliflower was okay!

author: Shelly Shi
review_text: Updated: second time here with groups of friends. The dishes are authentic and big portions! Highly recommend. Fast take out- the Szechuan cold noodles came out fast, and was delicious with tasty sauce, just wished there were some protein options can be added.

author: M planetmike
review_text: This is a Szechwan Zone. If you enjoy Spicy Chinese, this is the place. Like so many good restaurants in California, it is Innocuously located in a strip mall. We had excellent food and service. The restaurant furnishings have been updated. Prices were very reasonable. Our bill for 4 people came to $100. I encourage those who had negative experiences years ago to give this another chance.

author: Noa Pei
review_text: What a terrible dining experience! I was shocked to find hair in my food, and the indifferent tone and bad attitude of the waitress really shocked me. I really regret choosing to try the dishes here! It turns out that all those who gave bad reviews have their reasons! That waitress in the restaurant simply shouldn't be working in the service industry. She should be a queen at home!

author: Ben Park
review_text: Had the spicy cabbage, frog, and shrimp fried rice. The fried rice was just ok, but the other two dishes were great. The frog had a great texture and didn't taste fishy with a good numbing spice profile. The cabbage was actually my favorite. The staff was nice. Order a Beijing yogurt. It's just a sweet yogurt, but can offset the spice. EDIT: order the items with thumbs up. The spicy wontons and the garlic eggplant weren’t good but the items with thumbs up were good.

author: Kristine
review_text: Tasty zone is a yummy spicy Chinese restaurant. Newly renovated dive covid it has a fun vibe. It's not a big restaurant so if you are coming at lunch or dinner hours there may be a wait. There is plenty of parking and well located in the shopping center at the corner. The service is good. Nothing over the top but friendly and efficient. The food is yummy and spicy. It is served hot and fresh. The menu is large with a huge variety to choose from spicy, ma la and not spicy. I recommend getting the yogurt if getting spicy if you are not used to it.

author: David Monson
review_text: Loved everything I ate here. Took me back to my year living in China. So flavorful. Soany of my favorite dishes. I'll be coming back for sure!

author: Carrie Menendez
review_text: Stopped in for unplanned lunch, amazing food with flavors and huge portions. Planning how to use our extras!

author: Andrew Z
review_text: One of the only good Chinese food places I have found. Their noodles are spectacular!

author: Jack Du
review_text: Escape!!! This place is a joke. Sure, the food might be ‘authentic,’ but the service is absolute garbage. One rushed, incompetent server for the whole restaurant, unable to follow simple order instructions, let alone refill water or provide napkins. Worse, the server—a fellow Asian—was straight-up racist. Friendly and chatty with English speakers, but cold and monotone when I spoke Chinese. Unbelievable. And the best part? When I rightfully chose not to tip for this disaster of a service, the server told me not to come back. Instead of whining about a missing tip, maybe ask yourself why you didn’t earn it in the first place. Pathetic service, disrespectful staff—save your money and go somewhere that actually values customers.

author: Aisling Nox
review_text: Would never recommend this place. If you’re ordering takeout, be prepared to wait A LONG time past their time they tell you it’s ready. Also double check your order before you walk away. They’ll sometimes just “forget” a dish. So if you order takeout add on at least 15+ minutes to their estimated time. You’ll be waiting 30+ minutes and they won’t tell you anything about how much longer. They won’t even offer you a cup of water. Absolute zero sense of customer service. Not an ounce of thanks for waiting or sorry for the delay. Food is mediocre at best. Just drive to Irvine and get your Szechuan fix. Beware. Also, I’m pretty sure they reuse their oil day after day. Pretty shocked the food inspector hasn’t shut them down. Never again.

author: Xueting Alford
review_text: Had this meal last Thursday. Everything was great! Especially the service! The waitor was very considerate and sweet!

author: charlie purdue
review_text: driest chinese food i have ever had. was burnt black, had almost no sauce, no side of rice or vegetables to add flavor... portions were also offensively small for $18... girl at the counter was quick but not very friendly, not that i care, since i will not be coming back

author: Stacy Feinberg
review_text: We have been going here for years now, it is amazing! So so so delicious! One of my favorite foods. It’s hard to describe how amazing the taste and quality is. My favorite item on the menu is spicy wonton.please go here! It’s amazing

author: Kuang Yueheng
review_text: On Wednesday, I went to Tasty zone with my husband for dinner. This is a restaurant my husband and I often visit. We like their food very much. My husband and I like almost every dish, including rice noodles, jelly noodles and cold dishes. The restaurant is beautiful and clean, and the service is very good. In particular, the Sichuan cuisine made by their chef is very authentic and flavorful. I think it is the best Sichuan cuisine in Costa Mesa and I never get tired of it.

author: Angel Kim
review_text: I wanted to order the dry pot but it wasn’t vegetarian. The waiter offered to change the meat into veggies with fried tofu. IT WAS SUPER GOOD and it is big! I’d definitely come back again for the dry pot. Eggplant w/ garlic sauce was good too!

author: Peter B
review_text: This place is authentic and delicious food. These other reviews are absolute trash and mostly lies, written by delusional Karens with no idea what Sichuan food is. People saying they had allergic reactions when the numbing peppercorns are literally foundational to Sichuan cuisine. This place is great. Don't listen to the dumbos. Get the beans and spicy chicken.

author: Matthew Walker
review_text: Trust me, take the highway to the Tasty Zone!! For those of you who are familiar with Szechwan food and it’s unique flavors, you’ll be so happy that you finally found THE place. The quality, portions, prices, spiciness/numbing—it’s all just so wonderful.

author: Calvin
review_text: I came here about 10 years ago several times. And it is still here. The dishes are still delicious and in good portions. Wish you the best and stay another 10 years.

author: Yvonne A
review_text: We absolutely loved our visit to Ipoh Kopitiam!Everything was so delicious and packed with that authentic Malaysian flavor we’ve been craving. The nasi hainam was incredibly tender and fragrant, the dry wanton mee was perfectly seasoned, and the sambal had the right amount of kick. Even the Milo drink tasted just like home! We’re already missing Ipoh’s food, and of course we’ll definitely be back. Highly recommended for anyone looking for real, comforting Malaysian flavors! 🍜🇲🇾✨

author: Yasmeen Wilde
review_text: The best and most authentic Malaysian food I ever had in the United States. Ipoh kopitiam is a famous chain in Malaysia. I am so happy when I found out they opened a store in Alhambra. We had the chicken rice, kway teow noodles and roti canai. All amazing. The place is always crowded and service is quick. There was a waitlist but it went by super quick.

author: AJ
review_text: We ordered the Singapore Curry Laksa, Rendang Curry Beef, Kaya Toast, and White Coffee. Everything was absolutely delicious especially the Rendang Curry Beef, which was insanely good. I’ve been to Singapore about twelve times, and the Laksa here tasted just like what I had there. The interior also really reminded me of cafes in Singapore and Malaysia — cozy, casual, and authentic. Definitely worth visiting if you miss Southeast Asian flavors.

author: Linda Pham
review_text: Delicious food! Seems like there's a long line during the day but we ate around 8pm with little to no line. The Hainan chicken is our favorite! Meat is super tender and soft and the sauces provided are delicious. We also loved the Kaya toast and butter. Can't beat the classics! Parking is available underground behind the building.

author: Judy Nie
review_text: Amazing Malaysian/Singaporean food! Came here for the breakfast sets. Price is so reasonable! A set comes with entree + hot drink + side. Tried the curry noodles, kaya butter toast, and hot milk tea. Everything was on point and authentic! Also impeccable service, they offered us refills for the milk tea. You have to come here for breakfast!

author: Anonymous
review_text: Very authentic Hainan chicken rice and laksa even better than places in SG and Malaysia. Outdoor seating is warm and cozy. Long wait but food is excellent.

author: Felisia Micky
review_text: One cozy place for breakfast with delicious meals they serve is Ipoh Kopitiam. They got breakfast menu with affordable price until 10.45am. The price start $12.95++ for menu A and $13.95++ for menu B. I attached the menu which you can choose. First you choose the main course such as nasi lemak or noodle soup which is both are super recommended, the you choose the topping you want which is i love the spam, then the bread (toast) which is i recommended is the toast with Kaya and butter. This included choice of drinks which you can get freeflow, such as hot coffee, hot milk tea, hot chinese tea or hot lemon tea for cold (ice) got extra charge for $ 1.50. No wonder they got michelin bib gourmand since 2022! Super duper recommended.

author: Lingyu Liu
review_text: Finally made it to Ipoh Kappitiam, and it absolutely hit the spot. Everything tasted warm, familiar, and full of that cozy Southeast Asian comfort. i ordered Hainan Chicken Rice The chicken was tender and silky, just the way it should be. The rice was fragrant and perfectly oily, and the trio of sauces—ginger, chili, and dark soy—tied everything together. Simple but so satisfying.

author: J L
review_text: Second time lucky as there's usually a very long wait here. The virtual waiting queue helps as you can't book! I grew up in Malaysia and Laksa is my go to. My broth was rich from the coconut milk, fragrant from the spices and umami from the shrimp and curry flavours. The noodles were different from the mix of Hokkien noodles with Vermicelli I'm used to, but still chewy and contrasted with the textures of the other ingredients. My friend's Bak Kut Teh (pork ribs in herb soup) were tough and dry, like the meat is overcooked. The ratings reflect this chewing exercise for her jaw. Service was very efficient as we would expect for such a busy place. The front patio increased the seating area and the whole place was bustling. They didn't kick us out as soon as we finish, which would be very common in many countries. Maybe this is because of the tipping culture?

author: Vu Tran
review_text: A place worth visiting and enjoying exotic Asian food. The exotic food is delicious, the service is attentive, the atmosphere is moderate and not too noisy. Will come back next time, and recommend this place to friends.

author: satsuki hoshino
review_text: We came here to sign up the queue and found out that you could just do it by yelp’s app for faster seating. Mostly seating are for two or four. There seems a section that could accommodate larger party like 5 or 6 people. A lot of families came too. We already came couple times before. It actually has been our favorite place for laksa noodle soup. I like its flavorful soup and very bouncy noodle texture. Also included a lot of fried tofu boiled egg shrimp and fish balls. We had already tried stew beef with bread so this time we tried fried beef with wide rice noodles also sweet buns with butter. Both were great. For drinks you could customize the sugar levels. Our favorite dish is fried chicken wings in peppercorn and salt flavors. Also waiters were always friendly and courteous. The only things was it could be a bit of noisy since everyone was talking loudly and sometimes seating was very close.

author: Carl Wong
review_text: Came here for lunch. I've been when it first opened, since then they had picked up 3 Michelin Bib Gourmand awards. This is a nice Malaysian comfort food café, so don't expect immaculate service. The staff is very nice, friendly and multi lingual. The food, however, is excellent. I ordered the Roti Cenai and Hainan chicken rice (to go) and the Hokkien Prawn noodle soup and Malaysian milk tea for dining in. The broth is amazing, the noodles are not soggy, the water spinach (kangkung) is fresh and crisp and the shrimp is good as well. It seems the Hainan chicken rice is rather popular. Will find out how it compares to Savoy. I got seated right away, however as I was leaving there was a line outside at 1pm.

author: Vivian “Vivventure” Wayfarer
review_text: Authentic Malaysian/Singaporean breakfast spot with great combo prices (12-15 bucks for a set with an entree, a drink - all kinds of kopi, and complementary pastry of choice — ranging from Kaya toast, pandan cake, to pineapple buns). We ordered three sets, giving us a chance to try instant noodles with curry pork skin, nasi lemak with curry fish balls and Malaysian sticky rice with chicken. All the dishes hit the spot and are reminiscent of what you would get in the region locally. Definitely need to come back to try the lunch, which seems to be popular!

author: Sabs A
review_text: Ipoh Kopitiam in Alhambra is a great spot for authentic Southeast Asian flavors that are hard to find in California. The roti was easily my favorite dish - crispy, flaky, and absolutely delicious. The wantan mee with curry chicken was very tasty and especially nostalgic, reminding me of my trips to Singapore, though I would’ve loved the option for boneless chicken or BBQ pork instead. The beef rendang was flavorful and rich, with a noticeable kick of spice. Service was genuinely excellent - friendly, attentive, and often anticipating our needs - and while pricing was decent, the generous portions meant we happily took leftovers home.

author: B L
review_text: My go-to spot for authentic Hainan chicken rice and white coffee! This restaurant never fails to deliver - the chicken is always tender, flavorful, and perfectly poached. The rice is fragrant and infused with just the right amount of chicken stock. And the white coffee? Divine! Smooth, creamy, and not too sweet. It's the perfect complement to their delicious Hainan chicken. The service is always friendly, and the atmosphere is cozy and welcoming. If you're a fan of Hainan chicken or great coffee, this spot is a must-visit!

author: William Fong
review_text: For all the hype and wait, I was extremely disappointed. I thought it would stand out but everything we ordered was only OK. The Portuguese tart taste like bought from elsewhere and heated up. San Francisco cafes like this is way better. That is the honest truth.

author: Dee Jay
review_text: First time visiting and one thing to know! Join the waitlist before you actually get here!! We didn’t know and waited two hours 🥲But the food didn’t disappoint me. We tried their laksa noodle, chicken curry, Kaya butter toast and roti! Everything was on point and delicious! I love their Kaya and Butter toast. It’s so simple but so flavorful ❤️

author: Riki Yamashita
review_text: Wah lao weh! It definitely is like home, Ipoh mali. Delicious just like from my childhood. Authentic Malaysian Hainanese Chicken Rice. The closest I recall tastes as good as in PJ's Japan Gasing (near SFX Church) or Subang Jaya's SS15. My friend flew it from LA to Pittsburgh. It was an amazing treat. When I visit LA, this place would be my destination.

author: K
review_text: Came here during a holiday and was able to get seated quickly during tea time. I got the Singapore style hainan chicken and rice and Malaysian style BBQ pork and rice. Both dishes were delicious. For the drinks, I ordered the hot lemon tea and milk tea. Both teas were good. The milk tea came in small teacup and was on the heavy side. They refill on these. They have heaters if you are seated outdoors, which was great. I'm glad I got to try this place out. The customer service is great. The restaurant is nice, clean and cozy. Overall, I enjoyed my experience here. I can't wait to come back during dinner time since the menu changes. Free street parking.

author: Andy Mai
review_text: This restaurant is Michelin Guide 2024 and it definitely deserves it. The food doesn't have plenty of selection but everything is very tasty. You can try everything and it will taste good. The toast is what you should try as dessert instead of appetizers since it's pretty sweet and perfect after a meal. Plenty of parking in the parking structure behind the plaza. Seats can be limited so expect a wait line. Once you are in, the food comes out pretty fast. It's a handicap friendly facility.

author: Megan Gomez-Reyes
review_text: There is hardly any Potato Corner locations in LA Metropolitan area, so when we saw this location, we came out here for a nice quick bite. We had Spicy BBQ Loopy fries with the chicken tenders, and Garlic and Parmesan Loopy fries with tenders as well. The chicken is amazing, and the fries weren't bad but maybe we will try different flavors next time. It would be nice if they had a Cajun flavor or regular seasoned salt, though. But no complaints, but for a place called Potato Corner, the star of the show was definitely the chicken. Nice and hot, and REALLY crunchy!

author: Shawn Sheng
review_text: The different flavors of fries just hit different. They are super tasty and cause a flavor explosion in your mouth. Their chicken wings are decent too. A nice spot to go to after walking around the Americana for a snack. Nice and simple fast food. Make sure to enjoy while it is hot.

author: Rose
review_text: potato corner is for sure the best place to get fries. their sour cream flavor is simply addicting. i would come back to it over and over again if i could!

author: David Karapetyan
review_text: The worker didn’t want to get my order because of the personal conflict with one of my friends. So I do not suggest to go there, the worker has some mental and personal problems. I would rate a negative number but I just put 1 star because I cant put less than that.

author: Nicole A
review_text: Made by people that clearly have never tasted real potato corner bc what is up with the seasoning?? Yall just dump a whole bag in there or something? The ingredients are all there you just have to make it right. Also prices are outrageous patatas lang naman toh pero lahat di marunong.

author: Kevin Santos
review_text: Potato Corner is the best flavored fries at the best location! Sometimes this is our only reason to visit Americana. 😂

author: sisi
review_text: Please bring back the old Potato Corner and the original staff—this new setup just isn’t it. The experience has gone downhill. The cashier was fine, but the girl who handed me my food was incredibly rude. Seriously, someone needs to address her attitude. It’s disappointing to see how much the service has changed.

author: casual gamer
review_text: I occasionally stop by Potato Corner at the Americana, usually about once or twice every two months, for a quick bite. I’m not a regular customer, so the staff doesn’t recognize me. Unfortunately, the service has been consistently disappointing every time I’ve visited. While I’m not a big fan of wings or chicken tenders, I do enjoy the food from Potato Corner. However, the lack of customer service leaves a lot to be desired. The staff, who seem to be fresh out of high school, never acknowledge me when I pick up my order. They simply hand it over without so much as a “thank you,” even when I make the effort to thank them first. It’s clear that the young employees lack the work ethic and customer service skills necessary for this job. It’s frustrating as a customer to be treated with indifference, especially when all I’m doing is ordering food. A little politeness and appreciation can go a long way, but unfortunately, that’s been missing every time I’ve visited.

author: reshy daswani
review_text: January 31 around 7:30-8:30pm - Bad star for the woman with curly hair here. I ordered my childhood favorite bbq giga fries. The fries barely had seasoning so I asked her to give me a bit of bbq powder and she rudely said that it costs 50 cents. At that point, I did not have my card with me because my friend was sitting far away watching my stuff and it was very cold but she did not cared when I told her that. The Asian woman with fair skin ended up helping and she was friendly. She was pleasant and offered a good service.

author: JOYN
review_text: Went on November 3 2023 at 4:30 pm . Woman working the counter was extremely rude. I stood in line for almost half an hour just to get up to the front and have them tell me they’re out of most items . I would think a sign saying that they’re out of food would be appropriate which I kindly let her know. she then told me “oh we’ll get over it” I’m literally in shock

author: A
review_text: Delicious flavored French fries can’t speak for the rest of the food or drinks but the French fries are yummy.

author: Keith Patch (Patches)
review_text: It's a quaint little place to get fries and chicken tenders. It's not amazing, but it's a good amount of food for the price.

author: Armen B
review_text: My kids love this place. For adults it is little greasy but kids love French fries.

author: Berge Wassilian
review_text: For a quick fill of your stomach: French fries - Fast and delicious.

author: Polina Shevchenko
review_text: A variety of potato options, and you can customize it just the way you like. Delicious. Thank you!

author: Arno Harutyunyan
review_text: This Place Is A Very Good Place To Eat.The Food Is Good.The Service Is Good.And The Workers Are Very Nice.Keep Up The Great Work!

author: Armen Hovhannisyan
review_text: Something has changed about the food here, the chicken tenders seem different like a cheaper quality and the fries taste bland.

author: Adam Lambert
review_text: God they have 1 place to take peoples order and it takes them 45 minutes to take 1 persons order. 0 stars don’t waste your time

author: Evelyn Garcia
review_text: Worst unsanitary place ever!! Bought my kids some fries here and they both got food poisoning. Worst experience of my life witnessing my toddlers 2 year old and 3 year old having diarrhea, throwing up, screaming in pain, shaking and sweating from this. Never again will I buy from here. Please clean your stuff or wash your hands make everything so this won’t happen to anyone else or any kids since every kid loves fries. The feeling as a mother to not be able to do anything and see your kids in pain is the worst feeling ever.

author: hector cordero
review_text: Saturday 3 22 2025 I ordered tatter tots with extra cheddar and when I smelled and tasted the food it was rancid. The powder being used smelled like it has been in a plastic container for a very long time and expired. I ended trashing the food as I was already far from the location. We were looking forward to the tater. Tots, unfortunately the expectation, what's i'm not there. Please have your staff trained on your product and even taste the product and have knowledge of what is old, What is rancid and what should be served. Thank you Hector Cordero F&B Assist Director CSUN

author: Mukund Kaushik
review_text: If you want a rotisserie style chicken that is juicy and flavorful without being too spicy, and good value for money, Dino’s chicken does not disappoint. The 1/2 chicken with fries tortillas and coleslaw is less than 20 bucks. It’s a no frills atmosphere with tables on the inside and some outside overlooking the street traffic. The parking is a bit tight but if you circle around enough times, you might get lucky. Next time we will order the fries and the sauce on the side as they serve the chicken on top of the fries. The place does not disappoint and this place is a “keeper” on my list.

author: Christopher Gorrie
review_text: I didn’t know what to expect when coming here, but I’m sure glad that I did! I ordered a half chicken with rice and beans, which also came with complimentary coleslaw and corn tortillas. The rice and beans were absolutely incredible! They were obviously slow-cooked and have been perfecting the recipe for years. The chicken was great, too, and I’m impressed it was juicy and tender when being cooked in such huge batches. Even the coleslaw was great! Dino’s might not look like that much from the outside, and they only have basic hard-back booths and bar seats, but the food is so good I’d eat it sitting on the sidewalk. It was also only about $15 for a massive portion of food. I definitely want to come back here to try other items in the future.

author: Jon D. Visionary
review_text: Goodness gracious this place is bomb! Their chicken is the best charbroiled chicken in LA. Seasoned amazingly, and very juicy. The sauce compliments everything and cuts through the greasiness with the tanginess of the vinegar. Now people talk about the chicken with the fries, but the rice plate is what you should be getting. Very well seasoned rice. It just mixes with the beans so well, and makes me drool just thinking about it again 🤤 Their DUI fries are also bomb! Carne asada with pastramiis a dangerous combination. It would leave any big back with their back blown 🤤 The only fries I can put on par would be the pastrami fries from The Hat, but this might have it beat! The worst thing about this place is how far it is, and the parking. I luckily went on a Monday, and got a spot in the lot, but I’d imagine it would be more difficult on the weekends. Service was quick. Definitely visiting again after going to get my film developed at Gold Photo. Hopefully that will be soon 🤤 Update: Don’t dine in. No restrooms. The staff is pretty rude. I didn’t notice because I took my food to go last time. Their burgers are delicious too, but take your food to go! Grow your big back from the comfort of your car 😌 To go: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Dine in: ⭐️⭐️⭐️

author: Eddy Bretado
review_text: You have to get the chicken plate with the secret sauce to put on it it is amazing. This place has been there forever, I'm glad the flavors have never changed and the service has always been an excellent if you are in Los Angeles I recommend this place for a quick meal.

author: Eddie Marti
review_text: Dino's hand's down is one of my favorite spot to eat chicken when i visit back home in the L.A.area. I found this place back in my senior year in high school early 2000's, and you know what, the taste, the juiciness, the quantity, the quality, and the deliciousness, is all the same. Love how i can come back and visit and the flavor hasnt changed and its as good as my first time visiting. Keep up the great work. Highly recommend the chicken plate. Which ever way you like. Chicken is life!!!!😋

author: Robert Hinton Jr.
review_text: To me they have some wonderful chicken. I can only speak for me. My wife loves their food, she introduced me to this place. If you come by tell them to put extra juice on your fries and chicken. Man it's just exquisite. To get the full flavor punch you have to mix everything together...get the tortilla, bust it open, put the fries inside, then the chicken and put to cold slaw on top and eat that. To get the full flavor kick. It's really wonderful. Stop by. It's worth it. Now mind you only the shop downtown on Pico. Blvd Don't go to the one in Huntington Park, that location is trash.

author: Shaun Kart
review_text: Go with what they are known for and you can't go wrong However they do have good pastrami burgers and their hot dogs are pretty good too

author: Felita Ekwegh
review_text: The reviews I have read don’t give this place credit first of all the red color on the chicken is tandoori style chicken. A pastrami burrito will never have rice in it! Chilli cheese mustard and pickles!

author: Diamond Dae
review_text: It's LA so what can I say about the Atmosphere . I will say that OMG the food looked so delicious on the reviews and when I got there the smells were off the chain. However the chicken not so good. Which was disappointing. The smell and look makes you wanna hope there is a piece that tastes like something. Not even rotisserie. It's was so blah. Took leftover home and even my son was like this is so bad. Sadly it got tossed in the trash. It's smelled soooo good and wasn't. The staff w as friendly.

author: Dawit
review_text: Dino’s famous chicken and fries was not bad. 🍗 They like to sell the chicken already packed. I requested fresh chicken and fries, but the cashier kept saying, “Everything is fresh x100” with Spanish swear in whispering “Pinche…” My chicken was burned hard and tepid..🍟 My fries were not crispy but soggy. Not enough sauce on fries was disappointing me enough. 🥲 It is a good place to visit once out of curiosity

author: Adrian Y
review_text: Food was good. Bathrooms not available for me to wash my greasy hands before closing time. Also, they started cleaning the floor when we're still eating our food and the smell was filled with chlorine. I also have my infant with me so that's not cool.

author: FINESS917
review_text: I had chicken with rice and beans. The portion was a lot. But the flavor was ok. It was seasoned but tasted like all the season was on the skin of the chicken. Whatever the season is , it gives off a bit too salty taste. The chicken itself was grilled fine.

author: Pancho Villa
review_text: The chicken was OK, the best food were the beans, they had a side of coleslaw which tasted rotten, the 1/2 a chicken look more like pigeon, than a chicken. The person hiding on the other side of the window, was not friendly at all. It literally felt like he was doing me a favor, instead of providing a service. The overall feeling wasn't good. Never coming back.

author: Eric Cervantes
review_text: Dino's is a chicken spot in the downtown/USC area of Los Angeles. They are open late for hungry college kids and night owls alike. The chicken appears char broiled with a blend of vinegar, garlic, and various spices to give it a lively flavor. There are also options to order burgers, burritos, grilled cheeses, and more. Yet, the chicken is what gave Dino's its notoriety. Order the half chicken, with fries, and extra sauce. You'll get the whole platter swimming in the juices. Fries and all to give it that signature zing. It's a small area, with no bathroom to use. Be sure to bring some wet naps to clean your hands, but overall, a historical nice sit down for unique flavors.

author: Philip
review_text: Can't miss with the chicken and fries. Although the chicken was drier than we prefer the sauce (savory with a slight vinegar finish) the coleslaw and skinny fries made up for it. I'm surethere's better chicken in LA but this will do when hungry.

author: B
review_text: I miss the sweet guy who used to work the window. The guy there now is so serious lol. But anyway the food is great as always. Very consistent taste. It’s nice to see the upgrades and outside seating that has been installed. The prices are slowly creeping up like everything else. Last time I came it was $15 a box now it’s about $18 out the door =| but it’s worth it for the craving. I always get the half chicken over fries extra wet. The burgers and other menu items are good too but I come for that ! Very unique flavor that you can’t really get any where else! Very friendly service. Very fast service. Even when there’s a line. Would recommend !

author: Melissa Cortez
review_text: So let me put all yall mamasitas and mamsitos on game tho! This right herrrrrrrr this righhttt herrrr is the prize have you not tasted this delightfulness chicken yet get the chicken with the fries extra juice extra tortillas and dip my boy 😋 workers there are amazing and work hard for this delishness get you a plate ASAP rocky let me know the deal 🥰

author: Abraham Maz
review_text: My favorite hole in the wall chicken spot in LA hands down. Best quality price. Solid plates, you are definitely not leaving hungry. My favorite has to be the famous chicken with fries and sauce. Very unique flavor can’t find anywhere else. And let’s not forget all the guys who work there, they all deserve medals 👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽

author: Ashley Dean
review_text: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5-Star Review for Dino’s Chicken on Pico! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I had the pleasure of trying Dino’s Chicken on Pico, and it was an amazing experience! I ordered the Dino’s chicken plate with chicken fries, and let me tell you, it was absolutely delicious! The flavors were on point, and the chicken was cooked to perfection - juicy and tender with a mouthwatering crispy exterior. The chicken fries were a unique twist and added an extra level of deliciousness to the meal. The service was friendly, and the food was served quickly. The overall ambiance of the restaurant was welcoming and made the dining experience enjoyable. I highly recommend Dino’s Chicken on Pico to anyone looking for some seriously tasty chicken dishes. Whether you’re a fan of classic chicken plates or looking to try something different like the chicken fries, you won’t be disappointed! Definitely a must-visit spot for all chicken lovers out there. Can’t wait to come back for more! Keep up the fantastic work, Dino’s Chicken! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

author: Christian Ford
review_text: I came to Dino’s Famous Chicken & Fries (Pico Blvd location) on a whim after seeing the solid reviews. I was open to trying something new, even though the prices gave me a bit of sticker shock. I asked the cashier if the fries were good and whether they could be made crispy — he said yes, so I went for it. When the food came out, it was… baffling. The chicken was soaked in juice — not sauce, not marinade, just watery runoff. And the fries? All dumped underneath the chicken, completely soggy and drenched. It was like they had been boiled, not fried. Maybe that’s a “house style,” but there was no heads-up that the fries would be swimming in chicken runoff. If they had placed the fries on top or on the side, they might have stood a chance. Instead, what I got was a soggy mess. I politely brought it up to the cashier — the same guy I spoke to earlier — and mentioned the fries were completely soggy because of how the plate was put together. He just shrugged. No apology, no explanation, no offer to make it right. Didn’t even ask to see the problem. I literally said, “Okay, well, I’m not coming back,” in front of a line of other customers, and he didn’t seem to care. That kind of dismissive attitude is enough to guarantee I won’t be back. It’s one thing to have a unique food style, but it’s another to treat customers like their feedback doesn’t matter.

author: Edgar Pineda
review_text: Very good cheese burger & fries. I really enjoyed it. Pepsi refill will cost you 75 cents. Funny.

author: Yerslan Aimakov
review_text: Very nice fast food joint with affordable prices and decent portions. Taste is ok, burgers taste kinda like Burger King, fries are extremely salty though. 1/2 pound cheeseburger combo was $14.52 which is pretty good in today’s economy. Free parking is available.

author: Julie Spathos
review_text: Went for a quick bite but ended up trying more off menu and I didn’t regret it!! What a great restaurant If you’re in this part of town and you gotta try their chicken and salsa and onion rings! Loved everything we tried but those were my favs. They also have orange bang which is a blast from my past! Can’t wait to stop by this gem of a place again soon! Gotta mention their staff also all so fast and friendly! Go try this place out if you’re around.

author: Earthworm Sid
review_text: The grilled chicken here is so delicious with a hint of lime flavor. It is my favorite dish to order here. The buttered bread that comes with each plate of chicken is so addicting. The price for half a piece of chicken plus sides and a drink is super affordable for this day and age!! I totally recommend this place. It’s my favorite when it comes to charbroiled chicken!! 😋😋😋🤤🤤

author: Marcellus Barron
review_text: I am new to the area. I have been to Olympian Burgers twice now. The staff is friendly. They greet you as soon as you enter. The food is very good. Large portions, too. The pastrami sandwich is very good. I highly recommend this well-established restaurant.

author: Milton Mejía
review_text: Very bad service, the cashiers are always in a bad mood, and they don't pack things properly. Ranch dressing spilled all over my order, I paid extra, and the soda cups are broken; all the soda spilled in my car's cup holder.

author: Felipe Vargas
review_text: Got a cheese burger combo to go and all was really good. I like that the burger patty is the size of the bread!

author: St Francis
review_text: I love the charbroiled burgers. Olympian has a good breakfast menu and good service too. They sell a lot of grilled chicken. It's very good. I've been a satisfied customer for about 15 years. You won't be disappointed. Recently bought a double Cheeseburger at ASTRO Burger for $12.+ It was good. Olympian uses higher grade quality meat, and the buger is about $10.

author: MOSES NOLASCO
review_text: The place is clean and the cooks are ready to prepare your food as soon as you place your order. The lady at the cash register is polite and beautiful. The coffee is a little bit pricey in opinion because is just regular coffee, anyway; the French toast I ordered were soft, warm and delicious... enjoy it my dear friends.

author: B Vite
review_text: Reliable local spot for consistently delicious food. No frills. Clean, family place with friendly staff. I order breakfast burritos for work meetings; always ready on time.

author: Alireza Habibzadeh
review_text: Delicious and smoky. The restrooms are paid though! Even for customers. It’s just a quarter but who has coins these days.

author: enrique mendoza
review_text: Great small family-owned burger place with friendly staff. Food is delicious

author: Joshua Tarabek
review_text: The food was spicy which I like but they didn't have sour cream and that's like a must for my wife. Especially when it's spicy. But overall the size was good and price wise it was medium priced.

author: Judith Hurtado
review_text: First, did not like that they did not have a kids meal. Second the place was HOT. Third they charge for everything! 25 cents for each ranch, even to use they nasty restroom. Food was decent but not for the price.

review_text: We actually go to MC BARBER SHOP in this plaza. Reasonable prices & Martha is Excellent!!

review_text: A pretty simple burger and Mexican food joint. You order at the counter, and your number is called up when the food is ready. The steak sandwich with fries was quite tasty, and so we're the French fries. Lots of locals enjoyed their food, too

review_text: The fries were dark brown as if they never change the oil, the onions rings were flavorless and the breading on it fell apart from the onion rings and the breading tasted like if they also use it on shrimp, the buns on the burgers were burnt and a huge piece of tomato took up most of the burger, not a good food experience.

author: Bryan Garcia-Aguilar
review_text: Everything about this place screams authentic old-school burgers. The taste screams, "Amazing!". I'll be coming back to try out the gyros nexts.

author: Elmer Hernandez
review_text: The young cashier gets mad for any little thing, and I asked for a ln order of toast she wanted to charge me $10 . And she told me go to sleep

author: Sianna Lee
review_text: Thee best Indian resturant in L.A county hands down. Its amazing!!! I told the staff not a lot of spice (i cant take it) and they obliged, the flavor is perfect everything complement each other. I got a Chicken Lunch special its 15.23 with tax but it came with Rice, Chicken, Garlic nann, veggies. They do have vegetarian options as well.

author: ARYAN SINGH PUNDIR
review_text: WORST Chole Bhature experience of my life! No flavor, no effort, no quantity — just a sad excuse for a dish. If this is their idea of North Indian cuisine, it’s an insult to street vendors who actually know how to cook. Avoid this place like the plague unless you’re into culinary disappointment. 👎🤮

author: Khushi Nakum
review_text: My parents and I stopped by for dinner when I first moved in to USC housing. Now we go for lunch whenever they’re in town to visit. It’s super close to campus, so it’s convenient for students. There’s a large menu and the food is flavorful and well made. The staff are also friendly. Highly recommend!

author: Sohail Gidwani
review_text: If you are looking for an Indian restaurant near USC, this is the place you can eat from. I liked the chicken biryani, it was quite good. Don't try the indo-chinese options, it doesn't even come anywhere near to what you are expecting, at least I didn't like it personally.

author: Nikita Mittal
review_text: "Manas Indian Restaurant in LA is a culinary gem! Exceptional flavors, aromatic spices, and friendly staff create an unforgettable dining experience. Must-try dishes: Butter Chicken & Vegetable Biryani. A delightful taste of India right in the heart of LA!"

author: Erick Sanchez
review_text: Amazing vegetarian option my favorite is the Biryani, definitely is a great place to spend with your friends and family!

author: Chasom was Here
review_text: If you enjoy Indian food as I do very much, this is the place. They have a great selection, met the owners who were so welcoming, and the food was delicious. If you like Indian food, you will love this place!

author: HninNandar Hlaing
review_text: I recently dined at a restaurant with exceptional staff and outstanding food. The service was impeccable, and the staff went above and beyond to ensure a delightful experience. The menu offered a diverse range of delectable dishes, each prepared with precision and bursting with flavor. The combination of excellent service and delicious cuisine makes this restaurant a must-visit.

author: Prince Shah
review_text: The Indian restaurant provided an exceptional dining experience. The lamb korma I ordered was exquisite, with tender meat and a flavorful, creamy sauce. The service was impeccable, with attentive staff ensuring a pleasant meal. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for delicious Indian cuisine and excellent service.”

author: Cheryl Jackson
review_text: What a great little find! Authentic Indian food that’s absolutely delicious at a very reasonable price. This is a no frills place, so if you’re looking for atmosphere, this is not your jam. But the food is the real star here. Most dishes are offered in mild, medium or hot. Friendly wait staff, too! I’ll definitely will be returning soon, if only for take out.

author: Jacob Ferdman
review_text: Excellent food, authentic flavors and creativity. Linch special is a great deal, Manas special curry is fantastic.

author: Sovit
review_text: Indian Delight impresses with its delicious Indian cuisine and excellent service. The cozy atmosphere, coupled with traditional decor, creates a welcoming dining environment. Highlights include flavorful palak panner and fluffy cheese garlic naan. The attentive staff enhances the experience with their friendly and prompt service. Reasonably priced and generous portions make it a great value. Perfect for both casual meals and special occasions, Indian Delight is a top choice for Indian food lovers.

author: myvi
review_text: Vivi( Vivian) was the best ever. We were at the bar and barntender wasn’t the best but Vivi was best ever . Im coming back because of her

author: Shikhar
review_text: Their daily chicken Thalis were just delicious. The chicken was just cooked perfectly and their vegetarian dish and daal went so well with the rice. The naans were soft and slightly puffy just like the way I like it. Overall the atmosphere was very good too. I watched yje chelsea vs psg Club World Cup match while eating. I really enjoyed my meal and overall experience a lot.

author: Vibhav Deshpande
review_text: Extremely rude attitude! They refuse service to you for bringing a complaint! I had bought a idli/dosa batter from them which turned out to be expired 7-8 months prior. When I brought the complaint to the lady (probably the owner), she not only refused a refund but refused the service itself to me! She took my shopping cart from me and asked me to get out. When I brought her the expired box to show, she said that she does not want my business and asked me to get out or else she will call the cops!! Let this sync in. She refused service to a customer for bringing a complaint and threatened to call the cops! They can manage to run a business with this kind of attitude because that is the only Indian store in the area and most of the international students have to depend on their service. Extreme lack of business ethics! Edit :- The owner seems to have replied. Well if you buy fresh, then you should investigate why you had an expired batter instead of refusing service to your customers Lol! But after reading through all the 1 star reviews of your store, the rude behaviour of the lady seems to be a recurring pattern. I would suggest get treated for anger issues instead of shouting at your customers. This will help your business far more than calling your customers 'bogus'.

author: Timothy Teegarden
review_text: I liked this place, would go again. Lunch specials were served on a cute compartmentalized tray.

author: Ab Raham

review_text: "Fantastic dining experience! The staff at are friendly and attentive, and the food is outstanding. From flavorful curries to aromatic naan, every dish is a culinary delight. Highly recommend!"

review_text: chose for my Sunday lunch, and I wasn't expecting too much tbh. The food actually surprised me, the korma tastes great and I literally ate up every rice and every dip of sauce. The wait is relatively long but tolerable. Very likely to comeback in the future

author: James Sawyer Ford
review_text: The food was absolutely delicious — every dish was full of authentic flavors and perfectly cooked. The staff were incredibly welcoming, attentive, and made us feel right at home. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for amazing Indian food and warm hospitality. Will definitely be coming back!

author: Kathy Rodriguez
review_text: This Taco Bell saved my life. I do Uber eats and I work late at night and I was craving Taco Bell and they came through because they’re open 24 hours. Also the worker was super nice

Do better!

author: Ernest Webb

author: PJ
review_text: 7am staff is fabulous and friendly 🤩 "In Store" experience is peaceful; the playlist is calming. The Coffee Cream is a little weird but I left there a happy camper.

author: Ryan

author: Lu Bu
