author: Jennifer
review_text: Went to this location earlier during the week and had a great experience! The moment I walked in, Jillian not only greeted me with a bright smile but took my order really fast! She was very professional, friendly and gave me a great drink recommendation! I decided to eat in-house and was impressed by Noah's diligence in keeping the dining room spotless and making sure everyone was good. He even took the time to check in on me, offering extra napkins and sauces - great service! Will definitely come back 😊

author: Тамара Гулина
review_text: Cobb salad is not tasty, very salty ingredients and sauce, it would be better if the chicken was grilled, I eat it deep-fried. Grilled Chicken Club is tasty - the grilled chicken was tasty and soft, the chicken in the salad was not tasty. The staff is friendly, the prices are affordable, the service is fast. In the hall they asked us if we liked everything. I recommend. P.S. The cafe plays classical music. It is very rare to hear such a repertoire in a fast food restaurant.

author: Adrian C.L.
review_text: La Chuperia is definitely a must! It’s the perfect spot to pregame if you’re heading to an event at BMO or the Coliseum. They’ve got a great variety of specialty drinks from Micheladas to spiked agua frescas and every one looks better than the last. As soon as my eyes landed on the Chuper Mango Cart Michelada, I knew what I was ordering. Topped with fresh mango chunks and paired with Mango Cart beer… 10/10, hands down! I even had to snap a pic and send it to my wife, promising a trip here soon (though let’s be real, that promise was more for me 😂). The vibe is lively, the drinks are on point, and while the food menu leans more appetizer-style, it’s still solid. Just don’t roll in starving come for the drinks, the energy, and the good times.

author: whiplash girlchild
review_text: Came here after a concert and we ordered a sandwich with nuggets but they didn't give us the sandwich. Didn't notice till we got to our hotel and chik fil a was closed so we couldn't go back. Very disappointed. Spent 12.95 for no sandwich.

author: Jpezze
review_text: So I placed an order in store gave my name and used my app to collect points every time I come to this location on it’s an issue my order was ready and the guy working a white man could not say my name he was about to put my food up on the stand to wait I’m literally sitting in front of the counter not only that the name is in the bag and it also say the color of my shirt on the bag but I guess because I’m black native descent he didn’t not care ever other store I visit says my name even if it’s not correct but this store it always an issue that why I try my hardest not to come here

author: lillian meza
review_text: This is my favorite chicken burger place, always look for original flavors and this place has it, especially the sauce and the crispy chicken, like to order the deluxe with cheese combo, the staff has always been friendly, the service is usually very fast and coordinated it seems like, the only thing I would suggest is if they could also open on Sundays as I often forget and have had to go to other places when I have a sunday crave, overall great place.

author: Henry Smith
review_text: Good food, excellent service, if the service wasn't good enough, an employee went outside with a tray of sauces to ask people eating on the tables there if they wanted any. Absolutely beautiful service. Food is usually good but for fries I wouldn't order anything besides a large, as I got about 5 full size fries in a medium, although I think that's just Chick-Fil-A portion sizes. There's a huge difference between medium and large. Also, the fries in general always have a problem in this location, it's either too much or too little salt and sometimes the fries are just stale. I'd still give the food a 4 nonetheless.

author: josselyn chirinos
review_text: I had order lunch from this restaurant through Uber eats and aside from them giving me the work sizes of fries I got a long white hair on my sandwich which completely ruined my lunch.

author: Takahiro Koyama
review_text: Crispy Chicken Sandwich with Delicious Original Sauce! Chick-fil-A is a popular American fast-food chain known for its top-notch chicken sandwiches, nuggets, and friendly service. 【Chick-fil-A Deluxe Sandwich】 This sandwich includes a seasoned, freshly breaded chicken breast, pressure-cooked in 100% refined peanut oil, served on a toasted, buttered bun with pickles, lettuce, tomato, and American cheese. The delicious sauce complements the fresh ingredients perfectly.

author: Wise seer
review_text: The food was very good and the service was very good too.I'm only giving it a 4 on the atmosphere because it was a lot of people there and I couldn't get my order in enough time but other than that I had a good experience

author: melanie quiroz
review_text: skimmed out on the fries, ordered a large expecting it to at least be more filled

author: Lily Sandoval
review_text: Despite being right in the heart of USC and always packed with crowds from the students, this Chick-fil-A never misses a beat. They consistently get my order right and it’s always ready on time. The place stays impressively clean given how busy it gets, and the staff does a great job keeping the service friendly, fast, and efficient. It’s clear they care about maintaining high standards — even during the rush. Definitely one of the more reliable spots around campus. Only down fall is that parking really sucks. Unless you park in the parking garage, but even that seems a little bit overpriced for my liking.

author: Ashly Morales
review_text: Ordered a Cobb salad. It was delicious. Someone came by to clean my table as well. Great attention to detail.

author: John Catalano
review_text: Very hard to get parking, food was asnyounwould expect though. I guess I'm just a tourist that isn't used to there not being a drivethru.

author: Brandon Giolzetti
review_text: Raul was absolutely exceptional. He brought us extra sauces and made us laugh! Will be coming back.

author: J P
review_text: Really clean. Staff is friendly as always. Parking is a beast around there, but I'm assuming they are catering to museum visitors and students.

author: Daniel Navrozidis
review_text: The staff were great and kind, the food on the other hand is bland not worth it for the price. There are better fast food alternatives.

author: David Lagro
review_text: This is the first Chick-fil-A that I have ever walked into, so I can’t give a comparison to other franchise. The line was long when I entered as several people walked in just ahead of me. The staff were fantastic and methodically whittled down the line. The food was ready quickly and I was out the door. My sandwich and fries were fresh and hot, and my shake was cold and creamy. Job done!

author: Paul Kohn
review_text: Even though it was busy, I still got great service. Food is amazing!

author: CruzeFamily Blessed
review_text: We love it here. The customer service is immaculate. Everyone’s so nice and kind makes the food taste even better today I want to give a special thanks to Stephany for putting a smile on my one year-old son face it’s just the small things in life that can really touch a heart and make a big difference. Keep up the good work Chick-fil-A of USC.

author: April Bartol
review_text: Ordered at 11:43p. Said pick up was at 12:03a. So, I went to pick it up, got there at 11:58p. I saw my name on the Carry Out Screen. At 12:02a, my name disappeared off the screen. Asked the girl up front, Irene, why my name wasn't up there. She gave a look of "meh", then completely ignored me. So, I thought it wasn't ready. Yes, I understand they were busy after the concert release. But to completely ignore a customer with a question, a bit disrespectful. So after seeing a set of customers walk out that ordered AFTER I asked about my food. Then, I asked the manger on duty that happened to be at the register. Told her that I've been waiting and my name isn't on the screen. She said classic wings take longer to cook. I said I order at a quarter til. She then turned around and grabbed a bag off the shelf. I told her that NO ONE called my name, and I've heard staff repeat call names when they weren't picked up yet. I told her that her front person completely ignored me when I asked a simple question. So, IRENE cleared my name before even calling my name. Finally got my food at 12:35a, food was ok, but would have been better if I was able to get my order when Door Dash told me it was ready to pick up.

author: Joseline Animates
review_text: I ordered 22 original hot wings , and 5 cajun wings. BUT THEYRE ALL PLAIN! i’m calling them to talk about my order but they have put me on hold for more than 30 minutes.

author: Kieun Huh
review_text: Date of Visit: July 29, 2025 I walked into Wingstop around 7:47 PM to pick up my order, which included wings and the free 5 wings promotion they were offering. The store was crowded, with many people waiting or still ordering at the counter. I understand that it was a busy evening, but the experience I had clearly showed poor customer service and a lack of communication from the staff. I approached the pickup area and showed my order details on my phone to two employees at the front. One Hispanic man and one Hispanic woman. I showed them my name and showed my order more than once. They both saw it. But instead of giving a clear update or showing basic courtesy, the Hispanic woman rolled her eyes at me and other customers. That kind of reaction is unprofessional, especially during a high-volume time. A simple response like, “Your order is coming up soon,” or even, “Thank you for your patience,” would have made customers feel seen and respected. But the silence and the attitude only made things worse. I overheard another customer who had ordered at 7:30 PM still waiting at 7:59 PM, visibly frustrated. There was no apology or explanation given to them either. When a business tells customers to go to the pickup counter and confirm their name, it should not lead to eye rolls or dismissive behavior. It felt like staff were annoyed just for having to do their job. That is not acceptable. The entire situation showed a lack of proper training, leadership, and communication. No one was managing the floor. Staff seemed overwhelmed and unprepared, and customers were left confused and ignored. It reflected poorly on the store. This experience was disappointing. I hope the management takes serious steps to improve how their team communicates and treats customers, especially during busy hours. A little respect and basic updates can go a long way in improving customer satisfaction.

author: ena nieto
review_text: This guys did not send me my orders right they send me leftovers I was missing chicken wigs and the fries were nasty and cold also the wings I want my money back but they won’t answer me back

author: Jalayla Red
review_text: I had one of the worst customer service experiences I’ve ever encountered at this Wingstop location, and I feel compelled to share it—not just for myself, but as a warning to others. I walked in and waited in line for over 15 minutes. When it was finally my turn, the employee Edwin completely ignored me and allowed two women who arrived after me to cut in front and place their order. He didn’t ask who was next, didn’t acknowledge me, and when I spoke up, he brushed me off with, “I already started their order,”—as if that made it okay to skip someone who had been clearly waiting. I’m a Black customer, and the women he served first were Hispanic—like him—and while I can’t say for certain, it felt very personal. Whether it was discrimination, favoritism, or just plain disrespect, it was unprofessional, rude, and deeply uncomfortable. This experience completely changed the way I view this location. If you’re someone who expects to be treated with basic respect and fairness—especially if you’re a person of color—you may want to think twice before coming here. No one deserves to be disregarded, dismissed, or made to feel less than because of who they are. I truly hope corporate takes this seriously. Edwin’s behavior is unacceptable and reflects very poorly on the brand. Until there’s accountability and proper training at this location, I won’t be returning—and I suggest others don’t either.

author: Sharron green
review_text: Food is amazing staff is so friendly and prices isn't bad you need to tell them how saucey you like your wings but that's fine it's more than enough for my family of seven they don't disappoint

author: Sarah Liddell
review_text: The person who worked at the order stand on midnight on 10/25 was very patient and kind.

author: Jason Foo
review_text: Great food. Fast service. Had an absolute great time eating there. Really great sauces and chickens. Use an app to order for faster service. Probably lacked a bin for rubbish, otherwise all good.

author: Oracio Hernandez
review_text: This wingstop is by the USC. I was there on 06-19-25 around 2:00pm. I spent 50 dollars for a family meal. The chicken strip were hard and those were for my kids, the wings were flavorless, my fries weren't fully done. I'm actually gonna stop eating out for a while.

author: Dino Bands
review_text: “I had a great experience at Wingstop thanks to the amazing crew—Ruben, Ivone, Edwin, Henry, and Jason. Their service was fast, friendly, and professional, and they made sure everything was perfect. Big shoutout to the team for their hard work and great customer service!”

author: Hashlye Gonzalez
review_text: Horrible place! Took an hour for my order to come out wrong . I ordered a 20 boneless original hot but instead got a 10 LEMON PEPPER . Outrageous. Every time I come here they don’t serve wings instead they serve chicken nuggets . What is that . I need a refund and a Time Machine for my time wasted . Don’t come here .

author: B W
review_text: Ridiculous "rules" I ordered 8pc combo and wanted a 6pc wings only but they said I could only get the 5pc if it wasn't a combo then the 5pc does come with ranch u have to pay $2 to get a ranch if I order wings no matter how many I should at least get 1 sauce

author: E. Clara Verill
review_text: Wings were a bit tough and dry and the wait time was fairly long. No napkins were provided or visible. However, the offer of water was much appreciated, so 4 stars for service.

author: serin_rxses
review_text: Good food! I like the mango habanero sweet and addictive but spicy.

author: Braksigmog C
review_text: Food is good, service is normal. It's very difficult to find parking and their fountain drink machines are always out of service or soda.

author: Balmore Rene Esquivel
review_text: The food was good. The chicken wings can be a little bit more tender. Sometimes they're a little bit dry.

author: SavyLA
review_text: Best experience here at this location. Awesome service. Awesome employees. Will be “my spot” when I’m around this area.

author: Derek Liu
review_text: The restaurant is extremely dirty and the food is not well prepared. My chicken tenders were far too salty, I could not finish them. Additionally, the employees here are off-putting and rude.

author: Peter Michel
review_text: Wanted wings only amd was forced to get a comboniani unless I ordered a 10piece. We are forced to buy a soda when we only a drink. ALSO I ORDERED BONE IN WINGS AND I GOT BONE OUT WINGS.

author: Pablo Pinto
review_text: Great food great workers but bathroom never works and it's packed with USC students

author: Yuliia Biliak
review_text: Absolutely delicious! We had an amazing experience at this Mexican restaurant. The food was full of bold, authentic flavors and perfectly seasoned. The tacos were juicy, the sauces rich, seafood was super tasty. You can really taste the freshness of the ingredients and the care put into every dish. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, and the service was friendly and attentive. We will definitely be coming back and highly recommend it to anyone who loves great Mexican sea food! Sea scallops are hit!

author: Asli Akal
review_text: Really fresh food! Holbox has been on my list for a long time, and for seafood, I think it's very reasonably priced. It's located in Mercado la Paloma and has free parking. We arrived around 6:30 p.m. on a Saturday, and the line was about 20 minutes long. The mercado was pretty busy, so it was slightly hard to find a good place to sit. However, the service was very fast. The ambiance is casual and lively. We got ceviche mixto, smoked kanpachi tostada, Baja fish taco, taco de pulpo en su tinta, and churros! The ceviche mixto is a must, it was incredibly fresh! I would skip the smoked kanpachi tostada and taco de pulpo on my next visit; I thought they were just okay. The Baja fish taco was amazing, definitely try it! The star of the night was definitely the churros! They were crunchy on the outside and moist on the inside, and the chocolate sauce was delicious. Overall, it totally deserves the hype.

author: Amber Zhang
review_text: Absolutely phenomenal seafood! It’s located in a busy food hall and the lines get crazy (expect a 1-hour wait on weekends), but the flavors are unbeatable. This has become my go-to spot whenever I visit LA. Everything is so fresh and perfectly prepared. If you have the time, you HAVE to eat here!

author: Zeno Lee
review_text: Holbox definitely had some amazing dishes. Their fish tacos and their octopus were exceptional. The scallop aquachilles were a little too sour for us and the ceviche was good, but just as good as any other restaurant we been to. The presentation was amazing. And we generally really enjoyed the meal. The only thing that was challenging was waiting in line and then finding seats. We got there 30 minutes before open on Saturday and we waited just a little more than an hour. So 30 minutes after they opened. That wasn't bad considering the line got considerabl7 longer after we arrived. Then next challenge was finding a table. So many people were saving tables even though they weren't eating. Holbox definitely need to relocate to a new location. Would definitely go back for the fish tacos.

author: CB Architect-Builder
review_text: The food here is simply orgasmic! My son and I bought a diverse selection of dishes and loved every single one! Talk about food coma! Hope we can visit again sometime soon! There was a bit of a wait and line to get in as you’d imagine but it moved along and was worth it! The fact that it’s a food court takes away some of the “fine dining experience” and the interior of the place isn’t fancy at all but the food makes up for it! Pricing also seemed reasonable for the quality and flavor! Not being able to buy liquor (cocktails, beer or wine) also helps keep costs down. Anyway, highly recommend!!

author: JB Jose
review_text: My brother took me this Michelin-starred seafood place. Though it’s in a food hall, it’s not food hall prices. The quality of the dishes were still outstanding and worthy of the cost. The highlight for me was the sopa de mariscos. The flavors reminded me of how we used to have it as a youth, if not the texture. The seafood was abundant and fresh. Other highlights include the delicious tostadas and the fresh uni and scallop. Try all the dishes with their home made hot sauces. Though the wait was about 25 minutes to be sat at prime dinner time, it’s still definitely worth it. We’ll be back.

author: Vincent Crisol
review_text: Holbox serves some of the best seafood I’ve had, delivering Michelin level quality in a casual market setting. The scallop aguachile was incredibly fresh and beautifully presented, while the octopus and fish tacos were cooked to perfection. Since it's located in the busy Mercado La Paloma, be prepared for a bit of a wait. Because seating is shared with other restaurants, I highly recommend bringing a partner to scope out a table while you wait in line. The logistics take a little effort, but the food is absolutely worth the hustle. It is an absolute must visit for any seafood lover in LA.

author: Julia Tsang
review_text: This is probably my third or fourth time eating here, it seems every time I come the queue got longer and longer. This time the queue reached the beginning of the adjacent parking lot, maybe about 100 people, crazy! We stayed anyway, queued in the cold and rain for at least 45 minutes. Since it is within a food court, you have to find your own table, though we party of 5 found a table instantly. They provide free water and 4 levels of hot sauces. Food is excellent as always, hence so many people are willing to queue into the rain! Note to those dislike cilantro, their ceviches are very strong in cilantro taste, plenty mixed into the sauce that can not be picked out.

author: Jimmy Su
review_text: Came here with a friend for lunch on Friday and this place totally deserves its Michelin star. We got there about 15 minutes before opening, so parking was easy and we were part of the first group in line. Holbox serves Yucatán-style seafood tacos, and every single one we tried was incredible. We ordered the scallop taco, octopus taco, smoked kanpachi taco, Baja fish taco, and the aguachile with spot prawn and scallops. The scallop was buttery and sweet, the octopus was super tender with that perfect char, and the smoked kanpachi had this deep, smoky flavor that was just insane. The aguachile was bright, spicy, and refreshing—perfect for a warm day. The service was exceptional. You order at the counter, and they somehow manage to bring everything out quickly and perfectly timed, even with so many tables scattered around the market. It’s impressive how smoothly everything runs. We finished with the churros and chocolate sauce, which were the perfect ending—crispy, light, and the chocolate was rich but not overly sweet. The small lot is paid (about $4 an hour), but there’s some free street parking if you get lucky. Definitely worth coming a little early for a spot. Can’t wait to come back and try more of the menu, especially anything with uni. This place is a gem.

author: Now.Loading.Carlos
review_text: Holbox completely lived up to and honestly exceeded its Michelin-star reputation. We ordered the scallop ceviche, kampachi, lobster, and the fresh uni… and every dish was an absolute standout. The scallop ceviche was bright and silky, bursting with clean citrus flavors. The kampachi had that perfect buttery texture, so fresh it practically melted. The lobster was rich, sweet, and cooked to perfection. But the uni wow. Creamy, briny, and unbelievably fresh… now I fully understand why Holbox earned its Michelin star. Every plate was thoughtful, balanced, and executed with precision. This is seafood at its highest level innovative, respectful of the ingredients, and genuinely unforgettable. Holbox remains one of LA’s true culinary gems. If you love world-class seafood, this place is non-negotiable.

author: Claudia Michelle Chandra
review_text: I am so glad I came to Holbox in a large group because I got to try a lot of the menu items!! Every single dish in this place is out of this world. As someone who is usually averse to seafood, I have to admit that the seafood here is orgasmic!! Especially the fresh uni 🤤🥲 This restaurant definitely deserves its Michelin star. Each dish tasted intentional and offered mouthwatering flavors. I did not expect such an experience from a restaurant that is located within a food court. honestly, you can't even classify Holbox as a restaurant because it is more of a booth 😅 We arrived at around 11:30 AM and there was already a long line all the way to the car park. Thankfully, the line moved along quickly. The food is absolutely worth the weight and I cannot wait to return to this place on my next trip to LA.

author: Muge Selcuk
review_text: We had lunch at Holbox around noon, and even with the line, we were seated in less than 30 minutes. The service was warm, friendly, and quick. The food was excellent — we tried the sea urchin, grilled branzino, octopus, smoked fish and scallop tacos, and churros. Every bite was fresh, flavorful, and well-balanced. Despite being a Michelin-starred restaurant, the prices were quite reasonable. Watching the chef chat with guests added a personal touch. Overall, everything — food, service, and value — came together perfectly. We’re definitely planning to return and try the tasting menu.

author: Yuelin Li
review_text: Hidden inside Mercado La Paloma, Holbox is a Michelin-starred seafood counter that completely lives up to the hype. We tried the uni & scallop tostada — freshly opened sea urchin topped with scallop and green salsa, unbelievably sweet and creamy. The Filete al Carbon (grilled sea bass with cilantro rice) was perfectly cooked — crispy skin, tender meat, and full of flavor. Both octopus and fried fish tacos were light, crunchy, and fresh, especially with their house-made hot sauces. The Kanpachi ceviche was bright and balanced, a perfect mix of acid and spice. Everything tasted so clean and ocean-fresh. It’s a casual spot, not fancy at all, but the quality easily rivals high-end restaurants.

author: Victoria Marie
review_text: I came here for the seafood and left questioning my emotional readiness for a live cooking demonstration. The tostada? Was amazing. The aqua chile? Just ok, but I’ve had better elsewhere. I also tried the uni scallop — buttery, oceanic, and definitely worth a try. The real plot twist was watching a lobster flailing after being cut in half alive. Not exactly the tableside performance I was hoping for. 🦞😳 All in all, the food’s fresh and delicious, but the hype is in the Michelin rating. There’s great seafood in L.A., and Holbox is up there — just maybe… bring emotional support if you’re squeamish. I’ll go again to check it out one more time. The line is real.

author: Sasha M
review_text: A Michelin-recognized, upscale taco spot that became famous thanks to social media buzz. I went fairly early in the evening, so the line wasn’t too long, and I was able to get a seat at the bar right away. It’s not a fully open kitchen, but you can still see part of the action — the staff all looked incredibly busy and dedicated. The server was quick, attentive, and provided great service. The food came out fast, and everything tasted exceptionally fresh. Every bite was full of flavor and satisfaction. I’d definitely love to come back to try more of their dishes.

author: Patrick No
review_text: Definitely worth doing a little drive to get to this elevated food court and trying Holbox. This is some of the city’s best fresh Mexican cuisine, with a focus on seafood. Do yourself a favor and order a bunch of stuff, it’s worth it. We got: Branzino, Scallop Aguachile, fresh Santa Barbara Uni, Kanpachi & Uni Tostada, Kanpachi Taco, and Baja Fish Taco. Overall, whatever you do, get the Scallop Aquachile and something with Sea Urchin. By far, probably the best Sea Urchin I’ve had in my life. The Smoked Kampachi Taco was quite good too, it had a peanut chili oil (Salsa Macha) which I’ve never seen before until here. Really cool. The Branzino was fresh and cooked perfectly, with insanely good blue corn tortillas to go alongside. The Baja Fish taco was pretty standard. All in all, I try to come here every time I come to LA now. You get FRESH FRESH FISH here and it shows. Recently, there’s been lines out the door. Worth the wait, I think, but maybe come at a weird time and you won’t have to worry. All of this order was like $100.

author: Sabs A
review_text: These plates were well-worth the long line, outdoors, in the rain. The aguachile scallops were filled with flavor that left my tongue tingling on occasion. This was my first time having sea urchin, but the creaminess and freshness of all the seafood was memorable. I don’t think the urchin made the dish - the scallops and salsa would have been great on their own, but the urchin added some nice buttery texture that added to it. I can’t wait to return!

author: Taka H
review_text: AFFORDABLE and DELISH! Parking is on the streets or scan the QR when you park to pay. Others park in the DMV parking lot too. There's normally a line but the staff is VERY efficient in ensure it gets pushed through smoothly including no one trying to cut the line FOOD 5/5 Is always consistent coming here back to back times. - Baja Fish Taco - Baja Shrimp Taco = I COULD EAT ENDLESS AMOUNTS OF THIS - Filete Al Carbon - Pulpo a Las Brasas = TOP CHOICE just like the taco they have! - Shrimp Aguachile = Super fresh - Tostada de Jurel + ceviche are amazing! - Sopa De Mariscos - Mascarpone Pumpkin Spice Cheesecake = perfect amount to compliment the courses CLEAN AMBIENCE 4/5 Since it shares with our restaurants is busy but you're able to find seats every time you come. SERVICE 4/5 Quick and attentive staff from ordering, bringing out the food, and cleaning up the tables PARKING 4/5 It can get difficult on the time you come

author: Samer Salib
review_text: Amazing very high quality seafood taco options at an affordable price. The Baja fish tacos were so crispy and so tasty, my wife loved it, we had to order a second round! The Baja shrimp tacos were also great and a good size compared to any shrimp tacos I ever had. The octopus tacos were cooked just right and were large enough to have a good chew and bite and I really liked the sauce that came with it. The scallops taco was cooked to perfection like I’ve never tasted scallops this well cooked before! Finally, it was my first time to try sea urchins, and they were absolutely delicious! I loved how it was presented and the I really enjoyed the ceviche that came with it. It was so fresh and creamy it melted in my mouth. Great staff and food service. I highly recommend as a first time Michelin star restaurant on a budget.

author: Sky
review_text: I had huge expectation for Michelle 1 star. Long story short, it is not worth to wait 1 hour to get the food. I might try again if no line. The octopus was good but not exceptional, the sauce was not aligned with octopus and not tasty. The Aguachille was too sour and couldn't enjoy it well. Octopus taco was good. Smoked kanpachi taco was hmmmm. I don't smell any smoke and just plain taco. Urchin was good and I might come back for it. Lemonade was fresh good, but not super excellent. Dish setting is good for the price but not Michelle star up scale. I think there are lots of people due to relatively reasonable price for Michelle star, but taste is not balanced well, and not tasty for the star value.

author: Troy Foltz
review_text: Waffle was undercooked, rubbery and bland. They no longer provide butter for customers. Fried chicken was over cooked, and flavorless. Over priced and terrible food. Wouldn't come back

author: Brenda
review_text: Wonderful new concept of multiple food offerings in one interesting location. The process was simple and food was ready for pick up in 8 minutes. I am looking forward to trying other food shops here. I will probably order prior to arrival next time so I can just drive right through. Finding a nice place to sit and eat is going to be a challenge as the area is still up and coming. I have faith

author: Heidi Liou
review_text: If you’re going to order directly and physically come here (vs using Uber eats for example), make sure you order ahead. Highly recommend Brady’s Bakery for delicious cookies! We just got the cookies to go rather than the “made to order” cookies since we didn’t want to wait longer.

author: Carolynn LaRocca
review_text: The ordering and pick up process, and convenient location were all fantastic! We got our order from Detroit Pizza Depot. Their pizza made this born-in-Detroit woman VERY happy. Now I don’t need to wait for a visit to family and friends in Michigan to get Detroit-style pizza. And they have Faygo pop too!

author: richard g
review_text: Had high hopes with lovelys chicken almost as high as the prices, yet was extremely disappointed. The chicken wasn't even tenders like I ordered and were some reheated old stale chicken that was hard as a rock. Then the waffle was dryey than the dessert. Absolutely terrible food worst chicken I've received in LA.

author: Ny Delancy
review_text: I stumbled upon grand food Depot, purely by accident rushing around Los Angeles on a Friday afternoon, desperate to salvage a dinner party after my original caterer canceled last minute. Within a minute, they created a spread of fresh produce, artisan cheeses, specialty sauces and a selection of important spices that made my kitchen feel like a five star restaurant. Great food great service

author: beth b
review_text: Food is HEAVILY OVERPRICED for what you’re getting. For starters, the photos on the kiosk menu does not match what you’re gonna get at all. The food is fast food level at best. I got some pho, chicken tenders, fries, and two drinks and paid $110. No place to sit and eat.

author: AnunA Gankhuu
review_text: Incredibly top-of-the-food-chain grade wings from Banh Mi Cafe. Lemon pepper and Thai Chilli flavored ones were Chef’s kiss. Truly a blissful experience. The Garlic Soy Sauce Spring Rolls were not deep fried, more Summer Roll. That one was a sad emoji face. But the Wings overpowered the disappointment of the spring rolls.

author: Daniel Bray
review_text: I found this place by accident while looking for free parking near USC. Decided to give it a try. Really cool concept. Ordered a cheese steak. Waiting about 8 minutes in the lot before I got a text that my food was ready. Pull up through the alley to the vendor and grabbed my food. Cheese steak was middle of the road (my car still smells like it two days later). I’d like to see this concept rolled out in more places. Great idea

author: Jenelle Leane Velsa
review_text: A long drive thru with a bunch of restaurants to choose from. Such a cool concept and service was fast and orderly! HIGHLYYY recommend the chicken karaage bowl from Shin Sen Gumi Express

author: Randy Abulon
review_text: there's no seating or amenities for eating at the location. so the atmosphere was 'ok'. there are several vendors at this location, as it's more geared towards the food delivery services than the walk up customers. i ordered a pastrami philly cheesesteak sandwich, and the pastrami was very tasty. the sliced steak seemed a little over seasoned but was still good. would recommend trying one of the cheeses versus their cheese whiz, just as a balance for their version. both meats were very juicy and tender though, as the bread was soaking it up. the size was good, so portion wise was excellent. I'll add this to my list to try the other sandwiches here. i just need to try the other menus at this location first.

author: Andre Krause
review_text: Ordered lunch from 3 “kitchens” vendors. Wasn’t really a place to sit and eat. It’s really for pick-up only, but food options were solid and varied. My group of 3, got a Banh Mi sandwich, a BLT with waffle fries, and a “chicken and waffles” plate, from three separate vendors. We ordered ahead via online and grabbed food as soon as we arrived. Very quick.

author: Victor Hugo O.D.
review_text: Walking by caught this beauty of a place and wondered in, ordering is simple and fast. Tons of great food options and each was delicious. No dine it but you can carry out or order ahead and drive thru pickup.

author: Zak Poole
review_text: Friendly staff and convenient drive thru. Excellent variety of tastes and flavors from different kitchens, all worth a try!

author: Ana Sassin
review_text: Still blown away by the idea of 17 restaurants in 1 drive thru open til 1am. The college students always get the good eateries LOL it is in a bit of a weird place that almost seems like GPS is leading you into a nightmare if you're going late at night. But then all of a sudden, you'll see the skinny, well-lit opening between two warehouses that is the Grand Food Depot. Tried Sundays Korean Fried chicken wings. Very tasty however the wings aren't large. And they give a ton of waffle fries. Almost too many. Definitely going back to try some of the other spots.

author: Ranae Michell3
review_text: Had Hanks honey chicken sandwich was pretty good convenient and great idea

author: Bijan Ardalan
review_text: The restaurants they have here are great. They only have pickup to go since these are basically ghost kitchens. Check out their website to see all the restaurants and put together an order. You'll get a text when your food is ready, usually within 15 minutes of your order being placed. I'm especially fond of Figeroa Philly cheesesteak. The sandwiches and onion rings are great!

author: Marai Jimenez
review_text: I recently had the pleasure of eating at Healthy Organic Catering and indulged in their Grilled Chicken Pesto Sandwich and Turkey Club. The experience was nothing short of delightful. The Grilled Chicken Pesto Sandwich was a burst of flavors with its fresh basil pesto, ripe tomatoes, and juice tender chicken, all nestled between perfectly toasted bread. Each bite was a harmonious blend of savory and herbaceous notes, leaving me craving more. The Turkey Club was a classic favorite done right. The tender slices of turkey paired beautifully with crispy bacon, fresh lettuce, and juicy tomatoes, all held together by soft, toasted bread. The combination of textures and flavors made this sandwich a true standout. Overall, my experience at Healthy Organic Catering was exceptional. The use of fresh, organic ingredients shone through in every bite, and the attention to detail in the preparation of each dish was evident. I highly recommend trying the Pesto Sandwich and Turkey Club for a satisfying and delicious meal.

author: Monique Sanges
review_text: The Figueroa Philly cheesecake was legit. So juicy anx i LOVED the mushrooms. sides are big so we definitely didn't need two sides for two people. Pricey, but you do get pretty big portions. I been coming here since my kid was a toddler and he's 10 this year... my favorite Philly cheesecake place.

author: Skyla Nava (La)
review_text: I really love going to this little shop. It’s close to my work, it’s cheaper than expected, and the food is good! The service is great as well. They recognize me from my past orders and offer me free drinks and always thank me for ordering. The banh mi’s are pretty good and they have a lunch special for only $10! Would recommend! It’s also very quick within 10 minutes of me ordering it’s ready!

author: Randy
review_text: My favorite Tijuana style tacos out of all of LA! Savory and smoked coal-grilled meat wrapped in fresh hand-made tortillas. The line can get long sometimes but these authentic tacos are worth the wait!

author: John Wood
review_text: Great food, fresh and hit. Handmade tortilla. A bit spicy but so worth it and great price. Loved this place!

author: Edi Anguiano
review_text: Tire Shop Taqueria is a great place to enjoy flavorful food in a fun and relaxed setting. The restaurant has a cool, casual feel, and it really does feel like a neighborhood spot where people come to enjoy good food without any stress. From the moment you walk up, the smell of grilled meat lets you know you are in for something special. One of the best items on the menu is the carne asada tacos. The meat is very tender and juicy, and it has a rich, smoky flavor that tastes amazing in every bite. The carne asada is cooked just right and pairs perfectly with the warm tortillas and fresh toppings. These tacos are simple but incredibly delicious. The grilled al pastor tacos are also a must-try. They are well-seasoned and full of bold flavor without being too heavy. You can really taste the spices, and the grilled edges add a nice texture that makes them even better. Each taco feels carefully made and very satisfying. The cheesy gringas cooked on the griddle are another highlight. They are crispy on the outside, warm and melty on the inside, and packed with flavor. The cheese stretches with every bite, making them comforting and hard to resist. They are perfect if you want something rich and filling. The campechanas are very tasty and bring together different meats in one delicious dish. The flavors blend well, creating a hearty and satisfying option. Overall, Tire Shop Taqueria offers amazing food, friendly service, and a relaxed vibe that makes every visit enjoyable and memorable.

author: josh lee
review_text: Tortillas are handmade after you order, the folks handling orders are kind and warm while being very efficient. Meats are well-seasoned; I like the chicken most, chorizo second. There's a decently sized seating area so you can enjoy the freshly made food immediately on-site. Legitimately one of the best, though they're quite well known now and prices seem to have risen a bit.

author: Emily D
review_text: Definitely returning for the tacos whenever I'm in the area. Got the chorizo, chicken, and carne asada. All were an absolute hit. They did need more of a punch like some lime juice or vinegar-based hot sauce to elevate the flavors, but wow the tortilla, which they make right in front of you fresh, and the meats are awesome. Highly recommend all three meats. Ordering was easy and fast. They take card and cash. For three tacos, I paid $8.50 out the door. Covered seating right next to the prep area. Parking is street parking, so may be tricky to find, but I got a spot just around the corner in no time. Coming back to try more of their menu items!

author: Favorite Things
review_text: Disappointed! I keep seeing videos of this place and it looks good so my hopes were high. Unfortunately they were dashed quite quickly after taking my first bite. Zero flavor! Very surprising since everything is made fresh right in front of you. I wanted to like this place, but I have to admit... this might be the worst road side taco stand I've been to.

author: Anu Rao
review_text: The tacos here are absolutely delicious, especially when paired with their flavorful guacamole and salsas. The prices are very affordable, and I love that they customize everything right in front of you, ensuring the ingredients are fresh. The place does get very crowded, but it's definitely worth trying. Since this shop is located in the Carniceria Market, you can explore other food options in the night market as well. Just a heads-up, this shop is only open in the evenings.

author: Nhi Le
review_text: Hands down THE BEST CARNE ASADA I’ve had in LA! You must get these, the freshly made tortillas really make all the difference! Still drooling thinking about that smoky meat and soft, fresh, chewy corn tortillas. Cabeza was really good too, chorizo was ok. But carne asada is a must! We preferred the soft tortillas (tacos, mulitas) over the crunchy ones (vampiros - they were a bit hard and messy to eat. Horchata was a bit too sweet for my liking. $9 for mulitas, $2.5 for taco, and $4 for vampiros if I remember correctly. There were some chairs and tables for sit down. We had to find street parking in the nearby blocks though. Ordering can be confusing if you don’t know what the Mexican dish names mean.

author: Chris K
review_text: They've fallen off in the past few years. Vibe and visual still great, but the meat lacked flavor. Needs salt, marinade, or a pre-roll. Very 1 dimensional. Must be retirement phase

author: Isaac Romero
review_text: Funding a good taco stand here in LA, it's not an easy task, came here by a referral, and finding parking is not that easy. They make the tortillas by hand on the spot. I tried several of their meats and I only liked their Cabeza and Chorizo. The Asada was ok. Al Pastor was not well seasoned and tasted more like Carnitas. Their fountain drinks taste fresh.

author: 龔振勝
review_text: Let me say: I LOVE the fact that they make the shells fresh on-the-spot (got that extra corn flavor) and it's pressed right in front of you. Plus you can see them grill everything right there. Pretty self-explanatory: You start at the end of the line where the menu is. You let the lady making the shells know what you want, and she'll start the shells for those items, then you confirm with the next guy cutting up the stuff what kind of meat, so he'll cut it up and throw them on the shells once they're grilled correctly. Any more from the grill is the next guy over, but if you're good, you can skip straight to paying where you can get a drink. Horchata tasted good too! One thing to note: When the guy asked "Que carne?" (What meat?) My cousin said something in the most gringo accent there was. Homeboy's face got contorted as he tried to guess what she meant. Yo, give her a break, she's from Chicago, she's about as white as they come, but she tried. 🤣

author: Cindy G
review_text: These are authentic street tacos and some of the best in LA! Any meat you choose will be so delicious and the guacamole sauce they pour adds so much flavor! My family and I travel far just to eat these tacos every year!

author: Jeremiah
review_text: The Food is good the drinks are too but the atmosphere is really dirty it demoled like pee and like a dead animal. The service is bad i tried asking what i wanted but be acuse it was my first time i didn’t knee who to ask and then the one that i accedentslly ask was acting dumb on me and so then yea i would rate it 3/5

author: Ocean Medell
review_text: We come here at least once a week . You need to try these tacos . Salsa is spicy . Watch out . Tortas and mulitas are delicious.

author: Dior Ella
review_text: Located in a paid parking lot. I was skeptically but it smelled phenomenal so I tried since people were raving how spicy it is. Welcome to the taqueria where the tacos are as authentic as the street they're named after. The atmosphere? About as casual as a siesta under a palm tree. Now, let's taco 'bout the food. These tortillas are so fresh, they practically introduce themselves. The carne asada? Tender enough to make a vegetarian reconsider. And don't even get me started on the salsa—spicy enough to make your taste buds do the cha-cha. Service? It's like they've mastered the art of efficiency with a side of más salsa, señor?You'll have your tacos faster than you can say guac! So, if you're craving a taste of Mexico without the airfare, this taqueria is your ticket to flavor town. Just bring your appetite and leave your expectations on the side street. It’s street food after all not a five-star fiesta.

author: MIlton Ramos
review_text: I have mixed feelings about this place. I saw a YouTube and TikTok video where it was pretty hyped as a great place to eat, with a good atmosphere and great location. Visiting today the tacos are all OK, but I would not drive the 33 miles again to this location. The carne asada was excellent Tortillas are handmade. The salsas are spicy, but I think that there’s a lack of selection in meats. They have Al- pastor, Asada, chicken, and chorizo. They are missing lengua and tripas. They have vampiros, which was a hard tough tortilla, so not getting this again, and the guacamole is not real. Place was relatively small with limited seating spaces. Overall not quite what I expected.

author: Br3
review_text: I was in the area and just had to stop by. It had been too long. I ordered 6 tacos and a large drink and paid $20 flat. They take cash and card. Hand-made tortillas (always a good sign) and freshly cooked meat and spicy salsa plus agua frescas. They have a few tables set up to eat your food. If you're looking for good tacos, give them a try. FYI, parking is tricky. Sometimes, you have to drive around to find somewhere to park.

author: Roxana A
review_text: We started this adventure not knowing what we were going to encounter… we arrived a little after 5:30pm on a Friday but because it’s the middle of December it’s like midnight outside, so looking for parking was a nightmare here. Be ready to park a bit far and walk through puddles of piss or you might get lucky and find one close enough 😏 Avalon Blvd is busy that hour too! On to the food. I ordered something called a Vampiro, which was essentially protein sandwiched between two really toasted tortillas. Which wasn’t too bad I had the carne asada, the meat was really well seasoned and tender. Ordered a carne asada quesadilla, this was much better, love that they are making the tortillas right there in your face, super delicious this way! Also ordered an al pastor burrito, it was huge and lots of meat that was also very good and tasty. Kinda wish they added pineapple to this!! The mulita was also good and got two large agua frescas, which always hits the spot. Service was okay, a little intimidating (to me) when ordering because they do have different stations and people just standing around and I was trying figure that out but got going. Lol Prices were okay, we paid about $60 for all this and they take cash only. They have a lot of seating available as around the time we got there people are really prob getting off work and picking up to go’s. Music plays and pretty nice little spot to eat and enjoy good food. 💫

author: David Levy
review_text: Best tacos in Los Angeles. Granted there are a lot to choose from but these are the best. Wonderful people great service. Totally authentic.

author: Ortiz Ortiz
review_text: Food is ok but service is bad. They talk to you as if they're doing you a favor for serving you. Very rude.

author: Jennifer De La Torre
review_text: First time coming here because King Taco was closed, but glad we gave it a try. I will say that if given the choice I would always pick King Taco but this was a nice alternative. We ordered; torta cubana, tacos, militas and champurrado. Meat was tasty but I was not a fan of the cheese they used. It was not stringy and I honestly don’t know what cheese they used but I was not a fan. Both salsa were spicy so if you are into really spicy salsas, then this is a good place. Champurrado was good too! I would come again if King Taco was closed again.

author: Sandy Swenson
review_text: This place is the freakin bomb.com. Great food, great prices, amazing condiment bar. Like I’m not even gonna tell you what you’ll find at the condiment bar because you’ll just have to go and find out for yourself. Definitely an LA favorite!!

author: Robert Rael
review_text: Food was good and came out quick. There was no cilantro/onions on the burrito. They offer little packets, but who wants to open up the burrito again to put it on? Restrooms could use some work but otherwise nice place.

author: Elizabeth Wong
review_text: Passing by on street nearing downtown L.A. two locations, big inviting building with a comical chicken logo, a local chain??? The place looked clean fresh maybe newish amidst a not-so- clean or fresh or inviting urban neighborhood. I just felt like a little adventure, so I pulled in and found the parking lot full but one happy space for me. I went in to use the restroom, but the menu and wide open cheerful red-accented modern plexiglass screamed buen comida, eat something. And all the Hispanic clientele cannot be wrong. I got a super burrito. 5/5...carnitas 4/5 (saltiness is subjective, but i thought the carnitas too salty, my mom who shared this huge bad boy with me thought it was perfecto). She took a bit and said, " mmmmmm, is good!!) You get your choice of protein for anything you order -- they have sopes!! And the quesadillas look huge and impressive as other people were dining in and I snuck a peek at their dine-in trays...omg the soft street tacos looks good....gosh I wanted to try it all....they also had mulitas, tortas, and even a Cuban sandwich. I dont even know what a mulita is, but i wanted to try it. About my burrito, I wondered if I wanted to add a scoop of al pastor if I could have done it....I should have asked. Also the burrito was well built and held its shape great. I got it home and at it an hour later, still warm! Not soggy!@ Everyone there was friendly from the owner manning the order desk to the guys assembling your food...to the lady bagging takeout orders. She read my mind as I stood waiting nearby for my takeout, bec without me having to ask, she gave me a plastic bag for the handful of condiments. She's a mind reader!! Great service. Also great attention to hygiene as the salsa bar has everything prepackaged and ready to go. Also there was a traditional salsa bar. Very clean and sanitary. While I was there a guy came to wipe the counter with a clean towel even though it wasn't sloppy or dirty, very impressive. There's so Taco Gavilan where I live, the owner told me they are a chain of 15, maybe the closest is one in Huntington Park. I hope they establish in the SGV someday soon. Because my mom loved her burrito. Thanks for the fun foodie adventure while passing thru an unfamiliar part of town, I wish I had my cell phone with me so I could take pics of your well designed open large friendy colorful dining room. Next time!!

author: TAO D
review_text: Driving through the bustling downtown LA area under the scorching sun, a craving for some fiery Mexican cuisine suddenly struck me. We stumbled upon a low-key local chain eatery that specializes in quick-serve Mexican cooking, offering everything from mouthwatering tacos to scrumptious mulitas, along with a salsa bar. I must say, this hidden gem exceeded my expectations. From the moment we entered, the register welcomed us warmly and displayed incredible patience as they guided us through the menu. As someone who isn't well-versed in Mexican cuisine, their thorough explanations and recommendations were greatly appreciated. Their willingness to ensure that every customer feels comfortable and informed added an extra touch of hospitality to our visit. The restaurant itself was immaculate, with a steady flow of customers and a glimpse of the kitchen where fresh food was being prepared behind the counter. We opted for the taco combo, which allowed us to savor three tantalizing tacos with different meat fillings alongside a serving of steamed rice and flavorful bean paste (with a splash of cheese on top). The presentation of the food was exceptional and convenient. I particularly enjoyed the individually packed condiments and the generous serving of onions and cilantro, allowing us to customize each bite to our liking on the go. Another aspect that truly stood out was the reasonable price of the meal. For this combo (please see the attached pictures), it cost us less than $10 in total. Overall, our experience here was short (less than 15 mins) but nothing short of delightful. The combination of friendly and patient staff, spotless surroundings, and delectable food made for an exceptional dining experience. Whether you're craving a quick bite or a full Mexican feast, this low-key local chain eatery is definitely worth a visit.

author: Giovani V
review_text: Food and service good enough. I’m giving five stars because the time when I was there a man came in with different capabilities and they serve him as they should fhe other time a lady not in her best, she were dirty and maybe drunk but they still treat and serve here as they supposed to. Maybe if she were bothering the customers maybe they will do something .

author: R E “Florecita Rockera” Villalta
review_text: It has been 10 years and still the same or better. A little renovated with packing salsas still a place to go.

author: Joshua Gonzalez
review_text: Good food for the price, we tried the nachos andvtorta de milanesa with a horchata. The torta was actually really good, no complaints. Besides, I wish the milanesa had more breading, but besides that, it's all good! For the nachos, the chips seemed to be a but stale and not fresh cooked, but I could understand because of the cheap prices. The horchata was good, nothing bad or great about it. The service was exceptional and quick. The restaurant was clean, and the tvs were on with futbol that I loved! If you are looking for a cheap and quick meal, this is the spot.

author: Dukwan Adderley
review_text: I received this location to try. I will be honest the food wasn't as hyped as I was told however it wasn't bad. There tacos where okay but not something I am looking to run back to at the first chance. The area it is located is mas o meno (alright / so-so) again not a place if make a priority to get back to anytime soon. The service was good however. Very friendly and helpful staff members. The order and time to pick up was quick and efficient. 10 out of 10 for their staff members.

author: Rachel Avila
review_text: Kind of scary because we went to use the restroom and one of the workers were in there using the restroom and they walked out without washing their hands so we never end up getting anything except for I got a flawn that wasn't that great I've had better and that was pre-wrapped already that's the only reason why I bought it just because we went to use the restroom but other than that we would never go back

author: Valencia
review_text: This is my Favorite food spot when I'm in LA..the food is fresh and the beans are hot and seasoned well and garnishments are fresh and a added bonus(free) I ate chicken burritos both days ( Thanksgiving eve & Thanksgiving instead of turkey) this is how Goood & fresh the food is

author: Ryan LaFebre
review_text: It breaks my heart to have to change my rating from 5 to 3. I've been coming here since 2016 but unfortunately they've changed for the worse. The tacos are just different and not as good. This change started at some point during Covid and I was hoping it was temporary. It's not. Tacos are maybe more oily and a different type of corn tortilla? And they got rid of the amazing roasted jalapeños that used to go so well with the original tacos. I really wish they'd raise prices instead of making the food less tasty and offering only the cold, canned, pickled jalapenos that aren't worth eating. I miss the amazing, original Tacos El Gavilon 😔

author: Fredis Maravilla Saravia
review_text: Great customer services and the food always excellent. I love the beans 🫘

author: Pedro Rico Jr
review_text: Great service and tacos. I love lengua tacos and theirs remind me of home. 100% recommend trying this place at least once.

author: Dana “Pineapple Drop” Miles
review_text: Good service, food tasted good, I purchased their chicken burrito for $10+. The only problem to me is that their burritos can be bigger for that price, it tasted good

author: Rocio A. Cruz (Rosy)
review_text: First time here and I like it, I hesitate a little bit about eating here because I knew it would be just tacos, Tortas, burritos, etc., and it was really early in the morning to have tacos. While I was looking at the menu and , I asked the cashier Maria, and she was kind enough to tell me everything they have for their breakfast menu. I ordered a chorizo and egg burrito 🌯 and it was huge and yummy 🤤 I added the red tomatillo sauce and it tasted just like homemade! I will definitely return. Just a suggestion for the owner or manager about posting that your place carries delicious breakfast and hot coffee ☕ BTW... plenty of parking 🅿️

author: Sandra Figueroa
review_text: The staff here was very friendly. The food was subpar. It wasn't bad by any means, but if you want some really good tacos, then definitely look elsewhere. their aguas frescas very refreshing

author: isaac nagode
review_text: If you're craving late-night tacos in South LA, Tacos Gavilan on Broadway is a solid go-to. It's open crazy late (like 2 AM on weekdays, 4 AM on weekends), so it's perfect for post-party munchies or just a spontaneous taco run. The carne asada and al pastor tacos are my personal faves—super flavorful, with just the right amount of grease to hit the spot. The salsa bar is a nice touch too (if it’s open), with all the fixings to dress up your tacos just how you like. And the portions? Generous. You won’t leave hungry. The vibe inside is pretty chill—clean, fast service, and usually sports on the TVs. It’s not fancy, but that’s kind of the point. Prices are reasonable too, especially for LA. Only heads-up: double-check your order if you're doing takeout or delivery. A few folks (myself included once) have gotten a wrong item or two. Overall? Tacos Gavilan hits the spot when you want something fast, filling, and legit tasty. Definitely worth a stop if you’re in the area.

author: Zulma Aguiar
review_text: Tacos Gavilán is hands-down one of the best taco spots around! 🌮🔥 The food is always fresh, flavorful, and authentically delicious. Their tacos are packed with perfectly seasoned meat, fresh toppings, and warm tortillas that taste like they were made from scratch. The salsa bar is amazing, and the aguas frescas are the perfect refreshing touch. The service is quick, friendly, and efficient, even when they’re busy. Whether you’re dining in or grabbing food to go, Tacos Gavilán never disappoints. 100% recommend for a true taste of Mexico! 🇲🇽💯

author: TEAM BViR
review_text: I ordered a burrito with 2 horchatas using uber eats and got a small quesadilla with no drink. This is preposterous. And when I called no one answers the phone. I recommend others to just eat somewhere else. Totally unsatisfied with this experience.

author: Jenny Monroy
review_text: Decided to try something new closer to my home area, and WOW the combo B was so good the rice was soft and not salty, orange chicken was also so good along with the beef and broccoli I would recommend!! My new favorite chinese spot to eat at now!

author: melany hernandez
review_text: My experience here at Luckys has always been good. The food was very yummy, although the area may not be the best never judge a book by its cover. My personal fav Chinese food spot.

author: St Francis
review_text: As far as I'm concerned, the positive reviews I read before I tried Lucky's, were right on the money💰. Everything looked fresh and delicious the first time I visited. I had just found my favorite Chinese food in South Los Angeles! That's why they get the 5 stars. The spring rolls are always fresh, crispy, and very tasty. .50 cents extra for sweet & sour sauce. The combination plates are delicious. Served with generous portions. You won't be disappointed ordering at Lucky's. Every time I go back I try new things and I am never disappointed.

author: Reynaldo Garcia
review_text: 10/02 I bought 3 combos and 3 large Thai tea boba. The drinks were missing sweetener. I don’t live close to the location. I called in and told them the situation. I was told to come back whenever I get a chance and they will replace them. I went back today and was told I was only to receive one med drink. I paid for 3 large boba, I was going back and forth with the cashier and asked to speak to the manager. I was refused any communication with him. At the end I said “keep the drink I don’t even want it no more.” I wasted over $15 on 3 large drinks. I’m disappointed with the Customer Service I received. I used to like this place, time for a new location.

author: Victor G
review_text: I’ve been coming to Lucky’s Chinese Food for a while now, and it never disappoints. The portions are super generous for the price, and the food always hits the spot hot, fresh, and flavorful. The chow mein and fried rice is fire too, always cooked just right and not overly greasy like some other spots. What really sets this place apart, though, is the service. The staff is always friendly, fast, and welcoming. Even when they’re busy, they move quickly and stay polite. You can tell they care about keeping customers happy.

author: Maria Ruvalcaba
review_text: This is the go-to spot for amazing Chinese food! Their chow mein is absolutely my favorite—it has a unique flavor that sets it apart from other places I've tried. The food here is consistently excellent, and the staff are incredibly friendly, always providing fast, outstanding service. Highly recommend

author: Oopszahdaisy Crayola
review_text: Retraction: I have never done this before. I am retracted my statement for now. I decided to come back for some soup. And the next visit, I came back for a 2 combo plate. I must say I was very impressed. My food did not spoil. The food was fresh. It was nice. I've only been back twice, but if my third visit is a winner then I will delete the bottom of my post. I don't know what happened, but I thank you for the drastic change. I appreciate this. I never go back and retract my statements. I may edit them or just delete them. But I feel this restaurant did a total change, and they need to know the customers are looking and watching and tasting. And I thank you for listening. It takes three chances to win my vote. We will see what happens next. December 22nd 2024 First of all I "used to love coming here". I can deal with a lot of things. But what I CAN NOT deal with is how my food SPOILS within a few hours. On MULTIPLE occasions, I would come in for a plate after my shift at 4:30. By 8, I could not eat my food because of the sour smell. My food had STUNK up my whole house. I mean it smelled like kimchi, dead rats, and skunks. If it will spoil within three hours, imagine what it will do in your stomach. I am SO Sick of Chinese food places in South LA serving us reheated food that sours within hours. If you do get something, get white rice. The spices is KILLING the food under the heat. I know I'm not the only person experiencing this. This happens EVERY single time. It's HORRIBLE. We deserve FRESH food. I decided to give this place a few chances because I really liked it, but hell no, not again. Don't say I didn't warn you. If you knew better you would do better by us. I will NOT be coming here EVER again. Food poisoning isn't CUTE or healthy. I have permanently giving up Chinese food because of it, unless it's 🐼. I would love to see the owner eat his own food after leaving it sitting for 4 hours. I guarantee if he did, he would have the same reaction as I did 🎯

author: Aegean Sea

author: Dory Boyce

The dining area was tidy, and even though it was busy, they kept up with the orders efficiently. I love the late-night hours—it’s my go-to spot after a long day. Highly recommend for anyone looking for variety and great taste!

author: betty Ramirez
review_text: We arrived at this McDonald’s at 5:50 a.m. and waited outside because the posted opening time is 6:00 a.m. By 6:07 a.m., the restaurant was still not open. When we asked why they were opening late despite the sign stating 6:00 a.m., the employee responded dismissively with, “Well, it’s open now.” The lack of punctuality, poor communication, and unprofessional attitude were very frustrating. If this location does not consistently open at the posted time, the hours should be corrected to avoid misleading customers. She said "no she can't help us" she walk away.

review_text: Ordered the McCrispy.Chicken was dry, hard and tough to eat. Obviously it's been sitting for a long time under a heat lamp. Guess I could have picked a better location. Crazy warning signs everywhere 🤣 (see PHOTOS) and the staff working behind bullet proof GLASS.

review_text: Ah! The old Zep Diner! Home of the Hinden-Burger! And chicken & steak dinners! And malts & sodas! You youngins don't know what you missed! The restaurant was shaped like a blimp. And everything! McDonald's should make its restaurants look like a bunch of blimps! I know that blimps make me hungry! They make you hungry, too! Zep Diner! Yes!

author: Brenda Luna
review_text: To Whom It May Concern, I am writing to formally report a highly unprofessional and unacceptable experience I had at your McDonald’s location. I expect this complaint to be taken seriously and addressed by management and, if necessary, escalated to corporate oversight. On [06/09/2025], I visited your drive-thru. I was behind another vehicle and waited several minutes at the ordering speaker without any communication or greeting. After three full minutes of silence, I asked aloud if the location was open. I received no response. I proceeded forward to the second window, where there was also no employee present. When I reached the third window, I was shouted at by an employee who claimed someone was at the ordering speaker. They proceeded to refuse to serve me, even though I was attempting to purchase a simple coffee. When I asked to speak to a manager, the situation escalated rather than improved. The manager on duty was dismissive, confrontational, and completely unwilling to acknowledge the breakdown in communication or take basic accountability. Instead of resolving the issue, the manager instigated further hostility and excused the behavior of the staff. To make matters worse, a drive-thru employee named Miguel—who I’ve had issues with before—mocked me and laughed at me during this visit. This is not the first time he has behaved unprofessionally. In a previous incident, Miguel served me scalding hot coffee without a lid, which resulted in me getting burned. I reported that incident, and I believe he now targets me because of that prior complaint. I am deeply concerned that your staff: • Refused service without cause. • Failed to communicate properly at the ordering station. • Reacted with aggression when questioned. • Allowed personal bias and retaliation from a previous incident to impact current service. • Showed a lack of basic professionalism and critical thinking required for customer service. This is unacceptable for any business, let alone one operating under the McDonald’s brand. I request: 1. A formal apology. 2. A review of staff training, especially regarding customer interaction and drive-thru procedures. 3. Reassignment or disciplinary action for employees who engage in retaliatory behavior. 4. Clarification on how complaints like mine are being tracked and followed up on. I am a paying customer, and I expect to be treated with respect and dignity. I hope your company will take the necessary steps to correct these issues.

author: Joshua Gonzalez
review_text: I hope McDonalds corporate sees this, but I doubt it. I came in with my fiancé for a quick bite and started doing the usual pictures for my review without intrusion on customers or employees and went out to take a street shot of the building. As I'm coming back in 4 employees, one a security guard cane aggressively at me asking what am I doing? Again, they were very aggressive, but I simply told them I do google reviews and was taking a couple of shots. They said I couldn't, and I respected their wishes as they are a private company, and I was on private property, so I told them I wouldn't but I CAN still take photos from the PUBLIC sidewalk as per the UNITED STATES FIRST AMMENDMENT freedom of press gives me the right to. (Eyes can not be trespassing from public property). The manager said I could not, and the security guard was getting an aggressive look along with the other employees, so to de escalate, the situation I left without further confrontation, only to find out my order was also all messed up. MCDONALDS should make sure their employees and security guards aren't infringing on our constitutional rights!

author: Markesha Smith
review_text: My aunt had a truly distressing experience at Domino’s that I feel compelled to share. During her visit, she unexpectedly felt faint and ended up passing out. It was a scary situation, and she had to call 911 for assistance. In that moment, she asked for a simple cup of water to help her recover while waiting for help. Shockingly, the employee on duty refused to give her water unless she paid $2. Given her state—disoriented, shaken, and unable to think clearly—she wasn’t in a position to pay. It was deeply upsetting that, even in an emergency, a basic act of kindness like providing water wasn’t extended. While I understand that businesses have policies, this was a clear situation where human decency should have prevailed. My aunt was left feeling disappointed and hurt, not just because of her health scare, but because of the lack of compassion she experienced. I hope Domino’s management takes this feedback seriously and trains their staff to handle emergencies with more empathy. --- Not to mentioned she purchased food from them.

review_text: I just wanted to drop a quick line about my first visit to your place recently, a few things didn't quite hit the mark, and I thought you'd appreciate a heads-up! Also, a little heads-up about the avocado that came with my meal – it looked like it had seen better days, if you know what I mean. Just a thought for quality control! And the sushi was whatever. I will also suggest being extra careful with packing the food,that would make a customer happy, because I had to get up three times and ask for napkins, forks, chops sticks, sriracha, etc.... It kind of broke up the flow of the meal , I was-annoyed by then. All in all, these little hiccups just added up, and honestly, it made my first visit less enjoyable than I'd hoped. author: Roberto G
review_text: August 10, 2025 – My First and Last Visit I finally went to this sushi place my fiancé had been bragging about. I was excited… until I experienced the service. This is my personal opinion based on my personal experience. The food is good — but when customer service is this bad, the quality doesn’t matter. My order number was 141, and I waited 55 minutes before my food came out. Yes, they were busy, but here’s the problem: there should be a system in place — at least one dedicated cook or staff member for dine-in customers so they’re not stuck waiting while take-out orders flood the kitchen. By the time my food arrived, my hunger and patience were gone. For me, this was the first and last time I’ll be here. Advice for anyone thinking of visiting: Call ahead, place your order by phone, and give yourself at least an hour before you expect to eat. Owner/manager, if you read this — take it as constructive criticism. Good food might get people in the door, but bad service will keep them from coming back.

author: Virginia Cabrera
review_text: Food is good but the waiting time is long and prices are fair we love this food

author: Timothy Smith
review_text: These people here are very kind. However, the Mexican sushi had no flavor at all. A Japanese Chef would commit harakiri had he ate the sushi I bought. It was warm and bland and the sauces were also nasty. I though it was a traditional sushi place and when I realized it wasn’t I was hungry enough to give it a shot. I got what was recommended to me by one of the workers. And boy do I regret it. If you hate actual sushi maybe you’ll like this place. But don’t expect Asian sushi when coming here. They have cheese and steak and chips in theirs. So i hardly wanna even call it sushi. Sorry :/

author: Liliana M
review_text: Food is good, they have only out door sitting... minimal sitting available but it nice We alway order takeout.

author: Elizabeth Martinez
review_text: This is my fav sushi spot ever. I do live a couple hours away but when around I go grab a sushi. It’s soooo delicious 👍🏻😍!!!

author: marilyn V
review_text: I’ve been going here since 2018. It was always great and consistent with taste. Recently it’s really a hit or miss sometimes they make it really well, it’s well seasoned, crispy and you get plenty of shrimp other days you can tell they’re a bit rushed with the food being pretty bland. Over all a good place with great staff, I just hope they get better with the consistency.

author: Elizabeth Luna
review_text: This spot has some amazing rolls. From deep fried rolls to baked rolls and, of course, classic rolls, everything is different and delicious. We've been exploring their menu for years now, and it is definitely a fusion that calls to continue to be discovered. This is Sinaloa style sushi made with lots of love. The rolls are creative and culturally distinctive, and all come with classic regional sides that include a secret signature sauce. This food takes time. It's usually a 25-minute wait for your order. If there are people ahead, it usually takes a minute to get your order. Calling in your order is highly recommended. It is also cash only and the parking is very limited and there are only a few benches for outdoor seating and no restrooms. Despite a few unappealing elements, this place is always packed. It's definitely a must try.

author: Becky Gonzalez
review_text: One of the best Mexican sushi i ever had will definitely refer and Employees very polite

author: Zahra Zepeda
review_text: The food is good but, the service is the worst: I was waiting with my family the food and we wait an hour, they didn't call us to get the food and when they give us the food it wasn't hot. The atmosphere isn't clean I found a lot of hair on the floor and napkins.

author: CINTYA ENCISO
review_text: Ill be honest. I thought I had placed my order at another restaurant but I made a mistake and placed my order here. I had never been here before. I had driven by and it never appealed to me. I thought it was just another restaurant that served ceviche and cocketeles. So I had to pick up my food and thought OMG I WILL regret this mistake. Well I couldn't just leave the food. When I got there it was 9pm and they close at 10 and they still had people eating there, picking up orders I mean they were busy. Oh before I forget. The girl that took my phone order was very very nice. She explained the different types of rolls and their ingredients. She was super cool. If you read this review tell your boss to give you a raise, you deserve it. So when I was paying I still had my doubts and I asked her what the hell did I order so she gave me a menu and pointed to what I ordered. I was like this looks yummy. It was very delicious. I honestly don't remember everything I ordered. I know I ordered the Grenudo roll. It wasn't what I expected. It was great. Loved it. The sauce or dressing that they give is really good. Not spicy or bland at all. It has good flavor. I know i ate something that had crab meat on the bottom or the side. That was really good too. Like I said I don't remember the names but I do recommend it. You will not regret it. Oh and the portions are good size. Not exaggerated big but enough to fill u up and still have left over or one order is enough for two people.

author: Daniel V
review_text: The Food does not taste fresh, me and my wife got 4 rolls and of the 4, only one had a distinct flavor. Upon ordering food my wife had observed a piece of salmon just sitting on a shelf and as we waited 25 mins for food and also ate for 20 mins that same piece of salmon was sitting in the same spot. This place is not worth it to us. The food is edible but the handling of the food is questionable. Go at your own risk but for us this was not worth it. I definitely think it is over hyped. The rolls I purchased are Hot Cheeto roll Ali roll El pecado roll Bobby roll The distinct flavor was in the hot Cheeto roll.

author: J M
review_text: Every time I come here and order ahead. To pick up they make me wait 20-30 min extra It’s always the same, I’m done coming here is not even good & the prices aren’t that great. I would give 0 stars Honestly worst customer service in LA

author: Emerald “Emerald Violet” Violet
review_text: Prices did not match food, I know everything is expensive now still overpriced for what you get. Food was okay, you are basically eating a ton of rice and a few pieces of whatever protein you choose. The sauce is what makes the food, without sauce food not great. Looooong wait time, didn't add up.

author: Yancy Alfaro
review_text: Arrived at 7:58. Wouldn't take my order because they were closed. Aren't they supposed to close at 9pm? I asked at what time they closed. I was told 8pm. Only about a minute had passed since I arrived.

author: L G
