review_text: Needs to be faster... Two times I've been there and both were 30-40 minutes wait to get the food to go.

author: Elissa Massiel
review_text: We love this sushi.. But the place needs attention in cleaning, and better atmosphere. It's better not to eat there. I recommend only order to go.

author: bladimir hernandez
review_text: lovely place, delicious food, really transit as there it is a corner between 2 large avenues but the food and service gets a 10 of 10

author: Miguel Angel del Toro Diaz
review_text: I don't know why Uber eats or posmates never works, I hate that, I don't know why they want service applications if they are never available 😡

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: kimberly
review_text: Such a spacious and fun atmosphere! The waitresses were super friendly. The robots are pretty cool too. The meats were fresh and came out immediately after ordering them. I recommend the green apple soju.. it tastes like juice! I had such a fun and delicious time dining with my husband

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: saul mercado
review_text: Made a reservation for New years day party of 10. There was some miscommunication on their end not seeing my reservation the day of. Dispute that tey honored my word and the reservation I had made, and got me through even though it was super busy and a long wait. Seating area is large. We were seated at a large table in a somewhat secluded area which was perfect for our party. We all got the combo B. Meats where good. Large selection of sides, even got tortillas which I thought was cool. Service was excellent never had to wait long periods for food or drinks. I would definitely be coming back!

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Jonathan Wildman
review_text: Perfect all you can eat K bbq! Lots of sides, lots of meat options, three levels of meals, good quality on all, the service is quick and attentive and they have cool service robots that even sing happy birthday and say the person's name. Place gets busy as expected but it is large and good for big family groups. Will definitely be back again.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Yessi Gomez
review_text: First time here and I can honestly say I had a great experience. The food was good quality and overall, the atmosphere is amazing!! 10 out of 10

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: John Ramirez
review_text: Beware if you are a family of four. 18% gratuity added on the bill. Been a customer for a while now just recently brought my kids and god damn $140 is crazy. Server came once to ask for drinks and second to ask if we wanted meats as they were closing. Food is good, but service is subpar. Adding gratuity on 2 adults and 2 kids when’s it’s not busy is going to turn away a lot of people. Especially families. For two people this place rocks!

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Nicole N
review_text: SO HAPPY I FOUND THIS PLACE🙌 9/10 The quality of the food is so good and fresh. Someone recommended the radish paper in an older review, it has been a life changer imo! Overall the service is great, but I like that there's a button to call the waiter over. This place dosent get packed like most kbbq's, which is always a surprise to me because this place is just as good, if not BETTER than other kbbqs! I love getting Menu B, it has a good variety of dishes beyond regular meat options like fried rice, fried wontons, corn cheese, and i love the squid! Good for going solo or for a big group. A few things that dont make this place a 10/10 is there is a robot that brings most of the dishes, usually the waiter helps and unloads the dishes but not at all the time so its awkward having to standup from the table to get the dishes and you only have about a minute before the robot leaves so you have to be fast😅 Its also awkward when the robot stops in a spot where youre unsure if its meant for you or the table next to you... certain tables are too close to each other. Also the paying situation, I never know if Im suppose to ask the waiter for the bill or get up and pay at the exit. I always get up and pay on my way out but then they ask for my table number and i have no idea. Maybe this is a me problem? IDK, but this is the only restaurant that gives me this confusion. Confusion or not, I will be back😊

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Roger Alarcon
review_text: Great service by both the human and the robot lol.. food was great as well.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Emelyn Ortiz
review_text: Great music!! Macaroons are no longer sold temporarily because the warehouse burnt down 9/29/25. They have robots that take the food trays to your table for quicker service.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Stephanie Eudave
review_text: One of my fav Korean BBQ spots! There are little to no wait times & the food quality is amazing 😻

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: JMA Amaya
review_text: Real good service. The meats and sides are delicious. My group of 6 enjoyed menu A. Personally, enjoyed the beers on tap, they're better on tap. Lots of variety of Soju. Their radish paper is really good, preferred it over their rice paper. Good for a dinner on a Monday night.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Lutthanee Sattharatanatri
review_text: Authentic Korean food with an all-you-can-eat buffet option. There are Set A, B, and C available. Desserts not included. Free parking is available in front of the restaurant. They use robots for serving and iPads for ordering. The food comes out quickly, and the staff provides excellent service. A must-try! 😍😍😍

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: H FG
review_text: Excellent food and great customer service!!! Been coming here for years, I love their egg soup

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Sam
review_text: First and last last time coming here. Food was pretty good. Came in for lunch wasn't too busy. Asked for the check or how to best pay they went and got the bill brought it back out didn't say anything , so I left cash plus cash tip. Waited quite a few minutes finishing my food and drink no one came so go to leave say thank you to the staff as we're leaving and this random chic employee comes running out after us yelling did we pay for our food . Totally uncalled for and rude.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Pedro Najera
review_text: The Food Is Great!! A lot of Options!! Service Was 6 Out of 10, Just Cus The Server Never Came Bak To Our Table After The 2nd Time We Ordered, We Waited about 30 Mins And She Never Came Not Even For Refills But Again The Food is Delicious.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Drew
review_text: Good was great . However they do add a gratuity fee to your bill with out any notice and it's hard to get a waiter to come to your table when it's busy .

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: maddy acosta
review_text: Okay look Korean bbqs are my things. I've been to many bbqs and look the food is ight . The meets are great. The side dishes are alright like the rice and cucumbers. Everything was ight till I started to notice the hygiene of the restaurant. The bathrooms are extremely dirty. It smells like black mold . The seats at the tabels are greasy and sticky. How can it be both I have no clue but for sure my pants where peeling off the seats. Walking to bathroom 8 months pregnant was almost a safety hazard from the slippery floors. I really think they should have some professional cleaning done. The robot service it's pretty cool till ur trying to get everything off and it says bye and your still trying to chase it to get your food. The mango lemonade was so watered down I had to ask for a coke after trying 2 cups. Over all it wasn't that bad just i think they need to invest in cleaning the restaurant

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Pam Leonido
review_text: Amazing staff, meat selection and amount of time you can stay for this all you can eat Korean BBQ! Everything is top quality and the staff are the most respectful and kind people we met and we had a party of 12!

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: araceli angel
review_text: rvice was great and attentive. Everything we ordered was brought to our table within minutes. The food was good and spicy pork belly was delicious! The music was good throughout our visit. Very good place to have a good meal, drinks, and have a chill time

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Alexa Gonzalez
review_text: This place is so good!! I love the food🌚 Honestly it is so worth the money! You get to eat as much as you want and the meat is really good quality!! The staff is really kind. They check up on you and overall real sweet. The atmosphere is calm and chill. Very lively with all the people enjoying their food. I brought my friends here and they liked it too

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Jerry Granillo
review_text: Mauro is an amazing server! My family and I have been coming here for some time, and Mauro is always so friendly and attentive to us. One of the best servers here! The price is good and the food is amazing! Great place to come relax and have a great family experience

author: Hungry J
review_text: Surprisingly not hard to get a booking on a friday night. Overall the experience was positive but for the price, the food overall fall a bit short of expectation. Salad was good, meatballs can be better, calamari was decent but the sauce does not seem match. The bread and dip was good too but the eggplant was hard to taste. Cavatelli pasta was good but i think the balance was off due too much cheese. And the sausage was a bit too mushy. The vodka pasta was solid, the the Squash Agnolotti was the best pasta I had in a while. Steak is crowd favorite but the special duck dish is not there. The duck smelled a bit off but unfortunately it happens once in a while. Not much a restaurant can do. Sides was good too. Service is nice an chill. Its worth a try for sure.

author: Lily Zhang
review_text: Horrible experience. Everything was bad, especially the service and the food. First, we asked for iced lattes and they gave us all hot lattes. When we pointed this out they dumped the hot lattes into another glass with 3 ice cubes; the lattes were still warm and now, watered down. Our waiter was SUPER un-attentive. It took us forever to order our main dishes. To give the restaurant credit, the food came out fast and looked tasty. However, looks can be deceiving...the food was horrible too. The ocean view was nice, but it was hard to even look at it because the pasta tasted like it had been dunked in the salty ocean water. Our cacio e pepe and ragu tasted so salty we thought the whole salt canister was dumped onto the dishes. Since the waiter was no where to be seen, we only had one measly cup of water that was finished and our whole table was extremely parched. The waiter didn't check up on us once and was sitting at the bar chatting with her co-workers. We had to waive the waiter over to ask about alternative options with the food, she was dismissive and spoke so quietly we could not hear her over the chatter in the restaurant. The best part of this experience was leaving the establishment.... unless you are handicapped then good luck leaving because the exit points down to three flights of stairs.

author: Shanru
review_text: Beautiful restaurant with great views of the ocean from the windows. We were able to be seated before sunset — highly recommend getting a reservation. The whipped eggplant was unique and delicious as well, and the service was friendly. It felt a bit crowded inside the restaurant, with the seats and tables crammed next to each other, and it was harder to talk as it was very loud inside. The food also took longer than expected to come out, but it was nice to sit and enjoy the views.

author: Mike Sperando
review_text: Elephante was one of those restaurants that instantly stood out when searching for top Italian spots in the area. I can confidently say this experience was an absolute 10/10 from start to finish. I started with the Caesar salad and ordered the vodka sauce pasta. The Caesar was incredibly flavorful and generously portioned, and the vodka sauce pasta had some of the best flavor I’ve had in a long time — easily the standout of the meal. We sat outside by the window, which was perfect, but the indoor space is just as impressive. The interior has a bright, airy vibe that almost feels like something you’d find in Arizona (even though I’ve never been there), which made the atmosphere feel unique and memorable. I would go back to Elephante again and again without hesitation. This was my first real meal and true taste of Los Angeles, and I couldn’t have picked a better place to start.

author: Cindy W
review_text: Our meal was delicious, and the service overall was pleasant, but the hostess was not well trained and thus ruined the overall experience for us. The cocktails were decent, but nothing out of the ordinary. Some must-get food items are “whipped eggplant”, “octopus salad” (even though I have been avoiding eating octopus given the Netflix show), and the various pasta dishes (gemelli and ragu). Reservation is a must here. We were here to catch up with friends, so it didn’t bother us that we were seated in the garden section (no exterior view) of the restaurant rather than the lounge area that gets packed with patrons there for the sunset views. The restaurant is in partnership with GreenPlaces to reduce carbon footprints by charging a 0.5% fee per check. It was a relatively small amount but goes a long way to make the guests feel good that we get to participate in something positive.

author: Thu-Nga Ortega, DDS, MAGD
review_text: This rooftop restaurant is pretty cute. It has a nice ambience and overlooks the beach from afar. We came here for brunch. The food is decent, dessert is pretty good. We got the steak and eggs and it was tasty. This scrambled egg with prosciutto and cheese bread was delicious. The pepper pasta ( cacio e pepe ) is also pretty tasty. The mango and pineapple sorbet was delicious. Tiramisu was also delicious. This restaurant is worth going to if you are in LA

author: Portia Freeman
review_text: Positives: Service was fairly good, they were attentive, they let us switch our table to the lounge seats when we asked at a quiet time. The ambiance is very nice, and the view is to die for! It’s perfect to go at sunset so you can watch it over the ocean on this rooftop restaurant. I got the Oaxacan old fashioned, it was strong and delicious. Negatives: I heard so much about this whipped eggplant dip. It’s just a very small plate of velvety spread, and it mildly tastes of eggplant. It came with a huge plate of puffed up pita, which looked cool and was nice to rip into as a table. The spread and the pita as a whole just didn’t seem worth the hype? It wasn’t bad, but it was kind of nothing. My main gripe is that you realistically go through the entire spread before you get even halfway through the pita. We also ordered the ragu, pesto, polenta and mushrooms, and a vodka pasta. All of it, ESPECIALLY the ragu, was unbelievably salty. I am not shy about salt, and unfortunately, I am known to oversalt when I cook at home because I know how much the right amount of salt can elevate a dish, but it was so salty, it made my mouth hurt slightly. It was a bummer that the over salting showed up in every single pasta dish. I also didn’t appreciate the undercooked egg white in the polenta. It was pretty gooey… Lastly, this is more of a pet peeve of mine, but they took one of the plates of pasta away when approx a quarter of the dish was left. The server didn’t ask if we wanted it boxed. Usually, I’d say something or stop them before they whisked it away, but it was so mediocre and salty that I didn’t really care to not have it again. Go for the ambiance and a nice cocktail, not the food. It may be disappointing, at least given how much hype this restaurant has received in LA.

author: Karen Schreiber
review_text: The restaurant is beautiful. We were celebrating our nephews 18th birthday and sat on the private patio. The waiter was amazing. So warm, so attentive and so eager to know if we need a anything else. His helpers were also fantastic. This was our first time. Great people watching, great ocean view and delicious food.

author: Melisha Mahakumara
review_text: We had an incredible experience at Elephante thanks to Angelo who offered the best service! He was attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable. He made us feel truly taken care of from start to finish. The food was just as amazing.. the corn truffle agnolotti and truffle pasta were absolutely fabulous, perfectly balanced, and full of rich flavor. Every bite was a delight!

author: Brittany Furlan
review_text: Literally such a fun spot. Feels like you’re in Tulum but it’s Santa Monica. If you can get there before sunset, you will have the best view of the sun setting above the ocean. Pure beauty. The food is delicious. The whipped eggplant appetizer is insane. Everything is so good actually you can’t go wrong. Make reservations.

author: Ray Eguavoen
review_text: Elephante for lunch with a friend, and we did their $40 per person express lunch( one starter, one main, and one dessert). Even though it was overcast and the view wasn’t at its best, the food definitely delivered. The vodka pasta and branzino were the clear standouts. I also really enjoyed the calamari, though the balsamic aioli was a bit too bitter for my taste. I highly recommend asking for the lemon aioli instead. A must order is the whipped eggplant (not included in the express lunch). Overall, the express lunch is a great deal for the amount of food you get.

author: Tharindu Mahakumara
review_text: I went to Élephante for a birthday dinner and had one of the best nights! Our server, Angelo, was amazing! He so attentive and full of great recommendations. It was my first time dining there, and definitely not my last. The view was stunning, the food was delicious, and the whole experience was unforgettable. I highly recommend checking it out if you haven’t already!

author: Miguel Sanchez (Mich)
review_text: Élephante in Santa Monica is an absolute gem! Perched on the rooftop with breathtaking ocean views, this Italian restaurant is the perfect spot to watch the sunset. As the sky transforms into hues of orange and pink, the atmosphere becomes truly magical. Élephante's rooftop setting offers an unobstructed view of the Pacific Ocean, making it an ideal spot to witness the sunset. From wood-fired pizzas to handmade pastas, the menu features a range of traditional Italian dishes crafted with fresh, locally sourced ingredients. The staff at Élephante are knowledgeable and attentive, ensuring a seamless dining experience. The combination of chic decor, lush greenery, and stunning views creates a lively yet intimate ambiance, perfect for special occasions or casual gatherings. Reservations are highly recommended, especially if you want to secure a table with sunset views. The restaurant's rooftop setting is particularly stunning during sunset, making it a perfect spot for romantic dinners or special occasions. Overall, Élephante is a must-visit destination in Santa Monica, offering an unforgettable dining experience with its stunning sunset views, delicious Italian cuisine, and vibrant atmosphere

author: Reto K
review_text: After all, apparently this is one of Santa Monicas best (italian) restaurants. As an almost Italian I have to say this place is not living up to its promises. In my opinion their only advantage are those tables at the front site facing the sea. Watching sunset from there is really nice. As a walk-in, they just put you on a waiting list that allows you to sit on the bar. Totally unclear whether at one point you will actually get a table. Luckily we got a table after 1 hour wait. The food menu is pretty strange as neither dish seems to be a full dish. You order the chicken, you will only get the chicken (in a chinese chili sauce - this is supposed to be an italian place, no?). Pasta is just the pasta. So I ordered both. The bucatini were nice but ordering them alone would be like ordering a burger without buns. The bottle of wine I ordered… yeah I definitely had nicer Primitivos with more flavor. The service at the bar was pretty good, the one at the table not so inspiring. It seems like a place you go for the reputation and to be seen but not for the rest.

author: Delaney Weiland
review_text: Elephante is that kind of restaurant you can go to with so many kinds of groups and it works for every situation. Between the views, the food, drinks, and service, the experience is a 10/10. I was traveling for work and decided to go based on a colleagues recommendation. I went alone and sat at the bar. It was pretty crowded for 5:30 on a Tuesday but didn't feel too packed in and the service was still super quick. At the bar, I had Daniel and Dorian as my bartenders. They definitely made the solo experience lots more fun. They recommended my dinner and drinks, all of which were delicious and fun! I even got a little taste test of one of their frozen drinks which was a bonus. They definitely knew their menu and bar well. I had a dirty martini as well as a margarita and would say the margaritas are the way to go there!! It was so delicious and I am still thinking about it. As for the food, I had whipped eggplant to start and for my main, the Ragu Bianco. Whipped eggplant was incredible, I had never had anything like it and was super obsessed. And the Ragu was perfect, not too heavy and a good portion of food. Overall, it was a great dinner and I ended up chatting with another solo diner for the majority of the evening as well. Would recommend to anyone looking for a good date spot or just a place to grab dinner on a work trip! And if you're at the bar, ask for Daniel or Dorian for a great experience!!!

author: Kahani Patel
review_text: Elephante is such a vibe. The cocktails were excellent — super balanced and really well made. The standout dish for me was the whipped eggplant; honestly one of the best things on the menu. Fresh, flavorful, and addictive. Great atmosphere, great service. Perfect spot for a night out.

author: Alan Ritchie
review_text: We had an excellent meal at Elephante. The ambiance is next level and will be extremely hard to beat given its proximity to the water in Santa Monica. During our meal, we had a nice view of the water yet enjoyed the dark and moody atmosphere of the restaurant. The service was very kind and attentive despite being busy. We got the whipped egg plant dip which was solid (the bread is next level). We then got the vodka pasta and sopressata pizza. I really enjoyed the combination of the honey and hot soppressata on the pizza and felt that the vodka pasta was extremely well balanced. This was a great meal and I am glad we were able to make it in. Note- I would definitely recommend making a reservation multiple weeks in advance as it was quite busy.

author: Alain Maalouf
review_text: Great food and a really nice atmosphere. Everything we ordered tasted fresh and well prepared, and the service was friendly and attentive. A few small details could be improved, but overall it was a very enjoyable experience. I’d definitely come back and recommend it.

author: Jo S
review_text: Ehh. It’s a try hard scene-y spot that only cares who you are. I have been there numerous times and tried to give them the benefit of the doubt, but the last time I was there it became abundantly clear. Friends from out of town always want to go here, and I have been happy to oblige as I enjoy the sunset views and their famous eggplant dip. But every time I’ve been here, I’ve been treated like an imposition for simply being there, shoved at a table with barely enough space, crammed between 4 other parties and a server trying to rush to get their next cover. The last time I was there, they were “setting up for a private party” which literally included tables being carried OVER my party. It was stressful and chaotic. When asking our server, she was immediately rude about the situation. There were at least 10 open tables in the front (near the railing) but I was told those were all booked. Then some influencers in sweatpants came in, were given those tables and I watched the staff members discuss their needs and serve them right away; while I’ve been waiting 10 minutes for a drink and am having tables carried over me. I follow another Bachelor contestant on Instagram that is always perched in the front. This is a see and be scene spot more than anything, and if you’re an everyday person trying to enjoy the sunset with your mom, you’re better off elsewhere.

author: Gray Stone
review_text: Élephante is a must-try and a classic LA brunch spot. Anything you order on the menu is guaranteed to be great because of the high quality of the ingredients. The ambiance is unbeatable—think chic, beachy, and effortlessly cool. It’s the perfect place for a brunch with friends, a casual date, or even out-of-town visitors. I would absolutely recommend it, whether you’re a local or a tourist looking for that quintessential LA brunch experience.

author: Ezgi Melody Yurtseven
review_text: I had such a great experience at The Butcher’s Daughter. Our waiter Emily has such a kind soul — she was super friendly and took the time to explain everything to us about the orange wine. The manager Ashley was also very welcoming, which made the whole experience even better. I can honestly say that not only is the food good, but the people are too. We had the margarita pizza, and it was amazing. We also had white wine and rosé, both incredible, and we tasted some orange wine which was also very good. The aesthetic of this place is just unmatched. It’s such a clean, aesthetic, Pinterest-worthy restaurant that I will definitely visit again. The food came fast, the vibes were so on, and overall it was just a perfect experience.

author: Sara Volpatti Knutson
review_text: We had the most amazing dinner at The Butcher’s Daughter last night! 🍷 Their wine flights were such a fun and delicious way to try a variety of pours—each one was perfectly paired and absolutely delightful. The food was just as incredible—every bite felt so fresh and flavorful. The pasta was rich and comforting, the pizza was perfectly crisp and loaded with flavor, but the star of the night for me was the gnocchi. Hands down the best I’ve had—it just melted in my mouth! The ambiance was warm and welcoming, the service was spot on, and everything about the experience made it such a memorable evening. Already counting down the days until our next visit!

author: Your Honest Neighbor
review_text: I tried a white pizza and a lavender latte. Both were delicious. You can really taste that everything is made fresh and that the cooks enjoy being creative. I’d definitely come back and would recommend this spot. Service was super friendly and attentive. Atmosphere is relaxed.

author: Guillaume Bourcy
review_text: As a vegetarian this is a landmark place for me. Imagine this is where plants and veggies come to party to create the perfect dishes. Even the smoothies look ready for a magazine cover. It’s that perfect mix of “I’m being healthy” and “I might still order fries.” The space is pure Venice — sun-drenched, leafy, and filled with people who look like they just came from yoga or a photoshoot (or both). Food’s fresh, colorful, and guilt-optional. The avocado toast is practically a local landmark, and the juices taste like they were mixed by someone with a PhD in vibes. We also love their Pad Thai as well as the Surfer burrito, available all day. Pro tip: if you have the option, sit outside — it’s the best people-watching spot on Abbot Kinney, and the sunshine somehow makes your latte taste 20% better (scientifically unproven, spiritually accurate)

author: Mayank Dayal
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Food and service here are excellent. The red onion tart was absolutely amazing—full of flavor and beautifully presented. The spicy watermelon margaritas were another standout—refreshing with just the right kick, and the bartender is top notch. What’s also great is their bakery: after 8 PM, all remaining baked goods are just $1! The coffee cake and muffins are fluffy, fresh, and really tasty. I’ve also vouch wonderful things about their pizzas—crispy, light, and loaded with fresh toppings. Overall, this place is a real gem in Venice for a laid-back vibe, delicious food, and great drinks. Highly recommended!

author: Sophia Liu
review_text: This is a very nice vegetarian restauraunt. They offer a variety of options which is nice, but as someone who isn’t vegetarian, the flavors were a little bit weak/off to me. The Greek Style Eggs were pretty good, but the burnt flavor from the charred sourdough was a bit overpowering. I liked the addition of avocado on the side, but I think more feta would’ve enhanced taste. My family also commented that the Surfers’ Burrito and Impossible Burger both tasted okay, but that they were both a little flavorless. The Pure Passion juice was delicious and refreshing though, especially if you like sourness! Other than that, service was good, and the atmosphere was probably the highlight of this restaurant. Really nice to sit in the outside area, much quieter than inside. Overall, I think this is a good option for vegetarians but if you aren’t used to vegetarian meals, it may not suit your taste. I will mention, we didn’t get to try the salad or pizza but both looked very yummy too.

author: André
review_text: Great spot with a rustic warm interior serving some good coffee options, juices and good for a brunch with a variety of seating indoor and outdoor the service is friendly and attentive no waiting time and dishes are served fast.

author: Soraya Teffaha
review_text: Couldn’t resist stopping by for a bite. Cozy atmosphere, delicious food, and great drinks. Even though I’m not vegan or vegetarian, I was pleasantly surprised by how delicious everything was. A place worth returning to!

author: Shruti Rajiv
review_text: We came in during lunch hour but they have long brunch hours until 4pm and later dinner with different menus. We had the Mushroom quinoa burger and Mushroom Truffle pizza. The burger was the most delicious vegetarian burger I have ever had. Completely recommend it!!

author: Justin Ouellette
review_text: The Butcher’s Daughter – Stylish, Satisfying, and Full of Flavor The Butcher’s Daughter on Abbot Kinney delivers on every front—delicious food, warm service, and a beautifully curated atmosphere. The space has a cool, airy vibe that feels equal parts trendy and welcoming, perfect for a relaxed breakfast or brunch. I ordered the gluten-free vegan waffles with maple syrup and added a side of bacon—the combination was absolutely perfect. The waffles were crisp on the outside, soft on the inside, and full of flavor. The bacon added that savory contrast I was desiring. The staff were friendly, attentive, and created a genuinely pleasant dining experience. Whether you’re plant-based, gluten-free, or just looking for a great bite in Venice, The Butcher’s Daughter is a must-visit spot with great vibes and even better food.

author: sophie jacqueline
review_text: The vibes here are unmatched ☀️☀️ super beautiful and beachy space. The food was incredible - we got the ‘best egg sandwhich’ but veganized with tofu scramble & impossible sausage and it changed my life. We also got the butcher’s breakfast veganized & oyster mushroom calamari. The tofu scramble is soo flavourful & delicious! Also had really fun drinks like mimosa flights. Perfect sunny brunch spot. 5 stars!

author: Michal Carmel
review_text: Great place for drinks & small/big plates :) The place is vegetarian but it’s a non issue as everything’s so good so you can enjoy a whole meal without paying attention to it. The drinks are VERY good - especially on happy hour (afternoon of discounts on specific wine glasses, beers and cocktails) + they have daily offers (Wednesday afternoon all wine bottles are half price). A MUST - appetizers of broccolini and cauliflower alongside with cold sangria & a twist of espresso martini

author: Britt F
review_text: Very great vegan food, had the avocado ceviche and red beet pepperoni pizza. Place is a bit too loud for me because of the music. But would def come again because of the food!

author: hardika dave
review_text: We had a fantastic experience at The Butcher’s Daughter! We ordered a waffle, a burger, and a coffee, and everything was absolutely delicious. The restaurant offers a great selection of vegetarian and vegan options, making it a perfect spot for plant-based dining. The ambiance was warm and inviting, with a beautiful garden-like vibe that made it feel incredibly cozy. The service was excellent, making the entire visit even more enjoyable. Highly recommend!

author: Abhijit Chaterji
review_text: Anyone seeking a vibrant vegan-friendly dining experience in Los Angeles, The Butcher’s Daughter stands out for its creative plant-forward cuisine and chic ambiance Great experience

author: Christina W.
review_text: Really love having access to a vegetarian spot. The food was great, especially the mushroom calamari and Pad Thai. It’s not vegan but they’ll ask if you’re ok with eggs, etc. Very friendly wait staff and super helpful. We did have a bit of an issue regarding our seating but happy with everything else.

author: Vedangi Patel
review_text: I don't remember the server name, but she was very polite and well behaved. We ordered classic butcher's burger and the best egg sandwich. Sandwich was little in blend taste but burger was the highlight. Also we ordered cold pressed juices - red and passion . Which were truly amazing. The place's vibe was so so good. Love this place.

author: Tyra Montour
review_text: So I have all great things to say about this place! For my first time in Venice Beach it was a great experience. We went for my friends 30th birthday brunch and unbeknownst to us we didn’t know it was a vegetarian restaurant because she thrives off aesthetics but it was a 10 out of 10 on that end and for dining! We had some starters which were the biscuits and mushroom calamari and there were no pictures because we devoured them. The breakfast burritos were delicious and everything pictured matched my sentiments! Other friends ordered pizzas which are not pictured but they enjoyed them as well. I asked for hot sauce which I believe was made in house and it was more on the vinegar end but it’s all preference. The potatoes were well seasoned but to my taste they could’ve been a little more crispy but that didn’t take away from our experience at all. I provided a picture of where we were seated because it was beautiful and perfect for the birthday girl

author: Lauren Pagan
review_text: The food was pretty good, service a bit slow but beautiful outdoor seating to enjoy the LA sunshine. I would say the gluten free toast is decent but hard to cut. The most unfortunate thing was I got food poisoning from either the avocado toast or green juice. I’ve never been so sick. I hadn’t eaten anything else that day but by 5pm I was very ill.

author: Michael Daniels
review_text: Burger was solid, worth getting again. Pad Thai worked well with tofu (replaced instead of egg). Gnocchi and affogato both were good picks. Portion sizes were more European (not oversized, not tiny). Only miss was the hummus, not worth the price, would skip next time

author: L
review_text: Very fresh and great balance. Bamboo rice was good, ponzu was good and not too much source like other poke. It would be better to order online and pick up.

author: Linda McLoon
review_text: For a small take out poke place, this was great. The fish was fresh, and all the ingredients in our poke bowls were well thought out. We had the mango albacore poke bowl and the shitake chili tofu bowl. Lots of people came and picked up takeout. They do have two small tables in the front on the sidewalk. I would definitely get their poke bowls again. Not much atmosphere needless to say.

author: Helen Abera-Taggay
review_text: Goodness! I have given this place chance after chance and they disappoint. The portions here are a joke and you give four slivers of cucumber with a sprinkle of tuna. My goodness, at this point, just rob at in front of our eyes so we can see it coming at least. DO NOT ORDER FROM THIS LOCATION!

author: Talia Yohai
review_text: Very good poke and even better thanks to the student discount!

author: Euthymios Logothetis
review_text: Great food, good staff but badly understaffed most of the time. Orders taking fully a half hour after scheduled pickup times, god forbid you walk in. It’s a shame that it makes it unreliable when all the fundamentals are so good. Just trying to squeeze out an extra dollar.

author: Riley Cohen
review_text: I come here almost every day after work so I think I should leave a review at this point. Super nice staff and great poke :) they’re super sweet. I get orders in this location since it’s pretty fast service and i always get time to sit down and eat during my 30 minute lunch breaks.

author: - Romanoz -
review_text: Good service, friendly staff, very tasty natural lemonade! Very clean inside🤗

author: Joe Kleyner
review_text: I placed a pickup order at Sweetfin and was told it would be ready in 10 minutes — it ended up taking over 30. On top of that, while I was waiting, I noticed flies hovering over the food behind the counter, which was really off-putting. The food itself was decent, but between the long wait and hygiene concerns, I’m not in a rush to go back.

author: Dan Barker
review_text: horrible portions for the price I was paying I would have at expected then to be at least full. The tiniest little bowl with 3 pieces of tuna. Looked like they just threw it in there as quickly as possible: What a rip off!! 15 bucks a bowl for this??!! Never ordering from them again and I’m pissed I didn’t look at the reviews before I ordered.

author: Melanie Empting
review_text: Used to love this spot, but the poke quality just isn’t there anymore — not worth the price. Staff is friendly!

author: Joy Ni
review_text: Rice is undercooked. Can’t pick them up. Service people has food in mouth to talk to me …

author: Ira Simmons
review_text: I tried a new bowl (Sad Papi) It was delicious. (Albacore and forbidden rice) Try it. You’ll love it!

author: Constanza Blondet
review_text: I love Sweetfin Poke!!! I’m a fan! My go-to is the Signature Spicy Tuna Bowl with bamboo rice, extra salmon, and so many goodies I get to pick, to make my bowl exquisite, fun, and sensational! Everyone who works at my local Sweetfin in Venice, is a star! Super kind each and every time I go in person to enjoy Abbott Kinney. Grateful for Sweetfin Poke! 🙏🩵🍣🥗

author: Stella Han
review_text: If you are craving poke, this is a really great spot. They have premade menus for bowls or if you want to customize your own you can do so I usually get the large bowl and it is pretty filling. They have free water. They have outside seating and it’s pretty quick to receive your food. You will sometimes be able to find street parking depends on what time of day it is, but if you need time to kill time, there are plenty of shops around and there’s also a salt and straw if you want ice cream 🍦

author: Brandon Martinson
review_text: I ordered lunch online through the app for delivery. Everything was easy, worked perfectly and my lunch arrived on time. Everything was as I ordered and fresh. Highly recommend the spicy tuna poke bowl.

author: Andreas Lips
review_text: I love the location and vibe, but the food is not worth the price. I had the Yuzu Salmon bowl with Bamboo rice. Sounded yummy but was pretty tasteless…could not taste any Yuzu sauce and normal Sushi rice would be so much better. Unfortunately that is not available. Quite expensive, too. I ordered the large bowl which was not really large and had more of said bamboo rice than anything else. And cost me $20 (in tax and tip). All a matter of taste in the end, it’s a different spin on the classic sushi bowls. Service and vibe were good.

author: Jakub Szrodt
review_text: Cozy and welcoming, the spicy tuna burrito is AMAZING, must try!

author: Karen Berrien
review_text: I got the spicy tuna burritos last night for the family. First burrito here usually get the bowls. Fantastic experience, loved every bite and my family all felt exactly the same. Keep them coming and great new idea burritos. Thank you Tom for your great service. 5 star evening. Thanks karen

author: Cameo Litz
review_text: The quality of food is excellent. The service is phenomenal. The app is easy to use to order online and pick up. It’s my favorite place for poke.

author: Marti Deacon
review_text: Food was great. Spicy mayo def has a kick. Only problem is that when you order online, once you hit send, there is no way to contact the establishment if there is an issue, etc.

author: Emily G
review_text: Let’s just start with the white truffle pasta, out of this world divine, and yet so simply prepared and perfect in every way, worth the $100, for us yes! We much prefer quality over quantity. We had two other pasta dishes, all extremely good. The market salad was light, simple, healthy and delicious, for us the way prefer a salad. The Somm help us choose a perfect bottle of wine to celebrate our anniversary. The cannoli and the gelato were also worth the calories. If I were a local, this would be my neighborhood spot! We loved sitting next to the pasta making room.

author: corina vozniak
review_text: For Venice this was 5* for me. Attentive staff, good cocktail/wine list, and most marvelous sausage/rabe orecchiette pasta. Loved the meatballs, okay pizza (mostly because all LA pizzas taste the same, soggy in the middle, yeasty fluffy crust and whatever else on the middle), but the pasta...it was a little chewy, a little doughy (all in the best way possible), perfectly saucy, spiced to perfection. The Nebbiolo they source washes down splendidly after all the protein/carb intake. Servers are attentive, knowledgeable, non-intrusive but always around and quick.

author: Richard Wehmeyer
review_text: Came here for a birthday dinner. We had great service and got all questions answered professionally, especially one person has an allergy. All the food was delicious so at the end there was nothing left on the plate :D

author: Angelique Milillo
review_text: Wow! Amazing service from Kelly and a dining experience that was nothing short of perfect. Every dish, from the appetizers to the dessert, was beautifully presented and absolutely delicious. Authentic Italian flavors, fresh ingredients, and handmade pasta that melts in your mouth—what more could you ask for? A true culinary delight! thank you!

author: Gray Stone
review_text: Fantastic meal at Felix! You really can’t go wrong with an Evan Funke restaurant. The pasta was perfectly made, and the flavors were spot on. That said, I do wish the menu felt a little more distinct from his other restaurants. It’s definitely in line with his signature style, so if you’ve been to his other spots, you’ll find a lot of overlap. The quality and service are definitely there—the staff was knowledgeable, friendly, and attentive without being overbearing. The atmosphere is cozy but lively, with a great energy for date night or a special dinner with friends. Overall, Felix is absolutely worth a visit.

author: Chris Tang
review_text: Food here is pricey but the quality reflects. The true stars of the place are the pasta dishes. We ordered the peach with Burrata cheese and Polpette Della Maestra Alessandra (prosciutto meatball) as appetizers. Both were good but didn’t particularly stand out. The prosciutto meatballs was the better of the two dishes in my opinion. We tried the Margherita pizza and it was very good. The pizza dough had a good chewy texture. For the pasta dishes we got the Trofie (pesto sauce), Rigatoni All’Amatriciana and Orecchiette. All three were outstanding and cooked Al Dente. They were all delicious and had nice firm chewy feel in the mouth. Sauces were solid also. My wife liked the Trofie the best. My daughter voted for the Rigatoni, and I personally rate the Orechiette the best (on the slim margin the sauce has a spicy kick to it). It’s a good sign that there were no clear winners here - gives a good indication they were all good. We also ordered the grilled Branzino - preparation was great (they had debone most of the fish bone), the taste was good but didn’t blow us away (albeit we were all really full by that time and only took few bites of the fish - maybe if we had less food before we would have rate it higher. Service attentive and efficient and decor was good also. Overall the food were very good with special mention to the pasta. We plan to return

author: 밥버걸
review_text: I had one of the worst dining experiences at Felix Trattoria. Our server, a white blonde woman, seemed friendly on the surface—but what happened with the food was unacceptable. First, we ordered the walnut salad. It arrived with absolutely no walnuts. Strangely enough, the table right next to us got the exact same salad at the same time, and theirs was full of walnuts. When I pointed this out, the server apologized and just brought walnuts on the side. At first, I thought it was just a mistake or bad luck. Then the shrimp (gamberoni) came out—salty but still decent. The real nightmare started after that. We waited 20–30 minutes for our pizza while the table next to us got theirs much faster. We brushed it off, but after finishing the pizza, we ended up waiting another 40 minutes for our pasta. By then, we were furious. When the pasta finally arrived, it was inedible. It was so salty it actually tasted bitter. It was the kind of salt overload that makes you feel like even in death, your body still wouldn’t decompose. Everyone at the table took one bite and gave up. The pasta texture itself was fine, but serving food like that is disgraceful. On the outside, the staff put on a smile, but if you’re going to play games with the food, that’s something this restaurant should be ashamed of. Especially since this place was recommended by someone we trust, and they specifically said it wasn’t salty. That makes me believe this wasn’t an accident—it felt deliberate. And as if that wasn’t enough, when we asked for the check, they brought us the wrong bill. We had ordered four dishes and a glass of wine, but the check showed $440—obviously not ours. Imagine if we hadn’t noticed. So here’s my advice: if you ever dine here, always double-check your bill unless you want to get ripped off. So thanks for giving us the worst dining experience possible. But here’s a tip: don’t ever do this again. Tourists aren’t stupid. And if this was rooted in discrimination, that only shows your true lack of class.

author: Papa
review_text: Joined friends for dinner, it was our first time and the meal and service was amazing. We sat in the patio area, which was nice it being a warm night. The food came out delicious and the service was on point. Perfect place for date night.

author: Peter Farejowicz
review_text: Felix Trattoria on Abbot Kinney delivered a fantastic dining experience. The atmosphere was sophisticated yet warm, making it perfect for a night out with friends or a special occasion. We ordered everything family style, and every dish was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully prepared. The pastas, in particular, were standout. One note: I wouldn’t recommend the white sauce pizzas—those fell a little flat—so I’d suggest sticking with the traditional ones. Service was attentive without being overbearing, and the whole evening felt well-paced and enjoyable.

author: Kyle VonDeBur
review_text: Traveled to Italy last year, and this is still up there with the best pasta I have ever eaten! The bolognese and amatriciana were both phenomenal, and the prawns were also great! And the kids enjoyed the Margherita pizza too!

author: Ruth Alba
review_text: Felix Trattoria does not miss. The burrata with persimmons was unreal, fresh, creamy, and the persimmons made it feel special. And the pizza? I’m not even a pizza person, but I was obsessed. Spicy pepperoni with the perfect heat. 10/10 dinner.

author: NL. C.E.
review_text: Amazing experience! Had wanted to go here since I saw Funke’s Amazon docu in 2020! Well it was worth the wait. Fast (we were dining during a long layover to AUS), friendly service and amaze balls food. We were able to eat apps, mains and dessert all in an hr. Thanks to our server (and kitchen staff) for taking into account our short time to dine! Perfect, perfect all around.

author: Hamilton
review_text: Great pizza and pasta, not a fan of the pork chop with apricot jam, too dry. Be aware, the pasta is quite “al dente”. Obviously over-priced for what is basically a good pasta ($26 to $50 pastas)

author: Brian Young
review_text: Our third time coming and it never disappoints! Every part of the dining experience is top notch -- location, service, food. Servers are attentive without being disruptive, pacing is perfect, questions always answered with deep knowledge of the menu. Every dish we've had has been an A+: roman bread (so good!), every pasta, deserts. Wine selection is really good with Italian options that complement the meal. Lots of drink options with a full bar. The view of the pasta making station is such a cool touch to see all the handmade pasta. Secondi dishes also so good, we've had the pork and beef. Just everything you would want from an upscale Italian meal that tastes like Italy. We haven't had the pizza yet, but it's coming one of these days. Finish off with a Limoncello or Sambuca, just like you're in Tuscany. A+

author: Daniel John
review_text: Disappointing. First off, you can’t argue that the pasta itself is god-level. Perfect texture and shape. But the sauces on the pasta were terrible. Extremely oily and heavy, completely overwhelming the beautiful pasta. We couldn’t even finish the Busiate, and quite honestly it looked awful as well. The tagliatelle ragu was so oily after one small portion of it my plate was covered in residual oil, see the photo. The green salad was nice as were the prawns. We didn’t think the pizza was remarkable, super soggy in the middle. We skipped dessert. Wine was egregiously overpriced and small pours. I guess we missed out on this place’s heyday because there is much more refined Italian going on all over the city right now, especially at this price point.

author: P T
review_text: Food was incredible. Had the prawns, in-house focaccia, squash blossoms with herbed ricotta, and the pappardelle w/ragù toscano, fennel pollen & parmigiano reggiano. Nothing fell flat, everything was perfectly seasoned and cooked. I will definitely come here again when I'm back in LA for work. Server's were extremely helpful and kind.

author: Jessica Rush
review_text: We had a great time in Beverly Hills, and the Mexican food was an added bonus. Our server was excellent, and the food was good. However, as someone who hasn't had Mexican food in LA before, I wouldn't have too high of an expectation, It was good but could have been better. The atmosphere was lively, which matched the fun vibe of the town. The restaurant did a good job keeping the energy up. Although not cheap, the prices were reasonable considering the location.

author: taylor banasiak
review_text: The food at Felix was good but not unforgettable. The arancini were crisp and cheesy, the rigatoni carbonara was rich and well balanced, and the gnocchi in tomato sauce had that classic comforting flavor. You can tell the pasta is handmade with care, and the ingredients are fresh. That said, the overall experience left something to be desired. The service felt too casual, almost indifferent. For a restaurant of this caliber, you expect warm, attentive hospitality especially given the price point and reputation. Instead, it felt like the servers were just going through the motions. If you’re choosing between Felix and Funke (both from the same chef), skip Felix and head to Funke. You’ll get just as good (if not better) food, and the service and atmosphere are far more polished and welcoming. That makes all the difference.

author: Du Rainie
review_text: Agreed—an incredibly overpriced wine list. The food is okay, but one pasta dish was very salty, and the inside was still hard and undercooked. We arrived after 8 PM, and by 9 PM, the patio was empty. Staff started checking on us every 10 minutes while we were still finishing our last two dishes which were served very late (including the salty undercooked pasta). For over $100 per person, there are better options in the area.

author: Giuseppe Digiamma
review_text: Felix is one of the best places I've been in the last few months. Food is amazing, staff extra caring and accommodating. Never felt so much welcomed in a place being there for the first time! From the greetings to the service and the attention received during the meal all was outstanding!!! I'll definitely go back and try more of their dishes!!! AMAZING!!

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Michael Paul
review_text: I found the food to have a vast variety of choices, and absolutely fabulous. Most of the prices are reasonable. However I find the service itself to be poor and lacking as your suppose to tip a non waiter/waitress server that does not serve nor collect. No Bueno! Further more if your going to work with customers in the United States, speaking and understanding english clearly and fluidly is highly recommended if you like repeat business and recommendations. I am going to change to a five star, as my boyfriend and I went back for a second chance and it was better, as tips were earned this time by interacting at our seat with service to receive our food! Thank you! I don't mind putting my dishes away on the way out, it should be marked better to do so. I love the make your own bowl.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Casey Kopp
review_text: The people working here are so friendly!! Coconut cold brew is a must get. Great place to work or hang for a bit because of their nice patio seating area!! Inside has some seating as well with a couple outlets. Breakfast sandwich was 10/10 too!!! Coming back next chance I get 😍

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Emil Cohen
review_text: The Hive coffee shop at AMLI Marina Del Rey may look like a nice café, but behind the scenes, their operations create a serious nuisance for the residents who live here. Every single night at around 1:30 AM, delivery trucks arrive for The Hive — seven nights a week. These are large trucks with lift gates, engines running, loud reversing alarms, and flashing lights that wake people up in the middle of the night. The deliveries last 30–60 minutes, and the noise carries directly into apartments above. What makes this worse is that The Hive doesn’t even open until 7:00 AM. There is no valid reason why deliveries must happen at 1:30 AM when they could easily occur after opening or before closing. Instead, the business chooses a schedule that disrupts hundreds of residents’ sleep for their convenience. A café should be part of the community, not a source of nightly disturbance. Until The Hive changes its delivery practices and respects the residents who live above them, I cannot recommend supporting this business. If they fix this, I will update my review.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Pao M
review_text: Bad service in the afternoon..not sure if the morning staff is better. I updated my rating due to another bad experience, purchasing food at 6:30 pm, and not being allowed to eat inside because they were closing at 7. We were not told our food was going to be to-go only, we, and two other couples, were literally kicked out. ....I’ve been here many times and the food is usually very good. Service is generally OK too. However, I want to share a recent issue. I placed a to-go order two days ago for two chicken pesto bowls, and both were missing the chicken. Since it was takeout, I didn’t realize until I got home—and by then, the store was closed. I called the next day and was told I could come back to pick up the chicken, which didn’t make much sense and honestly took me by surprise. I let them know I wouldn’t be returning just for that, but wanted to make them aware so they can look into it and improve. I was disappointed with how it was handled. If interested in looking into it, the order was to go at around 6:50 PM on 07/02/2025 (I added a video of the bowl)

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Alex Ford
review_text: I met a friend here for breakfast. It’s a cute little spot! The menu has hot breakfasts, salads, açaí bowls, and smoothies. I had the breakfast bowl which isn’t marked as gluten free but is indeed gluten free. It was great!! Next time I’d ask for my eggs scrambled just because it’s hard to sop up all that yolk-y goodness without bread. But overall, very happy with my breakfast. I also got the Jasmine green tea and they gave me a FAT wad of tea which is awesome.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Heather Martin
review_text: We moved to the neighborhood recently and have gone to The Hive a couple of times now and definitely plan on making this a weekly treat. So far we have had: hot PSL, iced PSL, Green Hornet Smoothie, the Açaí berry champ smoothie, and the breakfast sandwich with bacon. Everything we’ve tried has been yummy. Cute and quiet little coffee shop in MDR. Pricing can vary depending on if you just get drinks or if you get drinks and food. For 2 beverages and 1 breakfast sandwich we spent about $45

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: NJ H
review_text: I love this place. They have the best fresh catch salad. I get it like once a week. I’m obsessed. Staff is nice. Food is clean. Try it out.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Colleen Grant (Wanderfrequently)
review_text: Just picked up my order that was ordered online. I asked for an 8AM pick up. I live in the area and this place is the only place to get decent healthy food. However, their customer service lacks. My latte was starting to freeze. I nicely told the front counter person that I thought the refrigerator was programmed too cold and that my drink is starting to freeze. She replied that it was sitting there for a while. I am 5 minutes late. Drinks don't freeze in the refrigerator for 5 minutes. Freezer - yes. Frig - no. She dismissed me. No offer to make it over again. Have you tried a frozen latte? I assume that if the refrigerator is operating correctly, she probably made my order at 7:30 when I ordered it and it sat there for 35 minutes. Either way, their staff are not willing to take ownership of their errors. If you go and order in person, things are typically fine - still have staff attitude. But if you order online, you have a 50/50 chance things are good.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Cassandra Bell
review_text: My favorite health food spot on the Westside! I’m actually attached to the Blue Crush smoothie…. Service is always warm, wide selection of health conscious options, vibe is lovely with books and games on the shelves. I make sure to come here whenever I’m in the area <3

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Raina M.
review_text: I got the iced strawberry matcha and the smoked salmon toast. I stood at the register quite a while before anyone acknowledged me. Food and drinks were good though. Almost all the customers there who stopped for a coffee had 1-2 dogs with them, which i loved! Plenty of outdoor seating.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Giancarlo Manco
review_text: We had a fantastic breakfast at The Hive. I went for the salmon toast with poached eggs, while my girlfriend chose the avocado toast. Both dishes were really well done—fresh ingredients and great balance of flavors. We also ordered two cappuccinos, one with almond milk, and finished with a gluten-free chocolate donut. The cappuccinos were spot on, and the donut was a perfect sweet treat to end the meal. Everything tasted fresh, and the ingredients were well-balanced and flavorful. The portions were satisfying without being too heavy, and the overall quality really stood out. If you’re looking for a spot with great food and attention to detail, The Hive is definitely worth a visit.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Zachary Weisenthal
review_text: I would give The Hive 6 stars if I could. It’s such a cute, clean spot right on the water. The entire menu is delicious and has truly nourishing options with healthy ingredients. The portions are good sizes. This is my teams’ go-to healthy spot for breakfast, lunch, and dinner whenever we are in the area! Staff is friendly!

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Lobna Akl
review_text: Their bowls are delicious, I’d have breakfast there everyday if I could!

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Melissa Jeffries
review_text: The Hive is THE spot in Manhattan Beach! Organic coffee? Fire 🔥 Build-your-own bowls? Straight-up fuel for the soul. They’ve got so many macronutrient-packed options that even my 🦩 flamingo spirit animal stays balanced—one leg up, vibing with the ocean views. The staff? A1 👌🏽 Friendly, welcoming, and they make you feel like a regular even if it’s your first time. Whether you’re pulling up for a post-surf espresso or a power bowl to keep you thriving, The Hive gets it right every time. 🍯 Hive, let’s heal 💛 Stay healthy, stay happy, and keep those good vibes buzzing! 🦩☕🔥 For more organic coffee reviews and music follow me IG: @TheBaristaBae

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Christopher Tann
review_text: Absolutely incredible eating experience. I had a warm bowl and every individual ingredient was fresh and prepared so deliciously. One of my favorite meals that I didn’t cook myself. And the people here are super cool; Angel is super kind and answered all my questions and help me with all my modifiers!

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Sasha de Witt
review_text: PHENOMENAL food. The make your own bowls were incredible as well as the protein shake. Will definitely be back!

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Taka H
review_text: Small grab and good spot Orangetheory fitness and semi close to Marriott A decent amount of outdoor seating and friendly service. They actually brought the food out and consistently checked in Donnie’s breakfast burrito was Phil. I love how it’s loaded with tons of mushrooms and well-balanced. The OG breakfast burrito was also amazing if you like your baking crispy or your potatoes crispy, I will let them know Avocado toast looks like a popular item since I saw a lot of people get it along with her açaí bowls Had the blue crush smoothie which is really good the blue spirulina, blueberries, and coconut whip cream definitely blended well Love this spot and nothing but positive vibes definitely will be coming back

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Anthony Montijo
review_text: Came in today as a dad on a mission, my daughter was working hard on her homework and really needed a coffee break. I wasn’t sure what to get her, so I asked the team for help. They were so kind and helped me pick out the perfect drink. She absolutely loved it! Thank you for the friendly service and for making her study session a little sweeter.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Nancy Garvin
review_text: The Hive is my go to spot in Marina del Rey! Delicious, health, fresh, + Inspired 🍒🍓🫐🥗🌯

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Sara Lee
review_text: Such a great vibe and food! Had the chicken pesto bowl and green hornet smoothie. Both were delicious

author: Leese Sheesh
review_text: I had one of my top 3 worst experiences as a customer at this location, and I do not saythag lightly. As soon as I walked in, I urgently needed to use the restroom, so I wanted to do that first, has people in front of me were still ordering anyways. The employees would literally not allow me to place my order after using the restroom; they refused to give me the code until I waited for my turn and then chose and paid for my order. I was already extremely unimpressed at how they were interacting with me, specifically as a customer. You would think it would end there, wouldn't you? WRONG. As I am in the process of using the songle person restroom, I had to deal with multiple knocks on the bathroom door. Finally I pick my head out, and told him I needed to still wash my hands, Ingrid rudely informed me that I had a strict 5 minute time limit for doing all my business in the bathroom!!! On top of being grossly unprofessional, I was so uncomfortable and perturbed are there multiple interruptions during this whole ordeal. The other employees then stated it was because of other customers need to use the restroom, but I sat in the restaurant for another 10 minutes after I got out and not a single person went in after me. Dishinesty can be added to the list of tbings I was forced to endure as a PAYING customer. Just overall gross, cheap, and unsophisticated behavior from all of the female workers behind the counter. If I go to rate this zero out of 5 stars, I would gladly do so, and it would be whole accurate. Honestly, just overall shame play treated me, from their tone to their explanations to their complete lack of sympathy and social/business etiquette. Do better, because honestly you couldn't do much worse. 👎👎👎

author: Lone wolf
review_text: I went to this place because I was in a hurry to get something to eat fast but I ended up paying for a simple sandwich without any vegetables just meat and cheese. $19 for a very simple sandwich meal come on. Just go to mcdonalds cheaper and better. Never coming back again

author: Antwon Waters
review_text: The food was absolutely delicious and the service was impeccable. I will definitely be coming back soon.

author: Victor
review_text: Ordered the Togo's #33 Triple Dip (1/2 lb. of hot roast beef, turkey & pastrami with provolone. Includes hot au jus) via Grubhub takeout and was quite impressed. While the place was busy during the weekday lunch rush, it only took about 10-15 min to get my food after placing my order. The half pound of meat is substantial and delicious and the bread and meats combined with the au jus made for a super satisfying meal. The indoor/outdoor seating area isn't the most comfortable but it got the job done. No Wi-Fi but was able to hotspot my laptop to watch a video while enjoying lunch. Decent amount of seating that even during peak times there was enough for everyone to get their own table. Most were taking the food to-go.

author: shannon filson
review_text: Togo's always hits the spot, although they seem pretty crazy expensive these days. A half a salad is $10! I used to get the half salad, half sandwich combo which was perfect amount of food. Now you can get a half salad and a mini sandwich, on the mini sandwich you can only have one meat unless it's the Italian.

author: Greg Mitchell
review_text: Very limited options for vegetarians. The veggie and cheese sandwich I had made for me was only so so.

author: Gabriel DeRose
review_text: The ladies in here were so friendly. I ordered a Mediterranean Chicken Wrap. It was great. Thanks.

author: Bernabe rramirez
review_text: Very good the servicio Rosario help us to get our sandwiches . We recommend

author: Deb B
review_text: Drove in from Berkeley, stop by Togo for lunch but Really had to use the bathroom Very badly. I was told that I had to purchase something first , even in my dyer state, before I could use the bathroom . I have purchased many many sandwich trays for work presentations for many years from this location. Needless to say, I have never felt so humiliated in my life!!! Very very awful feeling especially to have gone to the bathroom on yourself!!!! Of course I couldn’t dine or take out as I was so embarrassed!

author: teeku mulu
review_text: Very delicious sandwiches at this location. Friendly staff as well. 10 stars 🌟 🤩

author: Vikram Makol
review_text: Amazing sandwiches at this location. I drive 10 miles to get sandwiches from here.

author: P Hamilton
review_text: Closest location to work!! So it was busy, but served quickly. Food was great!!

author: Chelle T
review_text: Just had a half salad. It was a basic Iceburg lettuce with carrots but it was refreshing. Next time I may try a sandwich. I placed an order and within 5 minutes I was paying and ate on outside tables. Service is nice and efficient.

author: Althea Elaine Jaug
review_text: I go to this location a lot and usually do mobile order here. The customer service is always nice/helpful and the food is always fresh. This location is also very clean.

author: Norma Correa
review_text: For me it's a great treat I love pastrami sandwich no one has like them. especially when you had good results at another place this my treat for the day .

author: Tiana
review_text: I came in around 6pm. The store was pretty empty. Both workers helped my friends right away. The sandwich was nice. The restaurant clean and the workers friendly. 👌🏽

author: Ed Murphy
review_text: Great sandwiches! Love this location, super clean and very friendly staff!

author: A Holn
review_text: Pittsburgh if you're hungry and you want Togo's I suggest you go to Costco and buy a hot dog. Food was lacking hardly any meat on their sandwiches anymore.

author: Scott Davis
review_text: Great food and service, but I'm pretty sure I lost my wallet hear and it was never found so not all great.

author: Robert Llc
review_text: PLS BE AWARE OF THIS TOGOS, THE WHOLE ORDER WAS WRONG AND MESSED UP, THE CASHIER OVERCHARGED US, $5.00 FOR CHIPS?? WOW, THE STAFF IS VERY RUDE AND ARGUMENTATIVE! NEVER GOING BACK TO THIS LOCATION. DISHONEST AND UNEDUCATED STAFF!!

author: Kevin Drost
review_text: San Pedro Square Market is a really cool indoor market with plenty of outdoor seating as well. It’s made up of three different buildings, all packed with a wide variety of food vendors and bars, so there’s truly something for everyone here. I had to try the Hella Good Burger, and it definitely lived up to the name. The burger was very well seasoned, super juicy, and served on a soft potato bun that was honestly one of the best parts. It was a little messy, but in the best way — overall a really hella good burger. We also shared a margarita pizza from Pizza Bocca Lupo. The pizza was excellent: the sauce had great flavor and the crust was even better, perfectly cooked with a nice texture. Overall, this is a fun spot with tons of food options and a great atmosphere. Definitely a place you can come back to multiple times and try something new each visit. I’ll for sure be back to try more.

author: buyushay
review_text: San Pedro Square Market in San Jose is the kind of place that grabs you by the senses the moment you step in and refuses to let go until you leave pleasantly overfed and a little dazzled. It’s a lively crossroads of aromas, colors, and clinking glasses—a pocket-sized festival happening every day of the week. The variety of food alone feels like someone spun a globe, pointed blindly, and said, “Yeah, let’s serve all of that.” Want tacos? You’ll find tortillas puffing on the griddle and salsas bright enough to wake the sleepiest taste buds. Craving pizza? There’s dough spinning through the air like a mini–Cirque du Soleil performance. Fish and chips? Crispy, golden, and steaming like it came straight out of an English seaside fryer. Indian food? Spices bloom from those stalls—cumin, cardamom, chili—each one whispering promises of comfort and fire. And when you need to cool down, reset, or just enjoy the energy of the place, there’s always a bar waiting with something cold, smooth, or sparkling. Despite the crowds, seating never feels like a battlefield. There’s ample room to settle in—inside, outside, tucked into corners, or right out in the open where you can people-watch to your heart’s content. Families, couples, tech workers, the pre-show crowd, the post-work crowd—they all blend into one big, cheerful urban hum. Everything was excellent. San Pedro Square Market isn’t just a place to eat—it’s a place to graze, wander, sip, and soak in the good life for an hour or an afternoon. A colorful little oasis in downtown San Jose that delivers every time.

author: Aravind R
review_text: Nice place to visit and hang out while at downtown. Variety of food choices, plenty of seating including outdoors, a bit noisy atmosphere but the vibe is awesome. Parking across the street at the garage .

author: Subhankar Das
review_text: San Pedro Market Square is always buzzing with life — a vibrant mix of locals, travelers, music, and color. With tons of great food choices and stalls to explore, it’s easy to lose track of time. The blend of indoor and outdoor spaces makes it the perfect spot to wander, eat, and soak in the atmosphere.

author: Steven Cheng
review_text: It’s a good concept with many choices but the food is mediocre at best! But good beer selection for sure! The fish and chips are okay. The calamari is terrible， chicken burgers also bad, but hamburger is better! They even have a band playing on the Wednesday night, that’s impressive but makes regular conversation almost impossible. Lots seating between indoor and outdoor area. There are gas heaters available at the outside area that you can turn it on at you discretion! One other good thing is they have vary clean restrooms!

author: Paramveer Singh
review_text: Amazing place overall and a must visit when in San Jose. They have a lot of places and small restaurants. I really loved the Indian restaurant and the small tarts and gelato ice cream. Must visit with your friends!

author: Mika'ele Keni'
review_text: Great place to hang out and enjoy a variety of different cuisines, desserts and drinks. Can't forget about the live music as well

author: Teri Nardello
review_text: Can someone please sell a salad?! Or better yet, open a salad restaurant. Everything is deep fried and greasy and a person can only eat so much pasta or pizza. And maybe a breakfast spot with actual egg dishes. If nobody wants to open early, maybe a current vendor could put an all-day breakfast on their menu. Eggs are cheap and people love hash browns and toast. So simple. Out of the more than a dozen restaurants, there is nothing healthy. I've heard out-of-town people comment on it too. They have the courthouse crowd as a captive audience - people should not have to drive to get a decent meal. It saddens me because I eat there multiple times a week because I work at the courthouse, and I am constantly struggling to decide. It's worth the short walk to Nick the Greek's to get a gyro bowl, which at least has lettuce and tomatoes. I wish they would open a MIXT or Sweet Greens or something similar.

author: Randy
review_text: Beer selection is very good, with multiple bars with large selection of taps. Various food options, all quite good. Outside garden area is very well done, with live music. As long as it doesn't get too crowded, this is a great place to have a few and enjoy the ambiance.

author: Daryl Marcelo
review_text: If you're looking for a vibrant and diverse culinary experience in San Jose, look no further than San Pedro Square Market! This bustling marketplace offers a fantastic selection of food vendors, each serving up delicious and unique dishes to satisfy every craving. From savory empanadas and flavorful tacos to gourmet burgers and fresh seafood, there's something for everyone here. The ambiance is equally impressive. The open-air setting creates a lively and welcoming atmosphere, perfect for gathering with friends and family. The colorful decor and live music add to the overall charm. Plus, the easy parking options nearby make it a convenient spot to visit, even on busy weekends.

author: Eleana May
review_text: I'm excited to try the food at San Pedro Square Market in San Jose, CA, which offers a wide variety of options. I recently had a spring roll with fresh vegetables, crispy chicken and shrimp that left me eager for more. My priority is seafood, and I was thrilled by the shellfish combo I tried, which included mussels and clams in a delicious soup. The seafood flavor, combined with herbs and garlic bread, was fantastic! It's a great spot for delicious, affordable food in a pleasant setting with good music and a fun atmosphere.

author: Anthony Contreras
review_text: PROS: * Amazing selection of food from different restaurants. * Live music often playing outside and inside. * Tap beer selection is vast! * Family friendly place. * Plenty of outdoor seating for nice weather. CONS: * Parking can be tough.

author: Amanda Warnars
review_text: Great place to enjoy company with friends and family! Private party in the corner was amazing! The food they provided on the buffet was delicious!!

author: Joseph Saperstein
review_text: A wonderful space for hanging out, socializing, eating, or grabbing a drink right in downtown San Jose. It felt, calm, pleasant, and lively. I also loved feeling the connection to history. We need more places like this in downtown!

author: Jared Byrne
review_text: I was in this area for one night, a (not very busy) Monday in June 2024, as a part of a work trip; and myself and a colleague stumbled on San Pedro Square Market. The market turned into a highlight of my time in this area, as the food (and service) was good, there were lots of food options (I'll have to come back and try some other vendors), the location was clean, and the entertainment (a band) was good as well. I can't speak to the comparative price of the food (I only spent one night in this area), but it seemed reasonable for a California restaurant. As noted, I had a great experience and, because I'd love to come back to the San Pedro Square Market, I would recommend this location to anyone visiting the area.

author: Alex Buchanan
review_text: Checked out San Pedro Square for the first time—definitely got that Hispanic vibe going on! Tons of energy, a bunch of restaurants, parties happening, and people just chillin’ outside with some seriously cool rides parked up.

author: Shruti Sinha
review_text: Visited San Pedro square market on May 5th so got to witness the Cinco de Mayo festivities, live music and such vibrant atmosphere even though it was Monday evening. Lot of food options including Mexican, Indo-Nepalese and others bars for a good time. This square has a lot of history. Got to know that San Jose was the oldest city of CA from an info placard. Reminded me of The Alamo in San Antonio.

author: Carrie Tam
review_text: Super fun location that my roommate and I stumbled upon accidentally! There’s free parking for the first 90min nearby and plenty of outdoor tables where people are willing to talk to new strangers and dance and have fun!
