author: claudia sandoval
review_text: Thank you for making my mother soooo happy on her 76 birthday. The food was delicious and Hilda, our waitress was very kind and helpful with all the needs of our group.

author: Carolyn Bradford
review_text: Took my 18 year old son to eat breakfast where I used to eat breakfast when I was pregnant with him when I worked downtown however the food wasn't as good anymore neither was the atmosphere. However our waitress was very sweet. I probably will not go back

author: abe valdez
review_text: The prices are all different. When you go to their website its a price, when you call for delivery, its a different price, when you walk in and actually sit down, its a different price. I informed a worker that the prices are ALL different and she told me that "Everything has gone up".. please be consistent.

author: Cary Rich
review_text: I was early for a business meeting nearby and had not had breakfast yet. I was told that Cacique was THE place that all of the nearby construction crews dine at. So I tried it. Great, friendly service and wonderful food. I highly recommend it!

author: Aisha Damian
review_text: The location is a bit inconspicuous. Honestly I had higher expectations for the atmosphere as we went for NYE but it was just ok. The music was okay and they had some videos playing on a projector. The food was good but nothing to rave about. I enjoyed the nigiri the most. The himachi jalapeño roll was a disappointment. Drinks were good and decently priced. I really liked the passionfruit drink on their specialty cocktails.

author: Natalie Mendez
review_text: Paperfish Sushi is an absolute gem if you love fresh, beautifully made sushi with amazing flavors. The vibe is modern, cozy, and super aesthetic perfect for a date night or a cute dinner with friends. The presentation is gorgeous, and every dish tastes as good as it looks. The fish is incredibly fresh, the rolls are creative, and the menu has so many unique options that it’s hard to pick a favorite. The cocktails are just as impressive, and everything comes out with great attention to detail. The staff is friendly and attentive without being overwhelming, which makes the whole experience smooth and enjoyable. Overall, Paperfish Sushi is a must-try for sushi lovers. The quality, atmosphere, and flavors make it worth every visit.

author: Y Sun
review_text: Had high expectations for their New Year’s special menu at $120 per person, but unfortunately it wasn’t a pleasant experience. Courses were not paced properly: before we finished one dish, the next arrived, and by the second course we had both the second and main course on the table at the same time. It felt very rushed and overcrowded. When the main course was served, utensils were missing and only arrived after a delay of about 10 minutes so we had our food there and waiting for knives to arrive. Definitely need more training to their staff. The food overall was quite ordinary. The tuna tartare in particular lacked flavor and tasted very bland. There were also no vegetables included in the courses, other than two small garnish leaves, which ended up being the only greens I had.

author: Joanna Vasquez
review_text: My friends suggested this place for a happy hour on a Friday evening. I got there a little earlier than they did and sat at the bar and was handed the menu for the Miami Spice month. It looked good, but I really wanted to try the happy hour menu my friends spoke of. So I had to ask for it. My friend arrived shortly after and we ordered drinks from it. The drinks not only were delicious, but also very appealing to the eye. The bartender was a little inattentive. She was on her phone for a long time, and genuinely I really don’t care, but I clocked it because we were one of the only group sitting there, and there was two of us, and then there was another person sitting by themselves, and we constantly were trying to have to get her attention. However, a second bartender arrived within 15-20 minutes and really turned the night around. We ordered a lot of sushi off the happy hour menu and all of it was amazing. So overall, this is a solid place for sushi and an adequate place for happy hour.

author: Miriah Cruz
review_text: I absolutely love this place! The food is so good. I would personally recommend the black cod bites and the chocolate cake (to die for). The manager Danny is very friendly and does a great job checking on the tables to make sure everyone is happy. We usually have Diego as our server and he is amazing. But even the entire staff as a whole is attentive and happy to help, seems like they work as a team really well together. Would definitely recommend this spot if you enjoy sushi and a good atmosphere!

author: Fair reviews Based on my Experiences
review_text: Update 10/9. Paperfish replied "Paperfish applies a standard service charge that is fully disclosed on our menus and receipts, and it’s distributed among our entire service and support staff to ensure fair and consistent compensation across the team." To this I respond. It is not the Publics responsibility to pay your staff. Compensation-That's your responsibility. And if audited I'm sure more than half of these restaurants would not pass the sniff test. Food was great — but the forced service charge was shady. The food at Paperfish was excellent and the server did a great job. But I left feeling frustrated and misled. A mandatory service charge was added to the bill without any clear explanation or signage. When I asked, the server said it gets split among staff and she only sees a small portion — but if I tipped extra, that part goes to her. Which I felt obligated to do. This feels like a manipulative tactic targeting tourists. I’ve eaten at several restaurants in Miami this week, and this was the only one to quietly add a charge like this. If you’re going to force guests to pay extra, be upfront about it — don’t make your staff explain it awkwardly after the fact. Tips should go to the server providing the service, not get pooled by ownership. Be transparent — no one likes surprise fees on their bill. Legislation should be written to force restaurant owners to pay staff properly and not tack it onto their patrons.

author: Tasheena S
review_text: We stopped by here for happy hour and go enjoy some sushi. Please note the location is pretty interesting. It's before the train station, behind a restaurant..it's as if you're going into a parking lot and it's tucked away. Yeah u know that's a lot but it really gives the feel of hidden gem. The service was great we had a lovely waitress who was very knowledgeable of the menu. It was a Wednesday evening so it wasn't crowded or so busy. The decor and ambiance was really lovely. Now on to the food. We were not blown away by the options on the happy hour menu. We only ordered cocktails and the edamame from the happy hour menu. The cocktail was a big size for the price BUT it tastes more like juice. We decided to order rolls from their regular menu. We had the ACEVICHADO and SALMON FURAI rolls. I can't say we would go back because we are not in that area often. However, we would recommend it to our friends in that area of Miami.

author: Terence Kyaw
review_text: Interesting Peruvian/Japanese restaurant. Interesting menu and excellent service. Some of the menu items are never heard of before. Good Japanese food with Peruvian twist.

author: Renee Salcido
review_text: We sat outside & had Juliana has our server. We loved all of our dishes & the service was great!

author: Michael Jacobs
review_text: Fantastic food in a beautiful room . Highly recommend . In my top 5 for Rock shrimp tempura

author: M Bon
review_text: What a find! We were casually strolling around Brickell and saw the cute entrance to Paperfish. Intrigued by it we decided to have lunch there and my I’m so glad we did. Service is top notch. Food is delicious. Everything we ordered was fantastic. My Bento box was full of flavor and plentiful. The zucchini spiral salad was fenomenal as were the sushi and truffle infused fry rice. Dessert was also decadent to close a fabulous meal. We are coming back with our friends for sure.

author: Camila Isabel
review_text: Ordered the rainbow roll and hot truffle nigiri and it was sooo good! More than anything our server, Ana was so sweet and attentive. She knew the menu like the back of her hand and made sure we had everything we needed. Hope to be back to be served by her.

author: Y
review_text: Probably the most fresh sushi I’ve had in a very very long time!! I had the salmon with avocado and sesame seeds and it was divine!!! My friend had the jalapeño sushi roll; also delicious. Wish I had taken a picture but I ate it so quickly that there was no time haha Also the service was spectacular and the food came out quickly. The restaurant is also very nice and decorated beautifully. 10 out of 10!

author: Logan Jackson
review_text: I would rate it 6/6 stars if I could. Jason, our waiter, was absolutely incredible. This place is an absolute gem in Miami. Low key vibes and impeccable service. Paperfish is, without a doubt, my favorite sushi restaurant in Miami. The food is absolutely incredible - the fish is always fresh and flavorful, and the chefs are incredibly creative with their rolls. I've never had a bad dish here. The service is also top-notch - the staff is always friendly and attentive. The atmosphere is also great - the restaurant is stylish and modern, but it still feels warm and inviting. I highly recommend Paperfish to anyone looking for a great sushi experience in Miami. This place feels like a speakeasy. Hidden right next to the metro rail. Stop reading this and go!

author: Kavya Sebastian
review_text: The omakase at Paperfish was absolutely incredible and well worth the money. It was the perfect amount to split with someone else and still be full! The lychee martini was also divine, one of the best I’ve ever had. Even though we were one of the last customers left at the restaurant, the staff didn’t rush us or kick us out. Incredible food and very professional team!

author: Rafael Sa
review_text: Average japanese food; nothing outstanding in particular Service is ok; fast but not offering a lot of assistance or suggestions. Basic mistakes as forgetting drink orders, and offering shoyu and wasabi. Beware of pricing scheme: the menu prices does not include taxes, 20% service charge and 7% tip charge; so whatever you see in the menu, add 36% Atmosphere feels crowded and lowed; not what you would expect in a traditional Japanese restaurant There are definitely better options to dine in Lincoln street

author: Sofia Elizabeth Schumo Chwe
review_text: Lovely ambience with a cozy and modern vibe. The sushi is fresh and nicely presented. The staff were attentive and polite, making the whole experience enjoyable. A pleasant place to visit in Miami.

author: Margalit M
review_text: I'm happy that I found this spot near my hotel for a lovely sushi dinner. The tuna roll was good, and the nigiri tuna with Truffle and something else was divine! Edemame was too salty--like we are obsessed with salt, and sometimes I think restaurants go a little too heavy, which I don't need when there's lots of soy sauce on the table. Service was excellent and food came out very fast... like maybe too fast because I got my cocktail after the sushi was on the table. But overall, great spot with lots of space for large groups.

author: Sadiel Serrano
review_text: Its the forth time now, and still really good sushi, not that expensive and have a natural ambient and decoration that brings you at least to me peace, nice decoration and service its nice also

author: Nicole Freed
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ First-Class Experience at Paperfish Sushi on Española Way! Allison and Joy truly went above and beyond to deliver first-class service — prompt, friendly, and incredibly attentive from start to finish. The atmosphere on Española Way is such a vibe — lively, colorful, and full of energy — and Paperfish fits right in perfectly. The food was phenomenal — fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. I’m not even usually into sushi, but they offer such a variety of dishes to suit every palate that I was genuinely impressed. Everything tasted so good and was prepared with care. If you’re in Miami Beach, do yourself a favor and stop by Paperfish — and if you’re lucky enough to have Allison and Joy take care of you, you’re in for a treat! 🌸🍣✨

author: Jessica Diett
review_text: I was here back in November 2025. This is a nice and cozy restaurant. Although the vibe is more “romantic couple dinner”, I felt super comfortable going there alone (solo traveler) and my server was so nice! First, I got a rack to hang my purse and every table has a box to put your phone in, so you can have actual conversations with the one you’re with and enjoy the atmosphere. It’s not mandatory, and it felt weird at first given I was alone, but I enjoyed not being on my phone (except taking pictures), enjoying my food & drink, watching other people and taking in the precious view of the bay. Food, drink, and service was fantastic! I’ll definitely be back. Special shoutout to my server Keyla who constantly checked on me made sure everything was good.

author: Marielle J
review_text: Laura was our server and was exceptional! She was precise in taking our orders and refilling our waters. Very attentive and courteous, and she was patient in giving my sister updates for gluten free and dairy free options. The ambience of this place is divine! Colorful, classy and cute! The food was AMAZING! The cornbread is a must — you have to try! The ham croquetas were tasty! Everyone loved their dishes. The grilled salmon salad was delicious and the salmon was moist. I had the wagyu skirt steak wedge salad and it is by far, the BEST wagyu steak I’ve ever had! We also tried the “world’s best chocolate cake” and it was very unique! We LOVED it here and will recommend! Thank you for a lovely experience and a great time!

author: Alexandra On earth
review_text: Eclectic ambiance Waterfront dining! great service great quality food and fair priced!!! my guy and I had a great meal right next to the water for $160. We ordered 4 appetizers (2 for $25 and we each got a free app with our entree), 4 drinks and two entrees. The kale Caesar salad- freshly shaken at the table, potatoes bravas - on point even better than some I’ve had in Spain, perfect golden crust with a side of tangy red sauce. Chihuahua cheese - my guy had the pleasure of eating the whole thing and when he ran out of toast proceeded to eat the rest with a spoon 😆 For our entrees he chose the Kobe beef burger ($30) and I got the Wagyu churrassico ($47) both served with shoestring fries and a free appetizer. The flavor was DECADENT. meat melted in your mouth so tender and juicy not to mention cooked to perfection. This was a really great dining experience and worth every penny (picture of receipt in photos! Jorge was our server and he was excellent!

author: yth _
review_text: I love Andres! Excellent service. He explained the menu items clearly to us and even gave recommendations. He was very attentive to our needs, constantly checking in on us. The food was delicious and priced reasonably (They have free appetisers for each entree). The atmosphere of the restaurant was excellent too. I love the warm lighting. It was very comfortable to the eyes and provide a great candlelight experience :) Would definitely come back again

author: Donna Arnold
review_text: Great start to our cruise vacation, we're in Miami for only 1 night and Crazy About You was our choice for dinner, I think we chose well! Food was very tasty, service wonderful and of course the view was amazing. We got the 2 to Tango shrimp and steak dinner and sangria. An absolutely amazing night dining on the patio. Atmosphere and view is stunning and the food rocks!

author: Elizabeth M
review_text: We had a fantastic dining experience at Crazy About You! The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the food was absolutely delicious; every dish was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. A special shoutout to our waitress, LAURA, who went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed. She was friendly, attentive, and knowledgeable about the menu. Her service truly made our visit even more enjoyable. Highly recommend this place for both the amazing food and top-notch service. Can’t wait to come back!

author: Sofi Koltun
review_text: We had an amazing experience! Our server, Yusnavy, was absolutely incredible — so attentive, kind, and professional. The food was excellent, everything tasted amazing, and the service made the night even better. We will definitely be coming back. We also loved that the place is pet-friendly, which made the experience even more special for us. Highly recommended!

author: Ava
review_text: I loved the cocktails here!🍹and my favorite dish was the baby back ribs. The place feels tight when it starts to get busy, but has great service. If I come back I’ll probably do it for dinner, I think the view and atmosphere are better at night.

author: Chimene H. James
review_text: First time having dinner at Crazy About You. We had an amazing server Andrea, who explained the menu to us and gave his recommendations. The food was rich and well prepared. The service was top notch and Andrea made sure we were okay while we were there. Would definitely visit again next time I’m in Miami! We had the tortellini served with shrimp and the branzino with potatoes. FYI- Photos are done for you at an extra charge.

author: Felton Brown
review_text: I recently had dinner at Crazy About You in Brickell, and this place absolutely lives up to its name — I’m crazy about it! From the moment I walked in, I was taken by the stunning view of Biscayne Bay. Sitting on the terrace with the soft breeze, city lights reflecting off the water, and that vibrant yet peaceful Brickell energy — it felt like Miami magic at its finest. For dinner, I ordered the Zucchini Carbonara, and wow — this dish was on another level. The creamy texture, savory depth, and the way it balanced flavor and freshness was simply perfect. You can taste the chef’s creativity and attention to detail in every bite. And then came dessert — the restaurant’s famous “The Best Chocolate Cake in the World.” That name sounds bold until you try it… and then you get it. Moist, rich, melt-in-your-mouth chocolate perfection. Easily one of the best desserts I’ve had in Miami. The service was top-tier — warm, professional, and attentive without being overbearing. You can tell the staff genuinely care about creating a great experience for every guest. Whether you’re a local looking for a relaxing night out or a visitor wanting to soak in Miami’s waterfront charm, I highly recommend Crazy About You. Between the view, the food, and the vibe, this spot captures everything that makes Brickell such a special place to dine.

author: Robert Knott
review_text: An excellent location for dinner! The staff were friendly and attentive, the food was delicious, and the prices were an absolute deal considering the location and quality of food. I would absolutely recommend coming here for dinner. All the entrees are reasonably priced and include a free appetizer with the order, and there are great happy hour drink deals. They also get very creative with the presentation of the dishes which makes the meal even more fun.

author: Sara
review_text: Yusnavy was PHENOMENAL with providing us superb service. The food was FANTASTIC my burger was good perfectly. The atmosphere is very romantic with the low lighting and candle lights.

author: Durley Carrasco
review_text: This terrace is a hidden gem! With breathtaking views of the city bay skyline, it’s the perfect spot to unwind. The ambiance is cozy and inviting, making it ideal for family gatherings. The service is exceptional, with friendly staff that make you feel right at home. Overall, the combination of great food, stunning views, and warm hospitality makes this terrace a must-visit. Highly recommended!

author: Randa Gozum
review_text: We've been here a few times and always have had wonderful experiences. Our server, Francisco was excellent! Fun vibes by the water, great food, lots of photo ops. Definitely need to check it out!

author: Brittney M
review_text: The inside of this place is definitely aesthetically pleasing and nice to look at. I went here with my family for lunch and the experience was pleasant. Our server was super friendly and attentive. The cornbread and Croquettes were very good. However I got the chicken parm and it was just ok, very Mid. If I am ever in Miami I’d give this place another try, just a different dish. Haha.

author: Aiste Ber
review_text: Absolutely amazing service and food! We had a wonderful experience, and a huge part of it was thanks to our waitress Yusnavy. She was incredibly friendly, attentive, and genuinely caring from the moment we arrived. Her positive energy and warm smile made us feel truly welcome. She went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect, always checking in on us without being intrusive. It’s rare to meet such a lovely and professional waitress who clearly loves what she does. Thank you for making our visit so special — we will definitely remember this experience!

author: XZ Xu
review_text: It’s a hidden gem in Brickell. As a Bostonian, I have been to this place for five years. Our waiter Francisco is very friendly, cute and nice! Love the view, food and everything!

author: Lara
review_text: this place was pretty dang solid! the decor for both inside and outside was very cool, loved the atmosphere. the outside has a direct view of the water and was nicely shaded at night. for our appetizers, i got the asian spring rolls and my boyfriend got some type of cheese dip and both were very good! i always love a spring roll. for our entrees, i got the truffle pasta and my boyfriend got the waygu burger. my bf absolutely loved his burger and my pasta was pretty okay, it was just a bit much with it being all the same flavor. i liked the kale pieces in it, but i wish there was a side to break up the flavor or some type of protein in the pasta itself. i got very full lol. our server was nice, just a bit odd.. a lady took our picture and then later came back trying to sell us over priced glass photo frames?! i thought it was for social media or something but i guess not 😊but yeah, besides that, very solid experience!

author: Ismael Valverde Kardouchi
review_text: This place is awesome for hanging out with friends, especially in the evening. I came for lunch, and the food was delicious. The vibe is super chill, and it's also a great place to have drinks while enjoying some stunning views.

author: Yolanda Alvarez
review_text: Food was great! And our server Nancy was even better! We love to come to this place all the time, definitely recommended 👍

author: May P
review_text: Totally unexpected happy surprise of a Restaurant sharing the lot with a Gas Station. At first glance stepping in it looks like a shop, but then you walk inside it becomes this adorable Restaurant reminiscent to places in the Spanish countryside. The selection of wines was impressive and the foods we had ordered were delicious. No Happy Hour menu but of course provided you have a quiet well mannered dog it was also dog friendly with great service personnel.

author: Nicole M
review_text: We’ve lived in the neighborhood for years and finally decided to check this place out. We are so disappointed we waited so long! The wine, the food, the ambiance is amazing. The bacon wrapped dates were to die for. The only reason I gave is a 4 was because the staff was so off putting trying to turn the table that they were rushing us to leave when we were finishing our bottle of wine, even when all the tables around us had gotten there before us. Other than that, it was amazing. We will definitely be returning.

author: Katy Hernández
review_text: The place is located in a spot I never would’ve imagined — literally at a gas station — but to me, it’s a true hidden gem. You can choose your favorite wine and they’ll open it for you. The paella is delicious, the octopus is very good, and the people who work there are warm and welcoming. I also noticed that the owner is truly attentive to making sure everything runs smoothly. I’ve been there about three times, every time I visit Miami, and I always leave happy. If you’re someone who appreciates complete silence, this isn’t the place, but you can still have a perfectly good conversation and enjoy a delicious meal. If you live in Miami or are visiting, I highly recommend stopping by — it’s an interesting and unique spot!

author: Noa
review_text: A Miami staple! I love this place cause it’s so unpretentious, unlike most places in Miami, the food is always so good here. They are consistent with their delicious food and with great customer service. The atmosphere is also really nice; lively, but not loud enough that you cannot hear each other (great place to catch up with friends or go on a date) I also love that they have a fabulous extensive selection of wines. I always get the octopus here cause they cook it perfectly. Must try!

author: Abhilash M. Prasad
review_text: This place is the perfect example of why you should never judge a book by its cover. I walked in casually, not expecting anything special, and the inside completely surprised me. The vibe was great, the cafe was much better than it looked from outside, and their latte was genuinely amazing. I was extremely satisfied and would definitely recommend this spot.

author: Arem Assuan
review_text: El Carajo is a truly unique and exceptional spot in Miami that seamlessly blends the charm of a top tier wine store with the delights of a bakery and a fantastic Spanish restaurant. From the moment you step in, you're greeted by an impressive selection of wines from around the world . The knowledgeable staff are always on hand to offer recommendations, making it easy to find the perfect bottle, my favorite muga prado enea. But El Carajo isn't just about the wine. Their pastry counter is a delightful temptation. El Carajo is a must visit for anyone seeking a true taste of Spain and a truly unique Miami experience.

author: Joanne Kong
review_text: Ther service: friendly and attentive. Our server did a grest job in putting in our order wo our food came out appropiately knowing that the Paella took 35-40 min. The food: We ordered 4 tapas dished. Cod Croquttes were great. The Tortilla Slice Espanola was delicious. Patatas a la Brava also very good. The Chorizo al Vino, i usually love. But I found that that the chorizo in this tapas dish (in red wine) to be mealy and the casing tough. The alcohol itself in this dish was not burned off enough giving the entire dish a sour taste. Will not order again. The paella was delicious but the pricing is deceiving. The price on their menu is a per person price with 2 people being the minimum. The pricing doesn't make any sense cause you can't order a single serving. So, the cheapest paella dish is priced at $25, but its actually $50, whether u go there by yourself or with five people. Additionally, you can only order 2, 4, 6, etc. The paella comes in servings of 2. Which makes the pricing deceiving. On a side note, the chorizo in the paella is very tasty, and different from the tapas. Although its the same chorizo, the cook is better. Wine: Their selection of wine is resonably priced for a restaurant. There are two prices with each bottle. One for take home and one to drink at the restaurant. Still very reasonably priced and a very nice selction. Overall, it was a very nice experience. Overall, the food was very good. The atmosphere: once you step into the back restaurant area you forget thats its the bck side of a gas station. The wall of wine and murals make it a plesent dining experience. Its noting fancy with wooden tables and metal chairs, but the food is good. What more do you need. We will definately go back.

author: Cristina Da Costa
review_text: Impressive doesn't even begin to describe this hidden gem. I've heard of it so I wanted to try it and from the outside you'd want to turn away but once you go in and go into the restaurant you're transported somewhere else. Amazing wines and sangria and we had 2 different paellas and they were amazing! We'll be back!

author: Hana Karina Arraya
review_text: Nestled in the back of a gas station is a restaurant with an extensive wine selection and your classic Spanish tapas. Honestly, your Spanish friends might not be impressed by the food, but anyone else will be satisfied and entertained by the unique location of this local hidden gem. The bacon wrapped dates and gambas al ajillo are my favorite!

author: Aurora
review_text: Warm inviting atmosphere. Attentive, friendly staff. The food is delectable. We tried the Paella and it was divine. They carry a large selection of quality wine. Will definitely return again.

author: Madison Ramirez
review_text: A little hidden gem. Ordered tapas and wine and everything was delicious. We had croquetas, garbanzos with spinach, tortilla and the dates for tapas and ordered the dulce de leche crepes. Star of the show was the crepes. Wow wow wow. All the tapas were hot and fresh. We walked around after dinner and the selection of wine AND prices - you cannot beat it. I’ll be back to buy some wine and order more tapas.

author: vicki buchwald
review_text: Wonderful service with Paolo and very delicious food! We shared a traditional Seafood Paella and had Pulpo a la Gallega and Boquerones as appetizers. We finished this lovely meal with a shared Crema Catalana. The amazing lunch here was a highlight on our visit to Miami.

author: William Dawson
review_text: We had several starters and everything was delicious. Enjoyed Dates with bacon, stuffed mushrooms, patatas bravas, tortilla and Croquetas de Chorizo.

author: Julio Figueroa
review_text: We tried their expresso and it was very good. Guava pastries were fresh and good. The only negative was the small dinning area. They do have a large wine area but we stopped for the Café.

author: Mike Milner
review_text: Was not expecting this. Attached to a gas station i was thinking like a spanish WaWa. Couldn't have been more wrong. This little gem serves some of the best tapas I've tasted. Octopus and spanish sausage were amazing, as was the exceptional paella. Great service and a notable HUGE wine selection. Highly recommend.

author: Arman Barbuco
review_text: The place has good food. The service is good and they have a lot of good wines you can choose from. We ended up buying a couple of bottles after dinner. Their foods are good. The downside of this place is parking in case the area gets busy. But it is worth a visit and a must-try.

author: Bernhard VDM
review_text: I had an absolutely amazing time here. I felt so at home that I want to learn to speak Spanish😊 I got seated at the counter (I called last minute for reservation and was on my own) which seemed at 1st a bit impersonal, but since I was on my own, this is the best place to be part of the action. Everyone was super attentive and even though I don't speak Spanish, the manager and staff all stuck up a conversation to make me feel welcome. I liked the atmosphere created by El Carajo because it seems it used to be the convenience store at the gas station, but is now a wine shop and Restaurant. In fact, you feel as though you actually dine inside the wine shop (or shopping inside a restaurant 😁) They have a good wine selection that is part of the restaurant and you can just browse for something that takes your fancy. A good variety of tapas. I had the ham croquettes, boquerones, meat starter plate and later the pulpo de gallega. All food was very good and well presented. For wine I had the Vina Ardanza Reserva which was superb. What I liked most was the friendly atmosphere created by everyone. I felt like a regular on my 1st visit, which is a special quality not many restaurants can manage, and I want to thank all the staff for making my evening special.

author: Dana Rodriguez
review_text: I’ve been a customer for about 4 years, and I feel I need to be honest with my review. Since I come here often, I’ve noticed the changes, and honestly, I preferred the atmosphere when the previous manager was in charge. She was young, but her charisma, work ethic, and the way she supported her team were what I admired most about this place: everything was always organized and up to date. In my recent visits, I bought some empanadas that were so unpleasant they couldn’t be eaten — they seemed like they had been sitting there for hours. The same thing happened with the croquettes. Other times, there’s no bread or other basic items, showing a lack of consistency in this bakery. I’ve also had to wait over 30 minutes in line because there was only one person working. When I asked who the manager was, I was told she was at the gas station on the phone. I’m the kind of person who really values a team’s effort because it says a lot about the business, and it’s truly a shame that everything has changed. Nowadays, I feel like I waste my money here because the products are not fresh, and on top of that, I have to wait too long to be served. Really disappointing, especially since a year ago my experience was completely different.

author: Rose Mar
review_text: Food was good but the service wasn’t so great. Waitress took her break and we were left unattended for quite some time. My husband had to find another waitress to take care of us. Not sure if we will be back. Really didn’t meet our expectation.

author: Maria Murljacic
review_text: What a cute spot! The wine is very reasonably priced, and the food is quality. I highly recommend, as the food, wine, ambiance, and service were great. Between 4 people, we split 4-5 tapas and the meat platter.

author: Aft_and_About
review_text: I stopped by this restaurant last night (a Thursday) for a solo happy hour, and I’m so glad I did. Happy hour runs from 4–7 PM, which is perfect for easing into the evening. The atmosphere was perfectly chill with a DJ playing good music, and the marina views made the whole experience even better. I sat at the back bar where Monika and Mario were providing top-tier service. They were friendly, attentive, and had great menu recommendations. I really enjoyed chatting with both of them—they helped make the night feel relaxed and welcoming. For food, I ordered the mahi and wahoo fish dip as an appetizer, which was delicious. My first drink was the Pain Remover made with rum, and wow… that drink was sooo good. I ordered a #2, which comes with two shots, and it was perfectly balanced. During happy hour, there’s also a boat serving oysters, shrimp, and a few other items. I tried the oysters from Chesapeake, VA at $2 each and loved the self-serve condiment setup. I also tried a piña colada, mai tai, and a watermelon mojito. All were great, but the piña colada is an absolute must-try. Overall, I had a fantastic time and will definitely be going back. Highly recommend this spot for solo outings, happy hour, or just a chill evening by the marina! 🌅🍹🦪

author: Ella Spence
review_text: I had the mahi fish tacos and my husband had the grouper platter. We had coconut shrimp and a bowl of she crab soup. Everything we ate was delicious and full of flavor. The service was extremely slow and there was a $13 service charge that came on our ticket for using the dining room. This was a 19% charge that was hidden before we came in and is the only reason that we won't be back.

author: Vic C
review_text: Food was ok. Fish dip was more like canned tuna. Rockefeller oysters were ok, but were just above room temp. I thought they would be nice and toasty from baking. Mahi Mahi was nice and warm and still juicy.

author: Kathryn Johnson
review_text: Great food, service and view! Only complaint was the nearby smokers. The fish tacos were awesome! Park in lot 72 and get your parking validated by the restaurant.

author: Cathy Dang
review_text: Delightful laid-back atmosphere. Definitely a good spot for locals and families to enjoy a breeze by the water or a nice sunset. Portions were relatively generous. Food was nothing special, but it definitely served its purpose. Lots of families and people just coming to have a chill time. Would definitely recommend for a casual get together with friends. Wouldn’t necessarily come here for a special occasion or looking for anything spectacular.

author: Revel Ramjewan
review_text: We recently visited Monty’s in Coconut Grove, and it was a wonderful experience! The food was absolutely delicious, and the drinks were incredible. I especially enjoyed the fish and chips, which were perfectly cooked and full of flavor. The atmosphere relaxing, making it an ideal spot for a family dinner or casual evening out. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great food and a laid-back dining experience in Coconut Grove!

author: Cami Tussie
review_text: Great vibe, casual outdoor atmosphere with music playing by the boats. Lots of delicious seafood at a good price. Fried fish isn’t oily at all. Recommend the grouper. Coconut shrimp good but not amazing, same with seafood salad, probably wouldn’t get again. Great service, don’t forget to get your parking validated in lot 72 across the street!

author: Mariana M
review_text: Very tropical restaurant or sport bar with a DJ playing mostly tropical and Latino music very good by the way. Service was great and food too, delicious. It’s big and very popular, in front of a Marina, we loved it. They validate your parking for 3 hours told us.

author: Robert Rodriguez
review_text: Went specifically for the stone crabs. Ordered Lg platter. Received 4 medium claws for $64.95. But that's Lg to them. Terrible. Terrible. Terrible. Tasted old. Quality was not anywhere where it should have been. See the picture I took of one of the claws. Speaks for itself. The lobster bisque was delicious as was the chicken, bacon, avocado sandwich with fries. The fries were phenomenal. Service was good. It's the last 3 that saved it from a 1 star review. Told the mgr. He replaced the 1 claw for a much better one but still not worth the money. At any price because yes it was that bad.

author: Marilyn Sanchez-Osorio
review_text: I grew up in Miami where Monty’s has been a huge part of the vibe, a go to place to grab a bite or have a drink, meet up with friends after a movie, and just hang out in front of the water and the boats docked in the marina. Never known for excellence in food quality, but at least fair enough for the quick bite. By gosh, it had been years that I had not been at Monty’s and I was sadly disappointed. The simple mozzarella sticks I ordered were nothing short of horrific! The Margarita was 90% ice, and the rest was a mystery, but the worst was the “service”! This woman must do us all a favor and quit. ASAP! She literally dragged herself to my table and her facial expression was so unpleasant, it made me want to just get up and leave. She really was the cherry 🍒 on top of the whole disappointment, not to mention that the chair I sat on was falling apart and I almost fell to the ground..! Just horrible. 😣 OH! Super expensive too… run 🏃🏻‍♀️

author: Samuel Kaplan Art com
review_text: Best view of key Biscayne a land yacht club. Descent food nothing above average but okay. White table cloths denote price point for upscale service and lots of eye candy.

author: Ariana Taveras
review_text: OMG, the food at Monty’s Coconut Grove was absolutely delicious! We started with the gator bites—they tasted just like chicken and were a fun and tasty appetizer. Our meal included fresh oysters, flavorful Cajun shrimp Alfredo, and a perfectly cooked NY sirloin steak. Although we didn’t try any of the specialty drinks, they looked amazing and are definitely on our list for next time. The atmosphere was lively and enjoyable. The DJ played great music that was clean and appropriate for children, making it a fantastic spot for families. The waterfront setting added to the charm, providing beautiful views and a relaxing ambiance. If you’re in the area and looking for a place with great food, a welcoming environment, and family-friendly entertainment, Monty’s Coconut Grove is the place to go!

author: Indrasis Chakraborty
review_text: Me and my wife went there for a Sunday brunch during our visit to Miami. The place is exceptional , both in terms of food and ambience. Our host was nice and kind and brought every single dish with a smiling face. We got their calamari , which was crunchy and fresh, well seasoned and came with a homemade marinara sauce. I got their grouper for main dish, which tasted fresh and flaky, came with a house potato and a salad. My wife got the impossible taco, which she said is really good and fresh. For desert, our host recommended us their brownie, which came hot and served with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. Altogether, excellent choice for a brunch with your loved ones and family. P.S. they are also dog friendly, and if you like birds, you can see tons of them sitting next to your table.

author: Edward Scott
review_text: The atmosphere was full of great vibes the food was Great. Ordered chilled shrimp cocktail and gator bites. Was fresh the gator was fresh well seasoned fried to perfection

author: Aussie Abroad
review_text: Love this spot, really casual, laid back vibe with easy eats and screens for anyone who wants to watch sports… personally I prefer to watch the comings and going’s from the water from here 🛥️!

author: Christopher F
review_text: They have a variety of foods to offer and, personally, the fish tacos were good. The place was a little busy when we got there but not crazy. Most of the seating was outside but covered. There is an automatic 19% service charge on all food and drink which was stated on the menu. The issues I had were that it took a while to initially get a drink. Beers normally come in a bottle or a 16oz draft. Their draft was priced for a normal size but you got a 12oz plastic cup. Kids menu had a semi decent selection but if you dont want a corn cob on the side, you can switch it for normal items like fries for $1. One child wanted a corn and the other wanted fries. We should have switch amongst ourselves when the food arrived because they charged a $1 for each kid because each asked for what the other was getting on the side. (One wanted fries but was supposed to get corn and the other wanted corn but not fries.) The topper was that the service charge is added onto the bill and tax is done after. I asked for clarification since this is a tip and I should have to pay for tax on the 19% service charge. Tax the entire bill and add 19%. The waitress went to ask and came back with an explanation of what the service charge was. I said that I wanted to know why it was added like a meal and I was being taxed on top of that. (Maybe $5 difference overall but it is the fact I shouldn't have to even pay that) The waitress before listening fully just left because she wasn't able to understand my question. We paid the bill and left. I don't need to return there because there was nothing special about that location. Also, if you don't park in a certain lot, then parking is at your cost. Make sure to validate your ticket like we did. We just needed to wait for everyone else stuck at the gate that did not validate.

author: Kaustubh M
review_text: One of our all time favorite spots. Everything j the menu is perfect and well seasoned. Good cocktails and very hospitable staff. We always get the raw oysters and the loaded seafood roll. Can’t ask for much more than this.

author: Megan L
review_text: Amazing service and food! 10/10 Super Dog-friendly as well! One of the servers even brought water for my furbaby! Vibe was on point and everyone was super friendly!

author: Ashlyn Williams (Ash)
review_text: It's really hard for me to do 5 stars but my experience at Monty's has usually usually always been top notch. Today was definitely another good day. We arrived for lunch not thinking about it being Brunch (thought it's Saturday). Our server, Petrona, was on the ball. She got to my table with my family quickly and made good suggestions on things. We ordered drinks and an appetizer that came at a great speed and she made sure to bring a water when the last one of our party arrived. The food came out hot delicious. It was a great experience and I know next time I'm in town I will be back.

author: J S
review_text: Casual vibe on the water with great food and good service. The seafood is on point. Our server Jonathon recommended the stone crab and minuta ssndwich and it didn't miss!

author: C Perry
review_text: We had such a great time here, again! We tried it last December and were pleasantly surprised. We love the Mahi tacos and the Wahoo Fish Dip was fantastic. The service was super friendly and made the whole experience easy and enjoyable. Alex, our server, was very accommodating which makes the experience so much better. The tables were comfy, and we love the view. Definitely one of the highlights that brings us back. The food was delicious, and the atmosphere made it even better. Everything just came together for a really fun afternoon out. We’ll definitely be coming back!

author: Justin Stein
review_text: Great outdoor but covered spot, delicious food and cool vibe. Our Arepitas and shrimp cocktail were a great start, and the Mahi Tacos were incredible, coupled with my wife’s Smash Burger that was perfect. Only knock was long wait to see our server, but she was great afterwards.

author: Tasheena S
review_text: We came here for brunch and we LOVED IT! We will definitely be back. From the moment we arrived until we left the service was amazing. The views of the water really add to the ambiance. Let’s, add the food. The food was amazing. We started with the fish dip and conch fritters; followed by shrimp & grits and French toast. We loved every single bite. We can’t to return.

author: Helen Chen
review_text: We had a great time at the Bayshore! Our server Peter was excellent. The dishes we tried conch fritters, calamari and frutti de mart were great. The smash burger though was killer good. It was our favorite! The live music was unrivaled. Can’t wait to drop by again

author: Nina Brooks
review_text: Scott and Andres were absolutely amazing my husband brought me here for my birthday and the food was delicious! We ordered the whole fried snapper it was very impressive in presentation! The spicy margarita was perfection! We had white chocolate raspberry cheesecake for dessert. The ambience a music and history of the restaurant is wonderful. We will definitely be back!

author: Andrea Novoa
review_text: Bayshore Club Miami A Perfect Waterfront Escape Located right by the marina in Coconut Grove, Bayshore Club is one of those Miami spots that instantly makes you feel like you’re on vacation. The open-air design, ocean breeze, and tropical aesthetic create the perfect setting for a laid-back lunch or sunset dinner with friends and family. Their food selection is absolutely delicious from the fresh ceviche packed with flavor to the perfectly cooked mahi-mahi and crispy fried fish. Every plate feels fresh and made for coastal dining. Pair that with one of their signature cocktails and you’ll understand why this spot is always buzzing with good vibes. The ambiance is everything you’d want for a Miami night out relaxed yet vibrant, with music, palm trees, and beautiful views that make you want to stay long after you finish your meal. It’s the kind of place where you can eat, laugh, and enjoy the evening without feeling rushed. Whether you’re celebrating with friends, having a casual date night, or just want to unwind by the water, Bayshore Club is a must-visit. Definitely recommend staying for drinks after dinner the atmosphere gets even better as the sun goes down.

author: Alisa Kremer
review_text: Wow! What an unexpected surprise. My husband & I walked around from our hotel, and found the Bayshore Club restaurant. The service, the food, the staff were so accommodating, friendly and caring. Our entrees were delicious (I ordered the Snapper special and my husband had the Spice menu special). We will definitely return! Our waitress, Viviana was absolutely lovely, Javier, the manager & Chris were a pleasure to talk to. Apparently, there is a very good brunch here on the weekends which we will have to investigate! Thank you for an amazing dinner experience while visiting our daughter during Family Weekend at the "U". Go Canes!

author: KAT OLARTE
review_text: Our entire visit was stellar! The staff was so hospitable and accommodating. The view is prefect. The food was amazing and creative. I highly recommend requesting Tyrone! He's kind, on point, genuine, and passionate about being present with you. He's been with them since they opened and loves to answer questions with enthusiasm. It's right next to the shipyard and if you're there early enough, you'll see them lifting vessels out of the water to Dry-dock them. We took a walk after and it was so peaceful! Enjoy!

author: Al Martinez
review_text: This is now one of my favorite places. Went here on a perfect night with cool weather and clear skys. This place is absolutely amazing for an evening eating oysters and steak 🥩 and smoking cigar by the water. Glorious views of the marina. Amazing service and food. Will definitely return for brunch and weekends to check out the live music.

author: Mia Tucker
review_text: I can’t say enough good things about the Bayshore Club in Miami! The atmosphere is stunning—right on the water with the perfect mix of laid-back and upscale. The food and drinks were amazing, but what truly made our experience unforgettable was our server, Alex. From the second we sat down, Alex was warm, attentive, and genuinely friendly. She knew the menu inside and out, gave us excellent recommendations (the calamari and the asparagus were both incredible!), and somehow managed to anticipate what we needed before we even had to ask. Even though she was clearly busy, she made us feel like we were her only table. That level of service is rare, and it truly elevated the whole evening. If you’re coming to Bayshore Club, you’re already guaranteed a beautiful view and delicious food—but if you’re lucky enough to have Alex as your server, your night will be next-level. Can’t wait to come back!!

author: Cristy Anne Bustillos
review_text: 1st time eating here! My husband and I came here for my birthday! And it was so amazing the atmosphere was so beautiful! Very friendly servers especially Scott. You guys must try their very new Ckg moroccan salmon, very delicious!! I want a 2nd plate but, I was full already 🤣. Best place to eat!

author: Jeanine Stark
review_text: Viviana was our meal-curator. EVERY item she suggested was excellent and well within what we were looking for: whole fried red snapper, broccoli, skin-on mashed potato, duck surf n turf....and very timely! Thank you for a great meal, and time well spent!

author: Cesar Ruiz
review_text: We went for brunch on Sunday with the family what a great place! It was completely packed, lucky we had a reservation. We got seated quickly and our server was on point. We pretty much ordered everything he suggested, everything was delicious!! The seafood tower was a great way to try a little bit of everything! Location gets 100 points really beautiful place with relax atmosphere and great service! We will be back for sure!!

author: Vaughn-Rian St. James
review_text: This was a dinner treat from the president of my company Nexus 123 who flew out from California just to take us to Brunch and meet my team personally it was just perfect. He is still raving about the food the service and the experience. Everyone from the hostess to our server as well as the Manager greeted us. He checked in with me as we left. Having a back ground in Food service excellence I highly recommend this spot for formal and casual. Great 👍 Job and Thank you Bayshore Grill we will be back!!!

author: Dunia Cala Bértolo
review_text: We celebrate Christmas Eve at Bayshore Club with our family. Dana was an excellent server. He was very attentive. We love it there and will definitely return!

author: Chelsea Hallford
review_text: Amazing experience!!! Loved the food, the atmosphere and most of all the service. Nia was so kind, knowledgeable and a joy to have as my server. 10 out of 10 recommend. When you come get the local catch ceviche, delish!! Thank you Nia!

author: ingrid robles
review_text: the hostess in the front was so kind!! she greeted us with the warmest smile and made incredible conversation. vivana was the cutest server ever, created a great atmosphere. I had the 3 amigos smash burger and it was genuinely delicious. i had an issue with my drink and she immediately took it off our bill and got me a new drink. she was genuinely so sweet and had a ton of recommendations it seemed like she was very familiar with the menu and definitely contributed to my experience, very attentive and kind. lots of seating available and the view from any table in the restaurant is beautiful.

author: nate smith
review_text: Katrina was the best server we’ve ever had. Super personable. Told us the history of seaplanes in the area. Recommended dishes and drinks. 10 stars! Offered to sing happy birthday to me haha!!

author: Tammi Calarco
review_text: The service was absolutely fabulous. The hostess Junise was the mostess with her upbeat attitude and her willingness to accommodate my needs. Our waitress Sheyla C. was super with making sure we had cold drinks and our food at the right times. She also was accommodating when it rained. Between Junise and Sheyla, they made sure the big umbrella was positioned to avoid us getting wet from the rain. The food tasted excellent and was very delicious. The scenic views while eating outdoors were delightful. Overall, I highly recommend Bayshore Club and look forward to returning.

author: V A (Tom)
review_text: Pros: love the vibe. Very comfortable, very relaxed while also having a refined edge. The whole fish snapper was cooked to perfection. The chimichuri steak was 10/10 , tender and flavorful. Calamari is one of the best in town. Nice and crispy. The cesar salad was fresh, and the dressing was perfect. Our waiter Tyrone was absolutely fantastic , friendly, warm, and polite. Cons: what in gods name are we doing with the key lime pie? That radioactive green "kiwi lime syrup" that was drizzled on it was an abomination. The pie was 6/10 to begin with but that syrup added a nice little nursing home food touch to it. In fact, don't put that gross syrup on any of the other desserts please. Also, it's supposed to come with vanilla ice cream, but our came with melted caramel instead. What a flavor nightmare.

author: Justin Stein
review_text: Situated on the borders of Coconut Grove, this was one of our favorite places when we lived in Miami. Coming back, we remembered why we loved it, and enjoyed it again. The eggs scrambled were excellent, with mine coming with a generous helping of onions and nova. The potatoes were excellent, and our server’s attentiveness was perfect. Can’t wait to come back.

author: Nicoly Miyuki
review_text: We has great time at Greenstreet cafe! The ambience is absolutely beautiful,and lovely. Food is good, big portion but the French toast pistachio fell short, I barely tasted the pistachio cream. Eggs Benedict was pretty good and tasty, the sangria was the best. I recommend for a big party family and couple.

author: SarElIG71
review_text: Amazing our waiter Spencer made our afternoon so delightful for being our first time visiting you. Food suggestions, even pictures with us Your wings for sure, delicious. My party and I got different stuff to try a lil bit of everything. Salad, pasta and me your lamb chops. Everything was good. If I can point something only, your sweet potato fries those were soft not crunchy as I ate them before. But if it that recipe, I understand. Thank you, you may see us again.

author: T O
review_text: was there this past Saturday for brunch. very popular place, and I understand why. Delicious food. I had the nova benedict. It was very good. I think it would be better with kippered salmon, but of course that's a matter of taste. the pistachio cream stuffed french toast was the star just delicious. will definitely be back.

author: Carlos Vivas
review_text: A Must-Visit for Breakfast Lovers in Coconut Grove! 🌴☕🍳 Greenstreet Café is a true gem located in the heart of Coconut Grove, Florida. I came here for breakfast with my family and we were all thoroughly impressed. The atmosphere is vibrant and welcoming, with both indoor and outdoor seating that lets you soak in the Grove's charm. The food was absolutely delicious — fresh ingredients, generous portions, and beautifully presented. We tried a mix of dishes: fluffy omelets packed with flavor, perfectly toasted breakfast sandwiches, and one of their signature plates that left us wanting more. They also offer crisp, fresh salads, and a variety of healthy options that make it easy to start your day right. One of the highlights for me was the fresh-squeezed juices — vibrant, refreshing, and clearly made with care. Their coffee was rich and satisfying, a perfect pairing with our meal. Service was friendly and attentive, and the overall vibe was laid-back yet classy — ideal for a relaxing morning out. If you're in the Coconut Grove area and looking for a delicious breakfast spot with great service and a cozy atmosphere, I highly recommend Greenstreet Café. It’s the kind of place you’ll want to return to again and again.

author: Veronica P
review_text: way too much dressing mixed into my salad. the salmon that came in the salad was cooked well, and great flavor, but it was ~3.7 ounces in size. i also ordered the cinnamon bun pancakes, which came highly recommended by the waiter and others nearby, but it they were pretty underwhelming. they tasted like regular pancakes with a light glaze drizzled on top. considering they had a nice variety of coffee-based items on their menu, i expected the coffee to be good quality, but the black drip coffee tasted slightly burnt. overall, it was a meh experience for me.

author: Brayan Ramirez San Juan
review_text: Simply an amazing place, beautiful with excellent customer service, and very good food. Nothing bad to say, from the mac and cheese, to the truffle fries, to the pasta. Everything was delicious. The place was clean and quiet. Average parking.

author: PammyxPamela
review_text: It was my first time coming to green street cafe and I brought my family along as they are here on vacation. I had the pleasure of having Zoe as our server she was amazing and told us her favorite entrees and appetizers as we were unsure what to order. She was very attentive, super friendly, and welcoming. Thank you to Zoe we will be back here again. Very enjoyable experience. We will be asking for Zoe next time we come back. Thank you green street cafe.

author: Giselle T
review_text: We had a wonderful dinner at GreenStreet Café on Sunday. My husband and I really enjoyed the cozy atmosphere, the delicious food, and overall great vibe of the place. Our server, Zoe, was amazing — very kind, attentive, and professional. She made sure we felt comfortable and well taken care of throughout the entire evening. It was a lovely experience and we’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend!

author: maryjayne elizabeth
review_text: the service here is outstanding! and the food? even better! the caesar salad is my favorite in miami, and the chicken alfredo is made to perfection. raciel is an amazing server!

author: Kristen Kirkwood
review_text: Really couldn’t have had a worse experience here. Called in an order with a completely rude woman. Then we go to pickup food and it wasn’t there/ready. We waited over 1.5 hours for the food. Then when we got the “veggie burger” and side of asparagus it was awful. No bun. Four soggy strips of asparagus. Their food is so blah here. The staff was not nice or apologetic for this either. They were also talking rudely and complaining and guests could clearly hear. Have been here at least 4 times and the only positive thing this place has is their location and outdoor seating other than that it’s a complete waste of time and money. Will never come back.

author: Mary B
review_text: Green street is a great staple on a strip full of other restaurants you can pick from. My favorite dish for breakfast is the Grove Benedict with grilled tomatoes as my side instead of potatoes, for lunch I love the Salmon salad, The salmon dip appetizer and the Salmon Penne pasta. The meat lasagna is delicious and so is the Lamburger. This place has been around for over a decade. Thanks green st for amazing food , service and atmosphere .

author: Sergio Aleman
review_text: Great chill place for breakfast. Service was great and food was delish

author: Wavy Bandz
review_text: My actual new #1 breakfast place first time here and me and my lady loved it food came out pretty quick our server was top notch excellent wish I could remember his name but he was amazing if you ever have a waitress Lightskin with no beard kinda looks like Ryan Garcia he’s the man lol he’ll make sure to get you right

author: Francelia Maurell
review_text: We had such a great experience at Green Street thanks to our server Desire. I came in with my mom my husband and my children, and she was absolutely amazing super attentive, kind, and patient. She went out of her way to make my children feel special, which meant so much to me as a mom. Our drinks and food were always taken care of, and she made the whole experience feel relaxed and enjoyable. Excellent service like hers truly makes a difference. We’ll definitely be back!

author: Diana Luft
review_text: The place has really gone down the drain. The quality of the dishes was terrible. The service before was this place’s redeemable quality - not anymore! They continued sitting people outside in areas they know flooded as it rained. We watched as a couple was basically rained on since the canopy had small tears and water pooled around them. It stopped raining for a few minutes, the couple paid and left, they cleaned the table. One of the waiters warned the hostess “it’s going to rain again.” And was shrugged off and a new party was seated again…..

author: Carlos Gonzalez M.
review_text: Greenstreet Café is one of those places you don’t just visit once; you adopt it as a ritual. 🌿✨ From the first coffee to the last cocktail, the vibe carries that European charm seamlessly blended with Miami’s tropical spirit. The menu is generous, designed to cover every craving: from breakfasts that feel like a weekend indulgence even on a Tuesday, to main dishes that strike the right balance between comfort food and subtle sophistication. The coffee is solid, the brunch is a classic, and the mimosas… well, let’s just say they’ve rescued more than a few Sundays. 🥂 Service is usually quick, always with a genuine smile, which makes a difference in a spot that’s popular and buzzing yet never loses its personal touch. The terrace is the crown jewel: dining under the trees with the hum of Coconut Grove around you is almost therapeutic. In short, Greenstreet Café is the kind of place where time slows down, food tastes better than expected, and you end up promising yourself you’ll come back…. and you do.

author: unitedravers
review_text: This is my favorite after work spot. If you find yourself here during the weekend do yourself a favor and sit in the inside bar with Julissa if there are seats available. The sweetest bartender ever and she makes the best old fashions and cosmos. On top of that she is extremely quick juggling orders from the whole restaurant, coffee and the bar top. It’s truly inspiring to be served with someone with such good work ethic and that cares about their guest. I have a great experience every time.

author: Jania Consuegra
review_text: I love this place. No wonder why it’s busy all the time. Amazing prices, amazing food, amazing service. Definitely one of the restaurants to always go to in Coconut Grove. Pastas are a go to! Great drinks! Everything is good about this spot. Will always come back here

author: Rachel Butler
review_text: Loved this place overall - incredible food and $5 cocktails at happy hour. Great location on a corner in Coconut Grove too

author: Liza Chernov
review_text: The reviews tell the truth! I was skeptical at first for such a high review rate but it is true to reality!! The food is phenomenal, we had the panini and Benedict, also the crepe for dessert and it was AMAZING!! Texture spices presentation.. 10/10! My recommendation if you plan to visit during the weekend— BOOK YOUR TABLE ONLINE , it gets VERY BUSY 11-2 pm ! We got it online and waited 5-10 minutes for our outside table. Service was attentive, friendly, thank you Alfonso- I see why many write reviews for him! Friendly guy. Overall 10/10 , recommend 100% , do get your printed coffee! Not only it’s aesthetic but also very tasty! (Especially the vanilla one)

author: Rupert A.
review_text: The restaurant/Cafe is around the corner from the Marriott Cadillac. It has a small indoor dining room and a large patio with umbrellas. The menu is relatively e tensive for a cafe. Service is exceptional and very accommodating. Their specialty coffees are tasty. The various mains that we had were very fresh and tasty and special requests for modifications were accepted with a smile. The freshly made beignets were hot and delicious. Very relaxed lunch in a laid back environment.

author: Roberts .J06
review_text: I came across this place while staying in the area. I actually could see this place from my hotel balcony. I looked it up and saw the amazing menu they had and wanted to go and try it. I really enjoyed the food and the staff was great! The coffee I had was amazing, first coffee of the day so my whole life depended on this coffee! Healthy delicious brunch! They have a seating outside that the water is across the street as well. Very great location and vibes .

author: Melanie Pliskin
review_text: Bon Bouquet was an absolute treat! The food was incredible. My son had the pancakes and my husband and I split the avocado toast and French toast. Everything was delicious but the French toast was really special. Our waitress, Calista, did a superb job as well! I would highly recommend this restaurant.

author: Lisa Weber
review_text: Had breakfast here for the first time and it was a very good experience overall. The service really stood out – the waitress was incredibly kind, attentive, and fast, gave great advice, and genuinely thought ahead. She made us feel very well taken care of. The only small downside was that it was quite loud, which made it a bit less relaxing. Looking back, I might have been a little unfriendly that day myself – which makes the professionalism and warmth of the service even more impressive. I’d definitely come back.

author: Sai Kaushik Duvvur
review_text: Dorian was an amazing host and took real great care of us, we really loved the food and the ambience is great! My wife loved the custom print on her and hot chocolate which they do. Would definitely come back!

author: Ilana Ash
review_text: This place is awesome!! Our server Calista was so sweet, very prompt, and made excellent recommendations! This was our first visit and certainly not our last. The cafe itself was so cute, very clean, and offered a lovely outdoor dining patio as well. My only negative, was it seemed like the AC wasn’t working, in which it was very uncomfortably warm, and the tables were very very close together (which is understandable as they made the most of the beautiful space they have). Overall, would absolutely recommend this spot, and will be back!

author: Lior Singer
review_text: This place deserves a Michelin star. Whoever created the dishes was extremely accurate and creative with the flavor combinations. I gave five stars before, but this place truly deserves it. The food deserves to win awards. Thank you so much for having us!

author: Donna Robinson
review_text: Came for the experience and succeeded. The food that I ordered I did not like at all. Others did enjoy their croissant sandwiches and said the potatoes were very good. I had the sourdough avocado toast it did not even come to average, but I will say the experience was great to be in. Customer service was attentive . I definitely recommend making reservations it is extremely busy place to go. You will have to pay for parking . The picture on the coffee have easy instructions to follow and that was my favorite part. The coffee taste was just subpar not really good at all, but I’m glad I was able to go and I would go again just order something different.

author: Annie Van Peter
review_text: We had a GREAT experience at Bon Bouquet! The weather was so nice in Miami, we decided to sit outside. Alfonso was our server. He gave wonderful recommendations, and he was so attentive and was helpful with some dietary issues I have. I enjoyed the Royale Benedict (subbing spinach for the muffin). WOW! It was fantastic!! I can’t recommend this restaurant enough! If you’re fortunate enough to have Alfonso as your server, you’ll be treated Royale-ly!

author: Andrea Montgomery
review_text: Vanessa from Argentina was our server and she was so attentive and provided great service. Our party was a bigger party and some girls came late however she still handled everything in order and precisely. I had the turkey croissant which came with potatoes. I also tried the beignets and the caramel latte with my photo on it was amazing! Mica came and suggested that we take a photo in front of the flower Arc and she even accommodated Us by closing the doors and taking a photo of the entire group because there were 10 of us or more. I would recommend it and thank you ladies for your service.

author: Kevin Hubbard
review_text: The food and smoothie were both excellent but this place shines because of their service. Calista was one of the best servers I've ever seen. Not only did she handle my table with care, there was a difficult person at the table next to me who had some pretty odd requests. Not only did she not question them, the chef came out to confirm exactly how the person wanted his food, showing that this attitude is part of the culture of the cafe. Kudos to the management who are fostering such a great environment. If my business was in Miami I definitely would have tried to offer Calista a job working for me.

author: Amber Caracol Noguchi
review_text: Alfonso was such a great server. He gave us really good recommendations (we got the Turkey and Brie Crepe and the Pepperoni sandwich on a croissant with provolone 🤤) , was super attentive to our needs, read my mind when I needed a coffee refill, and also helped us order more for carry out. The coffee hit the spot, food was really tasty, and service was exceptional! Mahalo nui (thank you) Alfonso!

author: Tatsiana Tsiushkevich
review_text: I think the rating is overstated. The place is very busy, so be ready to wait. The coffee was just average, and the avocado toast had a very modest amount of avocado. There are definitely much better breakfast spots in this area.

author: Daniela Duenas
review_text: BEST BREAKFAST EVER!!! Alfonso was our server, he is from colombia like us and was soo nice!!!! He made accurate and diet specific recommendations. He recommended the french toast as one of the most popular items, and it was SOOO GOOD! Overall a great experience, the food is amazing and the atmosphere is gorgeous. But our waiter Alfonso truly tied it all together to a perfect experience

author: Allison Doody
review_text: Food was absolutely incredible, we had Calista as our waitress and she was wonderful. Her service felt like fine dining! She was so bright and kind. It added to the whole experience! If you’re visiting Miami definitely stop by here for any brunch and breakfast needs!!!

author: Alvi Rahman
review_text: Excellent food, amazing service. The latte art stuff is incredible, we printed a photo of our son on a caramel macchiato put a huge smile on our faces and was delicious. Very accommodating with high chairs and friendly service.

author: Maria Valenzuela
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ I had a wonderful experience at Bon Bouquet Coffee Shop, thanks to Calista! From the moment I walked in, she was warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. Her customer service was exceptional—friendly, professional, and thoughtful. She made great recommendations and ensured everything was perfect from start to finish. Calista’s positive energy truly elevated my visit and made it feel special. Outstanding service like hers is the reason I’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend! ☕🌸

author: Faith Rhodes
review_text: A Must-Visit Gem! 🌸 We had an amazing time at Bon Bouquet Café! Even though the place was fully booked, our food came out incredibly fast and everything was delicious. Our server was attentive, efficient, and made us feel so welcome throughout the meal. The atmosphere was lively but cozy, and you could tell the staff really had their rhythm down. We’re already planning to come back to try more of the menu—it all looked so good! If you're thinking of visiting, I highly recommend booking your reservation in advance—they fill up quickly, and it’s easy to see why. Can’t wait for round two!

author: Lisa Eckel
review_text: Do not miss this spot! Our waiter Alfonso was awesome!! Get the latte with your own photo! Coffee delish. Crepe amazing. So glad we came!

author: Eduardo Marrero
review_text: We drove through the area to try these restaurants we noticed, which are popular among Italian food fans. They recommended specific pastas and their pizza. It was quite a drive for me since I was in Doral and it was pouring rain, but it was definitely worth the trip. If you’re nearby, try the thin-crust pizza—it's worth it even if you’re not close by. You won't be disappointed, and you can also take a walk along the marina and enjoy a bit of North Bay Village.

author: George P
review_text: Petralunga is one of those places that stays on your mind after you leave. The standout is the thin, crispy pizza, which you order first and then compare all other pizzas to. Their simple yet really good fresh lemonade is perfect, especially when enjoyed outdoors overlooking the marina and bay. It’s on the pricier side for casual dining, making it more suitable for “date night” or special outings with friends rather than a regular weeknight dinner. However, with the scenic water views, the Italian pizza-and-cocktail atmosphere, and that fantastic crust, it definitely deserves a solid 4 stars.

author: Julieta Williams
review_text: After moving to North Beach on 2022, we are finally checking Petralunga! On a beautiful and perfect sky early evening, we had our lovely table under the stars. Sofia was our server and she was absolutely great! Our salad, pizza and Tiramesu were great. Our cocktails were also on point. We will certainly be returning. Bravo!🙌🏼🇮🇹

author: Sergio Murgas
review_text: We visited Petralunga and had a very pleasant experience. We ordered several dishes to share and overall we were satisfied. The Cacio e Pepe stood out for its great texture and a creamy, well-balanced flavor. The burrata was fresh, pairing nicely with the bread and olive oil. The fried calamari were crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, not greasy at all — a solid start to the meal. The tuna tartare was fresh, beautifully presented, and had a clean flavor. Nice atmosphere, friendly service, and good quality dishes. A recommended spot for a relaxed meal with Italian flavor.

author: Sakshi2 Jaiswal
review_text: We stumbled upon this little gem and tried their “Hidden Gem” pizza, which is perfectly named. It was honestly the best pizza I’ve ever had. On top of that, their tiramisu was absolutely mind-blowing. I don’t even have the words to describe the flavor, but I would recommend this place to anyone visiting or living here.

author: Tatiana Santos
review_text: I visited Petralunga in North Miami because they had a 50% off promotion on everything — and honestly, that was too good to miss! The place itself is very nice, the atmosphere feels welcoming, and the service was absolutely outstanding — everyone was attentive and friendly from start to finish. The pizzas were really good, and the tiramisu was one of the best I’ve had in Miami — truly a must-try dessert. However, I also ordered the tuna tartare and the tableside cacio e pepe, and those didn’t impress me as much. I’d definitely come back for dessert and a glass of wine, maybe even a pizza night, but probably not for a full dinner. The only downside is parking — it took me almost 25 minutes to find a spot, so be prepared for that if you visit during busy hours.

author: maria jose
review_text: Great food and vibes! Recommend Bruskhlyn Pizza and cacio e pepe pasta! Linguine Al frutti Di mare was okay, I had better ones. Servers need to be more open with what you’re being charged for example bread: it was given like it comes with the service. FYI, the tips are included at 20%, and they are charged even when it's just a 2-person date.

author: Ashley Nessl
review_text: Came on a Sunday some what randomly, they asked if we had reservations I didn’t really know was need from just stumbling upon this place but they were very accommodating and luckily able to get us in plus a table outside which was amazing, but I would recommend going the route of a reservation. Also was pleasantly surprised to find out everything was 50% off, and they do this every Saturday and Sunday. From here on out the food and service was amazing Sofia took very well care of us and ordered a few of her recommended items. And naza was very kind I will definitely be returning and loved my experience

author: Omar A Morillo
review_text: We had an absolutely wonderful dining experience at Petra Lunga in North Miami Beach! From start to finish, everything was top-notch. The service was attentive and friendly, and the owner even came by to greet us, making us feel truly welcomed. We started with the Metzi meatballs, which were absolutely delicious. The tableside cacio e pepe was a highlight—prepared in a giant wheel of parmesan and topped with truffles, it was simply phenomenal. We also loved the pizza with pepperoni, stracciatella, and a drizzle of hot honey—it was the perfect blend of flavors. The New York strip was a bit overcooked for our liking, but still flavorful and enjoyable. To top it all off, we indulged in their desserts—the tiramisu and the berries panna cotta—both were delightful and the perfect ending to our meal. The atmosphere, with outdoor seating by the bay, was just perfect for a relaxing evening. We even got to enjoy a digestivo, including a lovely limoncello. Overall, we highly recommend Petra Lunga and can’t wait to come back!

author: Luz Rodríguez
review_text: I had an amazing experience at Liu. The food was absolutely delicious, every dish was full of flavor and beautifully presented. But what truly made the visit unforgettable was our server. She went above and beyond to make us feel welcome, offering attentive, friendly, and personalized service that turned a great meal into a unique and memorable experience. Highly recommended!

author: Maria Klann
