review_text: Is not what I expected. I saw one of those amazing reviews on Instagram about this restaurant, but in real life it’s not like that. The lobster ravioli with zucchini was very rich and salty. The service is fantastic. The meat was also salty—it was ok, but nothing that takes my breath away. The tuna appetizer was fresh and good. Meatballs are good. About the place… The restaurant is located on the first floor of an old building that lacks of maintenance. It’s very informal and there is not ocean view. It’s a view to the marine which is obstructed by some walls. This restaurant is good for local people who around the area and for the marina.

author: Sileirim Ortega
review_text: This is the typical restaurant that is hyped up by influencers but DOES NOT DELIVER. We entered the restaurant and we were not acknowledged by anyone passing by. Everyone would look directly at us and not even ask if we were being helped. After a few minutes my boyfriend asked a waiter who could attend us, and then he served us. Food was mid AT BEST. The food lacked quality and taste. The pizza was the best tasting plate but it is extremely thin crust, which is not my favorite. The view was great and ambiance was good, but definitely not worth it. I suggest skipping it.

author: Estrella Sagarzazu
review_text: Beautiful waterfront Italian restaurant with exceptional service from Regina. Delicious food, creative drinks, and a perfect atmosphere for a great time. We enjoyed the weekend lunch special — 50% off made it even better! Highly recommend.

author: Leidi Chavez
review_text: This beautiful waterfront restaurant is located near the marina offering inside and outside seating. Place is nicely decorated, offering some cool photo opportunities especially if you are a ninja turtle fan. Fun. The fresh roses by the tables were a nice touch. Their menus, especially the drink menu is surprisingly extensive which is cool, although a bit pricey. All the food we ordered came out very tasty and fresh. Now, our server was not as attentive as we wish and we had to be reminding him of things, plus service was slow. Besides that, we had a nice experience, but I will recommend management to be in top of the servers to ensure service is to their standards. We will be back again.

author: Glori Acosta
review_text: I had high hopes for Petralunga and their Cacio e Pepe tableside cheese wheel , but unfortunately, the food didn’t live up to the expectations. From the meatballs to the pasta, everything was just average at best. The wait for our food was unusually long, and when it finally arrived, the pasta was cold. It honestly felt like something I could’ve made at home. That said, the tableside tiramisu was actually pretty good — it’s the main reason I gave them three stars. In addition, the setting is undeniably beautiful. The waterfront location creates a stunning atmosphere and is perfect for photos. I really wish I had come during their 2-for-1promotion — because at full price, the dishes simply don’t justify the cost.

author: Phillip Delgado
review_text: The pizza was spectacular!!! Light, thin and yummy!! We got the Margarita with pepperoni and the Brusklyn is a must have!!! Our waitress, Sophia was amazing!! Kind, attentive and friendly. We are definitely returning for pasta!!

author: Thalia Pardo
review_text: My boyfriend and I had dinner here and wow… everything was so much better than we expected. The food was incredible seriously, every single thing we ordered was delicious. We tried a bunch of different dishes (we definitely went all out), and not one disappointed. The flavors were rich, portions were perfect, and it all looked just as good as it tasted. Our server Amanda was amazing — super friendly, helpful, and just made the whole night feel even more special. You could tell she actually cared. The vibe of the restaurant was also really nice cozy but classy, and just felt like a great place to unwind and enjoy the evening. We left full and happy, already talking about coming back again. Highly recommend.

author: Irene Curbelo
review_text: The place is beautiful. It has options to sit inside our outside by the marina. The music inside is good enough to enjoy a meal with a beautiful conversation. It is clean, staff is friendly. Very good customer service and attention. Food is AMAZING. Servings easily serve 2 people, the dessert comes with a cute presentation. It is fresh and tasty. The drinks selection is so good. So many tequilas .. they can even make your cocktail with the tequila of choice. Our waiter was Malena, truly recommend her , she knows her menu and her recommendation were 10/10

author: Noah Jaid
review_text: Liu was amazing! She was super kind, attentive, and made our experience really enjoyable. She checked on us often without being overwhelming and made sure we had everything we needed. She was genuinely one of the best servers we’ve ever had. You could tell she cared about giving great service, and her friendly personality stood out the whole time. She made us feel welcome, and her positive energy made the visit even better. We really appreciate her and hope to have her as our server again. Highly recommend!

author: O D
review_text: Petralunga is one of those hidden places that you must visit in Miami. The food is delicious (the bolognese, caccio e Pepe, and cocktails) but the best part is the service. Every single member of the staff is very friendly and knowledgeable, but especially Sofia and Naza. They made our experience so much better

author: Vaughn Rondon
review_text: "If you’re looking for a perfect broadwalk spot, Nick’s Bar & Grill is it! I stopped in and was blown away by the food. The clam chowder was rich and loaded with flavor—definitely a highlight. I followed it up with the fish and chips, which were perfectly crispy and fresh. To top it all off, the Don Julio margaritas were expertly made and hit the spot while people watching. Great vibes, football game on multiple screens, and topped off by Karaoke after the game. Excellent service right on the boardwalk. I’ll definitely be back!"

author: Aleksandr L.
review_text: Good enough to eat there twice. The oysters were fresh, steak was ordered was blue rare, Mahi Mahi filled was slightly over cooked(i like mine undercooked and forgor to mention that to the server) and the kids had hamburger that was cooked to medium rare. Was satisfied 😌 and service was great.

author: Sara Calvey
review_text: I've been to Hollywood a few times and I have to say I always come back to this place. Its open till 4(whoo!) The frozen drinks and priced average for the boardwalk but tasty. They have decent bar food-great for a hangover. If youre a sports fan they will more than likely have it on somewhere in the bar. Good views and good staff

author: Carito Ingberg
review_text: Nick’s Bar and Grill is a good spot if you’re looking for a casual date or a place to hang out with friends. I wouldn’t call it family-oriented, but it works well for meeting up, especially to watch a game — there are screens everywhere. The location is great, right by the beach with nice views, and the place feels fresh inside with air conditioning. Food was fine — nothing extraordinary but decent. We had the mojo mahi (grilled fish) and fish & chips, both good. Portions were fair and service was friendly. Bathrooms were clean, which is always a plus. The biggest downside for me was the music. It was extremely loud, making it impossible to have a conversation. The playlist itself felt random and didn’t really match the vibe. I understand it’s a bar, but it doesn’t need to feel like a nightclub. Seating is mostly high tables inside, with only a handful of low tables outside (maybe 4). Overall, a fun place if you’re going for drinks, sports, or loud energy. If you’re looking for a quieter dinner with conversation, this might not be the right choice.

author: Kylie Mahaney
review_text: Stopped here for a beachside lunch and it was perfect. We started with the Old Bay peel-and-eat shrimp, simple and delicious. Our server recommended the sweet Thai chili wings and the flounder sandwich, and both were great. The wings were crispy, meaty, and flavorful, and the sandwich was huge and tasty. Service was super friendly, and sitting on the boardwalk made for great people-watching. Definitely a solid spot if you’re in the area.

author: Ms Jackson
review_text: The bar sotsvon the beach.They had Karoke night, the DJ made it very fun. The food came ot pretty fast. The waitress service was good despite the bar being busy.

author: Jared Weggeland
review_text: My wife and I were staying for just one night before an activity tomorrow nearby. We enjoyed some time on the beach, then looked for somewhere to have a tasty dinner. As we were walking along the boardwalk I smelled the burgers cooking and had to try. The atmosphere was upbeat and exciting. The staff were friendly. Our server forgot something and remedied it immediately. He was very attentive and our drinks never saw an empty bottom. The onion rings appetizers was very fresh, crispy and came with a zesty chipotle dipping sauce. I had the jalapeño Swiss burger and added bacon. It came with all the fixings and the fries were uber crispy. There was plenty of sauce to go around. I am glad we stopped by. This was a good choice. Thanks for the good food and service. I would recommend the place.

author: Mike Fitzpatrick
review_text: The bartender was wicked awesome. She was so incredibly friendly, attentive. The place is clean (the floor can be slick , due to the type of floor), and the little food I had was good. If you are sitting at the indoor side of the bar, and someone on the outside side of the bar is smoking, it blows into the indoor folks. Doesn't bother me personally, but it may bother some. Also a very good beer selection. Dogfish Head, Funky Budha, etc. About 20-25 beers. All bottles, no draft.

author: Joanne Wardell
review_text: Fun little shop, I got an entree of fries, he got an ENORMOUS burger, I got so much fries I could barely finish them, not a bad price either. Very attentive server with the round glasses. Thank you for having us!

author: Leidi Chavez
review_text: This restaurant’s location is excellent since it’s right at the Hollywood Beach Broadwalk and offers a great view of the beach. They open until late and they have indoors and outdoors seating weather permitting of course. This last time we visited during lunch and ended up ordering some burgers which tasted very good as well as the drinks. Our server was attentive and welcoming.

author: Oliver Glasemacher
review_text: Had an amazing strip steak, perfectly grilled, nice and quick staff, absolutely love this place. Great views of the beach.

author: Starasia Starr
review_text: Fantastic view, fans blowing, great breeze, amazing server and decent food. Loved the salad with salmon, better than the mahi mahi. Good clams steamed in a delicious garlic wine and butter sauce. Big portions. Excellent sweet potato fries. Great place to eat when at Hollywood Beach. Nightly live music but we were there for lunch.

author: P Oneliv
review_text: Great place to eat right on the Boardwalk facing the Beach and Ocean. The restaurant was clean and well staffed by friendly employees. Restrooms were also available. The Food and Drink menu has something for everyone and the prices were fair and the portions were more than adequate. The Burger was gigantic and cooked as ordered. Our Server EDDIE was the Best!

author: Debbie Gettler
review_text: Fabulous vibe, great food and outstanding service by Stu! Highly recommend the wings , fries and cadillac margaritas. Perfection with a lovely ocean view. We will definitely be back.

author: Anna Cammarota
review_text: Great food and service, music every night, place to come back over and over, nice atmosphere and right in the boardwalk

author: Oscar Pozo
review_text: Last Saturday I ordered 3 beers ($24) at the bar. Upon checking my debit card statement, I was charged $100 for this order. Highly unprofessional. LAST MONTH WAS THE SAME THING!!!! Be careful with these people 🚨🚨🚨🚨

author: David A.
review_text: This was a fun experience and our group really enjoyed it. We visited during a tropical storm which was unfortunate but the inside is lively and the service was great. We enjoyed the food we tried and the drinks hit the spot. I'm sure when the weather is gorgeous and you're visiting the beach, there couldn't really be a better choice.

author: Michael Holly
review_text: We really loved this place and will be back. The beers were ice cold and our burger and mahi sandwich were delicious. The only negative was the oblivious bartender who was unfriendly and not attentive at all

author: Carter Schlenz
review_text: Awesome restaurant. Very good food. Our waitress came to our table 3-4 times to check up on us. She was very friendly. My meal was 16.99 with then we added the fries so it was 2.50 more. On the pricier side. Otherwise it was great!

author: Andre Ouimet
review_text: Stopped in for a double rye during the week. A real comfortable place to stop. I tried them on Friday, but left after I was told that double was going to cost me 6 dollars more, coming in over 20 dollars.

author: Rachel Ochoa
review_text: Great place for authentic Peruvian! Our old favorite spot closed down further down the broadwalk, so we tried this place today, Christmas Eve, for lunch. Arrived at 12:15 and our party of 4 were seated right away by our friendly server, Roberto. It was a gorgeous day at the beach and a little crowded, but not crazy. Menu options are great! The kids ordered lemonade refreshers with popping boba (what a fun item to have on the menu!) One got mango and the other got strawberry. The kids split arroz chaufa with steak (my husband tried it and said the steak was excellent). Hubs got seafood ceviche which he said was tasty and spicy.I ordered aji de gallina (one of my favorite Peruvian dishes). It was delicious! I couldn't even finish it! So happy we tried this place out!

author: May M
review_text: We were a big group and everyone was very happy with their food. Music was great too. The service was excellent. Overall experience was amazing! It was our first time. We will definitely be back. :)

author: Karen C
review_text: I found this restaurant on Google, looking for a place to spend a relaxing time with my family. We love Peruvian food (I have been to Peru), so At Peru caught my attention. Everything was delicious! We tried the jalea, pesto with chicken and steak (both tender), fish ceviche, yuca a la huancaina, lomo saltado, and pisco sour. Hector, our waiter, was the best! He was very patient, friendly, and had a great sense of humor. Definitely coming back.

author: Flicka Zhang
review_text: The food was super nice!!! Highly recommend the shared snack seafood dishes. The service was nice and it’s a great place for gathering with friends.

author: Nathan Renaud
review_text: This place has it all excellent atmosphere, delicious food, and a great staff. The food is delicious and they give you surprisingly a lot of seafood in your dish. The food is absolutely delicious and at a great price. If you are T the beach you need to come visit At Peru.

author: Camila Mora
review_text: Great service! The owner came to check in on us multiple times. The food was delicious, we got the grilled octopus, grilled shrimp skewers, chicken chaufa, and the steak with pesto pasta. Will come again!!!

author: Ori Aphek
review_text: The ceviche was so so... The fish was chewy, and there was very little added to it. My partner ate the Salmon which wad OK. Not more. The fried calamari was pretty good. It's a fun place to sit and eat while watching the sea and the bypassers. But the food is nothing to write about.

author: MP Fashion
review_text: Disappointing experience We came here for my birthday dinner, and while our server was kind and professional, the experience was disappointing. My seafood dish arrived with something in it, so I couldn’t eat it. The management only removed the dish from the bill, which felt like the bare minimum. For a birthday dinner, I expected better care and responsibility from the restaurant.

author: Angie Roze
review_text: One of my favorite spots to go to… Great spot, amazing food and the staff is fantastic! Plus… the beach view. Can’t ask for more… 10/10 recommend.

author: Irene Smith
review_text: The food was delicious, the portions plenty. The server Roberto was super nice and friendly.

author: Jaime Schlegel
review_text: Rony is the absolute best!!! So familiar with the menu and makes the very best Espresso Martini’s❤️❤️❤️ Definitely will be back again!! Don’t miss this gem Lima Peru on the Hollywood broadwalk

author: Online Support
review_text: Unbelievably delicious ceviche and snapper. Highly recommended. Staff is top notch as well!

author: Brittney Casalina
review_text: Great experience! The drinks, food and atmosphere were incredible! Highly recommended! Our server, Roberto, was fantastic!!

author: pamela grandon
review_text: Great service from Ronny. Ceviche was delicious and the Yellow rice and seafood was also good. Big portion and great view.

author: Debbie Z
review_text: Had breakfast at At Peru this morning. I come to Hollywood Beach every year. Absolutely the best breakfast on the beach. Classic American - crispy bacon is actually crispy and tastes great. Potatoes have just the right amount of seasoning. Pancake is cooked perfectly. Not too mushy. Not too dry. Ronny is a fantastic server. Prices are reasonable - well actually cheap per HB standards. Price is cheap but food is not. Did I mention we eat here at least 4 times during our one week visit! You can’t go wrong if you eat breakfast at At Peru but you sure can go right!

author: Carolina Sanchez
review_text: My waiter Héctor was very friendly and so was Luis ..and the food really good, good portion and the coffee delicious I totally recommend it !

author: Lenore Johnson
review_text: Fantastic. Ronny (manager) was absolutely fantastic. I arrived after a rough day of delayed red-eye travel and he took fantastic care of me. Great food, great service, great prices while looking at the ocean. Who could ask for more?

author: Catherine Shelton
review_text: Everyone loved the ceviche trio, pisco sours and yellow seafood rice

author: Gorkem Topal
review_text: Picked up my to-go order, and I loved it. Tasty food, great service, and the owner was genuinely polite and caring. And back again — couldn’t stay away! And wanted to update my review. I wanted to try something else and it was so good. Thank you for great food and service. Let’s check the photos out!!!

author: Kevin Simpson
review_text: We ate here twice while in Hollywood, Florida. Highly recommend the breakfast meal. Roberto and the team were amazing!

author: indy Del
review_text: Only came here for breakfast twice during my stay. I'm normally not a pancake person but let me tell you..EXCELLENT pancakes, fluffy, fresh and NOT too thick. The eggs were good and home fried potatoes were fresh. Coffee was nice and strong, nice views-oceanfront. Music too loud in the morning. Save that for the night crowd. My service was friendly and prompt both days. Best bang for your buck. Under $10 for fresh breakfast.

author: Yoandra R
review_text: Amazing view and music 🎶 We had a great time and enjoyed the food. Had the biggest drinks I’ve ever had in my life. Hopefully I will get to visit it again.

author: Jason L
review_text: Large open space restaurant with great latin themed music. Beautiful view of the beach and boardwalk. The fried snapper was huge (MP~$40) and very well cooked, very tasty with plenty of rice and salad. Probably better for 2 people, but I eat alot. My server Tatiana was very nice and provided wonderful service (also very beautiful ). The piña colada was also huge lol. If I had to give a complaint, I wouldve preferred sitting by a fan as it was very humid but that's Florida in the midday for you. I will definitely come back again! saludos de NY!!

author: Rosa Almonte
review_text: Atmosphere is wonderful, great music and view. Service was not bad. However the food was terrible by far the worst ceviche I have ever had and the fried fish looked amazing and was decently seasoned but it was over cooked and extremely dry. Drinks look deceivingly great but taste like cheap liquor and cheap mixer. Overall, great ambience and view decent service but terrible over priced food. 1 appetizer 1 entree to share and two drinks for 175 dollars. Will not be returning.

author: Bethany Ely
review_text: The Food is good and tastes authentic. They provide large portions. The environment is fun, vibrant, and loud. FYI, they add 18% to your ticket no matter what you order.

author: S T 3 P H 4 N I 3
review_text: You guys need more servers, and I'm not sure how many chefs yall have back there. But yall either need to PICK UP THE PACE OR HIRE MORE CHEFS!!! Last night me and my family sat down and asked for our food. We waited for AN HOUR!!! AN HOUR!! They gave my dad's food first. And from what I was looking at the rice looks exactly like THE RICE THEY SERVED, DRY!! even the school lunch is better. Also, WHY IS WAS MY DAD'S FOOD SO EXPENSIVE??? IT WAS JUST ONE PERSON MY GOODNESS. IT WAS LIKE 40 dollars FOR ONE PERSON!!!! Don't think I didn't see the other waiting tables either or the MANY bad reviews i have seen on here, I've been watching at least 5 of you waitresses walking around, some talking to people and the rest just serving a big undercooked fish for supposedly 3 people. How do you get a FLY? IN SOMEONE'S FOOD? A STICKER IN SOMEONE'S FOOD?? there are probably even worse reviews than mine. You ALL need to do better or there will be consequences. Have a good day. :)

author: Luis Torres
review_text: This is a solid 3.5. View is amazingHe hadn't fears.Great, but the food leaves a lot to be desired. But this review is just my opinion. The fried snapper had good flavor but was extremely dry. The ceviche portion was generous but it looked like it was just thrown lazily thrown together (precooked shrimp no fish or octopus) and lacked flavor. If you love resort drinks you’ll love the frozen stuff here. They just taste off.

author: Kerly Skaret
review_text: Great atmosphere! The food portion was amazing, the food itself was delicious. The drinks were great! Waitress was very attentive and positive. All in all we had a great time here.

author: maryori guadalupe
review_text: Nice presentation and friendly staff. Mahi tacos were amazing but the chicken was a little over cooked and I could taste shrimp cross contamination flavor in the cilantro rice which felt like it was just reheated and not fresh at all. Not a lot flavor in the rice and beans .Nice view in front of the beach. Little too expensive for tacos 🌮. Meh nothing to write home about in my opinion. Sorry 😐

author: Liz Dunn
review_text: Went here recently for dinner. We were seated quickly and our order was taken relatively quickly. My husbands food (Cuban sandwich) and our d inks came out in about 15 minutes. The rest of our order did not come. After 45 minutes I asked about it and was told it’s a restaurant and it’s busy. No apologies. No offer to expedite. We ordered a burger (for my five year old and 3 year old to split) and two orders of tacos. Nothing fancy. The attitude of the wait staff and management was unreal. I could not believe how rude they were. Also the music is unbearably loud. Do not go here.

author: Addie Monopoly
review_text: I had The shrimp cocktail that was yummy & my daughter had chicken Tenders w/ fries but wasn’t a big fan & she’s very picky. So don’t be discouraged I saw a lot of the plates looked really yummy and people seem to enjoy them. It’s on the board walk so if ur on the beach u can take it to go. Also had a yummy piña colada to go and my daughter had a virgin daiquiri.

author: Patty Lopez
review_text: Love outdoor seating looking at the beach. We shared while fried snapper, sent should've warned how big this thing is $85 worth it was 2 of us, this is enough for 4 people. Flavor was great but the wait is long. Enough room for large parties.

author: Rachel Jacobs
review_text: What a fun beach place to get some good food and listen to live music/DJ. Great for day time. Went for lunch, family friendly and has beach bar vibe. We didn’t get the whole fried snapper this time but it looked amazing, and can be shared with several people. I also got one of their virgin drinks, a bikini frozen mango was really good and was able to share with my older child. Next time in Sunny Isles will be back again.

author: Kent Rasmussen
review_text: If you’re looking for authentic, energetic, and rich Latin culture, Mamacitas is the spot on the Broadwalk. You’re met with vibrant energy from the moment you arrive—live music or a DJ spinning Latin beats, strong margaritas that hit just right, and a menu full of bold, flavorful dishes. The food is fantastic—fresh, in generous portions, and delicious. Whether you’re there for a casual afternoon lunch or a lively night out, Mamacitas delivers the whole experience. Highly recommend if you want to soak in the sights, sounds, and tastes of Latin culture right on the beach.

author: Sharee Edwards
review_text: CHEF'S KISS 💋 the snapper was absolutely amazing .. we were a little hesitant because we didn't think it would be seasoned well, but WHEW it was seasoned perfectly .. it was enough at least 4 people, but we were so hungry my cousin and I ate majority with a little to spare LOL My only complaint was that our waitress was non-existent.. I guess because 18% gratuity was already included, there's a feeling of "no need to check on tables im getting paid regardless." she didn't check on us once .. other than that, it was well worth the $120

author: Sylvia
review_text: Super casual and fun cantina style spot on the Hollywood boardwalk overlooking the beach and the sea! Serving great authentic food from Cuba and Mexico! The whole fried snapper is a must try! It is big enough for 4 people to share. Enjoy it with savory cocktails while taking in the awesome Latin vibes. The service was great, and our server, Karen, was awesome! She went above and beyond to make sure we enjoyed our meal and the time. If you don't want a huge meal, there is plenty to choose from in the extensive menu. Great place to hang out and have drinks, too! It has Latin music playing the whole time. You will not be disappointed if you love Latin food, music, and vibes!

author: Tony Rosca
review_text: Mamacita’s Latin Bar & Grill in Hollywood, FL, delivers a lively beachfront dining experience. Located at 591 N Broadwalk, its ocean views and vibrant Latin atmosphere are undeniable draws. The menu features Mexican and Cuban dishes like shrimp ceviche, Cuban sandwiches, and their signature Red Snapper, praised for its freshness but sometimes criticized for lacking seasoning. Guacamole and chips are a hit, described as “on point” and fresh, though some find portions small for the price. A medium piña colada costs $20, reflecting medium-high prices that some reviewers on Tripadvisor and Yelp call overpriced, especially for drinks like margaritas, which can lack potency. Service is inconsistent—some praise the friendly staff and quick breakfast service (e.g., $6 eggs and pancakes), while others report slow, inattentive servers and issues like missing items or rude interactions. Food quality varies; tacos and seafood soups shine, but some dishes, like churrasco, disappoint due to overcooking. Street parking is challenging, often requiring patience to find a spot. Despite mixed reviews (3/5 on Tripadvisor, 2/5 on Yelp), the beachfront location and live Latin music make it a fun, if flawed, spot.

author: Nereida Crespo
review_text: My favorite restaurant on the Hollywood beach boardwalk. Always my first stop for food when I visit. Great food, service & music with beautiful views of the beach. Highly recommend this place!

author: Jay Culley
review_text: Food was OK. My wife's Huevos Rancheros were delicious. My fish tacos were so-so. The table next to us for the snapper, which was a pretty cool presentation as the whole fish. It looked like they enjoyed it. I did think it was really cool that they have 2 separate kitchens... Mexican and Cuban.

author: Hamza Juman
review_text: The food was excellent. Very tasty! Our waitress was super nice, very attentive. Excellent mimosa's and did not have to wait long at all for the food. Definitely one of my new favorite chill spots at Hollywood Beach.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Annie
review_text: My partner and I decided to check out Taco Beach Shack today given the great reviews and our craving for Mexican food and I can say it definitely did not disappoint! Kourtney, our hostess/ server was the friendliest person; she had a great personality and gave us the scoop on all the different foods on the menu. The food itself was amazing and fresh. We had dined at another Mexican place earlier in our trip on the Broadwalk but Taco beach shack was so much better! I tip my hat off to Kourtney and the gang at Taco beach shack, great food and service. I would highly recommend.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: MultiBeatlesROCK
review_text: We were staying at the hotel+suites next door to the Taco Shack, we had dinner and lunch there. It was A-MAZING!!!!!! Super delicious food! The Churrasco Steak was mouth watering. HUGE SHOUTOUT to our server Alexander, he was very welcoming and gave great service!

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: sally blankenship
review_text: I probably could have had a better meal at a chain restaurant for half the price. Do not order the chips and queso. Unless you went nachos, like you get at the basketball games. This place had the most reviews and their reviews gave it a 4.6 rating. I'm gonna say a bunch of young partying tourists are the ones that rate this place. The steak tacos were too hard to chew. The chips were overcooked. The cheese for the chips and queso was nasty, liquid cheese from a can and wasn't even spicy. The only mexican sauce they provided was a bottle of valentinos. Believe it or not the best thing I ate there was the "street corn" and that wasn't even all that. They rang us up for somebody else's order. Not bringing us a ticket, just ringing us up. It was two meals and a kid's meal And one beverage. They rang us up for 139 dollars. I then tipped without realizing they already give themselves a tip. Gratuity is added no matter the size apparently. Because we were charged for gratuity for a party of two and a half. I then asked if I could see an itemized statement, because I couldn't believe that's what we just paid. And thankfully, I did that because then I realized we were being billed for a picture of margaritas. And for adults that were sitting a table away from us. The beans were beyond salty. I literally think someone dropped a container of salt in there and said, i'm gonna run with this. The rice was mediocre. Needless to say, we would not recommend this place to anyone.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Samuel Godbout
review_text: The tacos at Taco Beach Shack were absolutely delicious, packed with bold flavors and fresh ingredients. The service was friendly and attentive, making us feel welcome from the moment we sat down. Despite how busy it was, the waiting time was impressively short, both for seating and for the food to arrive. Overall, it was a great spot for quality tacos and fast service.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Shelley Skrine
review_text: This was the coolest place! They fully commit to the atmosphere, quality and service. The food was fresh and excellent. Yela was our waitress and she was very sweet and quick! The best part is that our hotel partners with them for discounts and margaritas. I highly recommend this place and if I ever come back to Hollywood Beach. We will revisit!

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Dana Beisengaliyeva
review_text: I had a wonderful time at Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant, with my mom and auntie. The staff were friendly and attentive, I would say Big Thanks to Nicholas, our guy who gave us great service! Even though it was raining, short stuff, he was so respectfully talking to us and being super nice! I think he is a great asset for this place who made our experience in this place so easy, so we could relax.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Amy Liz
review_text: Me and my partner had a very delicious meal here - portion sizes were perfect. We had the mahi mahi tacos and beef tacos, and nachos. 10/10. Nice drinks too. Jonathan was a great waiter! Attentive and kind. We will definitely be back :)

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Abc Abc
review_text: Great flavors. Not the cleanest, but its at a beach in open air. The tacos are great, could develop a signature drink, non alcoholic options are limited. Opening for breakfast instead of 12noon, is also helpful-especially for their guest that check out at 11am.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Glenn Gatineau
review_text: This spot captures a vibrant, authentic Mexican atmosphere complemented by exceptional customer service. The food was outstanding!!! The beef burrito was fresh, flavorful, and the best I’ve ever had. 🌯 The brisket taco was perfectly cooked, and the sauce really enhanced the flavors.🌮 A must-stop spot if you’re at Hollywood Beach! 🏝️

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Leve Leverett
review_text: Loved the outdoor vibe, sunny and warm!! Come hungry! Serving sizes are super large! Food was hot and amazing! We ordered grilled chicken nachos and the mahi mahi tacos!!

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Cesar Davila
review_text: The food and service at taco beach shack was great, we had the churasco taco combo plate which comes with 3 tacos, grilled corn on the cob with Parmesan cheese, rice & black beans and a chicken salad with honey vinaigrette, monster-Rita and a shot of tequila. Our server Yela was very attentive, friendly and patient as we switched tables 3 times for a better view of the live performer they had there, she’s a great singer and it enhanced the great atmosphere of this outdoor and festive restaurant.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Colin Scholl
review_text: Love the indoor outdoor vibe with the roof overhead. Even in a rain storm vibes were good with music and they got a nice tiki bar. Very colorful place with some of the best steak fajitas I’ve had anywhere. I came back and got the Tuesday taco deal and those were great also! Soft corn tortilla is the way to go. Zero complaints. Nancy was also friendly!

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: MiKayla Delmont
review_text: This place was amazing!!! Kourtney and Chelsea really made our first time here something to remember! Would recommend this to anyone. Food is amazing

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Eric Batson
review_text: Great tacos. Very big portions on both the tacos and chips and guac. Good prices. Wonderful service, Yela was on top of it all night. 10/10 would recommend. Especially the Carnitas. Great live music on a Tuesday night as well.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Scout Goodey
review_text: Incredible atmosphere, the food was incredible, I definitely recommend the fajitas if you’re looking to fill up or share with another person. There’s plenty of shade and lots of fans if you’re looking to get out of the heat after the beach. Julio was my server and he was fantastic, so nice and enthusiastic, he made sure we had a great time and were taken care of the whole time.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Sarah Anne Duncan
review_text: Hidden gem. You need to look for this place, it's just off the boardwalk. What a gem. Excellent tacos. Excellent, friendly, helpful, cheerful staff. Lovely restrooms. Clean, fresh, well looked after Exceptional.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Sabinus Brutus
review_text: We got each a taco combo with 3 good size tacos with rice, beans and Parmesan cheese corn 🌽. Since we stayed at the hotel neighboring the restaurant, we got a free margarita and 20% off between 5 and 6 pm.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Brittany Redding
review_text: This place is great. The decor is so bright, colorful, and fun! The taco platter was amazing. You can't mix and match but my group just all got a different taco platter so we could try a few. The brisket taco and the Korean short rib with kimchi taco were amazing. Our server, Majo, was amazing. So friendly and made sure we had everything we needed. Will definitely be back next time I in town.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Justin Phillips
review_text: Amazing atmosphere. The staff are delightful. Joe was awesome and recommended the GRILLED CHURRASCO STEAK. They are amazing and I recommend everyone try it. I will definitely bring my friends here in the future! Thank you Joe!

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Selene
review_text: Amazing food and vibes at Taco Beach Shack! The steak fajitas were juicy and full of flavor, and the mahi-mahi taco was fresh, flaky, and delicious. The beachy atmosphere and great music made the experience even better. Huge shout-out to our server Henry, he was super attentive, friendly, and made great recommendations. His service really stood out! Absolutely recommend this spot can’t wait to come back!

author: MaKenzie Bissler
review_text: We found this place on Tik Tok because of the table made hummus. Christina was so kind and welcoming and helped us decide what to order. We got the sampler, the meat for 2, beet salad and baklava. We loved the sausage and the owner came over and talked to us too! Very family oriented and delicious food. My husband is a picky eater and he said that this place was probably the best food he’s had in a long time - I’d say that’s a win!

author: Dalit Rosenfeld
review_text: Taverna Opa in Hollywood is always such a FUN experience! The atmosphere is always alive especially if you come for dinner. Belly dancers, music, and napkins flying in the air! The food is delicious and very authentic Greek cuisine. The service is always good. I have been here many times with friends and for special occasions and it never disappoints. Perfect spot for great food, entertainment, and unforgettable memories right by the Hollywood boardwalk. Totally recommended!

author: Zlatka
review_text: I was absolutely delighted with this place🔥 and the staff❤️Everything was incredibly delicious, the portions were generous, and the team was so warm and welcoming🥹😻🥰 I want to give a special thank you to the staff for their kindness and attention. My daughter was sleeping in her stroller, and there is a bell in the café that makes a loud siren-like sound. Some kids were pressing it, and my baby got really scared. The staff immediately apologized multiple times 🥹and by covering the button so children couldn’t press it anymore🙏❤️❤️👍 That meant so much to me❤️❤️❤️This level of care and thoughtfulness is truly priceless🙏It’s rare to meet such attentive, kind, and genuinely caring people. Thank you so much we felt really valued and will definitely come back🥰❤️

author: Darrin Tebbe
review_text: I just can't say enough.. we lived in Greece for a few years and just loved the food and Greek hospitality. Taverna Opa takes us back every time we visit. We usually work weekends so this is our first visit on a Saturday nite... WOW!! A wonderful dinner, amazing entertainment, and simply THE best service. George, we ♥️ you! Oh, and the food was simply amazing, just like we remember from our early 90's stay in Greece.. Sincerely, "The retsina guy" 😁

author: Don Massa
review_text: Went for lunch, not crowded, valet parking. The Grilled Octopus was fabulous! Grilled, nice char and seasoned to perfection! Greek salad was fresh cut and we'll seasoned. I added Gyro meat for 6 bucks, seasoned well but on the dry side. Taste was good. My wife wanted a Gyro sandwich and was informed they only had platters. It was good but not what she wanted, plus the meat was on the dry side as well. Service was excellent and on ;b;;the water. Indoor, OUTDOOR dinning, Watch the boast go by with a nice breeze. All and all a nice lunch

author: Jason Mont
review_text: Last night, I had the pleasure of dining at this wonderful Mediterranean restaurant with a group of friends and family. We were looking for three things: exceptional Mediterranean cuisine, a fun dining experience, and a great atmosphere – and this place exceeded our expectations on every level. From the moment we walked in, the ambiance struck the perfect balance between lively and intimate. The warm lighting and thoughtfully designed space created an inviting environment that was perfect for our group gathering. The energy was vibrant without being overwhelming, making it easy to enjoy great conversation throughout the evening The menu impressed us from start to finish. Every single dish we ordered was expertly prepared and bursting with authentic Mediterranean flavors. The appetizers set a high bar – each one showcased fresh ingredients and bold seasoning that immediately transported us to the Mediterranean coast. The standout of the evening was undoubtedly the bronzino. Cooked to absolute perfection, the fish was flaky and tender with a beautiful crispy skin, seasoned with herbs that complemented rather than masked the delicate flavor of the fish. It's clear the kitchen knows how to handle seafood with the respect it deserves. Our main dishes were equally impressive, with generous portions and presentation that showed real care and attention to detail. The flavors were complex and well-balanced, showcasing the best of Mediterranean cooking traditions. The service throughout the evening was attentive without being intrusive, and our server was knowledgeable about the menu and happy to make recommendations. This restaurant has definitely earned a spot on our regular rotation. I'm already planning my next visit and looking forward to exploring more of their menu. If you're seeking an authentic Mediterranean dining experience with great food, wonderful atmosphere, and a fun night out, this place should be at the top of your list. Highly recommended!

author: Cocuti Roxana
review_text: I had a really good experience!! Amazing good food and great service! Dennis was our server and he did an outstanding job. Definitely coming back! Great greek atmosphere and music as well!!

author: Ken Durbin
review_text: 🌟 A Mesmerizing Evening at Taverna Opa, Hollywood Beach 🌟 From the moment we arrived at Taverna Opa, we knew we were in for something special. Nestled along the Intracoastal Waterway, the restaurant offered a stunning waterfront setting that felt both vibrant and serene. We were seated outdoors, right by the river, where the gentle breeze and rhythmic lapping of the water set the tone for a perfect afternoon. Our server was exceptional — warm, attentive, and genuinely passionate about the menu. He guided us through the evening with grace, offering thoughtful suggestions and ensuring every detail was just right. His timing was impeccable, and his energy matched the lively yet relaxed vibe of the restaurant. As we sipped our drinks and watched the boats drift by, nature added its own surprise: a manatee surfaced just feet from our table, rising slowly to take a breath. It was a quiet, awe-inspiring moment that made the night unforgettable — a gentle reminder of Florida’s wild beauty, right in the heart of Hollywood Beach. The food was equally impressive. I had the Chilean sea bass, perfectly seared and served over a rich bed of sautéed spinach, accompanied by golden roasted potatoes that were crisp on the outside and buttery within. My wife chose the Lavraki Branzino, topped with a bright, citrusy ladlemono sauce that elevated the delicate flavors of the fish. Each bite was a celebration of Mediterranean finesse and fresh, coastal ingredients. Taverna Opa isn’t just a restaurant — it’s an experience. Between the impeccable service, the enchanting riverside setting, and the surprise visit from a curious manatee, our evening was nothing short of magical. We’ll be back, and next time, we’ll bring friends to share in the them.

author: Leonard Behaj
review_text: Gent, listen: We stoped at this restaurant by accident just because we liked the view, but this restaurant is one of the best restaurants I ever visited in my life.(45 today is my birthday) The food was wow, fresh, delicious and very tasty. Service was the best part of it, Alex our server was amazing, he explained everything about the dishes about spices, cocking temperatures and everything else. I don’t usually write reviews but when I do they generate a thousands of views. This restaurant is the best in Miami, you don’t need to travel to Greece, save the tickets and come and enjoy a great traditional Greek meal in this location you will thank me. Ask for Alex he is the best ever team member at this restaurant.

author: Zachary Dobran
review_text: Amazing long standing greek established that takes huge pride in the service and food. Drinks were excellent, bartender provided exceptional service and the food was on point. We had the chilean seabass and Athenian shrimp both dishes were full of flavor and fresh. Gorgeous view of the water and a little show to help dinner go down smooth

author: karine belhumeur
review_text: Tavern OPA was just as delicious as I remembered from a few years ago! The food was fresh, flavorful, and so satisfying. I’ll definitely be back again.

author: Chris Kasel
review_text: We had an 80th birthday party for my aunt here. The entire staff was so accommodating, very helpful, and took pride in their work. The food was absolutely incredible. We will be coming back and recommending this place to others.

author: Natulya S.
review_text: It was an excellent choice. We arrived without a reservation but were seated on the patio. The food arrived promptly despite the restaurant being full. The food was delicious. The Greek salad is excellent and made by Greek standards: big chunks of feta and vegetables with a very tasty dressing. We got lamb kebab which was slightly burnt but still good and stuffed peppers-excellent. We also took a plate of fried smelts. In Greece it is called small fish. It was excellent as well. The portions are big, we could not finish them and they packed the leftovers for us. I would highly recommend this place.

author: M. Alvarado
review_text: We hosted my aunt’s birthday party here and couldn’t have asked for a better experience. The food was delicious, the service warm and attentive, and the atmosphere perfect for celebrating. Thank you to the team for helping make her day truly unforgettable!

author: Natalia Morgunova
review_text: I think this place needs to be visited by the department of sanitation. Barefoot belly dancers climb up on the tables (and encourage guests to do so too) and then food is served on these tables without so much as a wipe down. That’s just disgusting. The food was very good, however the atmosphere not so much. Seems like this place has an identity crisis and doesn’t know if it’s a restaurant or a club. Even at 6pm the music was so loud that you could not hear the waiter, nevermind trying to have a conversation with people you are dining with. Also everything is extremely cramped, so you barely have any room and you are constantly being bumped against by people trying to pass.

author: Alvaro Plazas
review_text: What a fantastic experience at Opa Taverna! From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere felt warm and inviting, lively but still comfortable enough to relax and enjoy a meal. The place is spotless and clearly well cared for, which made a great first impression. The chicken skewers were absolutely delicious, juicy, perfectly seasoned, and cooked to perfection. You can tell they use quality ingredients. I also tried the shakshuka, and it was bursting with flavor, rich, hearty, and beautifully presented. Every bite had that authentic Greek touch that makes you want to come back again and again. Parking was surprisingly easy, which is always a big plus in my book ($5 for valet). Overall, everything from the food to the service to the ambiance was excellent. Definitely a spot worth visiting and revisiting!

author: Lashandra Dorado
review_text: Beautiful dinner at Taverna Opa I had such a wonderful evening at Taverna Opa in Hollywood. The food was absolutely delicious — fresh, perfectly seasoned, and full of authentic Mediterranean flavor. The grilled octopus was tender and flavorful, the tzatziki bright and refreshing, and the lamb was cooked to perfection and the atmosphere was relaxed and inviting, with that subtle coastal charm that makes you want to stay a little longer. The staff was attentive, friendly, and made sure everything was just right. Even without loud music or dancing, it still felt warm and full of life — just the right balance between lively and peaceful.It’s one of those places where the flavors, service, and setting come together beautifully. I’d definitely come back again — next time maybe on a weekend to experience the more festive side too.

author: Ryan Falconer
review_text: The food was overall great. We had appetizers, drinks & mains. The ribeye was excellent. The appetizer sampler was delicious. Drinks were all very well made & tasty. I would not order the lemon potatoes as a side again. 3 stars for service because of how the rain was handled. We wanted to sit outside for the ambiance, but it rained. The servers/employees worked diligently to get the water screens down for every table except ours- even after we asked them to, it took a while. Wet rib eye was not as enjoyable as when it was dry. We'll still go back & hope for better service next time.

author: Maiara Pizzetti
review_text: This place is amazing is my 4th time here every time I'm in FL I stop by Great food, live dancers, great music very entertaining for all ages. Me and my family had a blast.

author: Xiomara Osrod
review_text: Since the moment you arrive at the valet, you feel so welcomed! The food is always SOOO good! The Opa Eggplant is amazing! And the lamb stew is my favorite. Ozkan, the server is a very professional waiter who takes care of every detail of your dinning experience. And I love all the dancers they are all beautiful, sweet girls 💝🙌

author: Hagz
review_text: I love Le Tub. It's a hidden gem! We come here every year when we visit Hollywood beach. The decor is made from a collection of old crab traps, driftwood, toilets (yes toilets) and other treasures found on the beach over the years super unique. There known for their amazing cheeseburgers very basic but huge and has that homemade backyard grill vibe I love it! Be careful how you order your cheeseburger if you say medium rare..it's going to be rare like blue...if you say medium it's going to be medium rare kind of confusing but that's how they get down at le tub lol...there greek salad is massive definitely feeds two maybe three...Good prices for the amount of food and quick service. Also awesome drinks! Amazing view of the inter coastal. You can see all the boats coming through and sometimes see fish jumping in and out of the water pretty awesome. 100% recommend!!

author: Jack Carello
review_text: I love Le Tub! The staff were friendly! The food was delicious! Very beautiful and detailed nautical and costal scenery in the interior! Plus you get a great view of the harbor! Without doubt worth going to! Have a great day!❤️🌊⚓️🔱⛵️😃🛟

author: Paul Ginnane
review_text: Old school “Roadhouse” feel place (without the fights!) that has great music, views and atmosphere! Great bar staff that will keep your drinks topped off and tons of stuff on the walls to keep your eyes wondering. Watched an awesome sunset from the deck seating area and enjoyed their classic burger and fries. Menu had some seafood that looked good too. Well worth the visit if in the area, I’ll be returning next time I’m in town.

author: Busi Ngwenya - Alexander
review_text: Le Tub was Le OK. Having to pay $3 to selfpark in their limited parking lot, is rarher silly. I am already about to go in and spend $17 on a burgerwith no fries? We ordered le burger and le lobster BLT, the egg nog and margaritas. The BLT came on a multi grain bread surprisingly. Such a delicate meat was overpowered by the bread choice I feel. Burger was ok, very tasty and juicy. Atmosphere was lovely, great views from the dock. Waitress was great. Nice to check it off the list, but most likely not worth a second visit.

author: Jennifer Elenbaas
review_text: This place was recommended by a friend for the shrimp. We went just before the dinner crowd got there. Parking is free if you are dining and leave within 2 hours. It’s a crowded area but in a cute way with lots of memorabilia. The sunset is beautiful for dinner time. The shrimp need to be peeled but the sauce is great with them. The smoked fish dip is also recommended and the vegetables with it were perfect. I had the fresh squeezed margarita, being a margarita lover this one was good but nothing new or special and served in a plastic cup. Overall I am glad we stopped in for a bite, if we were hungrier we would have tried that burger! Ps- don’t forget to get a photo at the front by the tub!

author: Tony Rosca
review_text: Le Tub Saloon – Hollywood, FL This place screams old-school Florida! Rustic, funky, and right on the water. The burgers are huge — juicy, perfectly grilled, and totally live up to the hype. Don’t come here if you’re in a rush though; service can be slow, but that’s part of the vibe. Grab a cold beer, chill by the Intracoastal, and enjoy the view. It’s got that laid-back beach shack energy that’s hard to find anymore. Must-try: The famous sirloin burger 🍔 Vibe: Quirky, chill, and unapologetically Florida 🌴

author: KB
review_text: Very cool spot on the water with a unique ocean vibe and tons of decorative pieces to show it (including tubs and toilets). The burger is large at 13 oz and was delicious, cooked perfectly.

author: Emre Acar
review_text: The place was very unique and beautiful; however, our burgers were a bit dry. The staff member who took care of us was very kind and attentive. We had a lovely time with our children. We would recommend it as a cozy spot by the water.

author: Yuley Gonzalez
review_text: Went during the week to treat myself to enjoy a beautiful view and dinner. Le Tub did not dissapoint. I was seated immediately even though I know the wait list is usually 30 minutes+ Cristina & Brianna quickly came over to say hello and help me decide on drinks & eats. Friendly & amazing service. They aim to please and make this a place you'd want to be a regular in. Must try the Steamed Shrimp & Le Burger. Cant wait to go back.

author: Anissa Be
review_text: A truly American bar experience! The place is very unique and beautifully designed, with an absolutely stunning sunset view. The burgers and ribs were delicious full of flavor and perfectly cooked. The only downside was the service: our waitress barely checked on us, which was disappointing. However, the rest of the staff seemed great and attentive. Overall, a memorable spot worth visiting for the atmosphere and food.

author: Kelly Bradbury
review_text: Perfect views, breezy, tropical; you can’t get anymore South Florida fun than Le Tub! Situated on the water of the intracoastal in beautiful Hollywood, Le Tub offers delicious appetizers and main dishes. Our family enjoyed the Caesar salad, Mahi sandwich, and every bite of Le Tub’s renowned hamburger. Our server, Jay, was friendly and professional. Our drinks were always refreshed when needed and our meals beautifully served. I highly recommend Le Tub for its delicious, fresh menu choices, excellent service, and delightful location. Pro tip: if needed, there is plenty of metered parking across the street (and a short walk) from the restaurant.

author: Israel Ortet
review_text: First time here. We came for the burger and it didn’t disappoint. It is big and delicious. The place has a unique feeling. Definitely coming back.

author: Maximilian
review_text: Le Tub gives funky Florida dive bar energy with huge burgers, rustic wood, a waterfront breeze…This place isn’t trying to be fine dining, it’s all about the character, the chaos, and that very specific “old Florida” charm. We ordered mahi mahi sandwich, a chicken club, burger, fries, etc. Portions are generous. Tastes solid. Is it going to blow your foodie mind? Nah. But does it hit the spot with a cold drink in hand while you’re sitting by the water? Absolutely. Service is on point, our server was chill, friendly, and way more attentive than I expected for a spot that feels like you should be barefoot.😅 Come here for the experience, not just the food. If you like quirky, tropical dives with character, this place is 100% a vibe.

author: Gege Miami
review_text: We ordered a burger cooked medium rare, but the experience was extremely disappointing. First, they brought us a patty that was completely burnt and dry — clearly overcooked. After we complained, they brought a replacement, but this time the burger was completely raw inside — cold, red, and visibly uncooked. We refused to pay for it, but the staff insisted that this was their standard for medium rare. That is simply not true. People at the next table agreed with us — they were also surprised that the restaurant considered this to be medium rare. Only thanks to a gentleman at the neighboring table who supported us and spoke up, the restaurant finally agreed to remove the burger from our bill. We were very disappointed with both the food and the staff’s attitude. We won’t be coming back.

author: Vanessa L.
review_text: What a lovely and unique dinning experience, I love the waterfront view, delicious food, great service and unique decor! We always come here when we are in Hollywood because its such a fun spot for dinner and drinks. Cant wait to be back again! Also management went above and beyond to a fix a little issue we had. I thoroughly appreciated that.

author: CHRIS PERRY
review_text: Great spot for a classic South Florida experience! The burger lives up to the hype — juicy, flame-grilled, and packed with flavor. The quirky, laid-back vibe with waterfront views makes it a perfect casual hangout. Service is friendly, and the atmosphere is pure local charm. Don’t expect fancy — just great food and a cool spot to kick back.

author: Jessica S
review_text: Overall our experience here was good, we only had s short wait to be seated unlike other reviews, and we were seated along the water. Double bonus! This place is super quirky and cute, the vibe is definitely beach shack, and the menu as well as how the food is served (paper plates etc) reflects that. Don't come here expecting a ton of food options, of fancy by any means, and if you have anyone picky in your group be sure to make sure theres something they will eat ahead of time. We did the BLT lobster sandwich and fries for $27 and the letub burger, our friends got the chicken sandwich and a salad. Overall the food was good. I would not say the burger is the best burger but it definitely was not bad. The lobster BLT was tasty, and it was the only entree that came with fries without the extra $6 charge. We would absolutely come back, and the vibe and location were lovely.

author: MAX POLOZANI
review_text: Best burger 🍔 joint around!! Great burgers & fries, awesome water views Highly recommend going for lunch or sunset

author: Kristin Weaver
review_text: Le Tub is a cool place to eat. Great water views. We had the Mahi sandwich, burger, fries and key lime pie for dessert. The food and drinks were awesome. Great,friendly service. Will definitely return!

author: Jim Schaefer
review_text: First time here, the menu is limited, the kids had the chicken BLT, which is huge and looks delicious and I just had the best oysters I’ve had in a long time. Brooke, our server was excellent and everyone here is very friendly. I would definitely come back to this place.

author: Brian Bush
review_text: Beautiful view. Food was good. Good menu. Bartenders/servers were great. Very small inside. There is outdoor seating as well.

author: Protective Dad Pranks
review_text: BEST CUBAN PANINI I’ve ever had! If you love Cuban sandwiches, you have to try the Cuban Panini here. The pork is slow-roasted overnight. And the flavors that comes from this sandwich is AMAZING! I love everything about this place from the decor to the location of the restaurant. With a phenomenal beach view and a laid-back setting. You can’t go wrong eating at Oceans 13. On the day of this review, I had a eight hour layover in Fort Lauderdale. So I rented a car and came here because of the Google reviews. Let me tell you this place does not disappoint. Phenomenal FOOD, LOCATION and STELLAR SERVICE! Easy 5-Star Review!

author: Edmond McClure
review_text: Great place right on the beach!!! The food and service were amazing. It was a perfect spot for our last night in FL before heading home.

author: Robert W. Rescue Beats AED
review_text: Vinny and Lisa and just as important the staff that works with them average best on the beach. Drinks, food, and service are way above others.

author: Ames Gonzalez
review_text: I cannot even begin to tell you how amazing this place is. First off the food is awesome! Perfect food after a day on the beach or after fishing etc. exactly the vibe! And the drinks are SOLID too! I had called last minute for a party of around 25 people for Saturday during their busy lunch hour. It was supposed to be a small lunch for my 9 year old son’s birthday. We originally had a different restaurant in mind but found out later on that several family members wanted to join us and the party got too large for the previous location. He was going deep sea fishing nearby with his friends earlier in the day and we needed a chill beach vibe that could accommodate a large party, this was perfect. They were so accommodating for my entire party! And even when his fishing trip was cut short because of bad weather and many guests had become sea sick, I called frantic and worried they wouldn't be able to accommodate us earlier than scheduled and they were already set up and prepared and told us to come on by whenever we were ready! We all showed up at different times because some family were coming from far away. All of the staff we met were very attentive, kind, calm, and everything was so smooth and took away all of my stress (as a mom, when your sons birthday gets ruined by weather/sea sickness and the restaurant staff are so welcoming and reassuring it helps SO much!) we all had a great time! We were able to bring a cake for him and then the staff EVEN did their own special birthday surprise for him! It was just SO sweet and special! I am really truly thankful to Oceans 13 for how well they handled everything, all the food they had to prepare… so many people in the same party ordering at different times. And they even gave the adults an extra Birthday “happy hour” form the bar to lighten the mood! Everyone was so impressed with this place. Just the absolute best! I don’t live super close but I will ABSOLUTELY travel to come back here and support them! So so thankful! Thank you guys so much for everything! You single handedly SAVED my sons birthday!

author: parisa ighani
review_text: We had their peel and ear shrimp, crab dip and chips, chipotle bowl, quesadillas, chicken tender, andddd steak Philly sandwich. Everything tasted great. We had an amazing View and the best server. Christie was amazing, sweet and attentive.

author: Dana McEvers
review_text: The food was bland, I hate it when cooks do not cook with salt. That tells me they know nothing about salt enhancing all the flavors together. Other than that...Mark was an awesome server and th view was perfect!

author: Breanna
review_text: Great place to eat on the boardwalk. Beautiful view of the ocean and tasty food! Our waiter was kind, quick, and attentive. Loved my Ocean Cobb salad!!! My only gripe is that I wish the drink menu had prices.

author: Jennelle Johnson
review_text: If you are looking for a beautiful, vibrant, ocean front establishment then you have found it! Oceans 13, where you can regularly find the owner Vinny. He is kind, fun and full of life just like the property that he owns!! The charismatic ocean blue interior reminds you that you are on the beach as you enjoy every sip of your cocktail with the amazing staff!!! Don't skip this little gem and their yummy menu while visiting the fun Hollywood Boardwalk!!

author: Jessica Coleman
review_text: Overall we were very disappointed with our experience. Our waiter seemed rushed and impatient. He rushed us when ordering and seemed annoyed when we needed something. The food was less than appetizing. The Cuban is apparently premade. My step dad asked to not have the relish on it and was told it’s premade and cannot be changed. It also didn’t taste good. The fries had no seasoning, the mashed potatoes seemed like instant potatoes, the snapper was ok but lacking flavor, and the crab dip was way overpriced for what it was. Overall I wouldn’t recommend dining here. We spent over $100 for 3 adults and 2 kids and McDonald’s would have been much better and less expensive.

author: Christine Eastvold
review_text: Absolutely amazing staff! Fabulous food! Don’t miss out on this hidden gem! I will be back soon! Thank you for an amazing afternoon!

author: Sarah L
review_text: We stopped in for dinner the night before we flew home and it was so worth it. We got the crab dip, lobster and shrimp empanadas and the Cash Cay fried seafood platter (all 3 are appetizers) and it was so much food. But worth it because it was *delicious* (the empanadas were my favourite). We had great service while sitting outside and watching the boardwalk/ocean. Highly recommend this stop if you’re in Hollywood Beach!

author: Brittany I (Mitts13)
review_text: I ate here with my friend 2 days in a row. The first day we had breakfast which was amazing and then the second day we had lunch since they opened later on weekdays. Both times were fabulous with great service! Drinks were amazing! We ate the bacon egg and cheese sandwich, grits, eggs Benedict, turkey club, and blackened mahi tacos. Great atmosphere, good music, great service! Awesome view of the boardwalk too!

author: Verouska Ferrario
review_text: Great location and lovely customer service. Food was a bit of a mixed bag. The tuna nachos were excellent. The fried seafood platter was a good size but fries were soggy and fritters overdone. Key lime pie was ok (but I'd get rid of that artificial radioactive looking syrup). Overall a nice experience anyway, prices are good for the area.

author: Tiffany Roldan-Howell
review_text: My friend and I came to do a sunrise meditation for her bday and after stopped by here for breakfast. The views are amazing for sure, but what really stands out is the service. It was 8:30 am and both the servers were so nice and welcoming. The food and drinks were really good and the executive chef Vinny even came out to say hello and happy birthday to my friend. You can tell this place is has a family dynamic and that’s a lost art now and days in the restaurant industry. Would recommend this to anyone & Will definitely be coming back!

author: Sarah Slatniske
review_text: If you’re like us and not from the area and this place comes up nearby… GO EAT HERE!! 100/10 experience. Menu was amazing!! Decently priced. Great staff and wonderful owner. Family friendly!! Perfect privately owned place at the beach and the food was amazing.

author: Jacob Hill
review_text: Our visit to Oceans 13 on the beach in Hollywood was nothing short of fantastic! From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with warmth and hospitality. The Ahi Tuna Nachos were a delightful start to our meal, absolutely mouthwatering. My son was thrilled with his chicken tenders, and the complementary fries were a thoughtful touch from the manager. The service was fantastic & the bartender went above and beyond to ensure we had a great time. The ambiance was perfect for a relaxing evening, with stunning views of the beach. Plus, my son couldn't stop talking about the extra cherries in his Shirley Temple! We're already looking forward to our next visit. Highly recommend Oceans 13 for a memorable dining experience by the sea!

author: Scott Richardson
review_text: Great sandwiches and wraps. Appetizer sampler was very mid. Want to watch football games on a Saturday because they have lots of screens and games on which is great, but no TVs were turned up and all you heard was worn out music. It was ok, but there are too many other places to spend our time than going back here.

author: Lori Villani
review_text: Nice and clean! Katie was AMAZING! Fun, spunky, beautiful inside and out. Go to Oceans 13 on Hollywood boardwalk for sure. Great atmosphere, great food & drinks and the servers are excellent!

author: Joanna Osborne
review_text: Sooooooooooo after COVID, they started opening later on Sundays, but we're early birds, so we started going to another restaurant on the beach. Today while walking to the other place, we realized they were back open early on Sundays, and we got extremely excited. So we are back eating at our Oceans 13 spot. Today, I had the lobster frittata, and it was delicious. I also had a mimosa, which was Amazing!! So glad they are back open early!!! The best on the Beach!!

author: Natalia Ciobanu
review_text: TIKI TIKI – Hollywood, FL We had a lovely dining experience at TIKI TIKI, a waterfront restaurant with a relaxed, tropical atmosphere. The décor is casual and inviting, and the setting by the water really adds to the charm. One of the highlights is that boats can dock directly next to the restaurant deck, which gives the place a unique marina vibe and makes it especially enjoyable. The food was mostly excellent. We had fresh raw oysters, a very flavorful seafood chowder, and the pasta with lobster was delicious, rich, and well prepared. The cocktails were also very good — refreshing and nicely balanced. The only downside was the stone crab, which unfortunately was a bit overcooked and didn’t quite meet expectations (as in my food experience in Keys 😉 )compared to the rest of the meal. Overall, it was a pleasant experience with quality ingredients, a beautiful waterfront setting, and a great atmosphere. With a bit more attention to cooking the seafood, this place could be outstanding.☺️

author: Bello Solano
review_text: We had a great experience at Tiki Tiki. We were able to pull up in our boat, and staff immediately came over to help us tie up at the dock, which was a huge plus. Service was excellent—everyone was attentive, friendly, and quick. Our drinks came out fast, and the food followed not long after. The chicken wings had great flavor without being overly salty, which can sometimes happen with Asian-inspired sauces. The kids’ chicken tenders were a generous portion and surprisingly flavorful. The grouper tacos could’ve used a touch more salt, but that was easily fixed at the table. The coconut shrimp were delicious—perfectly cooked with a dipping sauce that paired really well. Overall, a great spot with solid service and tasty food. We’ll definitely be back!

author: Adam Zdeb
review_text: We love this place for the reason we were able to bring our dog 🐶 with us to eat. Verry solid food with great views on the water. The Best item we had was the Key lime pie in a jar, it was a great spin on the classic and we enjoyed it a lot. For the food it was all solid but nothing was mind-blowing. The tiki tiki chicken was juicy but the rice under needed a bit more flavor. Fish tacos were well cooked had good flavor. The fish and chips had great flavor in the batter bit just too much batter. And my fish sandwich was blackened but it was missing that blackened spice. We really liked the tuna nachos because the flavors were on point and the chips super light and crunchy.

author: hungryhappyhippo
review_text: Great location, good food and immaculate vibes. FYI there’s valet parking only $5 but worth it in my opinion. The valet was super nice, I forgot my phone in the car and he brought it in to the waitress. I sat outside right by the water for a beautiful sunset dinner and boat watching. The vibes are chic coastal. I had Lobster Rigatoni and a mocktail. And the serving size was great and good amount of lobster meat in there. Be mindful that once it started to get dark I could feel like bugs biting me since I was by the water. Other than that the bathrooms were clean and decorated with fun vintage photos. Love this place, would come again.

author: Jilla Marie
review_text: Great service and a great Friday bar experience overall. Got the for the start of HH when the bar was 95% vacant. Had a very reasonably priced seafood/shellfish platter and a couple of tasty drinks. Would visit again because the location and vibe is great!

author: IDProductionsIT LLC
review_text: The atmosphere 👌 is top tier Food is very decent and priced well, mostly under $40 averaging around $20-$30 a plate. Salmon was very well cooked, but the rice 🍚 pared with it was bland Shrimp pasta was nice but a little too heavy on the sauce, if they would have lightened up the sauce a bit, it would have been much better The key lime was a 6 out of 10, I bit sour and I never had it in a cup 🥤 not a brilliant move The chocolate cake was a tad rich for me, but my party liked it. Andrew was a great server

author: J.W. Werner
review_text: Even though this place was busy I was still able to get a table for one fairly quickly. It is beautifully decorated with the South Florida vibe. You may have to wait a little extra, but you might consider asking for a waterside table. Just be prepared that you may be in the sun. But it’s worth it. This sweet tea is pretty good and I ordered the Smoked Fish Dip, Key West Pasta, a side of coleslaw, and the Sticky Toffee Cake for dessert. The smoked fish dip was good. I do think it had a little too much jalapeño that was overpowering the smoked fish. Maybe less jalapeño and add a hint of lemon or lime. I squeezed some lime for my tea and it was great. The coleslaw had a really good flavor and texture, but a little dry. I like my slaw a little wetter. The Key West Pasta was fabulous! The linguine was perfectly cooked and so were the shrimp. The sauce was extremely flavorful, almost like an Italian tomato-vodka sauce. The crispy, crunchy toasted bread was a perfect match. The Sticky Toffee Cake was really buttery rich and flavorful but mine was a tad on the dry side. Still a great finish to the meal. The waterside tables and atmosphere was inviting and super relaxing. At least 6-7 boats honked their horns as their passengers waved at the dock side guests. One boat even docked at the restaurant and those aboard came into the restaurant to dine. The staff was very friendly and attentive too.

author: Angeli Paray
review_text: Excellent brunch! We had bottomless mimosas and our server truly made sure my glass was never empty. Great location on the inlet so yes there are seats directly next to the water. Lots of umbrellas for shade and more than enough space for large parties. Our server was running around on double time taking care of all of the tables. The food, was excellent. We had the banana bread which came out hot and fresh. The coconut shrimp had this great mango salsa that gave it a fresh acidic flavor. Steak tacos were flavorful and cooked correctly so it was tender and soft. The lobster roll had full on clumps of lobster meat which you can clearly see is fresh and not from a can. The chicken wings were also very well seasoned and nice and crispy. Overall we had an amazing experience and the food did not disappoint. There is only valet parking for $5 unless you want to park across the street and walk.

author: Dolly
review_text: To start off, our waitress Karla was amazing! This was our first time here and I came with my fur baby. We were in the area and decided to give this place a shot. As New Yorkers, we were beyond impressed! The food was amazing! The seafood was fresh, that’s all that matters. To top it off, the peach cobbler was to die for. I’m just thinking about it and drooling. I would definitely go back, your $$ will be well spent. Take my word for it! Ooo the valet personnel was very nice and friendly. She was on a roll!

author: Michelle Medrek
review_text: Tiki Tiki has quickly become one of our favorite spots, especially for their outstanding ceviche! It's absolutely delicious, bursting with flavor, and the fish is incredibly fresh--definitely a must-try! I typically indulge in their amazing churrasco steak, but I find that the ceviche leaves me feeling satisfied every time. My partner usually opts for a fish dish, but he decided to switch it up with the fish and chips this time, and we were thrilled! The fish was lightly battered, cooked to perfection, and the flavor and texture were simply excellent. The staff is wonderful, and the bartenders are always welcoming. Plus, the view of the intercoastal and watching the boats pass by adds to the charm. It's the perfect spot for a romantic date or a fun outing with the whole family. After every meal, we always ask ourselves, "Would we come back?" The answer is a resounding yes! We'll definitely be returning!

author: Jeff Bell
review_text: Amazing spot for great service and fantastic food. We had the watermelon margarita, seafood platter, tuna poke, and the spicy salmon crunchy rice. Our server, Mila, was very attentive and helpful. It was all incredible and well returning!

author: Briana Villanueva
review_text: Food was great, server was kind, and the chocolate cake was to die for. The parking situation was rough, very small lot and they charge $5 for valet, which isn’t a big deal but they don’t actually give you an option to park your own car?

author: PATHY MURDOCK
review_text: I loved the location of this restaurant with its beautiful ocean view, the music was incredible, the service was good, the sea bass was delicious, and the cocktails were amazing. I recommend it 100% The Sunset was Phenomenal!!❤️

author: Tasheena S
review_text: I hidden gem! I came here for a solo brunch date on a Saturday. The service and views were perfect. This is the perfect hidden gem. Restaurants by the water is always so beautiful. The food was delicious! I decided to have the red snapper and eggs. It was so good. I can't wait to visit again to try something else off the menu.

author: Amanda E.
review_text: Awesome experience. Such a perfect, open air, al-fresco ambiance. The food has been outstanding each time, this is my third visit. I plan to continue going.
