It’s right on the water so I’d say they need to just improve the conditions of the outdoor seating from the mosquito overtaking. Aside from that, kind and attentive servants and bomb music. Chill vibes.

author: Jon Nakamura
review_text: Tiki Tiki in Hollywood, Florida is a laid-back waterfront escape with a breezy island vibe. The open-air patio overlooks the Intracoastal, making it perfect for sunset cocktails. Their menu features fresh seafood, casual bites, and tropical drinks made with care. With live music, friendly service, and a chill, coastal charm, it’s a great spot to unwind and soak in sunny South Florida.

author: Melissa Lapin
review_text: Absolutely fantastic place. Doc-side dining for the win. The whole experience was fabulous. The menu selection was good. Our food was delicious and our waiter Hector was a dream!!

author: Julia Oliveira
review_text: This place is so pretty, especially at night. The hosts give you a table immediately and the servers are always available. The food is really good as well. I've been there 3 times already and i loved it every time.

author: carolina Bolanos
review_text: Every time I go to the beach, I have to come eat at this delicious Tiki Tiki restaurant, as I love all the food!!! It feels super fresh, the atmosphere and the service are spectacular, in addition to the beautiful view, if you are near Hollywood or Davie you cannot miss this spectacular restaurant, my husband loves the oysters and I of course the shrimp! Dishes that I highly recommend in addition to their wonderful cocktails, I also have to highlight the espresso Martini, you have to try it.

author: Celeste Kerina
review_text: LOVED EVERYTHING! The gracious services, attention from management and the attention to detail for our food allergies. The food was DELICIOUS. This will be our new go to spot!

author: N J
review_text: Awesome location right along the beach. Service was great and they were all nice. I ordered the mariner platter and it was delicious. Breading was falling off of the fish but it was still good. Nice happy hour specials as well. If you are allergic to bees might want to make sure you have your epi as they are all over.

author: Mark VanPatton
review_text: Had time to kill waiting on our flight. Party of 3 with luggage and the waitress was nice and told us we could have our bags by us. And we could hang out for a few hours no problem! Very good food and great service! Liked the location and the atmosphere. Ubered over and quick seating outside. Honestly didn't look around. 2 burgers and the fish tacos. Chips and salsa. Overall experience very good! Highly Recommended-MVP

author: Carolina Diaz
review_text: The food itself wasn’t anything extraordinary for my taste. I found it a bit bland and lacking in seasoning, so it didn’t really stand out compared to other places. What truly made the visit worthwhile was the service. Samaira was absolutely exceptional, attentive, warm, and genuinely caring throughout the entire experience. She went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable, and her professionalism and kindness left a lasting impression. Without her, the experience would have felt very average, but thanks to her, we felt truly valued as guests. On the other hand, the drinks were quite disappointing. We tried the piña colada, but it tasted more like sugar water than a proper cocktail. We even had to ask to change it for something else, which is surprising given the $13 price tag. For that cost, you’d expect a much higher standard. The location itself is a strong point, spacious, right by the beach, and with beautiful views. With better consistency in the food and drinks, this place could match the level of service provided by Samaira.

author: Mariah Matt
review_text: Lucky Fish @luckyfishbeachbar 📍Dania Beach, FL Follow @eatzwithsweetz on ig and fb for more! Such a great spot only steps away from the beach! Here's what I had: Kiwi Melon Daiquiri Mermaid Water Rum Punch @ketelone Espresso Martini Tuna Poke Nachos Crispy Calamari Island Chopped Salad with shrimp Florida Fish Sandwich Fried Oreos Key Lime Pie Everything was great! Cant wait to visit again! When are you pulllin up to Lucky Fish? #LuckyFish #DaniaBeach #BeachBar #Seafood #Fresh #OceanBreeze #Poke #MermaidWater #KetelOne #BeachFood #Oceanfront #Vibes #LetsDrinkz #EatzWithSweetz #LetsEatz

author: Ronette Yarbrough
review_text: We love going to Lucky Fish Bar & Grill in Dania Beach. It’s our go to place when we want to have a relaxing lunch or dinner. The food is great! No matter what we have it comes out perfect. My favorite is the shrimp tacos. I get them fried. So yummy. I think I have tried most of the seafood on the menu and everything is great. My husband’s favorite are the chicken tenders and chicken Mediterranean wrap. Our favorite server is Zoe!! She is the best. So friendly, sweet, helpful. We always ask for her. The managers are awesome too. Kevin and Shane always stop by to see how we are doing. Lucky Fish is a great addition to Dania Beach!!

author: John Sutton
review_text: Let me start with the service, if there was a way to give them 4.9 Stars that's what I would give them. They were a little slow with service in the beginning. Because I think it was shift turnover. Otherwise the little gal that helped us was fantastic. I had two Lucky's Rum Punch, and they were pretty good. Had we more time, I'd have probably ordered a third or more. My wife ordered a watermelon Mojito and it was very good. Didn't detect very much watermelon but that is such a delicate flavor, the drink was still very good. I had the Traditional Fishing Village salad, which is a Greek salad and I added blackened Mahi Mahi. That fish was cooked perfectly, to my tastes, I know that your mileage may vary! The dressing was mild and the red onions were a little hotter than I'd like, but my experience lately is that all red onions have been hotter, which means that either my tastes are changing, or the onion crop this year was different. I regret that I did not get a picture of this, we just come off of a cruise and I was not in the taking pictures of my food mode. My wife ordered the blackened mahi mahi version of the Hooked Up Tacos, she said they were excellent, it's fair to mention we had a pretty good amount of seafood on our cruise and no Mexican cuisine. So she may have been a little bit hungry for the tacos, but that fish was very good! I like the atmosphere of this place, The View can't be beat and the Pagoda over the bar is massive and very cool. We sat at one of the covered high tops and that was additive to our lunch. We shared a piece of key lime pie, and since we had just come off of that cruise we had more than a little bit of experience with nicer desserts. I know that not everyone has the same requirement from Key Lime pie, but for us, this was amazing! We had key lime pie on probably three different meals, and this easily surpassed all of them. This place was a little pricey, but not expensive by any stretch. If I lived nearby, this place would be a regular stop.

author: Kiana Braun
review_text: Honestly the only thing that saves this place is the location. The French fries tasted like they had sat in a porta potty so I’m not sure if they just use way too strong of cleaner in the kitchen or if they were using a cleaner while cooking the food but I couldn’t eat them. The smash burger also had no flavor, it is a seafood place so hopefully the seafood is better. My other issue with this place was the outfits the waitresses and hostess were wearing, they were terrible and not flattering at all. This place would be great if the food was 10x better and they allowed these ladies to wear proper clothing that actually fit them because the views and the vibes were great!

author: Alisa M.
review_text: Lucky Fish in Dania has everything going for it—amazing views, great food, and drinks that hit the spot. It’s the kind of place you want to spend hours at, just soaking it all in. The only downside was the service; our server kept asking if we needed a box every 15 minutes, even though we clearly weren’t done and had plans for two more rounds of beer. We hadn’t even finished our drinks when the check arrived. It’s such a great place to enjoy yourself—if they let you! 😂 Unfortunately, we ended up leaving early.

author: Melissa C
review_text: We came on our one night before our cruise, and the food was solid. Very flavorful, fresh, and great portions. The staff were friendly and attentive. The food came out quicker than expected, and nice and hot. The sauces with our calamari and the coconut shrimp appetizers were so good as well as the mango pineapple salsa that came on our dishes. Having a beach view was icing on the cake. We had a great time!

author: Harry Plendl
review_text: There’s the usual busy crowd from the beach, tourists, locals who are obsessed with being at the beach. Come during a storm and it is your play ground. Otherwise it is a beehive of activity. The food is above par for the course when it comes to bar food. It’s nice island vibe. What needs improvement is there should be a food allergy codex for the menu. What is halal what is kosher, what has the gluten monsters in it? Actually add some stuff that’s gluten free and we’re on the right track . The staff is great. They need to authorized to wear crocs or proper footwear for wet and humid climates. It’s raining half the time and wearing wet shoes and socks is crazy. Want to talk about safety? Listen to a podcast on trench foot. I know no one reads at insurance companies or else their documents wouldn’t suck so bad. I’ll be back.

author: LH Smith
review_text: Emillie is always there for Amanda and me. Not only is the newly constructed bar clean and aesthetically appealing, along with the views being amazing, the service is warm, friendly, attentive and FUN!!! Excellent salmon and rice dish, too.

author: Kenn P
review_text: It has a dark moody beach vibe. It's paid street parking. On Fridays they have live music. It feels more like for an older crowd, 40+. It's up close to the water and at sunset its really nice. There's 3 TVs for sports, but not really a sports bar. Large selection of beers close to 40 if I had to guess. Come with your own crowd and make the good times happen.

author: Barrie Waisserberg
review_text: This place is the perfect beach scene. Since it's raised up, the ocean view is great. There is live music 6-9 weekdays and 3 - 6 weekends. Prices are surprisingly reasonable for a restaurant on the beach. Overall, Nice, fun experience.

author: John Fronczak
review_text: First time here. Being a local I usually stay in my local spots but decided to venture out to Dania Beach. We came here to Lucky Fish. What a great discovery. Fabulous place. Food, price atmosphere and the service. Rachael was the best. Attentive, funny, prompt and excellent customer service. 5⭐️ When in Dania I recommend coming here and asking for Rachael. You won’t be disappointed. 🍺👍🏻

author: Tasheena S
review_text: My coworkers and I stopped here for a bite to eat. It was a Friday afternoon around 2pm. We were seated immediately. Our waitress was super friendly. The restaurant was super quiet and relaxing. The ocean views and breeze really did add to the ambiance. I had the grilled mahi mahi. It was pretty good. I would definitely return especially after a long day at work.

author: robert hawkins
review_text: Stopped for breakfast with friends between cruise pickup and airport drop off. Beautiful beachside venue with a nice view of Dania Beach. The food was delicious and the service was very attentive. An all around great experience.

author: Vanessa Diaz
review_text: We wanted to spend a relaxing and memorable afternoon with my family. We found this lovely place with a perfect view, and the food was amazing! We ordered fish and chips, and since the portion was generous, I shared it with my husband—it was more than enough. Such a blessed afternoon :)

author: Joaquin Urbonas Alvarez
review_text: Great food and drinks very reasonable prices and even better ambiance and view. Will definitely come back. Shame in you miami for not having nothing remotely close to this .

author: Kiah J
review_text: Perfect oceanfront breakfast/lunch spot. Ate breakfast then came back to order lunch and eat on the beach. Loved my breakfast burrito and their fresh mango salsa. We ordered the mahi mahi for lunch and it was delicious along with the mixed veggies. All the drinks I ordered from the bar were nice and strong. Service was fast and the servers were so nice I really enjoyed this spot.

author: Liz Selles
review_text: I'll be honest, I wasn't expecting much from a beachside restaurant. But boy was I wrong. We went on a Friday around 2:30 pm. It was a beautiful day so this was the perfect spot. The food was so good. And so were the drinks. And very reasonably priced. But my favorite part was Amanda our bartender. She was awesome and my Sea Breeze was perfection. Took great care of us. Can't wait to come back. And a shout out to manager Shane. Great job. Thank you.

author: Trey Neely
review_text: This place is awesome. 100% delivered for exactly what I needed in the moment I was there. I was in town for a work event on the beach and was traveling in a large truck with a trailer. Miami isn't exactly made for this type of transportation, so when I found Duffy's with the huge parking lot - I was very relieved. I was tired, and hungry, and didn't want to deal with a crowd. When I walked in, I was immediately surprised by how huge it was! I can imagine this place is hugely popular for big sport days. I went outside and easily found a seat at the bar. It's next to a POOL, which had no one in it at the time, but I'm sure it's awesome when in use. My bartender was KiKo and he was on fire. He had the whole outdoor bar to himself and was taking excellent care of everyone. Very impressive! The food was pretty good. The calamari was great and I was in the mood for chicken tenders, so I wasn't very adventurous, but they were good! Beer was cold and Kiko never left me hanging empty. Another big plus when you sit outdoors is the scenery. You're right on the water and get to see all the high end yachts come through...saw some amazing million dollar yachts pass by. All in all - if you want an EASY, well serviced, good bar food type experience - Duffy's is THE PLACE. Highly recommend!

author: Tracy Andrews
review_text: If you're in Miami. Please make this your place for Lunch, Dinner or snack!! Had no idea that I was walking into Paradise! I will be back with more people!! Thank you for showing love to me on my Birthday 🎂! Food and Drinks (2for1)💕 are out of this world! So, was I when I finished!! LOL

author: Robert Taylor
review_text: This is one of the nicest Duffy I’ve been to. Located right next to the water with outdoor dining amazing view. Bartender Tina is amazing, very welcoming. She suggested the daily special which was amazing. Thank you Duffys for another great time.

author: Roxanne Raphael
review_text: Tony was amazing! It was so nice to be sitting out by the water enjoying good food! My friend and I had the chicken nachos and we split the firecracker shrimp.....scrumptious! The drinks (espresso martini and cosmos) were delicious and potent. I will definitely be back!

author: Aquarius Dawn Nancy
review_text: Wendy, the beautiful bartender is the bomb! I ordered the tasty All-American hot dog. It was very well done as I requested . My old fashioned Arnold Palmer was the the best I ever had made! Love North Miami Beach Duffy's Oliver took me to. He always takes me out and I appreciate him for always covering and making sure I get enough drinks!

author: Mistique Hernandez
review_text: The food was great and the atmosphere was lovely. Our waitress was Kayla she was efficient and nice. She even sang happy birthday to my friend twice which made the experience fun and playful. It was a great time. Highly recommend.

author: Carla
review_text: I had the firecracker shrimp tacos bomb. Com. Lol my cousin had them first and recommended them. So freaking good. The staff at the front bar was more attentive than the one closer to where the music is playing hit still good vibes overall and I just realized it's 2 for 1 drinks, all day everyday. I wish I didn't read that but lol that's a great deal especially in this economy. I have no complaints the djs on the weekend really get this place jumping. Pure good vibes. I will be back again and again ✨

author: Ciara
review_text: i love this spot so much, best calamari and 2 for 1 drinks all day! last night i had the pleasure of having Tony as my server and he was the BEST server i’ve had at any restaurant recently. he was consistent, funny, fast, and on point! the other servers who brought our food out were great as well. i also had the ribs that were falling straight off the bone and seasoned so well. if you come to this location, ask for Tony!!

author: lea'nora spencer
review_text: I came in on Monday and had an amazing experience thanks to my server Nehry!She was attentive, friendly, and made sure everything was perfect from start to finish. The service was quick, professional, and welcoming. She truly made the visit enjoyable and I’ll definitely be back!

author: Life Of Glo
review_text: I love coming here especially when Nehry is working! She’s such a sweet, caring server. She’s persistent always make sure the orders are done correctly, that we’re okay, & enjoying our food & drinks. I haven’t been seeing her much but i hope that she’s still there & to keep hiring great employees like her. Beautiful young lady!

author: J L
review_text: * I'm updating my review - down two stars. The last 2 times I've been this month the service is abysmal. Management doesn't care. The one male bartender is a joke. Seriously. Btw, I earned A LOT of rewards on my card. i.e. Ive spent money. Act like you care. Went recently for the first time and was pleasantly pleased. Picked a very slow day to get a real experience. My burger was cooked exactly how I wanted it, as well my fries were nice and hot. Winning. The server was also very attentive. This is when you know. They also have an interesting rewards system so I'll be taking advantage of that. It's a large space with awesome views and will be back soon. Thanks again.

author: Carol ODell
review_text: Excellent food cooked exactly as requested! The meal was awesome and Yoshi was more than helpful with his service. On our table was, a medium burger, full rack of ribs and a rib/shrimp plate. The sides were delicious as well with no room for dessert! Overall was a great place, great dinner, great experience. Do yourself a favor and go!!

author: Tiphanie Wright
review_text: Nehry was absolutely amazing from the moment we arrived—she was patient, attentive, warm, and made us feel genuinely welcomed. She was super nice and very intentional with our table, always checking in at just the right moments. Her service was fast, efficient, and she listened carefully to everything we needed. You can tell she cares about her guests and takes pride in providing great service.

author: Michael Robert
review_text: Food was very good and not overpriced. The place was very busy during Sunday foorball. The server who was handling our table was overwhelmed. Luis, who has working another area, noticed she was behind and got our food and drink order in. Good group of people there.

author: Gabriella L
review_text: I came with my homegirls and we had a great time. Great vibes and our server Nehry was 10/10!!! Very attentive, funny, welcoming and beautiful. She made the experience more comfortable. The food and drinks were great. Would come again!!

author: Joseph Flagge
review_text: I would give them ZERO stars if I could. Even though all was pretty good. The listed kids eat free on Dec 10, 2035 and a visit with Santa Claus. I paid the bill and realized that they DID charge us for the Kids Meal despite the waiter stating YES, Kids Eat Free Tonight! I live in the community and used to come to this place a lot but after tonight I am done and I will make sure to let other know about this scam!

author: Simone
review_text: Absolutely unacceptable! I was served a drink with two bottle caps sitting at the bottom of the glass. This isn’t just careless; it’s a serious hygiene and safety issue. Completely ruined my experience, and I would never recommend this place to anyone until they seriously rethink their quality control.

author: Anthony Torres
review_text: Lovely place! My family and I went for my brother’s bday dinner tonight, attention was great, food was delicious and 2 for 1 drinks amazing! Lovely Sofia took care of us and made our experience fabulous. Will come back!

author: Andre E
review_text: I had such a wonderful experience at Duffy’s Sports Grill recently, thanks to our amazing server, Keyra. From the moment we were seated, Keyra greeted us with a friendly smile and made us feel right at home. She was attentive without being overbearing, checked in often to make sure we had everything we needed, and handled our table with genuine warmth and professionalism. The food was fantastic everything came out hot, fresh, and perfectly prepared but it was really Keyra’s excellent service that made the meal so enjoyable. She made great recommendations, kept our drinks full, and made sure every detail was just right.

author: Tabitha Hall
review_text: This place! Was fantastic!! On my first night in town, we laughed, we ate, we danced, we partied, and we had such a great time! Duffy's was a 10 out 10. The dj really kept the night going!! Being next to water, enjoying great food, great friends, and craft music was just what this tourists needed to settle in to Miami!; To get the feel of the Saturday night life for those want to have a great time, meet new people, and listen to a huge variety of music. I will definitely be back on my next trip.

author: Rawlins Amar
review_text: We took our friend for her 70 th birthday our experience was not very good. The server was rude rude his mannerisms not of the caliber to be a server. We had to leave the premises before something unpleasant happened. I would not recommend this restaurant to anyone neither would I return. I feel though the food has some quality and the chefs knows what they are about however the front line people need some attention. We came because we saw an add on the Google chat about the restaurant and what they do for brunch this was totally misrepresented. Nothing on the add came to past. The restaurant had nobody.

author: Levent T
review_text: I can say almost perfect. Service and atmosphere is very good. Kitchen if we speak about appetizers 5 over 5, about seafood they know what they are doing 5 over 5, just steak cuts and cooking NY steak and serving that average, it was cold we told server and they act immediately and changed with new one but unfortunately also second one was cold and the cut was wrong and chewy but steak quality was delicious . It is worth to go again but you will definitely order seafood

author: Joelle Fhima-Berdowski
review_text: After a long travel day, Mykonos was the perfect place to enjoy a delicious meal with a view. Our waitress Valentina was wonderful and so attentive. She recommended the Special Greek Salad and lamb chops. Both were delicious and did not disappoint. If you love an Old Fashioned, you must try their Greek Old Fashioned… it’s nothing like we’ve tasted before. We loved our experience, the service and food so much that we’re coming back with our family in a couple of weeks… can’t wait!!!

author: Mariam A
review_text: What a hidden gem! Was looking for a waterfront restaurant to celebrate my 30th birthday at and found Mykonos kitchen and bar last minute. Decided to give it a try and I am so happy we did. Our server Valentina was the absolute sweetest server. She was so accommodating to everything our family of 4 needed, which included an infant and a toddler. The food was good. The atmosphere was perfect. There was live music on a Friday night. Thank you to the singer and the crew for singing the happy birthday song for me. We really enjoyed our dinner here!!!

author: Emily Etman
review_text: We had Family dinner there. A cozy and beautiful Mediterranean restaurant with a stunning water view. The atmosphere is warm and inviting—perfect for a relaxed quiet dinner. The food is absolutely delicious: all appetizers where top of the line, especially the grilled octopus, which was tender, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. Every detail, from the presentation to the taste, reflects authentic Greek cuisine. lamb shank, souvlaki, lamp chops 👍 A must try lava cake for desert ! A wonderful spot to enjoy great food and wine while watching the water.

author: Diana Mendelson
review_text: Food was really good but hot food was served before cold food/salads which is very weird. I wish service was better, our server wasn’t that good - seemed new. Food took some time to come out even though it was relatively empty for Father’s Day… idk probably not coming back unless someone else makes the rezzo.

author: Jennifer Sellers
review_text: This place was wonderful. Beautiful views and great vibes. We came with a group of 13 for a bachelorette party dinner. The food was delicious. The live music was also so nice! Highly recommend the meatballs and the halloumi. The server and staff did a great job!

author: Berta Gonzalez-Eloy
review_text: We had an amazing experience at Mykonos Kitchen and Bar! The service, especially from Matias, was excellent — he was incredibly attentive and made sure we had everything we needed throughout our meal. The quality of the food was absolutely incredible, every dish was full of flavor and beautifully presented. The view was very nice, and the atmosphere was warm and inviting. The live music was definitely a plus and made the evening even more enjoyable. Highly recommend!

author: Anzhelika S
review_text: I think it’s one of the best Greek restaurants in Miami. The amount of detail put into the decor and atmosphere, it looks very authentic. The food is on another level, every single dish is top! I celebrated my mom’s birthday there recently and it was perfect.

author: Michelle Rowlands
review_text: I absolutely loved it! The food was amazing. Service was good. Not too over the top & not lacking either. I went for Sunday brunch. Prices were pretty good especially for the amount of food. Would highly recommend. My husband actually went back that same evening to meet some colleagues. If I lived closer, I would definitely be dining at least once a week.

author: Moshe
review_text: Very nice place. Location is amazing, right on the calm waters of the canal. Romantic if you are looking for a date night. We had lamb shank and scallops. Wine selections were good. The interesting thing was, even though this is a Greek spot, they also have sushi.

author: Sofia Varela
review_text: Such a nice spot. Im traveling for work and staying nearby and the food was fresh! amazing branzino papillote. The service was friendly and made me feel at home. The manager came by to check on me, which I thought was a really nice touch! the place was empty but Valentina and the manager really took care of me.

author: Nick Diamantidis
review_text: I would definitely recommend this restaurant. The food was excellent, and the staff were very friendly. Matias did his best to take great care of us. We will certainly come back again!

author: Joanne Bowie Alvarez
review_text: It was a great spot – we arrived right at opening, so it wasn’t crowded, and the food was fantastic. They have live music on Fridays and Saturdays, plus valet parking or a nearby parking lot. The outdoor area is absolutely breathtaking, and the chef’s ceviche was delicious and very flavorful! Overall, an amazing experience! Margarita welcomed us warmly as we walked in, and our bartender, Sebastian, was very nice.

author: Kylie Camarda
review_text: Beautiful restaurant, food was amazing, and our server Valentina and the whole staff made our experience absolutely perfect! Highly recommend

author: Laura Castaneda
review_text: I went last night for dinner with my family and we completely enjoyed it since the first moment we walked in, everybody were so friendly. The environment was fabulous, nice music, beautiful place. Food was outstanding that i cant even explain how delicious it was. Wonderful service, always checking on us and making sure we were having a good time. I totally recommend it. They have a new fusion menu with sushi which let me tell u is the best in town and a wonderful seafood platter. THE BEST!!! I will definitely be back!!!!

author: Jeniffer Reyes
review_text: Matias was a great server but food was mediocre at best.. they offer free desert for the review… I guess now you know why they’re so highly rated! Come here for drinks skip the rest.

author: Stasi Michailidis
review_text: Absolutely fantastic experience at Mykonos Greek Restaurant in Sunny Isles! We hosted a group of 25 people, and the evening could not have been more perfect. From the moment we walked in, the manager Natalia and her incredible staff went above and beyond to ensure our event was magical. Every detail was thoughtfully attended to, and we truly felt like we were in the best hands. The food was out of this world – authentic, fresh, and bursting with flavor! From the appetizers to the main courses, every dish was a hit, with the grilled octopus and lamb chops stealing the show. The ambiance was second to none – a perfect blend of warm Greek hospitality and a lively, beautiful setting that transported us straight to the islands. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Thank you, Natalia, and the entire team at Mykonos for making our evening unforgettable! Highly recommend for anyone looking for an exceptional dining experience.

author: Andreina Salazar
review_text: Delicious food, beautiful place, and amazing service! Roberto was super attentive and helpful, and the whole staff was incredible. Thank you for a great experience! I truly enjoyed it and highly recommend this restaurant. I’ll definitely be back!

author: Colt Murgio
review_text: Mykonos is a unique Greek fusion restaurant featuring high-end Greek dishes. We booked a reservation for 11 people and were very flexible on the timing, as we ended up being an hour late. Once we arrived, we got seated immediately at the table. Also, we noticed the beautiful decor and atmosphere. We ordered a variety of appetizers and entrees. I will say I was a little disappointed with the lack of service, considering only a handful of tables were occupied. The food tasted amazing, with my favorite being the lamb chops. Overall, I would come back here and have a great meal.

author: Irina Uvarova
review_text: This is hands down the best hookah lounge for me and honestly one of my favorite places in Miami. I’ve been coming here since the very opening, and after the latest full remodel the place looks absolutely amazing — more space, a completely new design, and an even better vibe. Every Friday and Saturday they have DJs, plus daily specials and great deals. Even though it’s a hookah lounge, the food here is delicious — you must try the beef tartare, calamari, Caesar salad, syrniki, and tiramisu. They also recently had a sushi chef, and the sushi was incredible: super fresh and huge rolls. They have some of the best hookahs in Miami, with high-quality tobacco and a great variety of flavors, along with a wide selection of cocktails and alcohol. Amazing hookahs, tasty drinks, and great food — all in one place. The atmosphere is always beautiful and cozy, and the staff is absolutely wonderful — friendly servers and professional hookah masters who really know what they’re doing. I highly recommend this place for birthdays, events, corporate parties, or just to come, relax, smoke hookah, and enjoy the vibe. Truly the best of the best

author: Francisco Lozano
review_text: This has been our preferred date night option for more than three years now and even more so after their recent renovations. The menu options feel curated and the quality of each dish shines through. We’ve been lucky enough to try just about everything on the menu and pleasantly surprised by all of the options. My wife is particularly fond of their hookah and has never been disappointed with the preparation or service. Phenomenal staff, food, quality, ambience, and value. This has been our highest restaurant recommendation to friends and family when visiting the area. Highly Recommend.

author: Viktoriia Stepanushko
review_text: The most incredible hookah place to visit! Food was so delicious, I highly recommend to try sushi, skirt steak shawarma and fried calamari! I’ve got Sicilian Sour and Pineapple martini cocktails - really good, believe me. Hookah was also as strong and good as I wanted

author: Grigorii Rybakov
review_text: Yo, this spot is straight-up FIRE 🔥 Hands down the best hookah/tea lounge in the whole MIA area! Chill vibes, clouds on clouds, flavors hittin’ different every time. The teas? Insane selection, bro. But real talk — shoutout to Olga, our server, she’s an absolute QUEEN 👑 Super friendly, on point with everything, knows the menu like the back of her hand, and legit the prettiest smile in South Florida, no cap. Made the whole night 10x better. If you’re in the area, pull up ASAP. You won’t leave disappointed, fam. 5 stars easy ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Already planning the next sesh!

author: Lilliana Vallejo
review_text: Food and drinks were really good, and the hookah was yummy and smooth The staff were really sweet as well But honestly, all the stars are because of the DJ,, he was AMAZING and completely set the vibe for the night. The music, energy, and overall atmosphere were on point. Definitely made the experience i was bumping

author: Игорь Мыза
review_text: The restaurant makes a great first impression with its cozy outdoor terrace, stylish seating, and warm lighting. The palm trees and sunset view add to the relaxed vibe. Hubble Bubble is a stylish spot for dinner or a night out with friends. Delicious food, great hookah, and a cozy atmosphere make it an excellent place to relax and enjoy your evening.

author: Alex Was There
review_text: One of best hookah place in Miami in terms of quality of the hookah product, atmosphere and service. Their signature Hubble Bubble tea is also one of the kind. This place was recently reconstructed and has a much better vibe now. 8 out of 10 overall.

author: Ivan Balandiuk
review_text: Been stopping by every week to have some proper tea and hookah and let me tell you, even on the busiest day I had a proper ETA and high-end service from both servers and hookah specialists. No matter who assisted us, Olga, Zlata or Victoria, we had and have a great time here. Quite a difference to local spots because of the European quality of service. Definitely a place to check out and recommend.

author: Isabela Jazmín Santana Polanco
review_text: Amazing experience all around! Hubble Bubble truly exceeded my expectations. The atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming, the hookah was smooth, flavorful, and perfectly prepared, and the food was absolutely delicious. Everything we ordered was fresh and full of flavor, and the service made the experience even better. It’s the perfect spot to unwind, enjoy great food, and have an amazing hookah session. I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great vibe and quality all around!

author: Charles G
review_text: Wow! what a great place to eat, relax, and enjoy the great vibes, that the kind folks at Hubble Bubble Lounge have created. The best hookah ever, great drinks.. INCREDIBLE FOOD! You will feel completely welcomed by the whole staff who are all lovely, and very attentive to make sure that your whole service is perfect! They also showcase some great DJs that bring amazing sound live to the lounge setting. What more could you ask for?! This place is epic! Go for dinner, a date, a drink, some tea, great hookah, and awesome music. Excellent! 11/10

author: Dolce PicolaJO
review_text: The atmosphere is beautiful and cozy, and the staff is absolutely wonderful — friendly servers and professional hookah masters who really know what they’re doing. I highly recommend this place for birthdays, events, corporate parties, or just to come, relax, smoke hookah, and enjoy the vibe. Truly the best of the best. We are thankful to our friends who invite us for a New Year 2026 dinner. I highly recommend this place.

author: David Ryabov
review_text: This place is amazing. You do not even notice how time flies by (manage your time accordingly lol). Food is amazing, especially tea - when you go you HAVE to try the tea and dumplings.

author: Aaron Walker
review_text: Yesterday was my first time visiting Hubble Bubble Lounge, and unfortunately, the level of service we received was extremely disappointing. From the moment we ordered, the waitstaff was inattentive and unresponsive. No one checked on our table at any point during our visit. We asked for water when placing our food order, but it never arrived I had to physically get up and track down a waiter just to receive it. The same issue occurred when it was time to receive our check; I had to ask multiple staff members before anyone assisted us. As they would always just walk past or table consistently. Additionally, I clearly informed the staff that I am allergic to watermelon and requested a simple substitution for extra strawberries. Despite this being a reasonable request, they were unable or unwilling to accommodate it. Overall, this experience fell far below even the most basic expectations of service. I was genuinely shocked by how poor it was, especially for a first visit. At the very least, I believe a refund of the mandatory 20% service charge/tip is warranted, as the level of service provided did not justify it in any way. Hopefully some one can reach out to me to resolve this matter. I hope management takes this feedback seriously, as this experience has significantly impacted my impression of your establishment.

author: Alice Cooper
review_text: I love this place, food is delicious! Also, atmosphere is good for meeting with friends. Staff is very helpful and friendly! Will back soon.

author: Anna Minets
review_text: I am such a fan of everything this restaurateur does, from Davinci, All You Need to Hubble Bubble. Whatever he opens next, I already know I will be a loyal guest. The main reason is the atmosphere and care you feel from the team every time you walk in. The service is consistently exceptional! Wonderful Olya remembers all my favorite dishes and tea and always greets me with a big, cheerful smile. The bartenders go out of their way to make sure you get exactly what you want. The food is delicious, and I really appreciate that they stay open late.

author: abner
review_text: This place is amazing. Staff is very attentive and friendly and the food is AMAZING. Great vibes with live music and a comfy atmosphere to go with friends or family. Drinks and Hookah were also top quality. You won’t regret coming here it truly is a gem

author: Ahmed Mohammed
review_text: Amazing experience at Hubble Bubble Lounge! The food was delicious, the service was exceptional, and the atmosphere was absolutely perfect for relaxing and spending time with family and friends. The place has such a cozy and welcoming vibe — everything from the music to the presentation felt top-notch. A special shout-out to Olga, who truly made the night memorable with her outstanding customer service. She was attentive, friendly, and made sure every detail was perfect. Her positive energy and professionalism really elevated the entire experience. Highly recommend this spot — it’s easily one of the best lounges in Miami!

author: Joseph Siraki
review_text: This place was the best hookah lounge we have been in Miami! Amazing service by Zlata and her tea recommendation was absolutely great! Will be coming back for sure! And will let my friends who are visiting Miami to come here!

author: Shikhar Das
review_text: The Best Hookah Master in Miami! If you’re in Miami and want a flawless hookah experience, look no further than Amir at Hubble Bubble. I’ve been to lounges all over the city—and honestly, no one comes close to the level of skill, care, and hospitality Amir delivers every single time. From the moment you sit down, Amir makes sure everything is perfect. He knows exactly how to craft the smoothest, cleanest, and most flavorful hookah mixes, and he pays attention to every detail—heat management, airflow, bowl preparation, the works. You can tell immediately that he’s a true master of his craft. What really sets Amir apart is his attitude. He’s friendly, attentive, and genuinely wants guests to have an amazing experience. He checks on you without hovering, remembers your preferences, and always brings positive energy to the lounge. Hubble Bubble is great on its own, but with Amir there, it becomes a must-visit spot. Whether you’re a hookah expert or just enjoy a relaxing night out, ask for Amir—you’ll instantly understand why he’s the best in Miami. Highly recommend!

author: Justin
review_text: Amazing place! Super cozy with that authentic hookah vibe, you relax from the very first inhale. The food is fantastic; I especially recommend the new rolls on the menu, they’re absolutely delicious. The service is quick and friendly, and a special thanks to Olya for her warm smile and attentive care. We’ll definitely be coming back again and again!

author: Audrey Bennett (She’s a Little Local)
review_text: Small but well designed restaurant with a nice ambience. The service was wonderful - we really enjoyed all the staff. The boquerones with the tomate were delicious, we ordered it with a side of their toasted bread which was the perfect crispy exterior & soft fluffy interior. The steak tartare was fantastic - had ours topped with a soft fried egg to add that luscious yolk. Paella for main course - was a special with rabbit & escargot. Finished with the creme Catalan - delicious.

author: Doni Digiovanni
review_text: I’ll fully admit—I’ve written a review for Niu Kitchen before, but it deserves another. I’ve been in this industry for 16 years, worked alongside some of the top chefs in the game, and grew up with my grandmother, who was a chef at the Waldorf. I’d like to think I know what I’m talking about. And I can say with absolute confidence: Niu Kitchen isn’t just one of my favorite restaurants in the U.S.—it is my favorite restaurant in the United States. This little slice of Spain in downtown Miami is understated at first glance. But once you sit down, you’ll feel it: the warmth, the soul, the authenticity. What sets Niu apart—beyond its incendiary food—is its people. While so many restaurants around them are turning and burning through staff, Niu has kept the same loyal faces for nearly a decade. That kind of consistency and heart is rare in this industry, and it shows. I’m grateful this gem survived the pandemic, because they deserve every bit of praise. The food is transportive. I lose myself every time I dine here—each bite better than the last. The Bronzino tartar is a must, the legendary ous (only on Tuesdays, so book ahead!) is a revelation, and the squid ink arroz will stop you in your tracks. Don’t miss Chef Deme’s new clam dish, a family recipe from his mother—it’s soulful, heartfelt cooking at its best. For me, no trip to Miami is complete without a visit to Niu Kitchen. It will forever hold the most special place in my heart and truly feels like home.

author: Jenelly Edith
review_text: This is my go-to for a healthy lunch! Absolutely amazing everytime! So healthy, delicious and amazing vibes! I always feel so good after eating since they use raw ingredients and no seed oils! They also have GF options! I recommend getting the salon, sweet potatoes, carrots and beet sauce. So delish! One of my favorite lunches in Miami!

author: Miami Judge
review_text: If you only have one night to dine in Miami, this is the spot! Chefs Lomas and Cabrera put their hearts into every dish, and the team makes you feel like family. Great wine selection and top-tier music. ¡Gracias!

author: Monica Nieto
review_text: Delicious Spanish food and great selection of tapas! Make sure you order the grilled oysters.

author: Mike Richardson
review_text: 12/10 will be back. Don’t sleep on this spot! The charred oysters are not a dish, they are a life event. Smoky, briny, buttery perfection that made me question every decision I’ve ever made that didn’t involve ordering more of them. Pro tip: be like me. Order the charred oysters as a starter. Then, when the server asks about dessert, ignore all social norms and order the charred oysters again. Sweet? No. Satisfying in a deeply emotional way? Absolutely.

author: Carmen Tun
review_text: I really liked this place! We went on a wednesday night so not busy at all. Food came out quick and extra delicious. We ordered an assortment of foods and everything was a hit! Especially loved the Ous, the artichoke, and the gamba al ajillo. Super fresh, lovely tasting food and a very charming atmosphere. Staff were so nice and attentive as well. One thing I will say, is that you might want to order a few side orders of bread since a lot of the dishes really benefit from having it, but do not come with it (like sopping up all the delicious sauce from the gamba al ajillo). I don’t think you can really go wrong with anything you order on the menu. There was only one thing I did not particularly like, which was the foie gras, but I think that’s only because the pairings on this dish overpower the foie. I’m chalking it up to personal preference taste though. Overall great spot, very happy I stopped in.

author: Katy Huang
review_text: The go-to tapa place in Miami. Quality ingredients paired with authentic flavors of Spanish cuisine makes dining at NIU kitchen an outstanding experience.

author: Arturo Picicci
review_text: Amazing spanish food! Best tomatoe bread then Artichoke, paella, octopus, camarones al ajillo! And sarah the best giving the best service!

author: Karen Young
review_text: What a gem! We need GF, no dairy/no egg. Found what we wanted with several options here. And the GF baguette was perfection! We had the roasted artichokes and mushroom paella. So satisfying to eat such good food!!! Photo of our empty paella pan because I dove in so fast.

author: Jess St
review_text: I love this place - easily one of the tastiest restaurants in Miami. The atmosphere is simple, but the food more than makes up for it. Every dish is packed with flavor and creativity, with combinations that feel both unique and comforting. A real hidden gem for anyone who cares about amazing food

author: A J
review_text: This place has been on my list for years. Food was absolutely excellent! A bit pricey for the portions but we will be coming back here again. Everything was tapas size including the larger dishes. We ordered the charbroiled oysters, steak tartare, tomato bread, seared foie, bavette steak and arroz bec. Charbroiled Oysters - wonderful flavor of smokey with the mild oyster taste. A bit pricey at $8 per piece but would absolutely order again Steak tartare - My only critique would be that the steak tartare had a bit too much brine that overpowered the steak flavor but it was still quite good Tomato bread - can’t go wrong with this to complement the meal Seared Foie - loved the combination of flavors. Definitely combine each bite with the sweet and salty sauces on the dish Bavette Steak - made perfectly rare as we ordered despite the thinner cut of meat. Both he steak and roasted vegetable relish was had an amazing Smokey flavor! Only comment would be to have the relish warm instead of cold Arroz Bec - added this last minute to give one of the rice dishes a try. The combination of mushrooms, sausage and aioli with the rice was delicious. We couldn’t finish to wrapped up to go home and my husband ate it before the end of the night lol The establishment also only does wine so unfortunately no beers and cocktails. We didn’t ask but would be interested to know if they allowed customers to also BYOB. Looking forward to going back!

author: Binder Family
review_text: We live an hour north in Delray, and this is still our go to dinner date spot. Dishes are light, and flavors are intentional. We really appreciate the consistency here.

author: Erick Maitin Morales
review_text: I received this recommendation as the best representation of Spanish food in Miami, and it was a disappointment. Service: Unprofessional with wines, lack of knowledge about the menu and allergens, but the most notable issue was charging for dishes that were not served. Food: The dishes were very risky and lacked refinement. The recommended paella had overcooked rice, and the artichoke was undercooked.

author: Lyon Hu
review_text: The food had good taste, but the portions were small. The service was average.

author: barby terzian
review_text: Food was great! Sara was nice and very professional. She suggested good plates!

author: Laurence Mercier-Lafond
review_text: Just WOW! Will definitely be back soon! We were lucky enough to get seated early on a Thursday night without a reservation. My boyfriend said he’d come back here for their bavette steak rather than go to a steakhouse, it was THAT good! He even ate the artichoke which is a miracle! Everything was delicious. We also enjoyed the Arroz Sec, Tomato Bread, and Mahon + Chorizo. The skin contact wine Mission was funky & delicious. Service & ambiance were super pleasant

author: Agnes Hermann
review_text: By far the best restaurant in Miami. Every time we went to Niu Kitchen, the food was AMAZING. We love the simplicity of the place, very quick service, every single dish prepared with professionalism and love. We appreciate to have a place like this. Can’t wait to be back again.

author: Josh Friedlander
review_text: Exceptional food. The oysters are a Religious experience. The paella is very good. The pan con tomate is worth the carbs. The chocolate ganache dessert will end you. For the quality of the food, the prices are reasonable. I recommend you eat here while you can get a table.

author: Santiago Garcia
review_text: This is my go-to spot for spanish seafood dishes. Can’t go wrong with the rice and the charcosl oysters. There is always great wine options.

author: Stephanie Abil Vicente Gonzalez
review_text: It’s my first time here and I absolutely love this place. The atmosphere is excellent, and the service is outstanding. The quality of the food is truly 5-star—fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared. The coffee is delicious and simply incomparable to any of the nearby places. The service is impressively fast, and the music is at the perfect volume, creating a very pleasant and welcoming ambiance. Overall, it’s an exceptional experience from start to finish.

author: Abraham Daruich
review_text: Yiri was amazingg! The food was Great and tasty ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️ Absolutely loved MIAM MIAMI! The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Every bite felt thoughtful and well-balanced. The atmosphere is super chill but stylish, perfect for brunch or a relaxed meal. The staff was friendly and attentive without being overbearing. Definitely one of those places you keep coming back to. Highly recommend!

author: Debora Chong
review_text: Upon walking into Miam I thought, "Wow, this place is really nice!" The staff are so friendly, place is so organized and clean and as I looked into the kitchen the cooks were so busy and diligent at work. They looked so efficient. The star of the show was he food! Everything we ate was so delicious! We had the buttermilk pancakes, match latte and the breakfast burrito. Everything just melts in your mouth. You can't go wrong ordering anything from the menu. Amanda was super friendly and nice. Always there whenever we needed anything extra. We will definitely come back here again.

author: Erica Matos
review_text: I had such a great experience at this breakfast spot! Everything came out fresh, hot, and beautifully plated. Our server, Dani, was fantastic — super friendly, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed without ever feeling rushed. The pancakes were absolutely delicious — fluffy, buttery, and perfectly golden — but definitely huge! One order could easily feed two people, so I’d recommend sharing if you want to try other items too. The bacon, egg, and cheese croissant was another winner: buttery, flaky, and packed with flavor. The only miss for me was the matcha — not bad, just not something I’d order again next time. Still, with food this good and service this warm, I’ll absolutely be back. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a satisfying breakfast and great vibes!

author: Viral J
review_text: Miam Café in Miami is one of the best places for brunch, breakfast, and coffee in the Wynwood area. The café has a modern, cozy vibe with a menu full of fresh, flavorful, and healthy options. It’s perfect whether you want to grab a quick coffee, enjoy a relaxed meal, or meet friends for brunch. The menu offers a great mix of eggs, avocado toast, sandwiches, salads, pastries, and fresh juices. The ingredients taste fresh and high quality, and the presentation is always on point. The coffee is excellent, and they also have great vegetarian-friendly choices. The café atmosphere is relaxed yet stylish, making it a great spot to hang out, work, or simply enjoy a meal. The staff is friendly and welcoming, which makes the experience even better.

author: Ms Flo
review_text: My husband and I visited the Miam Cafe located in Miami about a week ago while we were in town. We were greeted promptly upon arrival. We then proceeded to the register to place our order. Once our order was ready, it was brought out to our table. They looked to be a little short staffed on this particular day, although I'm unsure if this is the typical set up regarding the number of staff daily. However, it didn't hinder them from getting the orders out in a timely fashion. The food was fresh, hot and delicious when it arrived. The cashier/waitress checked on us quite frequently despite her being the only one working both the register and waiting tables. Would definitely return to this location.

author: Leslie Schmerfeld
review_text: Eggs Benny was amazing! paired with rich smoked salmon and perfectly seasoned potatoes. Front hosts were very kind but need to work on communication and better flow. Our seat was moved twice. The food and drinks came out super quick!

author: Emilie Veyland
review_text: My first time here and I will for sure come back! Amazing and peaceful atmosphere, food is top notch, the menu is quite elaborated with different meal types, I did not know what to choose, so many great options! And cherry on the cake, the staff is wonderful, kind and caring 🫶🏻 thanks for such a nice lunch experience!

author: Chantil Sanchez
review_text: The Miam Pancakes were good, menu said it came with maple syrup but it was def not. It was what you’d expect with a high fructose corn syrup kind. The fruit and whipped topping was great and the pancakes themselves were fluffy but at room temperature, so not sure how freshly made they were. The Miam breakfast burrito however was fantastic. Very flavorful and jam packed with fresh ingredients and piping hot. I found it perplexing that we got our food before our coffee order. I had to ask for cream for my brewed coffee after being told when I initially ordered it that it was given on the side. Also be warned that the restaurant automatically adds a 4% “Restaurant Charge” to the bill.

author: Janna Rae
review_text: I LOVE LOVE Miami Cafe! Laureen & Judith are the absolute sweetest! the service is great and the food even better! it can get a little busy , they do their very, best to accommodate you and get you seated as soon as possible. We had no prob and got seated right away. Miami cafe is a miami brunch staple and a must go to!

author: Maribel Sanchez
review_text: Local & cute eatery! As soon as we walked in we were greeted and felt a super homey ambiance. The food was 10/10! we had some Miami fluffy pancakes topped with fruit & whip cream, a breakfast croissant with a side salad & a Miami sandwich with some side of sweet potatoes. I loved it !!!!

author: Layla P
review_text: Here’s a clean, friendly review you can use: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Amazing Experience at Miam Café! Miam Café is truly an amazing place, and Judi made the experience even better. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, and the servers are super kind, attentive, and always on top of everything. Judi especially stood out with her friendly attitude and great service. The food came out fast, everything was fresh, and the overall service was smooth and efficient. If you’re looking for a spot with great vibes, delicious food, and staff who genuinely care, Miam Café is definitely the place to go!

author: Jessica Diaz
review_text: We had a wonderful breakfast, avo toast, side of bacon and a bacon/egg/cheese croissant. Get the hot sauce on the side. Everything was hot, fresh and savory. I also had a hoy lavender latte and it was just right. Next time I will definitely get the pancake stack. Everyone had them around us and were raving about them!

author: A J
review_text: Absolutely amazing experience at Miam Cafe Biscayne! The food was delicious and beautifully presented, the pancakes were unreal and the matcha drink was perfect. The atmosphere is bright, clean, and so inviting. But what really made my visit exceptional was our server, Dani. He was incredibly attentive, pleasant, and professional from start to finish.

author: mikiah fribbley
review_text: Great food and even better service! Everything was fresh and flavorful, and the atmosphere was welcoming. Dani, our server, was absolutely amazing—friendly, attentive, and made the experience even better. Overall, a smooth and enjoyable visit. I’d definitely come back and recommend this place to others.

author: WILLIAM WHITE
review_text: Somewhat more of a "diner" type feel in a luxury condo bldg. Food was very good & portion size was excellent. I ordered the buttermilk pancakes w/whip cream & mixed berries. One portion cook really feed 2 ppl so if you're out with your girl fellas, order 1 & split it with your lady & it will be enough. Service was fine, plates & utensils were clean. Overall, I'd give it a 7.5- 8/10

author: Mayra Volquez
review_text: If you are looking for a nice breakfast/ Brunch place in Downtown Miami, this is your place. I will definitely come again and bring my sister.

author: Danni G
review_text: Such a great experience for my entire family — all 17 of us! While in Miami awaiting our cruise, we stopped by Miam for brunch, and it did not disappoint! The food was absolutely DELICIOUS and the portions were huge. 🍳🥞 Our server, Karè, took such good care of us and made the experience even better. From the Eggs Benedict to the French Toast, Nutella Pancakes, and Breakfast Burrito, you really can’t go wrong here. Highly recommend if you’re ever in the area!

author: Tiffany Leung
review_text: Food was delicious, and the menu has several bakery, breakfast, and lunch options. The staff are very friendly, and the space is lovely with big windows for lots of sunlight. Dani was helpful and kind!

author: AG
review_text: Miam Cafe was relatively close to our hotel. We’ve been hunting to find a good breakfast spot while visiting Miami, and man am I glad we found this place! They were really busy so we had to wait outside for a little bit but we had cover from the rain. The atmosphere inside is amazing, service is amazing, and the food is AMAZING! Probably some of the best food I’ve had, especially the breakfast burrito. The Dubai pancakes were so unique, presented beautifully, and tasted fantastic (although you can definitely split it with others, the portion is huge). This is just the place we were looking for the really get the Miami experience. Would absolutely recommend to anyone wanting some tasty breakfast/lunch that is unique and delicious!

author: Ann Zakkery
review_text: The place looks good on the pics and in reality. But the restroom is dirty, the faucet in the restroom needs replacement , it’s so dirty that you don’t want to touch it. The rolls contain too much of sugar, too much. It’s ok for rice to have sugar BUT not THAT much. As for the ramen - it’s tasty, but it’s not classics Japanese. The broth is tasty but not the Japanese style, more typical American. With big chunks of ingredients. Was supposed to find almost the whole zucchini in my ramen. The music was super loud and disturbing. The water has a scent of ray or smth that shouldn’t be in the water. Needs improvement In general - it’s ok place to visit once. But will not return.

author: Daryna Paterylo
review_text: The food was amazing — the sushi was just wow! I especially recommend the Volcano Roll. The atmosphere is very nice, but the big downside was the service, which felt very unorganized and messy.

author: Paola Fuentes Hernandez
review_text: I recently visited Sushi Sake for lunch and I really liked their variety in lunch special options. I ordered beef noodles and my friend had shrimp noodles; we liked it. I am giving it 4 starts because we arrived to the restaurant and no one was in the front so I ended up asking the security guard where was the person and he asked me to wait until someone showed up; after seated, the server took a while to come and take our order plus we ordered sriracha sauce and were charged $1 for it. Who charges for sriracha?? It is like charging for ketchup 🤷🏻‍♀️

author: Martie Parfait
review_text: I really don’t like this new upfront gratuity! The service should be above par for 20% gratuity. Sat out on the patio, waited a few to get served. The miso soup was tasty. The grilled calamari was bland. The veggie fried rice was good.

author: Jamieko Lane
review_text: What a great find. We only stayed a few nights in Miami and wanted to eat here every night. Our server Luisa was great. She was the only server for happy hour and even with a full restaurant we felt attended too. We had the shrimp shumai, nfl roll, spicy conch roll, veggie fried rice, and the combo tempura. We came during happy hour (which was pretty late) and scored some great deals! The old fashioned we had took a little while but was worth the wait. The food was great. The spicy conch roll had a hot sauce that was different but not bad. The veggie rice was definitely under cooked but it had a great flavor! They have an amazing outdoor seating area with fire pits. We chose to go inside bc we had our little with us. Highly suggest!

author: Alberto Miami
review_text: I’ve visited the Sushi Sake chain before at other locations around Miami, and this was my first time at the Biscayne location. I came to the restaurant on a Wednesday around 4 p.m.; it was pretty much empty. The hostess told me I could pick any table I wanted, inside or outside. The weather was nice that day, and the veranda looked very pretty, so I chose a table outside. Also I had a quick look inside, and the restaurant looked modern, nice, and clean. My waiter came over pretty fast and was nice. BUT he only brought me the regular menu and didn’t mention anything about the Happy Hour menu, which actually starts at 4 p.m. at Sushi Sake restaurants on weekdays. I had to bring it up myself, and he acted like he had forgotten about it. When I asked for the Happy Hour menu, he told me they didn’t have physical menus available at the moment, which seemed strange. Then he just started listing a few of the dishes from the Happy Hour menu, and of course, he missed a lot. Luckily, I had done a review of another Sushi Sake location a few months earlier and had ordered from their Happy Hour menu. So I pulled up that review on my phone to remind myself what I wanted. I ended up ordering the JB Roll and the Miami Heat Roll again. My food came out fast - about 10 minutes after I ordered. Everything looked and tasted as expected: nice and delicious! The portions at this restaurant are big and filling. Personally, I’m always fully satisfied after eating two sushi rolls. I absolutely love the JB Roll + Miami Heat Roll combo - they go really well together! As for the regular menu, it offers a lot of variety, which is great. I’ve never had bad food at this sushi chain. For drinks, I always order an iced tea. It’s very tasty here, plus they offer free refills. I also love that they have agave syrup and simple syrup, which I always ask for instead of sugar. Price-wise, I find this restaurant generally reasonable; just a few items on the regular menu seem a bit overpriced to me. But the Happy Hour menu is an excellent deal! My final bill after ordering two items from the Happy Hour menu plus a drink is around $22, which is fantastic! I absolutely recommend the Sushi Sake chain if you’re looking for good, tasty sushi and rolls. And the Biscayne location is a great option - it’s in a tourist-friendly area of Miami and not far from the Port of Miami, which makes it a perfect spot if you’re arriving by cruise ship and want to grab some Japanese food!

author: Lo Allison
review_text: Vibe was awesome, restaurant was clean, staff was friendly and food was delicious! As a vegetarian I never know what to expect, especially at sushi restaurants but the sushi was phenomenal. I got the veggie roll and asked to have cream cheese added. Ended up getting an additional roll. The veggie eggrolls were some of the best I've ever had. So delicious! Our 2 year old loves sushi but she ate more here than she typically does. Very impressed!

author: Jos S
review_text: I give all 5 because Edwin made our night while we were waiting for out server that took a little to come take our order! The food is good, the restaurant is pretty and Edwin was the best! Our server was super nice too but I really wish that Edwin would serve us. He had knowledge of what we were asking but he county take the order, since he could not serve us he was very nice and on top of the service while the server came to the table. No complains for the server, I just want to recognize that it was a team that made our experience nice!

author: Monica Nicholson
review_text: Great service from Danny at the bar! Amazing decor and atmosphere. The cocktails were amazing, Fuji apple crisp and espresso martini were deeeeeelicous!!!

author: Sophie Seltzer
review_text: Kept asking locals where to get good food, this place kept being named. Did not disappoint. Loved the octopus nigiri, so many amazing rolls and the vibes were super cool. Lots of sick neon.

author: Olga Acosta
review_text: On my first visit to this location after an event at the Kaseya Center, the experience was unfortunately below expectations. Upon arrival, the host immediately mentioned a private event and seemed discouraging about the wait time. However, I had already observed several tables simply waiting to pay, and a couple who arrived before me was seated while I briefly stepped away. Given this, it was unclear why an accurate wait time could not be communicated. During my wait, I also observed a man who appeared to be a manager inform a server that a table was about to leave without paying due to how long they had been waiting to check out. Instead of assisting directly, he stepped back, which gave the impression that staff support and oversight were lacking. After being seated, no one approached our table for about ten minutes, not even to offer water, so I had to request assistance. When the food finally arrived, it was disappointing to find that my meal was cold and clearly not freshly prepared. When I shared this feedback with the server, she appeared unfazed and simply walked away. Later, after asking for the bill, we waited an additional ten minutes before having to flag her down again because it seemed the request had been ignored. To make matters worse, a 20% gratuity was automatically added to the bill, despite the service falling far short of that standard. Having visited other Sushi Sake locations, this experience was by far the most disappointing. Based on this visit, I do not plan to return to this location.

author: Vinh Ly
review_text: The location and ambience was great but the food is subpar. Nigiri tastes old and the rice on the rolls were falling apart as we picked them up. We also ordered a seafood fried rice that was decent, packed with meats but was very very oily. The most disappointing was the fried/tempura ice cream, which was 90% dough. Overall, food looks better in pictures… I came with ONE other person and yet they automatically charged a 20% gratuity despite not refilling our water at all.

author: Taneisha Tomlinson
review_text: I went here with my husband in November for brunch while we were in Miami, and we had a good time. We were seated outside, which was great. The day was cool and breezy, and we enjoyed the ambiance and the view. The food and the drinks were delicious. We would definitely go back for sure.

author: Mariya Doncheva - Real Estate Agent
review_text: During our vacation, our visit to Sushi Sake Biscayne was a delight, marked by friendly staff and amazing food that truly stood out. My husband was particularly impressed with their sushi, praising its freshness and flavor, while I found myself enamored with their chicken fried rice and chicken hibachi—both dishes were cooked to perfection. We also indulged in their desserts, which were a wonderful end to our meal. The ambiance is welcoming, making for a memorable dining experience. Highly recommended for anyone looking for top-notch sushi and more.

author: Tina Sargent
review_text: This place was amazing! So delicious and fresh! You won’t be disappointed!! Give it a try! Ask for Stephanie, made dinner ever more enjoyable! full of joy and a beautiful smile. Very helpful! The jalapeño mahachi is the best!!

author: oriana rojas
review_text: my fiance, cousin, and I came on a whim after a billie concert and WOWWW SO GLAD WE DID!! Danny and Gladys were absolutely amazing! they were kind and made the best recommendations. Ten cuidado con los dos por que son como familia después de 10 minutos

author: Marissa Smith
review_text: This place really sets the date night tone with the low lights and tabletop spotlight. The beyond exceptional service our waiter Danny gave, made our experience just as great as the food was! I had a virgin Lychee Mojito (which lived up to my pregnant expectations lol) while my fiance had a bottle of Nigori Sake, which Danny made sure his glass was always full!! We started with the Sake Tostones. Followed by a small ginger salad before receiving our entrees. Our hibachi shrimp and filet mignon plates didn’t survive photos but I 10/10 recommend!

author: Yvonne W
review_text: Disappointing experience. They only gave two people one menu to share, which was already strange. Plates weren’t properly cleaned and even had greasy fingerprints on them. The shredded carrots and lettuce used as sushi garnish were dehydrated and wilted — either not fresh or being reused. On top of that, they still automatically expect a minimum 20% tip for this level of service. Would not recommend.

author: bianca magadan
review_text: sushi sale was an exceptional dining experience with tasty food, gorgeous interior design, and attentive staff. i ordered the volcano roll with the steamed gyoza, the result was a beautifully garnished platter with an even more flavorful taste. we couldn’t help but order more sushi later that night. besides the sushi, there are plenty more options to choose from, so there’s a taste of heaven for everyone!

author: Edwin Rios
review_text: Asked for a glass of water while looking at the menu and this has to be the worst tap water I've ever had in a restaurant. Enough to take your appetite away. Food was average and if they use the same water for cooking, this is likely affecting their food quality. Had to order a bottle of sparkling water to get by. For the price of their menu, the least they can do is give you a decent glass of water. Music was high enough where I had problems listening to the servers or the person a cross the table. This takes away from enjoying the environment with your party.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Meredith Sanders
review_text: The food was amazing and the restaurant is phenomenal. I got the crispy calamari, risotto of the day which it had all the seafood in it and definitely didn’t taste super fishy it was a super nice blend. Their tiramisu was really good and better than I expected. Definitely took me back to Italy for sure! The service was so great. Samet helped me with what I should choose and he was very knowledgeable about everything on the menu as well with the restaurant even if he’s been there for short time. Excellent service, food and atmosphere definitely will be back again!!!

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Thomas Strehle
review_text: Stunning space in a beautiful newish area downtown. The space is amazing. Realize it is Miami but I just got back from NYC and felt the comparative prices here were ridiculous for the quality of food. The least expensive spaghetti with tomato sauce (no protein) is $25. It was ok. They advertise San Marzano tomatoes in it but I question it. Service was VERY friendly and accommodating. Shortrib ravioli was ok for $36 for lunch. Looks like it would be a lot of fun at happy hour. Raspberry espresso martini was wonderful!

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Yanely Balbontin
review_text: Serafina in downtown is hands down one of my favorite spots. The food is consistently amazing, but the mussels are on another level—absolutely delicious and always perfectly cooked. What truly makes this place special, though, is the service. The bartenders, Kat and Alyza, are incredible. Their energy, professionalism, and genuine care for guests are the reason I became a regular. They always make you feel welcome and taken care of, and they know exactly how to elevate the whole experience. Great food, great drinks, and even better service. Highly recommend!

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Steve Ludwig
review_text: I come to Serafina often as a regular usually sitting up at the bar area. Kat is awesome and a great bartender! The food is great and atmosphere is perfect. There is a good balance of happy hour food specials + regular menu items. Also they sponsored an event with my apartment complex. It was very nice and great environment for meeting other people. The best items are the Alfredo with chicken, the meatballs and the chocolate cake. It's great Italian food matching the quality of other restaurants in the area. Recently my last two visits were really great. I could not travel for Christmas because of nose surgery. Serafina had a Christmas brunch which was so great and made my holiday. Also for New Year's eve they had a nice menu with really good cake. Serafina is fitting into the neighborhood very nicely and caters both to tourists and the regulars like myself very well.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Julia Doell
review_text: Attended Serafina Downtown Miami for date night last night. Our server was Daniel and he was very attentive and kind. Our food arrived to our table very fast. It was delicious and you could tell, house-made. I ordered the Gnocci, it was soft and delicious. Only thing I feel it was missing was a nice piece of bread. The tiramisu for dessert was quite good as well. I loved the chocolate shavings on top. Overall we really enjoyed our experience and would return next time we visit Miami.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Grekys Ferrer
review_text: I had an amazing experience at this restaurant. The food was absolutely delicious, full of flavor, and beautifully presented. On top of that, the service was outstanding. Jessica was extremely attentive, friendly, and professional, making sure we felt welcome and well taken care of at all times. Thanks to her excellent service and the incredible food, our visit was truly memorable. I highly recommend this place and especially Jessica!

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Dan Bob
review_text: Great spot for people watching seated at an outdoor table. Conveniently located just outside CitizenM hotel. Delicious mussels in garlic butter, shallots, cherry tomatoes and sprigs of fresh thyme. My waiter, Samet, was informative, attentive, efficient and very cute. Enjoy your time here!

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Cynthia Gutierrez
review_text: Ok, so I don’t like to give this kind of review, but unfortunately this place just... I don’t even have the words to express my disappointment. I chose this place for my partner’s birthday and was excited because it was a new spot and we love Italian food. When we arrived, we had to wait a few minutes until someone was available to attend to us. When we saw the host, we asked her if that was where we were supposed to wait, and she said yes—just wait for me, I’ll be right back—which never happened. A lovely woman showed us a few minutes later where to sit and was kind, especially since the table was for four and we were just two. They offered us prosecco on the house, and we appreciated the gesture. We waited more than 15 minutes until someone took our order. The waiter was really kind and did his best with the resources available to him. As for the food, it wasn’t anything extraordinary. Honestly, I’ve been in better places. My boyfriend ordered a truffled beef carpaccio and bruschetta, which weren’t good. I ordered a pepperoni pizza, and I have to say that was the best dish of the bunch. I also ordered truffle fettuccine, and my boyfriend had spaghetti al pacino. According to him, it wasn’t bad, but unfortunately, the chef didn’t want to accommodate our requests, so we moved on. I honestly didn’t have a good time there. Maybe it was just that day, or I don’t know, but for a barely new place, it was pretty empty. And can we talk about the bill? Too expensive for that quality. The worst money I have ever spent P.S.: Please also pay attention to the restrooms. They were pretty disgusting.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Paola Fuentes Hernandez
review_text: Stopped by Serafina with a friend to kill some time before a Miami Heat game and really enjoyed the pleasant atmosphere. We first sat at the tables near the bar, but no one came by after several minutes. As soon as I moved to the bar, we were helped within two minutes. We had two glasses prosecco, a Margherita pizza, and the fried calamari. The pizza was just okay, but the calamari were really good. Overall, a nice experience, and I’d come back to try more of the menu.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Artem Moldsvskiy
review_text: The restaurant is beautiful, with a pleasant atmosphere, and the food comes out very quickly — that’s a strong plus. However, several issues affected the overall experience. The bread served with both the tartare and the bruschetta was extremely dry — so much so that it actually hurt my gums. The Caesar salad was disappointing, no better than a 2/5.
