The dressing didn’t enhance the flavor at all. I was offered water, but it was never brought to the table. Also, the salad plate was unstable and kept moving every time I tried to take a bite, which made eating quite uncomfortable. On the positive side, the calamari were tasty, and the beef tartare itself was very good. The Margherita pizza was also enjoyable. Overall, the place has potential, but several details need improvement.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: May P
review_text: Elegant, spacious and inviting Restaurant with ample seating inside and outside. Expansive beautiful bar area with great Happy Hour offerings and prices every day! Nice plantings give it a tropical flair. Some nice vegetarian, but didn’t see much vegan options. Definitely recommend labeling the offerings so patrons can tell which meals are vegan and or vegetarian as so many other finer establishments do.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: neshat shahabi
review_text: Absolutely the best. My boyfriend and I loved it so much we went there twice during our three day vacation. Cute and bougie, close to everything. The space has a lush green vibe and the food was incredible. We left smiling and our hearts are still with them.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Erica Matos
review_text: Tammy was an excellent server at Serafina—on point, super efficient, and genuinely attentive. I never had to track her down for anything, and she knew the menu inside and out. The food was amazing, and the tiramisu was absolutely out of this world. Thoroughly enjoyed!

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: A P
review_text: Whenever you see a new restaurant with low reviews, and especially a chain restaurant that has done this multiple times, one always wonders what happened, and mostly it’s about the leadership at the top - especially the restaurant management. In our case, we ended up on a Monday with the restaurant 80 percent empty. On this particular day, they had run out of the house red to go with the food. While there were five other wines that were available by the glass , we were not allowed to substitute. Finally, courtesy the bartender we were offered a low cost Malbec that was not on the wine list. Several questions here: why do you have a cheap wine in the bar but not on the menu unless you are feeding it to unsuspecting customers. How much money are you gonna lose by substituting one red wine glass with another from already open bottles? And most importantly, how well are you training your staff to create happy experiences for your customers? After all, 80 percent of the questions your servers face are tied to 20 percent of the issues. Just remind your staff about these issues in your afternoon staff meeting till it becomes like A, B, Cs for them. On the food side, we simply had the pizza and it has nothing special to it. One can totally avoid it if needed. But, not everything was bad. a shout out to Vlada for giving us a listening ear and understanding the issues. To the super senior management, you can invest millions of dollars, but without the right people, you are just another 4.1 rated restaurant in a busy Miami restaurant scene. Good luck!

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Irena D
review_text: This place is located just downstairs of the building where I live, so I had visited it for a couple times already. I can say, very average and definitely not for a special occasion. Beautiful interior, nice patio, but food is not so great.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Dayton Blanco
review_text: Aury is an absolute star behind the bar! Super attentive, friendly, and always makes you feel welcome. The drinks were perfect, but what really stood out was her energy and the way she takes care of everyone with such ease. She truly made the night memorable. Highly recommend Aury if you want amazing service and a great vibe!

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Eric Hayes
review_text: I have been a loyal Serafina customer at both NYC locations and now the new Downtown Miami World Center location. I am a Condo owner at a neighboring building called Marina Blue at 888 Biscayne Blvd. I am so happy that Serafina is my neighborhood restaurant. I order takeout most of the time due to the proximity of the restaurant to my home. The bartenders and hostesses and especially the manager are always professional and respectful, which I expect as a New Yorker and they have always gone above and beyond to make me feel like family which is rare as a transplant from the Northeast. The food is always delicious and ready on time. Best addition to the neighborhood!!!

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: stephanie von lapcevic
review_text: Last night I visited this place and had an Amazing experience! The place is super warm and welcoming, with a really nice atmosphere✨. We tasted several dishes recommended by our waiter, Federico, who was incredibly kind, cordial, and attentive. Every single dish was delicious, and his suggestions were spot on. Thank you for such a great experience, we will definitely be coming back!🥂🤩

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Hector Leon
review_text: A new Miami staple right here. I feel like they’re bringing the quality of service and amazing food I love from NYC top spots, but with their unique Miami flare. Good place for Happy Hour and date night

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Katerina Denisenko
review_text: A stunningly beautiful place with completely clueless management. The food is absolutely tasteless, and the service is unbearably pushy — the waiters, seemingly high, don’t serve you so much as rush you out from the moment you arrive. To top it off, the staff apparently doesn’t know that on a birthday, the candle on the cake is supposed to be lit before it’s brought to the table, not after. Ridiculous.

author: Yongkwan Song
review_text: The food itself was excellent—especially the steak and the shrimp bucket, both of which were very tasty. We ordered the steak medium and medium rare. The medium was slightly overcooked, while the medium rare was much more tender and flavorful. The overall atmosphere of the restaurant was nice, but it wasn’t easy to get a staff member’s attention. If you wanted to place an additional order or ask for something, you usually had to wait around three minutes before seeing a server. Personally, when it comes to steak, I thought this place was better than Hard Rock Cafe.

author: Harrison C. Davies
review_text: 🎬 🍤🏃🦐🌊 “Life is like a box of chocolates… you never know what you’re gonna get,” and that fits perfectly because every Bubbly Gump Shrimp Co. location really does have its own vibe. This one is packed with throwback film memorabilia and feels like one of the flagship spots of this fictional-but-all-the-more-fun enterprise. The vibes were great, the service was friendly, and they definitely captured the Forrest-verse charm. Just wish they still did the movie trivia — that was always such a fun part of the experience.

author: Julio Andres
review_text: I had an amazing experience at Bubba Gump Shrimp Co. on Biscayne Blvd in Miami! The food was absolutely delicious — every bite full of flavor, fresh, and perfectly cooked. The whole place has such a fun and unique Forrest Gump theme that makes the atmosphere lively and memorable. But what really made our visit special was our server, Ramona. She was incredibly kind, friendly, and genuinely funny — her great energy made the whole experience even better. She went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed and kept us smiling the entire time. Highly recommend this place for anyone visiting Miami. Great food, great vibes, and ask for Ramona if you can — she’ll make your meal unforgettable! 🍤🌴

author: Rodney-James
review_text: We got a prompt greeting All food came out hot. App Calamari Came Crispy. A bit bland though. Some fried peppers come mixed in as well. Comes with two sauces. Marinara an spicy aioli. App isn’t terrible. Entree Baby back ribs This was full rack Ribs were falling off the bone. Alabama Chicken linguine Tatstes like a creamy scampi. Alfredo and scampi. This location in Miami did not charge a 20% percent gratuity.

author: Özge Evlek
review_text: I don’t know how I missed this place before! It was my first time at Bubba Gump, and I enjoyed every single moment and every bite of food. Everything was delicious—even my son, who is very picky, ate everything! We loved the classic shrimp plate, ribs, mac & cheese, and the crab sandwiches. And the mojitos… OMG, they were amazing! This will definitely be my go-to spot for daytime lunches. Highly recommend!

author: Piotr Treter
review_text: A must-visit for Forrest Gump fans, but also for those who appreciate great food. The dishes served are truly delicious, which, combined with the surrounding Bubba Gump atmosphere, creates something incredible. This place captivated us, wow. I recommend a visit; it's truly worth it ❤️

author: Joshua C Bonifas
review_text: I recently dined at [Restaurant Name], and I have to say, the service was truly exceptional. The staff was attentive and always made sure we had everything we needed, checking in frequently without being intrusive. It really enhanced the dining experience. As for the food, it was decent but didn’t quite meet my expectations. While the flavors were good, some dishes felt a bit underwhelming compared to the high standard set by the service. Overall, I would recommend this place for its outstanding service, but I hope they can elevate their menu to match the quality of their hospitality. I look forward to seeing how they improve in the future!

author: Mark
review_text: The food was amazing. As you see from my shrimp salad. The only issue was service. That could be attributed to low staff and the tempo of the crowd. I still highly recommend this place.

author: Jaimy De C
review_text: Sphere and food was okay. Missed a bit of the “ Forrest Gump “ vibe. We both took the salmon with broccoli and rice dish.

author: Christina Spuling
review_text: I had the best experience at Bubba Gump Shrimp, walking by on our way to Brickell and stopped by this Amazing Bartender Juan (JP), me and my fiancée we had the best food & cocktail experience in Miami so far. The costumer service and the food was so so amazing!!! We had such a great time and the best cocktails I ever had.

author: Jaimy Reuter
review_text: I am a fan of Bubba Gump Shrimp and anytime I am in the USA, I need to get my portion of shrimp there. I‘ve been to many locations and this bayside/downtown Miami Restaurant was no disappointment! It was exactly what I wanted. Good food, good service and an ok price. Overall, worth the visit!

author: Brad Paradis
review_text: We snuck into the Bubba Gump Shrimp company for dinner while in downtown Miami. It was really great. The staff was attentive and amazing and we loved the Forests Gump trivia challenge amongst tables while waiting for your food. We won too!

author: Nicole Elkhatib
review_text: The ladies working were so nice, the staff overall is very nice and welcoming, we ordered a bunch of food, the fish and chips were good, the shrimp and Mac n she’s was AMAZING !! The fries were cold:/ the salmon was okay.. I don’t think that sauce goes with it, if that salmon was a Cajun type of sauce it would have been amazing..

author: patricia schneider
review_text: Always a nice place for lunch or dinner. Located inside Bayside in downtown Miami. The menu is heavy on shrimps 🍤. Delicious shrimp cocktail with 8 large shrimp for 14,99. Very friendly service and great atmosphere. Went again in Nov 2025. Ramona was a great waitress. Consistently good food. Same good vibe. Thumbs up

author: Shane
review_text: Had an excellent meal here. Ramona served us and she was lovely, walked us through the basics and made sure we were catered to. Ordered the shrimp and crab boil, man was it so good. If you are travelling or on holiday, definitely make the stop in here. Markets are right next door so you can grab some souvenirs also.

author: Johnny 2by4
review_text: Food was great as always. Never had any issues at any Bubba Gump location I’ve been to. JP took care of my sister and I at the Biscayne BLVD spot. Food was great, and service was quick and great.

author: Danny Woodson
review_text: Walking by on our way back to the hotel and saw bubba gump shrimp (a restaurant I’ve ALWAYS wanted to eat at). I must admit my fiancé and I wasn’t to thrilled to stop by and was ready to go home after a long day of exploring the city on a hot September day. But as we walked by we saw a bartender with an amazing vibe! His energy was pulsing and we couldn’t pass it by! His name is Juan P!!! He was SUPER friendly and had such an amazing and outgoing personality that we just had to stop for a drink and conversation. All we can say is WOW! The vibe, the atmosphere and his awesome personality really made such a huge impact on us! We highly recommend this restaurant AND a drink especially if it’s from Juan P! Do yourself a favor and stop in and say hi! Oh and a shoutout to the manager who doesn’t want to take credit for her hospitality but OMG we thank you both SO much!

author: Leandro Alonso
review_text: We had a great time at Bubba Gump! The food was delicious, the service was excellent, and the atmosphere was very pleasant. The only downside was that the music was way too loud, it made it hard to have a conversation. Other than that, everything was really enjoyable. 🇺🇸

author: Per Hamrén Lundström
review_text: Lovely seafood restaurant with very good service. We both are different dishes with shrimps and both was very good. Coffee was not good and they only had Americano.

author: Zhang Zhuo
review_text: The food was okay. Yet it is a good pet-friendly restaurant for all of us to rest and have some food. Parking is a bit challenging/expensive though.

author: Manuel Gonzalez
review_text: This Subway in downtown Miami is a solid choice; the shop is always clean and the service is consistently fast. The manager, Kenya, is great and runs the place really efficiently, making sure everyone is taken care of quickly. It’s my go-to spot for a reliable meal, especially since the delivery is always so prompt.

author: Marcus Johnson
review_text: I’ve stopped by this location a handful of times now, and honestly, every visit feels like a coin toss. Some days things go smoothly, and other days you walk out wondering why you bothered stopping at all. It’s really one of those hit-or-miss places. The good first: The store looks pretty clean most of the time, and the downtown location is convenient if you’re already in the area running errands. When the right staff is on shift, the service can actually be decent. I’ve had one or two employees who were friendly, patient, and moved things along as best as they could. And when the food is fresh, the subs are exactly what you’d expect nothing fancy, but good enough for a quick bite. But here’s where the place loses me: the service is wildly inconsistent. There are days when the employees look completely checked out, chatting among themselves while customers stand waiting at the counter. I get that fast food can be stressful, but sometimes the attitude is just unnecessary. I’ve also had a couple of moments where I had to repeat my order multiple times because the person making the sandwich just wasn’t paying attention. Another issue is the closing hours they really need to update the times or stick to what’s posted. A few times I’ve arrived well before closing, only to find the doors locked or the employees already cleaning up and refusing to take an order. It’s frustrating, especially when you walk there thinking you’ll grab something quick. Food availability is also inconsistent. One visit they told me they were out of tomatoes, another time out of a specific bread, and once the cookies tasted like they’d been sitting out for days. It’s pretty obvious when something hasn’t been rotated or baked fresh. Overall, I keep hoping the place will improve because the location is convenient, but it feels like management really needs to step up better training, better communication, and just a bit more pride in the service. I wouldn’t say “never go,” but definitely go knowing your experience might depend on who’s working that day. If they could just tighten up the service and stick to their posted hours, this spot could easily be a reliable go-to. For now, it’s a solid “it’ll do if you’re nearby,” but not somewhere I’d go out of my way for.

author: Coy Swint
review_text: This is a new and very clean store that has a nice downtown location, but customer service needs improvement. I've visited this store twice, and each time, the server failed to acknowledge the customer even though there was no line. She pretended to be busy and didn't even look towards the counter. This has happened before with me as well as other customers. Perhaps another training course on customer service can correct this behavior. My rotisserie chicken foot long sub was delicious. This store has a lot of potential, so hopefully, they can improve in this area.

author: Mauro Davalos D
review_text: Door signs and google information shows they close at 10pm but the guy or guys that work here always close 1h early! It’s always the same insane problem!!! They do whatever the hell they want. Hope their manager or owner see this and solve it!

author: Sebastian Santana
review_text: Service was good, the workers had a language barrier but that didn't stop them. My sandwich was prepared beautiful.

author: Jennifer Quintana
review_text: The customer service in this location is absolute trash and downright disrespectful. The employees stand around talking instead of helping the customers (even when they have a line). They give you attitude just because they have to work. Several times I’ve gone in for a pickup order and they’ve LIED to my face telling me it’s not ready when it’s very visibly right behind them waiting on the counter with my name on it and everything. I ordered online for pickup and they gave me the items in a regular bag (which is hard to carry all the way to my job) and when I asked the worker if they could give me the other bag with handles, she says they don’t have any (which again A CLEAR LIE) since I could see the bags right by the counter and several other pickup orders were given in those bags. I had to explain to the cashier how to do her job because she did not know how to scan the subway app for points and she proceeds to give me attitude for it. They’re always rolling their eyes at people and acting annoyed when a customer doesn’t speak Spanish. I myself happen to know Spanish and have heard them trash talk other customers for not understanding them. Fire these horrible people who clearly don’t want to work there and give the opportunity to others who will at the very least, TRY to be nice instead of being rude and disrespectful. This is not the first time I’ve had a bad experience at this location and it’s a shame because it’s the nearest one to my college.

author: Jack Sanchez
review_text: Problems ordering cause the people here didnt speak English. You have to speak Spanish too eat here.

author: SAJI SR
review_text: Food as usual Subway food. But the staff doesn't know English

author: Giancarlo Spata
review_text: Two horrible experiences in a row. This place needs to be closed. On my first visit, they said they couldn't accept the coupon that I had because the machine that scans the coupons was broken. The manager got defensive as if this were my fault. I hesitantly accepted and paid full price anyways. After about 2 months on February 22nd, I decided to give it another try (THIS TIME without coupons) and upon check out they said that the Tuna Sandwich (FOOTLONG only, not the meal) went from $9.99 to almost $15.00. I asked the manager why prices on the menu haven't been updated and she decided to start yelling, saying she couldn't do anything because it was a system thing. She simply took the sandwich from my hand, threw it in the trash bin and started to be verbally aggressive towards me. I feel like the machine being broken is a lie and they try to charge customers more. TERRIBLE SERVICE. TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE. SUBWAY, CLOSE THIS LOCATION SINCE IT'S NOT DOING ANY GOOD FOR YOUR BRAND!

author: Francisco Casal
review_text: They overcharge every time and claim their system doesn’t let them charge the right amount. They claim they can’t use the simple menu, so they select a ready made sandwich with a higher price than what you actually order. Adds 15% to the price.

author: alaska harston
review_text: DEAR OWNER OF THIS STORE You better be paying these people extra to work in that heat!

author: Gleryca Perea
review_text: They closed 20 minutes early and we literally wanted cookies they were going to throw them out anyways. If I could give them a 0 I would bad Service she ignored us and Started mopping in front of the door saying she is not going to open they closed AT 10 but we go there at 9:40 and they didn't let us in.

author: Ivan Ramirez
review_text: The service I received today in this subway is unacceptable. Salad was nothing near what I wanted. Portions are not good. The lady that attended me was rude and with a lack of courtesy. I'm not coming back to this place. Period.

author: Lisa Matos
review_text: I work across the street and I came across this location decided to come in before my shift in the morning will I was the only customer there the women did not greet me after I stood there for about 8 mins straight while she set up her station when she was done doing her sit up she decided to acknowledge me finally gives me a blank stare so I can give her my order even after I order and paid she still did not say a work to me and I know she wasn't a minute cause she was having a full conversation with her coworker while making my order I work as a waitress one of the most important things we do is greet and make customer feel welcome as soon as they step in the fact that this women felt the need to be so rude as to ignore me in such a nasty way I will not be coming back the sandwich was good but the service was horrible

author: Liz Miniel
review_text: The food was fine, but they charged me for the wrong sandwich, even after I clarified I wanted a different one.

author: Agustin Tirado
review_text: I went at 8:44 pm today and they didn’t have any meat to make any sandwich? I mean

author: youcef ould
review_text: No Language , very rude , uneducated staff , I wish i could select below 0 star!

author: Cassandra Strozier
review_text: The subway downtown it's sad they never have 2 things to match 😕 they wait to prepare the sub then say we don't have onions no tomatoes 1 kind of bread I never go there again

author: Curtis S
review_text: The young woman working the counter made this visit extremely uncomfortable. She was rude and dismissive from the beginning, and her attitude made it feel like I was an inconvenience for simply ordering food. There was no greeting, no patience, and no basic customer service. On top of that, communication was a problem. It was genuinely hard to tell if she understood English, because she barely responded, didn’t acknowledge questions clearly, and seemed irritated when I tried to clarify my order. If you’re working directly with customers, clear communication and professionalism are the bare minimum—and neither was present here. This employee single-handedly ruined the experience. I won’t be returning unless management addresses how customers are treated.

author: killian aperce
review_text: The food was good, but the staff were very unpleasant, condescending, and barely spoke English. I recommend walking an extra 5 minutes to eat somewhere else.

author: Victoria Prokopovych
review_text: I really loved this place! We had breakfast inside, but there are also plenty of cozy tables outside in the backyard. The atmosphere was great and the service was excellent, the staff were very friendly and welcoming. We ordered the avo toast, PLT croissant, and Dubai latte, and everything was delicious. Highly recommend!

author: Riadh Said
review_text: I was really impressed by the reviews before trying this brunch place, so my expectations were high. I ordered the avocado toast with extra salmon and, given the price (around $30), I was expecting something more refined. The sourdough bread was excellent & crunchy on the outside and fluffy inside. However, the avocado was overly mashed and tasted very similar to the small pre-made guacamole cups from Costco. The egg was also disappointing, it felt like a standard machine-boiled egg, similar to what you’d get at McDonald’s or Tim Hortons, rather than something house-made or authentic. The side salad was another letdown as the dressing was very watery, as you can see in the picture, which took away from the overall freshness. On a positive note, the salmon was good, and the service and atmosphere were both great. Overall, a pleasant experience, but the food didn’t quite live up to the price or the hype.

author: Emma Lopez-Ponnada
review_text: Enjoyed my lunch here. Belen was a very nice server. They have a $19 lunch special. 1 protein, 2 sides, soup, & a coffee. I chose lamb kofta (juicy), humus, and salad. We also tried two delicious pastries: orange pound cake & spicy beef sfiha (also juicy). They do charge an automatic 18% service charge when you eat in & ask if you want to leave tip on top of that when you check out.

author: Carlos “Carlos H Mencia” Mencia
review_text: Place is a great quaint cafe I got breakfast in. Food was excellent along with the service and ambience. Definitely recommend going here if you want to have a good breakfast. My server Fabriccio was excellent server making sure food was on time and we were always comfortable. He was also not intrusive just checking the right amount of times.

author: Kim Cano
review_text: I tried Bobe yesterday with some girlfriends as I found in on TikTok and unfortunately I would have to say it was an ok place to eat. My server was super sweet and friendly and very accommodating to any allergies i had. The decor on the inside is super cute but unfortunately we are here for the food but why I’m giving 3 stars is because the food does lack in flavor unfortunately and so do the drinks. I wouldn’t be back but I will say the vibe is cute but as far as for the food and drinks * I had a strawberry matcha latte * you’re not missing out on anything and they’re are better places nearby that are so much more flavorful in their food.

author: Shannon Lee
review_text: First day in Miami and we stumbled on such a gem! Love the whimsical decor inside! The shakshuka was so hearty and the lox bagel was perfect! Belen was our waitress and she made sure we had everything we needed. Can’t wait to come back tomorrow!

author: Cathy Dang
review_text: Such a cute establishment with so much seating! Both indoor and outdoor. Great assortment of food and drinks. Service was excellent. Only thing I didn’t appreciate was that the photos of the grandmas on the wall Were so clearly AI generated. Would have loved to see real family photos or real grandmas. But that’s not enough to Derail my review from being a five star regardless.

author: Raquel Hokett
review_text: My sister and I were in town for a concert and were staying at the Port of Miami Holiday Inn. This little café/bakery was right behind the building! I could not stop stating how damn cute and fabulous this place was, the instant I walked in. They have a little gift shop where you can get shirts, cups, and little knick knacks. Too pricey for me (coffee mug in the $25-$30 range) but I understand it’s a small business thing. The items were seemingly well crafted and adorable! The atmosphere was very cutesy and welcoming and I just wish there was a place like this where I live. I would literally WALK there every day! We had a chocolate muffin and a hazelnut filled croissant which were out of this world. I had asked if I could get an iced vanilla latte with oat milk (was not on the menu) and the barista told me he could make me anything I wanted. Those three items cost $20. I was delighted to see that they actually serve lunch/dinner items and regret not going back. I heavily contemplated only eating from this place for our entire weekend stay! It really is that good. Reminded me of the bakeries in Italy. I actually thought all of the food on display was fake. Like when you go into Starbucks or something. But it is REAL! My croissant and my sister’s muffin was plucked right from the display window! Highly recommend! You will NOT be disappointed. We got our food to go and I was just praising my coffee the entire time I took a sip. Best coffee I have EVER had made. So creamy and flavorful and not bitter or too sweet. Just perfect.

author: A Viz
review_text: The food is out of this world. The service is amazing. The atmosphere is way beyond what we expected. Can't believe that we have not visited this place before. Will definitely come here again. You can't go wrong with anything on the menu. Camila was our waitress and she was AMAZING.

author: Dominique Guirand
review_text: Efereń was amazing, he helped me through and through and even helped me charge my computer while attending to busy guests. I got the beef kebab and it was 10/10 — also the matcha was amazing. Def a great study spot.

author: Mahesh choppa
review_text: Such a delightful experience! The shakshuka was rich and flavorful, and the pistachio affogato was exceptional. The complimentary pistachio tart was a lovely touch. Warm service, lovely staff, relaxing atmosphere — I left feeling genuinely happy. Highly recommend! 🌿

author: Logen Willey
review_text: My friends and I wanted to try a cute little place for a delicious breakfast and that’s exactly what we got. I couldn’t decide because everything sounded so good but I chose French toast and a caramel frappe. I was not disappointed. The atmosphere is very aesthetic and pleasing and a fun place to go with friends. I would come again for sure !

author: Ayleen Trindade
review_text: I’ve been here twice in one week and it’s just so good. You get the great service, tasty food, good coffee, and the pink aesthetics. Thank you Valentina & Annabelle! You ladies are so hospitable! 10/10 recommend

author: Edonore
review_text: Loved the vibe at Bobe Kitchen & Bakery. The black coffee hit just right — smooth and strong, without being too bitter. Tried the “Dubai Style” croissant and some Danish pastries and everything tasted incredibly fresh and flavorful. Sandra, who was working that day, was the sweetest. Super kind and attentive. Definitely one of those little spots you remember. 🥰

author: m caparra
review_text: Amazing! The food, the people, the atmosphere are all amazing. The rose and white chocolate coffee and any of the PLT sandwich were chef's kiss. I will miss this place and will definitely come back to Miami just for Bobe!

author: Richard
review_text: Great breakfast restaurant with fast and corteous service! Camila was very nice! Definitely a recommendation!

author: Cassius Clay
review_text: Bobe Kitchen & Bakery is incredible! The environment is really cool with such a creative design that makes you want to stay and enjoy. The staff were so friendly and helpful, which made the experience even better. I ordered a pizza and a latte through Uber Eats and both were delicious. Everything on the menu looked amazing, so I definitely want to come back to sit down and try more. Highly recommend this spot!

author: Henry
review_text: Friendly bakery / coffee shop. Enjoyed a lovely Salmon bagel breakfast as well as coffee and some of their pasties. Good to see stuff being baked in front of your eyes.

author: Natasha Zeba
review_text: Special thanks to Carolina and Camila for making my birthday super special! Very friendly staff and amazing atmosphere. Muchas gracias. This is one of the best bakeries ever. I went there for some coffee and cake and guess what! Someone ended up paying for my treats.

author: Ale P
review_text: Service was great and the place is beautiful. We had an iced pistachio latte and iced almond milk latte with the omelette and banana cake. The service was excellent and very attentive. We got are food pretty quick!

author: {Michie-Bea}
review_text: One of my absolute favorite places to go nearly everyday! Highly recommend. Very pretty place with the best hot chocolate for blocks. Amazing orange juice and amazing eggs. Absolutely try the French toast as well!

author: Laura Jeraci
review_text: came for a quick breakfast / brunch before heading on my flight. ordered a hot coffee with milk, got no milk. asked for milk, was met with confusion and given like half a shot of it. whatever no big deal, some places use creamer mainly. we ordered a waffle and eggs benedict. the eggs Benedict came with balsamic glaze on it?? not sure why but that's not usually a dish that needs acidity. and the waffle was "like cardboard, no flavor" according to my friend. i guess i was expecting more for it being near so many hotels and the ports. if you need a quick bite go for it, but don't expect too much.

author: Alan Staton
review_text: Lovely local cafe, we past it a few times on our walks to and from the hotel so we went in on our last 2 mornings for breakfast. You order and pay at the till, then take a seat. The decor is lovley, all neon signs and plants, theres a few TV screens but they were just showing a screensaver. The food was excellent and set us up for the day, think we skipped dinner we were that full. Crispy bacon and maple syrup is so nice. Infact thats why we went back a second time.

author: Janardhan MP
review_text: Very poor service and waited close to 1 hour. Totally understaffed and no proper response either from the staff. When ordered they mentioned it will be 20 mins but ended up waiting 1 hour. We had kids who were hungry and asked to expedite and all we got is sorry. Definitely not recommending the restaurant as the staff need to be trained on customer service. Chocolate chip cookie was mentioned as 50 cents in the menu but was charged $2.79. We did ask about the cookie before ordering and was misguided. When asked about this all we got is just sorry again.

author: Celio Centeno
review_text: The food was good. And the service too. They serve a lot, so have this in mind when you order.

author: Bob Job
review_text: Cafe Papillon has great food, but unfortunately the service really fell short. After paying, we asked for milk in one of the coffees and never received it. The Turkish coffee also wasn’t prepared properly. When we were seated, the table hadn’t been cleaned, there was still a bit of a mess on it and we had to call the server back to wipe it down. The space itself is very small and tightly packed, with chairs and tables extremely close together, which made it uncomfortable. On top of that, some of the staff came off with an attitude. I understand early mornings can be rough, but it still affects the experience. Overall, while the food was good, the poor service and lack of attention made it disappointing. Wouldn’t recommend.

author: DiM 1
review_text: Place is small inside, but there's some seats outside. Servers are very relaxed. Need to speak slowly and confirm your order. Food is really good they rush so make sure your potatoes are fully cooked. The Cuban coffee is BANGING! great! They make fresh OJ. French toast is great as well.

author: Perica Milicev
review_text: Very small place, just 4/5 tables inside available, but the location is good. No free parking around, so you gotta park on the spot which is $5 per hour. The service was quick and no much hassle. We liked fresh squeezed juices which were delicious but the food was just mediocre, not too much taste and flavour, just a basic experience which i think wasn’t worth for the price we paid for it. If you want a nice coffee or fresh squeezed juice while walking around downtown, this is a good place for it.

author: Antonionia “Marie”
review_text: $4 champagne $6 bellinis cant beat that. Nice big breakfast portions cant beat the price for the amount of food. Nice ambiance. Super soft baguettes. Tasty french toast. I enjoyed my meal. The food compared to the price, location and ambiance is unbeatable.

author: Tiago França
review_text: Man, I gotta tell you… What an amazing breakfast!!! I’ve had the “Papillon Special Omelette” with a fresh and real sweet orange juice. Absolutely divine. It’s a well deserved place to visit and enjoy the low back playlist and “zen” environment.

author: Daniela Bárbara Martínez Ramos
review_text: I love the food at this place — one of the best breakfasts I’ve had in Downtown Miami.

author: Lea Flego
review_text: Unmarked missing items from the menu. Food is mediocre. Drinks from the fridge not cold. Rude service when asked to correct an order. Decor is cute, but seating is awkward. Surprised at this place having such a high rating on Trip Advisor. Wouldn’t come back.

author: Hannah Marymarie
review_text: This is the cutest little breakfast place we have been to on vacation so far! The inside is instagram worthy vibes with plenty of photo opportunities! My only complaint thus far is we couldn't sit inside to eat because it was so hot! It could be tolerable but not comfortable.

author: Amanda Antonino
review_text: This place is terrible. The service sucked. We all got our food at a different time. They sold one of our meals to someone else and told us it was gonna be 30 to 45 minute wait for them to make it again after we’ve already been here for an hour. Don’t waste your money go somewhere else.

author: Yazmin Bu
review_text: I definitely adored this place! The food was amazing and prices were very affordable. The service was great, friendly staff that make you feel at home. I had brunch with friends after taking a walk and it was definitely a lovely way to finish our morning. Excellent atmosphere with beautiful decoration and great choice of music to complement an ample variety of delicious plates!! I recommend the Dulce de Leche Croissant waffle 😄

author: Geneva Williams
review_text: So me and my guy wanted some breakfast while in Miami we came across Cafe Papillon the pictures outside the door looked great and I glanced at some of the plates through the window they looked great so we decided to go in . We had to order at the register and pay before we ate ok didn't like that we found a table sooo presentation is everything to me and when she brought the breakfast out I looked at my eggs which supposed to be egg whites but the were gray the cook either burnt the butter or just didn't care what was going into my bowl the food wasn't good it seemed like they just threw it on the cutting board and served it to us . But I was really upset when I seen the gentleman on the side of us platter was perfect looked just the picture. They treat us tourists any kind of way and their own like a celebrity which I don't like.. Sorry I'm giving you guys a thumbs 👎 👎👎👎.

author: Camila García Varas
review_text: Best brunch in town! Delicious & Good pricing. Definitely coming back!

author: Bonnie Harrell
review_text: Within walking distance from our hotel, the Cafe Papillon provided so many options to choose from for Breakfast. I chose the Magda’s combo breakfast with eggs over medium. The eggs were not too oily or buttery or salty. The bacon was also not very salty or greasy. The French toast was the perfect way to end the meal on a sweeter note. Coffee was great, as was the cappuccino.

author: W. V. F.
review_text: Nice breakfast place, great food and a lot of it. Coffee is good too, and the orange juice is fresh pressed. Prices are not much more than a fast food breakfast at Denny’s, so for the location I can highly recommend it.

author: OB
review_text: Food looked pretty good when it came out. Everything tasted ok in the end, it was just lacking a bit. Staff thought it was a good idea to give us plastic forks and knives to cut steak. Had to ask 4 times and wait 20 minutes before we got it. Service was worse. It really felt like none of the staff members wanted to be there.

author: Nicole from HBCU 20x20
review_text: La Industria Bakery & Cafe has the best food in Miami, and I stand on that. We stumbled in while walking through Bayside before a boat ride and ended up eating here twice in one day. For breakfast, my husband had La Combi Completa and couldn’t stop talking about how fresh everything tasted. I had the Chicken Bacon Waffle Sandwich and it was perfect. And their bacon? The best I’ve ever had. Forget millionaire bacon elsewhere. We later skipped a dinner reservation at the former Versace Mansion just to come back. I had the ribs (fall-off-the-bone amazing), my husband had the La Boricua Burger, and we tried a Venezuelan empanada out of curiosity… unreal. Best empanada I’ve ever had. We actually risked missing our flight to have 2 to made to go. Amazing food, kind servers, attentive managers, great ambiance. Believe the hype. 10/10.

author: Melissa Texidor
review_text: My Husband and I are Holiday for the holidays and our very first dining experience in Miami… La Industria. LA COMBI COMPLETA had the best of everything on one dish. He began eating before I got the full pic. I ordered NICKY JAM'S FAVORITE -Guava marmalade, cream cheese frosting, graham cracker crumbs served … both AMAZING!! Service was great and even my take home bag was a surprise❤️ with a guava and cheese pastry

author: Mario Flores
review_text: We traveled into Miami for a convention and arrived early, so we stopped at Nicky Jam’s La Industria Bakery & Café for breakfast. It definitely has an interesting vibe, but it felt like it was missing a few atmosphere elements that would have elevated it into a high-end spot. The food was excellent — I ordered La Combi Completa with the Strawberry Cheesecake topping, and it even came with a slice of cheesecake, which was a great surprise. The coffee was strong and just what I needed for a morning pick-me-up. Overall, good food and good start to the day — with a little more attention to the ambiance, this place could really stand out even more. Worth a visit if you’re in the area early and hungry!

author: Miguel Alvarez
review_text: The Boricua Burger at La Industria had great potential the flavors were there, but the arepa was served cold and could’ve used a creamy sauce to tie everything together. Our server seemed distracted and missed two of our items, which took away from the experience. When it came time to pay, she mentioned that a 20% tip was already included, and seemed upset when I didn’t add more that was uncomfortable. The milkshakes were beautifully presented but a bit overpriced and not as sweet as expected. Overall, the atmosphere and concept are nice, but there’s definitely room for improvement in both service and food consistency. Overall I would not recommend or return!

author: Arihant Paruchuru
review_text: We ordered cheese arepas, fries, and a guava marmalade waffle, and every item was disappointing. The waffle had no noticeable cream at all—only the bland taste of the waffle itself. None of the food stood out in a good way, and honestly, the only thing worth consuming was the water. Overall, a very underwhelming experience.

author: m daniels
review_text: Great Vibes, Overwhelming Portions The vibes at this brunch spot were absolutely amazing—stylish atmosphere, great music, and a fun crowd. However, the food itself was just okay. What really stood out (and not necessarily in a good way) were the portion sizes. Each dish easily serves about four people, which might be great for those with a big appetite, but as someone with a smaller stature, it felt overwhelming. I ended up wasting a lot of food, which was disappointing. I wouldn’t recommend this place unless you're coming hungry or planning to share.

author: Gissella Lightsey
review_text: Loved the food, loved the environment. The lady who served us was very attentive, polite, nice and gracious. Her name was Carolina . We were blessed to have her. We were party of 3. We. shared some ribs, blue cheese burger 🍔, empanadas and some frappes .. We enjoyed what we had The ribs was about $30ish (I think) The blue cheese burger $22 Each empanada about $6 The frappes $14.99 each We had an awesome time. 20% tip was included in the bill and after that you have the option to tip 3, 5, or 7% more .

author: Celio Centeno
review_text: The food was good. The service was good too. Be advice that they serve a lot of food. We order "la convi completa" and we ate two out of it. The "arepas were really good too".

author: Michal Berkovich
review_text: Great spot next to Bayside Marketplace! Excellent coffee and desserts, with friendly and attentive service. Perfect place to grab something to eat before or after a boat tour at Bayside in Miami. Highly recommended!

author: Shandreka Hall
review_text: Brunch at this upscale gem was everything I didn’t know I needed! From the moment we walked in, the vibes were immaculate — the decor is stunning and absolutely perfect for photo ops. Every corner feels curated for both comfort and aesthetics. The food? Delicious with impressively large portions that left us full and happy. Every dish was seasoned perfectly and beautifully presented. What really made the experience unforgettable was the service. Carolina was our waitress and she was phenomenal — attentive, kind, and incredibly professional. The entire staff worked like a well-oiled machine. If we had a dirty dish or napkin on the table, it was gone within seconds. Our table was kept spotless the entire time, which really elevated the dining experience.

author: Yachai Reilly
review_text: I am obsessed with mofongos, so it was a must to stop here for brunch. Love the bayside market area. So much to do. Brunch was great. Gets very busy & is so much fun!

author: Adibe Garces
review_text: The food was presented beautifully and tasted delicious. Dayanara was so kind and friendly, she made us feel so welcome. Everyone had wonderful customer service. And the ambiance was increíble! I will definitely come back next time I’m in Miami!

author: Julianna Diaz
review_text: Nicki Jam's restaurant. I thought the whole time I was going to see Puerto Rican food, but to be honest, I think it's more Venezuelan food. It's very tasty. The arepitas with cheese are delicious, and the arepa with beef is delicious. Everything was great. It's best to make a reservation, especially if it's the weekend, because there's usually a wait time.

author: Sarah Devereaux
review_text: Such a relaxing space to share breakfast on our last day in Miami! Food was truly exceptional, from the maple bacon French toast all the way down to a simple, plain arepa. Coffee was awesome, and service was also fantastic. This will be a new tradition during our annual Miami trip! Thanks to the staff and chef!

author: SUNSHYNE315
review_text: First time here and I was so impressed...The food was excellent. My server Dayanara was amazing. Very friendly and accommodating. Thank you!

author: Gavin Peterson
review_text: Had outdoor seating for a quick bite. Or indoor seating for a more dedicated experience. 10/10 staff. Music was upbeat and kept the mood lively. The food was fantastic. Service charge is a part of the meal. It was a bit pricy, but some of the best breakfast items I've ever had. Definitely worth it.

author: Mursal Guliyev
review_text: I had a great experience at La Industria. The atmosphere was vibrant and stylish, with great music and decor. The food was fresh and flavorful.The staff was friendly and attentive, and everything came out quickly. Definitely a great spot for a casual lunch or a fun dinner with friends. I’ll be coming back soon!

author: Tiffany Morales
review_text: Worth Every Bite! From the moment we walked in, this restaurant impressed on every level. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, but it was the exceptional staff who truly set the tone for the afternoon. Friendly, attentive, and genuinely passionate about what they do—they made us feel like VIPs from start to finish. Our server Evelyn was superb!! Now, the food? Absolutely phenomenal. Every dish was a masterpiece bursting with flavor. The ingredients were clearly fresh and thoughtfully combined—each bite felt like a celebration. Whether it was the perfectly seasoned appetizers, the beautifully presented main courses, or the decorative coffees, everything was cooked to perfection. This place is a shining example of what great dining should be: delicious food, outstanding service, and a memorable experience. We’re already planning our next visit!

author: Chloe
review_text: Perfect spot for those Instagram 🤭 worthy pancake shots 📸🥞 The pancakes were yummy, but the toast with whipped cream was definitely the winner for me 😋🍞💛

author: Filip Świercz
review_text: Thanks to Susana, I’m giving this place 5 stars. I met the manager(probably), and he wanted to serve my coffee in a paper cup because of some rule. Honestly, if it wasn’t for Susana, I would have left a negative review — when you pay over $4 for a coffee, you don’t expect to drink it like it’s from a vending machine. Luckily, Susana really cares about the restaurant’s good reputation and made sure I had a great experience.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Yongkwan Song
review_text: I ordered delivery through Uber Eats to my hotel, and tried the USDA Prime Beef Picada. The portion was reasonable, and overall the flavor was good. The best item was the Churrasco — the meat was tender, aromatic, and not tough at all. The only disappointing part was the Lomo (Prime Pork Loin). It was quite salty, so I couldn’t eat much of it. If you don’t feel like going out but want to enjoy some meat in your room, I would recommend it. And if a full set feels too heavy, choosing individual cuts might be a better option. The mashed potatoes and corn that I ordered on the side were also delicious — especially the mashed potatoes, which were extremely smooth with just the right seasoning. One downside: I ordered twice from the hotel and asked for utensils both times, but none were ever included. Luckily, my hotel had utensils available, but if you’re staying somewhere without them, it could be quite inconvenient.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Clint MacLeod
review_text: Really decent steak sandwich, comes with 3 mini dips - the hot sauce and chimichurri are excellent, didn’t try the third & includes a portion of chips. All for $16. As a Scottish tourist here I did not expect that much of a bargain. Thoroughly worth a visit. Only downside is no seating - but it is a snack van so understandable.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Magdalena Velichkova
review_text: The food was soooooo delicious we ate until we couldn’t. The meat was professionally cooked and the sides with it were perfect. For these food we would have paid at least 200 dollars if we were on the bay side. AMAZING

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Ivo Salazar
review_text: I am writing to formally express my deep disappointment regarding an order I received today from your Bayfront Park location. I ordered two pounds of meat, but what was delivered was approximately 90% fat and scraps, completely unfit to be served as food. I have photos and videos of the order to support my claim. It is unacceptable and frankly a shame that whoever prepared and dispatched my order considered this quality of product acceptable. I have always enjoyed eating at your restaurant, but after this disastrous experience, I am left feeling deceived and frustrated. Out of a $50 order, the only thing I was able to eat was the $4 rice. I strongly urge you to review the quality control at this location, as serving customers in this manner seriously damages trust in your brand. If you would like, I am willing to share the photos and videos of the order for your review.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Adolfo Cañamar
review_text: My first time in Miami FL, Came across this Food truck so I gave it a try & I didn't regret it! Came back the next day for more, the food was delicious! I got the lamb chops with corn on the cob & even a simple mashed potatoes was so amazing with a unique flavor . My wife had the lomo sándwiches & really enjoyed them. Great service, very friendly and the prices were very fair for the quality of the meats .. No tables but we walked to the front to the pier & u can enjoy it there or have a picnic on the grass anywhere .. Highly recommended it ..

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Audric strongestkarate
review_text: Good quality of meat. Cooked well. Right amount of seasoning. Friendly staffs. But no tables to eat. Try them out. Servings are huge too.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: INQUSE GENERAL CONTRACTOR
review_text: I stopped by this food truck, and I can confidently say it has nothing to envy from the big steakhouses. The quality of the meat cuts is simply outstanding—perfectly cooked and full of flavor. The service was incredible, with friendly and attentive staff that made the experience even better. Definitely a highly recommended spot for true meat lovers. A solid 10/10!

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Gary Floyd
review_text: The menu pictured on the side of the truck looked amazing, but the actual food we received was the exact opposite. Bacon wrapped chicken was as dry and tough as could be, pork tacos were dry as could be. The portions were definitely not as pictured on the menu. We walked by the truck several times and never saw any customers. Makes sense now.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Rocky Ali
review_text: I went twice, the first time I got the steak sandwich and was great. The 2nd time I took my wife, we got the steak sandwich again w churrasco and an order of lamb chops We both got extreme food poisoning. Would not recommend, at least not the food truck. Dont even want to bother with the restaurant if they cant keep their food truck to safely handle food

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Andrija Milinkovic
review_text: This place is amazing I loved the food and the staff were so friendly and welcoming. I am amazed by the quality of the meats whole Miami should eat at this place!!🦾🍀

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Albert Martirosyan
review_text: the meat they put on the menu does not correspond to reality and the same weight dishes. the wait is very long. file mignon is the cheapest beef..

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Angel Travieso
review_text: THE WAITRESS WAS VERY CANDID IN EXPLAINING THE MENU AND RIPPED US OFF 2 PEOPLE A 179.00 PLATE . THAT IS JUST WRONG.... AND A 44.00 SERVICE FEE PLUS A TIP.... THAT IS WRONG. THE FOOD WAS UNDER COOKED WHEN ASKED WELL DONE. HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Jörg Baumeister
review_text: Lunch was fantastic. Highly recommended. Angus burger and chicken special with bacon. Very friendly service.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Shannon Jones
review_text: Smelled so good we had to try it!! We were not disappointed!! It’s very good!!

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Izzy C
review_text: Don’t tell them the bacon wrapped chicken is dry like a cardboard, there is a blonde manager that will get mad and tell you that the chicken is normally very dry… 😅 we have been at this restaurant like 20 times last two visits not so good

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Sydney
review_text: Paid never got food, gave me a beeper neber beeped, vibrated or anything came back less Than a hour later they gone with my $60 and my food mind u im starving no dinner no refund nothing

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Lisa Bennett
review_text: Amazing food! Ordered the picahna steak sandwich, it was sooo good! Great flavours and came with 3 different sauces which made it even better if that’s possible! Fabulous service with a great smile from Antonieta, told us about the other locations of the restaurants and trucks. Make sure you try this in Miami, just the best ❤️

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Yovanna2 Pardo
review_text: Love the pican̈a sandwich. Cravings for steak. Great price . Buying another skirt sandwich for my coworker 😋

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Erick Morales
review_text: This spot is a must when you are in the area and are craving delicious steaks and burgers, very flavorful food. My favorite is the Picada with their delicious chimichurri sauce. And Let’s not forget, the great service I received from the staff.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Andres Yepez
review_text: THE BEST FOOD ON THE AREA!! What’s better than good food? Great service! The food was delicious, the environment was fun, and everyone was super friendly. I will return; thank you to the whole team for the great experience!

author: Jennifer Stewart
review_text: Great location! We sat outside to enjoy the view, people watch, and listen to music from nearby restaurants. Ernest was very attentive and had excellent suggestions for menu items to try out. Portions for the mains are generous- so bring a healthy appetite or get a to go box. Everything we tried was flavorful and fresh. It was helpful to have photos of the menu items and drinks.

author: Marilyn Secor
review_text: We made a reservation for Christmas Day for my family of five. What a disappointment. Please check all the current negative reviews before you decide to dine here. The food was mediocre at best. The service was the worse I have ever experienced. The bill was 185.00 and we did not order drinks. Two of the dishes came out coated with sesame seeds which was not listed as one of the ingredients on the menu. I had oral surgery a week before and not able to eat nuts or seeds. When I made the server aware of it she nasily said it was listed on the ingredient list amd asked me if i wanted to order something else. I couldn't believe she didn't offer to bring another without the seeds. I said no and she abruptly left. I took a picture of the menu, sesame seeds were not listed. I wasn't able to eat anything. I asked to speak to the manager and he was unsympathetic. He offered free dessert. We were given 2 desserts to share for a family of five in a brown paper bag to go. What a waste of money. Not a great way to spend Christmas. Avoid this place. There are so many other places to dine that are so much better, especially if you want excellent food and top notch service. They also automatically add 20% to the bill for the tip. I suppose they have to or the servers would never make money. Since they know they are getting a tip regardless they don't work for it.

author: Amy B
review_text: Wow! Easily the best meal I had in Miami! The location is great, in the marina, but the food is what stood out. The pulled pork (lechon asado) and tamal (not pictured) were fantastic! The mashed potatoes, steamed vegetables and plantains were also fantastic. We actually ate here twice during our vacation because it was that good. The staff was very friendly and attentive. Cannot recommend this place enough!

author: JT Ysseldyke
review_text: Great food, and a fun atmosphere. I just fell like I was hung out to dry when it came to the bill. The server when I was ordering my drink asked if I wanted a small cup or medium. I said medium but unbeknownst to me the medium is a $40 drink (compared to the $16 "small"). To say when I got the bill I wasnt a Happy Camper is an understatement. Plus they add a mandatory 20% tip. I wish that was disclosed somewhere on the website, because a $40 drink (2x more than my food) lead to a massive mandatory tip I wasnt aware of until the server was breathing down my back. Just be aware of these tactics and switcheroos.

author: David Dars
review_text: We are so glad we skipped Bubba Gumps and cane to Kuba. Awesome service by all the staff, good food and good prices. The Crispy Boniatos was new to us and so tasty we would go back just for those. The meals were very good but we would have enjoyed a bit more spice but this was our first for Cuban style food. Shredded flank steak with salad and shredded pork with rice/black beans

author: Tim Ou
review_text: Food was good and serviced is excellent. Not the typical ones you get from Miami. Lobster was worth a tried. And service charge 20% is already included in the bill and waitress make sure you know about it. Worth it .

author: Faith
review_text: Atmosphere kind of busy because it's located on the boardwalk. Great for vegetarians. The congris: black beans 🫘 and rice was okay. Maybe i should have tasted it before eating the Kuba Fried Rice (V) I added eggs 🥚 it was delicious 😋 one of my top best rice I've had so far. The snapper & Sandwich Kubano was also very flavored and succulent. Only downside is gnats was swarming around my personal vinergeret salad 🥗 I just covered all my plates up until I was ready to divulge into them 😉 great servers kind of pricey but you pay for quality of food right? 😉 It was wroth it will visit again

author: Donyel Byrd
review_text: There were many choices in the marketplace to eat. However, we were SO happy with our choice to eat here. We really wanted Cuban food. It was so good! It was very hot, so we opted to eat inside. The ambiance and service were excellent! Highly recommend!

author: erin
review_text: Yasniel was excellent! Every item we ordered was recommended by him and excellent! Tha Vaca Frita was incredible and can never go wrong with maduros in Miami. Great service and great food!

author: Maria T
review_text: Lively area inside Bayside. Very nice views by the water. Food was delicious. Anthony gave us great service.

author: Fermin Coto
review_text: Fantastic place!!! The music on a Wednesday afternoon before Thanksgiving was a little loud, but I think that is the vibe, and likely I'm just old now. The food was fantastic, one of the best Cubanos I've ever had. The Kubiche was phenomenal, the right blend of citrus and savory.

author: cindy davis
review_text: Our food came hot, and it tasted fresh. We got the sandwiches that were circled, and to go with them I got white sweet potato (very good), husband got Cuban rice and beans (really good). Erin is a good server. As you can see on the ticket they already do a 20% tip. I would go back but we're just visiting.

author: LeAngela Robinson
review_text: We were celebrating birthdays! The food was delicious! The drinks were delicious! Ask for the house hot sauce. It's so good!The music and atmosphere were a vibe. Couldn't stop eating the good food and couldn't stop dancing while eating. Yummy Fun! 💃🏽💃🏽💃🏽💃🏽

author: Daniel Rothamel
review_text: The food was amazing. The Kuba fried rice was delecious, and had a perfect balance of rice to ingredients. I have never in my life had a plantain that was that delicious! Yasniel was super friendly, and he made great recommendations, answering all of the questions of our large party. Eating here was a wonderful experience from beginning to end.

author: Alberto Guzman
review_text: I recently had the pleasure of dining at a this charming restaurant situated right in front of a marina, offering a mostly enjoyable experience, though there were some areas that could be improved. The first thing that captured my attention was the stunning view of the marina—a picturesque backdrop that made it an ideal spot for a relaxing dinner. However, the environment was a bit noisier than I prefer, with lively conversations and the sounds of nearby boats creating a bustling atmosphere that occasionally distracted from the meal. The food, on the other hand, was a true delight. The menu featured a variety of delicious options, and each dish we ordered was well-prepared, flavorful, and made with fresh ingredients that perfectly complemented the waterfront setting. I also appreciated the surprisingly quick meal prep time, which allowed us to enjoy the evening without long waits between courses. The service was friendly and attentive, with our server ensuring our drinks were filled and checking in on us regularly. However, during peak times, it seemed they were stretched a bit thin, resulting in slight delays. Even so, I was impressed with their efficiency in delivering our meals promptly. Unfortunately, one downside to our visit was the occasional presence of individuals approaching our table to ask for money. While I understand this can occur in busy areas, it was disruptive and detracted from an otherwise pleasant experience. It would be helpful for the restaurant to implement measures to better manage such interruptions, enhancing the overall ambiance and comfort for diners.

author: Nur
review_text: Kuba On the Bay is a vibrant gem that transported my wife and me straight to the heart of Havana! We savored every bite of the Ropa Vieja, a soul-warming dish with tender, shredded beef swimming in a rich, tangy tomato sauce that danced on our taste buds. The Vaca Frita was equally phenomenal—crispy, marinated beef with a perfect char, paired with caramelized onions that added a delightful sweetness. Each dish was a masterful blend of authentic Cuban flavors, served with a side of warm, island hospitality. To top it off, we sipped on their virgin Piña Colada, a creamy, tropical dream that was so refreshing it felt like a mini-vacation in a glass—pineapple and coconut perfection without the buzz. The atmosphere was lively yet cozy, with colorful decor and a bayfront view that made the evening unforgettable. Kuba On the Bay is a must-visit for anyone craving bold flavors and a true taste of Cuba. We can’t wait to return!

author: Lumi Chuang
review_text: My husband and I visited Miami for the first time to get away from the Northern cold wave. It was only for a few days and wanted to try some Cuban food. I have severe gluten and dairy allergies so I researched online and this place kept coming up. We went a little after lunch, got seated inside, the music outside was soooo loud!! It was a little quieter inside, but not much. We ordered two appetizers and an entree to share. It took a while to get served, even to get some water, hardly any customers inside or outside. A lot of servers were just chatting and laughing around. Waited a little longer and a young woman came and asked what we wanted. I got a mocktail too and that came pretty fast, with whipped cream on top. I asked if that was whipped cream and she said yes, I gently reminded her I had a severe dairy allergy. She said no problem. I saw her tell the bartender and also saw the bartender roll her eyes, but got me another drink. Finally, food came, the plantains were tasty, everything else was just meh. That evening I was violently ill all night throwing up and going to the bathroom. My throat swelled up (the gluten part of my allergy), and the GI is my dairy allergy. Let’s just say it was a long night and the next day I was nauseated the whole day, couldn’t eat much. This is a note to the restaurant: when a client says they have an allergy, please, please educate your staff to know what not to do or do in the kitchen. Sure, you don’t need to serve us, just tell us, hey, there’s nothing for you here. Friends and family always ask us where we should all meet up for lunch/dinner, because of our allergies. We won’t pick your restaurant, just let us know. No one owes us a cooked meal, I get it, we just need to be told so we don’t suffer while on vacation. Thank you! I don’t usually write reviews, but I will now because people like me, with different allergies, need to be informed. If you have allergies, give this spot a miss. Even if you don’t, the food wasn’t all that great. I’ve had better Cuban food.

author: TELU VENDING LLC
review_text: Caroline was great! She took great care of me and my friends and was very attentive and brought out or food in a timely manner. She was also very pleasant and made sure to give us the best service!

author: Ali Safarov
review_text: Stopped here for an early lunch. Great food, great service, great location—and of course, a great view! It was enjoyable sitting outside watching the boats. I had the Beef Empanada, Sandwich Kubano, and a beer. I’ll definitely recommend this restaurant.

author: flightmedic333
review_text: It’s always a great experience here at Kuba in bayside, bartenders are very attentive especially Dalila, she’s always on point with the drinks, and she’s absolutely beautiful so that’s always a plus. chavely works very well with her as another bartender, she’s always working on something but somehow has time to ask if we need something. Also very pretty. This place is definitely a whole vibe. I recommend 100%

author: Scumdog 1980
review_text: Food was really good. Taco Nachos were amazing. Fish and chips were a win for me and im not a seafood person. The chicken sandwich with Chipotle pineapple aioli was also amazing. The dragonfruit spritzer was great, the strawberry one not as good. Our waitress Shanda did an amazing job taking care of us. Never once felt rushed and over burdened.

author: J P
review_text: Oceanside restaurant along the boardwalk very scenic. The food is good and you get plenty in your serving. I wish they had a single burger item on the menu but all they have for adults is double burgers which are too huge to finish. The kids menu has a single burger. Very good drinks coke, lemonade etc. Great location next to Margaritaville surfing machine. Friendly staff. Easy parking right next to the restaraunt in the parking garage. Prices are fair for the size of the items.

author: Not A Lie
review_text: Ordered tacos and got burnt tacos with black char on the sides with the most basic ingredients in the tacos that they were flavorless. If the chef burns his food, just toss it and redo it!!! At least there were chips and salsa on the side to snack in. Sadly this was a togo order so I only noticed that it was bad when I was already at a beach and there was nothing I could do about it. At least the servers and hostess were nice and helpful in the restaurant.

author: aimiaiko roselinne
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 10/10 Experience at LandShark Bar & Grill! From the moment we arrived, the atmosphere was exactly what you’d want for a perfect getaway meal — fun, beachy, and full of good vibes. The view by the water was absolutely beautiful, especially at sunset. The staff was super friendly and attentive, making sure everything came out just right. Our food was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked — from the juicy burgers to the seafood dishes, everything tasted amazing. The drinks were also on point — refreshing, strong, and well-presented. You can tell this place was designed for people to relax and enjoy themselves. Whether you’re stopping by for lunch, dinner, or just cocktails by the water, it’s the perfect spot to unwind. I’d definitely recommend LandShark to anyone looking for great food, great views, and great service. Can’t wait to come back again soon! 🌴🍹

author: Doug Hall
review_text: We strolled the markets and decided to give this place a try. Three of us got the cheeseburger deal and we all thought the burgers were excellent. Best burger I have had in a long time. The draft Landshark was great also. Service was just meh - had to track down our check to pay and leave.

author: PA Muller
review_text: Really nice place! The service was good and the food was delicious! We sat by the window with a nice view of the water and yachts. I will say it was very expensive. We got two plates of food and two drinks for a total of almost $100. It was definitely an experience. Thank you, Land Shark!

author: Towanda “Princess”
review_text: Came with a huge party for a meet and greet. Service and food was good. I only got a drink and an appetizer. The peel and eat shrimp was enjoyable. I wanna come back and try a couple of things I saw on the menu. Great view if you eat outside.

author: Taylor Deni
review_text: There is probably a reason why they were so empty! I had a light late lunch. The seafood lettuce wraps were OK. Something you could make at home. Not worth the price. The seafood salad was gritty. I think they need to devein the shrimp. No atmosphere. Staff were pleasant. Would not recommend.

author: Thanuj Pothula
review_text: We had a great time at LandShark Bar & Grill! The Cajun Shrimp was packed with flavor and had just the right amount of spice. The Uptown Top Shelf Margarita was smooth and refreshing, a perfect match with the food. Our waitress Ann was amazing—super friendly and attentive, which made the whole experience even better. Definitely a place I’d come back to! 🌟🍤🍹

author: Eduardo
review_text: The staff was really rude. We sat outside and waited for about 10 minutes for someone to come take our order. Then a woman “ Alexandra” came over and told us we couldn’t sit there because we weren’t buying anything. But how are we supposed to buy something if no one even came to serve us? Are we supposed to serve ourselves now? Come on — that’s just ridiculous.

author: Ernest Baca
review_text: Ok so service was awesome food 3* if the key lime pie was pie not a custard would gain a star. The drinks were 5* but food will stay at 3*. But it is worth a stop inn. We can try again next week will update with new visit. Tony never let our drinks go dry. Thanks Tony!

author: Heather Dawson
review_text: From the drinks to the food to the wonderful service from Ann, everything was amazing. Will definitely be coming back here when in town again

author: Revelmonger
review_text: They were hosting a "Christmas Party" inside and the kitchen was apparently delayed. Anyways took over an hour to get our food and when it came out out of 5 people only 3 meals were ready. First time going to Hard Rock Cafe as my friends were telling me how great it was. Anyways it basically ruined the evening. If the kitchen can't handle a party and it's regular activities maybe they shouldn't be open to both at all. Wish we had just been told there was a delay instead of being seated and starving.

author: R. Fletcher
review_text: Great beachfront restaurant, the service was great, and the food was good and the atmosphere was electric. .. Beautiful views, near all the ships and shops. I highly recommend this place if you wants sights, sounds and a cool vibe.

author: LATASHA GALLEGOS
review_text: I really liked the spacious dining room, decor, and music. The restaurant and restroom was very clean. Our staff was friendly and attentive and I really enjoyed my fish & chips!

author: Lindsay Harris
review_text: We got an assortment from the menu and some drinks (fish tacos, burgers, and shrimp). Everyone loved their food, and I had the coconut castaway, which I could have drank 10 of since it was so delicious. Very big and fun restaurant, I like that they take photos and give you a free postcard with the option to buy a bigger one. Service was great, and we liked the music they played. Overall, the only complaint is that inside doesn't have air conditioning, but they do have ceiling fans. Lastly, I love the little fins they put in their burgers and the view of the water if you sit outside.🦈 ❤️

author: LN
review_text: Our recent trip to LandShark Bar & Grill at Miami Bayside was everything we love about dining in Miami! Located right on the waterfront, this spot is a tropical paradise where great vibes and mouthwatering flavors come together in perfect harmony. As soon as we walked in, we were greeted by the friendly staff and a laid-back, beachy atmosphere that made us feel like we were on vacation (even if it was just for a few hours!). The views of the marina, with boats gently bobbing in the water, set the perfect backdrop for our dining experience. Now, let’s talk about the food—because wow, was it incredible! We kicked things off with their signature LandShark Lager (how could we not?), which was the ideal way to start our Miami adventure. Crisp, refreshing, and just the right amount of chill to match the ocean breeze. For starters, we couldn’t resist the Peel & Eat Shrimp—juicy, succulent, and perfectly seasoned with Old Bay. It was like a taste of the sea on our plate! Then came the main course, and let me tell you, choosing just one dish was a challenge! But we finally settled on the Fish Tacos and Jimmy’s Jammin’ Jambalaya. The fish tacos were bursting with flavor—fresh, flaky fish topped with zesty slaw and a drizzle of creamy lime sauce that tied everything together. The jambalaya? A spicy, savory delight that transported us straight to the heart of the South. Each bite was packed with shrimp, chicken, and sausage, all swimming in a rich, flavorful sauce that we couldn’t get enough of. Of course, no visit to LandShark Bar & Grill would be complete without indulging in dessert. We went all out with the Chocolate Hurricane—a massive, chocolatey delight that was as decadent as it sounds. It was the perfect sweet ending to a fantastic meal. But what truly made our time at LandShark special was the vibe—casual, fun, and quintessentially Miami. Whether you’re hanging out with friends, enjoying a family meal, or just looking for a great place to unwind, LandShark Bar & Grill is the spot to be. We left with full hearts, full stomachs, and memories of a day well spent in paradise. If you’re ever in Miami, make sure to stop by and experience it for yourself—you won’t be disappointed!

author: Alpesh Patel
review_text: Food was ok, service was attentive. I expected more from basic nachos. Not spicy at all even though we asked for Jalapeños (I get it, Jalapeños are a hot or miss), but the fish didn’t make up for it.

author: Leah J
review_text: Reviews say service is slow, but Collin was all over and never left us sitting long. He was taking care of everyone and the bar and was going non stop. We had the pleasure of, also, interacting with Raul and he added to our pleasant experience! Too bad we are just visitors because this place would be a regular for me!

author: Melissa Sepulveda
review_text: I had a great experience at Landshark Bayside . From the hostess to the waitress. I loved my entire experience.The hostess Alexandra immediately welcomed us and sat us at the table we requested.The waitress Piper was friendly and funny making sure our food came out on time. Piper approached our table several times making sure we had everything that we needed at our reach. The manager Raul was very attentive to our services making sure our experience was great and that our food was up to standards. Our view was great as we watched the boats come into dock.

author: Usir Wulf
