review_text: As one of the only places truly capable,. of not just tapping into the scenic dining experiences the Bayside Inlet is known for providing, but also an accessible menu ; with the host being flavor, into the wide range of gustatory and olfactory delight the Caribbean and Canjun descendants of the Americans are historically known for providing 😋, i am delighted to bring to your attention the amazing food, drinks and customer experience of Margaritaville Bayside. Ok that's the most of my big brain anyone gets before I start writing a food review site. So let's gets to it From the very first steps up to the bar from the front porch, I felt like i was stepping onto one of the many yachts or cruise ships circling in the port just behind me. Even walking in at 11 30 on a Thanksgiving its a good amount of people here. Gotta be decent right? RIGHT! I hadn't even made it past the bar before I was greeted by 3 different employees, once by the bartender and once by a server and a host just walking in. Buddy I've eaten in luxury restaurants not sitting in a tourist venue on a Thanksgiving already busy 30 mins into the restaurant opening... so let's just say I was "above impressed " as my intro into the place. I was offered a bar or a booth, i slide into my bench and start my war with the menu. I say war, because even though I don't really suffer from any dietary restrictions (other than , ewww that's nasty) I battle with indecisiveness when it comes to good food. The eastern border of taste was being represented by a pacific stir-fry bowl , with them broccoli I like!.. flash fried vegetables lil teriyaki sauce and the chicken over the rice, a hit! But end the it was the Caribbean that won. That summer taste beat my hunger into a willing retreat, and through combined efforts of Jimmy's jammin' jambalaya , set of his jerk Caribbean wings( extra sauce) and a tall bottle of Landshark to wash it down, the afternoon lunch/ dinner war of 2025 Thanksgiving was won.

author: Greg Michaels
review_text: From out of town and I expected better service. My second time at a margaritaville. My first experience was great! This was horrible! Waiter was impatient. The chef had a say in the menu. We ordered the new chicken and biscuit. Was told no biscuit, no big deal. Asked if we could substitute the biscuit for something else. Waiter had to go ask the chef, was told no. Again, no big deal. I said I will just take the meal without the biscuit. Waiter said the chef blocked it on the computer, seriously? Blocked it because he didn't want alternatives lol. Treat your tourists better, they make your money! I am returning to Florida in a few months and I definitely won't be back here. Chillis is here, will try them.

author: Candy Y
review_text: Service wasn’t bad but they were running slow on 1/4/26. Food was delicious. I had to send my Long Island Iced Tea back and get another drink because it tasted like a glass of Cola instead of alcohol with soda as an ingredient. Our waiter was a very nice person and made every attempt to provide good service but the forces of nature were against him. Overall, it was a decent experience.

author: Seth Hazen
review_text: So the wife and I were touring Bayside for the first time and we decided to have an appetizer and a few cocktails at Margaritaville. We got ourselves a Memorial Cup for Jimmy as well as the Cajun Shrimp Dip and Coconut Shrimp. Gellisa (Lisa) took care of us at the bar and she was so fun, on point and a great bartender. If you see her, sit at her side of the bar and you are good to have a great time.

author: Padma Janki
review_text: Lovely place to eat and drink, the cocktails are amazing. Delicious jerk salmon, yum. Take a walk around here, there are lovely little restaurants and shops along the river.

author: Elihu Salas
review_text: The portion sizes here are generous. I had the Beach Club sandwich and the BBQ combo. I only made it through two of the three club sandwiches, and my son ate most of his meal, only leaving a few ribs. He mentioned they could’ve used more sauce. The atmosphere is great, and if you sit outside, you can enjoy some beautiful water views depending on your spot. One thing to note is that an 18% gratuity was included in the bill, which is good to be aware of. Overall, a solid place to enjoy a filling meal with a nice vibe.

author: Mary Curry
review_text: The food was average and the server took forever just to come and take our order and forever to bring our drinks. The view of the water and activities around the restaurant was good.

author: Keila suarez
review_text: Special all day $16.99 delicious bacon cheese burger with fríes and soda/beer Nice place at bayside right in front of the chicago view ,excelent service,tips already included in the bill.

author: Nicole Blondin Howell
review_text: Despite the convenient location, I would NOT recommend this branch of Margaritaville. The entire venue is dirty- grime, sticky. The air does not work well, so they have the doors to the bar open which let birds into the main dining area. Their walls are banged up and it’s clearly not well maintained. Servers were understaffed and clearly not caring on a Saturday. Our server showed up twice, took us 15 minutes to get after, and over an hour for our food. The worst was I ordered a chicken Caesar salad and the chicken was green/gray. The service attempted to gaslight me in telling me it was the seasoning, but it was only on one side of the chicken and into it. While they took the item off my bill (I did not receive that salad, I just asked for it to be replaced without chicken) it took TWENTY minutes to replace a plate of lettuce. Also- why is there a 3% charge for credit cards? You bring my bill out on an AMEX receipt holder and then charge me 3% for using AMEX. This is bad business!

author: C Ware
review_text: The service was very slow and we had to keep asking for things (silverware, our food, napkins). The food was average, decent burger.

author: Orlando Martinez
review_text: Nice place next to the water. Very friendly nice bartender. Came in for lunch n sat by outside bar. Had fresh Landshark on draft n lunch special. Priced was reasonable for the area. 20% grad automatic on bill. Looking forward to going back

author: Selva Murugan
review_text: Came in for a quick bite and the place was buzzing with a lot of quests. The food was neat and came quick. Ask for their specials and ensure they charge right

author: Kylie Whitaker
review_text: **Caution: Double-Check Your Receipt and Bank Statement!** Our recent visit to Margaritaville was a mixed experience. While the food was decent and our server, Eric, provided excellent service, we did have some concerns. The nachos were enormous and easily fed both my husband and me, although we would have appreciated a bit more meat. The drinks were a bit pricey but tasted good! However, upon reviewing our receipt and bank statement after returning home from vacation, we noticed a significant discrepancy. Our receipt indicated a gratuity of $23, bringing the total to $167, but our bank statement reflected a charge of $201. Even accounting for a potential 20% additional tip, the final amount still doesn’t align with what was stated on the receipt. Whether it's a $5 or $25 difference, it raises questions about the accuracy of the final charge. We just wanted to share this experience to encourage others to verify their receipts and bank statements for peace of mind.

author: Lisa Ogston
review_text: This restaurant was the worst I have been to in Florida in a long time. We have visited other Margaitaville restaurants and from the minute you walk in the door the atmosphere is electric. This one there was no atmosphere whatsoever! We ordered our drinks and food. Our soft drinks came straight away but we sat and watched our beers sit on the bar for a good 10 mins before they were taken to us. Then came the food. We upgraded our fries to sweet potato waffle fries which were cold when they came. My daughter’s wings were cold and one was so cold I wondered if it had actually been cooked. We complained to the waiter and ate what we could. Once we asked for the bill out came new meals from the kitchen which were actually cooked, however we were on our way to the basketball so it was too late and the rest of our party had finished their meals long before this. We had also ordered another round of drinks in this time which again took a while to arrive. When the bill came and 18% service charge had been added, I asked if this would be removed however I was told this was compulsory. I always tip 18-20% but I didn’t feel that this meal deserved any tip. I now know why there was only us and 2 more tables in this restaurant! Avoid this restaurant!

author: Rahim Barnes
review_text: Great service! Went over and beyond to provide a pleasurable experience!!! It was my birthday and this happened without them even being aware!!! I feel so special and this stop has just been another memorable stop on a wonderful Miami Birthday trip!!!

author: Julia Jones
review_text: Had a great experience here today, after traveling to Miami from Virginia. We were sat and then greeted by our server Carolina, who was genuine, kind, and straight to the point which was great because we were very tired and very hungry. Her service maintained that same energy throughout our time there and it made all the difference. You can tell Carolina knows her shit, and doesn’t take any either! Thank you!

author: Patrick Burton
review_text: I always make it a point to visit a Margaritaville when I'm near one on vacation. This is located in a nice area with multiple shops and boats you can take trips on. Service was a little slow as there was only 1 bartender who was also waitressing tables. I recommend getting the Volcano Nachos. Retail store had some good offerings but be aware the price on the shirts is wrong and you'll be charged slightly more. I don't agree with that as they should charge how it's marked.

author: Minsub Song
review_text: We went here last week and enjoyed the view, environment, and food. But one problem. Idk if this is restaurant wide issue or our server. When we got our check, everything looked normal. We asked to pay with Apple Pay, and our server brought the tab machine. When he was ready, I simply tap my iPhone. After that…he was just going to leave, saying have a good night. We were all confused. “What about the tip? What about the receipt?” I mean don’t people usually get the receipt, leave a tip, and sign? When we asked about the receipt, he said their tap machine doesn’t print the receipt. So I said we needed the receipt cause this was business meal. He went inside the restaurant, saying he’s gonna ask his manager. He came back shortly with the receipts, but didn’t even give me a pen or anything. So I looked at the receipt and found that he had charged a credit card surcharge and 20% tip by himself. And that 20% tip was not only charged to the food, but also charged to the surcharge!! If the food was $10 and surcharge was $1, 20% to $11 was charged as a tip. Why on the earth I’m paying the surcharge? No one explained to us. And why am I paying tip to the surcharge? Ridiculous.

author: Noah Farmer
review_text: I ordered the hot honey chicken sandwich and it tasted like one of the best chicken sandwiches I’ve had. Not only that but it was a pretty good size portion you get so it really felt like it was worth the price. My server was fantastic and the views of the bay were fantasticer. My only problem was actually getting to here, with traffic and parking. Some people claim that there’s a woman to blame, but I know this is everybody’s fault (doot doot doo do do🎵)

author: Lorie Brandenberger
review_text: Eric was a most excellent server and our food was fantastic! Food arrived as ordered and hot vs the room temp food we have been getting many places. The chicken stir fry deserves special mention—rice was perfectly done, chicken crispy outside and tender and juicy inside, and the SAUCE!!! I will order this again for certain.

author: Julie Killeen
review_text: I had read an article about this “local gem” and decided to try this morning. It is a good no nonsense breakfast with fast & friendly service. The staff were welcoming & friendly, there were a couple large parties but our server was still attentive. All three meals were tasty.

author: Emilio Gonzalez
review_text: Amazing places good food and really nice services. The waitresses are super friendly definitely is a place you most come

author: VILLAS CHANNEL
review_text: Absolutely delicious! We had an incredible breakfast at Restaurant Farmers Market. The omelets were amazing—perfectly cooked, flavorful, and packed with fresh ingredients. The French toast was next level—crispy on the outside, soft and fluffy inside, with just the right amount of sweetness. Highly recommend going for the full breakfast experience—you won’t be disappointed. Great service and a cozy atmosphere made it even better. Definitely coming back!

author: Bob C
review_text: Great attention to us making sure we were treated well and fed well too. Loved the Chicken n dumplings. Spaghetti and meatball were as good. Service top of the line. I always say, you don’t need white table cloths to be a five star restaurant. Thank you for a great meal.

author: Santo Gore
review_text: The bacon cheese omelet with home fried potatoes and white toast with sweat tea was amazing. The servers are very friendly and do an awesome job. The atmosphere is very welcoming and friendly. Give the Farmers Market Restaurant a try. You won't be disappointed.👍✌️

author: MIKE EMMERSON
review_text: Found this place by accident but knew what to look for when I saw it as a friend who lives down there mentioned it. We love the local food atmosphere and experience, this one did not disappoint. Great service. Great food. Great time!

author: Roberts Lifestyle
review_text: Old school country kitchen. Great food at a decent price. We’ve been here a few times in the past for breakfast. The portions are always fulfilling. They offer a delicious southern breakfast that hits the spot. The grits were a great consistency and buttery. My eggs were scrambled well and the corned beef hash was excellent. The overall breakfast experience was satisfactory and the service was great.

author: Full time Fun
review_text: The Farmer's Market Restaurant offers a delightful farm-to-table dining experience with a focus on fresh, local ingredients. The menu is seasonal, with creative dishes that highlight the best of what’s available. Service is friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere is cozy yet vibrant. Whether you're enjoying brunch or dinner, it’s a perfect spot for those seeking quality, sustainable food in a welcoming setting. Highly recommended!

author: M Morraz
review_text: First off, the name is quite misleading. We went looking for fresh food and were met with plastic looking eggs and potatoes. The waitress was nice, but then didn’t circle back to check on us.

author: Janet
review_text: Delicious. mozzarella sticks taste so cheesy and good. Loved the lemon pepper chicken, it was juicy and loved every bite. The staff is friendly and the place is super clean. Definitely coming back and will try the roasted turkey with cornbread stuffing. Oh! 😍❤ Oh the chicken country fried sandwich is absolutely amazing! 🤤 Today had the country breakfast. Yum Another update went for breakfast with Fam and once again delicious 😋 Back again. Got the grilled chicken sandwich with fries and coleslaw. So good. Tried the meatball sub and it was so delicious. Fam order liver and onion and steak sub. Great food and service! Omelette 🥚🙌🫶🤍🔥🔥

author: Sup_Lick
review_text: After a long day/ night of drinking in key west,when awaking the next morning I started to head back up to Philly. Along the way I was getting that craving u get after a night of drinking, for me it’s bacon, or something salty in that range. Threw up maps and looked for a place close, I read farmers market I think good food. Walked in the waitress was nice sat down, she said the specials are behind on the screen, a full list of stuff there was. I grabbed a ham steak, salt cured. Eggs bacon home fries and toast. Eggs and bacon great, the ham steak was huge was salty, which well it’s in the name, the toast had so much butter had to get napkins to take it off. The service was great, the waitress soft spoken, Attractive with freckles and grey eyes. When I head back to Florida, would stop again, No ham tho.

author: Rudy&Michelle Still
review_text: Great food, very friendly atmosphere - breakfast was excellent

author: Brittany
review_text: Staff was very friendly. I would not recommend ordering the alligator bites. Almost 20 bucks for about 10 popcorn chicken sized pieces. Food was good, not wow. Not worth the expensive price tag in my opinion.

author: SeaWhy Adventures
review_text: Absolutely delicious and tons of selection. We picked this place since we were in the area and the reviews were good. My husband had the grilled grouper sandwich and I got grouper fish fingers, both were cooked and seasoned to perfection. We will absolutely eat here again. Great service and great food!

author: Jud Sa
review_text: Here the menu , because when I search and see the prices online was not correct I a little expensive. The food was good but not excellent for the price that we paid.

author: Sam Root
review_text: Good country breakfast with a massive portion.. If you looking for a quick bite to eat in the morning it is a great option right off the main road. Service was good with a nice ambiance. Place was clean and the staff was very friendly.

author: maurice solner
review_text: Great local spot, right down the street from our hotel. The food was excellent and so was our waitress. I love the fact they are BYOB as well. I highly recomend getting the country fried steak dinnner.

author: Grzegorz Litwin
review_text: The best breakfast since my stay in Florida. I ordered Fresh Vegetable Omlette and it turned out to be a great choice. At the beginning I was greeted by friendly staff, but the tasty and fresh dish and the large portion made a great impression. Phenomenal place, you will forget about fast food once you try this restaurant. I would highly recommend this place. Greetings from Greg

author: Antonio Perez Coss
review_text: We loved our brunch at the Farmers Market Restaurant! 😍 The food (we had a breakfast for the entire family) was delicious 😋 Home made food, super tasty and in a nice and cozy environment (it really looks like granny house) We recommended 100% let’s support our local businesses 💪

author: Danielle Riehl
review_text: We were greeted by Carlene, whom I believe is one of the owners or at least the manager. She was so kind and funny! You feel like family right away! It’s old diner feel, which was a nice nostalgic vibe. We ordered the gator bites and a chefs salad. Food was served promptly and the seasoning in the gator breading was chefs kiss! Mom and pop style dining, comfort food, clean and would definitely stop by here again!

author: YouMakeIt I'LL REVIEW IT
review_text: AVOID THIS LOCATION. Service is slow if you order inside. Drive thru is normal speed but beware you will be missing items or you will be given bad quality food. I was given a "whole chicken" unfortunately this chicken was missing both chicken breast and a thigh. And too make matters worse, they serve you plantains that are burned pass the point of no return. I recommend asking for your receipt, they tend to purposefully not give it to you at the window. I guess you can't complain if you don't have proof of purchase. Do yourself a favor and avoid this location.

author: BRYY
review_text: Everything from customer service to food quality was great. The portioning of the family meal is definitely a great deal, i plan on getting it again soon. The chicken was not overcooked nor undercooked. It was juicy & hot. Made fresh, tasteful. Rice tasted fresh as well. Rolls were nice & soft. The only thing I did not understand was the employee standing outside in the scorching heat when there was no cars around at all. My wife & I felt for her. Should be inside if no customers are around. Other than that. Everything was great. Appreciate this location.

author: Patrick S
review_text: The food was great and fast, I'm not sure for why the scores at this location are low, might be hard to keep up during busy times but everything was great for us.

author: Rod
review_text: Went in to Pollo Tropical to get takeout for dinner as we were staying nearby. We were pleasantly surprised by the quality and the size of the meals we received. Will definitely keep this place on the list to visit again.

author: Janet
review_text: Yum chicken cesar salad. The staff worked quickly and friendly and they were busy. Definitely coming back. 🤠😁 🥗🍴 Update Had a tropi chop so good! Oh the ropa vieja is so 🤤 delicious 🔥🫶 The fried chicken cilantro tropi chop with avocado is delicious 🤤

author: Eli
review_text: So I arrived here because I was staying in the hotel next door and I just finished a 12-hour Drive to get here. The service is brutally slow and English is not really well spoken in here so it was a little complicated to order. Thankfully I just wanted soup and plantains so that helps keep it simple. With that being said the soup was excellent and the plantains were perfectly roasted so overall I'm very happy with the food but they really needs to up their game when it comes to running the line because they had probably about 12 people in there working the kitchen and it took them almost 15 minutes to give me some soup and plantains. As you can imagine at 9:00 p.m. they were not exactly busy either

author: Marisol Medina
review_text: So disappointed. We paid almost $40 for two tropichops, one soda and a large portion of fries with not even 15 fries. When we ordered the Tropichops, the employee didn’t even ask us if we wanted any toppings so we literally paid $15 for rice, a few beans and 10 mini strips of steak with nothing else and $10 for the other chicken tropichop again with nothing toppings. We weren’t even given a receipt! I am so dissatisfied.

author: Mark Blackham
review_text: Food the family for $38 and had some left overs. The sides are very simple and well made. The meats are great. The sauces are the highlight. My favs are the pineapple rum and guava BBQ. This is the restaurant I look forward to when traveling to Florida. My 4 yr old granddaughter asked what a review was. I told her I was sharing my opinion that the restaurant was good. She said she she also liked it and would say that it was DELICIOUS!!!

author: Tamera Foster
review_text: My go to stop when I am heading back to middle keys. They often have someone outside now taking your order. A little nicer than before talking to the box to order. The food is alway Very good. Love the yucca bites with or without cheese Better than fries to me anyway. The tropical chop bowls are always good too. They do offer a great family value with good chicken and sides for less the KFC and it taste good.

author: Lori Shubert
review_text: Brush up on your Spanish. I could not communicate my order. It was missing black beans, avocado and plantains. No one was helpful. One girl tossed an unsliced avocado in a cup and placed it on the counter. No eye contact or conversation. Too much work to get back in line for missing items in my meal. I usually stop here when back and forth from kw. Last stop for me. Customer experience should always come first 👋

author: QueenQyn
review_text: Someone brought their dog inside the restaurant not a service dog either. It was their pet. Immediately gave me the ick. Yuck. Management tried to give me Someone else food. & my food took almost 30 minutes. They tried to fix my food while I waited on my chicken...yuck. 30 minutes wait with the rest of my food just sitting there not being warmed or chilled. Sorry but no thank you. Half the staff didn't speak any English.

author: Keith Alllmeroth
review_text: It's a chain. It's better than typical fast food, but not a standout. The onions on the pork were boiled and bland. The rice was dry and not very tasty. The beans were delicious, and pork was good but small portion. Again, it's ok for a chain, but there are much better places in town.

author: Jose Hernandez
review_text: Basically, like a lot of other fast food type restaurants like this one lately, the quality of the food just wasn't there. Got the trio, which looked a lot smasher than i remember. The Cuban sandwich was excellent though.

author: Mark Rutledge
review_text: Decent food for the price, better than the typical fast food restaurants in my opinion.

author: Lisa C
review_text: I've randomly stopped a few times on way into the Keys. However, each time they've been out of something. This last time they charged me for drinks prior to informing me all they had was lemonade.and I could take that or 'Have a nice day' No offer for moneyback and when I asked I wa told they can't do that 🤔 Yea, I'm going with the 3 strikes your out on this lication

author: Sam Root
review_text: Consistently good grilled chicken. This location looks well maintained and opens til midnight.

author: Michael Mataanda
review_text: The food is delicious, great customer service and comfortable to sit and dine

author: Emiliano Lucer0
review_text: Food was overall decent, but workers look very stressed service was decent not what you would look for though, big disappointment they had no forks or spoons but yet handed out foods that require utensils to eat with. They didn’t say a word about not having utensils until we asked for them, PLUS place is full of mosquitos.

author: Sherlyn M
review_text: Great place to eat. The food is amazing. Very tasty chicken! Great customer service, everyone was super friendly. Graciela was super helpful and prepared our food with love. My family and I love this PT location.

author: qwxxn_ isabella
review_text: The customer service was awful and they were rude. They gave small portions for the food I ordered and the food was cold. In my wrapped quesadilla there was a dot of sauce and the chicken was charred and the cheese wasn’t melted. Additionally, they forgot to put rice in the combo I ordered.

author: Kate O'Connor
review_text: We’ve tried this place three times and were disappointed every time. We’re honestly confused by the positive ratings. The sushi misses the mark across the board. The spicy tuna seriously lacked flavor and was just tuna with a side of spicy mayo and oversized cucumber, and the rice was oddly sweet. Overall, it almost tasted like what you’d expect sushi to taste like if you tried to make it at home. The shrimp tempura had similar issues. The house ramen also wasn’t good. The noodles were rubbery even after following the heating instructions, and the meat was strangely seasoned. Nothing tasted terrible, but everything tasted off. Overall, this is a 1–2 out of 10 for sushi and ramen. If you seriously like sushi or ramen, this is not your spot. It’s unfortunate because it’s close by, but there are much better options elsewhere.

author: Jacqueline 5000
review_text: Visiting New Hamshire from Florida. Stopped for a quick back on my way to Boston airport. OMG. Delicious. You will not be disappointed. I had the Short Rib Ramen Bowl; the broth was so flavorful, and the short rib was so tender and juicy.

author: Megan Martin
review_text: The atmosphere is cozy and the people who work here were pretty nice. The food came out quickly. I really wanted to give this place a great review but I was disappointed by the food. The vegetarian ramen was super bland. Cold tofu on top and all the veggies were extremely plain and only boiled. No seasoning or sauce to give it flavor whatsoever. The mushrooms were super chewy and unappetizing along with the bamboo shoots. And I usually love eating both of those foods. The only redeeming thing, food wise, was the matcha crepe cake which was okay and pre-made/refrigerated, but definitely not worth $8 a slice. The only thing I could think of while I was eating was the fact that I just wasted $30 on this meal.

author: Pearl Lee
review_text: Koro leaves much to be desired, food and service wise. We eat a lot of ramen and were excited to see a Japanese spot open in Eastie; I signed up for the weekly specials newsletter as a reminder to go. Won’t hold to Tokyo standard, but will hold it to other ramen that we’ve had in Boston (e.g., Santouka (our go-to), Yume Wo Katare, and the place in Chinatown across from Asana Sushi that rebranded recently) Service/Ordering : • No wait to order and seat 4 around 7:30pm, though seating quickly ran out after. Would recommend for parties of 4 or less • Several of us had questions on type of wavy/straight noodles used. Descriptions or photos would be helpful, because the wavy noodles turned out to be a non-conventional recipe. • When I ordered miso ramen with wavy noodles, I was met with “oh I think they already come with wavy…nevermind it doesn’t say on the menu.” Staff should be more knowledgeable; I expect this from a student pop-up, less so from a restaurant that’s been open for more than a month. I’m just following the 1-2-3-4 ordering steps, it was choose your broth and then your noodles. • I doubt many folks know what kukirage mushrooms are. Might be clearer to say “wood ear”, if you ever do a display revamp • During ordering, it is unclear whether you still get a third free topping if you opt for a paid topping. Partner got the bok choy, mushrooms, and $1.50 egg, but should’ve been able to add a fourth. • Kitchen was out of pork chashu two hours before closing, not a great look. • Please offer your guests cups and/or a setup for free tap water • Lights were lowered about 40% halfway into our meal even though it was ~8:15pm, far from 10pm closing time—mildly disruptive to our table’s conversation but mostly just confusing for a second • Most people’s attention is on the main menu when ordering and the weekly special flyer is easily missed. Just an observation. Food: • Chicken karaage was the highlight of the meal. Crispy batter without being too dry and good flavor on the chicken. The scallions don’t add anything when they’re underneath the chicken though, suggest leaving them out. • Miso ramen: the shiitake mushrooms were cold and watery (they should be marinated), the noodles were oddly spongey (instead of chewy & bouncy), and the miso broth was a disappointment—sharp but also lacked flavor and umami, as if the broth was thrown together 30 min ago and wasn’t given time to meld. Curious what kind of miso was used. Portions of corn and mushrooms were generous but only two leaves of bok choy? Chashu pork belly was reasonable—could be more tender, but the flavor was there. • Partner got the tonkatsu ramen. It was a thicker broth but still lacked flavor, as if flour was used to thicken it instead of aging pork bones properly. Was there any tare (seasoning sauce) added? He was similarly disappointed with the plain, cold mushrooms and $1.50 only netted half an egg. • I acknowledge this is subjective but the ramen spoons are comically large. I initially thought they were spoon rests. • I mean this in the nicest way possible, but perhaps consider lowering the frequency of your changing specials and focus on perfecting your mains. tl;dr would come back for the chicken karaage, would not come back for the miso or tonkatsu ramen unless both noodles and broths are significantly improved. Recommend taking a couple pages from Santouka and reworking some of your recipes & processes if you want to build a following. I genuinely want the best for this shop; Eastie deserves to have good (East) Asian food!

author: Melissa Mahecha
review_text: We had a wonderful time at Koro Ramen & Sushi. It's exciting to have a Japanese food option in East Boston. The food was delicious, fresh, and very flavorful. We tried the veggie and shrimp sushi, and we will definitely be coming back!

author: Diandra Leigh Dente
review_text: Koro is the new spot. From the moment you walk in, it's got that vibe – effortlessly chic, but still welcoming. You can tell there was thought and attention to detail about the whole experience. The sushi is so fresh, it's insane. You can really taste the quality, and tell that everything's made with so much care. Eastie has been needing a place like this, and Koro Ramen & Sushi is it. I'm so excited to have this restaurant in the neighborhood. It's not just a spot for food, it's a whole mood and so is Chef Harold.

author: Kevin Zhang
review_text: As a sushi lover I was so excited to hear that this restaurant was opening in Eastie. Unfortunately, the food did not live up to the expectation. The chicken karaage was good but the sushi was disappointing. I had the golden sunset and philly rolls. The fish did not taste very fresh, rice was not seasoned well, the mango was unripe, thin and leathery, and the roll quality was poor (see photos: not filled and pieces cut unevenly). Their specialty roll was so small, the same size as a basic maki despite being double in price. I do hope things improve so we can have some good Japanese food in East Boston.

author: Chenzhe Cao
review_text: Koro Ramen and Sushi fills a much-needed gap in the Jeffries Point neighborhood, offering fresh sushi, hearty ramen, and flavorful poke bowls. I am so glad they opened since there hasn’t really been any good, healthy, and Asian spots. This restaurant focuses primarily on takeout, making it a convenient option for locals seeking good food without the fuss. During my recent pickup order, I was impressed by both the value and quality. The poke bowl was generously portioned and well worth the price - clearly made with fresh ingredients that showcased the restaurant’s commitment to quality. The karaage chicken was a standout, featuring crispy, perfectly seasoned pieces paired with a creative chipotle mayo sauce that added a nice fusion twist to the traditional Japanese preparation. While I didn’t have the chance to experience the dine-in atmosphere, the takeout process was smooth and efficient. The variety on the menu - spanning sushi, ramen, and poke options - gives Koro an edge in a neighborhood where fresh, well-prepared Asian cuisine has been hard to come by. I hope to return soon and often!

author: Jeff Cannon
review_text: We have eagerly awaited Koro’s opening! They’re a welcome addition to the neighborhood of East Boston. The restaurant is clean and bright, the tables are intimate, and the menu is easy to read on the wall. You order at the counter and grab a table. There are 5-6 tables and an outward-facing bar seating for 5 people. The single-use bathroom was clean and accessible. My wife and I had chicken karaage (app), a spicy tuna roll, and a crazy caterpillar roll. I felt it was good for the price! The app came out within 5 minutes; the rolls came out about 10 minutes later. They were busy and I still felt this was a reasonable time to wait for freshly made, counter-ordered food. Give them a try! Welcome, Koro!

author: Peter S
review_text: My first experience with restaurant ramen. Although it was good, I was a little disappointed in the noodles. I expected something much better than store-bought. These were better, but not a lot better. The veggies and protein were very good and just the right amount of spice. With the tip it was over $21 which seemed a little overpriced for earthy, working class, East Boston.

author: Josue Castillo
review_text: I’ve been waiting for koro to open definitely a great addition to east Boston! I had the koro roll, wings, B.L.T roll, miso ramen and the shrimp tempura, they were all delicious I highly recommend! Can’t wait to come back and try the rest of the menu

author: Brittany O
review_text: This is a great new food option in Eastie. Very clean inside and we were able to get seats right away around 6pm on a Thursday. I had the shrimp tempura roll and a build-your-own ramen. I thought the sushi was very good and a good size for the price. I love the option to pick all your own ramen components. The tonkotsu broth was delicious and the pork belly was super tender. I would highly recommend and I will definitely be back!

author: Stephanie D.
review_text: We tried Koro for the second time after trying them on opening week. The food was greatly improved this time- my partner really loved his ramen and I felt like mine was pretty decent. I love the atmosphere of the restaurant , it's so nice to have a place like this in Eastie. However, I found it really odd that they won't serve customers tap water to go along with their meal. For a sit down restaurant, I've never seen such a thing, and it left a weird impression, since the restaurant ambiance is so nice. At the least, it seems like they would have a water dispenser. I will most likely come back, but likely because there isnt much competition for food like this right now in E Boston.

author: Ali Reneé
review_text: I’ve been counting down the days until Koro opened & the ramen was even better than I expected! So many toppings to choose from and they FILLED the bowls 😋 - so worth it!! The staff is also amazing and very friendly. When I walked in, I was handed a menu and got served very quickly - really great first impression before I even tasted the food! I can’t wait to come back soon and try the sushi!

author: Eric Barron
review_text: I love some good Japanese food, especially sushi, so I was excited to try Koro as the only Japanese spot around me in East Boston. I went my first time and ate in person and was underwhelmed by the maki rolls. The rice was poorly seasoned and fish was okay. I wanted to give it a second try a few weeks later and I got a few rolls for takeout and eating right away at the park nearby. These were worse and the spicy tuna roll had an "off" taste that led me to not finishing it, and I don't like to leave food unfinished. I did not get sick or feel ill, but I've been turned away from giving Koro a third try anytime soon. I really hope they can turn things around because I would love to have a great Japanese spot in Eastie. I'm rooting for you despite my experience.

author: Ana María García
review_text: KORO is what we needed in the neighborhood, amazing ramen!! I loved the wings, soo crispy and tasty! I am a big fan of the edamame and the offer 3 different flavors which I loved! Beautiful place and nice atmosphere! Thank you!

author: Ethan Taylor
review_text: Got sushi in May and all flavor was just hidden by above average-spicy mayo Got Ramen in June and the chicken was as hard as a hockey puck Got Ramen in August and the Pork was as hard as a hockey puck Ramen broth is salty and I don’t want any spoonful of it I like that someone monitors the reviews and hopefully adjusts. Best of luck

author: Christina Hathaway
review_text: I live in the neighborhood & have been so eager to try… well I tried it & it’s the best sushi I have ever had. I will be going back all the time!

author: Blake Aiton
review_text: Came from Maine for a conference and wanted some sushi. Googled near me and found this restaurant. Great little joint. Immediately greeted with a friendly hello, and service was great. Had a dynamite roll, salmon and tuna nigiri and sushi. The place was clean and welcoming, and the sushi was awesome.

author: Juliet Clark
review_text: I’ve given this place several chances, especially after winning a $100 gift card during their opening promotion. I really want to like it since it’s just around the corner, but I’ve left disappointed every time. The tempura in the rolls is always cold, which makes me wonder if the shrimp and sweet potato are pre-fried and just sitting around before being added. The rolls themselves often fall apart, and the rice has that hard, slightly stale texture you’d expect from grocery store sushi, not what I’d hope for from a made-to-order restaurant. I’ve only ever ordered takeout, so maybe the dine-in experience is better, but what I’ve had hasn’t left a good impression. I also tried the vegetarian ramen once, and it upset my stomach, and left me questioning if the broth was truly vegetarian. Overall, despite its convenience and my initial excitement, this spot just isn’t for me.

author: Karen Liu
review_text: I had a great dinner experience at this Legal Sea Food’s rooftop enclosed patio! It was hardly busy at all on a Monday night, so the place was quiet and very easy to talk. Our server was attentive and helpful. We started with the fisherman’s platter, which consisted of a variety of fried seafood and veggies (onion, fries, coleslaw). The calamari was fishier than other ones I’ve had at restaurants, but everything else was tasty! We also ordered two soups: the clam chowder and the lobster bisque. The clam chowder was delicious, cheesy, and creamy. The lobster bisque, however, was weirdly caramel-y and off putting; we did not enjoy it. Onto the mains, the prime rib cooked medium rare was delicious, and cooked just a bit more rare than expected but I actually prefer a rare/medium rare so it was great. The szechuan beans and mashed potatoes were also decent, they paired well with the steak. The other two mains (white fish and lobster tails) met our expectations as well, as they were tasty and well-portioned. The one main that we were let down by was the clam pasta (I forgot the specific name), but everyone thought it was overly sour, perhaps due to lemon? Overall, we enjoyed a great meal at Legal Sea Foods; the atmosphere and service were both great and I would recommend this chain to anyone visiting Boston.

author: Tim Noonen
review_text: We were in Boston for a couple of days and looking for seafood. We made reservations through open table and we were immediately seated near the back windows. The view of the harbor is amazing. Our server was young and a little nervous, but super friendly and after a little conversation she relaxed and was really friendly and helpful. We ordered the seafood tower for two and it was outstanding ... 4 oysters, 4 clams, 1/2 lobster, 4 shrimp, and tuna tartar. All were outstanding quality. For the main course I selected the clams and my partner ordered the fettuccine with clams. My clams were good and cooked well, but i would probably order something else the next time. My partners dish was tasty, but a little heavy on the pancetta. Overall, we had a great experience at Legal Seafood

author: Tiffany Nicole
review_text: This restaurant is a decent size with good service. I went for lunch around 2pm and it was slow we walked right in no reservation for a party of 7. Everything that was ordered was outstanding! Lobster mac and cheese appetizer down to the seafood platter, calamari, drinks were strong as well. The dessert cheesecake was also very delicious and authentic. You can tell everything here is super fresh it is a pricey restaurant but good and plenty of seating and a bar.

author: Avery Watson III
review_text: Went Back For An Encore! With all of the seafood choices in Boston, to opt for this restaurant twice in a 4-day vacation….says alot. The seafood is obviously excellant. But the ambiance is every bit as enjoyable. We dined outside, among a cozy set of tables on the harbor. It was a pleasant combination of relative seaside serinity and circus just inside. I had and truly recommend the basic Fish and Chips. Wifey selected the Crabcake& Shrimp, a signature dish for the restaurant. Both were truly delicious. We will definitely return!

author: Natalee Guerra
review_text: Came in for lunch because we saw they had gluten-free fish and chips and were excited! We had an extremely uncomfortable experience here and will likely never return when visiting Boston. Overall, the food was ok for the price, but the service was not good at all. We were sat instantly, however, it seemed to take about 10 minutes for us to even be acknowledged by our waitress. The restaurant was not very busy for a Sunday afternoon and they seemed to be perfectly staffed. Initally, she just handed us waters with no introduction. She then came back around 10 minutes later and asked if we were ready to order to which we ordered the fish and chips. We then proceeded to be given gluten-free rolls which was awesome. The Guy who ran our food out, gave us more conversation than our waitress did the entire time. I started to put my coat back on to show we were ready to leave. The waitress came over and asked if we wanted dessert, we declined and said we were ready for the check. To which she pulled out the machine for us to pay. We were planning on leaving a cash tip, however when my sister selected no tip the waitress immediately asked is there a reason why you selected no tip? It threw us off. I looked at her and said we were planning on leaving a cash tip to which her demeanor changed and her response was I take cash as well. I was extremely thrown off and just grabbed the loose dollars that I had in my purse which I gave to her. She counted in front of me and scoffed. She did not give us a receipt so I am unable to leave a name that explains how much service she even gave to us in the first place. In my opinion, this is extremely inappropriate behavior from a waitress. We were hardly attended to in the first place yet to be asked this kind of question? I have never been asked why I wasn’t leaving a tip or watched while selecting the tip option. It was extremely uncomfortable. For the price of the food, the service should match and this restaurant did not meet those expectations.

author: Amy B
review_text: The yellowtail and the sole fish were wonderful. The oyster delicious- the freshness was just perfection. The clam chowder is not bad, but not the best there is. Definitely worth a visit for sure. Staff was helpful and gave good suggestions. Atmosphere was nice, not so loud you can't hear the party you're with, but not super quiet. I love how is within walking distance to a variety of places.

author: Lisa Spenneberg
review_text: The atmosphere was like totally awesome! I did not get a picture of the oysters, we had four different types of oysters, yes it was the first time I've ever eaten an oyster and it was most awesome

author: Humberto Lameda
review_text: I wasn’t sure about coming here at first since it’s a chain and I wanted an authentic Boston seafood experience — but I’m so glad I did. The clam chowder is fantastic and might just rival my long-time favorite She Crab chowder from Charleston. No wonder this soup is served at the Presidential Inaugural Luncheon every year! I also had the swordfish — beautifully presented, satisfying, and full of flavor. The service was warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. Highly recommended!

author: Melanie Ponichtera
review_text: We had the best experience at this Legal Seafood location than any other we’ve visited before! The entire wait staff was kind, accommodating and incredibly fast. Our server was lovely and gave great recommendations. She was calm and patient with our questions and requests even though she had many tables and patrons. The food was outstanding and the portions were fantastic. We started with the shrimp cocktail and it was so tasty for our first bite. Served with fresh lemon and a superb cocktail sauce, the colossal shrimp were cooked perfectly and were quite tender. Definitely a favorite for everyone! I didn’t get to take a photo, we got to them pretty fast! Our kiddo had freshly sliced watermelon and a grilled cheeseburger and steak cut French fries. I had the Thai Peanut Salad with grilled chicken and it was such a delight. A generous portion, perfectly seasoned and grilled chicken and the flavor was everything I wanted it to be and more! My husband had the baked stuffed lobster and it was better than he had hoped it would be. Plenty of food in the smaller portion which is about a 1.5 lb lobster, filled with bay scallops, shrimp crumbs and buttery goodness!! We will absolutely be coming back the next time we are in Boston. Thank you to the staff of Legal Seafood for the lovely experience this afternoon.

author: Jenny P
review_text: We visited this place because it was recommended by multiple people. We did not have to wait much to get a table and our server was the savior of the review ?and the bread). He was amazing!!!! We ordered fried calamari, it was good. We also had the clam chowder and it was very good too but I was honestly expecting something with more punch. Reasons why the low rating: - The sodas we ordered were flat - Restrooms were not clean at all and very unorganized. There was no soap; all there was, was an empty liquid soap bottle with the top out. No drying towels.

author: Akin Ulusoy
review_text: This is hands down Boston’s best seafood spot. The lobster sandwich I had here? Best I’ve ever tasted! Loved it so much we came twice-if we’d stayed any longer, honestly, I’d have dragged you back every single day. Staff were proper friendly, kitchen smashed it, every dish was spot-on. Big thanks to the whole team-see you next time we’re in town!

author: Esther Mbiwan
review_text: I love fish! I recently tried swordfish for the first time, and I have to say, I was not disappointed! It was tender, flavorful, and absolutely delicious. It's quickly become my new favorite. The food was amazing! If you enjoy seafood, then Legal Sea Foods is the place to go! I’ll definitely be back for more!! The service was excellent as well.

author: Steven Briggs
review_text: I loved the location and the service was great given how busy it was. They seem very responsive to food allergies which was helpful. The food was good but what kept this from a 5 star experience was that the food was rather flavorless. Even the salt/vinegar cod needed salt and has zero vinegar flavor. It all looked great on the plate but I didn’t feel like I really got what I paid for. Maybe it was an off night but I felt at $200 (plus tip) for 4 people, that I overpaid a bit. I hadn’t been to a legal sea food in maybe 12 years as my travel to the Boston area didn’t happen after moving to a different role at work. I made a point of getting reservations months in advance and looked forward to the night. It wasn’t like I remembered so perhaps that tarnishes the experience some.

author: T Y
review_text: We recently dined as a family at Legal Seafood in Boston and were thoroughly satisfied with our experience. Seated on the terrace overlooking the harbor where the boats are moored, we appreciated the picturesque and pleasant setting. Despite the busy atmosphere and high occupancy, the ambiance remained friendly and warm, especially thanks to the proximity of the bar, the display of fresh fish, oysters, and lobsters. The open kitchen demonstrated remarkable expertise and transparency regarding the quality of the products offered. This experience fully met our expectations for a seafood specialty restaurant. We highly recommend this establishment.

author: Anthony Lawson
review_text: On my last evening in town for a work trip, our group of eight was looking for dinner in the Seaport area without a reservation, not an easy task. We decided to try Legal Sea Foods and lucked out when a no-show freed up a table for us right as we walked in. The restaurant is large and was buzzing with activity. They also have a great patio that faces the harbor, perfect for an outdoor meal with a view. Since we had appetizers at a prior stop, we went straight to entrées. Faced with a menu full of tempting seafood options, I asked our server for a recommendation of something local and fresh-caught. He suggested the North Atlantic haddock. I had never had haddock before, but I was impressed. It was perfectly cooked, meaty yet slightly flaky, with a clean flavor. It was served with rice pilaf, which was fine but forgettable, and steamed broccoli. One of my co-workers ordered the lobster mac and cheese, and it was both impressive and indulgent. They use a full one-pound lobster, serving the mac and cheese inside the entire lobster shell with all of the meat mixed in. Highly recommended if you are not watching calories. If you are in the Seaport area and need a solid seafood dinner without a reservation, Legal Sea Foods is worth keeping in mind, especially if you can snag one of those harbor-view patio tables.

author: Leonard Lim
review_text: Legal Sea Foods in Boston is a highly regarded restaurant chain known for its fresh, high-quality seafood and impressive wine selection. The Legal Harborside location stands out for its multi-level design, featuring a lively rooftop bar with scenic waterfront views. Signature dishes such as the New England Clam Chowder and Lobster Roll are must-tries. While it’s a renowned destination for seafood lovers, the diverse menu also caters to various tastes and budgets.

author: Jamme Ray II
review_text: Went here with a group of 6 for lunch and we got seated almost immediately. Our server was super nice and our food times was very responsive. The seafood tasted really fresh and tasty. I got the Market Fish which was a Bass that day and the sides were the Szechuan Greenbeans and Bok Choy & Kimchi which were both good but the kimchi wasn't as flavorful as I was hoping. We also got Oysters on the shell that were really good sharing! I had a Cucumber drink that was refreshing and I would definitely order again. The place seemed fairly priced and the atmosphere was quite to where you could comfortably have a conversation at the table. Would recommend to people to go for some good seafood.

author: Stan Kuleshov
review_text: Great spot with amazing seafood. The oysters were super fresh, the hazy beer was perfect, and the lobster roll really hit the spot. Service was awesome too — very attentive and detail-oriented without feeling over the top. Everything came out just right. Would definitely come back.

author: Shawn Shirley
review_text: Very good full service restaurant right on the harbor. The food was delicious all around. I tasted a lot from the party I was with and cant say I had anything I didnt like. I personally ordered the lobster roll. The roll was perfect with a healthy dose of lobster, yum!

author: Andrew Gummo
review_text: Legal Sea Foods in Boston was an excellent dining experience right on the water. The atmosphere was clean, relaxed, and well-managed, with efficient service from start to finish. We tried the lobster cone, buffalo shrimp cone, mussels in lemon garlic sauce, steak tips, and sole — everything was fresh, flavorful, and well-prepared. Prices were surprisingly reasonable for both the quality and the location. If you’re planning to dine in, definitely make a reservation — tables fill up fast. Highly recommend for seafood lovers visiting Boston!

author: Christopher Vargas
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 4/5 “Golden Vibes at the Golden Cane” The Raising Cane’s in downtown Boston—known as the Gold Cane—definitely lives up to its name. The gold theme makes the place stand out from the typical fast-food spots; it feels a little more special and modern, like a celebration of Cane’s itself. The decor is flashy but clean, and the bright gold accents give it a fun, upbeat atmosphere. As for the food, it’s classic Cane’s—simple, crispy, and satisfying. The chicken fingers were fresh and hot, the Cane’s sauce hit just right, and the Texas toast was buttery perfection. The crinkle fries were solid, though they could’ve been a bit crispier. Service was friendly and quick even though the place was pretty packed. The “gold” theme isn’t just for looks—it’s meant to mark this location as one of the flagship or showcase restaurants for Raising Cane’s, highlighting the brand’s best design and energy. It’s got that downtown buzz and a good mix of students, tourists, and locals grabbing quick bites. Overall, the Gold Cane is worth checking out for the experience alone. Great for a quick meal, late-night stop, or just to see what a “gold standard” Cane’s feels like.

author: Anthony W
review_text: Review of Raising Cane’s – 828th Location Rating: 8.5/10 This location offered the most generous portion sizes I’ve ever received at any Raising Cane’s, making the price point feel especially reasonable for Boston. As someone who has visited over 25 Cane’s locations across the United States, I can confidently say this was the least clean among them. That said, the all-gold aesthetic and the unique sentimental value tied to it being the 828th restaurant add a distinct charm that sets it apart. Despite the cleanliness concerns, the visual experience and symbolic significance make this one of the most memorable Cane’s locations I’ve visited.

author: anant kumar
review_text: Straight to the top of my fast food rankings! The chicken was unbelievably tender, and those crinkle-cut fries might be the best I’ve ever had. Didn’t dig the sweet tea tho, should have gone for the lemonade

author: Y
review_text: Reasonable prices, no forced tipping, AND the waitress offered to throw out my trash?! In this economy, the fact that the food tasted good is the cherry on top. My only suggestion is to change your interior designer because it felt like I was dining at Trump Tower with all the gold...

author: bryan debarbieris
review_text: It's good overall. You know what you're getting when you come here and in my experience it's always been consistent. You can get varying sizes of chicken boxes with different numbers of strips. It's pretty much all they do. I get no slaw with extra toast. I got the caniac combo and it filled me up.

author: Treturus Savantur
review_text: Oh Canes… where do I began. I love Canes so much. The chicken is always crispy, the fries are well salted. The bread is warm and buttery. The sauce is immaculate. Wow! Don’t get me started on their SWEET Tea. Yum yummy yum

author: Adam Donaldson
review_text: After hearing a lot of hype around this chain and especially people highly rating their "Cane Sauce" I was very excited to try it. But I left disappointed as it wasn't that great and I personally think Chick-Fil-A is a better fast good fried chicken chain. Service was reasonable but the restaurant was generally loud and messy. We had a quick bite and got out. Food wasn't great but also wasn't terrible.

author: andréa
review_text: i live in europe and i heard a lot about how good raising cane’s was.. and they did not lie !! this is honestly the best fast food ever =D everything was good and i went there multiple times during my trip. please open a raising cane’s in France !!!!

author: Dom
review_text: Cool golden interior. Food was pretty good. If there are any sweet tea enjoyers in Boston it is sold here.

author: Vicki L
review_text: I have tried Cane’s at Las Vegas. The decorations are completely different from this Boston Cane’s. Both are about LOVE. The chicken tenders are for sure very tender and fresh. Their Cane’s sauce is the best. Check if they give it to you. It’s a must-have. The crinkle fries are average. The cole slaw is very smooth. The bread is very soft. Next time I’ll try their chicken sandwich. Staff are efficient. It’s extremely crowded but you get your food very fast. 5 stars.

author: Anuj Bhatia
review_text: Good food and fast service, middle of boston with gold theme amazing atmosphere

author: The Soto Standard
review_text: I got the 3 tender combo with toast and fries, my wife got the same thing. We throughly enjoyed every bite and the ice in the drink is a nice touch. I also love the ketchup packets. The guy at the door welcomed us and even gave us a suggestion to use the self service to get our food faster (great host) anyways to be short. Great Food, Excellent Customer Service , Very Clean and Spacious Environment. Got my food in 5 mins regardless of the huge line out of the door. I entered and the guy welcomed me immediately. For a fast food spot this specific Raising Canes Is And Should be the Standard for Fast Food Done Right!!!

author: Eric Perez
review_text: This was my first time trying Raising Cane's and I really enjoyed it. I got a combo box with 4 tenders, fries and sauce, usually comes with coleslaw as well, but I'm not a big fan of 'slaw', so I got extra fries. The chicken was really delicate and flaky, almost like it was fresh. The fries were, just fries and the toast, didn't even pay attention to it, but it was fresh and crispy on one side, but not the other. The sauce was really good, I even dipped my fries in it and made them a little better. The place is all gold as well because it opened on the 28th of August, so Golden Birthday. Overall, the place was clean, it was busy, but I only waited about 5 minutes for my food and it was good. Overall 7/10, got Eric stamp of approval!

author: Timothy Grace
review_text: It's pretty good food, and priced VERY well. It can be a bit messy to eat, but such is the nature of these things. The music was very loud, as was the restaurant as a whole, which detracted from the experience in my opinion. The price my lure me back here, and the food is good enough to make it worth it.

author: Shelby Vandewalle
review_text: Love the everything gold aesthetic. The staff is really friendly and helpful. My order came out fast. Although I did come here on a weekday. Ordered a three finger combo. Came out just as I wanted. Worth checking out.

author: Kay Foulkes
review_text: The only downside was the bathrooms which only had hand sanitizer. Lived the gold theme of the restaurant and the food was some of the best fast food we had visiting the states.

author: Nat E
review_text: Such a cool concept! Everything is gold! Just wish they had some gear to buy in store to take as a souvenir for us visitors. The service was not as great as what I am used to in Texas, where I live but it was ok. Food was also not as fresh but I came in at 10pm (they close at midnight) so maybe that’s why? Overall I would recommend to visit just to check it out if you happen to be in the area.

author: beni
review_text: I recently visited the Raising Cane's in Downtown Crossing, Boston, and overall, the experience was great! The chicken fingers were perfectly crispy, juicy, and packed with flavor—exactly what you'd expect from Cane's. The signature sauce paired with the Texas toast and crinkle-cut fries made for a very satisfying meal. What really stood out was the decor. The restaurant was decked out in gold accents, which gave it a fun, upscale vibe—definitely not what I expected from a fast-food spot. However, the one downside was that I had a hard time finding seating. The place was packed, and the seating area seemed pretty limited for the size of the crowd. It would have been nice to enjoy the meal in a bit more comfort. Overall, still a great spot for some delicious chicken, just be prepared for a possible wait if you want to sit and eat inside!

author: Jessica Schneider
review_text: Raisin cane chicken fingers are so juicy and delicious. They melt off bone good. The service wasnt clear what i ordered. While waiting, it was a bit hectic. I was disappointed that $9 didnt get meal. It was only the chicken. It goes in the splurge fast food section. It's def worth it.

author: Ashley Chance
review_text: My picky daughter even loved it. Fast, friendly, and absolutely delicious.

author: Meka Simms
review_text: I don’t know how this place has 4.8 stars Tacos were horrible. The lettuce were wilted and soggy. They got my order wrong. I order the super taco and got regular tacos. I gave one star only because the potatoes were good.

author: Nau Como
review_text: It was my first time eating at Taco John’s and it didn’t disappoint! The place was super clean and had a cool vibe! The chicken was fresh, flavorful, not greasy, and packed with just the right amount of seasoning. The Potato Olés were so good—crispy, perfectly seasoned, and addictive. The service was quick and friendly, making the whole experience even better. Whether you're craving a classic taco or a hearty burrito, this place hits the spot!

author: Hussaim
review_text: I just had the best experience at Taco John’s in Boston! From the second I walked in, the vibe was super chill and welcoming. The staff were friendly, which always makes a big difference, and the place itself was clean and comfy. Let’s talk about the food—honestly, it was amazing. I got the tacos, and they were so good! The seasoned beef was perfect, and the crunchy shell with all the fresh toppings made every bite satisfying. I also tried the Potato Olés (because why not?), and I have to say, they’re a game changer—crispy, loaded with flavor, and just the right amount of seasoning. The menu has a great variety, so you’ll definitely find something that hits the spot no matter what you’re craving. And their salsa bar? Big fan. It’s perfect for adding that extra flavor kick. Plus, the service was fast and friendly—always a plus when you’re hungry. I’ll definitely be back next time I’m in the area! Highly recommend this spot if you’re looking for a quick, tasty meal.

author: Susie Li
review_text: I ordered catering from Taco John's in Boston for a big meeting at work, and I couldn't be happier! We needed 100 burritos with some specific survival food restrictions, and they went above and beyond to accommodate all our requests. The food was absolutely amazing—fresh, flavorful, and satisfying. Everyone loved it! The staff was super friendly and professional throughout the process. I'll definitely be ordering from Taco John's again for future events. Highly recommend!

author: The Soto Standard
review_text: Great Customer Service. Solid food but I could feel how cold some of the ingredients were before I ate it. I also had trouble with ordering on the tablet because there was so many customization items that I accidentally added an extra side of sauce. Other than that, my experience was great. Best Comparison : If Burger King and Taco Bell had a child !

author: Brad Loncar
review_text: The service was super friendly, fast, and helpful. Really appreciate that. The tacos are very thin and look (at least mine) nothing like the photo. The potato olés have a good flavor.

author: gochase85
review_text: Grand opening of Taco John’s in Downtown Crossing. So much better food than the Door Bell further down the street. Friendly staff, great food and great location. Can’t wait to try the Fish Tacos next time!!! 👍👍

author: Susie Li
review_text: I just found the best tacos in Boston at Taco John’s! They use fresh, high-quality ingredients — you can actually taste the difference in their sauces and meats. My favorites are the Boss Bowl with steak, cheesy quesadillas, and the spicy jalapeño burrito — perfect for heat lovers! Don’t miss the churros — only $3.49 and 6 inches long! Plus, they have amazing deals, especially on Taco Tuesday — tacos under $2! If you want Mexican-inspired fast food made with care, come to Taco John’s. Trust me, I’m now a total taco fan!

author: Joy James
review_text: Taco John’s just opened this past Thursday in Downtown Crossing, and I’m really impressed. Opening a taco spot right across from Taco Bell is a bold move, but they absolutely deliver. The food is incredibly fresh, hot, and full of flavor. Everything I tried was delicious, and it came out really quickly. The staff was kind and helpful, and the bathrooms were very clean — always a good sign. I’ll definitely be back. It’s a great new addition to the area, and totally worth checking out.

author: R C
review_text: ★★★★★ Taco John’s absolutely blows Taco Bell out of the water! This place is a fantastic addition to downtown Boston—finally, a fast-food taco spot that delivers on quality and flavor. The service is top-notch, with friendly and efficient staff who make sure your order is perfect every time. The food is fresh, fast, and absolutely delicious. The tacos are loaded with flavor, the Potato Olés are addictive, and everything tastes like it’s made with care. If you’re looking for a quick, satisfying meal that doesn’t sacrifice quality, Taco John’s is the place to go. Highly recommend!

author: Mohammed Elkholy
review_text: Prices are insanely good. A full meal for just $5! Totally recommended.

author: Chef Champ
review_text: Cool spot with affordable prices. They have daily specials and taco Tuesday prices. The only issue which may not be a big one is the taco meat has no flavor. You definitely need to use the sauce packets for an extra boost. But the potato oli's are 🔥🔥🔥

author: Jose Lopez
review_text: Delicious Mexican food and very affordable for the amount of food per dish definitely will fill you up. 10/10 Would recommend to others in the future.

author: Dwayne Sturdivant
review_text: And ask for extra everything I paid for it and it looks like this I want my order re made or my money money back this this nasty

author: Sarah Jane
review_text: After leaving the midwest, this was the chain I missed most, the absolute joy I have that this food is close by again. The location is great if you use South Station, the employees were all incredibly nice, the place was clean and bright. The food? Just as good as I remembered, everything was made in incredible time, it was hot and wonderful. They even had some gluten free options for my sister! This was the PERFECT place to catch up with old friends and reminisce. I will absolutely be back!

author: Ashby H
review_text: Very friendly staff. The atmosphere in general was pretty overstimulating, and the food had little to no flavor, other than grease and salt. I felt sick after eating one taco

author: Anthony C
review_text: First welcome to downtown Boston, growing up in the Midwest allows me to become familiar with Taco Johns and im so glad to see you all finally open up! The prices that im used too are alittle lower but this is Boston so the price of everything I ordered was fair. Service was excellent thanks for being so welcoming! I will be coming back again !

author: Shelly Ja
review_text: My first time trying Taco Johns. I had a great experience here. Clean place first of all, kind and attentive employees. Ease of ordering, order came out quickly and I was on my way. The taco salad is actually pretty good! Soft chicken taco was yummy with good flavor, love the diced chicken pieces inside.

author: Edward Park
review_text: Food not bad, I just put Taco John's behind Del Taco, Taco time and, the Bell. Restaurant interior is very nice, enjoyable to spend time there.

author: A V
review_text: My husband and I were shopping downtown for our vacation and walked by this place, so we decided to stop in and check it out. We were greeted by one of the gentlemen at the door, ordered our food, and waited less than five minutes for it to be ready. Everyone was friendly. We dined in, and the food was fresh and delicious. We had a boss bowl along with chicken tacos and potatoes oles with nacho cheese sauce, all of which were very delicious. 10/10. One of our chicken tacos tasted like fish, so my husband asked if it was chicken or fish, and they confirmed it was chicken but also gave us a new taco at no charge. The food was very delicious, and we will be stopping by again. Congratulations on your new journey. 🎉

author: Fang Phattha
review_text: A lovely food court near South Station. They have a lot of seatings. Most people here seem to be office workers looking for lunch. The vibe is quite nice and not rushing. I had a DIY bowl from a healthy place with a long line that I can't remember the name. It's very fresh and very delicious. Ingredients are already seasoned and go well together. I'd give it 5 stars if there are more variety of food to choose here.

author: Jane Sh
review_text: Excellent and very stylish and beautiful place, looks like a food court with a large number of different restaurants, from sushi to halal cafes, there is also Mexican and Indian cuisine and many others, there is a bar where you can drink beer and eat fresh oysters, in general a complete variety. The sushi was great, we also ordered shawarma with halal chicken, we also really liked it. I recommend this great place

author: J. Yeh
review_text: This is a wonderful hidden area for a lot of great food choices. Great area for lunch. My brother got oysters from a raw bar, and I got a fried chicken sandwich and sweet potato fries from Hailey Jane's. There are many other foods like, pizza, sushi, Mediterranean, Indian, drink bar, etc. The area is spacious with many seating tables, and has a very nice atmosphere with natural lighting. It's also very close to the red line South Station T station.

author: rossana urugutia
review_text: We enjoy this food halls when we want a bit of different food, a change for our tastebuds. More of a mature food halls than others in the area. Always stop by when we are in Boston

author: Michael Allen
review_text: High Street Place is a fantastic food hall with a wide variety of options all in one spot. The atmosphere is modern and lively, making it a great place to grab lunch, dinner, or even just a drink. There’s something for everyone, whether you’re in the mood for casual bites, creative cocktails, or more elevated dishes. The layout makes it easy to explore different vendors, and the quality across the board is consistently strong. It’s also a convenient location right downtown, perfect if you’re visiting nearby attractions or just want a fun, social spot to eat. A great mix of local flavor and variety under one roof.

author: Gabbie Kim
review_text: I enjoyed eating at this food court. There were so many options to choose from—pizza, burgers, sandwiches, Mexican, Indian, Japanese, Mediterranean, and even a café, just to name a few. The food was decent and reasonably priced. We went during lunchtime, so it was quite crowded and hard to find seats. I would visit again.

author: Simon McAuliffe
review_text: Great vendors. The cocktail bar (Daisies and Daiquirs) is amazing. You can lots of different types of food, so it is great for meeting up with people who have a variety of tastes.

author: Shali S
review_text: Second time I’ve been here. Love it. So many options are available for food. All the restaurants are worth trying. Already planning on returning soon.

author: Tomas Piaggio
review_text: Awesome place in Boston, with great food options, nice beer and cocktails, plenty of space to go with a big group. The music is not loud so you can chat without any problems. Will definitely come back!

author: Chimere oronzi
review_text: The food hall has a variety of foods to offer. It's cute and surprisingly very clean. We went to Mike and Patty's because we saw they had vegan options. My husband got the vegan Burrito, and I ordered the vegan classic. Firstly, the girl working gave me a regular egg and cheese, so I took it back to explain that I requested to make it vegan. I didn't like her response and tone when I tried to have my order corrected. Telling me that I didn't order a vegan sandwich. When I sure wouldn't have ordered a regular one because I don't eat regular eggs. That is why I rated the service with 3 stars. The rating does not apply to the entire food hall and other vendors. Just my encounter with the employee from Mike and Patty's.

author: A R
review_text: High Street Place is a fancy food court in the financial district / seaport area of Boston. We stopped by here for some after dinner coffee and dessert. This food court is very nice and highly recommended if you live in or are staying in the area!

author: Alexander Ly
review_text: Several food options. We are at Mike and Patty's where I ordered the MBB burrito. It's made fresh, though tastes like it looks. Tortilla, avocado, and eggs. My wife and son ordered the Crack sandwich 🥪. Good and cheesy, but must eat while hot; otherwise, the cheese cools down.

author: Laurence Jackson
review_text: Such a fun spot for an evening! We did trivia on a Tuesday, but check out live music, sports or family programs! Melbourne laneways maybe inspire this use of commercial space.

author: Ciara T
review_text: We had to go to the Japanese Consulate and were so happy to find this food hall right next door. The food was really good and it seemed very clean and new. There weren’t a lot of people in the middle of the day. I’d love to try all the restaurants.

author: Jimmy B
review_text: Not a bad place to eat, drink and have fun, although not as much of a selection as Time Out Market. This place offers a more sophisticated approach to mall dining . Pizza, pasta, bar food, Mexican, ice cream, alcoholic drinks and even a champagne vending machine.... What more could one ask for?? PRO TIP: grab the chicken nuggs from HALEY JANES (be careful of the spice kick 🔥) and combo it up with the Mac n cheese from PENNYPACKERS Then, Grab a cocktail from the professionals at DACQUIRIS & DAISIES After ice cream time! And you've got yourself a nice date. Tenderoni slice was not bad but very small for the price tag of 8$ (tasty slice tho)

author: Sarah
review_text: Really awesome selection of food. Lots to chose from which makes it fun. The downside is that it can get very busy and feels like a small space.

author: Alain Lafume
review_text: I went to high street place to have a few drinks and the varieties were plentyful enough. I had two kinds of beers. One blueberry 🫐 and another some kind of creamer one. I had a good time with my friend. Would go again. Though I might try some other kinds of drinks.

author: TANIA RODRIGUEZ
review_text: The food hall atmosphere and the food options are super good! If you are a group, everyone can order exactly what they want! Experience worldwide food in just one place! Sushi, Pasta, Sandwiches, Tacos, Hamburger, Hand made Juices, Salads, Pizza, MOET champagne, Coffee, Cocktails… Saturday afternoon DJ is fantastic for enjoying a beer! I love this place for the options and vibe!😉

author: Irvving Kairos
review_text: The rain helped us stumble upon this place. Before walking in, we did not hear about it nor saw any type of advertisement in Boston. But it was a pleasant surprise tucked in the middle of buildings. Offering a variety in different shops, food and drinks, this food hall did delivered. The lounge area was buzzing but sadly the food halls seemed ghostly. Don't know if the set up is to blame for, but it provided a nice space for a bite, some drinks and a chill place to hang out with friends and family.

author: Esmeralda Isufi
review_text: I had a great experience at Noble Castella! Their katsu sando is absolutely delicious! And the desserts are heaven 🤤

author: Jasmine Caez
review_text: We dined here on Christmas evening and had an exceptional experience. Despite how busy the restaurant was, our server remained attentive, professional, and genuinely welcoming throughout the night. He would pop in on us constantly to see if we needed anything! The food was outstanding from start to finish. The warm bread served at the beginning was so good we had to stop ourselves from eating too much before the meal. We ordered the Surf & Turf for 2 with mac and cheese for our side, and everything was prepared perfectly. The steak was cooked just right, the lobster tail was tender and flavorful, and the mac and cheese was rich and well-seasoned. We ended the evening with the coconut cream cake, which was unique and absolutely delicious. Unlike anything we’ve had elsewhere. Overall, it was a wonderful dining experience, and we would happily return. Thank you for making our Christmas dinner memorable.

author: Alexis Sabbaghian
review_text: Smith & Wollensky Boston never disappoints. We shared the porterhouse steak — perfectly cooked and full of flavor — along with creamed spinach, fried onions, and mac and cheese that were all spot on.
