(a) Eclectic, global menu (b) every dish, be it the rigatoni with chanterelle or the clams in a spicy sauce, the dishes were made to perfection and highly palate pleasing (c) warm and friendly service staff and finally (d) reasonably priced and no service charge. All charges and taxes are built into the prices on the menu. I so wish other restaurants would follow this practice.

author: Steven Weston
review_text: Bittersweet I don’t think the designer kept in mind what Brassica was before they moved. It used to be a hip, quirky spot with an artsy vibe. The new place has its own vibe, but it doesn’t feel like Brassica anymore, and it doesn’t feel like the same restaurant either. Lighting is bright and a bit chaotic. The space reads as modern, with contractor-white walls, and bookshelves , office like floor. In the bar, you can see the sound system, lighting, and some odd shelves. The fake bar top and the blue floor tiles look like something you’d find in an maybe an office food court or something.. it can read like one of those coworker places or a franchised bar rather than a unique dining experience. The food is still good, but it doesn’t feel as distinctive or exciting as It use to be.. portions seem a bit bigger too - which isn’t a good thing imo - the redesign lost the essence of what made Brassica special, leaning toward something more generic. I would have loved to have seen them leverage the older bones of the building and use warmer, more tactile finishes (tile, wood, stone) low lights, plants, brick to add character. Quick fixes: - Rework the lighting: dim down the general lighting, add a couple warm low vintage lamps, get your vibe back - Hide or integrate visible tech: conceal the sound system and shelving behind the bar - Curate the soundtrack: a more cohesive, hip vibe with music - turn it up a bit - supports conversation without overpowering it.

author: Val
review_text: Best no nonsense breakfast in town! French toast is great, service is friendly, & they accept credit card. A neighborhood institution for a reason, just wish it was open Sunday!

author: Jimmy Vee
review_text: I wanted authentic breakfast in the area and decided to give this place a try. I was impressed. And to see that this place has been around for quite some time, I'm glad I eventually had the experience. Food, service and atmosphere was wonderful. Great location, right across from Forest Hills T station. Free street parking as well. Their menu has many options to choose from. Staff was pleasant and catered to every request I had. If you live in or around Forest Hills, make sure to give this place a try. You won't be disappointed.

author: C
review_text: This spot is a cherished favorite. Whenever I have the time it's a top choice for breakfast. Service is unparalleled. Very clean and welcoming environment. Its Saturday morning so theres about a 20 minute wait. Reasonable. I started off with a giant grilled blueberry muffin and medium coffee. Deliciousness. Ordered one egg full breakfast which included toast and hashbrowns with choice of meat. Expertly prepared to order. All I've got to say this is a solid choice with all the basic amenities available. I hope y'all never change.

author: Anthony De La Puente
review_text: Nestled amidst the charming streets of Jamaica Plain, MA, lies the Forest Hill Diner, a haven of warmth and nostalgia that beckons travelers and locals alike. Here, every sip of coffee is an invitation to journey back to simpler times, evoking memories of cozy mornings and hearty conversations. Served in classic Styrofoam cups with traditional pull-up lids, the coffee speaks of timeless quality and care. But the experience extends beyond the steaming brew. Forest Hill Diner’s pancakes are a symphony of flavors, each bite a delicate balance of fluffy texture, creamy butter, and sweet syrup. With every indulgent mouthful, diners are transported to a realm of pancake perfection, where every bite is a celebration of culinary craftsmanship. Yet, it is not merely the food that sets this diner apart. It is the intangible warmth that permeates its atmosphere, the genuine hospitality of its staff that makes every visitor feel like family. From the moment one steps through the door, they are enveloped in smiles and kindness, welcomed into a sanctuary of comfort and camaraderie. In essence, Forest Hill Diner transcends its role as a mere eatery; it is a sanctuary where the harmonious blend of good food, great coffee, and genuine hospitality creates an unforgettable dining experience, leaving a lasting impression on all who pass through its doors.

author: Darrell Maule (Dagga)
review_text: Very nice and pleasant joint, workers are very friendly and food is pretty tasty. Only real downside is the long wait for food depending on the amount of customers. Overall would recommend....

author: Lauren Thompson
review_text: My roommates and I love this cozy spot. True family run place and it shows, from the fresh food to the amazing service every single visit. Our favorite breakfast spot!!!

author: Millie Stonerook
review_text: Went here for breakfast while on vacation. Great portion size and great price. Would highly recommend!

author: Andrew Bennett
review_text: This a classic old school diner, with eggs and French toast exactly the way I love them. Thank you!

author: Cory Schwab
review_text: Stopped in for a quick breakfast and really enjoyed it. Staff was friendly and food was delicious.

author: Danielle O'Garro
review_text: I'm 38. Tried them for the first time at 15 and still go to this day. Same staff, same food, same atmosphere and I love that they stayed true to themselves amongst all the change around them. The food is A+... and staff is friendly. Give it a try, you won't be disappointed.

author: Karma Fashion
review_text: I love forest hill diner breakfast and services I order every Saturday morning routine for pickup and the guy who takes the orders is always so friendly and patient with my difficult orders. And the food is good! Fresh and not greasy like some breakfast sandwiches at other places.

author: ihopetheyhaveicees
review_text: If you’re in the area and need breakfast this is the place to go. Haven’t gone there for anything else, but diner breakfasts are hard to beat especially since it doesn’t break the bank.

author: Ms. Teacher
review_text: Awesome breakfast spot right on the MBTA line across the street from Forest Hills T on Washington St you will find Forest hills diner. If you love diners, you will not be disappointed! They offer yummy diner eats and an actual diner menu in Boston- hard to find! Something for everyone on their menu!

author: T Keane
review_text: Nancy and Mary are sweethearts. Never had a bad meal. I always go there any chance I can get.

author: James Pappas
review_text: Nice people here and it's convenient. The food is a little slow sometimes and you go up to the counter to get your own food. But it seems like one of those places where everyone knows each other. They probably do. Decent prices for good food.

author: Damika
review_text: My first time eating here and the food along with the customer service was phenomenal!

author: Michele Redman
review_text: Really great onion rings, wonderful people serving delish food in neighborhood diner.

author: Kai Pierce
review_text: It's a little dinner with dinner food. You can't go too wrong. I'm not expecting Michelin star level service just a big plate of eggs and bacon and this place delivered.

author: Bill Sheehan
review_text: They don't have wait staff. You order when you come in. I am handicapped they brought me my food. They don't have a restroom. Food is great, large portions for the price and very good value. They are closed on Sunday

author: Kristina “Chicklassique” Mateo
review_text: The food is great . I love the Breakfast Sandwiches and Chocolate Chip Pancakes. The prices are $$$ probably because I usually order Breakfast and have it delivered so the prices I pay are higher then if I were to take-out or Dine-in I think.

author: Dave
review_text: Walked by this place all the time and never thought to try Indian food in general. However, I came here soon after I tried Indian food for the first time a few months ago. I was sort of thrown aback by how small the dining room is compared to other restaurants up and down that same street, which tend to go way deeper into the restaurant. Regardless of space, I was ready to enjoy the food! I had to start off with a mango lassi, as is customary anytime I eat at an Indian establishment. It was really tasty, refreshing, and worth the price. I say this in appreciation of how the restaurant doesn't stuff the drink full of ice so you're getting a fraction of your actual beverage, it was ALL lassi. I went with a classic, butter chicken. It was juicy and flavorful. The sauce was lovely to pour all over my rice. My wife ordered the goat curry and she was enamored. The goat was the least bit gamey and extremely tender. I was excited that this place was so delicious however, I am kicking myself knowing I could have walked in plenty of times. I will continue to visit whenever I am craving lassi, naan, and hopefully a new favorite from their menu!

author: Chris Ayers
review_text: Solid Indian staples served by kind staffers. May be the best Indian food in JP?

author: Pelaiah Auset
review_text: This is my favorite (go-to) Indian food restaurant in Boston! I have a very delicate palate & prefer authentic & real food- and the food gives authentic Indian! I love that they have fish options , mainly why we chose this this spot -I had the Fish(haddock) Masala, my partner had the Fish( haddock) mango, both were equally delicious 😋. In a world of fast & fake food, this spot is👌🏽! The food is delicious, the service was lovely, the atmosphere is positive and there's on street parking ! I highly recommend - esp for vegan /vegetarians 🤍

author: Amory Emlon
review_text: We have been fans of Tikki for several years now. We've never been disappointed! The menu is diverse and delicious, and the kitchen always gets the spice level just right for us. The service is attentive, and the atmosphere is calm and friendly. Recently we tried the Tikki Masala app for take-out, and it was great, too. Thanks to Mr Sharma and his lovely staff!

author: Erin Elizabeth
review_text: This was the hands-down worst restaurant meal of my life; the food was, quite literally, inedible. The samosas came sitting in a puddle of about half a cup of cold, sloshing orange cooking oil. The naan was burned black — to the extent where, when I opened the foil, all I could smell was burnt food. The tikka masala sauce was the consistency of water, and — to top off the single worst meal I’ve ever ordered — they only sent about a teaspoon of each chutney; the little plastic containers were 3/4 empty. Possibly the deplorable preparation had to do with the fact that I ordered it for delivery? I can't imagine that any restaurant would serve up half a cup of cold cooking oil, or burnt black naan, or teaspoon-sized servings of chutney, to people dining in person. Disgraceful.

author: Mary Lou Matteson
review_text: The food is delicious, there are vegetarian options, and you can choose mild, medium, or spicy. It is perfect for our family where each person has preferences.

author: Mahsa
review_text: Liked the place, food was delicious and the owner is nice and accepts requests if you want to add or change part of the order that is written in the menu. Small place but cozy.

author: Steve.PM. “Spreadsheet Nerd” VBA
review_text: Tikki Masala was our first introduction to what proved to be a foodies paradise in the great city of Boston. With family from Fall River, I thought that my nostalgia for New England was the root of my affection for this place. However, the approval from the rest of our ten group party affirmed that my affection was justified. Cannot recommend Tikki Masala high enough. The food was authentic Indian, the service exceptional and the atmosphere pure “whole in the wall”, “side of the road”, “diamond in the rough” perfection. Will make a point to visit again when back in Boston.

author: MikaelaRoze Starr
review_text: Stopped in for a quick bite and was very surprised that it wasn’t busier. The food was amazing and the service was even better from Somdat. Will definitely visit again soon! 🤍

author: Murugan Namasivayam
review_text: We enjoyed the quality of the food and service. Veggie platter was very well made and crisp. My personal favorite was Veggie wrap that had chickpeas and tofu with the right amount and blend of spices.We also had biriyani, tandoori chicken and mango lassi which we enjoyed it.

author: Stephen Fallon
review_text: I stopped in for take out after a long day of work on Saturday 3/22/25. I wanted to try something different from my normal order, the young woman working the tables suggested the Korma. Best thing I did today was take her recommendation, it was exactly what I was craving! Thank you for making my Saturday night! I am sorry I did not get her name, but she was absolutely phenomenal!

author: Matthew Coronato
review_text: 10/10. Very accommodating with no rush. Came in from out of town with loads of bags and they had no issues. Quickly fed with very tasty food! All the meats were outstanding and tender.

author: Kurt Whittemore
review_text: I came here with my wife and had great Indian food and good service.

author: Megha Sheth
review_text: Probably the only Indian food place that I'd rate at zero. The food was bland, it was apparent that no effort was made to look at the taste and spice level. The Dal Tadka had no Tadka and dal tasted uncooked. The rice that is served along looked re-heated than fresh made. I'd recommend this place to No One.

author: Sara Perkins
review_text: Love it here! I never see that many people dining in but it’s actually a lovely place to sit down and grab something to eat. Large portions, amazing taste, good service. I also do pickup fairly often. Lots of vegan and vegetarian choices. 10/10 I hope they never close!

author: Courtney C
review_text: We ordered two curries and a daal. The dishes were really not tasty and extremely OILY. This is the worst Indian restaurant we've been to.

author: Tharen Mcgon
review_text: Excellent Indian flavors in a clean and comfortable setting. Absolutely loved it , would return !

author: joe Yaz
review_text: It was fantastic honestly. Really enjoyed the food very much. I don't normally eat indian food that often but it was absolutely perfect loved it. If you are in the area I'd definitely check this place out.

author: Atul Kumar
review_text: Really tasty authentic India food. We ordered dahi papdi and Mali kofta and it was delicious. The service by the girl at the counter was really great.

author: E L
review_text: We went in late on a quiet weekday evening. The restaurant is very cozy and clean, with good music playing. The food itself was also really good and the portion sizes were balanced -- most of us had just enough leftovers to bring home for a second meal. The owner and the server were both amiable and attentive. No complaints! It was lovely.

author: Food & Footprints
review_text: Wide variety of dominican food. They had everything from rotisserie chicken, beef, and meatballs to oxtail and goat. We ordered mangú with salami, and white rice, green pigeons (guandules) and goat. On both plates we asked for a side of avocado. Food was very well seasoned and cooked, we will be coming back. Prices were fair ($12-13 for the mangú and $23 for the goat) side of avocado was $2.5 and juice was $5.

author: Christopher Benitez
review_text: If you're craving the real taste of the Dominican Republic, drop everything and RUN—don't walk—to this incredible Dominican restaurant serving up some of the best mangú and authentic Dominican dishes in all of New England. Yes, you read that right. Delicious! From the moment you step inside, you're greeted with warm smiles and an unmistakable aroma that hits you right in the soul—like abuela's kitchen on a Sunday morning. The place is spotless, cozy, and full of good vibes. Whether you’re grabbing breakfast or lunch, this spot NEVER misses. Their mangú? Creamy, rich, perfectly seasoned and paired with the most mouthwatering onions, salami, eggs, and queso frito you've ever tasted. It's the kind of meal that makes you sit back, close your eyes, and say, “THIS is what life’s about.” And everything else on the menu? Equally 🔥. The food is always fresh, the portions are generous, and the prices? Very reasonable Customer service is great. The staff makes you feel like family from the second you walk in. It's no wonder regulars keep coming back, and new customers quickly become loyal fans. This small business is easy to find and deserves all the love. So next time you're thinking about where to eat, skip the chain restaurants and do your taste buds a favor—go here ASAP. ⚠️ Don't sleep on this place. Your stomach will thank you. Your soul will too. Dominican flavor. New England’s best. Support local. Eat unforgettable. GO NOW. 🇩🇴💥

author: Katie Manzo
review_text: Food is absolutely delicious. The Cubano sandwich, Pollo lunch plate (with the yellow rice & beans), and mofongo were incredible. The empanadas were very good (small but cheap). The tostones were thicker than I expected, but were still good. Staff was very patient (I speak little to no Spanish) - highly recommend this place.

author: Barbaro Moya
review_text: If you are looking for a good food, a lovely Staff and a friendly ambient. This is the place.

author: cleavroy T
review_text: I was happy that someone understood me but didn't mind waiting for them to cook ,ask the price they show the bowl But look at what they gave me for the price very turn off . There cooking look very good. No quedé contento con lo que me dieron por el precio pregunto que talla pero mira

author: Alisha cruz
review_text: We were visiting from NYC and wow. I knew once I saw the menu that this place would be awesome. Authentic Dominican food. We had the mangu platter and the serving size was great. The taste? Amazing, everything balanced each other so well. I also recommend getting a fresh fruit juice. The chinelo was such a refreshing, sweet unique taste. I wish I had something like this back home! The staff was also very friendly.

author: Mary Carmona
review_text: The chicken was salty and the sweet plantain tasted old. She was nice but the food was a big no yesterday. So disappointed.

author: Abismael Diaz Melendez
review_text: Outstanding service and absolutely great food. ¡Fenomenal!

author: ramon perez
review_text: The food is decent but prices are very hi for a regular Dominican food Restaurant. The breakdown on the prices when you add something extra is really tricky.

author: Winfield Chan
review_text: The two times I've come, they have gotten my order wrong (regular plate instead of family size or queso instead of pollo pastelito). At least the food is good. I recommend the picaderas and pollo guisado to share.

author: Laurent Dubois
review_text: We went in 15min before they closed and they were already cleaning up. When we asked whether they still serve food and what they recommended as we never had Dominican food, they took the time and explained all the dishes to us. We ended up getting a platter with different samples for takeout. It was amazing food at a very reasonable price. I'm a big eater and just came from a run, so I was very hungry: But the plate was so big, that I was more than full afterwards. So, we will definitely go back to try the other dishes they have. This might become my go-to-place!

author: James Knauer
review_text: Large selection of food, it tasted great, plenty of indoor seating. Spanish/English menus

author: Stephan Papandrea (Skpapandrea)
review_text: The food is great and inexpensive, the staff is friendly, and the restaurant is kept very clean.

author: Lauren B
review_text: Had to order a bunch of tostones for a last minute cultural event at my sons school and they were perfect, hot, crispy and packed well... everyone loved them and they were better then the ones I make myself😉 and way faster😂 Cant wait to go back and try the Mangu... everything looked so good😍

author: Norah Burch
review_text: My car broke down, so we ducked into this place for a quick bite to wait while the tow truck showed up. I had a Cubano sandwich. I have only had Cuban Cubanos, but this Dominican one was AMAZING. It was like you take all the good bits from a normal Cubano and make them better. I want another one. Right now. We also got some pastelitos which were likewise amazing! I can't wait to go back here!

author: Nadia Williams
review_text: Food was cooked very well, spices on point, good texture. My picky daughter loved it. Good Caribbean food. Options to eat in on glass plates is a plus

author: Cole Kehn
review_text: delicious local spot, I am obsessed with their pastinis!!!!!

author: Raisa Ceron
review_text: Was visiting Boston for the weekend and was craving a Dominican breakfast. Listen my mom is a great cook but I have never had Mangu this smooth. Everything was delicious, would definitely recommend and have again when in Boston.

author: Sheila Agosto
review_text: The stew chicken was too salty for my taste, only eat one piece out of the three on my plate. Also, the white rice had a burnt smell to it.

author: Angel Carta Blanca
review_text: Well to start this off on the right note. I dont think yall wanna eat from here. Some if not all of these meats sit for days on display.

author: Alexandra Honor Arrivillaga
review_text: “ The food here is ok , not great “ We went here today to try this place . We got the pernil , arroz , and plátano . The food was ok ( fills a hungry stomach ), but not great . The beef empanadas are good though. If we are ever in the area we will come back for those . They have a big parking lot so parking is not an issue. The staff is super friendly. The vibe is warm and welcoming.

author: Isis Adams
review_text: Probably the worst tasting so-called Puerto Rican food I’ve ever tasted in my life. All the food was bland and had no flavor. Spent $70 and I expected the food to be way better than what it is. I definitely will not go back.

author: Mary Carmona
review_text: I'm late finding this place. Order a soup, bacalaito, stuffed sweet plantain, and cooked banana with pernil. All was good, employees were sweet and the place itself is so cute. Parking is a plus.

author: Maria Goines
review_text: I am a Puerto Rican person. I went here really expecting to find good Puerto Rican food. The food had no flavor. There’s a certain flavor. Puerto Rican foods have all the food basically taste the same. I got what they call little which is not the actually ribs. I don’t know where they come up with these different names. Their beans were watery no flavor. We had a dinner of the steak with onions. You can even taste the onions I’m sorry, but it was the worst Puerto Rican food I’ve ever tasted it.

author: Anthony Nygren
review_text: So glad I tried this place! Mango smoothie might be the best I've ever had. Alcapurria was hot and delicious.

author: Yianni Dimitriou
review_text: It was my first time getting authentic Puerto Rican food. My girlfriend and I got the fried chicken, with yellow rice, and fried plantains. The crust and seasoning on the chicken was oooooouuuuuweeeeee goooooood!!! They did not have flan today so I got the tres leches dessert instead and it was really good! The hot sauce was almost like a spicy vinaigrette — really enjoyed it with my rice. The service was excellent and food delectable. Thank you!

author: Michelle T
review_text: The food was terrible the service was terrible everything was cool we told him to heat it up it took them forever we ended up getting up and leaving

author: Jose Cora
review_text: My parents are Puerto Ricans and their culinary skills are 😘👌 My dad's hobby is roasting pork on the weekends. My mom chefs up arroz con guandules, yuca, guineitos and morsillas. When I go to Spanish Restaurants, I always check to see how they compare to that old school style way of cooking my parents have. The lechonera 👍👍 The food is excellent!!! I definitely recommend this restaurant!!!

author: Juan World
review_text: Went there food was good i ate the plantains with fried meat very tasty my sister gad the tamarind juice n she loved it the pasteles en oja were great but the young server with red hair was real off she was like a robot made us feel kinda unwanted she never smiled real dry

author: Gerardo Cruz
review_text: Got alcapurrias for takeout. They didn't have enough so I got some fresh ones! Good size and value for about $3

author: Lucille Rose
review_text: Food is delicious!!!!! Everyone is friendly One long table, no decor on the table, or tablecloth on it. So it doesn't really feel inviting to sit and eat. No music playing So it feels more like a come order, take your food and go type of place.

author: Common Courtesy
review_text: La Lechonera is hands down one of the best spots for authentic Puerto Rican food! The pernil (roast pork) is perfectly seasoned and tender, and the arroz con gandules is full of flavor. Everything tastes homemade and cooked with love. The portions are generous, the prices are fair, and the service is always warm and friendly. Whether you’re grabbing a quick bite or sitting down with family, La Lechonera delivers every time. Highly recommend if you’re craving real, delicious Latin food!

author: PIRM
review_text: I purchase a pionono it had no flavor what so ever and they only add a tiny bit of meat very stingy the pasteles as well no meat no flavors and expensive.

author: Kora Blair
review_text: What can I say? The food is delectable and the service: exceptional! It taste like a bit of my childhood. I just love being in La Lechonera and enjoying the cuisine! I wish they offered seating. I’d love to sit down and have a proper Puerto Rican meal!

author: Heriberto Cardona
review_text: I come from Swampscott just for the food the best food Puerto Rico 🇵🇷

author: Manny Negron
review_text: It has been roughly 1 year since I ate here. Wow how the place has changed. Ownership is definitely different. Customer service is cold and borderline rude. Food is rushed and it shows. This was a great little mom and pop spot years ago. Not anymore. What a shame.

author: Monica King
review_text: The food is great and the staff are so nice. Very helpful helping me with my selections.

author: Margo Conley
review_text: Best Puerto Rican food in Boston. Been coming for years. Sometimes a bit salty but tastes like grandma made it with lots of love. Authentic flavor. Literally all dishes are flavorful and delicious. I love the soups, beans, arroz con candules, alcapurrias, pollo guisado, Pollo frito, tres leches etc.

author: REO
review_text: Even though the owner's aren't puerto rican anymore they kept the the tradition and menu the same as the original owner's...really good authentic tasting Puerto Rican food!!!

author: Evelyn Mendivil
review_text: I enjoy this place, it is not overpriced and food tastes good. The staff is also welcoming and kind.

author: Arty
review_text: I liked everything besides being rushed by the hostess by being asked to follow her multiple times, when i already was. Food is great. The hostess was nice too, it just doesn’t have to be a rush during a meal, praying, sex or bathroom time. Everything and everyone was awesome. Free refills. Paid $21 per myself😂Gladly tipped. Everyone was full and happy. P. S. Please consider mixing up your music playlist. Thank you, FG & B.

author: Selva Murugan
review_text: Come with a heavy appetite and you will not be disappointed. Has a huge selection of Chinese food and includes hibachi grill and sushi. The desert is good too.

author: S.
review_text: So this is the best buffet on this side of town. Everything is pretty tasty well the dishes I choose 😋. They have these little shrimps made with a bomb garlic sauce and they aren't over cooked not gummy but soft melts in your mouth. Rice both yellow and the brown one is my favorite with mushrooms in it not alot of them just enough for the flavor. When I ask to have something filled they don't give you no attitude they tell you how long the wait will be and bring it out in that time. Very pleasant ☺️. I do the take out plates so for 2 it cost like $30. Don't know how much buffet is but I think it's around the same price. Good eats to make the belly happy 😊

author: Cynthia Francis
review_text: Don’t go to a buffet when you haven’t eaten all day! I planned to take the food to go but when I realized how much food I had, it made sense to just pay the buffet price and sit down and eat! The worst decision! I had three employees come to my table asking for my receipt! The last person was a rude teenager- braces wearing kid! Just as I was about to tell him to go get your father. My waitress came to the rescue and set him straight. She gets a tip!! Ruined my appetite!!! My plastic glass was broken! The food is not good and my tongue is coated with MSG! 🤮

author: Shivam Patel
review_text: Was looking forward to coming with my friends after looking at some of the reviews, especially the crab rangoons. Well, you get what you pay for. Stay away from the seafood later in the day. Everything else was ok, chicken dry/overcooked but edible. We accidentally paid extras for soda (which was fine) but we had to ask our server for water instead 3 times, she kept asking us what kind of soda. Not sure why that’s an issue, you’re getting extra money for nothing? Can tell the staff has an attitude problem, from the front desk to the waitress, maybe just a bad day? A couple of waitresses were talking amongst themselves near us and kept glancing at us, not sure if they had some issue with us? We were still polite regardless because we don’t have time to cause problems. What finally did it was seeing a mouse scurry from the buffet food area running towards behind the front desk from where we were seated. Was hoping to come back with my family, now you won’t see us again. Hope others have a better experience. Or just get a much better quality plate from anywhere else for $18. Reviews from other take out restaurants nearby say they have generous portions anyways. Will be going there in the future

author: Khadija
review_text: It’s cheap. The food is decent. I wouldn’t get my hopes up going into this place. If you’re big on volume but not big on eating a good meal, this place is for you. If you have any allergies, run. As a picky eater who also has allergies, I found this to be a pretty big disappointment. I wouldn’t come again.

author: Lilith Purpura'Regina
review_text: We go here literally every week! It's the best buffet in the area! And the people are super friendly! Shout out to my boy at the front desk! The dude with the cool hair is always super nice! And the food is usually really good! Like any buffets, they have off times. But I've never left regretting eating there! I definitely recommend to everyone! P.s. gotta try their crab Rangoon! It's one of the best I ever had! They fill them so much! And you gotta get the Hibachi rice and put the drippings from the beef roast on it and a little soy sauce.... literally to die for!

author: J B MacDonald
review_text: The Chinese food part was fine, but the seafood and desserts weren’t eatable. A little Overpriced and they make you pay before so for the people that only have card, you can’t leave a tip for the server. Also I can find better food and prices at another buffet only 10 minutes from my house. This was almost an hour drive. Don’t come here, MID!

author: Khalida
review_text: Had a family dinner here. It was okay. Food options were plentiful but nothing was that good. I will not be returning. I felt a way about being asked to pay before we even sat down. It was a bit janky. Nice people.

author: Hank Goldman
review_text: This was our first visit to this newer location. We were there between 2 and 3 on a Thursday. The food was well stocked and hot. It was not as fresh as we have experienced at their other locations but I think that was to be expected because it was pretty slow while we were there. The one real disappointment was the server. It was very slow yet we had to chase her down for refills and to clear a large pile of plates. We love the Flaming Grill Buffets and will be back again.

author: Darryl Paraison
review_text: Some Food is good while others are bad, the crab lagoon, mac and cheese. Pizza taste horrible. The rice and chicken taste pretty good, the spaghetti is flavorful

author: Cor Mango
review_text: My family first time dining here. I've never seen so much food! Although I'm vegan their were plenty of vegetables, rice noodles, and fresh fruits. My family are not vegan reason for the none vegan photo's. The dining area was very clean. Waitress always cleaning the tables. My only issue was that they was sweeping around our table which cause to cough, sneeze and my mother constantly blowing her nose. Otherwise we enjoyed the food.

author: Lindsay L. Bigby
review_text: Place was pretty slow though it was peak lunch time. I had a hard time finding my plate for the first round because most things looked dried out or I recognizable. A few months back it was decent. Hoping it's a bad day vs a trend.

author: Gary Markosyan (LaserHere)
review_text: This is the Place to go for everyone with kids who are "constantly hungry". I do not know how they can meet ends with such low prices! Good selection of food to feed whole family.

author: Abner Bonilla
review_text: It is what it is. If you’re looking for cheap food and lots of it this is your place if you’re thinking you’re going to get filet mignon and lobster tails for the price your gravely mistaken based on that that’s what I judge it on the service is great and when you walk in, they usually are friendly, they clean up the tables right away. It is handicap accessible, and there is plenty of parking out front. For what the price of the food is the food is fine. It’s a really big area. Have fun and enjoy.

author: Jurassic world
review_text: This place is a hard NO for me, and it’s all because of how horribly we were treated after our meal. Paying upfront at a buffet is totally normal, and we did so without any issue. The meal itself was nothing to write home about average at best. But what absolutely ruined the experience was the behavior of our server, Jenny. As we were leaving, Jenny confronted us and flat-out demanded a tip aggressively and in a tone that was completely out of line. This was after we had already paid and were getting ready to walk out. She literally dragged us to the front and wouldn’t let the issue go, making a scene as if we owed her something beyond what we had already paid. Tipping is a choice not something that should be shaken down from customers under pressure. To make things worse, Jenny took the customer copy of our receipt, and forced us to sign for a tip. That receipt is supposed to be ours to keep for verification, tracking expenses, or just basic transparency. Without it, we have no idea what the exact final charge was or if anything extra was added. It felt sneaky, dishonest, and completely unprofessional. There’s no excuse for this kind of behavior. It’s one thing to ask politely if we’d like to leave a tip. It’s another thing entirely to harass customers at the door and confiscate receipts like we’re being scammed. We left feeling uncomfortable, disrespected, and frankly disgusted. Avoid this place unless you enjoy being bullied for more money after you’ve already paid. Jenny’s behavior was outrageous, and if this is how they train their staff, then management is just as bad. Spend your money somewhere that values basic customer respect and knows how to operate a restaurant without resorting to intimidation tactics.

author: Daniel
review_text: This place used to be amazing. Now it is just ok. Only got one refill. Plates stayed on table for a while. Hibachi person looked like he couldn't be bothered to put effort into making your food good.

author: Henry Paige
review_text: 1. the sushi looked dry. 2. The rice tasted like it was cooked with dog food - I tossed that out. 3 the vegetables were good and beef and broccoli was great

author: Danny
review_text: Food is cold PS: much cleaner and better food. Will come back more often. Just quick question: why collect people money beforehand?

author: Johnny Wyatt
review_text: Food was pretty good. No long line and service was impressive. I found it very unprofessional of the young man behind the counter constantly on his personal phone the entire time for the people in line ahead of me and through my entire check in. Needless to say he was still on his phone as I left

author: harrymik100
review_text: This is one of my favorite places to eat. I come here for breakfast, but I will stop in from time to time for the fresh baked goods. The pan de bono, the empanada, the buñuello, are perfect. The coffee is great, and perfect with one of the baked goods, but even better with a hot breakfast. My favorite is the Calentado Paisa. Grilled sirloin steak, scrambled eggs with tomato and onion, rice and beans, served with arepa with cheese. The chicharron is the best I have ever had, also. If you have a big appetite or even for two people, the Super Bandeja. It is a little of everything, and a great way to find out how amazing it all is. I noticed the people don't only come here for the food either. The Chef/Owner, Miguel, will come out and greet guests, and they love him. His sister Erica takes care of the restaurant side and is so hospitable. She knows almost every guest by name. She will burst out singing from time to time, and if you are there to catch it, it's amazing. Definitely check this place out for amazing hospitality, service, and even better food.

author: Solomon Clarke
review_text: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Great experience at Delicias Colombianas! The food was delicious and Carolina gave excellent service — friendly, attentive, and fun to chat with. Looking forward to coming back!

author: Meriel Marmanillo
review_text: Just had an amazing meal at Delicias Colombianas Restaurant! The food was absolutely fantastic – every dish was bursting with flavor and cooked to perfection. Seriously, you have to try this local spot. But what really made the experience special was the incredible service. Our server, Carolina, was so attentive and helpful. She clearly knew the menu inside and out and made some great recommendations. You could tell she really cares about her work and making sure everyone has a great time. If you're looking for delicious food and top-notch service, this place is a must-visit. I highly recommend it and can't wait to go back!

author: Victor Price
review_text: Great place. Pleasant atmosphere. Excellent customer service. Food well cooked with acceptable portions and presentation.

author: David Bello
review_text: I recently dined at your restaurant and had a fantastic experience. The food and atmosphere were excellent, and the staff's warmth and friendliness added to the enjoyment. Special thanks to Carolina for ensuring everything was perfect. I highly recommend your restaurant to everyone. Keep up the great work!

author: Alex Cole
review_text: Delicious food options in a fun atmosphere with attentive staff. They also offer some items to cook at home, such as packs of arepa de choclo and quesito Colombiano. They make a delicious jugo de mora en leche that I almost always get as a treat when I pick up food.

author: Andy B
review_text: If you’re searching for a dining experience that combines mouthwatering food with outstanding service, look no further than Delicias Colombianas in Hyde Park. From the moment you step inside, you're enveloped by the inviting atmosphere that radiates warmth and authenticity. The decor reflects the vibrant culture of Colombia, and it sets the perfect backdrop for the culinary journey that awaits.! Each dish is a masterpiece, bursting with flavors that transport you straight to the heart of Colombia. Whether it's the arepas, empanadas, or the traditional bandeja paisa, every bite delivers an explosion of taste and a comforting familiarity that keeps drawing me back for more. But what truly sets Delicias Colombianas apart is the incredible service, and that’s where Caroline shines! Every time I visit, she greets me with a warm smile and genuine enthusiasm that instantly makes me feel welcome. Caroline's attentiveness and personal touch elevate the meal to a whole new level; she's never too far away when you need something but also knows the perfect moments to check in, allowing for both personal interaction and the space to enjoy your meal. In short, Delicias Colombianas Hyde Park is a culinary gem, and with service like Caroline’s, it’s a destination I wholeheartedly recommend to anyone seeking authentic Colombian cuisine in a friendly and welcoming environment. Treat yourself to a meal here — you won't be disappointed!

author: Sharryn Gedeon
review_text: Great ambiance and staff is lovely. The owner Caroline definitely invests in their property and staff. Place is always clean and inviting. Food beautifully presented and love the music! I definitely will be back!

author: Daniel Glickman
review_text: A surprisingly good place to eat where you would not expect it. Best for Spanish speakers but they will do their best to accommodate and explain the dishes to you. The food aims to punch above its weight and while it’s not quite upscale it’s definitely very tasty. The staff is the highlight, very chatty and eager to provide a good time. Enjoy!

author: Kiauna Washington
review_text: Attended on Mother’s Day. They were very friendly and accommodating, though we didn’t have a reservation. There was live music. A little confusion at times due to the language barrier, but I used google translate to assist. Overall things went smoothly. Would definitely eat here again. Highly recommend the modongo soup and truffle fries. Drinks were really good too…best mojitos since my trip to Puerto Rico. Plenty of off street parking in the rear.

author: Mahesh Balkarran
review_text: Their fruit juices are freshly made. The food is definitely homemade and fresh. It's one of the top columbian restaurants i been to. Delicious and friendly staff. Portions are huge and definitely would be a regular customer if i live here.

author: Catherine Flynn
review_text: Everything was delicious and portions were plentiful (so had.leftovers for lunch). It was my birthday and they made it very festive!

author: C C
review_text: Colombia's food is amazing. I recommend this place to anyone who wants to try some amazing Spanish food. It's excellent. the staff are very friendly and courteous

author: K O
review_text: Delicious food and generous portions. Service was so kind and attentive, the atmosphere was clean and very nice. If you're in the area I definitely recommend it!

author: Samuel Cintra
review_text: Carolina was our server and she was amazing!! Food and drinks were great and I loved celebrating my birthday with y’all!!

author: IamGloria Louis
review_text: I absolutely love coming here . I’ve been coming here for about 3 years and the service here is amazing . Carolina de Hyde park is such an amazing server ! Very welcoming and kind . You will not regret coming here .

author: Elmer Castillo
review_text: If I could give Delicias Colombianas six stars, I would. This place is a true gem and the perfect spot for any occasion. Carolina is an absolute star. She is always so friendly and attentive, and she remembers my favorite order even when it's been a while since I've visited. She makes every dining experience feel special and personal.

author: Joshua González
review_text: Wow, this place was incredible! I was just passing through and heard great things about it from a friend. The service was top-notch! We had two people with allergies, and the server was an absolute lifesaver. She knew exactly what ingredients were safe for us and made some amazing recommendations. The food, drinks, and ambiance were all 10/10!! Thanks for a fantastic night, Will definitely be back next time I’m in town!

author: samuel gerald
review_text: I ordered two Salmon Mariners. I asked her can she change the rice to picture number two with rice and vegetables she told me it would be an extra charge. I said OK not a problem. The order ended up being $60.00 When I opened the package and seen I was overcharged for rice with Sazón seasoning I was very disappointed because I planned on spending a lot of money with them. Unfortunately, everyone’s looking for a fast buck.

author: Valerie Johnson
review_text: Prepare to be delighted by Delicias Colombianas! This hidden gem consistently delivers on all fronts. From the moment you step in, the service is truly exceptional – warm, attentive, and incredibly friendly. But the real star is the outstanding food; every bite is a delicious journey of authentic Colombian flavors. Pair that with the casual and inviting atmosphere, and you've got the recipe for a perfect meal. Don't miss out on this fantastic spot!

author: Adrian Bridglal
review_text: Service there sucks as staff would rather have conversations than serve people and get a line moving in for far too long. I have supported this business and every time I come there people walk out from behind the counter to go do something other than serve the customers while a line builds up. There’s usually one person, servant, and they will all look at you and leave you there to suffer like you’re begging for the food do better only one you have potential to be great I walked out of that restaurant today and told myself I will not come back and support a local business that can get things done right simple service etiquette they lack.

author: roxanne charles
review_text: This is my 2nd review with the same issue different staff. I went there this past weekend after running errands. Out of all the many many Jamaican spots I enjoy them overall for the food. I come from Dorchester (in traffic) to receive the rudeness. The server was a man (again) very rude and lack hearing. He looked as if he was high. I asked for a large jerk chicken rice and peas. He proceeds to put white rice. I was trying to get his attention and clearly he is not hearing me. At that point I asked the female server to take my order. I still had to watch the customer behind deal with his ignorance. He had the nerve to go back and forth with her about her order. To the owner: Customer service its the key to a successful business. If you choose to keep ignoring these complaints regarding the rude staff, your business will eventually suffer in the long run. This is insulting to our people who want to support black business. We have to do better and hold staff accountable for their unprofessional behaviors.

author: Dameain Mims
review_text: The food is excellent. I recommend the curry chicken or stew chicken but my favorite is the escovitch chicken it's a fried chicken in a hot pepper sauce with carrots and onions. I usually order the escovitch chicken with cabbage and yellow rice and veggies with the stew chicken gravy over the rice

author: swalrond
review_text: Food is hit or miss but the attitude especially with the female staff is uncalled for. Not sure why so many Jamaican resturants tend to hire these disgruntled women. I've had decent experiences with the men there but a good majority of the female staff will make you go elsewhere and not spend a dime in there. To the owner please explain why I can't be sold a small plate with just meat and no rice or cabbage? If I'm paying the same price and not asking for more meat than they would normally put on a plate that includes the sides, whats the problem? I'm asking for the same portion they would give if it was meat with sides but I don't want sides for dietary reasons but your female staff says they cannot sell it that way. Are you losing money on the rice not sold if its not included in the plate? Make it make sense please. You can only buy a medium oxtail but not a large or small. Makes no sense. Food is not consistent but I've always supported this place and gave it many chances but like many others I don't think I will continue to do so.

author: L Frederick
review_text: I ordered a medium jerk chicken. The portion of the rice and cabbage was suitable , however i was given 3 pieces of the chicken thigh back bone which is unacceptable. The taste of the food lack that Jamaican flavor. I called to give constructive criticism but they said they are to busy to speak with me why am leaving this feedback. Boston have a big Caribbean community step your game up only one! Don't be the only one!

author: Gabriela Contreras
review_text: I spent $18 with a soda included. The portion served is very generous which is always an extra ⭐ since it was my first time, I had to ask for my options, the person who was serving took the time to explained me and everything was nice and easy.

author: Joseph BROWN (Mr. Brown)
review_text: Me and my family was there tonight and yooooooo the customer service was stop on. I did not have tip money on me and i fault bad but since my son goes to school i will send the tip money with him. Thanking the crew

author: C
review_text: After shopping we worked up an appetite and stopped in to sample the jerk and curried chicken offerings. It's like the other Jamaican spots. Food displayed cafeteria style. The servers were more than generous with the portions. My shopping buddy likes the fluffy rice and beans. The curried chicken had good heat to it. The jerk chicken succulent and flavorful. I will try lunch next time.

author: Ta'Shana Brown
review_text: Today, I had a very bad experience with the servers/cashiers at Only One Jamaican Restaurant on Hyde Park avenue. I was purchasing a soup and I asked if the boiled dumpling was made with cornmeal. The response given was, “I don’t know sir”. Instead of attempting to find out for me, she alongside another worker decided to make other comments as if I were to know what ingredients were used. This is very bothersome as a paying customer. The customer service was overall terrible. At the end of it I left with regret and unable to properly enjoy my meal.

author: Physique Fitness
review_text: Very busy here but food was good beef pattie was good but idk what happen I think they forgot the cheese. Awesome got the oxtail and rice with cabbage. Wasn’t spicy which was good cuz I’m pregnant

author: Kevin Stallings
review_text: i’ve ordered here multiple times , i’ve only been disappointed , because i didn’t order more food ! i love everything they sell, the food is absolutely delicious ,the portions are enormous, the bag of food for the $60 i spent was easily 25 pounds or more , no kidding , the chicken soup is excellent & my daughter absolutely loves it , the sweet & spicy chicken is incredible , the Oxtail is amazing , all the vegetables are done perfectly , all of their Rice is done perfectly , i have to buy 6 beef patties in order to get one , thats because my kids love them so much , Honestly I can’t say enough about the taste ,freshness & generous amount of food at the price you get, at Only one !

author: Olivia Walsh
review_text: I stop here at work every chance I get. I usually get jerk chicken but today I got curry. Both are delicious and you get a lot of food for a good price.

author: Charm
review_text: I was very disappointed by my oxtail lunch 11/7/23 the oxtail was full of fat more fat that meat. We all should know oxtail cannot be cooked that way, because you will have more grease than gravy. Everyone talks about how great the food is at Only One well lets be more consistent and on point or get a better cook. Very Disappointed...........

author: Elle Barnes
review_text: I went in to purchase a salmon plate with rice and peas and cabbage. I asked for jerk gravy on my salmon while placing my order. I notice while the server was closing my plate she did not add the jerk gravy, so I asked her could she pls add it. She responded with a nasty attitude “ I’m not opening the tray again it will be hard to close” so I said ok that’s fine, do you mind putting some in a small container. She does, when she comes back I said thank you. She rolled her eyes and sucked her teeth as she was walking away. And I left that plate on the counter . There is NO way I was paying for her attitude. It sucks even trying to support this business. You have to mentally prepare yourself to be miss treated . I’m all set ! They really need learn customer service ! You can’t buy everything online - I will never support this business again 🤷🏽‍♀️

author: Andre Thomas
review_text: If the food was great, I would tolerate the poor customer service. But since it’s not, they need a better staff there at least late night. What happened to service with a smile, what happened to eye contact when talk to customers. How about not being rude to someone helping you get a check? Do better late night staff on 10/24! Or I will find another place who wants my money!

author: c man
review_text: Out of all the ONLY ONES RESTURANT LOCATIONS … this one has a more fresher and cleaner feeling and look. I also find the food better especially the chicken soup. BUT THE COCO BREAD & CHEESE LEAVES A LOT TO BE DESIRED AND THERES NEVER NOT MUCH CHEESE. THE CHEESE ISNT MELTED AND IT JUST VERY VERY LITTLE AMOUNT OF CHEESE. IF THAT GETS FIXED theyre absolutely for me THE JAMAICAN RESTURANT IN BOSTON.

author: J Celtic617
review_text: I've been here multiple times over the past few years and I love this location. I have personally never experienced any bad service. The food Is delicious and portions are worth the money

author: Shaquanna Brown
review_text: Food is usually good -- pretty much what we'd expect of an average / slight above average Jamaican food takeout restaurant. For the dinner plate, I would prefer for the meat portions to be larger and the rice portion smaller.

author: Brendan Thomas
review_text: EDit 1/6/2024: I updated my review to reflect a few changes I noticed since I first wrote this. I was one of the first to eat from here when it opened five years ago in the former D'Angelo's location. They food is outstanding, the service is friendly and the space is VERY clean. That's where the compliments stop unfortunately. Three and a half years after the Pandemic closed the dining area, I was able to use the dining area myself. The staff person I spoke to said they reopened the dining area "a while ago" but I saw no proof or evidence of that--as in customers eating in--until I finally asked a few months ago. It would help if they simply posted signs saying indoor dining is open again. I have no idea why they never did that much so people can know.The only possible explaination I can think of at this point is they got used to not having to bother cleaning those spaces several times a day. . That aside, the prices on the entrees and even side items have been gradually increasing without notice. When they first opened in 2018, the Oxtail plate came in three size options (Small, Medium and Large). In the summer of 2019 they announced due to rising prices on oxtail meat, they were dropping their Small and Large options for the Oxtail and would sell the Medium at a higher price in a styrofoam container. It started at $18 and is now $24. About two years ago, they brought back the Small size that started at $11 and is now 14. I like their Oxtail but I'm not willing to pay $24 for a "Medium" Oxtail. I'm better off buying the meat and cooking it myself in that case (and you can buy raw Oxtail meat at some meat markets in the Boston area). It's sad that Only One has decided to pass those rising costs onto their customers, most of whom they know live in the neighborhood--myself included. Other entrees have also had price increases in recent years. The pandemic sucked for everyone financially. People get you need to be profitable to stay in business and pay your employees but this is really pushing it. One myth/rumor I've heard for a while that I can personally confirm is NOT true is some think the food is cooked at another location and brought there. This is NOT true. All food is cooked on site in the kitchen in the back. The food is SAFE, Sanitary and good. They also take custom requests on all orders within reason. For example if you want to mix and match certain items in the same plate, you can. Just ask. On that last point, here's a tip you can use at not just Only One but any other West Indian restaurant that plates the food in front of you: If you want more, speak up. That's how you get more bang for your buck. I always tell them to drown the rice with gravy no matter what I order for example. I don't like my rice dry but I know others only prefer enough sauce to cover the meat. One time the sever looked at me like I was crazy and I said "I'm paying for it and I'll eat it, keep going." My mother tells them not to skimp on the meat which they will if you let them. Why should you pay $14 for a Small Curry Goat with mostly bones for example? It's something to think about. When in doubt, see how others order their food and take cues from them. I live in the neighborhood and walk there but the very limited parking is shared with the other businesses including the health center. If you don't mind walking a little, you can park in the Shaws Parking Lot. More so if you plan to eat in.

author: andrea Isaac
review_text: 45$ for two plates whole medium of oxtail was fatty got my food early morning so I was clearly the first order. Sad, I'd was gonna go my money back but I wasn't wasting my gas to Go back across town! Not even given forks. NEVER AGAIN

author: H Woodson
review_text: Food was just alright. Everytime I visit Boston I look for black owned restaurants and the atmosphere was great but the Restaurant Pasta is waaaay too spicy for my liking and the Mac and cheese had no flavor. The calamari was very chewy. The oxtails were good but fatty. The water boy stayed on his job and I approached that. The manager did give us a round of drinks on the house though so that was nice of him. I would go back though just to support.

author: Cordero Emile
review_text: I went here last week and I had the time of my life over here. The interior of this place is beautiful combined with the food and service makes this one of the Best Black Restaurants and Restaurants period in Boston. The complimentary muffins they give you is so addictive, while the drink I ordered was a Red sangria tasted so right and the Rasta Pasta with chicken I ordered is one of the best I’ve eaten. I would definitely come here again. In addition to what I previously said, here are more photos of Park 54 and it’s food I ate at later visits and also when you stop by at Park 54 I want you to give praise to the Chef Khadijah who works there. She is the best Chef I ever met and that woman works too hard to not get the respect she deserves.

author: Ar Monsanto
review_text: The food is extremely delicious and not overpriced. The space is cozy and perfect for a date night or hanging out with friends. There’s a variety of ways you can experience oxtails. Say yes to the shrimp and grits!

author: O
review_text: Food, vibes, and service were immaculate. Drinks were good. We really loved the shrimp and grits and the fried chicken wings (not pictured). Service was truly above and beyond exceptional, so attentive and professional. Awesome music was playing. The bar looked fun too.

author: Tyre Kenney
review_text: I’m from Baton Rouge, Louisiana and live in Atlanta now so I know a thing or two about soul food. This place is topping any soul food spot in ATL and will give Louisiana restaurants a run. Shoutout to Juceila our waiter and Mai the cook who did his thing on the snapper (that didn’t make the pic cause we were already smashing). 12/10 recommend. Will be back.

author: barbara Mosley
review_text: First time there service was great, drinks were good. I ordered the Hennessey barbecue honey wings and the spicy calamari. Well the chicken was over cooked and didn't taste like Hennessey barbecue honey. Calamari was cold. Didn't even wanna take the left overs. Beautiful establishment in need of a dance floor or at least have karaoke night. They have a DJ but no dance floor. Big screen TV's that are awesome for watching the games!!!

author: Clifford Sorrell
review_text: I came here from Philly excited to try the shrimp, lobster, crab and grits. Unfortunately the grits weren't ready to my disappointment. I had the oxtail, rice beans and collars which were amazing. The white sangria was to refreshing. The chef came out later and apologized and gave me an order of the shrimp and grits to go which was appreciated. Great atmosphere and service I also seen Jason Tatum.

author: Ashley
review_text: Nice venue, drinks were very good. Street parking. Food was decent definitely would return.

author: Charlene Elizabeth Clark
review_text: Celebrated a Repass Here and It Was My First Experience and It Was Amazing, Can't Wait 2 Revisit and Be An Actual Customer.. Staff was So Amazing All Out Food Was Free and I Still Left a $30 Tip Chicken Wings Were Bussin 9/10 Cannied Yams 8/10 Greens 💚 8.5/10 Can't Wait 2 Customize My Own Plate 2 Eat

author: MrsJ Brice
review_text: My first time at Park 54 on a Date night with my husband and I give everything 10/10. The food was delicious, portion sizes were on point. The cleanliness , the look and atmosphere all around was top tier. The servers were very attentive and friendly. And I love to dance when I eat my food cause food is my happy place lol, and you can’t help but vibe to the dope mix of songs in the background. I think I danced through my whole meal. We will definitely be back again.

author: Chika Brown
review_text: Not crowded at the time of our visit. Food was subpar. Fried pork chops were good… lemon pepper wings were way too salty, loaded fries were mediocre, corn muffins and candy yams were good. .*Updated review… revisited with a friend and the hospitality provided by the owners was top notch! Thank you for the friendly convo and welcome you provided.

author: Gvel Cmajor
review_text: If you haven't been, YOU NEED TO visit this gem in Hyde Park. Service is great, food is amazing and the patrons seem like friends from the neighborhood decided to go eat at the same time. Lol. My wife and I went around 1230 for brunch on a Sunday. I'll be honest, for two brunch meals at 35 a pop, 2 mimosas a piece and 2 desserts to go, the price was 200. 🤯 just don't get the mimosas. Lol but this is an absolute must! You'll thank me later. Oh, yeah, the DJ and music was so on point! I just wish the volume was a tad lower. But all in all no complaints!

author: Nieca Baybez
review_text: I’ve been here 4x’s and each visit was a great time!! The food and drinks never disappoint with reasonable prices, not overpriced at all. A restaurant like that is hard to find- it’s usually hit or miss but not here and I love that. It’s a nice ambiance, atmosphere, & vibe. They definitely cater to the people, even down to the music. The music is not loud which allows you to still communicate with your guest. Love that! If you’re thinking about going, Go! I’ll definitely be going back.

author: Abri
review_text: 5/5 Food 5/5 Customer Service 5/5 Ambiance 4/5 Drinks (pricey downtown prices) Amazing experience!!! It is fun, the music and live music is great!! The food is so delicious. I have been at least 4 times and everytime has been a blast. The servers are kind, friendly, and helpful. This time we got corn and garlic parmesean wings and it's was busssinn (so damn good) the time before we have gotten lemon pepper wings and shrimp ceasar salad which is also very food. The catfish stripes are also very delicious. The cornbread appetizer is to die for, my absolutely favorite. The drinks are kinda of pricey but are very good. When crowded the food takes a long time but the servers sometimes bless you with a free drink if the food takes too long. Highly recommend. If you don't like loud music and loud talking don't go here.

author: Kristina Bates
review_text: The Restaurant was clean and well put together. The food was great & the blueberry lemon drop was excellent. Coming from a 20 year Server/Bartender our server wasn’t very attentive ☹️. We just felt like she disappeared a lot during our meal, and it was weird because the restaurant wasn’t crazy busy. But she was sweet! The guy pouring waters was extremely nice and sweet as well, The chef even stopped by to ask us how our meal was. Overall I’d return and hope the next time our server would be more attentive.

author: Melnea Cass (IYADONNA)
review_text: I love this place! Seriously, they can have all my money because I had an amazing time here. The food was amazing. I had the Rasta pasta, I also tried the Mac & cheese (I kept stealing my mother’s catfish strips tho. Those were truly top tier. Staff was very polite and inviting. I can’t wait to return!

author: Kat Olowu
review_text: 11/13/22 - 6:15p reservations Arrived right before 6:10 and got seated right away. It was a busy night. Although our server (Lindsey) was great, the kitchen was behind and our food took an hour to come out. Service and food were GREAT but the timing to get the food was poor. Despite the delays with the kitchen, I would give this restaurant another try as the food and service were great. The server indicated that it's typically not backed up like it was tonight.

author: KATHERINE HANDY
review_text: I tried park 54 for the first time during dine out week, we were a group of 4. The food was great I had the fried snapper, I was surprised it was flour fried I'm use to skin fried snapper but it was still delicious. I will say the peach cobbler came out cold, the manger did apologize about that. The lemonade and cornbread are absolutely delicious. The hostess did come over and tell us she needs our table about 10 minutes after we paid despite the 5 tables around us being completely empty and upstairs was empty as well we were there around 430 pm on a Thursday.

author: Shena Diaz
review_text: Everything is great here and I mean everything but I am very pissed off that I just spent 88.28 in this store tonight and got some candies yams that were ten dollars…. I was never in my big back mind thinking they were ever gunna turn around and give me the smallest container of yams going…clearly this is a big order for more than one person but the serving of these yams is for one person and yet they are charging folks ten dollars for it with my order being 88 dollars the least they could have done was throw in a free cup of yams I means why not I purchased two cups anyway if you ask me

author: NiMan Liu
review_text: It was pretty busy, but once someone came over to help us an excellent dinner took place. Steak medium rare was cooked perfect. Red snapper had a fantastic crisp. Candied yam was to die for. Edit: Red velvet cake and banana bread pudding was amazing. Too bad they ran out of peach cobbler, definitely coming back to try that.

author: Michael Johnson
review_text: Was doing some shopping and ended up stuck in the fuel tanker roll-over traffic jam for hours. Made the best of the situation by stopping in and grabbing dinner solo. There was a wait for a seat at the bar, but seats opened up quickly! Bar staff was quick to take drink orders and patient with dinner decisions. Tito's dirty martinis were perfect. Ordered the "Chicken Critters" with two sides; house salad and fries...salad first. The house salad (which I think might be called "Road House Salad" was a 10/10!... Fresh crisp lettuce, tomatoes, cheese and even egg slices that made it seem like a small chef salad. After the salad, there was room for only half of the chicken tenders and fries. The tenders were crispy and didn't need any dip/dressing but had a small side of ranch. The fries were great....right out of the fryer. Didn't ask if they were fresh or frozen. (Ask your server)

author: Jim Haynie
review_text: Cold day today on New Years Eve! The wind was blowing through the windows!! Someone needs to send them a case or two of caulking to caulk inside and out. Freezing near any windows.

author: Bradley Nakaji
review_text: The family was impressed with the steaks at Texas Roadhouse as the meat was prepared according to their indicated preference. Salads were crisp and fresh tasting. Potato sides are calorie bombs when ordered "loaded". The veggies can vary from fresh to canned (corn and green beans). Service was excellent. Both server and management were a pleasure.

author: Mark Czako
review_text: It’s always a pleasure to come here! I always get seated and served within a couple of minutes the waiters/waitresses are very kind (important to note that I sit down at the bar most of the time). The only thing this specific Texas Roadhouse could improve on is the Steak Fries… Sometimes come out cold, but overall they could have a little more crunch. The sirloins are top quality, I never had to chew on some raw portion. Clean meat, properly grilled! Highly recommend this restaurant!

author: Aline Martinian
review_text: I ordered the 8 oz. Sirloin with rice and grilled shrimp. Second side was green beans. Steak was delicious but a bit overcooked. The green beans.... let's just say I would jot order again. Way too overcooked, soggy. Overall a good experience. Wait staff very nice. I changed my review to a lower star level because within 40 minutes after eating here, I got severe stomach and intestine pain and cramps and have been in the bathroom for the past 3 hours off and on. Horrible! Will never rat here again!!!

author: Aref Aasi
review_text: This place never disappoints you. This Texas road house branch has been our favorite place to gather with our friends. I love their bread & butter!

author: KC KC
review_text: Long wait on Friday night but no one seemed mind at all! Good food and good place to hang out and wait staff would come out to celebrate your birthday at your table, Texian style! very fun place to be

author: Ericka Henderson (BlackGal)
review_text: MacKenzie and Maddhie were amazing 👏Thanks ladies and working as a team "You Rock" 🏆 see yall soon 👋 I'm still eating the 🥩today! My son ❤️ his Togo order as well.

author: Patrice Martin
review_text: Our server Zay was fantastic. He was friendly and knowledgeable. I had the Dallas filet and it was cooked perfectly and delicious. Zay suggested mushrooms and onions and that was a great addition. The mashed potatoes are perfect. The broccoli was cooked perfectly and buttery. The bread is sweet and yeasty. The kitchen was slower than expected: on that day, we probably waited 30 minutes for the salad to come out and the food came out 10 minutes after that. It was busy, and I was visiting with friends, so I didn't mind it so much. Overall, this visit changed my perspective on Texas Roadhouse. I will consider visiting the one closer to my home in the near future.

author: Pilai W
review_text: From the moment we walked through the doors, the ambiance of the steakhouse set the tone for a memorable evening. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, with dim lighting, rustic wood accents, and the subtle aroma of grilled meat in the air — it felt both elegant and comfortable. Our server was attentive, knowledgeable, and genuinely enthusiastic about the menu. He walked us through the different cuts of steak, cooking styles, and mocktails with patience and professionalism. We started with a salad and bread— both fresh and full of flavor. But the real highlight of the evening was the steak. I ordered the ribeye, cooked medium rare, and it was absolute perfection. The crust on the outside was seared just right, locking in the juicy tenderness within. Every bite melted in my mouth. My partner had the filet mignon , and it was equally impressive — tender, rich, and perfectly seasoned. The sides — especially the garlic mashed potatoes and grilled pork chop — were the ideal complement to our meal. What stood out most was the attention to detail. Everything from the bread service to the dinner was thoughtfully prepared and beautifully presented. Even the mocktails list was extensive, with great recommendations that matched our meals perfectly. The prices were fair for the quality and portion sizes. We left feeling full, satisfied, and already planning our next visit. If you’re a steak lover or simply someone who appreciates a great dining experience, this steakhouse is a must-visit. From exceptional food and service to an inviting atmosphere, it’s truly a five-star experience from start to

author: diesse dasilva
review_text: Great restaurant experience. One of my favorite places to go with the family. For starters they have the best dinner rolls by far, paired with the most delicious cinnamon sugar butter. Their complimentary peanuts are always on point. Their steaks are perfectly cooked whenever I get them, always medium-rare and paired with ribs. Their salads have always been great. If you're getting a margarita go for the extra shot.

author: Cédric Hochsticher
review_text: Friendly staff. Great Steak! I think this is the highlight of this restaurant. They have plenty of steak options, which is great. It was my first time there, but I’ll come back!

author: S S
review_text: Juan was great he was my waiter the food was decent .The steak was overcooked some what hard to chew wanted medium rare but it is what it is …

author: Terry Singh
review_text: We ordered takeout from this place. We always get the family meal. And they do a really good job. A lot of food for my family for we enjoy everything. The salads fresh, we usually get whatever. Is available usually use the chicken grilled chicken BBQ style or the chicken tenders? We haven't tried the other items yet. We're going to we're planning to they give a lot of bread-and-butter and their bread is to die for with the butter. When I go to pick up the staff is great.I really like this location

author: Jacob Barbato
review_text: Busy and lively atmosphere, kitschy decor, and fresh cut steaks. Appetizers and entrees round out offerings, full bar available. Service is quick and friendly. Affordable prices for families.

author: Jessica Mao
review_text: Delicious food with generous portions, fast service, and a great overall atmosphere！

author: Victoria Figueroa
review_text: Biggins was our server today, and I must say that his attention to our preferences and his ability to anticipate everything we needed made him an outstanding asset to this location. Since it was Mother’s Day, he remained composed, detail-oriented, and truly enhanced our experience. I was out with my mom, uncle, and grandmother, and while we don't go out often (mostly just on holidays or special occasions) we felt welcomed and never rushed. Overall, it was a wonderful experience. Bravo! A genuine personality goes a long way in service, and Biggins exemplified this. Thank you all once again. We will definitely come back on our next outing!

author: Anders
review_text: Beautiful restaurant, very friendly and helpful staff, hot delicious food and reasonable prices. Classic American chain location serving it up hot and juicy. Not a lot to like here if you’re vegetarian or looking to broaden your food horizons. The main attraction is steaks, but they have beef, pork, chicken and salmon done several ways. I really enjoyed the table buns with whipped cinnamon butter. Of particular note were the rattlesnake bites, jalapeño red pepper and jack cheese balls fried and served with ranch dressing. I had the half rack of ribs, which sadly was somewhat overcooked and parts were inedible, but was very tasty nonetheless.

author: Malena Mendez
review_text: I had such a great experience tonight! The place was full of life with a fun and welcoming atmosphere. The food was absolutely amazing everything was fresh, flavorful, and cooked perfectly. Our server, Maddi, truly made the experience even better. She was friendly, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed. Thank you, Maddi, for the wonderful service! I will definitely be coming back.

author: benjamin flores
review_text: If I could give them less than 1,000,000, I would because they played with my son's feelings, who for over a week had been asking me to take him to dinner at this damn place. I finally had the day off from work, and I'm taking my son and the rest of my family. It was a day like today, a Monday at 6:30 pm. My wife arrived, checked in, and was told that in about 20 minutes there would be a table for us. More than an hour passed and people kept arriving. The place was getting crowded, but it was full of older people, and obviously they were letting us wait. 2 hours passed. I got desperate and spoke to the person who checked me in and asked what was going on, and he clearly told me that there was still no table for me because the place was very busy with older people who did drink, or had consumed alcohol. Then I realized that the problem was that my party was less conducive to them because no one drank alcohol, and the older people who arrived for 5 to 10 people, or more, did drink, and obviously they were going to consume more than us at the end of the night. I understand that that's the business, liquor, but I hate it. They made me waste more than 2 hours sitting there watching how they served the others just because I was accompanied. From my children and my wife, I think that for those of us who are parents, they understand that it is not a family place, but rather another bar only for those who drink alcohol. A very, very, very bad experience. I spoke to the person in charge and he told me to wait for 10 more minutes, and I replied, "Are you sure?" And smiling, he said no, because if someone else who drinks alcohol eats, we'll give them the table because selling alcohol is our priority, and food is something extra. I feel very angry. Looking at my son, I said, "I think children aren't welcome here." I said, "He looks down and answers, 'Okay, Dad.'" Honestly, I'm frustrated with this place. I know very few people will understand the frustration you'll experience, but I advise you, if you're looking to get drunk, you're in the perfect place. But if you go with the family, you're not welcome. I would tell them more about my bad experience, but I'm at Chillies Chelsea, where they served me right away. Please don't go there. If you want to have a family afternoon, they only want drunks. People who only want to drink alcohol. Hurry up, do it yourself. Don't go. Don't go. Don't go.

author: Sarah Chansriharaj
review_text: Food so good and delicious! Very small place but plenty of seating but no bathrooms.

author: Benson B
review_text: Ordered delivery on their app yesterday. It took an hour and 22 minutes exactly to arrive. The shop is just a bit over half a mile away. No update in the food or delivery status regarding the delay. The food was cold, my wings were soggy and the breadsticks were an unholy brick of carbs and cheese. Called their shop and got put on hold forever only to find out they don’t know why there is such a holdup, because they depend on third party drivers. All I know is I spent 50$+ and received terrible service and goods. Might as well stock up on frozen pizza from stop and shop, the food will be way cheaper, timely, and taste about the same. (They also forgot to give me the one of the dips I paid extra for, so that was fun.)

author: Raymond Ng
