review_text: Thus pizza hut skimps on everything. My orders always have underwhelming toppings. That's really the only thing I can say that gets my fired up. If I order a pizza I just want to see a nice amount of toppings. Always under the bar. I once got the wrong order and wanted to get a refund and they always Pass you off to a manager who is never there. Tried calling the customer line and they tell you to call the store. Pizza hut just isn't for the customer anymore, and have resulted turning the one beloved restaurant to all pizza hut express that you'd find at a target.

author: Honestadie
review_text: You walk in and there's no one at the counter, just a bunch of people waiting for service while everyone talks in the back. Lady literally slammed on the counter and no one came out. Terrible service

author: Leydiperez Makeup and hairstyle
review_text: A horrible experience. I ordered through Uber Eats. The first time I waited two hours and it never arrived. Today I ordered for my son's birthday and the pepperoni arrived burnt and smelled awful—disgusting.

author: Luis Ardon
review_text: The worst delivery experience possible. It’s almost like they try to get it wrong every single time. I keep ordering because it’s conveniently close to home but they either don’t deliver and don’t communicate it to us making us waste time. Or they get the order wrong and miss items. Or they deliver the food without notice and we find it full of flies and bugs hours later. TERRIBLE service. I never write reviews but I have to at this point.

author: Gianna Freitas
review_text: foods good, but horrible service. a guy came here 3 times with the wrong order, horribly busy, barely doing orders and EATING PIZZA instead of DOING THE ORDERS??

author: Frankie Bradley
review_text: So I called in to order the new knotted pizza 🍕 and the lady told me 21.50 then after taxes 23.99. I went to order it offline and it came up to 17.11 now this lady is rude and I always have issues with her and her attitude towards me. So I hear her ask someone and they told her 19 I told her that it was 17.11 online then she asked someone again I believe in Spanish and told me they give it to me for 17. Im afraid to eat the pizza cause they special her are very petty. If I get sick 🤢🤒 y'all know who did it. I'm so hungry 😭 should I trust it? To be continued 😆

author: Leslie Perez
review_text: Do not order from here. Waited 20 minutes for my order. Cashier hid in the back for over 10 minutes. Had to assert myself just to give my name only for my pizza order to be wrong. Place was full of Uber eats drivers who apparently get priority.

author: Tony Yip
review_text: Hit and miss. I ordered two different orders from them during the Xmas week. One was done correctly and tasted so good. Another time was done so sad and very little topping and didnt have enough cheese and the crust was so thick.

author: joe rocca
review_text: What a horrible experience. I called in for an order to be picked up on my way to work. So I have something to eat. The call center sent my order elsewhere. I walk in the manager is staring at his phone Before he took a good solid minute To even acknowledge I was standing there. They had to remake my order didn't even offer a discount. The girls on the inside don't even speak english. And it took up about 25 minutes to make my order I don't see this business open for too much longer the way they run it..

author: Rob Lewis
review_text: Worst place, I ordered online 20 mins, another 15 waiting in the store, even when fully staffed still slow

author: James Tene
review_text: Jolson was very helpful and friendly so is the rest of the staff and every time I get of a stressful day from work or school I always leave with a smile on my face. Sometimes even if this place is packed I can always count on getting my food before my 15 minute break ends. Every time I enter I am in awe seeing how clean the floors are. I recommend this place 110%

author: Tameika Rosario
review_text: 8/22/24 Order 2 pizzas & a pasta through the app. App said my food would be delivered by 5:57pm. By 6pm, I decided to call the store. A lady picked up, then put me on hold for over 5 minutes, & never returned. As me & my daughter sat outside waiting another 15 minutes, I decided to call the store again. That’s when XAVIER answered the phone. I stated my issue, & he told me he couldn’t understand me. I said okay, and proceeded to slow my speech & speak again, only to not be given the chance becuz HE HUNG UP THE PHONE ON ME! Now let me state that I am literally LESS THAN 5 minutes from this location, had my husband NOT calmed me down, Xavier & I would’ve met in person!! Horrible customer service, & Xavier better hope he doesn’t see me becuz I WILL REMEMBER THIS! I work in retail, & this is unacceptable to me

author: Jeremy LeBlanc (Jeremy)
review_text: I haven't had Pizza Hut in a long time it's got to be better than Little Caesars because that was so horrible the final results was a really big let down , especially because of the tremendously delicious advertising, ughh absolute falsely faked by the ads and it upsets me tremendously, trash that was a robbery at 7:11 211 which is robbery in progress and is no better than a 7-Eleven Pizza you can't get with food stamp!! SMH

author: Jonathan Diaz
review_text: They take too long for the order to be ready bad customer services, don't come here unless your willing to spend an extra 40min wait go to another pizza hut please

author: Daniela Gutierrez
review_text: I’ve been waiting for 15 minutes for someone to come out. I tried to say hello and I even shouted a little but no one listened to me, they were in the back talking entertainingly, until the phone rang and it was my savior. Otherwise I would have waited half an hour or more.

author: Lee Leblanc
review_text: Snotty workers and people who care about nothing but there money they didn't want to make a medium stuffed crust they told me it was only large pizza nobody spoke English in America employee did not make me feel welcome and gave me the stiff upper lip face because I didn't want a large but at least the food was served hot if that counts for anything

author: Shahil Patel
review_text: I love this Pizza Hut, the service, wait time and quality of the pizza is excellent. Specifically while I was there, the manager Vianna and Lilian were very kind and made the experience of visiting here great.

author: Asia Edwards
review_text: The food is great. I love their lemon pepper wings. If you like Wing Stop, then please give them a try. Their cheese sticks are so delicious. 😋

author: Hayden Leung
review_text: Your typical Chinese-American buffet. The typical price for lunch is around $13, but I visited on Indigineous People’s Day where the all day price was $18. Interiors & Atmosphere: - I was seated away from the food area. This section had a slight antique, musty odor. The inside is rather old and could benefit from some modernization. Food: - Selection is pretty typical with a variety of meats, fried foods, seafood, and stir-fry’s. Sushi did not seem very fresh. Overall, I’d say this place is worth it for the price and when you just need to get your fix of Chinese-American buffet food.

author: Justin C
review_text: It’s your basic Chinese buffet place, but the hibachi grill guy was pretty good at making my fried rice. All you can eat so no complaining, and decent selection of food. I left with a full stomach.

author: Yong Zhou
review_text: We usually come here when we're nearby shopping for groceries. It's usually not crowded before 2 p.m. on Sundays. There's a wide selection of crayfish, seafood, crab, duck, pork, chicken, sushi, hibachi, fruit, and more, so if you're hungry, you'll likely be able to fill up easily. The food is just okay. Don't expect the same quality and taste as you'd get at a specialty restaurant. However, considering the price we paid, I think it's well worth it.

author: J P
review_text: This place is definitely not worth going out of your way for. The selection was not very good. There were only 10 Chinese-American options in the buffet, the rest were things like chicken nuggets, desserts, salad, pizza. The food we tried wasn't great... It was edible. It didn't taste like it had gone rotten or rancid. Most items were hot enough in the steam tables. Nothing to write home about. The dining room looked fairly clean and I didn't stick to the table, which surprised me. At the end of dinner, I looked up, and you can see from the picture that they don't clean their ceiling vents or filters, so all that crud is falling and blowing into the food and onto your plates. I walked into the bathroom. It was gross. This bathroom hasn't been cleaned for more than a day. It was filthy everywhere. I hardly ever say bad stuff about a restaurant. I will never go back to this one because it was gross and I can't imagine how it passed health inspection, and the food wasn't great. Great prices, but not worth it

author: Grace Charmenita
review_text: First of all, food not taste so good,but have a lot of option. Second , sushi rice taste weird and I found a Little Rocks inside from couple of sushi. Third, the Salmon they’re cut so thin and small,doesn’t have a couple option for sushi and doesn’t have sashimi(even the price $15/person) I’m from New York,I know the price is reasonable for buffet here,but I know you still can upgrade it,that’s why you guys have 2 location now. Fourd,all the server speak so loudly to each other and laughing so loud ,it’s not polite when you’re working like that, it’s not beside each other but the gap so far and they’re talking to each other like have no customers,that’s not good SOP. Fifth,server was rude! I’m coming with my husband for my birthday, they put me in small booth seat for 2 people, I mean we’re big person even not so fat but we can’t sit there because our winter coat also so big,we need space to put it so we can sit more comfortable and enjoy the food. First time eating we want to ask the server but they didn’t ask us how’s everything, until we move by ourself and one of server from far away ask like why you want move to other tables(which is that time not busy and not full table around us ,maybe 1 section side just have us and 1 family of 3 , that’s it) and then my husband just said because we need to put our winter coat we don’t have space. And then she ask,how many of you, we said just 2 people. And then I think either the manager or the lady owner said it’s okay, so just it’s okay,why need ask so many times? I mean even we just 2 people’s why we can’t move to the other tables? Next time you need to see if even just 2 people if they’re bringing a lot of stuff or have a big winter coat,just give them booth seat with 4 people not just for 2 peoples. I know maybe there have server who got section side for them to paid their salary but it’s not how to service the guest especially when you’re in buffet which is need more higher service not just let the customers pick and eat and go home,it’s not to go shop. I hope you guys upgrade it everything, but for now I will not recommended this place for buffet, I will see you guys later and I will try to edit this review if you guys done upgrading this.

author: Mark Altreuter
review_text: All-you-can-eat is amazing. So much variety and no time or plate limits. I highly recommend the Hibachi station. If you want to get your money's worth, just throw a bunch of steak on the grill. I had hibachi steak with some teriyaki sauce and it was delicious. Desserts were ample and the cheesecake to die for. Sushi was okay. The rice seemed thick/dense. *Note: I went on a Sunday afternoon and had the Sunday all-day buffet.

author: Farz Tex
review_text: The food was just okay below. Good quality. The service was super friendly and the restaurant was okay clean but the bathrooms were really bad And the sushi was not fresh at all but the rest of the food was just okay. The staff were super welcoming and very professional.

author: Michael Pay
review_text: This place was very clean, had a good selection of seafoods, sushi, hibachi grill, and they had a ton of varieties of ice creams. Their dessert chocolate cake was very good as well! We were comparing the buffet with a restaurant downtown and the quality of food and taste weren't that far apart and the whole buffet was the price of a single dish! Would definitely come back again, the only problem is we end up eating way too much food! 🤣😭🤣

author: Lisa Xiaremba
review_text: I’ve wanted to try this place for a while since it’s in the plaza with 99 Asian Supermarket - I have to say I was pleasantly surprised! The seafood and dinner buffet are the way to go here, surprisingly fresh and tender black pepper crab, and they have a more Cajun-y seafood tray for the dinner buffet as well with some really juicy shrimp. Lunch buffet I’m not sure is worth it compared to other Chinese buffets. Also don’t get the sashimi on the sushi station, it tastes a little like death. But the sushi is okay. Also, can we talk about the stir fried cabbage. That was surprisingly flavorful…

author: BR AL
review_text: I went to this buffet last night with my girlfriend, and the place was completely packed. The first thing we noticed at the entrance was the strong smell of detergent and the amount of cleaning chemicals sitting out in the open, which already felt unusual. When we sat down and went to get food, most of the plates and serving areas looked messy and not properly cleaned. The utensils used to grab the food weren’t actually dirty, but it looked like leftover food from previous customers was still stuck on them. It didn’t seem like they were being replaced or wiped down regularly. I went back to the table and saw that my girlfriend had filled her plate but looked extremely uncomfortable because of the place not being clean. At that point, I told the waitress that we wanted to leave. She noticed we had only been there for about five minutes and asked if we didn’t like the food, and I confirmed. Despite leaving immediately and not eating anything, they still charged us the full amount. She even pointed to the tip line on the receipt to make sure I didn’t forget to add a tip, which felt inappropriate given the circumstances.

author: Sherman Hanke
review_text: Helpful staff, accommodating sushi chef. Even right at opening, much of my food was lukewarm tho. They seem capable of doing much better than what I saw. I'll try again and update!

author: PH Chan
review_text: I visited here for dinner early on a Thursday evening. Asian buffets are my guilty pleasure. Please don’t tell my Chinese mom ; ) Maybe I caught them on an off night, but it was disappointing. The good: large selection of Asian entrees and some not-so-Asian offerings too (including cheese pizza, mac & cheese, and tater tots). The roasted meats were solid. Duck was surprisingly good. BBQ chicken and pork ribs were also solid. Sushi was good too. Mostly assorted rolls, but everything was well prepared. The other seafood dishes were also tasty. They were fresh and nicely sauced. Desserts were cafeteria quality, but there was a big selection of ice cream bars and cups in a freezer nearby. I didn’t try the hibachi, but it looked good too. Server was friendly and efficient. The not-so-good: pretty much all of the fried foods were limp or soggy, including the fried shrimp dishes, Gen’l Tso’s chicken, calamari, potstickers, eggrolls, etc. I think this could have been because it wasn’t too busy when I was there, and they were bringing out lots of food. So a lot of the food was sitting on the steam trays for long enough to loose its crunch. But that also meant that the food on the top of the piles got kind of cold. So my recommendation would be to either visit when they’re really busy and replacing the food quickly or get a seat where you can see when they bring out the refills and make your choices accordingly.

author: Jaime Smith
review_text: I just tried this place for the first time not long ago. It was pretty good. The buffet is a pretty decent size which means the variety of food they have is good. I enjoyed it & the price is great!

author: William Tun
review_text: For the price this is a best buffet in the state of mass. Even better than other flaming grills. The staff there is wonderful. Amy is a great server like always. Thanks again guys will definitely come often!

author: Shu Ou
review_text: Friendly helpful staff and hot good food. Check out the hibachi at the farthest point from the door!

author: Almighty LO
review_text: I not only lost my appetite but I became nauseous within minutes and then I took a uber to the hospital. Nothing was fresh, food was reheated and lukewarm. I honestly don’t understand how this place is still in business. I didn’t finish my food I paid but then I was harassed to leave a tip

author: Dante Gell
review_text: Flaming Grill Buffet has a good variety of food, but the best part is the service, especially from the manager. She's super attentive and makes sure everyone's having a good experience. The food is what you'd expect from a buffet – lots of options and a good value. Definitely worth a try if you're looking for a casual meal with friendly service!

author: Paabii “Aayusna” Atokved
review_text: Perfect place to stop if you are seafood lover. There wide varieties of grill and fried dishes with dessert makes it worth it. There hibachi is my absolute favorite all the time.

author: Josh
review_text: The food is really good here. And there is SO much of it! The variety is good. And the quality is good. The staff are efficient, but not overly friendly nor obtrusive. It is also VERY reasonably priced.

author: Yusuf Nasrullah
review_text: Fantastic place actually! Nice hot food with great crabmeat, fried shrimp, beef with scallions, hot and sour soup and fried rice. Very nice desserts and fresh fruits for dessert. Good price for a lot of food, comfortable air conditioning and hanging out with a group of hungry friends!

author: Alexandra
review_text: The food is really good. The burger patty is soft and juicy, honestly one of the best burgers I’ve ever had. Highly recommended! The only thing I’d suggest is getting it to go since the place is a bit small.

author: Joslyn Deschenes
review_text: Great date spot- cute bar set up setting looking outside. I tried the buffalo chicken fries and the I’m Crazy for Cookies shake, and both were amazing! The fries were loaded with tender chicken, just the right amount of heat, and plenty of flavor. The shake was rich, creamy, and packed with cookie goodness—basically dessert heaven in a cup. Friendly service and a fun vibe made the visit even better.

author: Cody Belanger
review_text: We tried the Ice Cream Chicken Sundae Sandwich, the Sweet & Spicy Fries, and the Hot Mess & Cheese Express, every single item was a 5/5! I was especially excited (and curious) about the ice cream sandwich, while my wife was a little hesitant, but even she loved it! The food was incredible. Just make sure you show up hungry, you’ll want to try everything!

author: Abigail Thompson
review_text: Went in about 20 minutes after open. Got water, bottle was so dirty, and there was floaters. Server never can to take our drink order, so we order food and drinks at one. Chicken tenders was fine, not bad. I got merica burger, medium. It was raw, like mushy raw. Server never came to ask how food was. I had to go up to the bar to ask for our check. Would not recommend and will not go back.

author: Nephileen Kattel
review_text: When I walked in I was hit by a very unpleasant smell of feet/sweat. I was thinking maybe it was the bathroom or something, but idk it just smelled bad. Then the food came out, and the chicken sandwiches were nothing like it showed in the images!! They weren’t crispy and it was really below average. The fries were great though….

author: Cassandra Montes
review_text: The food was amazing. I had the Hot Mess & Cheese. Best burger I have ever had. The prices are also amazing for the amount of food.

author: david we
review_text: I ordered the Merica smash burger with the better than ketchup. The smash burger itself was very tasty but for me the bun kinda brought it down a bit. It would be nice to have a brioche bun or something softer than these harder sesame seed rolls. Cheese fries tasted good too thanks to the cheese but the French fry itself was nothing special.

author: Heather Pontius
review_text: Amazing food. Little bit of a weird seating area but its meant for take out. Excellent burger.

author: Ivna Aragao
review_text: They have a greta combination of ingredients, but the burger was a bit rare and falling apart. I haven't quite summed up the "want" to go back, despite how good the food looks. Also, avoid parking at the gyms parking lot, next to their place.

author: Minor
review_text: As a first-time customer, I can confidently say Crazy Good Kitchen lives up to its name. From the moment I received my food, it was clear that care and attention went into both preparation and presentation. The flavors were bold, well-balanced, and genuinely satisfying—nothing tasted rushed or generic. Will definitely be going back often.

author: arpita
review_text: Quaint place to eat in Boston. I'm from Texas and don't get opportunity to eat outside. This was perfect time to do people watching while eating good food. My son is picky and he finished his plate. Reasonably priced.

author: Apex Imagery
review_text: Crazy Good Kitchen lives up to its name! Their bacon double cheeseburgers are packed with flavor, the Parmesan truffle fries are absolutely incredible, and their milkshakes are the perfect sweet treat to top it all off. Highly recommend for an unforgettable meal!

author: Rachel Iacomini
review_text: I want to start by saying I’ve had burgers and truffle fries here before and they were solid but today’s meal was not great at all and I’m super disappointed. I ordered online directly from the website and went to pick up right away. Was there within 10 minutes and it was already ready….red flag! I got home about 7 minutes later and the food was so cold, it just didn’t feel fresh at all. I got the 3 piece buffalo tenders and truffle fries and first of all these are in WAY too small of a container. Separate the fries and chicken please. 🙏 The chicken tenders were super odd….never seen anything like them and honestly I didn’t eat them at all. They really ruined my appetite. They were HUGE pieces of chicken tenderloin that were poorly breaded, and not crispy at all. All the breading (which was minimal) was soggy and falling off. Partially due to it not seeming fresh or recently fried and then partially from being in a super cramped container with no air vents. This time the fries seemed different as well…like frozen ones when I swore they used to seem fresh and I thought they used to have rosemary but I might be wrong. Not sure if management changed or the quality is just going down hill but I’m not sure I’ll be back.

author: Sierra Harken
review_text: The shakes are insanely good! The burgers and fries are also great. This is truly a staple so make sure to come hungry. We found there’s good availability for seating if you go in person, but typically get this as takeaway.

author: Dr.Foodie
review_text: A solid place for good burgers and chicken sandwich. Haven't tried the shakes yet. It's outdoor dining on a patio area with a nice cool breeze. The steak and cheese fries were delicious and I do recommend. The only thing I can't wrap around is the price as it is more than 14 dollars for a chicken sandwich/burger.

author: Sergio Solis Checa
review_text: Burgers are good and very similar to the pictures, but dining in ia definitely not a good choice. There are like bar seats for roughly 15 people, and we did that because we don't live that close. However, it's not comfortable, not enough room, temperature and wind were bad. I could definitely have the burger again, but at home

author: Chris Ayers
review_text: Exceptional burgers & fried chicken sandwiches at this small stand. Eat your lunch and watch the happenings on Eastern Ave.

author: Shu Ou
review_text: Fantastic burgers. Mango shake is very thick: might need a spoon!

author: Kathleen Sullivan
review_text: Picked up a shake for my husband. Service was excellent. The pickup area and stairs could use some sprucing up. That may be on the “to-do” list in the spring.

author: Peter Sujanani
review_text: Tired the Hot Mess & Cheese Burger. It had me licking my fingers and was cooked to perfection, a juicy dripping messy burger, aptly named, just the way I like it. Also got the But Make It Spicy Chicken sandwich. It was a top quality breaded chicken breast with the right amount of heat complimented with the perfect crunch of the slaw. The buffalo tenders were top notch as their quality chicken and Buffalo sauce was one of the best we've had with an awesome balance of heat and tangy flavor. Such Yummy Deliciousness made for a memorable meal.

author: ariel M
review_text: We made a reservation for New Year's Eve for the 5 of us but the restaurant is huge so we probably didn't even need one. The parking lot was very full but we managed to find a spot. We started wit the nachos and added pork and Guacamole. They were delicious and the chips themselves are seasoned and spicy! For an entree, I had the braised short rib and the blue cheese mashed potatoes were fantastic. The rest of the family had the burger deluxe, OG classic pizza, and hot bird sandwich. For dessert, the kids had sundaes and my boyfriend and I split the apple pie cheesecake and it was good. If we are ever in the area again, we would definitely go back. The bar area was huge and looked like a good place to watch sports as well. We were seated in quieter area off to the side (which was great for us!) and they gave us a sling for our baby car seat. Our server was excellent and everyone we came into contact with was very friendly and nice. The drink lady seemed quite extensive but we didn't order off it. They have a kids menu but my kids ordered off the main menu. Our total bill before tip was $144.

author: Larry Morton
review_text: First time here loved it. Food was great. I had a chance to set up the way back bar before my girlfriend and family came. Then we moved up to the front for dinner. There’s multiple places you can enjoy a good meal or drinks with friends. I highly recommend it during the Woburn area or anywhere close to it to stop in. This was Christmas time which made an extra special. God bless all of you and come down to Sam Walker’s American tavern for a great night feel like to see the full video. Go to life with Larry on YouTube.

author: Joshua Einhorn
review_text: We have been waiting for this grand opening for a while... To say the least it was worth the wait! Noting we went on a Sunday evening with the family so it was a bit busier, but that did not affect service whatsoever. For a place that's been open for only two weeks now they seem to be running smoothly. I had the Walker Burger Royale. It was pretty amazing! Hit the spot. Great portion sizes all around the table. Loved the idea of the "cocktail for a cause" libations. The Late Check-out is something I would definitely get again! Usually go for a beer but this was a pretty solid choice. Great options for kids too. Have a feeling this spot is going to fit right in to the Vinnin Square scene... and fills a void of a gathering spot for locals that the area has needed for some time as an alternative to the growing options on Humphrey St and Downtown Marblehead. Would come back again... and again! Still cannot believe the transformation this place did as you would've never expected this with the way it was set up before.

author: Chris Duffy
review_text: We went to Sam’s for breakfast today. Our server Caroline was amazing. The staff was friendly. The El Jefe Burrito was top 3 breakfast sandwiches I’ve ever had! We’ll back next time we’re in town

author: Marc Cooper
review_text: Great breakfast joint!!! Ainsley was an awesome server. I highly recommend the, "In Yo' Face Breakfast Sammie Sandwich!" Soooo good. It's fried eggs, bacon, American cheese, advocado, with a spicy aioli sauce on a soft brioche bun. 😋 oh yeah, the advocado toast with corn and tomatoes is ridiculously 🔥 as well. Yes, I read a lot of reviews in order to find this gem.

author: Jennieanne Steinman
review_text: I visited this place with my husband and 17 year old son a few days ago for brunch. We were quickly sat and really liked the comfortable vibe. The menu had plenty to choose from. When the food came, my husband and son's were fine but they brought me the wrong food. The waitress took it away and said she'd have the correct food brought over. Unfortunately, when my meal finally arrived, my son and husband were done eating so that was kind of a bummer but they didnt mind waiting for me to eat. The chicken in my sandwich was so dry and tough that it was inedible. I ate some of the bread because I was honestly so hungry at that point. The waitress asked if I wanted a box and I let her know that I didnt eat it because it was tough and dry. She just quickly said "sorry about that" and quickly brought us our bill. I was honestly bummed to pay $17 for an inedible sandwich that I got at the end of our visit with barely an acknowledgement at all about it. That being said, my son's pancakes were awesome and the portion was huge. My husband's chicken and waffles was great.

author: Joseph Meoli
review_text: Greeted , nicely and professional and were seated in the bar area .. a little loud to our liking for brunch .. but very clean … Our waitress Erin was very nice and introduced herself .. took drink order and gave us time to order very professional and helpful with explaining any questions.. superb service… waited a little long for food ,, but was definitely worth waiting for our country Benedict , and Breakfast egg rolls.. food was delicious.. recommend both ! And ask for ERIN O .. for waitress she was just superb .. Bon appetite

author: Juliana
review_text: Very very good tavern food!! Highly recommend this place they a lot of good apps and different dinner choices to choose from. I recommend the buffalo chicken dip for an app and for your meal you can’t go wrong with anything! The steak frites were incredible with the sauce !!!! And the burger so juicy and flavorful this place is bomb can’t wait to come back!!

author: Chuck Paone
review_text: Nice place for a quick meal, drink or a long hang with friends and family. Easy to locate right off of Rte 93 with wonderful rustic atmosphere. Attended as part of a large holiday party. The food was great, appetizers were a big hit with the Italian egg rolls the stars. Large party orders can be a challenge for one server, but ours was professional, patient and perfect with the delivery. The only reason there is not a 5 star review for the restaurant and service is the head of house at the door was maybe having a bad day, but wow not exactly a warm greeting or helpful when we arrived and asked about our reservation. Hopefully she has a better day next time.

author: Pamela Barron
review_text: A-mazing food taste and presentation! A delight for the senses. Atmosphere has a cozy, but busy bar vibe.

author: Kayla MacDonald
review_text: Sam Walker’s has been our go-to spot ever since it opened in Woburn, and it just keeps getting better! It’s the perfect neighborhood place, whether you’re meeting friends, grabbing a casual dinner, or riding out a New England snowstorm. The food is fantastic across the board, but the nachos and the brisket mac and cheese are absolute standouts! The bar selection is always great too, with fun local options and seasonal picks. The atmosphere is welcoming, the service is friendly, and the whole place has that “local favorite” feel that keeps you coming back. Sam Walker’s is truly one of my favorite spots in the area, and I’m always happy to shout out one of my favorite Toast customers. Highly recommend checking it out! *This review was made in connection with a Toast promotion.

author: John Van Note
review_text: Traveling solo from Missouri had great experience with staff(Bridgette), Had chicken Parmesan It’s a simple dish, but done very well here. This Midwest boy enjoyed the place. I was not prepared for the strength of drinks, but I loved it.

author: Jake Flynn
review_text: Ahhhhh Sam Walker’s…not to tout myself but we go to Bowery and Chubbs more often than I’d like to admit. And trust me I get a chub for Chubbs. Both are sister restaurants and in the same restaurant group as Sam Walker’s, evident by the identical menu font…FINE. Sam walkers offers similar fare but more of a combination of all the offerings at Lucy’s, Chubbs and Bowery. Great beer selection friendly staff and good food. However…….. It’s almost like you get the selection of all three restaurants, the nachos from Chubbs, the Italian egg rolls from Lucy’s and the pasta from Bowery but somehow it just doesn’t hit the same level, just being honest. Maybe because they are trying to do all three. Overall it is good though and is a great value. Espresso martini didn’t skip a beat from the sister restaurants, identical, delicious and large like Jack G’s peepeee. Overall I think they could try to do less with the menu and offer some more uniqueness/originality for the benefit of quality over quantity. This is my constructive criticism though if they ever ready this. I would come back.

author: Kathy Troxell
review_text: We are traveling from Oklahoma and staying at the BW Plus, directly behind the restaurant. We decided to walk to dinner and hadn't been to a Walkers. Hopefully it won't be our last! Jessie was a great waitress!! Highly recommend.

author: All Year Inc
review_text: We had such a great experience at Sam Walker’s on a Saturday evening! The place was super busy and they put us on a waiting list with 30 min estimate time, but ended up calling us in 15 min. The atmosphere, food and service were amazing! Unfortunately my wife forgot her purse and we realised that next morning, we called the place and we were told that they found it, that was such a relief since she had everything in there, documents, credit cards and cash! Thank you guys for being so kind and honest! Definitely coming back for another lunch or dinner and we recommend the place to our friends and relatives. By the way the espresso martinis are the best there🍸

author: Paul Craven Craven
review_text: What a fabulous brunch experience and the staff was absolutely amazing especially Caitlyn as she had so much going on and was so friendly and sense of urgency was absolutely 💯 above and beyond and the food was great and so that means we will def be coming back and thank you for a great breakfast brunch experience as it was my daughters birthday !!!

author: Jenn D
review_text: The reviews are very overrated for this place. We got steak tips, which only had 6 pieces for over $30 and chicken parm with was completely burnt on the bottom and dried out. The waitress was nice enough but barely checked in on us. I would not go there again

author: Nikita
review_text: Came here to celebrate, and were amazed with the food and service!! Our waiter was very friendly, and fast. I demolished that chicken burger in 20 seconds flat, and everyone at the table loved their meals. Loved our lunch, thank you!

author: Grogu
review_text: Food was good. Serve attentive. Bathrooms clean. There was lots of free parking but the noise level im the restaurant was extremely loud. It is impossible to hold any sort of conversation. I would not recommend it for a date night or a place to go if you want to talk to each other.

author: Tameka Osborne
review_text: Great place for a high end sports bar and food experience! Great drinks and food at a reasonable price.

author: Tee Elle See
review_text: This restaurant is the nicest I've been to, and also extremely clean. The food was delicious, our server, Emily, was wonderful. The posters on the wall, were fun to see. We can't wait to visit again, when we are in town!!

author: Andrew Hudson
review_text: First time eating at Wahlburgers. It was all around great! The hamburgers had a great ratio of meat, veggies, and bun. The brioche bun was a nice touch. Bryce our server was very friendly to everyone who walked in the door and sat close to the bar. The fries and tots were cooked and seasoned well.

author: RVSSO
review_text: Phenomenal juicy burguer, medium rare is the way to go. Amazing service by Katie a local who has an amazing energy and overall service qualities. Great music, clean bathroom, amazing spot.

author: Maricela Herrera
review_text: I'm from Texas and have been a fan. Ever since watching the show I had always wanted to come to a Whalbugers. Finally had the chance and let me tell you, it did not disappoint especiallythe fried pickles, best by far. Great service, food and prices. 10/10 wishing I had been able to see one of the brothers bit the manager made up for it with his great attitude/service. Will make another trip just for another wonderful experience.

author: joseph allocca
review_text: Went to dinner on Friday 01/02/2026 at the Hingham Shipyard location. Three of us got burgers which were very good however my sister got a chicken sandwich and the center of it was still pink. Under cooked chicken can make you very sick. They did take it off the bill but that is not acceptable for any restaurant.

author: Davi Santos
review_text: I recently had the pleasure of visiting Wahlburgers and indulging in a selection of their mouthwatering burgers. From the first glance, it was clear that these burgers were crafted with care and an eye for delicious detail. Classic Cheeseburger The classic cheeseburger was a sight to behold, with its perfectly melted cheese draped over a juicy beef patty. The fresh lettuce and thick slice of onion added a crisp texture that complemented the richness of the beef. Each bite was a delightful blend of savory meat, creamy cheese, and refreshing vegetables. It's the kind of burger that reminds you why you love burgers in the first place. The Super Melt Next up was the grilled cheese burger, which took a creative twist on the traditional burger. Sandwiched between two slices of golden, buttery toast, the patty was packed with flavor and paired perfectly with the melted cheese and caramelized onions. This burger managed to capture the essence of comfort food, delivering a nostalgic yet innovative experience. Double Decker For those who crave a bit more, the double cheeseburger did not disappoint. Stacked with two beef patties and layers of gooey cheese, this burger was a feast for both the eyes and the stomach. The combination of the well-seasoned beef and the creamy cheese was simply irresistible, making it a top choice for anyone with a hearty appetite. Crispy Chicken Sandwich Lastly, the crispy chicken sandwich offered a delightful alternative for non-beef lovers. The chicken was fried to perfection, boasting a crunchy exterior that gave way to tender, juicy meat inside. Paired with fresh lettuce and a slice of tomato, this sandwich was both satisfying and refreshing. Overall, Wahlburgers delivered an exceptional burger experience. Each item was carefully crafted, balancing flavors and textures to create a truly memorable meal. Whether you're a fan of the classics or looking to try something new, Wahlburgers has something to offer for every burger enthusiast.

author: Janet Stiles
review_text: We always enjoy our trip to Wahlburgers. The food, service, and atmosphere were perfect. The food was cooked perfectly, and I loved the truffle fries. Our waitress was very good and attentive. The atmosphere is cozy and very clean.

author: David Hernandez
review_text: Checked off one of the bucket list places I’ve wanted to eat today. Food was fresh and delicious.

author: Jana Batista
review_text: The burgers are delicious. Well stuffed and varied. Very well served and really worth it. The milkshakes are very good too. Only the service is sometimes not so good. The staff seem forgetful and take a while, but they do serve you well! It's a nice place to go with the family.

author: Eric Zago
review_text: The Parmesan Truffle Tots were amazing. Loved the burger, too! We got there at 4:30 on a Wednesday, and were the only customers there. But, our server was fantastically attentive, and it was great meal after a great day. Wish there were locations in the Worcester or Milford areas!

author: Ami Lanning
review_text: One of the best burgers I’ve ever had. Great truffle fries and fried pickles, too. My parents had the chicken sandwich and the meatball sub, and they said everything was delicious. Great, fast and friendly service. Hey Wahlburgers, open some locations in PA, please!!

author: Kristie R
review_text: Excellent service, food & atmosphere. Our waitress Kirsten (hope I spelled that right) was friendly, and our food came out pretty quickly. Everything tasted fresh and was cooked perfectly. We've been to other Wahlburgers locations in other states, but the surrounding area of this one is the most beautiful we've seen so far. Took a quick walk across the street to look over the water for a little bit and relax. Free street parking was easy, but there is a parking lot also.

author: Stacy
review_text: I was at the Hingham Wahlburgers last Thursday. Jill was our server and she was AMAZING!! Very friendly and patient. I was there with my 80 yr old mom - who can be pretty picky about what she eats. She loved the ‘Our Burger’ in a bowl - absolutely perfect choice for her and easy to eat. Everything was delicious!! 💚

author: Karla Cortez
review_text: We visited on a trip from Texas, right before Thanksgiving. I was not disappointed. Walking in, the store was clean and welcoming. The staff was friendly and right away started conversations. They gave us the locals recommended places we should see and visit on our trip. It was really nice. The food was fresh and delicious. There's nothing like a good, juicy burger with crispy bacon! The chicken burger was good, too. We also had the fried pickles! Delish!! I personally loved the tots, but my family's favorite was definitely the onion rings! We would definitely visit again!

author: Chris Parent
review_text: None of the Wahlberg brothers were there this time either... Lol! I have to ask each time I go. The food is amazing every time and staff is very patient with everyone that has the same kind of questions. Hahaha! They also sell many different kinds of franchise stuff, including shirts, hats and accessories. They have now opened different ones up all over in and out of the Country, so check em out and see what You 🤔.

author: Michael Keller
review_text: Best service in the history of food service! Food tasted like it was crafted in high heaven, and our waiter said his name was "Bryce" but we shall forever refer to him as, "JOHN WAITER" If you're ever in Boston, it should be an obligation to place this on your to-do list

author: Kelly Aieta
review_text: We enjoy the take out options and app is very user friendly. Kids love smahlburger and adults are team bbq burger. Fries are fresh. Truffle fries are a nice addition. Sweet potato tots are also tasty. Mexican Cola also delicious.

author: william gross
review_text: In the beginning it started out shakey the hostess didnt seat us and the bar tender was yelling across the room to her she turns around and says why cant you seat them the food and drinks were great and the waiter was attentive. Kinda pricey for the drinks but food was very reasonable. Overall would go again.

author: Carol Leonard
review_text: We dined in. Service was fantastic. Crispy fish sandwich was dark brown, hard and dry, disappointed. Burger was ok. Fries and shake were great !

author: S B.S.S.
review_text: **6years later I have to change my review ** staff have no clue on anything! Starting with the old way when you walk in and order your food sit and eat was the easiest and faster way, they changed that to a way when no one knows how things works! Order they were unable to give me my receipt with my order on it so I have no clue what they charge me for, wait and wait then went to ask the host if they will call my name or I have to wait or what? She was not able to comprehend what I was asking while I figure out my order was behind her waiting for her to let me know my order was ready…while I was there literally 3 people was complaining about the same issue smh…to make things better while I was waiting I saw a mice running around from the bar to the kitchen I understand in a way but they could do better! The burger honestly was still delicious as 6 years ago! However the fried pickles were pretty greasy! Very disappointed and this was my last trip to here unfortunately not coming back! Staff not friendly at all!!! ** 6 years ago review Delicious burgers indeed!!Super friendly workers, fast and delicious burgers!Will be back for sure!**

author: Paul Anderson
review_text: The restaurant inside and outside is beautiful. The food is absolutely delicious. I knocked one star off of atmosphere purely because I personally am not a fan of live music. There was live music playing outside, and in my humble opinion it was too loud. Thankfully, they eventually took a break and I was able to eat my dinner in peace. - I would definitely go back but I would sit indoors. My wife had one alcoholic beverage. I didn’t. He had two seafood dinners. The check came to a little over $130.

author: Todd Curtiss
review_text: Waterfront dinning with a spectacular view and food that rivals anything upscale restaurant in the major New England area. The staff were extremely friendly and helpful. Live music and drinks were excellent. Live music was the cherry on top of the cake. I highly recommend this place if you’re in town or simply just driving through it is definitely a destination stop.

author: Jea Kim
review_text: Amazing views, & vibes and solid seafood dishes. Came here with my colleagues for an early dinner on a weekday. The restaurant was in a secluded pier with all the boats and storage yards, so compared to other bay area restaurants I’ve been to in the area, it felt more private. The patio got eventually packed by the time we were about to leave, but we were able to snag a table right away. We started off with some oysters, shrimps, and sautéed mussels. To be honest, the oysters and the shrimps were disappointing. The oysters lacked brininess, and overall it was just too mild. The jumbo shrimp looked great, but they were slightly overcooked and came out a tad rubbery. The mussels were satisfying and the white sauce was on point. For the entrées, we opted for the scallops, swordfish, and the blackened chicken pasta. My colleague said the scallops were his favorite, and it was the most solid dish of the three. The rice grains were perfectly al dente, and I liked how they used the claw meats instead of the tail to amplify that natural lobster flavors. They also cut it in long chunks which helped accentuate its texture. Some of the scallop pieces weren’t exactly the freshest, but a solid dish overall. For entrées we had the scallops, swordfish, and blackened chicken pasta. My colleague was all about the scallops, and I’d say they were the best of the three. The rice had a good al dente bite, and I liked that they used claw meat instead of tail as it gave the lobster flavor a little more depth. Cutting it into long chunks made the texture pop too. Not every scallop tasted super fresh, but overall it was a pretty satisfying plate. The swordfish was probably the thickest I’ve ever seen served as a steak, and even with the crisped edges it stayed fairly moist. Swordfish is usually kind of boring to me, but the crunchy bits in each bite kept it more interesting. Small tip: swap the fingerling potatoes for risotto—the extra moisture makes a big difference. As for the blackened chicken pasta, it had a pleasant kick, but otherwise was pretty standard. Would come back to soak in the vibes and enjoy the waterfront setting. Food’s on par with some of the good seafood places I’ve been around Boston, but not the best in the area.

author: Jaclyn D
review_text: Stopped in for drinks and apps and everything was great! The lobster avocado was so unique and a great combo! The sticky ribs were AMAZING and the clam chowder I look forward to having again. Overall a great place with a bright, fresh ambiance.

author: Chris Ianiri
review_text: This restaurant offers nice water views and outdoor seating. The staff is very friendly and accommodating. The food was phenomenal! I highly recommend the blue crab ravioli meal… One of the best seafood dishes I’ve had in a long time! Definitely check this place out!

author: Maria Felina
review_text: First time at this restaurant with my family. Plenty of parking but they are busy! Originally they told us one hour wait but ended up being 15 mins. Food was delicious and it came out quick. The kids menu had plenty to pick from but is pricy at $15. Comes with drink and ice cream. My salad was okay. Nothing fancy but the chowder was delicious. NOTICE: There is a admin fee when dining here. Our waitress said it is due to inflation and it’s per item. Receipt included.

author: Sam kassis
review_text: The food was perfect we were party of four every we was happy with there food nothing to complain about, the day was raining and we sat inside but they do have nice deck i am sure the deck is beautiful on a nice sunny day

author: Maureen Ryan-Hoffman
review_text: I'm so glad I picked this restaurant. The stuffed lobster is the BEST we've had in about 30 years. The quality, preparation (all cleaned out, meat removed from claws, mixed in the stuffing...). Our Server, Eddie, was smiley, friendly, wanted to take good care of his customers, which he did with great ease. Beautiful, relaxing atmosphere. Very comfortable. It was a nice experience and meal to remember. Thank you .

author: Lorena Gomes Rocha
review_text: Fantastic Waterfront Dining Experience I had an amazing time at this waterfront restaurant! The food was absolutely delicious, and the service was top-notch—friendly and attentive. The atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming, perfect for a summer outing by the water. I especially loved the fish tank—it adds such a fun and unique touch to the dining space. Highly recommend for anyone looking for great food with a view!

author: Amanda Landry
review_text: Absolutely gorgeous venue especially for a shower (we had 60 ppl) & great customer service. Flexible to fit your needs; pricey packages but understandable for a waterfront (harbor) view near Boston. Beautiful room, big windows & vaulted wooden ceilings. My o my complaint, however, was the function food (brunch) couldve been much much better for that price tag. Waitstaff and bartenders were exceptional! Very helpful, kind & great service. Plenty of parking. Thank you!

author: Kerrie Fraser
review_text: We made an impromptu stop at Bay Pointe on our way through Boston and we are so glad we did! We were able to be seated right away with a view of the water. Our waitress was so attentive and gracious. The food was delicious but the star of the night was the sweet chili shrimp appetizer. We just loved our stop in Quincy. Thank you!!!

author: Marquise Bailey-Dillard
review_text: I visited Bay Point Restaurant today with a family group of eight. The atmosphere was definitely the highlight — they have outdoor seating with a breezy, relaxed summer vibe, as well as drink-only high-top tables where you can enjoy a drink before sitting down. We waited outside with a drink before heading indoors for our meal, and the outdoor setting felt inviting. Once inside, service for a large party was decent. The staff took appetizer and drink orders in a reasonable time, refilled drinks, and checked in as needed. Food, however, was underwhelming. Two people ordered steak tips and found them enjoyable. Two others ordered chicken but found it dry. Two of us ordered the “catch of the day,” which was said to be haddock — but as someone who enjoys fish regularly, I didn’t taste anything resembling true haddock. Overall, the food was mediocre and lacked anything memorable. In the end, while the atmosphere is a nice spot to grab a drink on a pleasant day, the food doesn’t justify a return visit for me. If you’re looking for a place with a good summer view and a drink in hand, it works. But for a satisfying meal, I’d look elsewhere.

author: Krissy M
review_text: Great spot, wish I knew about it sooner! The food was delicious and reasonably priced. Atmosphere can’t be beat on a nice day.

author: renee pham
review_text: Overall pretty good. Lots of free parking. Food did take a while to come out though, but they were busy. My family was satisfied with their meals.

author: Paul Oliveira
review_text: Had a birthday celebration there with 11 people and everything was fabulous. Olivia and the entire staff did a great job accommodating us with a private table on the patio. Rob, our waiter, was very attentive, and did a fantastic job. Food and drinks were great! The view is wonderful and very serene. We all took pictures on the lower dock area. Thank you for everything 🥂

author: Martina Zoi
review_text: Amazing place. Great atmosphere there was live music. I loved the singer. The food was very good. Scallops were cooked excellent. Lobster roll was kind of blunt. Did not feel mayo or any marination. Definitely overpriced lobster roll. There is a wait of ~45 minutes on busy days for outdoor seating.

author: Павел Жардецкий
review_text: We been there for the first time and it was awesome. We didn't expect something extraordinary but we were very surprised when we finished our dinner. Everything was perfect. Food delicious. We ordered Serlion steak tips and it was cooked exactly i wanted. Oysters and shrimps were fabulous. We came from VA and definitely come back again.

author: Melise Nguyen
review_text: I’ve been here a few times, and I must say..never disappointed. Food was staff amazing. Amanda was our waitress and she was friendly and pleasant and always checking to see if we need anything but giving us enough time and space to have our meal. Host was very friendly and informative. Highly recommended.

author: Jeneen Hinkle
review_text: Oh my!! It was my first time on the North-east coast and I wanted lobster and fish and chips and Bay Pointe did not disappoint! The fish and chips were so light and flaky they were the best I have ever tasted. The lobster roll was flavorful, stuffed with sweet succulent lobster with a hint of mayonnaise! The clam chowder was rich and flavorful with large chunks of clam! The service was great also! What a wonderful dining experience 👌

author: Savannah Broderick
review_text: The best part of the experience was our server Patrick. He made it personal and inviting. We were impressed by his speedy service and his patience and kindness. Would return again only for the service. I loved the waterfront experience and the fish tanks. There are several puffer fish and clown fish! Great food, came out timely and was flavorful. I got the french dip sandwich. It came with fries and oju, which I never had before but was pleasantly surprised!

author: Samuel Lin
review_text: Did I mention this was the best dinner of my 10-day trip to the U.S.? An absolutely wonderful experience — every dish was fantastic. I especially recommend the Cajun seafood pasta; it instantly became one of the top three pasta dishes I’ve ever had. Beyond the food, the service truly stood out. Every server was warm, friendly, and attentive, which made the whole experience even more memorable. Highly recommended if you’re visiting Las Vegas!

author: Amber A
review_text: First time eating at Triple George and it did not disappoint. We were a party of 6 on Christmas Day. Service was great. Drinks came quickly from the bar. The Vanilla Raspberry Martini was delicious. One of the best french onion soups I've ever had. Great downtown restaurant.

author: CariAnne Behr Huffman
review_text: We stayed the Downtown Grand for one night and wanted a delicious meal with great service without a strict dress code, but not a tourist place, so we chose to eat here. The ambiance was perfection, but the service even better — with (of course) delicious food and drink!! Our server, Rebbecca, was one of the two best servers we’ve ever had, and she tied with the other: beautiful smile, friendly, perfect timing! The food would bring us back, she makes us recommend it to others!!

author: J M (Texas Foodie)
review_text: Slow. And I mean painfully slow service. Maybe they are understaffed? IDK. I ate at the bar. I started with the wedge that was ok but it had hardly any dressing and it was supposed to have bacon on it and I maybe had two bites. For an entree I got the filet mignon with bearnaise sauce. The filet was tasty but not Ruth’s Chris tasty. Good flavor but not as tender as Ruth’s Chris or other high end steak houses. Probably won’t be back.

author: Tina Bueno
review_text: LOVE LOVE Triple George Grill for dinner and lunch… we stopped in today for brunch and again, LOVE!! Always a memorable downtown dining experience, decadent steaks,classic cocktails, and the BEST service!! Thank you to our bartender this morning, exceptional service by Joy!

author: Judy K
review_text: We had a group birthday dinner for over 20 people, and Triple George was a great choice! The room was comfortable, and the wood tone walls made the room very warm and easy to decorate. The staff worked hard, and the food was great. The calamari was a particular hit, and people said it was the best they ever had! The location is perfect with a 2 minute walk to Freemont Street after dinner. I was very happy that I had booked The Triple George!

author: BREW
review_text: Triple George is on par with the best. We have never had a bad meal or experience. Todd makes the best drinks and his vibrant personality just adds even more fun to the experience. Tana is also amazing and so attentive to requests you really feel special. LOVE this place!!

author: Jeff Petersen
review_text: Great place downtown Vegas, just a block off Fremont Street. Nice old school steakhouse vibe. Real good steaks and seafood. No wait for our table with reservation. Very good service. Very cool long bar with seating; also some booths and tables for dining. Very extensive cocktail list. Tableside prepared Cesar salad for 2 was very nice presentation, but it was just average tasting in our opinion. Good portions- not huge (unless you order the huge steaks) and not skimpy. Too full to try dessert, but it was a nice list. If there is free street parking, we didn’t see it. Paid street parking and a variety of paid garages walking distance.

author: Celeste Abbott
review_text: ★★★★★ 5 stars — Triple George’s is a downtown Vegas must!!! We had dinner at a booth atTriple George’s on New Year’s Day and it was a ballet of hospitality… the kind of service that feels rare lately. They actually pick up the phone when you call! And from the host to the servers to the entire crew, everyone brought their best to the table warm, attentive, professional, and somehow still relaxed and human… even on New Year’s Day. And the food? Perfection. Our steaks were cooked exactly right, beautifully paced, and genuinely delightful from start to finish. You can tell this place takes pride in doing it the right way… no gimmicks, just classic Vegas steakhouse excellence and a fun, professional team that makes you feel like family. Where is that these days? Also: the staff had this bright sense of humor that only comes from teamwork and being appreciated. I truly hope leadership is as solid behind the scenes as what they deliver to the table. If you’re downtown and want a meal that feels special (without the Strip chaos… which is the opposite of what happens downtown), go to Triple George’s. We left happy, impressed, and already talking about coming back… and we still have steak for days!

author: Charles Wonsey
review_text: Gave it a try with the $25 off from the hotel. Would rather pay full price for decent food. Lobster mac was basically undercooked pasta covered in bisque served lukewarm. Maybe served hot the pasta would have been a bit better. One scallop was slightly under and the other was rubbery. Steak was cooked properly but doesn't have much flavor and the peppercorn sauce was abysmal and arrived with a film on top and tasted some kind of rancid. Waiter encouraged a small Caesar salad, didn't expect $17 for a side salad when that's the same as my scallops or a side dish but the salad was the best tasting part of the meal. Bill was $140 before the discount so not badly priced just poor quality. The food, including the salad, was quite slow coming out.

author: daniel garcia
review_text: The staff was perfect the food was perfect it was a perfect Birthday Dinner for my beautiful wife of 35 years thank you Triple George for the perfect Dinner and drinks. We had the dinner for 2 and added a Tail Ceasars Salad was excellent as well and the loaf of warm fresh baked bread was awesome we did not finish that whole porterhouse it was cooked to perfection, we left there completely satisfied. I never new this place was here will definitely go back next special occasion when we come back Downtown Vegas

author: Roland Stewart
review_text: I was in Vegas, and stayed at the Grand Downtown Las Vegas. I was hungry so I decided to venture across the street to Triple George Grill. I was greeted at the door by a slim gentleman wearing a blue shirt and wearing glasses. He had a pot belly and was holding his stomach as though he was sick. I asked him if he was OK, he never answered, so I said, for one pls. He responded rudely, "sit at the bar." Throughout my stay, I noticed he seemed very friendly and attentive to others sitting at the bar, but never once did he approach me and ask me how was my meal or how was everything? In fact, I noticed he asked others at the bar on several occasions, how their meal was? He wd look at me and keep going. Other than the seemingly rude host, the food was excellent and the service was great. Everyone else, the beautiful atmosphere and the food made up for the rude, unhappy host. He made me feel like I shoud have never come in there. I would not go back, or recommend to ppl I know to avoid this place. I did speak to a female manager behind the bar, who was very kind, and welcoming The male host in the blue shirt made me feel uncomfortable and unwelcome.

author: Tony Solano
review_text: I loved the service. Sat at the bar and gentleman was pretty attentive and friendly. The octopus was AMAZING. The Steak even better. I was asked if I needed any condiment on the Steak. Just cook it with salt please.

author: Healys Internet Training
review_text: This is the best kept secret in Las Vegas. The food was amazing and the service went above and beyond. I was particularly impressed with Tanya the general manager who helped me get across the street because I am visually impaired. I come to Las Vegas monthly and will definitely make this my new go to spot.

author: Cori E.
review_text: We chose this location for my daughter's wedding celebration. Every single person we interacted with was wonderful from the phone calls to the service and the meals. Everyone raved about their food and fantastic cocktails. Such a wonderful evening of exemplary service and food. Thank you to all the staff for truly making it a magical night for all of us.

author: Stephanie Grant
review_text: The best food I’ve had in my ENTIRE life. My husband and I shared the steak dinner for two and it was perfect. Cooked to perfection. Flavored to perfection. I just cannot stress enough how delicious the food was. The atmosphere is so charming and romantic. Please visit this place!!!

author: Chad Hutchins
review_text: Outstanding restaurant, and I can't believe this was our first visit. They are doing everything right... food, service, and atmosphere! Very friendly from the moment we stepped in. The food was cooked to perfection and very tasty! You don't hear many people talking about Triple George, but it's a hidden Gem. Highly recommend and we'll be back for sure!

author: Angela Abney
review_text: This was an amazing place to eat. We came here for my fiancé birthday. We received a birthday card from the staff congratulating him. The tables were spacious and a beautiful ambiance. The meals were divine. We had steak, seafood pasta and prime rib. All the sides were ala carte. The waitstaff were very attentive. This is a must try outside of the strip

author: Onkar Bhamra
review_text: Amazing restaurant with a New York style vibe! Ricardo, our server, is such a huge credit to the establishment and very patient with us whilst we were deciding on our dishes. Popped in to celebrate mine and my wife's 20th wedding anniversary on the recommendation from someone who works at Mon Bel Ami Wedding Chapel (look out for the review for them 😘). We were not disappointed with the recommendation! There is a bar you can sit at as well as tables and booths. We popped in on a Wednesday at lunch time and whilst it was not quiet, we managed to bag a booth to ourselves. Food was amazing; I opted for the meatball starter whilst wifey decided to skip the starters and opt for just a main due to portion sizes. Wifey selected a turkey club sandwich with fries and I opted for a medium rare steak, which was cooked to perfection, along with truffle fries. The steak was so nice, even the fat was edible (it was very crunchy!) The sandwich was nice but as anticipated, too large for my wife to finish. The restrooms, located on the other side of the bar from where we were sat were nice and clean, which is always good. Staff overall were friendly and polite and it's just a shame I am a visitor to Vegas and not a resident as I would frequent this establishment at least a couple of times a month (the Big Dogs Lager goes down VERY easy, even at $8!) Thanks for a very memorable meal and top notch service, the food and service in this place are second to none!

author: Stephen Carvalho
review_text: We got there at Happy hour and got the Fremont salad and Steak and frites. The salad was one of the best I had. So refreshing and savory. The steak was cooked perfect. The bartender mixed up some great drinks. This was our first time here and it won't be our last!

author: Seal
review_text: Good food good portions Good atmosphere. Gets packed so come early. Besides the Tabasco sauce spilled half the bottle onto my plate bc it was missing the stopper. 2x within a week. Everything else was good. I especially loved the cute lattes ☕️

author: Carmen Toure
review_text: Good breakfast. The veggie skillet was great. I usually eat lots of ketchup but it tasted great without ketchup… the veggies were kinda sauter which gave good an elevated flavor. My partner has the French toast which was really good as well

author: Justin H
review_text: Loved this place. The wait was a bit long due to how busy it was (Saturday morning so im not too upset about it). We sat at the bar top which was cool cause we got to watch everyone buzzing around. They were well orchestrated, communicative and really pumping out the food and drinks. When it came to customer service, Antonio was really nice and friendly. The food was good as well! I got the breakfast sandwich and my wife got the spicy chicken sandwich. My sandwich was good, not great but I wasnt disappointed at all. Her sandwich was really good. The French Toast that I saw coming from the kitchen looked incredible. This will for sure be on the list to visit when we come back!

author: It's Nass Fitness
review_text: The food was absolutely delicious, and Alfredo was an exceptional host. It’s now my top breakfast spot whenever I visit Las Vegas—the lively atmosphere, combined with Alfredo’s friendly and helpful nature, made for a fantastic experience. I highly recommend trying their legendary three-layer pancakes! Parking is available on the street for a fee, and I suggest making a reservation in advance to avoid long lines.

author: Eklil Oriakhil
review_text: We were visiting Las Vegas for vacation, and this restaurant was one of the highlights of our trip! Everything was absolutely perfect — the food, the atmosphere, and especially the service. Our waiter, Rob, was incredible! He was so friendly, attentive, and really took great care of us from start to finish. You could tell he genuinely cared about making sure we had a great experience. Everything was 10/10, and we left completely happy and satisfied. We’ll definitely be coming back next time we’re in Vegas — highly recommend!

author: Elaine Aviles
review_text: We had a fantastic experience here! We enjoyed a Philly cheesesteak with jalapeños on the side and fresh fruit, plus a delicious breakfast burrito loaded with chorizo, egg, bacon, and potatoes — served with their famous crispy potatoes. Everything was full of flavor and perfectly cooked. The cappuccinos were amazing too! Alfredo, our server, was friendly and attentive, and Nick, the owner, made us feel genuinely welcome. Great food, great service, and great vibes — we’ll definitely be back!

author: Fay M
review_text: Nice brunch place downtown. I recommend getting on the wait-list through Yelp and then head over. There can be a wait. Large portions and lots to choose from. I got the veggie skillet. It was great and all fresh ingredients. There were 5 of us and everyone enjoyed their dishes. I would come again.

author: Sam Napolitano
review_text: Ok, wow… what an amazing place. We stayed at “The D” on Freemont Street. Ameribrunch was a short 5 minute walk away. I saw previous reviews on Google Maps and thought we need to give this place a try… while we weren’t money winners in Vegas this time, we won the best picked breakfast place in town! Every dish was meticulously prepared, hot, fast and fresh. The Americanos we had were smooth and tasty along with an amazing spicy Bloody Mary. The restaurant is super cute and very eclectic. It just had a happy vibe to it! Topping off our experience was our waiter Alex. What an incredible guy and he really made our day. Not once, but twice. We had such a great experience with him that we brought more people from our party over the next morning. I hope the management sees this post and keeps him happy because he is a true asset to your organization! Thanks Alex! Give Ameribrunch a shot! You owe your belly a happy experience and this is the place to make it happen!!!

author: Cayla Madaris
review_text: Pretty good experience! My eggs were perfectly soft scrambled. Potatoes were goooood. The chai latte was delicious. The biscuits were burned and tough, could only eat about half of it but they did take some off of the check. The waiter could have been more attentive but overall a pretty good visit!

author: Jessica Hensley
review_text: This place is unbelievable! The service was just the beginning of this fantastic experience. Alfredo was our server very friendly and cheerful. The food was off the charts. This is unassuming from the outside but don’t let that fool you. It’s a must try.

author: Jolina SM
review_text: I found this place just by searching brunch spots what caught my eye was it is family owned and operated. Also I wanted a place away from the strip. Boy it didn’t disappoint! The service the food was amazing the selection of savory foods and sweet was amazing. Rob was outstanding personality and hospitality!

author: Kathryn B
review_text: Do not visit Las Vegas and miss out on experiencing Ameribrunch Cafe! Even though we visited at a PEAK time we were brought to our table quickly yet not rushed once we were seated. Every interaction with staff was lovely. Our server, Jonathan, was charming, funny & knowledgeable. The chorizo biscut is placed as one of my favorite brunch meals anywhere!!!! Chill music was at a level that allowed for conversation. Both the Bloody Mary and cappuccino were DELICIOUS. My only regret is that I couldn't finish everything because the portions are HUGE!!!! One of my favorite dining experiences in my 54 years of a travel filled life.

author: Evelyn Ladera
review_text: We, the women, loved our lattes, toasts, and pancakes!!....However, the men weren't too happy w/ theirs. One asked for medium rare steak, but got medium well, and expected more steak than what he got. The other wanted medium well, but got medium. Steak is everything to these men, so I had to knock off a star for that. Our server was welcoming, helpful, and attentive. The environment is what was expected...hip, modern, yet homey, and moderately noisy....all indicative of a great place to eat! Space is limited however, so go early! Parking can also be a challenge if you go during the busy hours.

author: M P
review_text: We came here our first day in Vegas, and bc of the service, the food and the total experience was awesome, we came back everyday for breakfast. All the servers were awesome , but Rob was very memorable..he remembered us and always stopped by to chat even if he was not our server. Everyone who works here was so courteous and friendly, the management team needs to appreciate the great staff they have here.

author: S T
review_text: I recently visited a café that left me with mixed feelings, but overall, it was a pleasant experience worth sharing. As soon as we walked in, we were greeted warmly, which set a positive tone for our visit. After a brief wait, we were seated, though I did notice the floors could use a bit more attention; they were quite dirty. On the upside, the tables were relatively clean, and the polite demeanor of the waitstaff really stood out. Now, let's talk about the food. I ordered an espresso, avocado toast with scrambled eggs, and a slice of French toast. The espresso was impressive, presenting a nice strong flavor that I really enjoyed. The scrambled eggs were decent, but nothing to rave about—I'd rate them a 3 out of 4. The standout for me were the French fries; they were exceptionally crunchy and flavorful, earning a solid 4 out of 4. The avocado toast was the highlight of my meal. I rarely give top marks, but the flavor was absolutely amazing, and I’d rate it a solid 4 out of 5. The French toast was also quite good—fluffy and flavorful, deserving another 4 out of 5 rating. While I typically reserve a 5 out of 5 rating for places that are flawless, this café gave off strong 5 out of 5 vibes despite my overall rating of 4 out of 5. I highly recommend it, as it has a charm that makes you want to return. I also appreciated that it seemed to be friendly towards 2A supporters, as I didn't see any signs against it. Additionally, they offer discounts for military personnel and veterans, which is a nice touch. In my personal rating system, a score of 1 or 2 means I definitely wouldn’t return, while a 3 indicates a place I wouldn’t recommend but might revisit in a pinch. A 4 is a place I’d recommend without hesitation, and achieving a 5 requires perfection, which is tough to come by. Overall, this café is one I would happily recommend, especially for their avocado toast and friendly service.

author: Sandy Heidloff
review_text: Excellent breakfast spot just a short walk from Circa Resort. The staff were so inviting, felt like part of the extended family. Was the best breakfast we've had out in years. Highly recommend a visit you won't be disappointed.

author: Cyndi Scott
review_text: If you’re looking for a top-tier brunch experience, AmeriBrunch Cafe is the spot — and be sure to ask for Big Rob! His service is unmatched — friendly, attentive, and made the whole experience even better. We kicked things off with a Sunrise Mimosa — the perfect refreshing start. The food? Absolutely flawless. The Philly omelette was savory and loaded with flavor, and the smoked salmon toast was fresh and beautifully presented. We also shared the French toast with fruit, which was sweet and satisfying without being too heavy, and the breakfast potatoes were crispy and seasoned just right. Everything from the drinks to the dishes to the hospitality was on point. We’ll definitely be back.

author: Michelle Walter
review_text: They accommodated our need for a larger table than we originally requested. I had the French toast which was great but too much for me to finish! Everyone else said they enjoyed their food. A short walk from Fremont street, much better prices than any casino restaurant!

author: Sacha Martinez
review_text: Delicious and fresh food! Challenging that they only serve walk-in. We showed up just before 12P and were seated in 30 mins even though predicted wait time was 53-73 mins. I felt for people waiting with kids. It was worth the wait! If you value fresh and wholesome food - you will not be disappointed here. I had the veggie scramble - it was great!

author: J Hill
review_text: 5/5 no question. The moment you walk in, you can tell the staff works hard—just spending a minute in the lobby shows how much hustle goes into this place. I was greeted right away, and my food came out surprisingly fast. The coffee selection was solid, the prices were fair, and the food looked just as good as it tasted. Overall, a great experience from start to finish and they even matched my partners sweater with the latte!

author: Ashley C
review_text: Step back into the 1970s with this evil Knievel-themed pizza restaurant located right on Fremont Street that offers some no-frills New York style slices and a whole lot of evil iconography. You can even try your skills on the evil pinball machine while you wait for your pizza. We started off with the cheese slice and evil ale for only eight bucks. The slices were large, hot, greasy, and everything you’d want in a New York style pizza. The aisle was really good, too, and the price can’t be beat. We got a little adventurous with the sweet heat slice. I love the pepperoni and jalapeño, but the hot honey was a little much for me - still good though. We finished with an order of the Led Zeppoli, and if you haven’t had these yet, you’re definitely missing out. They’re delicious! This one is 4.5 out of five, and will definitely be back. On to the next!

author: Ethan Gaudioso Travels
review_text: I came here on a Saturday night, and the pizza was delicious! They had so many different choices to choose from. All of the pizzas weren’t too expensive and you can buy them by the slice. For a Saturday, we only waited five to ten minutes, and there was room to sit down and wait. I loved the vibes and atmosphere with all of the neon signs and pictures everywhere. I definitely will be coming back next time I am downtown!

author: Paul Duncan
review_text: Amazing GF Deep Dish! Using this app to locate a gluten free pizza option in Las Vegas was daunting with so many choices, however, due to the many positive reviews we decided to try Evel Pie. The business was busy, a great sign of good food. Ordering is done at the counter and if you are eating in, they give you a number for your table. The gluten free is a little bit of a wait, but, 100% worth it. I had the ‘Olivia Gluten Free John” with mushrooms, olives and pepperoni. My wife had the same crust with the Maui Wowie version. Be aware it is a little spicy, but great flavor. After a 50 minute wait, we had our delicious dinner delivered to the table. Great flavor from the pizza, and an amazing gluten free treat. I have never had a deep-dish pizza in a gluten free version.
