Ordering tip, grab a menu while you are waiting to be helped, then have your decision before to arrive at the cashier, and be prepared for taking some home as the deep dish is a lot of great food (that warms up very well). Love it, would absolutely recommend.

author: B “BurrrBarrry” S
review_text: Evel Pie didn’t live up to the hype for us. The place was extremely loud to the point where the staff could barely hear our order. Unfortunately, our pizza came out burnt and making it hard and unpleasant to eat. Honestly, Pizza Rock down the street was ten times better. It’s a shame, especially after seeing so many great reviews, only to end up with a burnt, hard slice.

author: Susan Z
review_text: Such a bad ass hole in the wall gem in the heart of Downtown Las Vegas -Adjacent to the arts district. Love the Evel Knievel theme throughout the dining area and the artsy feel inside with all the slap stickers flooding every wall and blank space. They have a cool bar, small indoor dining area and a small outdoor patio area. Great customer service and good drinks. But the food is what brings the entire experience together. The wings are delicious, meaty, and done well. Love the garlic knots with marinara👌🏻 and the Caesar salad was good too. I look forward to coming back and trying their pizza next 👍🏻

author: Terrence Reed
review_text: A very hectic, yet efficient experience. You walk in, get in line if it’s busy. You can order by the slice or order a whole pie. The restaurant itself, I hate to say, is disgusting. I don’t think 2 full time housekeepers could keep the place clean, sit to the sheer volume of people coming in and out. It was very packed at 8pm on a Monday night. The pizza was the best part of the experience. You get a wide variety of slices to choose from so that you can get a mix instead of committing to one whole pizza like a traditional restaurant. The pizza gets a 6/10 in my opinion. Many spirits to choose from top of course. Worth checking the box.

author: Ryan Schroeder
review_text: This place is definitely a vibe! The pizza was amazing for sure! My wife and I walked down from fremont street to get a pie before going back to hotel and we were not disappointed. So good and the slices were huge! Loved it!

author: Gloria Raymond
review_text: Can't speak for the other combinations but my Sweet Heat slice was soooooo good that I had to run it back before I left Vegas. Everyone in my party was happy with their pizza. Will def go back next time I'm in town. Creative pizza joint/bar with something for everyone.

author: Hannah Madaus
review_text: Solid 3 out of 5. Props to them for staying open late for all the drunk gamblers out there in Fremont, definitely saved us when we were hungry - however we waited in a very long line for alright tasting pizza that ended up being over 30$ for three slices including tax and tip.

author: Rick Cobb
review_text: Fun place, great service, but the food wasn’t great at all. The pizza was super salty. Then again we ordered one with several kinds of processed meats. The garlic knots were terrible though. They were hockey pucks with flavor added on the top. I hate to be so negative, but after reading other reviews I really expected better.

author: Natalie Amat
review_text: Had to show my brother my favorite pizza place in all of Las Vegas! It's evel kenevel themed. We have both worked in pizza places and this place is on point let me tell ya! Their slices are huge! Their toppings are delicious! The names of the pizzas are fun and silly! Absolutely adore this pizza place!

author: Rogue Sheepdog
review_text: The reason for my two star rating is because I love their pizza.But all too often they burn the bottom black, and this last one I got was literally black.It was totally crunchy, not chewy with the crisp that we all love. And I had to pay DoorDash to bring it to me. So that was like a $70 Pizza, not too happy. Probably won't water again.Because this is the second time, and it's just to the impensive, to get a mediocre pizza That's burnt.

author: Lori Santiago
review_text: I had the Extreme Pepperoni pizza...2 slices. Thin, crispy crust, perfect amount of cheese and pepperonis (2 types with extra pepperoni).. Loved those big slices where the cheese strings start when you bite and pull away. Fresh herbs were there for sure. Everyone got something different, and it all looked and sounded yummy 😋

author: Matt Bernson
review_text: A lil expensive but still accessible considering the area. Pizza was tasty. Beer was good. They had a deal for a cheese slice and the evel ale for $8 which is what I'd recommend. Some seating but it gets packed easy so likely have to wait for a seat. Chill rockin decor. They call out your name for you to pick up your slice. Like a 2 minute walk to the fremont experience. They have slices ready of each of their specialty flavors. T-Shirts for $35.

author: Chuck Roast
review_text: I have been here multiple times the pizza and the vibe is awesome! There is a nice outdoor seating in the back, as well as a few spots up front outside.

author: John Eckelbarger
review_text: Evel Pie was the perfect spot for our wedding weekend kickoff dinner with both families. We wanted cool + casual… and got it here! 🍕 We started with wings in 3 flavors — BBQ, buffalo, and lemon pepper — plus mozzarella sticks, then moved on to the Goblin Sausage and Barry White whole pies. 🐔 Everything was delicious and plenty to go around. The atmosphere was lively and fun, which was exactly what we needed to kickoff the celebration 💒 Afterwards, we walked Fremont Street and soaked in all the energy of downtown Las Vegas. It made for a very memorable night out bringing our families together over some pizza, wings, and beer 🍺 Highly recommend Evel Pie if you’re looking for great pizza, good vibes, and a quintessential Vegas experience. 🎲 Thanks for being a part of our wedding weekend! 💍

author: Jim Morris
review_text: Walked in with seven friends and had a great reception. Quick service premade pizzas are delicious and hot. You can custom order pizzas and they do take about 20 minutes to 40 minutes. Depends on how busy they are but it’s well worth it. The gluten-free option is absolutely amazing. One of my friends is gluten-free one of the best pizzas he’s ever eaten! The traditional buffalo wings are non-breaded and great sauce. Step off the strip and have an affordable meal with all of the excellent service and awesome ambience!

author: Keith Lennop
review_text: Love everything about this place. The pizza isnt the best you have had but still good and the overall vibe of the place makes it a cool spot.

author: Aisha Pleasant
review_text: If you’re in Las Vegas and craving an unforgettable slice of pizza, Evel Pie is a must-visit. This funky pizza joint/bar has a super chill vibe, great music, and a cool, down-to-earth staff that makes the whole experience feel laid-back and fun. I ordered a slice of the chicken and ranch pizza and another one (wish I could remember what it was—probably too busy enjoying it!), and let me tell you, these slices are HUGE. Like, one slice could easily take up a whole small pizza box. At about $6.25 a slice, you’re definitely getting your money’s worth—and then some. The pizza itself? Insanely delicious. Crispy on the edges, cheesy in the middle, and full of bold, creative flavors. Honestly, it might just be the best slice I’ve had in a very long time—hands down better than any slice I’ve had before. They call your name over the microphone when your order’s ready, which just adds to the fun and casual vibe. Whether you’re just grabbing a quick bite or hanging out for a drink, Evel Pie delivers on taste, size, and good energy. Highly recommend! Don’t forget this place is on Fremont Street as well.

author: Tabatha Loihle
review_text: Great pizza! I’m very picky when it comes to pizza just because I personally prefer homemade, but sometimes you just need a good fold on pie, that heals everything!

author: Antonio T
review_text: Why, why, WHY did I wait so long to come back to Carson Kitchen? This place has officially become one of my absolute favorite restaurants in Las Vegas — downtown or Strip. I first discovered it years ago during a New Year’s trip with visiting friends from Boston, and I still remember being blown away. After taking a year-long break from downtown Vegas, I recently returned… and instantly regretted staying away for so long. Carson Kitchen is tucked away behind one of the most nondescript entrances in downtown Las Vegas. My limo drove past twice before I realized the place was right in front of me. Hidden in plain sight — and I love that about it. Inside, the vibe is warm, friendly, and genuinely welcoming. Downtown staff always feel more grounded than the Strip, but Carson Kitchen takes it to another level. It almost feels small-town — think Biddeford, Maine or Snyder, Texas — smack in the middle of Vegas. Over the years I’ve come with everything from parties of nine (five kids and teens — the pickiest eaters on earth) to smaller family outings. Every time, the food hits. Here are the essentials: ⭐ Must-Order Dishes • Bacon Jam This is next-level. Served sizzling with a strip of baked brie running through the middle. I’ve had bacon jams all over the country — this one is truly artisanal. An automatic order every time. • Fried Chicken Skins My whole family demands two orders right away. I grew up partly in Indonesia where this is normal fare, and Carson Kitchen nails it. Crunchy, savory comfort food with smoked honey dipping sauce. If you’re a chicken-skin person, this is heaven. • Pork Belly My wife’s forever favorite — perfectly rich and flavorful. • Deviled Eggs My oldest son insists on these every visit. • Chicken Thighs A recent new favorite. The charred chicken pairs with an Alabama-style mustard BBQ sauce that brings way more depth and complexity than expected. This is joining the permanent rotation. The Finale: Glazed Donut Bread Pudding The absolute showstopper. If dessert could be described as soft, bouncy, moist, warm, creamy perfection — this is it. I’ve said it before: we could’ve ordered nothing but nine of these and everyone would’ve been thrilled. Still my top dessert in all of Las Vegas. Final Verdict Carson Kitchen delivers consistently fantastic food, warm hospitality, and a downtown vibe that’s casual, elevated, and refreshingly genuine. After coming back recently with my family, I’m kicking myself for staying away for a year. Highly recommend — and I’ll be returning regularly.

author: Ajay
review_text: Waitress was very helpful and attentive. I forget her name but she's blonde and I remember her saying she's from an island. All the food we had was really good, I just wish they served the oysters in half dozen or a dozen instead of only 3. The outside looks a little suspect but once you're inside its worth it. This is a little hidden gem. Prices are not too expensive "but", certain dishes are a little over priced seeing that the portions are small. The question you all want to know...Will I come back?...The answer is yes! Not only will I come back, I will bring my friends and family here when they come visit. Right off Fremont street so once you eat add drink,you can go on a nice walk and get some good pics.

author: Dennis S
review_text: An amazing find! We dined on the patio in very relaxed and casual atmosphere. The patio is large an even has an upstairs area. Plenty of tables that seat 4 or pull up a chair to the large fire pit and relax with a drink from the bar. We had the short rib steak which paired well with the creamy mac and cheese. The steak is small but oh so juicy and tender. The mac & cheese was creamy and did not have an overwhelming cheese flavor. Just perfect! We finished off with the bourbon fudge brownie.

author: Jill
review_text: This was my favorite visit of our whole vacation!!! The atmosphere was nothing but perfect. The service was so friendly and welcoming. Now about the food! We ordered like half of the menu and not one dish disappointed. Everything was 5 star 🌟 Amazing drink selections to accompany the menu. Thank you for such an incredible dining experience 💖

author: Aden Teklu
review_text: Got the chance to try a variety of things here and we were really pleased. The STAR OF THE SHOW is their baked mac and cheese. That was the dish that our group collectively kept saying they wanted more of. The bacon burger and spicy notes were so great, and the tots definitely were delicious. Grape and burrito was super refreshing next to all of the hot meals, and the black rice and oxtail risotto was perfection. For dessert we tried the glazed donut bread pudding, and while yummy it was a bit underwhelming. Should’ve added their bacon ice cream on top, would’ve added a great flavor to it. Staff was really friendly and accommodating. Also, they gave a rooftop but you need to make a reservation

author: Willy Illas
review_text: Went here with friends for my 50th. birthday. Food was pretty good and with a service to match. Atmosphere wasn't bad but not great. Kinfa family oriented I guess? But again, great to just go there to eat in supposed.

author: Peter & Rachel Badgett Real Estate Agents
review_text: Tempura green beans were the bomb and the desserts. Fruitcake buckle sounds like a terrible idea, but was our group's winner! Shortrib steak was terribly fatty - couldn't fully chew any one piece! Pork chop overcooked but still very flavorful. Burgers were great.

author: Lena Kim
review_text: Even though I had a reservation, I still had to wait about 10 minutes after arriving. Among the dishes I ordered, the bacon burger was pretty good, but there were no vegetables in it — no lettuce, pickles, or onions, just the beef patty, cheese, and bacon. The staff were friendly though.

author: Donnie Biederman
review_text: Our group did the Lip Smacking Foodie tour. This was one of our stops. They have a great selection of beer and mixed drinks. My favorite was the deviled eggs. Awesome atmosphere here. I plan on returning.

author: Rodney Yoswig
review_text: The only negative I have is they sat us at the bar saying it was the only thing available even though the whole time we we there they had empty tables. Food was good, my choice of wild mushroom flatbread didn't impress me. Wouldn't orde ot again, however plenty of others options to try.

author: Rachel Kissinger
review_text: WHOAH. This place is a 5min walk from Freemont Street and absolutely amazing. Even with the paving work outside, which added to the low-key vibe, we looooooooved this place. We had Devil's Eggs, Beet salad and each had a smashburger. Everything was delicious. Great staff, great food and great ambience. Do it - you won't regret it.

author: Will See
review_text: On a lively Sunday evening, my friends and I, a group of six, visited Carson Kitchen in historic Downtown Las Vegas, a vibrant spot known for its creative American comfort food. Arriving without a reservation, we were fortunate to snag seats early, as the restaurant was packed and buzzing with energy. Reservations are highly recommended, as the intimate space fills up quickly. The menu, though concise, offered plenty of tempting small plates perfect for sharing. We ordered several dishes, with the cocoa espresso New York strip, tempura green beans with pepper jelly cream cheese, and spicy killer shrimp stealing the show—each bursting with bold, well-executed flavors. Other dishes were tasty but leaned slightly too salty for our liking. The drink menu was similarly compact but thoughtfully curated, ensuring we found satisfying cocktails to complement the meal. The portions were generous for the price, offering solid value for an off-Strip gem. Service was friendly and attentive despite the bustling crowd, though it felt a touch stretched at times, earning a 3.5-star rating. Carson Kitchen’s modern, urban vibe and inventive dishes made for a memorable night, and we’d return if back in the Downtown area. Deliciousness Rating: ★★★☆☆ (3.5/5) Service Attitude: ★★★☆☆ (3.5/5) Value for Money: ★★★★☆ (4/5) Likelihood of Returning: ★★★☆☆ (3.5/5)

author: Lori Batronis
review_text: One of the best places I have ever eaten in Vegas!! We had the Pork Belly, Chicken Skins, Deviled Eggs, and Oysters. Also enjoyed the Tequila flight and bourbon flight. EVERYTHING was wonderful. Staff was very personable and helpful. We will be going back each time we are staying on Fremont street.

author: Jakob
review_text: Attended dinner after making a same day reservation. Food choices are plentiful and are complementary to all palates. These are more of shared portion types of servings. Order a bunch and share amongst your party. The Mac and Cheese is unmatched. The best I’ve had in quite some time. The only dish we tried that I didn’t have a second portion of was the shrimp scampi. Just didn’t hit hard for me. Everything else was fantastic. Service was friendly and prompt. I really enjoyed the ambiance, though near the end of our visit it did get quite crowded and loud. Still, this is nothing that would prevent me from returning. If you’re in the area and looking for high quality food and service, all at a fair price, look no further.

author: Blane Hartleb
review_text: One of our must go to places every time we come to Vegas. Chicken skins with honey dipping sauce. The chicken thighs in a white sauce and the bread with bacon jam....omg. words can't describe these dishes. Then we finish with the bread pudding. I ask for extra glaze. Wow.

author: David Orridge
review_text: Great food, awesome cocktails, really enjoyed the steak, potatoes bravas and old fashion cocktails. Waiter took really good care of us.

author: David Ganzel
review_text: What an excellent find off Fremont! The food was well designed and extremely flavorful. I loved the drink selection and was tempted to double back to the bourbon headliner - Just the Tip. We sat at the bar, which I feel like gives the best restaurant experience. Adam entertained with great conversation and top recommendations. The vibe was intentional, as all staff were wearing grunge band tees, with an eclectic music selection and low key ambiance. If I was local, I would be a regular. DO NOT miss out on the dessert, Glazed Donut Bread Pudding. It’s worth every single calorie.

author: Matt Culbertson
review_text: Meh. I tend to love new flavors and items but this was a miss. The chicken skins were weird. The bacon jam was blah. The deviled eggs were good but 16 bucks for 4 is crazy, especially when they aren't the best I've had. It was ok though so 3 stars. Updated to one star seeing they charge credit card surcharge.

author: Yvonne
review_text: Had a great cocktail at the bar. We were seated and had another great cocktail. Service was friendly and they delivered great food! The shrimp, the devil's eggs!! The beat salad was also tasty.

author: Adam Shivers
review_text: We were in Downtown Las Vegas for vacation recently and we always heard amazing things about Carson Kitchen and we decided to stop in for dinner during our recent trip. We made a reservation in advance- the restaurant is pretty small, so definitely try to make a reservation if you can. We arrived a few minutes before our reservation and were seated promptly at a table near the front. Our server came by a few minutes later and offered to answer any questions we had on the menu. We ordered a bottle of wine to start, all at reasonable prices, they had a few options to pick from. We ordered the Pepp on Pepp flatbread to start ($18), and the Brussell Sprout Caesar Salad ($13) and two of the Pot Roast Dips ($19). All of the food was truly amazing and all very fresh and tasty! The service was also really good throughout the meal and efficient. We look forward to returning and highly recommend trying Carson Kitchen if you're in the Downtown Las Vegas area!

author: Karoadtrips
review_text: The entrance was not the easiest to find, but we managed to locate it. A spotless restaurant with extremely friendly staff. The menu has something for everyone, but the prices felt a bit high. The food was fresh, though, so it was worth it. I had chicken and waffles Benedict. Those weren't the best chicken and waffles I've had, but they'll do. Also love the big chunks of fresh fruit as a side. My Bloody Mary was also delicious. Although I requested not to be spicy, it still made my mouth tingle, but not to the point of being too spicy. So that one is forgiven. Every person working that day kept checking on me, to the point it became a bit annoying, honestly. However, when we asked for the check, we were offered the payment machine to be brought to our table. And the waitress already decided we were going to tip 25%... Although we could still change that before actually paying, the move didn't feel right, and it automatically makes me want to tip less. Worth it? If you like over-friendly service that expects big tips and fresh food, go for it. I don't think I'll be visiting again.

author: BREW
review_text: What an awesome place! It is a chain but this was our first visit. Well worth the trip! Great food and service! Emily, Kenna and the team are attentive and fun. We had a great experience all around. We will absolutely visit again. Walking distance from every hotel on Fremont street.

author: END ADVENTURES
review_text: We were recommended by our Air BnB host. And they were right in the mark. The menu is large, has so much available, something for everyone! We started with a Bellini and a mimosas flight. Amber was attentive and friendly. The food was great, especially the sour dough toast. Clean, airy, music playing. Definitely recommend. Erin EnD Adventures

author: Devan “D Leg” Legington
review_text: Broken Yolk Cafe was amazing from start to finish. My waitress D’Essence was fantastic. She was friendly, attentive, and went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect. I even requested a special order that wasn’t on the menu, and she made it happen without hesitation. The food was on point. The chicken was amazing, the eggs were fluffy, and my special cinnamon roll waffle was absolutely delicious. Everything came out hot and exactly how I wanted it. Great service, great food, and an overall excellent experience. I’ll definitely be back.

author: Liz S
review_text: No my first time in Vegas, but my first time at Broken Yolk and it did not disappoint! The food, the drinks, the service 10/10! My husband order the sopes, my son order the Diablo omelet and I ordered the ranchero skillet. We shared lemon custard pancakes and frozen drink flight. We were stuffed and there was food left over! Nice portions, good flavors and overall amazing service. Totally recommend!

author: Becky
review_text: From loud Freemont Street to Broken Yolk Cafe. It was a nice change of scenery. Let's jump right into this review. I'm not from Las Vegas so I have no logistical advice on how to get to the cafe or parking recommendations. But, it's worth you finding out or Google mapping yourself there. We visited on Saturday around noon. It was a 20 minute wait for a booth. What did we have - Mom Omelet - Spinach, mushroom, onion, red and green bell pepper. Topped with avocado, salsa fresca, and sour cream - (530 cal) - vegetarian -$17.95 -10/10 Californian Omelet -Bacon, homefries, American cheese. Topped with avocado and sour cream - (1050 cal) - $17.95 -10/10 ** Omelets are served with a side and toast. ** Food arrived quickly within 15 minutes. The inside of the cafe is asethically pleasing - bright colors, tables, booths, and bar seating available - indoor and outdoor. The menu had options/variety. Our server was friendly and personable. All the employees we encountered were friendly and welcoming. Great customer service overall. When I'm back in Las Vegas I'll definitely be dropping in for brunch.

author: Bebe William
review_text: This place is amazing. I love food. The portions are pretty big. They definitely give you your money's worth. Our server Noah was great. He was patient, attentive, and helpful. I gave 4 stars ⭐ because the hostess said we'd receive a text when they had a table available. We never received any contact nor did they call our name for a table. I went into the restaurant and she said she'd called us already. Which was false. I told her we had been sitting in the waiting area the entire time.

author: Jeremy Guzman
review_text: We decided to try this place for breakfast since we were in the area running errands. The food was very good. And despite it being very busy at the time we went, since we sat at the bar the service was really good. The prices where about the same to other common breakfast places. Even though ever since the pandemic breakfast can be around the same price as dinner these days. But that doesn't mean the food wasn't good. I had the Santa Fe skillet made with chorizo... As pictured. My wife had the classic eggs over easy.. Made very well. And yes I will be back and I do recommend. 👍😃

author: Hans Griese
review_text: Really great breakfast spot, easy to get to. Staff (Noah and Derrick) were awesome, really attentive. Vibes were cool but chill, nice easy start to a morning. Food was very tasty. I had: Chicken & Waffles Benedict: 8/10. Was really just chicken and waffles, but it was very tasty. Add syrup! Golden State Benedict: 10/10. delicious, hollandaise was well made, good balance of elements. Biscuit and Gravy (side): 7/10. Solid, nothing special. Presentation was meh, but I did like being able to add butter under the gravy. Bloody Mary Flight: 6/10. Solid options. Gin was meh, adding tobasco helped. Tequila was better, but wanted more spice. The two vodkas were both solid, but nothing crazy. The salt rim was really good lol.

author: Amanda Hoffman
review_text: Mike the manager went above and beyond to come to our table offering to fill our personal water bottles so we stay safe and having a great time during the day after we leave the restaurant. The food was delicious and hearty and our server D was very attentive and sweet! Will come back!

author: Roger Hamilton
review_text: This was our first visit, and we loved it. There is no free parking, but that is expected in downtown Las Vegas. There is a public parking lot attached to the building that is very convenient. The restaurant is modern and clean with floor to ceiling windows open to the street, and there is outdoor seating on a patio alongside the sidewalk. The staff was polite and friendly, while also being efficient and unobtrusive. Our food arrived within 10-15 minutes of us placing the order, which was pretty good since the place was at about 70% capacity. Once the food arrived, we couldn't wait to dig in because it looked delicious! We weren't disappointed with the flavors of the food either; it was excellent. In conclusion, I definitely recommend The Broken Yolk Cafe if you want some good food near The Freemont Street Experience without the big crowds.

author: Andrea Hernandez
review_text: Best place for breakfast. Our waitress was very attentive. A nice vibe here. The smoked salmon with avocado and capers was delicious. Mom's omelet was very good too. We enjoyed the champagne flight and tropical flights.

author: Maria Bashko
review_text: Great customer service! Cute decor and a large menu. I appreciate the vegan options. I had the Spicy Vegan bowl which filled me up for a long convention day. Highly recommend :)

author: Cynthia Kenina
review_text: It was our first time in Las Vegas and I am goodie and love sharing experience on my social media and this is how I found this place. We visited one near fremon street and wow menu was just amazing so much to choose from. I had bloody Marie at 8am don’t judge me I was on holiday. I had an omelette and my fiancé had something else, soon as we stepped in service was 10/10 nice new clean and most importantly so so delicious. I would defiantly fine broken yolk in different areas and visit again

author: namredwop
review_text: Very impressed, here on vacation and stopped in. Very nice breakfast place. Great atmosphere. Very fresh ingredients. Had the salmon bene came with fresh till on top.

author: Danica Bahadur
review_text: Great breakfast spot! Drink option was insane in the best way. We had the mimosa flight. Service was excellent. Manager was also great in that he checked on all the guest to make sure their food and service was great. I can definitely recommend this location as I know there are a few.

author: Bryson Ritz
review_text: Such a great experience! The Tiki Toast was a must get. Dee was a great server. Mike the General Manager came by and filled up our water bottles for us. Will definitely come back both for the great food but also the great service!

author: Tammy Pavelich
review_text: Food was great! Chicken n biscuits and a skillet, both were terrific and filling. Drinks were good, being Canadian, I find it somewhat difficult to find a good Ceasar in the U.S, mine was perfect! General manager was chatting with all the tables, giving a welcoming and relaxed atmosphere. They helped with some tourist attractions and recommendations and made a wonderful start to our day!

author: Raymond Bowman
review_text: Such a great experience! Will likely eat here everyday while in Vegas. The food was delicious and our server, D' Essence was very helpful and overall just so pleasant. This place is definitely newer and you can tell that all the staff clearly cares about everyones experience. You can not beat the pricing!!! Must try.

author: Leala Benally
review_text: The best was TASTY! And the Bloody Marry was cute and fun. Unfortunately our server was not the best. We had only seen our server twice during our time there and had to ask another server for the bill, etc. I recommend coming here if you have time to kill and don’t mind waiting because the food was awesome.

author: Priscilla Hernandez
review_text: The food here is amazing!!! I had the short rib fried rice and yellow chicken curry! Both spice level 3 which was perfect! Although the food is awesome what makes this place stand out to me is the service! My waitress was so attentive and all the employees were so friendly. The host Luis was amazing definitely set the tone for the evening. Nothing worse then when you get a rude host to ruin the evening. Definitely recommend.

author: Tony Skeans
review_text: Just one block off Fremont Street, Lay Thai proves that escaping the chaos pays off. The second you walk in, you realize this isn’t another overpriced Vegas eatery—it’s an oasis of flavor and value. The wok sear on the garlic fried rice is, GAWD, the best I’ve ever had—smoky, buttery, perfect texture, and just enough spice to keep you hooked. I ordered mine at a level three, which turned out to be the sweet spot for both me and my wife. You could go hotter, sure, but three gives you that balance of burn and flavor that makes Thai food sing. The crab rangoon? Adorable little handmade bundles of creamy perfection. The spring rolls? Crisp, light, and clean on the palate. And let’s talk about that bartending staff—easily some of the best I’ve ever encountered in Vegas: fast, personable, and genuinely proud of their craft. In a city that’s forgotten what a fair price and great food look like together, Lay Thai nails both. If you’re tired of inflated menus and tourist traps, step a block away—you’ll find flavor, service, and sanity right here.

author: Cole
review_text: Manny was absolutely amazing, best bartender I’ve had in a LONG time. Le Thai is easily the best restaurant I’ve had in Vegas, especially when factoring in quality, quantity, and price! The happy hour is great and the waterfall beef is insanely delicious. Also tried the beef short rib which was insane. I would recommend this place 1000 times. It was so good, we went back a second time. Got the yellow curry with short rib and it was fantastic as well. Definitely recommend!

author: Akhila Illa
review_text: We had to wait for 40 minutes to get our table. We tried 3 color curry, garlic fried rice and the mango sticky rice. None of them were good. There was no flavor at all. Mango sticky rice was the worst. I never imagined mango sticky rice can ever be bad, but it was a disaster here. Service is very slow, prolly because the restaurant is very busy. Overall, a let down :(

author: JM
review_text: BEST MEAL I HAD DURING A WEEK IN VEGAS! We were able to snag a seat at the bar around 7PM. We ordered drinks and the crispy spring rolls, which were AMAZING! I had the short rib fried rice and my husband had the green curry with pork. Everything was amazing. If I come back to Las Vegas, I will have to visit Le Thai again!

author: Cerah Venturo
review_text: Le Thai is seriously one of the best spots to eat in downtown fremont street. The green curry was incredibly flavorful, the oxtail meatball noodle soup was rich and comforting, and the Thai iced coffee was strong, sweet, and absolutely delicious. Every dish tasted fresh and well-balanced. The atmosphere is super cute with plants, warm lighting, and creative décor, and the service was friendly and fast. Brayan was a great server ! Overall, just a great vibe and amazing food.

author: Rafael Alvarez
review_text: I had a great meal and experience at Le Thai. This place gets busy but is worth the wait. I was seated immediately since I was just a party of one and went to the bar. Shout out to Gwen and Destiny for the great service. For my meal I ordered the cheese Rangoons and the 3 Color Curry. I wish I had more pictures to share of the meal but I got too eager and started digging into the curry before thinking to snap a picture. The Rangoons were delicious, crispy and filled to the brim with cream cheese. I definitely recommend for crab Rangoon lovers. As for the 3 color curry, it was exactly what I needed on a chilly evening. The curry was amazing with the right amount of spice.

author: Jinxiang Shi
review_text: A restaurant in Las Vegas with a lot of flavor. I've been to Thailand and the food here is very authentic, so the fact that so many people have given it good reviews is well deserved encouragement! I will definitely come back next time I'm in Las Vegas!

author: Rafael Souchet
review_text: Amazing experience. Manny was our waiter. He was incredible. Short rib fried rice, chicken fried rice, and waterfall beef all incredible. Best food we’ve had in vegas. Must go especially if you go to Fremont st.

author: Shelby Rice
review_text: My favorite place we ate in Las Vegas. Our waitress was so friendly and seemed passionate about the food and history of the place. I got the Pad Thai which was good, but I sampled the Pad Si Eew and it was on another level. Savory, a hint of sweetness. Would recommend that. They were out of the Mango Sticky rice which ended up being a pleasant surprise. The Ube Creme Brulee was SO DELICIOUS. The crisp, burnt sugar coating covered the whole dish. The ube custard below was thick and a perfect consistency. Highly recommend this restaurant.

author: JOE THOMAS
review_text: Le Thai Delivers Big Flavors! Le Thai on Fremont Street in downtown Las Vegas completely blew us away! From start to finish, it was a truly five-star dining experience. We kicked things off with the spring rolls and chicken satay, and both were absolute perfection. The spring rolls were fresh, crisp, and bursting with flavor, while the chicken satay was incredibly tender with a rich, delicious peanut sauce that we couldn't get enough of. But the real showstopper was the beef short rib with fried rice. Seriously, if you go to Le Thai, you must order this dish. The short rib was fall-off-the-bone tender and incredibly flavorful, and it paired perfectly with the savory fried rice. Every bite was a delight. Beyond the amazing food, the atmosphere was fantastic and the service was top-notch. Le Thai is now firmly on our must-visit list whenever we're in Las Vegas. You won't be disappointed!

author: Sandra Cash
review_text: This was my first time here. I will definitely be back! We had the waterfall beef, pork belly, the wings and the short rib beef fried rice with an egg on top. Also had the mango margarita. Food was delicious. This was more than enough for 3 people to share with leftovers.

author: Hagz
review_text: One of the best Thai restaurant in Vegas it's a must every time I visit. The staff was pleasant and extremely attentive. The remodel has changed this from a hole in the wall to a stylish spot for lunch and dinner. You can't go wrong with anything on the menu it's all amazing and the heat scale is very reasonable. Worth a trip to Fremont Street! 100% recommend!

author: Summer Smith
review_text: Visited this place by chance years ago and fell in love with the waterfall sauce. I have frequented over the years when traveling. Stopped in for a light meal before a music festival. Enjoyed the Larb chicken salad, mango margaritas, and always mango sticky rice. I have over the years decreased my heat level from 4 to 2. However i still find 2 on the Thai scale fairly spicy yet enjoyable. I sat at the bar and was surprised by the delightful bartender. He was knowledgeable, efficient, and attentive, Jose if I remember correctly. Regardless he was great! Food and drink were delicious and I took the dessert to eat in my room later, excellent option for no microwave.

author: Leslie Jones
review_text: From the time, I walked to the front patio with the hostess greeting me and my cousin, to the bar staff and servers everyone here are pleasant and welcoming. Then the food just amazing, I had the Cream Cheese Rangoons when I said cooked to perfection 😊 The owner mother did her big one with that amazing treat, my taste buds were pleased 😋 Wait one more thing, I had the Garlic Fried Rice with Chicken and a fried egg on top,no spicy because I can’t 😫but you can choose your level of heat 🌶️ My taste buds are so pleased, I had to stop eating because I was full for one and I wanted to write this review while still here

author: Amber Burns
review_text: Small hometown feel! Great atmosphere. Service is hopping and ready at your beck & call. Food came fast. Plum sauce and spring rolls were to perfection. Steak salad was excellent. Glad we found a local healthy place to eat!

author: Reno
review_text: We went there for dinner and the food and service were great. The food was so good that we decided to return for lunch the next day. However, two female staff members working at that time were very rude and ignored us when we asked for a table, so we decided not to have lunch that day. Overall, the food was excellent, but the poor service at lunch time was disappointing.

author: Xavier M
review_text: I tried the short rib fried rice, with a 3/5 spice level ((3 is definitely hot enough to feel it)) and it was excellent. You’re able to add an egg but I chose not too. Went in on a Monday and got seated without a wait but there’s usually a long line on busy nights, expect to wait 50-90 minutes on weekends. They also have an outdoor window for to-go orders. Bar has a nice selection of wines and local brews on tap, some imported beers and spirits as well. Pedro and Destiny were rocking the bar when I visited. Expect to pay downtown prices, but the portions are pretty large, definitely able to split an entree with 2-3 people.

author: GH W
review_text: I am not sure why this place has such a high rating. I have eaten hundreds of papaya salads in Europe, the US and in Thailand, where I spend 1-2 months every year and this was not a good papaya salad. It looked pretty authentic, but the taste was just not very sophisticated / refined. The Pad Thai was also on the lower scale in terms of taste. Further, the location is very busy and service rather slow. Nevertheless my waitress was pretty friendly at the end and asked me how everything was. Would not return here.

author: Mihir Kulkarni
review_text: Excellent lunch special. Really solid panang curry and Manny’s service was awesome. Thai iced tea was a bit watered down but still great. $17.34 after tip for my meal makes this a great value.

author: Suuraj
review_text: An excellent spot for authentic Thai food with one of the best ambiances in Las Vegas. The walls are beautifully painted with scenes that truly resemble Thailand, and popular English songs playing in the background add to the vibrant atmosphere. The restaurant was almost fully packed when we arrived, which speaks volumes about its popularity. The location on Fremont Street makes it even more special. Beng, our server, warmly welcomed us and provided outstanding hospitality; from taking our order to serving the food. She thoughtfully asked about allergies and spice preferences, which we really appreciated. We ordered the Red Curry with Tofu (similar to Panang curry), and it was one of the most flavorful and delicious curries I’ve ever had. The Veggie Pad Thai was equally impressive—perfectly balanced with a tangy taste, and the noodles had a unique dark brown, glass-like appearance. The Thai Iced Tea was absolutely amazing and a must-try. There are plenty of vegetarian options available; just ask the server for recommendations. Highly recommended for anyone looking for authentic Thai cuisine with great food, service, and ambiance.

author: Pitchaya Chanthawong
review_text: We came here 2nd time already this year as we live in England. I am Thai and my husband is English. We love Thai food so much as I cook every day at home. This restaurant is very good and all the food is so delicious and authentic. We love Ribeye waterfall ( Nam tok ) so much and all the other dishes are amazing too. P’ Kay assisted us with the order and even offered me to change a bowl of rice if it’s not hot anymore. He is very friendly with us. The food portions are big and we allowed to take some back to the hotel as I can’t finish all the dishes I ordered. Thanks so much for making me feel like home. We will definitely be back again soon ❤️

author: Londa Rozier-Taylor
review_text: A Whole Vibe on Fremont! Last night’s experience was everything! The dynamic duo on service absolutely nailed it — friendly, attentive, and full of great energy from the first “hello” to the final “baai-baai.” Customer service is everything to me, and they went above and beyond! The all-day happy hour is unbeatable — from the crispy calamari to the juicy pork belly, tasty spring rolls, and that papaya salad with a spicy punch that took me straight to Thailand. Every bite was perfection. The ambiance sealed the deal — tuk tuks, wall art of Bangkok, and a lively atmosphere that made us forget we were still on Fremont. I live over 30 minutes away, but this is officially my new spot. Thank you for one of the best nights out I’ve had in a long while — can’t wait to come back!

author: Nat Han
review_text: The man who took our order and served us our food could take some course in mannerism. He was rude. Didn't welcome or even greet us upon entering. This was our second choice because the other Thai Restaurant that we wanted to try had a line out the door. So we came here. The food was mediocre and way over priced. The portion was not worth the price but had the employee pretend to be friendly then I would have been fine with it. We thanked him multiple times but he didnt care to respond. This place should learn better customer service. No wonder this place was empty.

author: Life Of A Nomad
review_text: Authentic flavors and colorful presentation! Bangkok Street Thai Street Kitchen brings true Thai street vibes to Las Vegas. The papaya salad was super fresh, crunchy, and bursting with lime and chili just the right kick! The chicken satay was tender and grilled perfectly, served with creamy peanut sauce and sticky rice on the side. Everything came out beautifully plated, full of color and flavor. The place has that cozy local feel with great service and a chill atmosphere. Perfect for anyone who loves real Thai food. Highly recommend if you want a little Bangkok experience right here in Vegas!

author: Zhip Phow
review_text: You must have the Salmon Carpaccio and the Larb Chicken, $10 each! This wonderful place has $5 Drafts! Modern, Clean, Inviting, and Service IS Tops! The servers that made my day, Bird and Top, great Bros. A Draft one Must try is Cali Squeeze, sweet, and flavorful. Dont Pass By ... Stop In

author: Joe Murphy
review_text: I took my Father to the Freemont Street Experience tonight for his birthday and after enjoying the scenery and street concerts Vegas has to offer, we stumbled into Bangkok Street Thai Restaurant. The staff was great and the food was amazing. My Father and I had the Drunken Noodles. It was absolutely delicious. You gotta check this place out and Bird thank you for the great service.

author: Apple Galaxy
review_text: We went to Chinatown and ate at Bangkok street food. There was a lady who serenaded everybody while they were eating. I ordered the orange chicken and my wife had the garlic chicken. I highly recommend going there! The food was everything I thought it would be!

author: Caylin Lancione
review_text: Amazing spot. Top and all the crew are wonderful people and great at what they do. So delicious, great drink options and specials. Sake bombs too! I had the Tokyo Tea and Drunken Noodle with beef. Superb 🔥

author: Laura Amador
review_text: Richard was awesome. It was my first time in and he answered all of my questions. It helped me make a fantastic choice. I had the steak with Thai fried rice I take a picture of my food, but I already devoured it I also had a lychee martini which was really good

author: guy nolan
review_text: Kay and Richard were great ! I popped in mid afternoon for a few drinks and a light snack and I wasn't disappointed. Is refreshing change from the craziness of the main part of Fremont street further up the road. I highly recommend this place.

author: jan Kennedy
review_text: Absolutely love this place! Had the best drunken noodles with shrimp that I have ever eaten!! Richard and Banks are the real thing. Richard came over and introduced himself to us!

author: Jimmy Si
review_text: Decent place. They tell you to order at the front if you're ready, but they also take your order at your table. The waiter was very nice and attentive. It was nice they they offered hot water long with regular water. I ordered the khao soi with the large chicken. My family ordered the green curry and pad Thai. I also ordered the papaya salad. The papaya salad was very refreshing and good and had that nice tangy flavor. The khao soi had a good broth and the noodles were very good and the chicken was very tender and huge. The green curry with chicken was decent. The pad Thai was ok. This place is also a bar/cocktail place and it has a decent selection to choose from. I had the pfriem Japanese lager that was very smooth. The place is very much like a late night bar eats which gives it a cool vibe.

author: Jaxson Alexander Rourke
review_text: I recently visited Bangkok Street Thai Street Kitchen and overall it was a decent experience. The food was good we tried the Pad Thai and some of the curries, and the flavors were pleasant and reasonably authentic. The service was friendly and polite, which added to the visit. On the downside, the portion sizes felt a bit small for the price, and the atmosphere was nothing special just average. I might come back if I’m in the area and craving Thai food, but I wouldn’t go out of my way for it.

author: Mafrey S
review_text: I went there for dinner, and the service was amazing. However, I was very disappointed with the papaya salad. It lacked flavor, and the sauce didn’t taste right—it seemed like it might have been pre-made. I mentioned it to the server, but they said it was American style. My husband tried the papaya salad as well and agreed that the taste was off. On a positive note, the baked mussels were delicious and ended up being our favorite dish of the night.

author: Wander in Wisconsin
review_text: I had the Thai Green chicken curry which was fantastic. The eggplant was a nice addition. The owner was very friendly and the restaurant is very clean. They offer Thailand beverages and lemon diffused ice water. I highly recommend esp if you’re look for Authentic Thai food.

author: Margot Perry
review_text: Absolutely phenomenal! This Thai restaurant blew me away from start to finish. The flavors were bold, authentic, and perfectly balanced—every dish felt like a masterpiece. The service was warm and attentive, making the whole experience even more memorable. I honestly can’t recommend it enough; if you’re craving Thai food that’s both comforting and exciting, this is the place to be!

author: Paul Niehouse
review_text: Abolutely fabulous food! Had the pork belly appetizer, green curry Chicken and the Daisy, Eggplant with basil and a Lychee martini. Everything was absolutely fabulous. Finished every bite. Can't wait to go back again!

author: Kpop Girl
review_text: SERIOUSLY amazing GOOD authentic Thai food!! My husband and I eat here multiple times EVERY single time we visit Vegas! (A true hidden gem!!) YES, it's THAT good!! And they have crazy good prices!! Try their crazy wings, mussels with seafood sauce, papaya salad with sticky rice and Tom Yum!! WOW! So so YUMMY!! And their service is fantastic!! AND Kay was AMAZING server too!!!

author: Tedd Lookatch
review_text: Right at the end of Fremont's experience, just a little outside the crazy zone, you'll find a nice little authentic taste of Thai. Big beer selection, including Chang Singha and slew of good selection and locals. The person next to me highly enjoyed theirLechee martini. The vibe with live feed footage of the streets of Bangkok lived up the hype. They had a huge menu with of of options including many specials. I tackled the dungeness crab fried rice perfect for late night bite. Light, fresh, and layered flavors made a simple dish a lot more complex. The red curry and its 18 ingredients made fresh had a nice snap to it to it. The yellow was more mild and balanced. Patron next to me took on a ribeye plate and raved about the flavorful cook on the meat.

author: Spud Racing
review_text: Incredible! My new favorite restaurant in Vegas. Would come here every day if I could. Lol. Portions are huge and the food delicious. The house and hibiscus margaritas were fantastic. Didn't actually like the other two specialty margaritas much, but they were interesting and beautiful if nothing else.

author: Ryo Zsun
review_text: Met up with an old friend at Nacho Daddy, one of my go-to spots in Vegas, and it didn’t disappoint. The newly renovated space looks great, and our server James set the tone with friendly, upbeat service. We started with the Daddy Wings (a must!) — perfectly crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside, and always a crowd-pleaser. For our main, we shared the Supreme Nachos, loaded with toppings and just the right amount of heat. My friend loved the vibe and said she wants to come back — same here. Whether you’re catching up with friends or just craving solid nachos and wings, Nacho Daddy is always a great choice.

author: Chris Peralta
review_text: Great food and great drinks here! The nachos pictured were as good as they look! I ordered the house margarita, and I was prepared for it to be just OK since house margaritas tend to be -- but it was actually very good! I recommend!

author: Irania Rodriguez
review_text: Randomly found the place while visiting Vegas and on Fremont St area. We told them we were celebrating his birthday and they were generous enough to provide a fried ice cream dessert with cinnamon sugar chips! They tasty food and the nachos order we had was enough for 2!

author: Ann Nguyen
review_text: Late-night dinner when we are in Las Vegas. We ordered Mexican Corn as a starter. Rating our orders from most to least favorite: 1. Chicken Tinga Nacho was my top pick, great seasoning, and it's hard to find chicken tinga sold at stores, usually only grandma makes it at home. 2. Filet Mignon Nacho, very good. 3. Al Pastor Nachos. The drinks came in huge sizes, perfect for a birthday celebration. The staff were very kind.

author: Simple Things
review_text: Nacho Daddy has a large, open space that’s perfect for big groups, with plenty of seating options to fit everyone’s vibe. Our waiter was super helpful, kind, and knowledgeable, which made the experience even better. The food was good and the drinks were refreshing. If you’re in Vegas looking for a spot with a fun bar vibe and great atmosphere, this is definitely the place to be!

author: Anthony Maxwell
review_text: It was a wonderful experience. Actually, I was told to go here by my side and just a lap and a friend of mine. When is some nachos so we went here? The service was great. The food was fresh i had the enchilada nachos.I left a picture, the music was cool, and the atmosphere was cool. Great spot to sit down and have something to eat or to drink. I definitely will go back..

author: Aditya Goyal
review_text: Living in Texas, I thought there can be no place for a better Mexican food experience. I was pleasantly proved wrong by Nacho daddy . The menu is very refreshing. A lot of options for vegans and vegetarians. It’s not possible not to overeat at this place.

author: Jamie L
review_text: Outstanding service! Somehow our group reservation wasn't in their system, but they quickly accommodated us, and they were happy to do so. From walking in the door to paying the tab, everyone we encountered was friendly and helpful. Our server, Jaredh, was very attentive and nice. Even the manager, Kevin, took care of us at times with a kind and friendly disposition. Also, the food was delicious! And the drinks... Get the margarita flight!

author: Reaching The Soul
review_text: Just a short walk around the corner of the Fremont street experience and you will find yourself at Nacho Daddy! It’s a fun casual atmosphere nothing fancy, but they have a great menu with lots of choices for unique style nachos. We were just looking for a snack so we shared the Al Pastor and had a margarita and we dug into it before I even had a chance to take a picture, but it was very good, but if you’re hungry, I would not share it again. To me, the portion size was a little smaller than I expected, and that was the larger size nacho platter that we were told we were getting. I would definitely go back to try another one of their creations . They have a tequila shot with a scorpion in it that they offer and you get a free shot glass if you down the scorpion 🤣 I did not partake as I’ve already had close encounters with scorpions since I live in Arizona 🤣

author: Celeste Zanabria
review_text: Good joint just off of miracle mile, if you walk down where the boat is and past the Brazilian steakhouse. We ordered a few plates: chicken quesadilla, wings, rice and beans, 2 carnitas tacos, chicken nachos and chips and salsa. I loved the tacos, great amount of meat for the price (2 for $7). Nachos were also good. I asked for only the avocado, chicken, cheese, and pickled onions. The chicken quesadilla and wings were for my bf. He liked the seasoning on the wings and the chicken quesadilla was as should be. It wasn't until dinner time, at another place, I realized that my beans and rice was never brought out :( we were charged for it, and now I'll never know if the place was a 10/10 (I base my "Mexican food" review off of their rice and beans, a staple and must). If staying near, I'd probably be back. The awesome early 2000s punk/pop music is a keeper!!

author: Vaibhav Jain
review_text: Loved the food—lots of great vegetarian options and tasty dips. The atmosphere is lively, but the loud music can make conversation tough. Overall, a fun spot with flavorful dishes

author: Lisa Russ
review_text: Great food, salsa great went for lunch with others. The street tacos with rice and beans and the quesadillas. Check this place out and try the scorpion shot. Cool decor 😎

author: Sridutt Miraskar
review_text: Great spot just steps away from the Fremont Street Experience, yet far enough to escape the crowd and noise. Comfortable seating, a friendly bartender, and plenty of beer options to try. Even late on a weekday night, the staff had the same energy and enthusiasm, encouraging us to sample different brews. We only had a beer and a cocktail since we were full, but both were excellent. Bonus: free parking right in front of the restaurant after midnight.

author: Christina McFarland
review_text: The food was verry tasty, chicken quesadilla could use a bit more sessoning with the meat but salsa helped, if you order the coffee is it a light/medium roast so not really on par- with dark/french roast. Server was happy and attentive. The flaming fajita mix (stake and shrimp) Was awsome easily enought for two if your light eatters Blackened Brisket Tip Natchos- were tasty, think we would have prefered tortilla chips- the potato chips got soggy really fast.(still tasted great)

author: Jenny T
review_text: Overall the chicken quesadilla was the best dish. The nachos would have been nicer if they didn’t forget to add the guacamole and I didn’t realise until I looked at another review with it on it. So make sure you check that the guacamole is on the nachos if you ask to have the same dish as pictured!! The burrito was just average, nothing special. I loved the margarita!! Favourite I have had to date. The setting is nice would come again.

author: Erika Graham
review_text: Love the atmosphere here on Fremont Street . The food was ok but , love the fact they offer vegan options. James our server was fantastic polite and very pleasant. When I make it back to Vegas I’ll hit it up!

author: PraSan
review_text: Love this place. Everyone is so nice and our waiter was really nice and awesome! I am coming again with friends. Love this place so much. It is authentic nacho and it is really good.

author: BREW
review_text: Good place to stop, just off Fremont St. Lots of nacho options. Did not disappoint. Perfect size to share and very tasty!

author: Lexie Corrie
review_text: Deanza served AMAZING service I will come back only when she is working and solely for her service. She brought personality and customer service to the maximum. She didn’t make me feel like just another customer she made me feel like THE customer. She made my night and I will come back only for her. Thank you <3

author: Datashia Stansell Estes
review_text: We had an amazing time! I took my fiance here for his birthday yesterday and we had great food,service and drinks! Our waitress was so sweet and nice! I'm assuming the gentleman with the hat was the owner he got us seated very quickly and he was very kind. We felt very welcomed. Upon them knowing it was his birthday they came out singing and brought him a tequilla shot!! Very big menu 😋 very tasty! We will be back also great drink specials.

author: Michael Elias
review_text: Definitely the best spot for a Mexican family breakfast! Authentic comida that’s full of flavor—perfectly seasoned and prepared. The atmosphere is great, almost like when I was a Lil one. Customer service is truly beyond on point. I highly recommend Frannie as your serve, she was the best! It felt like we were part of her familia, and even though she had other tables, it was like we were the only ones there. I’m sure all her tables would agree. We’ll definitely always come back here. Thank you, Frannie!

author: Leo03
review_text: An authentic Mexican restaurant. We enjoyed our lunch here, it was delicious! If you like coffee you have to try the cafe de olla with the concha bread to dip, it was amazing! I recommend the chilaquiles with the ranchera it’s fire! The burritos are delicious too! Huge menu with many Mexican dishes, we will be back to try the other options soon! The sever was very nice and took very good care of us!

author: Lj
review_text: This is a family friendly Mexican restaurant. They serve the best authentic Mexican-inspired breakfast. The atmosphere is lively with friendly service. Our waiter Lorenzo was very attentive & made sure our food arrived quickly. They are famous for their pancake & mimosa flights. Best of all you have to have their cafe de olla, served with a concha. Their portions are large & the prices are reasonable. Definitely have to come back & try the other amazing dishes!

author: Frank Herrera
review_text: I don't want to give up this hidden gem but too good to keep it a secret! Nothing on the menu disappoints!! Cafe de olla a must try with a free piece of pan dulce! Now to the service.....my boy Frank handled business with top notch service. I always come here when in town not only for the food but amazing service! Pictured is the sopes of chorizo and papas and chilaquiles tricolor.

author: Leticia Berrios
review_text: I ordered the tricolor chilaquiles and they were amazing! They come with a very generous portion steak. Their cafe de la olla was delicious and they serve it with a concha bread that is to die for. It was so soft and very tasty. Our server Marvin was very nice and attentive and brought our food out pretty quickly. I highly recommend you try this place out if you are looking for excellent authentic Mexican food with great service.

author: Alivey Maldonado
review_text: The food is so good and so many options!! I love the mexican music playing the whole time. Really represents our culture. Lots of authentic mexican food options as well as american. George was our server and he was super friendly. They provided fast service. 10/10 recommend. Will come back next time i am in vegas!

author: Christina Estrada
review_text: What an incredible and authentic Mexican restaurant! I visited with my boss and a coworker, and we loved the experience. The service was fantastic our waiter was friendly, funny, and let us taste-test all the mimosa flavors (which were seriously yummy!). Great food and a wonderful time.

author: Yadira Breland
review_text: It is wonderful to find a breakfast restaurant with so many delicious platters to choose from. My all time favorite is the Tri-Color Chilaquiles with the New York Steak! The green sauce is tangy and yummy. The red sauce is just the right spice and flavor! The steak was cooked medium rare with tons of flavor! The atmosphere is nice, cozy, and relaxing. Our server Lorenzo was very welcoming and on point! I recommend this place to anyone missing home made Mexican food!!! The "Cafe de olla" is the bomb!!!

author: Freddy Gonzalez
review_text: Absolutely wonderful food! You definitely get your money's worth here, great proportions for your meal, the pancake flight was the perfect size to not overwhelm you. Mimosa flight was very good as well. Shout out to Lorenzo for being a great server, very attentive and wasn't helicoptering over us, came in just in time to refill drinks, customized breakfast orders were executed perfectly and was friendly the entire time we were there. Some of the best Mexican food in Vegas, and bonus stars for being a local business. Highly recommend and can't wait to return.

author: Ray Martinez
review_text: Frank was an excellent waiter and he suggested items for us to try since it was our first time here. Food recommendations was great and we will definitely be back and also recommend this place to our friends. Loved this place, the food and our waiter Frank. Best food in Vegas!

author: Adriana Rivera
review_text: We arrived at 9:30a, got seated right away. I ordered the mimosa flights, Jorge (server) recommended some yummy flavors! My crepes combo hit the spot, came w/2 eggs, bacons & sausage all very good. My daughter loved her cafe de olla & my son his chocolate milk shake. Jorge was very attentive, great customer service! Will def be back soon.

author: Stephanie Rivas
review_text: We visited this establishment for the first time on a Friday morning and were pleased to find there was no wait time. Our server was exceptionally kind and efficient. The food was average; I ordered the carne asada burrito with a side of French fries. However, I was disappointed to find French fries already included in the burrito, which defeated the purpose of ordering them as a side. The carne asada had an unusual flavor, and I only managed to eat half of the burrito. We also tried the mini trio pancakes, expecting a variety of flavors, but were surprised that the Oreo pancakes only had Oreo toppings and as well as the dulce de leche pancakes hint of dulce de leche. The strawberry pancakes lacked banana flavor despite being labeled as strawberry and banana. The concha served with café de la olla was only half a concha. Given the food's somewhat lacking flavor profile, I personally do not think I will be returning.

author: Suspish
review_text: Steph our server was so nice, and on her game! Give her a raise! She kept our cafe filled, and was very helpful and attentive. The food really is amazing, and priced well! Please come!!! You will not regret it! Better than any breakfast spot around!!

author: Chris Guarnieri
review_text: Stephanie was one of the best waitresses we had came across. She gave great service and recommendations for food. The mango mimosa was the best one we sampled and ended up getting a big one to share. Will definitely be making this a regular stop.

author: Addriana Esparza
review_text: “We came for breakfast and loved everything from start to finish. The chilaquiles were flavorful, the beans tasted homemade, and the tortillas were fresh. The staff made us feel like family. Jeanine was our server, she was the sweetest and made our experience memorable. Can’t wait to come back!”

author: Jessica Bishop
review_text: The food here never misses! Always delicious and full of flavor! You need to get the chorizo sopes. On this visit we had Johnathan and the service was fantastic! He had a full section but took excellent care of us. Very attentive and friendly! We’ll be sure to ask for him every visit!

author: Soly Portillo
review_text: When driving up to the place you think two things. One, where will I park and two, this place must be very good. I didn't actually have to wait for parking that long. Under 3 minutes. Also it was on a Saturday morning. They have bench seating even outside of where you check in your party which is a nice gesture especially for those who need/want to sit while waiting in line. The servers were on the go at all times. So we waited under 20 minutes which showed just how quickly the service was. The placed was a little crammed up it seemed like but, walked through the aisles with no problems. The agua fresa drinks are made from concentrated. Unfortunately. The liquados were made well. All there dishes seemed like they had a little of that spicy . It tasted really great except, not everyone such as a person in my group can handle and amount of it. There fresh coffee from their pot was delicious. Lorenzo was the server. He was quick. He was knowledgeable about what they had. His suggestions were tried with appreciation. With one of the plates having a piece of shell from the egg still, I let them know so they could mention to the chefs. I know you guys are busy and all but dont rush to where it becomes a growing mistake. The noise level was perfect unlike those other places that have music so loud you can't even hear yourself think. I heard it was like a Spanish Dennys. I reminds me more of Eli's on the eastside. As if they was its sister. Maybe they are? It was priced well compared to other places. I think I went in there with higher expectations. Overall decent place.

author: Tandie Nunez
review_text: From Utah trying here loved it definitely go eat there real Mexican food so good I had chilaquiles kids had carne asada burrito and other kid Nutella pancakes coffee was amazing 🤩

author: Sandra Elizondo
review_text: We are in town visiting from Texas staying at the Aria and my husband found this place on Tik Tok and I must say we will be back 10/10 Carolina was Great and answered all our questions we had about menu. Everything was delicious.

author: John in NV
review_text: First time at this place, it's a very cool diner type in a pretty busy strip mall, there's a capriotti's, roberto's, and a wing place. The parking lot is pretty busy but I was able to find parking at 10:30 in the morning on a Tuesday. The food was delicious particularly the pancakes with their homemade syrup. The country fried steak with pork meat was also very tasty. They were very busy, so I had to wait a bit for my coffee refill. The coffee was worth the wait, one of the best at a diner I've ever had. I would come back here anytime.

author: April Butler
review_text: Literally probably the best breakfast I've ever had. Visiting for for hubby's bday and our 10 year anniversary. The service was phenomenal and the food was even better. These 2 employees made our whole experience that much better at this restaurant and we're a highlight of our day. Not to mention the bloody Mary was SO GOOD and I'm a bloody Mary connoisseur. GO EAT HERE AND SUPPORT THIS RESTAURANT

author: gina theesfield
review_text: Delicious food and friendly service. Large portions. We ordered country fried steak, French Toast w candied pecans and fried chicken sandwich. Biscuit was a bit doughy and claggy. Cornflakes were a nice touch to the French toast. I ordered the season drink of apple horchata coffee. It was not a good flavor profile. I do not recommend that drink. Plenty of parking, but currently hard to get to with the amount of construction going on in the area. Kinda pricey. $100 for 3 including tip. Definitely a great stop during our brief visit to Vegas.

author: Jo V.
review_text: Winnie & Ethel's proved to be an excellent place to meet up for brunch with wonderful foodie friends, which makes Winnie & Ethel's even more iconic 👏🏽 One of their best features is their venue. Feeling like an expanded living and dining area in someone's home, we were seated at a good-sized long table with enough elbow room, and table space for all our plates. Check out their drink specialties! Their drink and food menus are ones to really browse through and make calculated decisions, because their selections are all appetizing 😋 Service with a smile and attentiveness from Katherine (I believe) was what any customer would love. Many thanks for making our ordering and dining experience easy. We know how stressful large groups and extremely busy weekends can be. If you haven't eaten at Winnie & Ethel's yet, make your reservation in advance. They book up for a reason. Come enjoy and experience it for yourself, and learn about its special history.

author: Dolores Damian
review_text: Such a cute mom and pop spot. Got the cold brew it was good. But asked for flavor and basically had to make my own coffee. They even brought out the milk for me. Got the club sandwich and man that was huge! But good. The sausage in the biscuits and gravy were not that great.

author: Cristina Anderson
review_text: Great food! Impeccable service and beautiful decor. I truly enjoyed this place! Make reservations ahead of time. We came here at 8:45am and luckily I made reservations otherwise it would be an hour wait and I understand why! It’s not in the best location but I felt 100% safe at least in the morning, so don’t quote me if you’re going in the evening. I had the French toast (which was fresh and delicious) and a rose and vanilla cold brew, my kids had fried French toast. Definitely go!!

author: Jamie Spranger
review_text: This was a great spot for a pre-wedding breakfast. Our server was fun and attentive. She even brought us mimosas to celebrate! The plates were plentiful and tasty. My onion bacon and mushroom omelet really hit the spot and I was fueled for the the big day being a brides maid. It was a cute place with an old school style inside. If we are in the area we would come back.

author: Kyla Burton
review_text: We had been hearing a lot of good things about Winnie & Ethel's and being locals, of course we had to give it a try. We went mid-week to avoid the long wait times on the weekend. We had to wait for just a few minutes and we're seated. The restaurant decor was nicely done, with a comfortable feel. The waitress came immediately with a great attitude and a friendly and knowledgeable demeanor. We ordered right a way. I chose the catfish & grits with their special Mothership coffee and my husband got steak & eggs. Everything was well prepared and tasty. We really enjoyed our meal. The only downside was, it took quite a long time to get our food, close to 30 minutes and we weren't the only ones. But it gave us a chance to chat with some other locals sitting on either side of us. We also thought it was a little pricier than other breakfast restaurants, $75 for two regular breakfasts and 2 drinks plus tip. Overall, it was a good experience.

author: Faray Almazrouei
review_text: Winnie and Ethel’s is the kind of diner that makes you feel instantly at home the moment you walk in. Nestled in downtown Las Vegas, it blends that old-school diner charm with a touch of modern flair. The staff are genuinely friendly, greeting you like a regular even on your first visit, which sets the tone for a relaxed and welcoming experience. The menu is full of comforting classics done right—fluffy pancakes, perfectly crispy hash browns, and hearty sandwiches that hit the spot any time of day. The portions are generous without feeling over the top, and everything tastes fresh and thoughtfully prepared. What really stands out, though, is the atmosphere. It has that nostalgic, retro-diner vibe but feels clean and updated, making it a cozy place to enjoy breakfast with friends or a late-night bite. Whether you’re a local or just exploring downtown, Winnie and Ethel’s is the kind of spot that leaves you planning your next visit before you’ve even finished your coffee.

author: Neil May
review_text: Excellent food. Their waffles are savory and lovely. One of the better coffees. My wife's club sandwich looked fresh and massive. I'm also glad to see the arts district is growing and improving.

author: George Dickerson
review_text: Winnie & Ethel's Downtown Diner is a true Las Vegas gem. All of the food items are homemade. My favorite is the Diner Breakfast. I always get all bacon that comes with 2 eggs, home style potatoes, and a biscuit. In addition, I get coffee and water. I can say that this place never disappoints and the staff here are absolutely amazing! This truly is the best breakfast place in Las Vegas!

author: Karen Shepard
review_text: Our first meal we had once we got to Vegas was this restaurant. It was totally hopping. Busy. Busy. We had no reservation (highly recommended), but got seated quickly since it was myself and my husband. I had a breakfast special with a pancake (a huge one at that),and my husband had a huge omelet. There was so much food we couldn't finish it! But it was so gosh darn delicious! All fresh. All homemade. So we boxed it up and had it later on. This place is so amazing that we went back again, the day we were leaving Vegas 😪. I had sausage gravy and biscuits(huge bowl) and my husband had a breakfast burrito (that was huge also). Soooooo goooood!! So much food we got that boxed up and finished it before we got on the plane. Please go visit Winnie & Ethel's. You won't be disappointed! I guarantee it 👍👍

author: Kagura Misaka
review_text: Our family came here for brunch on the last day of our Vegas trip after seeing it recommended online, and it absolutely lived up to its name. The food was absolutely incredible, flavorful, and the menu is such a great blend of classics. The service was so amazing as well, with Cheri being such a sweet server and taking such great care of us. The rest of the staff were also just as kind and their energy really adds to the comfy atmosphere. We are already excited about our next visit to Vegas so we can hit this gem of a diner again! Highly recommend and many thanks!

author: Megan Alvarez
review_text: What a gem! Food was amazing, awesome atmosphere, and the service was excellent. We had the breakfast sandwich and country fried steak and eggs with a side of pork belly! Yum! Had the Cherry Lemonade to go and it was delicious. Our waitress, Melissa, was attentive and sweet. Will definitely be sharing Winnie and Ethel’s with any and everyone we know visiting Vegas.

author: Daryl Combs
review_text: Arrived at about 9:30 Sunday am. Was told there would be about a 20 minute wait and that I would get a text. An hour later, still nothing. Went inside and was told, “sure we can seat you.” Of course that was true, she had 6 empty tables. FYI: an important metric for restaurants is turns of the tables – if they are empty, there is no revenue. So, we were seated, and almost immediately, Catherine showed up. Catherine had just finished the last of a coffee pot and a Dentyne commercial, so she was way too hyped for us. She then proceeded to tell us about every single new drink that was available from the bar, and each one was better then the last. Sorry, we were not interested in drinks. Next the menu. After my wife decided on the pancakes, next came all the add ons, blueberries, eggs, hot chocolate, etc. She felt like she had just chosen the Dodge in the back and had been pushed to get the seat covers and spinners. I ordered the haystack. Wife was satisfied with her pancake. The haystack was not as I pictured in my mind – it basically was fries with chorizo gravy dumped on it and the worlds smallest egg on top. We came here for the chorizo gravy because of @brandonfromvegas, but it didn’t live up to his hype. All in all, the food was edible, but the experience was not so much.

author: Endea McKnight
review_text: First, I would like to say Kathryn is one of the best waitresses I’ve ever had ! I visit a Las Vegas restaurant 1-3 times a week and I have had some great service but Kathryn is now number one . She made several recommendations and gave me a background on the coffee, house potatoes and malt syrup. She seemed very excited about their menu items which made me even more excited. She was also very attentive . I just loved her energy and fun sweater. Next, the house potatoes were incredibly crispy on the outside and fluffy in the inside. The gravy on the chicken fried steak had something special in it. The gravy was sweet and savory. Lastly , I never want to eat a waffle without malt syrup again !

author: Melody Quiros
review_text: Great service and excellent breakfast and lunch items. Everything looked delicious from what we saw and we both loved our food, we just couldn’t eat it all of course. Brandon was a great server and knows the menu well. We both had their specialty elderberry and pistachio coffee and we loved them

author: Kimberly Vallejo (Kimbuyanda)
review_text: Good experience server was very nice. Food took a while to arrive and my father's plate was the last one we were waiting for with was only a sandwich so we sat at our table watching out food getting cold waiting for my father's sandwich to arrive. It was his birthday too. Food was ok. I had to ask for tomatoes on my plate so it didn't look all brown. Dad enjoyed his sandwich with was good. Overall good experience.

author: Misti Pierce
review_text: I had been wanting to eat at this restaurant for over a year, & it did not disappoint! We went for Brunch. The Staff was fantastic from the moment we walked in the door. They were busy, so we put our name on the list & got seated within 30min. We tried some of the new Drink Menu items & loved them both. We shared a Breakfast Plate, which was more than enough for 2 people. We also added 1 of their famous Pancakes, at the suggestion of our Waiter. Highly recommend.
