The prices were extremely fair & we enjoyed everything about this restaurant. Next time we are in Vegas, we will definitely eat at Winnie & Ethel's again.

author: Leo Jacquez
review_text: We’ve been regulars at Winnie & Ethel for a while and always enjoyed it, but this last visit was rough. From the moment we walked in, the floor was covered in crumbs and it didn’t feel clean at all. The staff seemed robotic and unhappy, with zero warmth or friendliness. Every request felt like a hassle, even just asking for water refills. I tried to swap poached eggs for scrambled and was told they “can’t do substitutions” even though I’ve done it numerous times, including last week. The food, which is usually great, came out overcooked and just off. The place is still nice inside, but between the lack of cleanliness, poor service, and disappointing food experience. Hopefully this was just an off day, but it was enough to make us think twice about coming back.

author: sergio perez
review_text: Coming for the barbacoa not complain, take my back to mexico flavors Saturday mid-day they are busy Menudo, my son's likes the menudo and quesabirrias. Churros small p good. Thanks

author: Jackie esquivel
review_text: I was here earlier with my family for our first time service was bad constantly had to keep reminding our server for what we asked .. I got my 4 year old the nugget basket with French fries she took couple bites of it and to find out it was raw.. look at this like how can this happen very disappointing I will not be coming here again .

author: Carmen Pineda
review_text: Barbacoa didn't disappoint! The food was delicious, but what really makes ut special is our server maria. She's so kind, always checking in on us, and made my first time visit feel welcoming. We truly appreciate her! I'm from Santa Ana, CA this is worth the trip and ill definitely be coming back again!

author: Adrian Zambrano
review_text: I like it alot they have good deals and prices that you can’t be the food also tastes very authentic and Mexican. The people were very kind and made me feel welcome. I 100% guarantee this amazing restaurant.

author: Jasmin R
review_text: My family and I came to this restaurant for dinner and was pleasantly surprised but the atmosphere. Our server, Fabi, was attentive and super friendly.

author: Hyunwoo J

author: YEREMIAH PRINCE
review_text: To give Pepe's Tacos just five stars feels like an injustice. If I could, I'd give them 45 stars for their exceptional food, incredible value, and consistent quality. This place is a Las Vegas institution for a reason. Let's start with the food: authentic, flavorful, and generously portioned. The carne asada fries are legendary—piled high with perfectly seasoned steak, rich nacho cheese, and a perfect blend of toppings. It's a full meal that could feed two, and it's easy to see why it was voted the best in Las Vegas. For taco purists, the street tacos are a revelation. Whether you go for the succulent carnitas or the spicy adobada, the meat is cooked to perfection and served on fresh, warm tortillas. The condiment bar is stocked with fresh salsas and toppings that add the perfect final touch. Service is fast and friendly, even during the busiest hours. The fact that it's open 24/7 is a gift to anyone looking for a satisfying late-night meal that's a massive step up from fast-food chains. This isn't just a restaurant; it's a dependable, delicious cornerstone of the community. Pepe's Tacos delivers a fantastic, authentic Mexican food experience every time, and that's worth more than five stars in my book.

author: Jenifer Mattock
review_text: We’ve eaten at this IHOP a few times and it’s always been great. Even though it’s located in a casino and therefore cigarette smoke is unavoidable, the restaurant is always clean and very comfortable. We ate there last night and there was only one visible employee on duty, Roger, who took excellent care of us. He was polite, attentive, and genuinely seemed eager to provide excellent service. There’s one key detail that I believe makes the biggest impact on guest satisfaction that many, if not most, restaurant servers fail to understand. That is checking back a minute or two after order delivery to make sure everything is satisfactory and asking if they need anything else. Roger not only did that, when I asked for a side of mayonnaise, he brought it promptly along with a refill of my husband’s soda which he noticed was nearly empty when he delivered our food. At the end of the meal, he thanked us for coming in—another thing many restaurant workers fail to do a lot of the time. It might seem like I’m Roger’s mom or friend based on my glowing review, but I’m just a former waitress who remembers what it’s like to only have negative experiences reported. Last but not least, our meals were delicious. We’ll definitely be back soon.

author: John Castillo
review_text: You know, I hate like heck to be so negative about this place, but I have to be honest. In the quest for the franchisee to realize profitability, unfortunately they have gone down a rabbit hole. The problem is that they have cut back on staff because it is slow. The last time I came in was to pick up to go order last Wednesday at about 8:45 am. When I walked in, all the tables were empty. The server was just seating 2 people. Considering the location and time you would think the place should be packed, but they have disappointed too many guests with bad service because of lack of staff when it does pick up. Not to mention very inconsistent food quality and cook times. Also the app is not well developed and confusing. The rewards program is a joke. To redeem a reward, you have to first pick what food you want, then they give you a long set of numbers that you cannot copy or transfer to the payment page. You have a write it down on a piece of paper, because it is too long to remember. And half the time it says it is not valid. Want to hear something funny? I cashed in some of my rewards for a short stack of pancakes. Guess what? There is no short stack in the app or online menu, so it can't be redeemed! I sent an email to IHOP customer service asking about it. After 3 days they wrote me back. You know what they said? They want me to CALL customer service to get an answer. Bottom line: After ordering from this location in person, pick up and delivery, at least 10 times unfortunately, they consistently disappointed me. All of it self inflicted. Considering, as of this posting, they have several breakfast specials for only $7, the place should be packed. Set for success. Fix the service , staffing shortages, food consistency, app, online menu, rewards and customer service.

author: Kurt Kurtenbach
review_text: I highly recommend this restaurant. You shouldn't believe me. Go there for yourselves to test my judgement. Ask if the old chef is cooking - he makes the magic. I was driving around looking for a place to eat with my wife. Being in Las Vegas as visitors had left us missing a little bit of home. We couldn't eat in a casino restaurant again - neon lights, loud music, people smoking ten feet away, someone trying to sell me a watch - couldn't do it again until we had a normal meal. We trekked around town in my truck until we got into a very Hispanic neighborhood. Like our home town of Tucson, AZ, that tends to mean good food. My wife pointed out the restaurant, El Canelo Restaurant. We pulled in and went inside. The owner, I believe, greeted us immediately. She was colorfully dressed to match her beautiful attitude and genuine smile. We chose the seats we wanted to sit in. They serve canned soda or Mexican imported bottled soda along with a selection of beer. After a time of our looking over the extensive choices in the menu, she took our orders. My wife got a cacerola campirana while I ordered the molcejeta mixta. Chips and a delicious medium heat salsa were served. Not long after our food was served. If you have never experienced a molcejeta, let me tell you about it. Great big stone bowl on carved legs. It's been in a very hot oven till its super hot. Then they add thin sliced beef. Chicken strips. Fish filet. Shrimp in styles butterflied, peeled with shell on the tail, and bacon wrapped. All this goodness is in the bowl with a generous leaf of lettuce draped over the side, a grilling (and grilled) onion, and a halved jalapeño. It's all afloat in a generous amount of delicious broth and cream. When the molcajeta arrives at your table, the heat from within the stone is boiling the broth and mixing all the flavors. I could not believe how good it tasted. I've eaten good Mexican food at fine restaurants before, but this was honestly great food. The service was awesome. The atmosphere was typical Mexican restaurant affair, except it all was clean and well placed - nothing crooked on the walls, dust was absent, not even a single fly. We leave town in two days and hope to return before doing so. My wife really liked her food. Normally I would talk you though it, but I was busy head down working on that molcejeta. (Did I mention the Queso Fresca in the broth?)

Alicia is an excellent server with all the great qualities to represent Golden Coral. She has alway been pleasant, respond immediately and a hard worker. She has no hesitation to say hi with a smile. Golden Coral is very fortunate to have such a great loyal employee, who promotes the restaurant and extend her services to make sure that her customer leave with a good experiences and return. Thank you so much Alicia you are the best and wish you longetivity with Golden Coral because you make my experience a very pleasant and enjoyable one.

author: Gina Guedesse
review_text: The food was really good. It looks dated inside and there were a lot of people so I can't fault the servers but in this particular instance, it just took a little while to get drink refills (and our first drink, because the Coke and sweet tea was out when we went through the line to pay). I would definitely go here again.

author: Wolf Raven
review_text: The place looked great — clean, stocked, plenty of choices, everything warm and fresh on the surface. But the taste? That’s where the wheels came off. Most of the food was either bland or just… off. I grabbed a deviled egg, and whatever that flavor was, it sure wasn’t “egg.” Tried a hotdog next — it acted like it wanted to be all-beef, but it missed the mark and limped in with a weird, almost-there flavor. Good presentation, zero payoff.

author: Bernardo Dizon
review_text: Please dont come here expecting fine dining. It's a chain buffet. Come here for a cheat meal. Come here for your protein intake. Variety of choices to fill you up without breaking the bank. I spent >$20 for a Sunday breakfast buffet with water and coffee, and that's including tip.

author: john alexander
review_text: Great time, nice atmosphere and friendly folks. First time here, actually had a great experience and I ate the most my wife said in a couple years. So, there's that. Recommended for sure. Oh, sorry, the one picture was the end of second plate of catfish, excellent.

author: Joshua Moses
review_text: I first visited this location at the grand opening back in December of 2013, the line was outside the door lol. I've visited this restaurant a few times lately. The food is good especially their omelettes. The service is good, and the ambiance is always busy.

author: andronicus pannell
review_text: Their sweet potato casserole is thee BEST in the world!!!! You can order a whole turkey or ham holiday meal for small and big families or for a giant crowd with their online catering. It's just me and all I wanted was gooey, marshmallow sweet potatoes. But Their website when I tried to order the sweet potato casserole online it wouldn't allow me to pick it up the next day but for like a week later. But I went inside today and the manager said I could get it today. So there I was scooping up buckets of sweet potato casserole. It was a marshmallow mess. I could of took a bath in the stuff. Ha ha ha They only have this during the holidays and I highly recommend you stock up on it while you can. I'm sure you can freeze it and have some other than the Holidays. And it's to long a wait until next Thanksgiving/ Christmas. OMG It is SOOOOOO good. It really is the best ANYWHERE. I'm having mine for breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack, late night snack. Thank you to the manager during lunch on Dec. 9, 2025 and to the cashier. Thank you for allowing me to grab it today and not wait a week. Your the best!!!! I'm in sweet potato casserole heaven!!!!!

author: DAVE MACKENZIE
review_text: Definitely a five star free it was clean. It was friendly. Oliver was fantastic. The food was warm and fresh. Definitely worth the value definitely worth the time. Something for everyone.

author: june megumi
review_text: Very family friendly buffet. The food is pretty good. Not gourmet but no complaints. Gave 4 stars because the frozen yogurt machine was broken and they did not have biscuits and gravy. The birria tacos needed more meat and less cheese. Dessert station is AWESOME. I would go again.

author: Paola Nevarez
review_text: My family and I have been coming here for years & it has really gone down hill. The service is terrible. The lady cooking the steaks today 9/16/25, has a serious attitude and turns out to be the manager. Our server was nice but didn't even come around to refill our drinks or take our plates until we asked. The restrooms are beyond disgusting! They are covered in dust & and just filthy. You can tell they haven't been cleaned in weeks. The Henderson location is definitely better.

author: Phyllis Twilligear
review_text: BBQ ribs, and Bourbon chicken were really tasty, hit the spot. Had a tremendous spinach salad, onions mushrooms, chopped eggs, tomatoes, croutons, pickled beets, Ranch. Love the buttery fish, clam chowder, etc. Ice cream cone.carrot cake, bread pudding, banana pudding Yum, went to heaven! May God bless these hard working people! Love you guys, Carlos- great waiter thank you!

author: Robin Luff
review_text: I went to the buffet with my neighbor an we truly enjoyed the buffet! It was all hot an very much enjoyed it! The service is amazing too! It's very busy but the food is hot everytime we went back for more! The drink shouldn't be a separate charge? With the drink its over $20 so folks know. We will definitely be back! Bringing my bff in a week! Yummy meal! Steak is great too! See ya soon!

author: Giovanni Velez
review_text: Ruben was awesome! He paid attention to detail and constantly making sure that we are not missing anything and keeping our table clean. He really take care of us. Always smiling and friendly no just with us also with everybody else as well. He is the best. Thank you Ruben.

author: Sandy
review_text: Visited here a couple times when we are on holiday in the states. Always busy which is good for business. The food choices are great and always well stocked up. I always go with the intentions of having a feast but never get close. I wish we had decent places like this in the UK

author: Alejandra Ruiz
review_text: Everything was good except the manager who was training the cashier really ask to see my daughter ID to prove she was 12. I know people lie but even my daughter told her age and why lie about it. So that means if she was 9 or younger that would be ask too. Other than that it was a good.

author: Ms. Monrare
review_text: Came here for Thanksgiving. Everything was amazing. Did wait in line, but the line moved fairly quickly. The food was up, kept very well. The servers were on top of keeping the tables previous bus very impressed

author: Daniyal Arai
review_text: The Plate Bar & Grill – Review: The Plate Bar & Grill offers a welcoming atmosphere with a diverse menu featuring American classics and comfort food. Known for generous portions and well-prepared dishes, favorites include burgers, steaks, and hearty appetizers. The bar selection is solid, with a good variety of beers and cocktails. Service is friendly and attentive, making it a great spot for casual dining or meeting up with friends. The ambiance strikes a nice balance between laid-back and lively, perfect for both dinners and weekend hangouts. Overall, it’s a dependable choice for good food, drinks, and a relaxed vibe.

author: BigP
review_text: Came here with family for a quick dinner, food was great Michelle was even better! Thank you guys for the fast and friendly service. Love the halloween vibe, will definitely be back!

author: Blaker Giron
review_text: I'll start off by saying this is a local sports bar. It leans towards the divey side in the best way possible. The best thing about this bar is the surprisingly well cooked food. They have a great selection that is reasonably priced. You can't go wrong with any other burgers and if you want a steak dinner the prime rib is amazing. I thoroughly enjoyed the chili bowl with beans. Whether you go to watch a game or play billiards with some friends, you won't break the bank with the pricing of the drinks. During the week they have different events, such as scavenger hunts, bingo and karaoke, to name a few. This is a great place to have a relaxing evening with friends. I will definitely be back.

author: Courtney Abbott
review_text: Treated me like family and a dope chill spot. Always have cake and always a good time. You best get my bud mr jon a budlight, wings are fire, any special that have is delish ❤️ shane is also a charm.

author: A Google User
review_text: Great energy, bold flavors, and solid drinks. The ribs were fall of the bone good, and the cocktails hit just right. Lively crowd but still cozy enough to chill. Perfect spot to unwind after work or kick off the weekend.

author: Craig Johnson
review_text: Bar food wasn't that great. It wasnt bad but didn't live up to some of the other reviews I read. Lots of homeless camped out right next to the building. Table clothes were thin cotton blankets that were dirty, full of crumbs.

author: Xbox User
review_text: 5🌟 I vote this one of my BEST neighborhood bars One of those hidden gems in Vegas that you don't know about unless a buddy takes you there. Food is great. Bartender is always awesome. Drinks are cheap. Places nice. It's also kind of military-centric sports on all TVs. Bar poker/slot/keno. Totally recommend it. Very community feel so you'll have to put some time in here before you can really get your groove on. Jukebox always playing good jams. It's clean. You'll have the opposite of "sticker shock" when you get your bill.

author: DJ Reynolds
review_text: Waited 1.5 hours for a terrible salad that said grilled chicken but came out with deli meat. Terrible atmosphere filled with cigarette smoke. Don’t waste your time or money

author: matt pesino
review_text: Waited hour and twenty minutes for a terrible salad that said grilled chicken and came out with deli meat. Don't recommend unless you want to wait forever for horrible food and breathe cigarettes in

author: Ron Wayne
review_text: The cook was great. But it's really smokey. Nothing worse than eating your prime rib in a cloud of cigarette smoke. Ruins the taste of everything. The farthest table from the actual bar was about 20 feet

author: Cody Flowers (Cody Flowers)
review_text: Stopped by here on a whim. Fun, smaller hole in a wall type atmosphere. Food was great and fair prices. The Saturday night prime rib special was better than a high dollar steak house we ate at while here. Will definitely come back when in Vegas next.

author: Jacqueline Khoury
review_text: This is a really cool bar. It has 2 pool tables, large TVs, full food menu, and WIFI. I like to come here to get work done from my computer while eating lunch or dinner. Coffee in the morning is also really good. The bartenders treat you like a friend would and they are very helpful overall. I recommend trying the burgers here. Thanks Zo for making me feel welcomed and introducing me to the bar. That was a nice feeling.

author: Irwin Wainwright
review_text: Such a wholesome fun bar perfect place for a good meal if you’re hungry or a good drink at the end of a work day! Karaoke is a blast every Friday and the bartenders Renea, Marissa , and Zoe are the best

author: Maria
review_text: Absolutely love this bar!!! Marissa, on grave, is the BEST bartender in town with the BEST drinks for every occasion! Amazing food and they make you feel like FAMILY!!!!

author: Leanna Saavedra
review_text: Marissa makes the BEST shots in Vegas!!! Every employee treats you like family and you really become family in there! Trivia night on Sunday at 10:30pm with Marissa is THE BEST and the most fun I've had in a long time and is hilarious! Also, Michelle, Shane, Zo, Renée, and Sharon are awesome as well, but no one is better than Marissa because she will give me wake up calls for work in the morning😁 I LOVE THIS BAR

author: TheMikey1865
review_text: This place has a down home neighborhood bar atmosphere. It's a locals hangout off the strip that has great food,at reasonable prices. The wife and I haven't been disappointed yet. They serve burgers,sandwiches and a lot more.

author: Lauren Castaneda
review_text: Marissa and Zoe have always made my experience here amazing and have always kept me returning! My new favorite place to go with my friends and especially to see all the amazing staff that is always so friendly :’) 10/10 recommend !!

author: Ed Taylor
review_text: Went at 3 AM and had a Huge Plate of Steak and eggs cooked to perfection .. The Service was Amazing and so was the whole vibe of the place .. Definitely recommend this Great East Side Gem ..!🙂

author: Stacy Rohrer
review_text: This place is great. The food is good and very reasonable. The staff have all been very friendly. We will be back again and again and again. Cheers!!

author: LaMozae Kelley
review_text: I stumbled upon this neighborhood bar, checked it out in a night Marissa was there and fell in love with the bar huts based off of her energy and service . The food exceeds your average “dive bar” expectations and I feel like I found my home bar ❤️

author: Carmine Santiago
review_text: The absolute best deal and quality in the Fast Food arena is this ($10 Burger Pack ) You Must try it nothing compares to this excerpt paying more than double at a sit down restaurant. You get a restaurant quality burger with everything on it too humongous homestyle Chicken strips that taste like my mother made, but couldn’t cook them as good as these a bunch of fries and a big cup of Good ranch! It doesn’t taste like anybody else’s it taste like a restaurant and for $10. It is amazing to go through a drive-through and get this. To get the best quality, eat it ASAP You know how those delivery apps take almost an hour and your food taste like an hour old but hands down best bang for your buck!

author: Las Vegas Hair and Makeup
review_text: This place taste so good. They are burgers are authentic and amazing. I don’t like burgers and these ones were my favorite. I was gonna tell Alexx can you get One of my sons got pancakes. We got zucchinis. The only thing that I could say is, it’s kind of pricey. But I would come back for a caving.

author: Yuliana Gallegos
review_text: It doesn’t matter what time of the day it is they have breakfast and lunch All day !! This is one of my favorite restaurants in Las Vegas !! Fresh food excellent customer service and their Manager is an amazing and humble person I’ve ever met .

author: Jayy L
review_text: Many varieties of foods , very good serving portion sizes worth the price !! Amazing customer service, always help you out. quality food, definitely worth it! The staff is top notch always ready to assist us customers for a great customer service experience! And to top it of all store is clean and ready for new customers to enjoy the dine in experience!!!

author: Juan Mendoza
review_text: R Burgers on Nellis is a very welcomed surprise in the Eastside. I went through the drive-thru after work to get my family some dinner. The service was fairly quick for the large order I placed. I ordered 4 double cheeseburgers, 2 carne asada Fries, chili cheese fries, zucchini fries and a grilled chicken salad. It took about 10 minutes to receive my order. The burgers were what I consider a good California style burger, delicious thousand island dressing that got my bottom bun all soggy and delicious. My mouth is watering just thinking about it. The chili cheese fries have got to be the BEST in all of Las Vegas. The seasoned fries loaded with that delicious chili and tons of melty cheese is the perfect combo. The carne asada fries were a hit with everyone. Perfectly seasoned fries and asada. The zucchini fries in my opinion were a 3 out of 5. They were a little soggy in the middle. The grilled chicken on the salad was perfectly grilled and a very nice portion. I will definitely be returning to try more of R Burgers delicious menu. Can't wait to return!

author: kevin uhlin
review_text: Finally tried R Burgers on Nellis, & have been back almost every day for the last few days. Tonight I asked for a custom burger not on the menu, a double chile cheese burger & it was GREAT!! Please add this to the menu. Love the buy 1-get 1 breakfast burritos, 2 fat loaded burritos for 10.95? Can’t beat it. The fries are excellent too, all in all a great little spot for everyone’s appetite!

author: sabrina gonzalez
review_text: The food is pretty good also for a great price. Service is fast and the staff are friendly and professional. The only reason why I'm doing 4 stars is I think they could be a lot better customer service and greeting when customers walk in the door.

author: Lexi Lopez
review_text: Super super super delicious food omg!! The burger and the sauce on it were amazing. But the highlights were truly the fries and chicken tenders, all so flavorful and perfectly crispy. The ultimate stand out was the delicious ranch. Order was ready quickly despite being so fresh. 10/10 would definitely go back again. Super good prices as well

author: stevenis
review_text: Great to find a good classic burger really. The short end: the food is good and that’s the value. The long end: I just don’t see the value in fast food, McDonald’s is expensive for what you get. I remember eating at a Carl’s Jr and was shocked at the price of a combo. In this way, it’s good to find a classic burger joint. I think the price is a little more than other fast food places, but I’m willing to pay the extra for a decent burger. Also, the fries are my favorite fries in town, hands down. The service is friendly, the atmosphere, is as expected, it’s a burger joint, but, it is really clean inside, that a plus. I’m definitely marking this as my go to burger joint. They also have good snack deals if I want a quick bite when I’m not in the mood for a burger. Looking forward to the other menu items…the pastrami fries look pretty amazing.

author: Chris Lindsay
review_text: What an awesome 1st experience! Its good to finally have a great quality Burger place on the East side of town that exceeds expectations! The burger meat is fresh, NOT frozen like the guys accross the street. Cooked on a flat-top not in a convection Microwave. The pickles, and all the other toppings where crisp and fresh. The dining room was extra clean and comfortable, with booths and tables that can be moved around for the larger parties, and an awsome soda station for your refills! Service, was above and beyond, Andrea who brought us our food on actual plates not card board and Sophia was full of friendly information. Hats off to the BOH, nothing was over or under cooked, it was perfect! I will try the chorizo burrito 🌯 for breakfast with the awesome fresh salsa I saw Sophia making tonight from scratch... If your concerned with price people....you need to re-evaluate what you would spend at the guys accoss the street, for frozen unhealthy chemically preserved food. Honestly, for my family of three we only spent about $9 dollars more, or $3 dollars more! However, we took Hella left over fries home to reheat in the Air fryer...because, O' YEAH they are using real untreated fries....thx R burger and you will be seeing a lot of us... East side get on board 👌.

author: Latisha B
review_text: My first time using the R Burger app AND eating at R Burger’s was very different! After using the app to order my food, I went into the Nellis location and was advised my food was ordered for the California location when I’m actually in Las Vegas. Idk how that happened but the manager, Andres came over while I was on the app talking to a customer support agent via chat and asked what happened and explained the app is fairly new and asked to check out the chat to see how it worked. After he checked out the app, he offered to make my order and to simply advise CS he had done so since it was very clear that there wasn’t really a resolution to my situation as CS stated I could hire a third party to pick up my food from California and have them bring it to Nevada. Andres was very helpful and friendly!!! His actions alone has made me an R Burger customer for life!!! FYI, My burger and fries were so delicious!!!!! 🤤😋

author: ed crisostomo
review_text: fast quick service, food came out less than 5 minutes. menu has something about everybody from burgers, chicken fingers, tacos, burritos,shakes, and breakfast. don't forget they have happy hour too.

author: Aaron Brown
review_text: The burgers are on par with Whataburger. There, i said it and I'm sticking to it. The service was great, very friendly and helpful to a first timer, and they guys cooking are fast and efficient. Don't get me started on the chicken strips. One word: Huge. That milkshake, omg! I'm officially designating R Burgers best burger Las Vegas 2025. That's official, write it down, make a plaque, go ahead and give it to them

author: Yuridiana N
review_text: Food is delicious! Great prices and Excellent Customer Service. I highly recommend this location at Nellis. Aldo the gentleman who assisted me through the drive up window made my day. He offered me excellent customer service, he welcome me with a Smile and a happy attitude. I loved this encounter and I LOVE the food!! Will definitely be back! Thank you.

author: Dymond Glover
review_text: Chili cheese pastrami fries. BOMB! I was wondering where this place was from when I drive past I saw pastrami.. I’m like yeahhh they from Cali fasure! But these fries have lots of flavor, not dry, seasoned well and cheesy. Every bite has pastrami. Looking forward to trying more from their menu.

author: Ty Bridges
review_text: Messed up my order after asking multiple times for two meals. Ordered a burger and a chicken sandwich. Didn't come with the chicken sandwich but another of the same burger I ordered. Also the burgers are impossible to eat especially with the bag you are supposed to pick it up with. Like sonic and carls jr burgers can even be picked up better than this. Fries are great though. But most likely won't come back do to how expensive this place is for how crappy the burgers are.

author: José Alfredo Maldonado
review_text: Probablybthe best burguer I have tasted in Las Vegas. Great fast, and friendly service, clean establishment.

author: normie_ loser
review_text: R burger has decent food, out of all 3 locations in Vegas, the one on Russel and valley view is the best one, but this one, I went today and the manager had a very mean look as soon as I walked in, luckily he wasn't the one to help me with our order, it was another worker who seemed very nice. Another thing to state that, the manager was wearing sandals, sandals in a restaurant? Very unhygienic and can cause a work place accident. After today, I rather spend more money on gas just to go to the other locations.

author: MA TM
review_text: Legitimately good food and very reasonable prices. The zucchini sticks are great!

author: H.Y.M
review_text: Great food and polite staffing and clean service. Great salad 🥗 preparation, flavors for days. French Fries were perfectly seasoned and fried to perfection. I would recommend announcing greetings at the door for guest entry it would definitely improve overall experience.

author: Nate MrInk
review_text: Must try when visiting vegas. Portions are Huge and Very Very Fresh. Pricing is excellent aswell. So if you want to save a few dollars versus eating at the strip this is your spot. Food quality is better than most asian cuisine on the strip

author: WTFYD DYFTW
review_text: Well what can i say about this place, it was an experience, please do not compare this place to panda express, its a moms and pops style, mixed with traditional asian style food, even though it has many similarities with panda express, but panda can never COMPETE WITH THE NOODLES IN THE CHOW MEIN. The place was not pack when we arrived but im sure we arrived at the right time because as we entered the line the place began to look we had found a neighborhood jewel with the amount of people that showed up. The staff were focused on taking care of the rush and everyone seemed to know how to do there jobs. This place was busy and not one customer was complaining about the wait. We drove 15 miles to get there because of recent publicity on tik tok, my wife finds these places all the time for us to experience different things as a family. The food portions were comparable to the price, if not more of a value than what we paid, we had left overs for two days. The selection was what you would expect in a franchise Chinese restaurant. I chose not to use the sauces they had to get a taste of the food they made, it was not bland at all. I can see me going back if i was on that side of town without a doubt.

author: Kina R.
review_text: I’d rate it a 5, but the teriyaki chicken was a bit bland, although fresh, but lacks sauce/flavor. The orange chicken was good, but my fav was the kung pao chicken for sure! I got a 2 item plate and 3 item plate with half noodles and half rice and spent about $23 and some change so not bad at all! They are generous with their portions so this easily fed my family of 5. I will say, the wait time is no joke! They’re super busy so I get it. I went during dinner time and arrived at about 5:47 and got out of there at 6:52! The line was all the way to the back and because they make the food fresh as they run out, many people had to wait for one of their items to be ready, like my orange chicken. I’d definitely recommend it to others, but probably won’t go back until the hype dies down and it doesn’t take so long. After all, it’s meant to be take out “fast Chinese food”.

author: Joe B.
review_text: Message to the Chef: All your food taste the same. I couldn't find the difference among Beef Broccoli, Compaw chicken or orange chicken, salty and overcooked vegetables. Too sweet and missing special ingredients such as ginger, green onions and or fish sauce. The amount of food doesn't compensate flavor. I gave your place 3 chances try different plates. Work on you seasoning.

author: Miché U
review_text: Food is great for the price. Service is so-so because wait time even when there is a small line. Overall the restaurant is small and gets packed with people to the brim that I wouldn’t recommend visiting during peak hours you’ll be in line for 20-30 minutes. The men’s restroom needs to be cleaned and maintained more properly. The plumbing is slow when flushing, the knob is a little loose and the urinal is out of order. There is a mop bucket in there as well. I feel dirty just being in there. You can tell a lot about an establishment by how well they maintain their restroom. For now it’s more of a carry out place for me. I wouldn’t recommend dine in.

author: sergio valles-blancarte
review_text: The portions are huge and the food was good. Reminds me of a mom and pops spots in cali.,Service was ok the team wirks fast . The bbq pork was probably the only item not worth getting.the expeditor is fast and knows his stuff. I though I was missing an item and he said he knew it was in there just by the weight. He was right but should still open it up and show the customer that all items are in just incase he happens to be wrong especially to go orders. Will try again if we are out on that side of town.

author: Pokerface S
review_text: The food was by far the BEST, the serving size was enough to fill to the top. The cooks were constantly cooking fresh food, the lines are getting longer by the minute. They have variety of drinks to choose from . The only thing that was upsetting was the thin Hispanic ladies that serve the food had a frown face and had no energy, nor customer service. While a young Hispanic lady was serving i can hear another Hispanic lady talk in SPANISH , “quietly telling the other girl, “Don’t serve so much PUT LESS in there plat and kept telling her over repeatedly!” They have such bad attitude I try not let it get to me I want to come back but they need to not be in the front line serving if they have such a bad attitude for no reason at all. Nor was I rude to them.

author: Kimberly Renteria
review_text: Went in and there were only two people ahead of me, but somehow I ended up being one of the last to pay. The portions are huge, I’ll give them that. I ordered half noodles, half fried rice with teriyaki chicken and beef & broccoli. My brother-in-law got half noodles, half white rice with BBQ pork and teriyaki chicken. The rice was dry, so it wasn’t enjoyable, but the noodles were great. The teriyaki sauce definitely carried the chicken, and the beef & broccoli had a weird texture. When it came time to pay, they couldn’t find my order even though I was already at the counter. They kept moving other people ahead of me. About three customers, while trying to figure it out. I mentioned it to what seemed like the owner, and he just shrugged. To top it off, they only gave my brother-in-law and me one teriyaki sauce to share for both plates, which was ridiculous. Overall, definitely not worth the TikTok hype. I won’t recommend this place at all.

author: Mike Be
review_text: Tastes pretty good and the portions were decent. Typical Chinese food options. Kinda small on the inside so seating was limited. But over all the food was good.

author: Jacob Fisher
review_text: Imagine Panda Express but good. Line out the door good. Portions overflowing the to-go box good. Imagine a wonton soup that isn't 2 wontons in water with three scallions but a hearty flavorful broth with massive leaks made fresh to order. I had genuinely forgotten what good wonton soup tasted like until I chanced in on this place. You know the place is good when it is always busy and I've never seen this place. Not busy but service is still fast and you are in and out the door. I love the idea that this place is doing everything that Panda Express wishes that it was and should aspire to be. For my money, this is my favorite local asian food restaurant. I hate to even compare them to Panda Express because they're not even in the same class. Dragon Express is so much better.

author: Harrison Nguyen
review_text: **Dragon Express — Nellis Blvd, Las Vegas** Located on the east side of Las Vegas, Dragon Express stands as a testament to the enduring appeal of a vibrant culinary tapestry of Las Vegas. Dragon Express stands as a testament to the enduring appeal of family-run establishments that resist the sterile confines of modern minimalism. With the warmth of a bygone era, this eatery embodies a heartfelt commitment to satisfying its patrons with genuine hospitality. The counter—creatively situated within a thoughtfully transformed former Panda Express layout—exudes an atmosphere radiating earnestness and unpretentious generosity. Upon entry, one is immediately enveloped by an ambiance that prioritizes the diner's appetite over curated aesthetic experiences intended for social media. My culinary journey commenced with Plate B, a veritable feast comprising fried rice paired with two sumptuous entrées: orange chicken and Chinese sweet BBQ pork. The to-go container itself was a marvel—a veritable cornucopia filled to the brim, defiantly resisting closure as its bountiful contents spilled forth. This overflow is reminiscent of a traditional ethos where generous portions reflect gratitude and hospitality, serving as a tactile embodiment of warmth and welcome. Upon its arrival, the orange chicken immediately tantalized both the eyes and the palate. Its outer shell, delicately crisp and audibly crackling, sidesteps the common pitfalls of overly sweet or gummy variations. Beneath this crisp exterior lies perfectly cooked, juicy meat, inviting the diner to indulge. The accompanying sauce enhances the experience with a vibrant citrus note that sings on the taste buds, beautifully balanced by a caramelized depth. This harmony combines a gentle sweetness with a zingy acidity that invigorates the senses. Subtle hints of ginger dance alongside a nuanced soy essence, while a persistent umami resonance compels the diner to savor each bite long after the last mouthful has been enjoyed. This interplay leaves a lingering pucker-sweetness that tantalizes the palate and entices for more. Complementing the exuberant orange chicken, the Chinese sweet BBQ pork presents itself as a more reflective counterpart. Its glossy exterior, masterfully caramelized, exhibits a sticky sheen that entices without overwhelming. Each tender slice yields effortlessly, unveiling juicy morsels imbued with a fragrant medley of toasted garlic and nuanced fermented soy. These layers of umami depth transform the accompanying fried rice from a mere side dish into an essential contributor to the overall experience, enriching the meal with every harmonious bite. Speaking of the fried rice, it is a triumph of precision and restraint—each grain is meticulously separated, imbued with savory aromatic undertones that invite exploration, punctuated by the bright freshness of scallions. This rice serves as an ideal underpinning, effectively balancing the saucier elements of the meal while providing a comforting contrast that delights both the palate and the spirit. The dish unfolds as a culinary symphony, intertwining the luminous zest of the orange chicken, the smoky richness of the pork, and the grounding comfort of the rice into every bite. What lingers in memory is not merely a singular flavor, but rather a harmonious gestalt—a delicate equilibrium of sweetness and salt, a profound umami foundation, and an evident spirit of generosity manifested in both the ample portions and the thoughtful preparation. Dragon Express does not seek to redefine culinary boundaries; instead, it elegantly embodies the art of straightforward, satisfying Chinese-American fare, crafted with authenticity and care. For those who appreciate cuisine as a quiet act of camaraderie—inviting, devoid of pretension yet bursting with flavor—Dragon Express deserves unequivocal recognition. Five stars.

author: Noc L.
review_text: Checking out the hype that everyone was raging about. I have to say its overrated. Can't believe everything you see on social media. The chowmein was salty, the mushroom chicken was salty, the orange chicken was more batter than chicken. The flavor is there, just too salty for my palate. My favorite would have to be the honey walnut shrimp, but they're stingy on that bc I had to pay extra for that side. Because they just open, I might give them another chance to settle in and improve their routine and recipe.

author: Dana Carrasco
review_text: Service, food and atmosphere is always awesome. Very friendly. Huge portions. The food is always fresh and tastes wonderful. This is our #1 Chinese food restaurant when we come to Las Vegas.

author: K. O.
review_text: Great food. Great service!! The portions were huge!! My wife and I saw this place pop up on a TikTok and decided to make the trip from Anthem to the Eastside. Let me tell you, the trip is definitely worth it.

author: R w
review_text: It’s a small restaurant and the workers are very fast. Overall nice 👍🏾 my favorite is the honey walnut shrimp best honey walnut shrimp I had in my 35 years of living.❗️❗️❗️ I usually order the small honey one shrimp by itself when I don’t want a whole full course meal, but they only give you a few when you do that!! But the plates are very large they give you a lot.✅✅

author: Risse Simpson
review_text: The location was decently busy. Portion sizes are really large, I can make at least three meals out of a two entree plate. Rice and chow mein were pretty standard, like you would find at most Chinese takeaways. Cream cheese wontons were just that, cream cheese only. Named appropriately, lol. Mushroom chicken was juicy with whole mushrooms. Salt and pepper pork was outstanding. Nicely spiced! There were chunks of bone and gristle, letting me know this wasn't a processed pork product. May not be everyone's preference, but I liked it. Service could have been better, the server had to be told a couple of times she had a customer before she came to take my order (she was on her phone). And no receipt given. Overall I would come again because the location is so close.

author: Vonnie H
review_text: I never had Beijing beef with potato’s in it but it truly was flavorful. I am so picky with Chinese food but the reviews spoke and it was delicious. I’ll be back to try some other entrees.

author: Alexis Escaray
review_text: can I just say the food was delicious and the servings were generous! bbq pork was our favorite , haven’t had anything like it in a while! & the customer service was great. he gave us free soup to try with our purchase too. not pricey at all! we’ll definitely be back!

author: Magdalena Rocha
review_text: Service was fast and friendly, the food is very good and portions are a good size. I ordered plate A, which was chow mein, fried rice, and entrée (salt and pepper pork chops) which was the chef's special, and you have to add $1.50 more. That was a lot of food, the plate was full. I ate probably 1/3 only and you can see in the picture how much was left. (Sorry but I was hungry and didn't take the picture BEFORE eating) I also ordered cream cheese ranguns and paid around $17.00 plus tip. Honestly, that's enough food for 2 hungry people. It was nice to see actual Chinese people cooking and serving the customers. I recommend this place.

author: chris carvo
review_text: I kept getting adds saying it was so much better than panda without the panda price. The rice was ok but the chow mein was disgusting. The noodles were overdone mush. The orange chicken was super thick breaded and all sugar no flavor. The real star was the bbq pork. I spit out the first bit due to the overwhelming sugar and taste of red dye. It didn't take like any bbq pork I've ever had. I ate almost all of everything simply to not waste food but I couldn't eat more than one piece of the pork. Good marketing but the food doesn't hold up.

author: Nancy E
review_text: Food is always great! This time I rated 4 stars because the red chilaquiles were pretty much just chips and salsa, not a chilaquile sauce (yes, there's a difference). We ordered them without chicken and the price remained the same, I expected the price to go down, but I didn't ask. The breakfast items like eggs, bacon, pancakes, are always great. Coffee tasted great, ordered the TikTok coffee and it was huge and delicious. Everybody is always friendly and despite the place being full, we got seated right away and served in a timely manner.

author: Wholesome CBD & Supplements
review_text: The food was fast, the server staff is friendly and helpful with their menu, and the restaurant is clean. We were able to eat in their 50's Diner Car which adding a nice ambiance to our meal. The music was family friendly and the price for their pancake special was affordable. The food was delicious and we will be back!!!

author: MA TM
review_text: I would rate this restaurant 3.5/5. Ambiance is awesome, I love the 50s vibe and it is well done. Service is super friendly and welcoming and prices are reasonable. My issue is more so with the food. I ordered an omelette, coffee, and orange juice. The orange juice was fresh and delicious; however, the coffee was extremely watered down and the omelette was very bland.

author: Maria Colomy
review_text: Super cute place - excellent service. Bacon could’ve been cooked a lot more - crispy is best lol… Would visit again- they had a huge menu. Had the BLT with a side of fried zucchini - it was fast, fresh, and the servers were super fast and friendly.

author: Mo Jo
review_text: The service was great 👍 and the food was very satisfying and tasty. Atmosphere was good but we sat in a booth in the corner which had worn out seats that felt lumpy. But overall, a good place to get a good meal. Orange juice is fresh squeezed!

author: Joel Keane
review_text: We went for dinner while waiting for our laundry to dry. The food was absolutely delicious and very well priced! Some of the most friendly customer service we have experienced in the USA. The 50's theme was very well done also. Would most definitely return.

author: I'm a pisces and love food
review_text: The 50's theme was fantastic. There is a car themed table, pictures of cars,and Elvis. The chocolate chip pancakes were good The severs were fast and kind. The prices are very good and low. The impression that I got was I would come back if I was in town. The oreo shake was big and good.

author: Ashley C
review_text: Looking for a cool 50’s diner off the strip? Check out the Omelette House 50’s Diner on Desert Inn. Known as “the friendliest diner around.“ They have an awesome menu, the portions are huge, and they have some of the lowest prices we’ve seen in Vegas. Make sure to try their signature pumpkin nut bread and delicious spuds. Got 10 bucks to spare? You can splurge to eat in style in their classic 1957 Chevrolet Bel Air.

author: Rosa Munoz
review_text: This place is amazing! We been coming here for the last 7 years. The food,service and the atmosphere never disappoints. I highly recommend this place🔥

author: Jorge Narvaez
review_text: 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 5-Star Review – A Blast from the Past at 50’s Diner! Stepping into 50’s Diner in Las Vegas is like taking a time machine straight back to the golden age of jukeboxes, chrome, and rock ’n roll. The vibe is spot-on vintage — black-and-white checkered floors, red leather booths, and walls lined with classic pin-ups and retro memorabilia. They even have a Chevy Bel Air booth — yeah, an actual car turned into a table. That’s how deep they go into the theme! The service? Fast, friendly, and downright old-school in the best way. You’re treated like family the moment you walk in. Now for the food — top notch. I had a hearty plate loaded with crispy chilaquiles, two perfectly runny sunny-side-up eggs, grilled steak, creamy refried beans, fresh avocado slices, and sour cream. Full flavor, no shortcuts. And for the kiddo? Classic pancakes with butter melting just right, scrambled eggs, and sausage that was cooked to perfection. Clean plate = happy customer. Whether you’re craving comfort food or just want a legit retro experience, 50’s Diner hits the mark. Nostalgia, great food, and better service — what more can you ask for? Highly recommend. Will definitely be back!

author: jme sheppard
review_text: The Food was so good, I got the number 13 omelet Large and the Large is a Large, delicious and the service was very good....we got to see the king of kings lowriders there aswell......thanks again for the great start to our day.......

author: Aaron Brown
review_text: This is my go to place for friendly people, great food, at a really good price. Your sweet tea mug will never be empty, your food will always be cooked the way you order, and the servers are some of the nicest people in Vegas. 03-16-25 I still stand by my original review. My boys, daughter-in-law, and grandson flew in from Texas, so I reserved the Belaire for them. The service, food, and atmosphere made it a great first breakfast in Vegas. 06-11-2025 Kick ass Club sandwich 10-2-25 Hours are now till 10pm. yes!

author: Candy Ramirez
review_text: First time going with my husband and it did not disappoint! I would always see the place but we finally made it today and it was worth every penny! Service was great everyone there working together in checking in and asking us if we needed anything. The food was done so quick and it was DELICIOUS!! 😋 The spuds were a 10/10!! Definitely will be recommending this place! I love the whole vibe of the place and music!

author: Lester Adea (punkmonkey92)
review_text: Food was good. Ordered the eggs Benedict and it hit the spot. Also has that nice 50's theme if youre into that.

author: Ayesha Connolly
review_text: We’ve been to just about every diner in Las Vegas, and saying we’ve tried them all is barely scratching the surface. As true diner fans, we know a good one when we find it. This place is it. Sure, it’s in a rougher part of town, but honestly, who cares when the food is this good? Everything they make here hits the spot. The omelettes are always cooked perfectly and packed with flavor. Their chicken-fried steak is comfort food at its finest. The cheeseburger is classic and satisfying. Don’t miss the chili either. It’s hearty and full of flavor. And for a sweet finish, you have to try the blueberry-filled French toast. It’s unreal. Always check the board for their specials! We keep coming back because it never disappoints. Friendly staff, great portions, and real-deal diner food. Highly recommend to anyone who loves diners as much as we do.

author: Nelly Torres
review_text: i never do reviews because I never do food delivery but I was sick yesterday so thought it was the easier thing to do. I was very upset yesterday with our food order and feel like they should at least hear the good and bad. I spent $50 for two breakfast meals first off the meal on the menu said 2 sausages or bacon. We picked sausage and only got one sausage on each order. Our food arrived extremely cold and who ever prepped our order put all the condiments napkins and utensils at bottom of the bag and the boxes of food on top so of course the boxes flipped to the side. Due to not a flat surface of bottom of the bag. The French toasts were little, cold and not fluffy at all. The whole thing was a whole disappointment having to wait an hour, spending $50 and then having cold food and missing food. We ate it because well I mean if you spend $50 you better eat it at that point but very dissatisfied. The dasher was very nice she was trying to hold the bag a certain way and once I grabbed it I noticed it was bagged incorrectly.

author: lisa murphy
review_text: Came here every day for a week it was so good. Great omelets. Awesome value for money. Cute diner.

author: Ricardo
review_text: Excellent food, fast service, but I find the place a bit expensive.

author: Sierra Phillips
review_text: Was so excited we found this place it was everything we wanted and more! Dennis was amazing and had the best customer service we have had our whole visit here in Vegas! The food was delicious and great prices! We also tried their tik tok coffee, it was the best and bigger than our heads! The vibe over all was exactly what we needed!

author: Sexy Eyez
review_text: Today November 22,2025 I went into this diner I have been into many of times before . There food and prices have always been reasonable . Placed my order over the phone to pick up was on the way to work and was on my way . I pulled into the parking lot to pick up my food and it was a ghost town that should have been my clue to get on .This place is one of those places you can never find a parking spot went in the lady told me the price and I almost fell out for what I usually order is $ 11.00 she told me $19.49 I really just wanted to walk out I paid and picked up the bag and the bag felt like a bag of paper how light it was. I get to work and open my bag and this is the worst $20.00 ever spent for food special them I will not be back 2 scoops of eggs and a few potatoes is a dam shame I understand prices go up but this is really ridiculous I WILL NOT BE GOING BACK ..

author: David Stejkowski
review_text: Honestly, the food fell short today. Everything we ate was terribly over salted. Ironically, they included extra packets of salt to go with the salt that I think also consisted of some meat and potatoes. The service was fine the atmosphere was good. But I’m going to have to drink about a gallon of water to flush out all the extra sodium.

author: Lauren Prado
review_text: Always a great experience. Loved the location on the Strip. We ate outside on the patio since it wasn't too hot. Place was packed but they move so fast you don't even feel the wait.

author: Mela M
review_text: I never mind a long line when it comes to waiting for food here because my food is usually hot. But that did not apply at this location. This was my first time here and definitely my last. I waited in the drive thru for 28 minutes and when got my order and bit into my burger it was absolutely cold!! I did not wait until I was home to eat. I started digging into my food immediately upon pulling out of the parking lot. This was super disappointing!! My pictures clearly show the melted cheese was nearly solid because the burger was now cooled. There is no reason for that. If the shopping center here wasn’t so chaotic I would have drove back, went inside, and asked for a refund. Eat at different location if you’re expecting hot food.

author: Twila Kawai
review_text: This location on Flamingo is the cleanest In-N-Out Burger I've been too. The staff was friendly. They stopped to ask if they could take away our trash. The food came out fast.

author: Mr Polo
review_text: 10/31/25 Casandra made my day. A beautiful 18 yr old employee who exchanged my fries to make them lighter and more tender.She’s the perfect customer charmer with a beautiful smile to Charm an older wizard like myself and make my strawberry shake sweeter! I’ll be back ! This place also runs like a Rolex Watch! A clean as they go and stock up supplies and condiments gracefully and with ease . Thanks to management. Sincerely M Polo! 6/30/25 Sebastian made my day, especially this wonderful location. From the moment I walked in, he informed me about additives that I asked about that you could put on fries and burgers at no extra charge. He was constantly busy cleaning everywhere from the floor to the windows and the doors. He also rang up my order on the register. I had a wonderful shake fries with chopped herbs on top and a mustard fried patty on my double burger with extra tomato lettuce. A wonderful experience with the wonderful guy who I know will be a huge success and all he does. Thank you in and out Management for having such a wonderful employee such as Sebastian. I’m looking forward to seeing him in the future. +++++++++++++++++++++++++ 10-16-2023 Again a great 4x 4 burger and strawberry shake. Very quick service, clean rest rooms and a fast staff of 8 to 10 workers. ********************************** In and out 9/22 8pm The young lady at the counter was very professional and smiling. And my food came out quickly thank you for that. Of course I had to order my 4 x 4 which the lady said they still had. I ordered it with extra tomatoes no pickles but it came with cheese that I didn’t order but I ate it anyway. It was fresh and delicious and the fries are pretty good as well. The strawberry shake was delicious as well. I was surprised they didn’t have any veteran discounts because all the other burger places I know do. The front door does not have any auto handicap buttons to open the doors and although it’s wheelchair accessible but not handy. It’s a nice clean establishment. Enjoy your food. Be blessed and safe always. Jesus cares say your prayers Amen ****************************** ****New location. Sandhill at Flamingo. Great 4x4 burger. Fresh & tender, moist and delicious. Delayed Service with a smile but counter service seemed ignored even though 5 employees like busy bees. I had to call loudly across the counter and ask if they were taking orders while the cashier was packaging catsup. Food was quickly served, clean rest rooms for male as female. Very clean establishment. Great atmosphere .

author: Andy Bullard
review_text: You can count on consistency when you ho to an in-n-out burger place. One time I went and the drive through was a super long line, so I just went inside and the wait was not so long. The next time I saw the drive through was clear so I went through there. The service in both instances was the same, great. No differences in food quality or service. I will make it my choice when the need arises.

author: Miss Pink
review_text: I ordered the flying dutch man and received just meat and cheese with a sprinkle of lettuce on top. I even relayed that I wanted the double double with everything on it but with onion instead of a bun and received the wrong order anyway. Please train the employees in proper preparation or they need to admit they don't know what something is. Me and my friend were so excited to try them and we were so disappointed.The fries were also stale and hard.

author: Stuart Gibbel
review_text: For peeps from the east coast In-N-Out is a rare treat. Same great taste and prices as a regular in n out but in Vegas. Very busy but fantastic service. If you stay at the Linq its only a few steps away. A great burger and fantastic prices await you.

author: RG K
review_text: Great team & service. Everyone is sharp, attentive & Pleasent. Clean place. Burgers are nicely assembled beautifully.

author: Shawn “SinCity” Burke
review_text: Great crew, excellent service and always friendly! The burgers and fries are just what you’d expect from In N Out.

author: KRISDIAZ
review_text: I'm a fan of good burgers... and if you're looking for that, this is the best place. I also want to highlight the customer service provided by Gary, an older man with a great attitude toward children and young people, offering stickers and hats... thanks IN-N-OUT Burger...

author: Judy Trimarchi
review_text: This In n Out burger is next door to the regional headquarters so we expected it to be a great cafe. The regular hamburgers were tasty with free extra toppings. Not anything spectacular, but tasty. The French fries were outstanding! Service was fast despite it being very busy. The cafe was clean and bright.

author: Matt Begley
review_text: When I walked in the door, I was greeted by multiple of the friendly employees. They were a little bit busy, but my order came out fresh and then a timely fashion. This is a good spot to go eat if you have a vehicle and can get away from the strip.

author: Christy Boiles
review_text: We travel full time around the US. Hardly EVER do we get the kind of service like we did here at a fast food place. Didn’t get the managers name but he obviously does a great job in hiring and training. Place was clean and everyone was so nice! I will add we are from TX so it’s all about Whataburger lol. This place has won me over! Even though my husband ordered it “doggy style” instead of “animal style “ 😂😂 🤦‍♀️

author: Filip Mizerski
review_text: First time on the west coast and all I can say is I loved the food. Although just a burger and fries, it was amazing. The service was great and really fast. The restaurant is clean and there was no issues with my order. Loved it

author: Jennifer Krueger
review_text: Did a takeout order on Veteran's Day. Staff was incredibly nice. I've dined at this location before, dine in and takeout. Always clean, friendly staff, who work well together. Food is hot fresh and delicious and very quick!

author: Billie Perrone
review_text: Great west coast spot. Always fresh ingredients and fast friendly service. Everyone gravitates to this place. Drive thru is always crowded. Love the huge safety pins on their uniforms! I'd hate to keep those white uniforms clean!!!

author: Anthony McCool
review_text: I do like this place. No chicken sandwich only burgers? Well that will limit my visits as my wife doesn't eat beef. Great service!!! See our YouTube channel Coolest Life.

author: Karla Martinez
review_text: This is a Classic!! You can’t t leave Vegas without trying it at least once! This burgers were Fresh, Hot and Made to Order. It’s a Favorite among the Locals! We had some simple cheese burgers 🍔 for our picky eaters… That were more Out than In 😆 In the City that Never Sleeps… They had other plans… Definitely Check it out!

author: Dr. Ravikiran Barigala
review_text: Stepping into in-n-out felt like walking into a time capsule. The burger was objectively the best burger I've ever had. There was a nice employee who gave my kids the in-n-out hats and some stickers, making them really happy. It was a great experience on the whole.

author: Estrella Rodriguez
review_text: An exceptional dining experience from start to finish. This all-you-can-eat sushi restaurant truly sets the standard for quality, offering some of the freshest and best sushi in town. Each dish was beautifully prepared, impeccably fresh, and consistently delicious. The service was equally outstanding. My waitress, Brenda, provided above-and-beyond hospitality—attentive, warm, and genuinely welcoming throughout the entire meal. Her professionalism elevated the experience and made me feel truly valued as a guest. The restaurant itself was immaculate, with a clean, inviting atmosphere and a pleasant, fresh scent that immediately stood out. To top it all off, the pricing was phenomenal—surprisingly affordable and easily among the best values in town for the quality offered. Highly recommended for anyone seeking exceptional sushi, outstanding service, and unbeatable value.

author: Joshua Moses
review_text: I've been a few times and I have Amazing experience every time. The service is amazing. The servers are provided an awesome level of service. The ambiance is very chill with a variety of good music playing. All of the food I've tried is delicious from the sushi, steamed snow crab legs, to the seafood boil, and the price for all you can eat Crab Leg, and Seafood Bowl along with the Sushi is for an unbeatable $45.95. I highly recommend this place to everyone I come across whether it be friends or family. This place is in my top 3 favorite places to eat in town.

author: Danny Graffice
review_text: So, the food itself was not bad I don't do sushi witch they have a lot of. It was everything else that earned a 3 star rating. They had everybody creamed into 1 side of the restaurant. The wait staff was scrambling to stay caught up,to the point that I had 2 dishes dropped on my placement. The entire team seemed very unorganized,and I was still charged full price. I don't think between the 2 of us we are 80$ worth of food. Needless to say, probably won't be returning anytime soon.ps there was no wait when we arrived,but when we left they were telling people 20-30 minutes, while still having 1 hole side of the restaurant unused.

author: Joycelyn Pangilinan
review_text: EXCELLENT: customer service, food, ambiance. Only $24.99 lunch. Definitely recommend and will visit again. One and only thing that made us sad, ONLY ONE PIECE OF DESSERT IS ALLOWED.

author: Victor Ramirez Romero
review_text: Joe is an amazing server. My wife and I used to come here all the time, and although we had to stop for a bit due to traveling, it was great to come back and see that he had become a manager or lead. He truly deserves it. His service has always been outstanding, and it clearly shows why he earned the promotion.

author: Food Soul
review_text: The food are totally really great here but you have to wait a little bit for the service. Maybe, it's just busy and they have to take care all costumers. It's all you can eat but you have to order everything from the staffs. The crab legs were a little salty for us. But all the sushi and Japanese food were delicious. Also, all deep fried food was amazing. They also gave us plastic gloves to eat crab legs.

author: Mikki McGehee
review_text: My daughter and I love sushi and have been to several places in Las Vegas but this is by far our favorite. The sushi is always fresh and delicious. Something I also love is that there is so much variety on the menu, so it’s perfect if you have people who don’t like sushi. The service and staff are exceptional and we always feel so welcomed. The prices for take out can’t be beat!

author: Alexander Pasay
review_text: My wife and I had a wonderful time here. Great service. Amazing atmosphere. And the food was so delicious. Will definitely come again with the whole family. Came back the 2nd time and brought my daughter. She loves this place so much. Highly recommend if you like seafood and sushi.

author: Rob Gonzalez
review_text: The Food was great and or server Jacqueline was very friendly and sweetheart offered substitution on some of the sushi cause I was allergic to salmon and avocado. Thank you for such great service. The food tasted great and came to the table quick I'll definitely be back

author: GirlgeniusNYC
review_text: Excellent! The avocado salad is great! The sushi is delicious! The affogado dessert was awesome! (Small but mighty -- perfect!) The menu is very clear and easy to understand. I suggest ordering only one or two dishes at a time, you need it eat it ALL. You can order as often as you like. Excellent friendly service! I will be back! *** You have 90 minutes to enjoy the ALL You Can Eat ***

author: Kat Jane Thirsty
review_text: I've been here once before so I suggested to my friends for us to come here for lunch. They almost suggested somewhere else because the reviews were all over the place. I insisted that the last time I was here, I really enjoyed the food. So they took my word for it and ended up loving it! Everything was fresh and tasty. The servers/ staff were so friendly and attentive. My friends are coming back with their kids. I'm glad I introduced them to a new spot for them to enjoy.

author: Roxana Gonzalez
review_text: Lots of options, everything is fresh and delicious! Love their all you can eat options.

author: Bill Munger
review_text: Random Google find. Amazing food and great value. The waitress walked us through the menu and how the ALL YOU CAN EAT worked. Left stuffed and happy. FatKid friendly for sure.

author: Traveling Kupo
review_text: Great great AYCE. I got 3 of the specials which two of them were the ones that offer a cloister, jumbo shrimp, & oysters. The other was the cajun style which was really really good & not that spicy at all. Sushi was also great sushi over rice ratio is an 8 out of 10. Which is really good. This is kot your typical AYCE where the sushi is sitting out. You order it and then they make it as you keep ordering. Well worth it, service is great. Large parking, wheelchair access. Great price cheaper on weekday, but is a bit far from the strip. So worth the drive. I will be returning again & again when I am in that side of town.

author: Dj Gillespie
review_text: Sat there for over 2 hours and sushi didn't show up. The people without a clip board won't even talk to you. Waiter and manager did make an effort to make it right, but still. Waiting 2 hours for your main meal is a bit much even if you get a 10% discount. At $40 a person...was a bit disappointed. Food was great when they finally brought it out.

author: Gary Bressler
review_text: AYCE is opening soon on Ft Apache in Spring Valley right by our house so we drove to Henderson to check it out and everything was great.

author: John Vaisa
review_text: I’ve been coming here since this AYCE first opened. Sadly, I have to say, with a heavy heart, that the restaurant has gone downhill in customer service. You’re given 90 minutes to eat, but when you wait over 45 minutes just for a server to come by and take your order, that time is wasted. On top of that, when the food finally arrived, it wasn’t even the correct order. This was during dinner on a Saturday, which made the experience even more disappointing.

author: Stephen Black
review_text: Luis was our server and he was awesome explained everything and took care of us. The food is awesome and is served fast! The ambiance is nice and they were playing best of the 80s music. Very clean and has there A rating posted clearly. And I have been to many AYCE sushi restaurants and this one is a step above the rest. And there are many options for someone who does not like fish. So weather you like fish or not it will be your fault if you leave hungry. Thanks Luis

author: Miss Bella
review_text: Open daily and all options are available from open to close. Parking is available but limited. The atmosphere is Casual. Staff is friendly, knowledgeable, and attentive. The menu is listed on both front and back. Pricing for the food is reasonably priced, the all you can eat Crab Boil option is $45.95 which also includes everything on the menu except the items that are listed within the AYCE Premium Option $35.95. Price for kids (ages 4-9) is $14.95. Please refer to the picture of the menu that I have included. There is a 90 minute limit on dining. Enjoyed the Crab Boil, Boston Roll (Cooked Sushi), Steak and Shrimp teriyaki skewers, and of course the Crab legs with butter. Definitely a restaurant I will be returning to regularly.

author: Broderick Tolbert
review_text: Maaaaaaaan!!!!! This place is amazing! The food is second to none but, the drinks are to GOOD-to-be-true! The owner puts his own swing on the cocktails. I recommend The Mule, Apple Sake(comes in a nice bottle) and the Berry Citrus Sangria. This place does not disappoint!

author: Pat L.
review_text: Excellent place. The entertainmen along with a small cozy dance floor is lots of fun. It'll probably become a regular.

author: Jeremy Guzman
review_text: UPDATE: After many years is been since we have been here, we are not disappointed with the food or service. I had the fish special and wife had the hamburger as pictured. It was very good. Prices are reasonable, but no higher than most places these days. I still recommend and will be back. 👍👍😃 I've been coming to Inchabods for a few times now. And every time I come I love the food. It's fresh daily and the soups are good too. The wait staff is good too. I'm only speaking of the table side. But will keep coming back. :-) It's worth trying.

author: Katie Maus (KAT)
review_text: A truly wonderful place where you can order the same types of meals that your Mother or Grandmother's house used to make. There are 2 sections, smoking & non smoking. The Live 🎷 music is sensational. Sometimes jazz, sometimes country, 🎹and they have a crowd that comes for it, too. And did I mention, FINALLY priced low and fair, as it should to be. Drinks are righteous 🥃🍸Vintage Vegas at it's absolute BEST✨️

author: Monique Quiros
review_text: I stumbled upon this hidden gem while waiting for my vehicle windows to be tinted, and I’m so glad I did! This local restaurant and bar has a fantastic atmosphere with a Sleepy Hollow theme that adds a unique charm to the experience. The bar area offers plenty of seating options, and they have live music every evening, with karaoke kicking off every Saturday at 11 PM and going strong until 2 or 3 AM. It’s a perfect spot for a late-night hangout. What’s even better is their separate family-friendly dining area, so kids are more than welcome. Dinner is served all day, and I couldn’t resist trying their steak with breakfast potatoes and eggs—absolutely phenomenal! The food quality, paired with the ambiance, makes it a place I can't wait to return to. Service is pretty good as you’re promptly attended to, regardless of where you seat yourself and whether there was anyone at the front when you walked in. Ample parking that is free and directly in front of the lounge is available it is nestled in the complex next to the planet fitness. Highly recommend stopping by if you're in the area!

author: Dan Buckle
review_text: I had seen outside and thought it was just another Bar/Casino. But OMG this is Vegas nostalgia! The food is amazing, service is great. Went on Sinatra Saturday and the performer was fantastic, people were dancing - a perfect night out!

author: mackfrack
review_text: One of my absolute favorite places to spend an evening in Las Vegas. There’s live music every night, and our favorite group to watch is always The Ambassadors. They took a few special music requests and made our evening. We’ve had the same waiter several times, and the service is phenomenal. Definitely a budget friendly option for dinner and a show off the strip!

author: christopher varner
review_text: Was there for dinner very early, with my inlaws, so only saw the early bird crowd. I had the haddock which was surprisingly good. It has an old Vegas vibe, complete with a large chandelier over the baby grand. The restaurant side is non-smoking. Would definitely go back.

author: Lynn Surnock
review_text: We went at lunchtime and it was lovely. A relaxing and delicious meal. Service was exceptional. The chandelier was a real surprise. I would like to go back in the evening for rat pack type music.

author: TDC
review_text: This is an unassuming old school Vegas spot. There's a smoke-fee restaurant section and a bar/lounge section with live music. The clientele is older. This is not the Instagram crowd, and I say that in a good way. They have the best prime rib in town. Tender, juicy, well seasoned and perfectly prepared. My picture doesn't do it justice. The other items on the menu are generally ok. The customer service is hit or miss. The owner doesn't have the best reputation for different reasons.

author: Elaine DeFelice
review_text: This restaurant has wholesome, delicious food. I recently had the haddock which was so wonderfully cooked and they gave me enough for two people. This place is sort of vintage Vegas. The owner has a old car collection and he usually is displaying one at the top of the parking lot when you go there try this, you’ll like it. It’s also a great place to have a good conversation with friends or go on a date.Enjoy!

author: Kim Reale Artist
review_text: Ichabod’s is wonderful old school Las Vegas. The food is terrific. The service is superior and it’s got a very cozy atmosphere that you don’t find and a lot of the newer restaurants these days. Five stars all the way! I recommend it very highly.

author: Wade Marshall
review_text: I just want to thank you to Ichabobs for a wonderful Thanksgiving dinner. The atmosphere was outstanding. The customer service was even better. My experience there was 100% delightful Thank you Ichabobs .

author: Danielle M Liquori
review_text: I’ve never heard of this place and I went there for a party. It was a pretty good party and the people I New had a party in the dining room and they accommodated and set a really large table for them. I enjoyed my euro salad, and I had a iced tea. All the other dishes looked really good too.

author: Matt Krick
review_text: Great servers at this lounge. Great pasta but the steak was so so. The chocolate bomb cake was amazing! Very affordable prices!

author: Zelilah Perez
review_text: We had such a great time last night! The service was excellent, and the food was even better! My steak was cooked to perfection, and you can never go wrong with a baked potato. The atmosphere was Old School Vegas with a beautiful baby grand piano in the dining area. They even had a band in the bar area. Highly recommend!

author: CedarwoodPhotos
