review_text: We had a great time in the lounge. Quick bite to eat and then sang along with the piano man. Neal was fun and took requests. I would come back just for the piano bar.

author: Shelby Schwilke
review_text: This is one of those places where you walk in and you just know that you're comfortable there. The food is awesome and the services as well. For the couple of times I have been there the machines have not been very nice to me though. That is no fault of ichabods though. That's why they call it gambling.

author: James
review_text: I would like to say this is an amazing establishment. They have amazing food. Amazing customer service the owner keeps this place looking amazing. You can go here to have dinner or have a good time. Live music.

author: E L
review_text: Old school Vegas spot with great food and service. I enjoy that they have a seperate enclosed dining area away from the gaming and smoking. Been coming here for years with family and friends and we've never been disappointed.

author: Richard Carrillo
review_text: So I usually stick to the restaurant side of Ichabods but this time I opted for the lounge since I wanted to play a little video poker. Glad I did! They had my go-to drink: a Heineken 0.0%. I asked for a menu and went straight for my comfort food—the Meatloaf with a baked potato and steamed broccoli. A classic, and reasonably priced (especially in today’s economy). Service was great—Steph behind the bar was friendly and welcoming, and Kelly, my server, was attentive and made sure to time my meal just the way I like it. I asked to finish my salad before the main course came out, and she made it happen. By the time I was done eating… let’s just say I proudly reestablished myself as a member of the Clean Plate Club! As for the video poker… it wasn’t exactly my lucky day, but hey—that’s the game. Win some, lose some. If you’re in the area, definitely stop by. The place has that classic Old Vegas vibe that’s getting harder to find these days.

author: Marina
review_text: My husband and I have been here twice now and we will be back again. The food is to die for!!! We were the only ones who were eating when we arrived but we did go at an odd lunch time so we had the whole place to ourselves. I think the husband-wife owner team served us and they were very kind and also accommodating. I ordered a tea, shish kabob and then we ordered the saffron pistachio ice cream. The food is so fresh and flavored perfectly. The meat was tender and the veggies were grilled to perfection. My tea was delicious and fresh and the best part was the ice cream. I’ve never had saffron ice cream before but it’s now my favorite. We love the ambiance here. There is a stage where I imagine is live music but while we were there, Arabic music was playing and I loved listening to it. Can’t wait to come back. Oh yeah, the booths were very spacious and comfortable and the serving size for the price is worth it.

author: Juvanny Joseph
review_text: We had the Kabab Koobideh (which is ground beef kabob skewers, rice, and grilled tomatoes) and the beef soltani (which is one ground beef skewer and one flat filet mignon/tenderloin piece with rice and grilled tomatoes). Everything was delectable. The beef was seasoned to perfection and cooked perfectly. Every bite was juicy and bursting with flavor. It’s clear that they use quality meat. I can’t speak on the chicken kabobs but if their beef kabobs are any indication, the chicken should be just as good. The rice was also cooked perfectly. At a lot of Persian restaurants I’ve been to, the rice is usually undercooked or lacking in flavor and the meat is either too dry or lacks the appropriate seasoning. But this place does both right. They also serve black tea after a meal if you ask. The service is friendly and attentive. The atmosphere is also a nice place to bring family or friends to. It would also work well for a small event (80-100 people). If you’re looking for high quality, delicious Persian food, I strongly recommend Soroush.

author: Dio Fitzgerald
review_text: Food and Music was awesome!!! I had the Chicken Kabob and it was the best chicken kabob I’ve eaten! And the waiters are very nice and friendly! Don’t miss out on amazing Persian food so please eat here.

author: Kinney
review_text: Joojeh (chicken breast) and Koobideh (beef) charcoal grilled! Delicious fluffy basmati rice. Grilled tomatoes. Authentic. Spiced perfectly! You will love it! Clean and bright restaurant, inviting hosts. Very enjoyable dining experience.

author: Rmsadeq
review_text: It was great 😍🤩Iranian authentic food with the best koobideh kebab and excellent rice. Definitely give it a try. The staff were also wonderful and very kind.

author: Sammy Sage
review_text: Expectations were absolutely met and exceeded. From the moment we arrived, the service was fabulous—warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. The staff made us feel taken care of without being overbearing, which really set the tone for a great experience. The food came out piping hot and was beyond tasty. Every bite was full of rich, authentic flavor, clearly made with high-quality ingredients and attention to detail. Portions were generous, presentation was beautiful, and everything tasted fresh and perfectly seasoned. You can tell this place takes pride in both their cuisine and their hospitality. It’s the kind of restaurant that makes you want to come back again and again. Highly recommended for anyone looking for amazing food and outstanding service!

author: Arvin Rahmatian
review_text: Persian here, food was amazing with PLENTY of options. We got the family platter and it was at a great price and plenty. I cannot stress how AMAZING our waiters were, they were nice and very funny. One of them even were so nice they called someone famous who I like, I didn’t even ask them or anything. They just were so nice because they realized that I liked the person, but I didn’t even say anything. This completely made my day. He even told my family amazing stories.

author: Julie Ershadi
review_text: Unfortunately the food was really bad. The service was very friendly and attentive. But the skirt steak in the beef soltani was not browned and tasted very old, like one day away from going bad. The ghormeh sabzi was black(?!) and not very flavorful, the meat in both khoreshes was totally dry and flavorless, like cubes of cardboard. Everything was really oily and salty. The kashke bademjan tasted really off, I don't even know what was going on there. Even the lavash sucked. :\

author: Ehsan Asadi
review_text: The food was generally okay. The portion was smaller than I expected. The chicken wasn't cooked well though. The kobideh was better than the chicken. The service was not professional. They had difficulty managing 5 tables.

author: Mory Rabi
review_text: The food was absolutely delicious and tasted very authentic. The kebab koobideh and ground chicken were perfectly seasoned and juicy, and the saffron rice was fluffy and fragrant. The atmosphere was warm, clean, and welcoming, and the staff were extremely friendly and attentive. Higher recommended.

author: David DiVito
review_text: Me and my wife stopped in starving for a late lunch and had no idea what to expect. We love trying new places, and Soroush Mediterranean Cuisine did not disappoint! The atmosphere is warm and beautifully decorated. I ordered a barg kabob, and honestly, I wanted to lick the plate clean. The portion was generous, the food fresh, and hours later I was still full and satisfied. We also tried the pistachio and saffron ice cream—absolutely excellent and unlike anything I’ve ever had before. Thank you to Soroush for a wonderful dining experience. We’ll definitely be coming back!

author: Lucia Spill
review_text: Delicious homemade Persian food !! Authentic and tasty. Stumbled across this place and happy I walked in. Owner and staff are lovely. Highly recommend will be coming back soon.

author: Beyzaa Osmani
review_text: I have tried many different Persian and Mediterranean cuisines, but this one stands out at the top. The food is absolutely delicious and enjoyable. The staff members are friendly and attentive. I loved everything about the experience and will definitely return. I highly recommend it 😃

author: Staci Crouch
review_text: The best Persian food in Vegas! The food is so good and the owner is the sweetest. It's worth going off the strip for. Just a 15 min cab and you'll get one of the best meals! My favorite is the Barg with rice. So tasty!

author: Bradford Webster
review_text: What a hidden gem Saroush is! We got the filet and the chicken shawarma and the hummus and eggplant and everything was amazing! They have room for big parties and can have a full bar if you need it. We got to meet the owners and they were lovely, we will definitely be back soon, thank you for your hospitality!

author: D J
review_text: The food was average. It didn't have a lot of flavor. The grape leaves were the best item for the taste that we ordered. The beef kabob wasn't char grilled which made a difference in the taste I am used to getting. While eating the heating ventilation system kicked on and was horribly loud. We left early because of the loud noise. You couldn't hear the other person talk. I expected a lot more for the price point of the dinner. We did not get any free soup as others outlined in their reviews. We asked for a glass of water and was told we would be dissatisfied with the tap water and to order the bottle of water for $2. Somehow I don't think they will be in business for long. I won't be returning soon.

author: Mishary Almutairi
review_text: Amazing experience overall. The lamb shank was outstanding—tender, flavorful, and easily the highlight of the meal. I genuinely loved it and would definitely order it again.

author: Aryan Shah
review_text: Great food and great service. The food was so good I wanted to keep eating but had no space left. Cant believe this place isn’t more popular. I must suggest the chicken kabab

author: Seth Coldren
review_text: The food, service, hospitality, and ambiance was incredible. We arrived at lunch time with a large party of 11 people. They took our group in and treated us like family! They moved tables around so we could all sit together, and prepared one of the most delicious family style meals we’ve ever had. We will definitely be back and look forward to next time!

author: Kach Opinion
review_text: Was craving Mediterranean food and came across this place on a whim. The koobideh is absolutely delicious!!! The plate was enough for 2 people to share. Will definitely be back :)

author: Fay M
review_text: All you can eat sushi for 90 minutes for $31 ($18 for kids 5-9). They have a lot of items on their menu including ramen, salads, skewers and desserts. We got there late so I chose to just à la carte a couple of items but next time I'll definitely do the all you can eat option.

author: Jay Kim
review_text: Got there super as they opened and our waitress was really nice. Ordered the dinner version of the ayce for two. Food was good and I enjoyed it for an ayce spot. I loved that my rolls were not mostly rice ... but the fish slices were quite thin for my liking so it was a borderline wash for me. As I mentioned that my waitress was super nice and was very attentive, however, some of my orders were never fulfilled (but I did not mention this to my waitress). Service would have been a 5 out of 5 but since several dishes I ordered were unaccounted for and still a little hungry at the end of my 90 mins,tis why I have the service a 4 out of 5. Taste wise, I would give this spot a 3 out of 5 (as a sushi snob) but accounting for value, how quick my food came out, and overall the service with a beautiful smile, I gave it a 4. Would I come back? I would probably revisit this spot but with less expectations. Our total with drinks came out to be roughly $115 ish and left a $20+ tip.

author: I. Molnar
review_text: Great selection of sushi for dinner or lunch AYCE! My favorites are baked muscles and nigiri salmon egg, also the hand rolls are pretty good. Fresh fish, well made. For the price you get top for your dollar, so dont expect some royalty ikra and real lobster, but there wont be any shortages of goods... Mochi mango for dessert was delicious and just scratched the right spot. Place is clean and well designed. Would definitely come back!! Update: I did come back and ordered the Gigi, No Name, and Flamingo. Reason is, Ive seen you can order them only once. Absolutely delicious sushi rolls! A MUST TRY! Now I know what Im ordering until I get tired of it :D

author: Cheshire Cat
review_text: Wow what an amazing sushi place....absolutely delicious and affordable. Wonderful experience with José and the entire staff. Chill atmosphere, and they also habe great wine, sake and beer. Highly recommend!

author: Amanda Taylor
review_text: Omg! The sushi was beyond what I thought it was. Sake options were fruitful and my friend and I could not get enough of the one fish! Must try! Service was accommodating and atmosphere with music was catchy.

author: Kelvie Malia
review_text: Ono Sushi was… semi-licious. Let’s just say the food was decent—not bad, but certainly not the highest quality or freshest grade sushi I’ve ever had. The flavors were okay, but nothing stood out as exceptional or memorable. If you’re looking for sushi that wows you, this might not be the place. What really tipped the experience downhill, though, was the bathroom situation. Imagine this: no toilet paper, no paper towels, and not even a sign of an attempt to fix it quickly. I flagged this issue to the servers, but nothing was done until another customer also complained after going to the bathroom. Mind you, the restaurant wasn’t even a third full, so they had more than enough time to address the issue promptly. It’s disappointing when basic things like cleanliness and customer care are overlooked, especially when the restaurant wasn’t busy. While the food was passable, the lack of attention to something as essential as stocking the restroom left a bad taste in my mouth.

author: leonel renteria
review_text: Place was off the charts amazing. One server and runner for about 9-10 tables. The sushi chefs and serving staff did amazing tonight. I didn't get their names but visited on Sat December 20th at about 5pm for dinner service! Never waited very long for anything and the one server and runner did amazing with as many tables that they had. Regret not taking any photos!

author: AndreaKiana OK
review_text: Thank you Wendy and Jackie! They were absolutely amazing servers! Food was great as always. I Ordered the dragon sushi roll and jackpot sushi roll.

author: Meia Ford
review_text: Ono Sushi was definitely ONO!!! They really live up to their name. We just had our Reception dinner there and the service Bell and Wendy put down was on point❣️❣️They service was fast, clean and friendly. FOOD was delicious 😋 😍, especially for the price! 🍣🍢🍤🍥We are putting it on our list of regular spots!! Go Check em out...

author: Angelica Moore
review_text: Best sushi spot. So close to the stip. Sushi so fresh and lots of flavors. We had a great time. Nice and cozy inside. Miss Suzette had the best recommendations and her playlist was on point. It’s super cute inside. Lastly desert was amazing. We came twice in a row!!!

author: Joel Headley
review_text: Update: another visit to Vegas with another great visit to Ono. There are plenty of other all you can eat places, but I'd be worried we would have said, Oh no, had we visited there. White the rules are still listed in the menu, the waiter seems eager to make us happy rather than stick to the letter of the law. I had the deep fried rice which had spicy tuna and is sauced to finish my meal. Great easy to end it. _________________ Great sushi in Vegas? Ono Sushi has shown it's possible. If you eat like I do, the lunch all-you-can-eat sushi is a great deal. All sushi and food is still prepared each order and comes out looking, and ultimately tasting great. There's a 90 minute limit on the meal, and you get charged for leftovers if you can't eat what is ordered, but loosen the belt and get as much as you can.

author: Mika'ele Keni'
review_text: Ono Sushi is a solid AYCE spot; Southeast of the Strip, about a fifteen minute drive. I came here for a quick solo lunch, was the first one to arrive and get seated when it opened. A few other patrons started trickling in. All of them looked like local professionals on their respective lunch breaks. I don't think there were any tourists. Medium size venue with a decent amount of seating with plenty of parking available in the plaza. I didn't realize I've actually been here before...forgot to write a review. The menu has changed a bit. I don't see s few item I got the last time I was here. Looks like they were minimally staffed. There was a lady running the front, taking orders a cleaning tables...superstar efficiency kind of stuff. I only saw one chef making all the sushi and I heard there were another one or two people in the back. Everything came out in a timely manor, good presentation and food was good. No issues! I was impressed... #AYCE: ~ Idako Karaage (Baby Octopus) - 3.5/5 ~ Geso Karaage (Squid Legs) - 3.5/5 ~ Pork Belly - 5/5 ~ Sashimi Appetizer (Chef Choice) - 4/5 ~ Oyster - 4/5 ~ Poke Tacos - 4/5 ~ Kaki Fry (Fried Oyster) - 4/5 ~ Shrimp Skewer - 4/5 ~ Salmon Belly - 4/5 ~ Ocean Trout - 4/5 ~ Amaebi - 4/5 ~ Uni - 4/5 ~ Unagi - 4/5 ~ Nigiri - 4/5 - Ikura - 4/5 - Ono - 4/5 - Red Snapper - 4/5 ~ Lychee sorbet - 4/5 I noticed some this that are no longer on the menu: Previous visit: (2019) ~ Seasoned Brussle Sprouts - 4/5 ~ Green Tea Pannacotta - 4/5 ~ Red Bean Ice Cream - 4/5 This place definitely has a more local vibe to it. No issues coming back...

author: Hannah Swann
review_text: Amazing sushi! Every roll was delicious and no wasting any sushi because it's all so good you cant resist eating it. Destiny and Bella gave us such great service which made the whole experience that much better. This is our new go to AYCE Sushi 🍣

author: Lanxin Shen (Ada)
review_text: Food is good and they got many interesting items. A lot of non-rice options :) And $30 for AYCE

author: Angelo Cantrell
review_text: Great customer service. Welcoming and heart warming. Clean and nice smelling. And they were friendly. The type of restaurant that has a good staff. I definitely appreciated the customer service. A great place!

author: Jacob Ekegren
review_text: Price is great. Went out for a good time. Ordered a bunch of food and the server was great. She was by herself, but did an amazing job.

author: A Day with Melo Melo
review_text: I’ve been here not once but many times. I loved the service and food! Reasonable prices. Wendy our server is very nice and professional. Thanks for outstanding customer service!

author: Cynthia Spenard
review_text: We sat at the bar, our server Jese and team had our drinks in before we knew it we had food sitting in front of us hot and ready!!! Thank you for a tasty evening...

author: Brian Kwok
review_text: Great place for Japanese food in Las Vegas. Very reasonable price with quality food. Fish is fresh, and many items are for choice. But tempura is not that great.

author: Mark Kunie
review_text: Great staff. Everything was fresh and perfect quality. Monkeys dream is a must. PaDak chicken also.

author: Iveta Petelova
review_text: To be honest Roberto’s is so much better; I got a burrito asada; the meat was not seasoned and sometimes some beef has this..very unfavorable old fatty like taste -that is just not a good taste . I asked for sour cream (in hopes u can kill the beef flavor and eat the rest) that’s $3 but no one tells you it’s extra; I had a smoothie - not home made; rather an ice packed with cool air taste.. service charge for credit card is another $1; tip is automatically added for parties. The “regular” burrito and soft drink ran me $34 and for $24 the next day I went to AYCE sushi/ Asian food I did enjoy the authentic items as decor - and I always try to find something good in any situation so here - enjoy the atmosphere :)

author: W M
review_text: Food was great. Prices were reasonable especially compared to the outrageous strip restaurants. We ended up here based on tik tok reviews of the place and glad we came. The atmosphere is cute, very authentic Mexican vibe. Sometimes places are social media picture worthy but the food doesn't match. This place was good. We are used to our LA Mexican spots so we can be picky 😂. Check this place out, definitely worth a visit. Staff was very friendly.

author: Evelyn Cota
review_text: This place is stunning! The staff is fun and playful. The food is delicious! Our waiter had great suggestions for us. They were very attentive to our table. The food marked labeled as "spicy" is moderately spicy but nothing overwhelming. The portions are sizeable. If you're looking for authentic Mexican food, this is a great choice.

author: Thelma Ortiz
review_text: We recently ate there for my daughter’s wedding. Thalia and Mr. Velasquez treated us with kindness, respect and integrity. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone. We were welcomed like family and they are so generous too. The food is delicious, freshly cooked and served. The atmosphere is pleasant and the decor is beautiful. Thank you both for making this experience possible and we hope to see you soon.

author: Omar Ramos
review_text: Good food, very reasonable prices, and significant portions. I found this place via a TikTok posting and I have to say, it didn’t disappoint. The restaurant is medium sized and it’s family owned. The decor is Mexican to the max but that doesn’t really impact the food. I had two salsas Azada wet burrito and it was really good. I added some of the spicy green salsa that comes with the complimentary chips to add more spice to it. Overall, great food with plenty of parking space. The customer service is great too. The staff is super friendly.

author: Denella Gaona
review_text: We live right down the street and never knew this place existed. We went yesterday and were so impressed. Right when u walk in, it's absolutely gorgeous, nice, cool, clean, and smells great. The food was delicious, and the waitress was very attentive. We were impressed with this restaurant so much. It's a bit out of eyesight, so you don't see it right away. But I really recommend this place if anyone wants some great Mexican food.

author: Gerald Prado
review_text: This is the best Mexican restaurant in all of Las Vegas. Tortillas were fresh, the beef enchiladas had some of the best shredded beef. Was basicallly Barbacoa. Sabroso! 10/10 would enchilada again.

author: Jennifer Rios
review_text: Really enjoyed the ambiance like walking into an authentic Mexican place with beautiful decor. My mom loved the background music of her favorite singer Javier Solis. When you walk in everyone is very nice and welcoming, the waitress was nice and attentive and I over heard another young waiter taking care of a table with all ladies and one in particular was being picky and he had great customer service and allot of patience. I felt bad for him but I have to say he did a great job. Me and my mom had a good dinner, we ordered the fajitas with chicken and shrimp and it was delicious the shrimp were big and the chicken was cooked just right, it had allot of bell peppers of all 3 kinds and onions and all was very fresh. The beans and rice also very good. It was a big portion and we took leftovers home. I recommend this place and prices are good.

author: David
review_text: For a great dine in experience with the family, Los Cedros Mexican Restaurant is the place to go. This was highly recommended by my fellow peers on Google. They were spot on. I ordered the Wet Burrito with Carne de Pastor with red sauce, and the portions are filling, I would say huge, but I ate the whole thing....lol. The sauce was flavorful, not too thick or watered down. It had a great consistency, and the flower tortilla is not homemade, but a good quality and held up to the sauce and carne. The pastor had a great flavor and also not to salty, and you can taste that hint of chorizo. It's topped off with sour cream and side of salsa. Dish does not come with rice or beans but can be ordered separately. The atmosphere is amazing also, you feel like you're in a different country. The corn tortillas are hand-made fresh to order, so any dish you order, I recommend asking for the corn tortillas. I included pics of other dishes my family ordered. It's a 10-minute drive east from the Las Vegas strip

author: Eli Hernandez
review_text: My family and I love coming here! I usually always get the same thing, the mole enchiladas. They’re delicious! Also their agua Fresca tamarindo flavor is so good!

author: Mario Reyna
review_text: The food and service was excellent! There was a good balance of checking in and letting us enjoy the food, atmosphere, and overall vibe of the place. It was not busy at 5pm on a Saturday, which I really enjoyed. Definitely worth the drive.

author: Omar Lopez (Marejo)
review_text: I found this place on TikTok, and it was called the Mexican Narnia. It did NOT disappoint. It was beautiful inside. The best atmosphere I've ever been in for a Mexican restaurant. The only disappointment was I ordered Menudo, and they didn't have any. I settled for the Chilaquiles, and they were fire🔥 with asada on them. Big portion. My prima had a shrimp cocktail and my mom and had some ceviche, and it was all very good. It's definitely a must try. We showed up once they opened, and within 20 minutes of sitting down, that place was packed. Make sure you are hungry if you visit cause they hook it up.

author: Robert M
review_text: Food is great no doubt. Visited on not busy day it was empty so the atmosphere was pretty relaxing. I'm not sure how this place is when it's busy, but food arrived on time. Waiter was moody but not rude. Mole enchiladas 🤌🏽.

author: L VK
review_text: To celebrate Cinco de Mayo we chose a fun local spot we hadn’t been to. Located on Flamingo Rd in Las Vegas, Los Cedros is definitely a great find. As a family-owned establishment, their dedication to authentic Mexican cuisine shines through in every dish. The Mexican-inspired explosion decor, adorned with Virgin de Guadalupe statues, Mexican art, fountains, colorful flags and flowers through and even intricately decorated bathrooms, creates a visually stunning atmosphere. Our dining experience was nothing short of spectacular. We were warmly greeted with complimentary chips and salsa, setting the tone for a fantastic meal. The guacamole was a standout with its generous serving and amazing flavors. The shrimp tacos, chicken tacos, and bean burrito were a delightful explosion of flavors that left us wanting to lick the plates. To complement our meal, we indulged in their margaritas in mango, strawberry, and pomegranate flavors. These cocktails were not only excellent but also generously poured and delightfully strong. The service at Los Cedros was great, friendly, fun, and incredibly attentive. Overall Los Cedros is an excellent find for anyone craving authentic Mexican cuisine in Vegas. From the decor to the food to the service, every aspect of our visit was exceptional. Highly recommended for a flavorful and memorable dining experience!

author: Scott Bradford
review_text: Chirping bird sounds was a bit much. Although some will like the very busy decorations I felt it to be plastic feeling and too much. The prices were reasonable and food passable. They were able to seat our group of 20 at one table.

author: Carla Harris
review_text: The food was great when it finally came, the wait to be seated was an hour and after being seated and getting our orders taken right away, the people next to us got served first though they were seated after. We waited and additional 30 minutes for our food to arrive to the table. Shrimp was huge and juicy in the molcajete, and the beans (which I hate) was absolutely delicious! The staff was great and our waiter was the greatest. He was funny and gorgeous. The prices were high but very well worth it and you can tell the food is authentic and made to serve, also if you think you don’t want to tip that’s out the question the tip is included on the receipt automatically.

author: Nelson Brunes
review_text: While visiting Las Vegas I wanted some good Mexican food and I found a post on tiktok about this place. I ordered the molcajete for 2 people for take out, and it was amazing, so much food and so much flavor. Next time, I'll make sure to eat in

author: Jo De Leon
review_text: The food was delicious, and the service was on point. I highly recommend the cilantro steak. We originally went to try chilaquiles, but they were soggy and had no egg. Every other dish was excellent.

author: Daisy Linares
review_text: The place is very beautiful and unique. The food was amazing. Love the mojarra frita. It was amazing 😋🥰🥰😍 The restrooms are very clean and very beautifully decorated.

author: Connor Scotton
review_text: Fun….super fresh fajita’s!!!!! This is a small authentic Mexican restaurant that is tucked into a corner end plaza. Keep going!!!!! Its great food served very neatly and very fresh. So well done.

author: Aaron Feld
review_text: As of today, my favorite & by far the best New York Style Pizza in Las Vegas! We decided last minute to try Lucinos’s, a place I tried years ago that was always good. I don’t remember them being this great. Crust was perfectly cooked, sauce was so tasty, & they had a great Vegan cheese option. The Margherita pizza was perfectly cooked too. We tried their poppers which were delicious & the homemade vegan ranch was incredible. They had mozzarella sticks that were huge & the kids enjoyed them. Everything is priced well & the service is impeccable! Erika, our server was exceptional. The place is super clean & has a lot of space. I’m not into sports but if you are they have a handful of tvs to watch games. Team Luciano’s! Thanks For everything. See you soon!

author: DANIEL LAWSON
review_text: Had to try a philly after another local said they had the best. And it was great! had a joeys philly, love the fresh texture of the imported rolls. What a difference. Had a slice of tomato pizza which really good as well. East Coast pizzaria vibe as well.

author: Harrison Nguyen
review_text: **Lucino's Pizza — A Philadelphia Gem in Las Vegas** Lucino's Pizza is more than just a place to grab a slice; it embodies East Coast authenticity right in the heart of Las Vegas. The dining room is a tribute to Philadelphia sports culture, adorned with framed jerseys, memorabilia lining the walls, and TVs playing the latest games, creating an atmosphere of camaraderie and excitement. This is a venue where the joy of sharing a good meal pairs perfectly with a sense of tradition. In the kitchen, classic techniques are employed with skill and care. The hand-tossed crust is a standout feature, striking a balance between chewiness and char. It boasts a gently blistered edge with just the right amount of texture and a tender center. The "original" slice delivers a harmonious flavor profile, with tangy tomato purée, stretchy mozzarella, and a touch of salinity that enhances the overall taste. The pepperoni version adds a delicious contrast with crispy edges from rendered fat and a hint of spice, while the cheese slice, satisfying yet straightforward, highlights the beauty of quality dairy. Value and practicality shine through with Lucino's 2-slice-and-a-drink lunch special—a wise choice for a midday meal that offers both comfort and affordability (the complimentary soda adds a charming, nostalgic touch). The portions are generous yet sensible, fitting perfectly with the lively sports-bar vibe where patrons gather, cheer, and enjoy their food throughout the game. The Lucino's Fries deserve special mention. Their crinkle-cut shape provides an extra crunch and maximizes seasoning retention. Dressed with the house garlic-parmesan sauce, the fries achieve a rich umami flavor. The addition of Pecorino cheese adds a salty, nutty contrast, while parsley flakes provide a fresh touch to keep the dish exciting. Overall, the fries are well-crafted and complement the Pizza beautifully. Service is efficient and friendly, matching the casual pace of a sports-themed lunch or a lively evening of game-watching. The staff handles orders with a warm, approachable demeanor that fits the restaurant's confident charm. For anyone craving an authentic East Coast pizza experience and a lively, sports-friendly atmosphere in Las Vegas, Lucino's Pizza is an excellent choice. It avoids gimmicks and instead focuses on delivering honest, well-prepared food at a fair price, making it ideal for gatherings, game nights, or anyone looking to savor a taste of Philadelphia with genuine craftsmanship.

author: Fairraiting
review_text: Highly recommended! Very friendly staff, the server was great! She checked on us all the time. They deserve every penny you give 💗

author: douglas hendrix
review_text: To me one of the best pizza places in vegas....by far my favorite..... don't even have to go for Just Pizza the appetizer menu is second to none a absolute must try are the hot honey chicken strips and the chicken parm egg roles

author: Michael Ruelas
review_text: The service was top notch! The lady was very polite and went above and beyond to help me with the large order. The food was good, but needed a little more to get that fifth star. The atmosphere is great if your an eagles fan. I recommend the supreme and the Philly pizza.

author: Kismet
review_text: Best pizza in town and reheats the next day even better (that’s if there’s leftovers)! I enjoy supporting a small family business that really cares and creates delicious food. Can’t wait u until the next time I can treat myself!

author: Sandy L
review_text: The Chick-fil-A pizza is interesting and delicious. I was pretty skeptical how a chick fil a be incorporated into a pizza but they did it. The crisscut fries were very crispy, the sauce was on point to the chick fil a sauce. Very creative. The Bird is spot on with spicy-ness and the ooey gooey cheese on top. The meatball sub was alright but not great. The meatball was a little dry. The Classic Philly is also tasty. The meat was very tender n it melts in your mouth.

author: Alejandra Cervantez
review_text: Wings were awesome! I had the hot buffalo and the lemon pepper also had hot buffalo sauce which was super delicious. The pizza tasted really fresh the crust was superb. I would highly recommend this place for really amazing wings. But be prepared, the wings are on the pricey side. We got 3 drinks, a pizza, and a 24 count of wings, and the total was close to $79. But the wings were worth it.

author: Parker Fitzgerald
review_text: Joey & Erica are the best! I went here the other night with a friend and I must say that I was very impressed. It is by far one of my new favorite pizza spots here in Las Vegas. I had two slices of pizza (pepperoni & cheese) and also the Philly Philly which was also very good. Cannot wait to be back soon. TRUE FACT: Their bread comes from Jersey and their steak comes from Philly! Makes the food very good high quality and top notch!

author: Josemari O. Calip (Joma)
review_text: This was my first time visiting through my buddy Jeremy. He reckoned me and I actually like it if it is actually a family friend orientated a little better than your average pizza, but they are from Philadelphia so definitely go through that. I am an ECW Philadelphia fan so I'm sure the owner will know a lot of them. But overall definitely give that a shot if you're around town. Definitely a crown jewel Susie was actually one of the servers that helped me so definitely worth it out

author: Nathan King
review_text: Too tier! My dad and I enjoyed a meat lovers pizza and a Philly. The crust on the pizza was out of this world! The bread on the Philly was so soft and the cheese steak was massive. Our eyes were bigger than our stomachs but we managed to make it thought all the food because it was DELICIOUS!!!! Definitely a must try place! Great staff, clean restaurant and tasty food!

author: Where To Feed
review_text: THE BEST CHEESESTEAK! THE BEST PIZZA! (the culture fries!!!) Just now realizing I have never reviewed the place I frequent the most in Las Vegas! I took it for granted how amazing it was. Taking the time now to say it!!

author: SKIP.ej1
review_text: Food was excellent 👌 loved it. Live band. Was so awesome.. order the ONION RiNGS.. there the best. Should have came back the next day when the Eagles played DeM B☆YS though. Otherwise this place is great. And will most def be coming back again.

author: Kenzi
review_text: Dined in today. Truly was the best experience I’ve had at a restaurant! Staff is so kind especially our server Suzy. Food was amazing! Highly recommend the Caesar Salad Fries, Buffalo Chicken pizza, and the Apple Walnut dessert pizza. All in all amazing experience food is beyond delicious! I will be back! 😋

author: Cani Esma
review_text: Don't get me wrong, their Philly Cheesesteak, Supreme Pizza, and Garlic Parm wings were good, but the customer service could be better. I had to cancel an order because we unexpectedly had to take our dog to the emergency vet. I called the store when they were still located next to 7-11, apologized profusely, and was assured by the employee that they would "take care of it" (whatever that meant). -- Several months later, they move near the Walmart Supercenter on Pecos and Trop, and I decided to place an order. The employee seemed nervous on the phone, told me he was getting the manager, and I was immediately told that I had an outstanding balance from the time I canceled. I explained what happened, and the manager claimed that he was never informed and that I still had to pay, or else I was barred from future purchases. -- Well, since I like the food and had hyped them up to my family, I paid the outstanding amount. The total came to about 80 something dollars. I've had my fair share of working retail, so I don't really give a hoot that the employee forgot, because we all have those days. What I didn't really appreciate was the awkward and unnecessary tension in that phone call and in-person pickup, as if I was trying to cheat them out of 40 dollars. I can understand where they were coming from, but my family and I won't be returning. *Edit: Love the response from owner continuing to claim that there was no documentation about the incident, yet here they are replying, scrambling to their defense, and getting dates mixed up as if they know what I'm referring to; because the incident was fairly brief. As previously mentioned, I don't care that the employee forgot their own store's policy and let it slip that they would help me. At the end of the day, I remembered this place and gave my own experience in exchange for points. They can complain about it and respond all they want; I have every right to express feeling uncomfortable enough not to return as much as they have the right to reply.

author: James Wong
review_text: A restaurant that could be plucked right out of Philly, Lucino’s serves good pizza and even better authentic Philly cheesesteaks and other fares in an environment that celebrates the reigning NFL Super Bowl champion Eagles. Serving sizes are generous and in today’s environment can be considered decent value. Add a trivia night that is hosted one night every other week and you have a restaurant that deserves regular visits.

author: Sam L
review_text: Being from PA, this was a must-visit. And I am happy to say, Lucino’s is ALWAYS the best! Whether it be the pizza, the wings, pasta, everything is delicious. And the Cheesesteak are a MUST!

author: Loowee
review_text: Located in a regular shopping plaza, front entrance doesn't suggest that there is a restaurant there. Once inside, its small and very clean, purposely designed just like most east coast pizzarias. Service was very good and welcoming. I ordered a slice of Sicilian cheese. The sauce on the pizza was magical. You can tell the quality. The crust although was tick but was also airy which made it easy to eat. I definitely recommend and will be back soon.

author: Daniel Herrera
review_text: Delicious and affordable pizza-by-the slice! Very hard to find these days, perfect for a quick lunch stop. Restaurant was clean, spacious and has multiple TVs for viewing. Erika was very friendly and accommodating. Hooked me up with a slice and side salad. Salad was big and very tasty with lots of veggies in it. Pepperoni pizza was crispy and hot and not too greasy. Slice was not huge, but on the bigger side. There were lots of options for slices when I went in. So far a Hidden gem!

author: Rick Reinhardt
review_text: Good food with real onion rings. Lots of different choice burgers but they didn't have hot fudge Sunday. I'm not supposed to eat it anyways so probably a good thing but our Hardee's have it. Good service

author: V Cat
review_text: If i could give 0 stars i would. I go in to the drive thru make my order. A few minutes later im told to park my car and go inside to pick up my food. I go inside there is a group of people waiting and showing the workers their receipts of what they ordered. I told the worker if i or anybody who used the drive thru wanted to park our cars come in to pick up the food we not have used the drive thru in the first place. Next thing I over hear the employees asking one another whose order is whose and whose order is next in front of the customers present. I regret not asking for my mobey back. My food arrives no apology given. This place needs better management. If you are overwhelmed or short staff. Put sign up to have customers not use the drive thru and just take orders one by one 1 line at the cashier so people will get there food, the person at the grill wont be overwhelmed and orders will not get mixed up.

author: Teresa Demos
review_text: Don’t get the hand breaded chicken sandwich. It is very rubbery in the texture is not good even though it is cooked fresh. I’ve already eaten it so I don’t really have a picture, but it is edible, but I just didn’t like the texture at all. Everything else was perfectly fine.

author: Emiliano Guerra Juarez
review_text: The food and customer service was excellent and exceptional and delightful. The shift leader Kyle was really amazing at his job I had a question about the food and he gave me the most amazing feedback and honest recommendation about his favorite burger the western bacon cheeseburger such an amazing experience here today. I love kyle great food and great service.

author: Eric Creighton
review_text: I went to the Carl's jr on sunset and it was closed as in forever and I should have followed my first mind and went somewhere other than Carl's Jr but I went to Carl's Jr on eastern they had an old lady behind the window couldn't hear so reluctantly ordered the food anyway when I got home this is how many fries I had didn't matter because the fries where like a day old she had a bad attitude but that's okay because if I was in my mind to late 70s I would probably be the same but anyway this will be my last time ever going to any Carl's Jr in the state of Nevada again

author: Raven Cuddels
review_text: Wow!! Lawrence was super nice and professional - Him and the lady chef were fast and amazing! Give them a raise! amazing food

author: Shaun Lomelin
review_text: I've eaten from this location multiple times, and the accuracy level is about 25%. I ordered a Double Western Bacon, and a California Classic. I received a basic double cheeseburger, and a single burger that is most definitely not a Double Western. I didn't even have time to return it since I had to make it to school on time. If this were the first or second time, I'd be a bit more forgiving, but this is well beyond that. What a waste of money.

author: Karla
review_text: The manager was very rude and completely unhelpful. They messed up the order and she didn’t even try to fix it. The service is awful in general and the place is not clean at all. Not worth it

author: Sarah Wilson
review_text: Great Carlo Jr Location! My Husband & I stop to grab a bite to eat here and the serves was great & the food well made well & quickly! That Jennifer & her Team!

author: Anya Lindsey
review_text: Passing thru town we went drive thru. I requested 2 cups of mayonnaise on the side. The girl acted like the four ranches was being generous.Even though the food we ordered was supposed to come with that many dipping sauces. She handed me 1 mayo so I asked her for a second. Her words were "we're too busy. We can't do it. We don't have the time," so I told her, Get me a manager & my second cup of mayonnaise. Manager never came to window & the 2 cup was 1/3 filled. $30 for super dry over heated horrible food plus an attitude.... corporate needs to fix this!!

author: L C
review_text: I ordered the Jalapeno Angus Burger Combo which was very good. The ingredients all came together perfectly: pepper jack cheese, jalapeno, lettuce, tomatos, red onions and santa fe sauce. Fries are served hot & crispy lightly salted. 4 1/2 Stars.

author: María
review_text: Food could be better, weird people coming in and THE WORST MANAGER EVER she is very rude to both costumers and workers…

author: Olena Voloshchuk
review_text: I ordered one combo and a separate burger. They charged me for two combos instead and then said they couldn’t refund me because the manager was not in on weekends. I'm going to point out that I was asked multiple times if I wanted to make it a combo and I said no every time and they still gave me two combos instead of just one. I'm very disappointed. I’m sorry but 26$ is ridiculously expensive for processed food. I’m not coming here again.

author: Brandon Martin
review_text: They stopped carrying Beyond burgers, so we don't go anymore. They have good burgers though. Like any of the fast food joints, if the food is fresh it's pretty good. I'd say it's probably 85% of the time at any Carl's Jr.

author: George Cendejas
review_text: I ordered Large fries and received fries in a box still flat, not opened all the way. Theyre stingy on the fries. The cashier told me it doesnt make a difference.

author: Steven
review_text: Always enjoy Carl's Jr. My go to is the Double Western Bacon cheeseburger.

author: FlavorFool-N-Spain
review_text: My brother told me they had great breakfast sandwiches...and he was correct!!!! I had the bacon and 😋

author: Hello Dude
review_text: The food was phenomenal! Your manager there, what's her name? Jennifer is a wonder to be around. If I had anything to complain about I just wish you would add strawberry/grape jelly to the menu. The biscuit can be a little dry. 11/10 otherwise. Please think about the jelly.

author: kimberly Clement
review_text: 8pm at night. # 1, i did not get a welcome in or anything. #2, ordered my food, so i was a paying customer #3. I needed to use the restroom while i waited for my food and they said they close the bathroom at 6:30pm everyday… Why is the dining room open then?? 6:30pm closing bathroom for what?

author: Okema Brooks
review_text: Purchased a classic double cheeseburger combo, fries were under cooked the patties were slider sized patties on a regular bun Smashed together very Disappointing because I was Hungry food presentation was terrible gave it to my Dog even he was looking crazy at me like you bought this smh

author: Anthony Ladd
review_text: Decided on Panera bread wanted to try to Bread bowl. Meal was nice. Service was great. The associate Make sure that out ingredients was fresh nice.

author: Sky Jay
review_text: This Panera is in a good location, plenty of parking and not a mad house like the Hughes Dr. Location. However, my thoughts about the quality of the food and the customer service fluctuate between a 3 and 4 star rating. The employees here are either very friendly or they are not very. Also the food and drinks are quite pricey for what they are, as most menu items are rather plain tasting - but do seem healthy. With that said, I would probably visit more only if it were more affordable.

author: The Laughing Lion
review_text: This location has a big dining area. I've eaten here over 20 times and I've never had a bad experience. They have a drive thru too. Careful with going late in the day, like after 6 pm because they might run out of certain food options. The parking lot is huge too.

author: Laura Ahmad
review_text: 2 soups, 1 sandwich and a pick 2, $41 otd and had a 25% off coupon that the "general manager" would not honor because of "franchise owned or not." Idk what the deal with the GM was but he would not budge. And to tell a loyal guest that it's not for "my store" like he owns Panera. Well, my family, friends and I will not frequent this location and will have to think about dining at Panera moving forward, especially if they have people like Ben Villalvaso(the GM out of all people) ready to turn people away. Like as if it was coming out of his own pocket. Be aware of this location people. One thing to note, absolutely no one was wearing name tags except Ben. The guy with the pink shirt, don't know if it's someone higher than Ben, but no name tag on him either. Our cashier(had to find her name on receipt) had mucus hanging out of her nose while I was ordering. Not her fault but instead of Ben telling her that the coupon is not valid at "his" location, he should be giving her a heads up to clean her nose out. The worst thing to do when ordering food is to look at someone with snot in both their nostrils. If anyone takes the risk visiting this Panera, GOOD LUCK. My family and I had a terrible experience. Food matched the service sadly. Soups were all cold and sandwich bread was so hard it almost chipped my Aunts tooth. Also, how does a French onion soup have minimal to NO cheese in it? What’s funny is on the receipt shows “accuracy matters”, that’s a lie! NOT WORTH IT

author: Scott Alan Blanchard
review_text: Decent food, but for the price and robots that "greet" and "serve" (and want/expect a tip). I did find one person today actually conversing with a customer and that was lovely. I'd like more options and customizations for salads. Also don't be so stingy with napkins!

author: D J
review_text: Unfortunately I went to Panera which I normally enjoy. Not this time. I went through the drive through to get a drink and a cup of soup. How difficult should this be? It took 15 minutes. I ordered, paid and waited. Nobody updated me and the cars behind me piled up and started beeping at me. I couldn't move because I didn't get my food. It took forever, I had to ask for a spoon and napkin when I did get the order. The girl at the window was somewhat rude. I won't be coming back to this Panera. Hopefully the manager reads these reviews and gets the crews act together. I enjoy the food but don't want to deal with the poor service and lack of attention.

author: Ray Ju
review_text: The parking spaces for the place is more than enough. The decor is simple. The dining area is a good size. They had some pastry on display. They have coffee, tea, and soda choices off to the side. The coffee was tasty. The bear claw and muffin was pretty good. The service was good too.

author: rick pentecost
review_text: I got a bowl of chicken noodle soup and a drink. It was 13.00 and it was not even half a bowl of soup. I would not eat here.

author: C B
review_text: I LOVE Panera and I eat here a lot!! The food is always fresh & delicious and the drive up works great when you are in a hurry. The soups & sandwiches are THE BEST and the bakery items to die for especially the french baguette!! It is addicting!! Love the bagels & orange scones too!! YUM!!!! Friendly staff too!!

author: KNote
review_text: I got the Mediterranean Chicken salad. The chicken was basically cold cut slices of chicken that didn't taste like chicken. The lettuce was not crispy and just about every single leaf was from the core. The salad was mushy. I got a chocolate chip cookie that was stale. Luckily the Dr pepper was okay. But even the slice of bread that came with the meal was as hard as a rock. I don't think I'm ever going to go to a Panera again. The cashier was really good, very friendly. The food wasn't her fault at all. But over $20 for that? What a waste

author: Kelly Daley
review_text: This is a new location, and I'm giving a 1 star in hopes feedback will be taken. I was delivering for UberEats. I asked the female preparing the order for an additional bag to put the beverages in. She refused and continued to argue with me. Saying "if you put them (2 large beverages) in a bag, they will spill). **if someone asks for an additional bag, don't argue** First, ALL of the order should be bagged, including beverages, for the customer's safety. Second, the bag with all the food items was so heavily packed, when I picked it up, the safety seal tore from the weight. This order was not packed properly. You need to put the beverages in a bag, and distribute the remaining order properly so that it will NOT spill or tip over. SN: I have been doing deliveries for over a year now. IF the order does spill, I'd rather it be in a bag (paper or plastic) then all over my car while I'm driving. Please set up delivery orders for success.

author: NDSOLDIER
review_text: This was my first trip to Panera and I thought it was great. I was told about the mac and cheese and I have to agree, it was delicious. I also had the turkey sandwich, it was just as good. The restaurant was very clean and presentable. The staff was very professional, courteous and polite. I will definitely recommend Panera and eat here again.

author: Adam Adam
review_text: I visited the store on Monday 07/24/2023 at 8:15 pm and most of the drinks were out, they closed most of the dining area...usually they don't say "welcome" or "have a good day"! This location should be closed by 9 pm by they start cleaning so early...poor service.

author: Sammie Peters
review_text: I dont often review chains but wanted to give this place a quick shout-out. They have really wonderful management. I've been a few times and they are kind and helpful. Above and beyond. Its clean and spacious as well. Food is good as usual.

author: Queen Nok
review_text: Toasted Italian sandwich. Toasted on the outside which made it very hard/crispy. Like trying to eat a sandwich made of croutons. Ordered whole, could only eat 1/2 because of it being overly salty. If you want your entire week's worth of sodium allowance in one sandwich, then this is the one to eat. I love Panera Bread and am a frequent customer, but this sandwich should be taken off the menu. This sandwich left me with such a bad taste/experience, that I'll probably not have another craving for an Italian sub until next year.

author: Yvette Kelley
review_text: I had a bowl of your THIN WATERY broccoli cheese soup yesterday at your location. I also have broccoli cheese soup at other Panera locations. Have you changed the recipe? it's very watery and thin. I will not be returning to Panera very disappointed. My order number was 2633360. Yucky thin soup never again.

author: Jessica Maloy
review_text: Great restaurant with yummy food & assertive staff. Shelly was friendly, and my tomato soup hit the spot on a cool day. The blueberry muffin & cookie were delish. I'm going to try broccoli- cheddar in a bread bowl next time. 😋 Definitely recommend this Panara location.

author: Raymond Coshuner
review_text: I recently had the misfortune of ordering the strawberry poppy seed salad from Panera Bread, and I was thoroughly disappointed with my experience. The salad was an absolute disaster as it contained rotten produce, which completely ruined the entire meal for me. The strawberries were mushy and had an unpleasant smell, while the lettuce was wilted and unappetizing. It is incredibly disheartening to spend hard-earned money on a supposedly fresh and healthy salad, only to be served subpar ingredients. Panera Bread, you need to prioritize quality control and ensure that your customers receive fresh and edible food. This experience has left me with a strong distaste for your establishment, and I won't be returning anytime soon.

author: Elijah Brooks
review_text: Very welcoming. Food is amazing!! I always get this for lunch but the workers deserve so much credit for creating this amazing atmosphere.

author: Amanda Brendel
review_text: Had to call in order because website wouldn't let me check out. Ordered 6 meals for a business lunch for pick up. I arrived early, ordered a smoothie to wait. Out of bananas which took too long to notify and then to make with another option. Once food was ready, no one offered to help with bringing to my car. Took 3 trips to my car with food bags and drinks. I regularly order from AZ locations and they ate much more willing to offer assistance and appreciation for ordering. Will order somewhere else next time in town. Too many options when given poor service.

author: Dani
review_text: you can always depend on great food here. lots of meat in your sandwich, perfectly cooked on the grill; creamy eggs and crispy juicy bacon; stuffed burritos that will never fall apart. this place reminds me of the very best diners back east. the bustling ambience of those diners is, alas, not present inside Bob's, which seems best suited for well-packed to-go orders. but always, the food here is a satisfying pleasure, and the prices are a relief among other surrounding higher-priced breakfast joints.

author: James Allan
review_text: First time here was 15yrs ago. The office I worked at always ordered breakfast from here! My absolute fave is the Steak and Eggs on Kaiser roll! The other breakfast offerings are equally great. Today I came for lunch. We ordered their Pastrami Sandwich, Philly Cheese Steak, Chicken Fingers, Onion Rings, and Chili Cheese Fries! Everything was D-lish! 100% recommend! Gonna miss this place when I move away from NV!

author: Jorge Narvaez
review_text: Bob may be gone, but his legacy is alive and delicious. Bob’s East Side Deli is still boomin’—same classic sandwiches, same flavor-packed punch. You can taste the pride in every bite. It’s clear the team kept his standards alive: generous portions, fresh ingredients, and no messing around when it comes to quality. RIP to the legend, but his name still stands strong—one bite at a time. If you haven’t been, you’re missing out.

author: Mark Estochin - Realtor Henderson, NV
review_text: This is what I call a "hole in the wall" an east side deli. They have some great food at great prices. It does have new owners since the owner Bob, unfortunately passed unexpectedly. R.I.P. Bob. But the food is always great, service is always great, great location, and they also do deliver. They have great sandwiches as well. I mean how can you pass up the breakfast wrap/burrito for $7.03 with tax?!

author: Matthew Heiser
review_text: Placed a catering pickup order and loved how easy it was to tweak the headcount and adjust right up to the last minute. We got 40 breakfast burritos, sausage, chorizo, bacon, and plain egg with cheese, plus a 25-piece variety Danish tray from Bob's East Side Deli. Everything was a hit—everyone raved about the food. Highly recommend!

author: Ruby Graves
review_text: Had the fondest memories of this place, but it's been totally sold out since the previous owner passed on. Such a shame, stay away in 2025, it's a shell of its former self. :( Food is now mid and overpriced, bread is soggy from overpoured oil/vinegar. No mayo when it used to be homemade. Inside has been corporatized, so it's empty and lifeless. Slower than it ever was when it was busy. Somehow 4 people working behind the counter, but 3 cold sandwiches took 35 minutes.

author: Kyle Montoya
review_text: Breakfast burrito was bland and mediocre. I’m suspicious the tortillas were bought at target. If you put ketchup on eggs, you’ll like this place. If you like flavor, I recommend eating elsewhere.

author: Row Pascua
review_text: I’m very happy that Bob’s East Side Deli is still open for business. I love supporting local businesses and I’m cheering them on. Nice size and clean restaurant. Friendly staff and great food always and surely affordable. Keep it up Bob’s Deli Team! I’ve only been here to pick up food haven’t had a chance to eat inside. Glad that they’re open early mornings a good time to pick up breakfast before going to work. We like the Steak and two eggs (cooked over hard) on a Kaiser Roll and Buffalo Cauliflower with Ranch. Oh so yummy!

author: Richard Romero
review_text: Bob's Eastside Deli is outstanding! We used their catering service for two events—one in October and again last month—and both experiences were exceptional. The food was incredibly fresh and delicious. What really stood out was their attention to detail: each meal was individually labeled with our attendees’ names, ensuring everything got to the right person. I've never seen that level of organization before. Thank you, Bob's Deli, for helping make our RC Boating events so memorable with your fantastic service and amazing food!

author: Juan Hernandez
review_text: I gave you 1 star. Your food the best. Your service the best Your atmosphere awesome. The part I completely did not like was. That you have to impose minimum 20% on tips. Come on be real. The people that eats around you or come in to your stablishment are regular folks. From the neighboring businesses. Be more humble and change that. I'm sure Mr. Bob would never have done that. If he was alive.

author: Brian Bounds
review_text: Hello Bob’s East Side Deli, I want to start out by saying this place Rocks. If anyone is looking for a great Breakfast, or Lunch you must stop here at Bob’s. Bob’s crew that work there are such awesome people they take care of their customers whether it’s the first time or not. So I put on RC Boat races at Sunset park in Las Vegas. The Boating organization is Called NAMBA we have been around for over 50 years. We came to Bob’s with a large request, we asked them if they would be willing to serve lunches for our National event we put on in September of last year 2024. Stacy said sure we came up with a menu. They knocked it out of the park. They had every lunch ready on time, they didn’t miss a lunch they even had name tags on every box. Wow it was amazing what they did. We couldn’t thank them enough. So Now it’s the first weekend in May, we went back to Bob’s East side Deli and asked them if they would be willing to help us out again on Lunches as I put on another RC Boat races at Sunset Park they said for sure. So we came up with another menu and every thing was Great. But this time they went above & Beyond they are not open on Sundays, but she had a crew come in & make are lunches on a day they are not open on. Stacy, her Daughter, & staff NAMBA & I can’t thank you enough for the wonderful lunches you provided us with. Thank you so much. So if you live here or if you’re just visiting from out of town please Stop here you will not be disappointed. Brian

author: Trav23 Angel
review_text: Nice spot as a new Yorker of course katz is #1 but on the west coast I'd pick this spot Mariano delicious 😋

author: neal elsey
review_text: If you haven't tried this deli, please do yourself a favor and get here asap. Everything that I've tried has been great or amazing. Made with love and very fair prices. I stumbled upon this by accident, and now I'm hooked. Their patty melt was the best I've ever had at any restaurant.

author: J H
review_text: My first time at this place was this past weekend and I wanted it to be so good as I love my Boar's Head Meats. I paid almost $15 for a sandwich and drink which I have no problem paying, but when I get the amount of meat I got on my sandwich, that's when there is a problem. I know what they pay per lb for the meat I got and I feel ripped off. The meat was also not very fresh looking like you would usually get at the grocery store or other places. It had definitely been sitting around for a bit. So disappointed as I was hoping this was my new go to spot. Such a shame and it looks as though I should have gone when Bob was alive. I feel duped

author: David Hed
review_text: Bob's is probably best for takeout. My food was brought to my table on a Styrofoam plate with plastic wrapped utensils. The price is right (except the 50¢ surcharge PER EGG in your order) and service is quick though, so you'll see the blue collar clientele quickly rotate through the tables.

author: James Smith
review_text: My favorite sandwich place in the US. Always great service and fresh sandwiches.

author: Jaie Mo
review_text: The food is awesome here I actually met the new owner and I also met the former owners wife they were real nice. Customer service was awesome and on top of that the food was great. I ordered a pastrami sandwich which was very delicious, if you haven’t been there, what are you waiting for? It’s great.

author: Chris Lis
review_text: Haven’t been here in several years, but was working on that side of town and stopped. Had a Tolls Creation loaded with meat and crispy hot fries were excellent. Will def try and get by more often in the future.

author: Jami R.
review_text: Cold delis were great! The French dip was mediocre. Could have seasoned the meat while cooking. Service was wonderful.

author: Michael Holstrom
review_text: The ladies that work here are sweet and always smiling. We love Bob's Deli and come every week on our bike rides. They have won us over with their great sandwiches and service.

author: Jess
review_text: We decided to visit for the first time after seeing their Instagram story, and the restaurant is tucked away on the outer edge of the Vegas Strip. You can tell the building has been well-loved and maintained. The atmosphere is decent, and the food comes out quickly with great presentation. We’re big BBQ fans, and while the smoke flavor was fine, it wasn’t anything exceptional. I ordered the tostada plate, which comes with three small tostadas brisket, chicken, and another beef. Those were great, and the chicken was amazing. 2nd order ribs and sides. The ribs, however, needed a bit more time; the meat didn’t come off the bone easily, so they were just okay overall.

author: Justin Webee
review_text: Great BBQ and worth the drive! I’ll start by saying I don’t usually go to places I see on Instagram or TikTok — but my son asked if we could check this one out, so we made the drive. Totally worth it in the end! First impression: the place looks kinda closed from the outside (half the signage is out, so maybe fix that, guys). But don’t worry, it’s definitely open during normal business hours. We walked in and were greeted right away. The hostess asked if we wanted a booth or table, we went with a booth. The dining room isn’t huge, but it’s clean and comfortable. Looks like they do a lot of takeout, too. Our waitress could’ve been a little more upbeat, but the food runner totally made up for it — super friendly and took time to explain everything. We ordered the Grande Family Platter ($110) which came with: • Full rack of pork ribs • 1 lb pulled pork • 1 lb brisket • 1 qt Hatch chili mac & cheese • 1 qt sweet & spicy Brussels sprouts • 6 Hawaiian garlic biscuits • Plus pickles and pickled onions Everything came out hot and fresh. The smoke was on point, the flavors were fantastic, and the OG BBQ sauce was legit — a little spicy but really balanced. All in all, great food, solid service, and definitely worth checking out. You won’t be disappointed!

author: Charlie Te
review_text: This pace has been on my radar for awhile and I am glad that I got a chance to check it out veggie heading back home. We ordered a variety of items on the menu just because it all sounded good. The barbacoa tacos, burnt ends, ribs, brisket, and hot link were all tasty. I did really enjoy their Hatch Chile Mac & Cheese and street corn as well. I really don't think you can go wrong with anything here.

author: Ashley C
review_text: We finally got to try Humo barbecue and it did not disappoint. Their concept is a fusion of Mexican and American barbecue. If you’re a meat lover, this is your place! We ordered the half rack, mouthwatering ribs, Barbacoa tacos, sliced brisket, half roasted chicken, and an order of fries. Our favorite were the ribs and tacos. The prices were great, the service was fabulous!

author: Chuck Roast
review_text: The 3 different employees I encountered in my pickup order were all extremely friendly and made me feel welcomed! The food quality was fantastic! I really enjoyed everything we ordered the burnt ends, the brisket, bacon jam brisket, brisket taco, and the hatch chili mac and cheese. I jave been wanting to try this place for awhile and it did not disappoint!

author: MRS. KR
review_text: This barbecue spot is really good, it surprise me. The host was straight forward not friendly. It took a while for our server to come to the table. But when she did and the drinks and food came out, the story changed… delicious margarita and the platter was amazing however the Mac n cheese just not my style. The dessert was just enough to satisfy the sweet tooth. Really good place, I would go back and recommend!!

author: claire wiedmann
review_text: This local restaurant at Sunset and Sandhill serves delicious barbeque meats with a Mexican twist. We got the Tostada Flight which I loved but my boyfriend would have perfered a bowl because it had salad on too of the meats. We shared the half of the burnt ends which had a most flavored sauce where we didn't have to add a barbeque sauce. They had 3 tasty sauces on the table which I added to my tostadas. We chose the 16 oz hatch chili Mac. & Cheese which was one of the best I ever had. Our server was great because he was attentive, took the time to explain the menu, and timely with the meal delivery. The restaurant lost a star because it was so cold in there (90 degrees outside) that I needed a sweater. Thus, I was too cold to enjoy the delicious meal fully. The other downside for me was they didn't serve plain churros there which I like simple deserts.

author: JR
review_text: Gabby was very nice. Her recommendations were on point! The Burnt ends and brisket were great. The chorizo refried beans were delicious. Almost wish I did not have to leave.

author: Wm R
review_text: Met up with a friend for lunch. I had this place on my list and she had been here and confirmed it was good. Located in a commercial plaza so parking was easy to find. We were quickly seated. She knew what she wanted and I took a few moments to look at the menu. I ended up going w to meats and one side. Requested the brisket and burnt ends along with the street corn. Wow the meat was delicious and juicy. The sauce was on point. We sat in a booth. There was plenty of art around and that added to the atmosphere. We sat there and talked for quite awhile.

author: Nick Miner
review_text: The brisket is really brisket unlike a lot of bbq places in Vegas. However, it is boiled with no flavor. The burnt ends were pretty good. I'll come back for those. But save your money on the brisket. Both dishes came covered in pickles. I don't want pickle flavored meat, guys. Please put that on the side. I was seated promtly. My order was taken and brought quickly. No complaints there. The music was far too loud. Prices are in line with everywhere else. Just to be clear, PLEASE PUT THE PICKLES ON A SEPARATE PLATE.

author: Brian Tai
review_text: The social media advertisements make this place look pretty good. The BBQ and food overall however, is very average. The pork ribs fell off the bone; that's not a good thing. Over steamed ribs fall off the bone. Well prepared BBQ comes off cleanly with the bite but still has structure. The brisket was very dry. The burnt ends were hit or miss. I did like the sides however. For vegas, this is "fine". I'd eat here again, but I wouldn't go out of my way to take people here bragging about it.

author: mikel simmons
review_text: I went with my cousin, when we arrived the music was a little loud so we asked them to turn it down. We ordered our food and it arrived quick. I tasted the Mac and cheese, I didn’t like it but my cousin gave it a strong 9. I tasted the potato salad, didn’t like it but I was told that it’s ordered a lot. They didn’t have baked beans. The ribs were a solid 10 the burnt ends were a solid 10 and they give you enough. Would I go back YES… The service was great.

author: David Mariscal
review_text: Amazing Barbecue!!! The burnt ends and brisket are as good as any place in Texas, and those ribs are so meaty and tender, the smoky flavor is here with a fantastic selection of sauces. Don’t miss out on the sides the street corn and sweet Brussels sprouts were straight fire. Great service and personable staff make this hidden gem a BBQ goldmine!

author: Patrick
review_text: I found this place on IG. This is the best BBQ I've ever had anywhere. Better than John Brown in LIC Queens, Mighty Quinn in NYC, Hometown in Brooklyn or Truth, and Pinkerton in Houston. Their sausage links were on point! Can't wait to bring the family here next year when we come for the Big Foot Tournament.

author: Melinda
review_text: This was our first time at Humo BBQ and we're hoping they'll expand across town b/c this one is 20 miles from our house. So good it's worth the drive though. We shared: Two Meats - Two Sides (Burnt Ends, Hot Link - Chorizo Refried Beans, French Fries) for $26. A bit pricey, but a lot of food. Four Tacos (generous portions of Barbacoa, Brisket, Pulled Pork, Potato) for just $3 each! Chan was an efficient and friendly server, honoring our wish to avoid the dreaded soapy-tasting cilantro (which meant we couldn't order the delicious-sounding Hatch Chile Mac & Cheese or Humo Street Corn unfortunately). But he also double-checked with the kitchen and the owner (manager?) told us the Chile Verde served with the tacos also has cilantro so they would eliminate it also. Excellent service and delicious food!

author: Jorge Chiman
review_text: I always see this spot and never got around to going, and now I realize I've missed out this whole time! The atmosphere is giving tex mex, the food is full of flavor and the sides are very diverse. Not one overpowers the other. I got the BBQ chicken and pulled pork and it had a good mix of sweet and spicy with the Mac and cheese and chorizo beans. Overall solid experience would definitely come again. Make sure you save room for dessert the portions are bigger than they seem.

author: Roberto Robledo
review_text: Food was delicious all the way from the Burnt Ends (food item) to the sauce they used. The bread was also soft and buttery. Also the Jamaica was home made. And the dessert we went with the bread pudding w the ice cream also superb. Highly recommend and plan on returning for more food items. Wow!

author: Harrison K
review_text: Great BBQ! I love the Latino influence in the BBQ flavors! Meat was falling off the bone. Sorry, I hit the ribs before taking the pic 😁. You have to try the hatch chili Mac n cheese. Only downfall is there are a lot of hard surfaces in the dining area and sound echos a lot. For most folks that's fine but I have some hearing damage in one ear and it was hard to have a conversation. Even with that said, I'm still going back!

author: Brenda Alvarez
review_text: This is our 3rd time coming and we have no complaints. Well just one thing to keep in mind Sunday’s they tend to run out of some items which is not a biggie for us. The food is great the ribs are full of flavor and fall off the bone. Best sides in my opinion and my parents is the potato salad and the corn. Definitely worth a try.

author: Lupita Luna
review_text: The meat was delicious tender and very flavorful. We had the Chico platter it had half slab of ribs and half chicken for me and my husband and some brisket all the choices were magnificent! The meat smelled delicious and tasted you could tell how well they brined it. Anyhow we had left overs and that’s what had for next day lunch. The spot was picked by my husband 🙌

author: Annaliese
review_text: I’ve been to this place a few times and unless you’re getting specialty donuts, quiche, or their freshly made cinnamon rolls their general donuts aren’t that great. Specific instance is their glazed donuts and donut holes are cakey not airy. And others like maple bar are pretty dry. But if you get specialty ones they pay pretty good attention and have fun flavors. One of my favorites are their peanutbutter and jelly. They also made some pretty good caramel and blueberry pie donuts as well. Perfect amount of filling in those.

author: Neil May (Spartan Claim Resources)
review_text: Great selection. My vendors love it when I bring boxes to their offices. I bought this cute 3d printed spider for my grandson who is obsessed with jumping spiders.

author: Charles Cheese
review_text: If you’re looking for dry donuts that taste a day old, just come in after 7 AM. And don’t expect a true “Baker’s Dozen” anymore—apparently 12 is the new 13 here. Very sloppy. Staff also seem irritated if you don’t tip, which just adds to the negative experience. On top of that, it feels unprofessional when employees switch to Spanish to give certain customers extras. The combination of stale donuts, no extra piece, and poor service is disappointing. I’m not the only one who noticed—there were over 10 people with me upset about the change from 13 to 12. One customer lost, and probably more to follow.

author: Rohan Dmello
review_text: Amazingly fresh donuts and friendly people. I don't think I have ever had such fresh donuts anywhere. They even made a custom donut for my son. Coffee was great too. Anytime I'm in Vegas I am going to get donuts from here. I would recommend anyone who like to eat donuts once in a while this place is worth the drive from strip. Compared to other places it's is extremely affordable.

author: Harrison Nguyen
review_text: **Carl's Donuts: A Legacy of Culinary Craftsmanship** Along Sunset Road, Carl's Donuts stands out as a family-owned bakery that blends traditional techniques with innovative practices, rooted in a rich history dating back to its inception in 1966 by Carl and Lyn Sanders at the Wonder World variety store. What sets them apart is their commitment to quality and our ability to balance time-honored methods with contemporary culinary trends. Currently, the third generation of the Ramsay family, Amber and Brock, meticulously uphold the bakery's heritage, ensuring that every product we offer is a testament to our culinary craftsmanship. **First Impressions & Atmosphere** Upon entry, the bakery welcomes patrons with a complex olfactory profile that combines notes of sweetness and warmth, evoking a sense of nostalgia. The design ethos is characterized by minimalistic elegance; carefully curated display cases showcase a selection of pastries, while the customer service area, designed to foster a welcoming environment, makes you feel right at home. A transparent view into the operational kitchen enhances the experience, allowing guests to observe the meticulous production processes that define the bakery's offerings. **Culinary Mastery: Donuts & Pastries** Carl's Donuts showcases a carefully curated menu that emphasizes quality over quantity.
